1011.name: 安比

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
另有小道消息称，安比是妮可在旧都附近的废墟中「捡到」的。因为看上了她不知从何而来的强大战力。
「才不是因为看她厉害！我收留她是因为我人好~」——by妮可
根据安比的日常行为和战斗表现分析推测，她的身上存在一定军事训练的痕迹。
考虑到其履历中的可疑空白，建议：对此人保持一定程度的警惕。
profile.descriptionEn:
Rumors suggest Nicole found Anby near the ruins of the old capital and took her in because she was impressed by her formidable combat abilities.
"It's not because she's strong! I took her in because I'm kind~" — Nicole
Anby's behavior and combat performance suggest she has had military training.
Due to the suspicious gaps in her history, it's advised to maintain a certain level of vigilance towards her.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: FEB 20

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
安比经常来录像店借影片呢，而且每次还得都很快，看起来阅片量很大啊。
有危机感了吗，哥哥？身为录像店店长，我们的阅片量要是不如客人，那可就太丢脸了。
profile.descriptionEn:
Anby often comes to the video store to borrow movies and returns them quickly, so she seems to watch a lot of movies.
Feelin' the pressure, bro? As the manager of the video rental store, it'd be embarrassing if the amount of movies we watch falls behind our customers.

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 说实话，我最好奇的是安比的歌单。因为她一直戴着耳机…到底是在听什么呢？
profile.descriptionEn: Honestly, I'm most curious about Anby's playlist. She's got her headphones on constantly... but what exactly is she listening to?

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对安比的印象：
 · 作为唯一担忧狡兔屋财政的人，安比操碎了心
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Anby:
 · As the only one who's worried about the Cunning Hares' finances, Anby really has it hard.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 电影或许才是安比真正的生活…
profile.descriptionEn: · Maybe movies are Anby's real life...

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 「喜欢电影的不会是坏人」，安比也一样
profile.descriptionEn: · "Movie Lovers Can't be Bad Guys" — Just like Anby

1011.description:
安比，狡兔屋成立最初的雇员（没有之一）。
根据新艾利都居民档案可知，「安比·德玛拉」这一身份在其加入狡兔屋后才凭空出现，且「德玛拉」的姓氏明显取自妮可。而在以狡兔屋雇员的身份进行相关登记之前，安比的个人履历及相关数据全部呈现可疑的空白。
安比虽然极度缺乏常识，但却精通战斗相关事宜，属于狡兔屋最强战力（之一）。

安比最大的兴趣爱好是电影，且涉猎范围极其广泛。或许是因为过度痴迷，她常把电影中的故事当真。
和看起来一副喜怒不形于色的模样不同，安比很容易被一些并不存在的故事情节感动。
最钟意的食物是汉堡，因为「同时包含蛋白质，碳水和绿叶菜，味道好吃，甚至还价格低廉的食物，除了汉堡之外没有其他。」
1011.descriptionEn:
Anby, the original member of Gentle House.
According to the New Eridu resident records, her identity as "Anby Demara" only exists after joining Gentle House, the name obviously being taken from Nicole. Before registering as an employee of Gentle House, all data relating to Anby is suspiciously blank.
Despite her extreme lack of common sense, Anby is well-versed in matters related to combat and is among the strongest combatants of the Cunning Hares.

Anby's greatest interest is movies, of which she likes an extensive range of genres. Due to an excessive obsession, she tends to take the stories in movies as reality.
Contrary to her seemingly emotionless appearance, Anby is easily moved by movie storylines.
Her favorite food is hamburgers because "they contain protein, carbs, and greens, taste good, and are even affordable — there's nothing else besides hamburgers."

skills.name: 普通攻击：伏特速攻
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，前三段造成物理伤害，第四段造成电属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes. The first 3 hits deal Physical DMG, the 4th hit deals Electric DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：落雷
skills.description:
发动[普通攻击]第三段后，长按或停顿后点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行下落打击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
After unleashing the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, hold down or pause for a short while, and then press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike that deals Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：电光挥击
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行上挑斩击，造成电属性伤害；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第三段或[普通攻击：落雷]之后，则能够以更快的速度发动；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes an upward slash that deals Electric DMG.
This attack launches faster when used after the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack or Basic Attack: Thunderbolt.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：苍雷斩
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力上挑斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第三段或[普通攻击：落雷]之后，则能够以更快的速度发动；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash that deals massive Electric DMG.
This attack launches faster when used after the 3rd hit of her Basic Attack or Basic Attack: Thunderbolt.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：滑步
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：电弧斩
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向身周进行斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes all nearby enemies, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：迅雷
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：电磁引擎
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力上挑斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upwards slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：过载引擎
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力上挑斩击，并追加下落攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area followed by several downward strikes, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：降雷
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：电光一闪
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：回旋闪电
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动回旋斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：波动电压
skills.description: 安比在[普通攻击]第三段后发动[普通攻击：落雷]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，招式造成的失衡值提升32%。
skills.descriptionEn: Launch a Basic Attack: Thunderbolt, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack after the 3rd hit of Anby's Basic Attack for an extra 32% Daze.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.label: 基础
levels.description: 安比在[普通攻击]第三段后发动[普通攻击：落雷]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，招式造成的失衡值提升32%。
levels.descriptionEn: Launch a Basic Attack: Thunderbolt, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack after the 3rd hit of Anby's Basic Attack for an extra 32% Daze.

levels.descriptionEn: Launch a Basic Attack: Thunderbolt, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack after the 3rd hit of Anby's Basic Attack for an extra 37.3% Daze.

levels.label: B
levels.description: 安比在[普通攻击]第三段后发动[普通攻击：落雷]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，招式造成的失衡值提升42.6%。
levels.descriptionEn: Launch a Basic Attack: Thunderbolt, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack after the 3rd hit of Anby's Basic Attack for an extra 42.6% Daze.

levels.description: 安比在[普通攻击]第三段后发动[普通攻击：落雷]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，招式造成的失衡值提升48%。
levels.descriptionEn: Launch a Basic Attack: Thunderbolt, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack after the 3rd hit of Anby's Basic Attack for an extra 48% Daze.

levels.description: 安比在[普通攻击]第三段后发动[普通攻击：落雷]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，招式造成的失衡值提升53.3%。

levels.descriptionEn: Launch a Basic Attack: Thunderbolt, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack after the 3rd hit of Anby's Basic Attack for an extra 64% Daze.

skills.name: 额外能力：并联电路
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
安比[闪避反击]命中敌人时，额外回复7.2点能量，5秒内最多触发一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Anby's Dodge Counter hits an enemy, she gains an extra 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

cinema.name: 快充模式
cinema.description: [普通攻击]第四段斩击命中敌人时，安比的能量获得效率提升12%，持续30秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When the 4th hit of Anby's Basic Attack hits an enemy, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 12% for 30s.
cinema.story:
「快充一分钟，战斗半小时！」
为武器加装拓展功能模块的专家是这么保证的——
使用效果也确实符合他的宣言。
cinema.storyEn:
"Charge up for just a minute, and you're set to fight for an hour!" That's the sales pitch for these weapon expansion modules.
And they deliver exactly that.

cinema.name: 精准放电
cinema.description: [普通攻击：落雷]命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，招式造成的伤害提升30%；[强化特殊技]命中未处于失衡状态下的敌人时，招式造成的失衡值提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Basic Attack: Thunderbolt hits a Stunned enemy, its DMG is increased by 30%. When Anby's EX Special Attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, the Daze inflicted is increased by 10%.
cinema.story:
「触电了，就会晕倒。」
少女淡淡的望着面前轰然昏倒的敌人，补了一句：
「电影里都是这么演的。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Electric shocks will knock you out cold."
Looking at the enemy out cold at her feet, she added:
"At least, that's what happens in the movies."

cinema.name: 训练有素
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 奔跑、挥刀、动若雷霆。少女不是探索空洞的生手，而是精于此道的专家。
cinema.storyEn: Run, slash, move like lightning. She is no amateur when it comes to Hollows—she's an expert.

cinema.name: 电荷传导
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，为后场电属性角色回复3点能量；安比每拥有12%能量获得效率，回复量额外提升2点，最多额外提升6点。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Anby launches a Chain Attack or uses her Ultimate, off-field Electric Agents recover 3 Energy.
For every 12% Energy Generation Rate Anby has, recover an additional 2 Energy, up to a maximum of 6.
cinema.story: 单打独斗不是长久之计，老练的盗洞客还会在战斗中适时为队友创造机会。
cinema.storyEn: You won't last long fighting solo. An experienced Hollow Raider knows how to create opportunities for their teammates.

cinema.name: 街头经验
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 狡兔屋的工作不仅能提升心理素质，还能（被迫）提升身体素质。
cinema.storyEn: Working for the Cunning Hares not only builds your mental toughness but also helps (or rather, forces) you to get in shape.

cinema.name: 充能电场
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]时，安比获得8层充能（上限8层）；[普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]命中敌人时，消耗1层充能，使当前招式造成的伤害提升45%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Anby uses her EX Special Attack, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her Basic Attack or Dash Attack, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.
cinema.story:
闪烁的电光在少女的指尖跳跃。
少女抬起头，眼里盛着超出外貌年龄的坚毅。
或许终有一日，她将成为掌控这须臾电光的人。
cinema.storyEn:
Coils of electricity flickered over her fingertips.
Anby raised her head, eyes brimming with determination beyond her years.
Perhaps, one day, she will be the one with total mastery over electricity.

1021.name: 猫又

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
额外信息：在狡兔屋中，猫又似乎对妮可怀有相当的兴趣，但却因此招来安比的不满。
推测原因可能为：「明明是我先来的…」。
profile.descriptionEn: Additional Note: Within the Gentle House, Nekomata seems to hold a significant interest in Nicole, much to Anby's displeasure. The likely reason for this could be summed up as: "I was here first..."

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JUL 30

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
猫猫！谁会不喜欢猫猫！
呜呜呜好想摸摸猫又的尾巴！她还有两条，双倍的快乐！
profile.descriptionEn:
Kitty cat! Who doesn't like kitty cats!
Ohhh, I want to touch Nekomata's tails! She's got two, that's double the fun!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
冷静一点…这可不是新艾利都街头可爱又无害的小猫…
不过在面对猫又的时候，最重要的事应该是守护好自己的钱包吧…
profile.descriptionEn:
Take it easy... She's not some harmless little kitten on the street in New Eridu...
When dealing with Nekomata, the most important thing is keeping an eye on your wallet...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对猫又的印象：
 · 猫的报恩永远让人动容，送「死去的老鼠」除外
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Nekomata:
 · The gratitude of a cat is always so touching... except when they give a dead mouse.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 虽然已离开赤牙帮很久，但猫又依然饱受帮众的尊敬
profile.descriptionEn: · Despite leaving the Red Fang Gang for a while, Nekomata still commands respect within the gang

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 野猫终于也有了可以回去的地方，那里通常被叫做「家」
profile.descriptionEn: · The stray cat finally has a place it can come back to, a place to call "home."

1021.description:
猫宫又奈，通常自称「猫又」。
猫希人，拥有猫科动物的相关特性，在狩猎状态时具有强大的机动性，同时对外界怀有过剩的好奇心。
偶尔会耍些小坏，做一些无伤大雅的恶作剧。但当她盯准了猎物之后，那种猫科动物与生俱来的行动力与专注度，也总会让人感到心惊。
目前最感兴趣的东西是「别人的钱包」。
建议：在与猫又相处时，时刻关注自己钱包的去向。

猫又曾隶属于新艾利都老牌组织「赤牙帮」，自小受到赤牙帮老大「白佬」米格尔的照顾，与其情同父女。后因与赤牙帮产生理念分歧，离开了组织，独自在外漂泊。
在与妮可等人共同经历某些事件后，决意加入狡兔屋，成为狡兔屋的第三位雇员。
1021.descriptionEn:
Nekomiya Mana. Refers to herself as "Nekomata."
A cat Thiren with feline traits, possessing great dexterity when hunting and an insatiable curiosity about the outside world.
Sometimes mischievous, she engages in harmless pranks. But when she sets her sights on a target, her feline-like agility and focus are enough to leave others in awe.
She's most interested in other people's wallets.
Recommendation: Always keep an eye on your wallet when Nekomata is around.

In the past, Nekomata was a member of the long-standing Red Fang Gang. Its leader, Miguel Silver, took on a fatherly role in her life. Nonetheless, due to differing beliefs from the gang, she opted to part ways and go it alone.
Following certain encounters involving Nicole and others, she eventually opted to enlist in Gentle House, thus becoming the third employee on the team.

skills.name: 普通攻击：猫猫爪刺
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
发动最后一段斩击时，有33.33%的概率重复攻击三次。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
On the last hit, there is a 33.33% chance to repeat this hit 3 times.

Unleashes up to five slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
When the final slash lands on a Stunned enemy, it repeats three additional times.

Hold [Basic Attack] during the first 3 hits of Nekomata's Basic Attack to activate:
Slashes enemies in front and passes through them, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activation, there is a 33.33% chance to repeat this attack 3 times.

Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

variants.name: 特殊技：奇袭

能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful falling slash that deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：打不着喵~
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：尾巴失踪术（潜能觉醒）
skills.description:
当猫又拥有大于等于40点[呼噜能量]时，触发[极限闪避]后点按 【闪避键】 消耗30点[呼噜能量]发动：
猫又进入极限视域，并快速闪身至敌人的身后；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，该招式不消耗闪避次数。
skills.descriptionEn:
With at least 40 Purr Energy and after triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Dodge] and consume 30 Purr Energy to activate:
Nekomata enters Vital View and swiftly moves behind the enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. This skill does not consume dodge uses.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：你在看哪边？
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：虚影双刺
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避反击：绒爪穿刺（潜能觉醒）

发动[闪避：尾巴失踪术]后点按 【普通攻击键】 或拥有大于等于40点[呼噜能量]时长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：刃爪挥击
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：刃爪强袭
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：借用猫爪
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：应激防御
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：迅影
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

variants.name: 核心被动：猫步诡影
variants.description:
猫又[闪避反击]或[快速支援]命中敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升30%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
猫又进入战场会获得40点[呼噜能量]，该效果在勘域模式中每180秒最多触发一次；
当猫又处于接战状态时，每秒获得1点[呼噜能量]，最多积累60点，猫又不同招式命中敌人可以回复不同量的[呼噜能量]；
猫又拥有大于等于40点[呼噜能量]时，触发[极限闪避]后点按 【闪避键】 可以消耗30点[呼噜能量]发动[闪避：尾巴失踪术]，随后点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动一次不消耗[呼噜能量]的[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]；
猫又拥有大于等于40点[呼噜能量]时，长按 【普通攻击键】 消耗40点[呼噜能量]可以发动[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]；
猫又发动[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]会进入[肉球突袭]状态，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，[肉球突袭]状态下猫又自身的攻击命中时均视为从背后命中；
处于[肉球突袭]状态时，猫又自身的攻击命中时会触发[超凶爪印]效果，造成一次等同于自身30%攻击力的物理伤害，该效果每1秒最多触发一次；
猫又发动[终结技]额外回复20点[呼噜能量]，发动[连携技]额外回复10点[呼噜能量]，发动[强化特殊技]额外回复5点[呼噜能量]。
variants.descriptionEn:
When Nekomata's Dodge Counter or Quick Assist hits an enemy, her DMG increases by 30% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Nekomata gains 40 Purr Energy upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Nekomata is in combat, she gains 1 Purr Energy every second, up to a maximum of 60. Different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy when they hit an enemy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy and after triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Dodge] to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail. Then press [Basic Attack] to perform Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw once without consuming Purr Energy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 40 Purr Energy and activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.
When using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw, Nekomata enters the Pawpad Ambush state for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, Nekomata's attacks trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing an additional instance of Physical DMG equal to 30% of her ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Nekomata restores 20 additional Purr Energy when using her Ultimate, 10 when using her Chain Attack, and 5 when using her EX Special Attack.

levels.descriptionEn:

While Nekomata is in combat, she gains 1 Purr Energy every second, up to a maximum of 60. Different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy when they hit an enemy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy and after triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Dodge] to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail. Then press [Basic Attack] to perform Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw once without consuming Purr Energy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 40 Purr Energy and activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.
When using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw, Nekomata enters the Pawpad Ambush state for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, Nekomata's attacks trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing an additional instance of Physical DMG equal to 30% of her ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Nekomata restores 20 additional Purr Energy when using her Ultimate, 10 when using her Chain Attack, and 5 when using her EX Special Attack.

cinema.name: 猎鸟技巧
cinema.description: 从背后攻击命中敌人时，猫又无视目标16%物理伤害抗性；敌方处于失衡状态时，猫又对其的所有攻击均被视为背后攻击。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's Physical RES. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
cinema.story: 娇小的猫又并没有强大的膂力，取而代之的是捕捉对手弱点的眼光，和准确攻击弱点的迅敏。
cinema.storyEn: While Nekomata lacks strength due to her small size, she has the perceptiveness and agility required to locate her enemies' weaknesses and strike right where it hurts most.

cinema.name: 猫鼠游戏
cinema.description: 当场上只有一名敌人且自身位于前场时，猫又的能量获得效率提升25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.
cinema.story:
猫咪们总是更喜欢玩弄猎物。
当场上的「老鼠」只剩一只时，就是独属于她的玩乐时光了。
cinema.storyEn:
Cats always prefer to toy with their prey.
If there's only one mouse left in combat — that's Nekomata's play time.

cinema.name: 好奇的左尾
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
在旧文明的传说里，一根尾巴代表猫的一条命，里面寄宿着多年的生存智慧…
这话是假的，但猫又积累的街头生存经验确实是真的。
cinema.storyEn:
According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within...
Even if that's not true, the experience Nekomata has gained on the streets certainly is.

cinema.name: 磨爪
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]时，猫又的暴击率提升7%，最多叠加2层，持续15秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Nekomata uses her EX Special Attack, her CRIT Rate increases by 7% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times, with each stack's duration being calculated separately.
cinema.story:
「多来点多来点！我全~部都能消化掉哟！」
猫希人舔了舔爪子，眼睛亮晶晶的。
cinema.storyEn:
"Gimme more, gimme MORE! I can eat 'em all~"
Her eyes sparkle as she licks the back of her paws.

cinema.name: 幸运的右尾
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
在旧文明的传说里，一根尾巴代表猫的一条命，里面寄宿着多年的生存智慧…
有时候猫又也会好奇，如果自己能继续幸运地活下去，是不是还会长出新尾巴？
cinema.storyEn: According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within... Sometimes Nekomata wonders to herself: If she is lucky enough to keep surviving, will she eventually grow another tail?

cinema.name: 捕食者血统
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，猫又的暴击伤害提升18%，最多叠加3层，退出接战状态时增益效果结束；猫又击败敌人时，该增益效果直接叠加至层数上限。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Nekomata launches a Chain Attack or uses her Ultimate, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.
cinema.story:
「对猫希人来说，因攻击行为而获得的正向反馈，
极有可能触发他们性格中所潜藏的暴力倾向。
幸运的是，这种倾向似乎并不具有永久性效果…」
——摘自一本破旧的《猫希人不完全研究手册》
cinema.storyEn:
"When a feline Thiren gets positive reinforcement from aggressive behavior,
their latent animalistic tendencies emerge.
Fortunately, these tendencies aren't permanent..."
—Excerpt from the Handbook of Incomplete Research on Feline Thirens

1031.name: 妮可

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
妮可早年曾在孤儿院内待过较长时间。
有传闻称，妮可曾和有名望的家庭达成过收养协议。但不久之后，妮可却再次独自现身于新艾利都某处，并由此开始混迹街头巷尾的生活，直至现在。
profile.descriptionEn:
During her early years, Nicole spent a good amount of time in an orphanage.
There are rumors that Nicole once reached an adoption agreement with a prominent family. Yet, shortly afterward, she reappeared by herself somewhere in New Eridu, and has been out around the streets ever since.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: NOV 11

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 原来妮可在圈子里比我想象的还要有名诶！
profile.descriptionEn: Turns out Nicole is more famous in the biz than I thought huh!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 比起这些锐评，我还是更想看到妮可到目前为止拖欠的所有账单整合。
profile.descriptionEn: Instead of these astute comments, I'm more interested in seeing a comprehensive list of everything Nicole owes us.

profile.descriptionEn:

 · Nicole's afraid of ghosts... Perhaps because of a guilty conscience?

profile.name: 印象 2

profile.descriptionEn: · The usually stingy Nicole is generous when treating the orphanage kids.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 妮可确实是商业领域的天才，再穷也是天才
profile.descriptionEn: · Nicole is a genius when it comes to business. No matter how poor she may be, she is still a genius

1031.description:
在数据库中搜索：妮可，返回相关结果：
「万能事务所『狡兔屋』的经营者」，「街头摸爬滚打出来的人精」，「父母成谜的孤儿」。
妮可旗下事务所原名为「gentle house」，温柔之家。但因其狡猾抠门的处事风格而被戏称为「狡兔屋」。
「这人真是钻钱眼里去了！真不知道她搞这么多钱是要干嘛，好像什么也没干。」
——以上信息原文摘录自绳网热贴：「挂一家离谱的万事屋，我从未见过这种钻到钱眼里的老板！」
对此，当事人的表态为：「这、这是污蔑！听好了，我妮可从来没有钻到钱眼里——因为根本就没钱！」
根据可靠消息，狡兔屋常年处于赤字状态。经营者的「精打细算」似乎并没有为这个组织带来正面效果。
1031.descriptionEn:
Database search: Nicole. Returned results:
"Boss of the odd-job agency, the Cunning Hares," "Streetwise," "Orphan, parents unknown."
Nicole's agency was originally called Gentle House, but due to her reputation of being cunning, it gained the nickname the Cunning Hares.
"She's really into money! I don't know what she's doing with it all though, seems like she's doing nothing."
— The above is a quote from a popular post on Inter-Knot: "Her odd-job agency is outrageous. I've never encountered a boss who knows how to turn everything into profit!"
The individual involved responded, "This, this is a false accusation! I, Nicole, have never been skilled at making money — mainly because I don't have any money to begin with!"
According to reliable sources, the Cunning Hares are constantly in debt, and their "careful budgeting" seems to have no effect on the organization.

skills.name: 普通攻击：狡兔连打
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的打击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：为所欲为
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Do As I Please
skills.description: 发动[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]、[连携技]、[终结技]等招式后，能够上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，提升子弹的威力。
skills.descriptionEn: After using a Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, Nicole can reload, and her Basic Attack and Dash Attack are enhanced, increasing the power of her bullets.

skills.name: 特殊技：糖衣炮弹
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动远程打击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a ranged strike against enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：夹心糖衣炮弹
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Stuffed Sugarcoated Bullet
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力远程打击，并在目标处生成能量场，持续牵引敌人，造成以太伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，在炮口生成小型能量场，持续消耗能量并对近处的敌人造成额外伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
A powerful ranged strike, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] down to charge up this attack, during which a small energy field is generated at the muzzle as Energy is consumed, dealing bonus DMG to enemies nearby.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: 闪避：脱兔
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
拖曳摇杆发动闪避时，长按 【闪避键】 ，可以在闪避中途上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Drag the joystick to dodge, then hold [Dodge] to reload while dodging, enhancing Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks up to 8 times.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：惊喜开箱
skills.nameEn: Dash Attack: Jack in the Box
skills.description:
拖曳摇杆发动闪避后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向对应方向冲刺，并对身周敌人进行打击，造成物理伤害；
未拖曳摇杆发动闪避后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向后躲避，并对前方敌人发动远程打击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
skills.descriptionEn:
When dragging the joystick during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Dashes in the target direction and strikes nearby enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
When not dragging the joystick during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Vaults backward and launches a ranged strike against enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance her Basic Attack and Dash Attack, up to 8 times.

skills.name: 闪避反击：牵制炮击
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向后闪避，并对前方敌人发动远程打击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
skills.descriptionEn:

Dodge backwards and send a ranged strike at enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: 连携技：高价以太爆弹

skills.descriptionEn:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: 终结技：特制以太榴弹

skills.descriptionEn:

skills.name: 额外能力：狡兔三窟
skills.nameEn: Additional Ability: Hare of Many Burrows
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
妮可通过[核心被动：机关箱]对敌人施加减益效果时，所有单位对目标造成的以太伤害额外提升25%，持续3.5秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Nicole's Core Passive: Mechanical Case applies a debuff to an enemy, all units deal 25% more Ether DMG to the target for 3.5s.

cinema.name: 增压强化弹
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]造成的伤害和累积的属性异常积蓄值提升16%；发动[强化特殊技]时，每多蓄力0.1秒，在目标处生成的能量场持续时间提升0.15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: The DMG and the Anomaly Buildup inflicted by Nicole's EX Special Attack increases by 16%. For each additional 0.1s of charging when Nicole activates her EX Special Attack, the duration of the energy field created at the target location increases by 0.15s
cinema.story:
「你们都被我强化了，赶紧上！」
「什么，我、我才没有想趁机逃跑，只是需要休息下而已！」
cinema.storyEn:
"I've juiced you all up! Go get 'em!"
"Huh? I—I wasn't slacking off, I swear — I just needed a break!"

cinema.name: 聚能装置
cinema.description: 触发[核心被动：机关箱]的减益效果时，妮可回复5点能量，15秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Nicole recovers 5 Energy when Core Passive: Mechanical Case's debuff is triggered. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
cinema.story:
「不要小看增加的这一秒钟！」
「你知道这一秒内，我能产生多少价值吗？那可是数都数不清！」
「所以，我再多要10％的补贴，不过分吧？」
cinema.storyEn:
"Never underestimate the value of a single second!"
"Do you have any idea how much extra I can squeeze out of just one second? It's unfathomable!"
"So, can I get a productivity bonus? How about 10%, huh?"

cinema.name: 狡兔智慧
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 既没有卓绝的武力，也没有丰厚的资源，妮可能把狡兔屋运营至今靠的是灵活的头脑。
cinema.storyEn: Without overpowering might or abundant resources, Nicole depended on her own sharp mind to bring the Cunning Hares to where they are today.

cinema.name: 领域扩增

cinema.descriptionEn: When Nicole uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, the diameter of the energy field generated at the target location is increased by 3m.
cinema.story:

1041.name: 「11号」

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
主人，根据您的真实见闻以及代理人安比所提供的证词，「11号」的真名为夏潾，是新艾利都防卫军曾经推行的克隆士兵项目的复制体之一，与安比同样曾隶属于防卫军的「白银小队」。

该研究项目制造了多名绝对听命于防卫军高层的复制体，但受到多方面因素影响，在多年前不得不宣告作废；防卫军意图处理掉该不人道项目的产出与证据，仅保留一名士兵作为代表性成果，这一成果原定人选为安比，但安比为保护「11号」而做出了自毁行为，令「11号」成为了被保留下来的那一位士兵。此后，奥波勒斯小队的队长「鬼火」主动接收了「11号」至自己的队伍中。

由于并不知道这段真相，「11号」一直对安比保持着被抛弃、被背叛的仇恨心理，并以成为比安比更强的最强士兵为奋斗目标。同时，奥波勒斯小队的各位成员与她均相处融洽，她已将小队的众人视作最为重要的战友与同伴。
profile.descriptionEn:
Master, based on your firsthand account and Agent Anby's testimony, Soldier 11's real name is Harin. She's one of the clones from New Eridu's former clone soldier project and, like Anby, once served in the Defense Force's Silver Squad.

This research project produced multiple clones programmed to obey the upper ranks of the Defense Force without question. However, due to various complications, it was scrapped years ago. The Defense Force sought to erase the unethical experiment and its results, preserving only one soldier as a symbolic success. Anby had been the intended candidate, but her self-destructive act to protect Soldier 11 led to Soldier 11 being the one preserved. Magus, captain of Obol Squad, later chose to bring Soldier 11 into her squad.

Having never known the truth, Soldier 11 grew up resenting Anby, feeling abandoned and betrayed. She set her sights on becoming stronger than Anby — stronger than anyone. Still, she developed a strong rapport with her squadmates in Obol Squad, and now considers them her most important allies.

1041.description:
「11号」是新艾利都防卫军的成员，现属于黑曜石营中奥波勒斯小队，担任主攻手。「11号」是她在军队中的代号，其自称早已舍弃了真实的姓名。

「11号」似乎很喜欢辛辣口味的食物，对锦鲤面馆的超辣拉面情有独钟。值得一提的是，目前她每次和我们打招呼时，都会叫出不同的名字。
1041.descriptionEn:
Soldier 11 is a member of the New Eridu Defense Force.
She currently serves as a direct attacker in Obol squad, Obsidian Division. Soldier 11 is a code name — she gave up her real name long ago.

Soldier 11 is a fan of spicy food and likes the super-spicy noodles served at Waterfall Soup.
It's worth noting she currently calls us by a different name every time she greets us.

在必定触发[火力镇压]的状态下，可解锁第五段[普通攻击]，发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，可强化下一次第五段[普通攻击]。强化第五段[普通攻击]发动时可消耗当前所有必定触发[火力镇压]的次数，每消耗一次造成额外火属性伤害。
触发[极限闪避]后，可保留当前普攻段数持续5秒，发动[闪避反击]后点按 【普通攻击键】 可从保留的普攻段数开始发动[普通攻击]。
variants.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] at the right moment to activate:
Launches a stronger slash, dealing Fire DMG.
When Fire Suppression is guaranteed to trigger, pressing [Basic Attack] when the attack is about to end speeds up the transition into the next hit of Basic Attack.
When Fire Suppression is guaranteed to trigger, the 5th hit of the Basic Attack string unlocks. Activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate powers up her next Basic Attack 5th hit. A strengthened Basic Attack 5th hit will consume all remaining guaranteed Fire Suppression activations to deal additional Fire DMG per activation spent.
After triggering a Perfect Dodge, the current Basic Attack hit count is retained for 5s. After performing a Dodge Counter, pressing [Basic Attack] resumes the Basic Attack from the retained hit count.

skills.name: 普通攻击:火力迸发（潜能觉醒）

[普通攻击：火力充能]发动过程中松开 【普通攻击键】 时发动[普通攻击：火力迸发]。
[普通攻击：火力迸发]发动过程中或[普通攻击：火力充能]发动瞬间受到敌方攻击时，可触发格挡反击，免疫该次伤害，并额外获得3次必定触发[火力镇压]的次数，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接至第三段[普通攻击]，上限为8次，

skills.descriptionEn:

Release [Basic Attack] while Basic Attack: Fire Charge is activated to launch Basic Attack: Fire Assault.
If attacked by an enemy during Basic Attack: Fire Assault or the moment Basic Attack: Fire Charge is activated, a Block Counter can be triggered, negating that instance of DMG and granting 3 guaranteed triggers of Fire Suppression. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack, up to 8 times.
While charging, tilting the joystick launches Basic Attack: Blazing Rush.

cinema.name: 快速升温
cinema.description: 成为接战状态下的当前操作角色时，若「11号」的能量不足40点，则立即回复至80点，50秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Soldier 11 becomes the active character in combat, if her Energy is less than 40, her Energy is recovered to 80. This effect can trigger once every 50s.
cinema.story:
长期的高强度实战训练让「11号」掌握了对于自身状态的调控。
她会竭尽全力，保证以最好的状态迎接每一场战斗。
cinema.storyEn:
Long-term high-intensity combat training allows Soldier 11 to complete mastery of her regulatory systems.
She will always strive to ensure that she's in the best shape for each and every battle.

cinema.name: 高温汇聚
cinema.description: 触发[火力镇压]时，[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]造成的伤害提升3%，最多叠加12层，持续15秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When triggering Fire Suppression, Basic Attack, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 3%, up to 12 stacks, lasting 15s, with the duration of each stack calculated separately.
cinema.story:
「虽然她看起来又冷又硬，跟个大冰块似的…」
「实际上内心却是滚烫滚烫的呢，就像有火在燃烧。」
——来自黑曜石营内一位匿名的军人
cinema.storyEn:
"She may look cold and hard, like a big ice cube... But actually, she's scalding hot inside, like a blazing fire."
— From an anonymous soldier of the Obsidian Division

cinema.name: 精锐士兵
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 不论是训练还是实战，「11号」从来都是以最高标准要求自己，故而能一直拥有高标准的战斗力。
cinema.storyEn: Soldier 11 always expects the most from herself, no matter if it's in training or physical combat. That is how she maintains her combat prowess.

cinema.name: 纵情燃烧
cinema.description: [普通攻击]第一、二、三段或[冲刺攻击]发动时，若触发[火力镇压]，则在招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低18%；[普通攻击]第四段发动时，若触发[火力镇压]，则在招式发动期间获得无敌效果。
cinema.descriptionEn:
If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd hit of Soldier 11's Basic Attack or a Dash Attack, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG received is reduced by 18% during skill activation.
If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 4th hit of her Basic Attack, she becomes invulnerable during skill activation.
cinema.story:
她很羡慕火焰。
而这些尽情燃烧着的火焰，也总会帮到她。
cinema.storyEn: She envies fire. And these smoldering flames will always help her.

cinema.name: 完美士兵
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 从精锐到楷模是一次漫长的跨越，但「11号」依然咬牙坚持着，似乎暗中有些什么理由一直鞭策她向完美士兵这一目标努力…
cinema.storyEn: The road from elite to exemplar is long and difficult, but Soldier 11 grits her teeth and perseveres, as if there's something pushing her towards the goal of becoming a perfect soldier...

cinema.name: 炽热心流
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]时，「11号」获得8层充能（上限8层）；触发[火力镇压]时，消耗1层充能，使当前招式无视目标25%火属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Soldier 11 uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks).
When Fire Suppression is triggered, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, causing the current move to ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES.
cinema.story: 剑刃的火焰撩起热浪，银发少女的战斗越来越热烈，那份热度仿佛顺着呼吸渗入了精神，连思考也变得炽热起来。
cinema.storyEn: The flames of the sword distorted the air with their heat. Her movements grew ever more impassioned, as if that heat seeped into her spirit with every breath, igniting her thoughts.

1051.name: 伊德海莉

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
伊德海莉对雨天与泡澡有着非同一般的热爱。
因为这两样喜好能在现实的世界带给她短暂的安宁与平静，让她能够享有片刻闲暇，不再为脑海中承载的纷杂信息流困扰。

然而她的这两样热爱在最近的相处中发生了些许改变。
她不再习惯孤独，不再满怀忐忑与期盼地追逐雨天，不再依靠将身体浸泡在温水中疗愈自我。
她开始在晴朗的天空下漫步，她能从容地穿过熙攘的人群…她开始期待尝试一切对她而言崭新的事物。

而伊德海莉这一切改变的伊始，源自与您的相遇。
profile.descriptionEn:
Yidhari has an unusual fondness for rainy days and long baths.
These two comforts grant her brief moments of peace in the real world, allowing her moments of rest free from the tangled streams of information in her mind.

But lately, her feelings toward these two comforts have changed.
She's grown unaccustomed to being alone, no longer anxiously yearning for the rain, no longer relying on warm baths to heal herself.
She has begun strolling beneath clear skies, moving with ease through bustling crowds... and looking forward to trying everything that feels new to her.
For Yidhari, everything started to change from the moment she met you.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: MAR 19

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
伊德海莉虽然看上去好像对什么都不太关心的样子，但她其实超级细心，还很会照顾人哦！
有次我搬录像带的时候不小心在手上划破了一道小口子，我自己都没发现，她就拿着创可贴给我贴上了！
profile.descriptionEn:
Yidhari always seems like she couldn't care less, but she's actually really thoughtful and knows how to take care of others!
Once, while I was carrying some videotapes, I got a small cut on my hand without even noticing, and she came right over with a bandage and put it on for me!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 同感…之前和她外出的时候，我走得急没吃午餐也被她发现了，说是我的嘴唇有些发白，肯定是没吃东西就赶来了，虽然我自己完全看不出来…
profile.descriptionEn: I know the feeling... When we hung out together before, I was in such a rush, I skipped lunch, and she noticed right away. She said my lips looked pale, so I must have come without eating, even though I couldn't tell myself...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对伊德海莉的印象：
 · 黑暗中分明是冰凉的触感，却给她带来了滚烫的体验。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Yidhari:
 · In the darkness was undeniably cold, yet it burned her with searing heat.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 她没有等到雨天，但她等到了你。
profile.descriptionEn: · She never got the rainy day she was waiting for, but she did get you.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 想要与在意的人一起前行。
profile.descriptionEn: · She wants to continue forward with those she cares about.

1051.description:
伊德海莉，除了代理人的身份外，也兼任绳匠以及怪啖屋的投稿作者。
在其他人看来，伊德海莉在寻常情况下待人处事总有种闲适的慵懒感，不过就记录的资料来判断，相较于慵懒这样的描述，她更像在被一种与周遭环境格格不入的虚无感所包裹。
或许对多数人而言，这是沉浸创作之人的通病——作为天赋异禀的怪诞故事作者，伊德海莉应当比其他人更容易沉浸在自己构造的幻想世界中。
可实际上，她的异常表现更多是源自自身能力带来的负担。
她在空洞中能接触到常人难以想象的庞大信息，那些信息纠缠着空洞中长年累月堆积的过往。而这无数过往积累的负荷不断冲击着她对现实的感知，最终连同情感也在冲刷下逐渐变得迟钝。
能够承受这份负担，将其变成自己的能力之余还能用自己的方式正常生活，便是伊德海莉超越常人的天赋。
1051.descriptionEn:
In addition to her role as an Agent, Yidhari doubles as both a Proxy, and a contributor for Spook Shack.
To most, she comes across as laid-back and leisurely, but according to records, it's less "laziness" than a shroud of nothingness, leaving her at odds with the world around her.
Perhaps to most people, this would seem like the usual quirk of someone absorbed in their craft. As a gifted writer of bizarre tales, Yidhari should be more prone than most to immersing herself in the worlds of her own imagination.
In truth, however, her unusual behavior stems more from the burden of her own abilities.
In the Hollows, she's exposed to vast torrents of information unimaginable to most, tangled with years upon years of memories that have amassed there. That crushing weight of countless pasts constantly batters her sense of reality, until even her emotions are gradually worn dull.
The fact that she can bear this burden, turn it into her own strength, and still live life in her own way — that's what sets Yidhari apart as gifted beyond others.

skills.name: 普通攻击：碎惘沉击
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的打击，造成冰属性伤害。
第三段打击命中时，伊德海莉将回复10%生命值。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Ice DMG.
On the 3rd hit, Yidhari recovers 10% HP.

skills.name: 普通攻击：霜寒拥覆
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
伊德海莉开始蓄力，蓄力会持续消耗生命值，最多可以进行三段蓄力，松开 【普通攻击键】 时，伊德海莉将根据当前蓄力段数，前方发动强力蓄力锤击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
伊德海莉生命值越多，蓄力消耗生命值的速度越快，最多消耗生命值至最大生命值的25%；
蓄力段数达到2时，招式发动后，点击 【普通攻击键】 ，可以直接衔接第三段[普通攻击：碎惘沉击]，通过这种方式发动的[普通攻击：碎惘沉击]伤害会根据当前的蓄力段数提升，最多提升30%，
蓄力段数达到3时，蓄力招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，点击 【普通攻击键】 ，可以提前衔接至终结下砸。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Yidhari begins charging, continuously consuming HP to reach up to three levels of charge. When [Basic Attack] is released, Yidhari unleashes a powerful charged hammer attack in front based on the current charge level, dealing massive Ice DMG.
The higher Yidhari's HP, the faster charging consumes it. HP consumption will at most reduce Yidhari's HP to 25% of Max HP.
At 2 charge levels, after using the skill, press [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Crushing Strike. The DMG of a Basic Attack: Crushing Strike triggered this way increases based on the current charge level, up to 30%.
At 3 charge levels, Yidhari gains increased Anti-Interrupt level during the charged skill. Press [Basic Attack] to chain early into the finishing smash.

skills.name: 霜凝千钧
skills.description:
在[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的蓄力或旋转横挥期间受到敌方攻击时，可以用触手格挡，使受到的伤害降低25%；
如果此时正在蓄力或蓄力段数未满，则会用触手借势反击敌人，回到蓄力姿态并立刻提升1段蓄力等级，对前方敌人造成冰属性伤害；
在霜凝千钧期间点击 【普通攻击键】 ，伊德海莉会基于当前蓄力等级立刻发动[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的下砸终结攻击。
在霜凝千钧期间点击 【特殊技键】 、 【强化特殊技键】 ，伊德海莉会发动必定触发[溯寒]的[特殊技：溯寒追碾]
skills.descriptionEn:
While charging or spinning during Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace, if hit by an enemy, Yidhari can block with her tentacles, reducing the DMG taken by 25%.
If charging or not yet at full charge, Yidhari counterattacks with her tentacles, returning to the charging stance and instantly gaining 1 charge level, while also dealing Ice DMG to enemies ahead.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing [Basic Attack] makes Yidhari immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on her current charge level.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] makes Yidhari unleash a Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit that is guaranteed to trigger Surging Cold.

skills.name: 特殊技：断想
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
挑飞前方敌人，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：缠霜
skills.description:
闪能足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
连续上挑两次，并挥出冰雾，造成大量冰属性伤害；
[强化特殊技：缠霜]若成功命中敌人，会在招式发动结束时回复生命值，回复量相当于伊德海莉已损失生命值的33%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform two consecutive upward strikes, then release an icy mist, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If EX Special Attack: Frost Coil hits an enemy, Yidhari recovers HP at the end of the skill equal to 33% of her missing HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：溯寒追碾
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit
skills.description:
在[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的蓄力或旋转横挥期间，点按 【特殊技键】 、 【强化特殊技键】 或在保持按住 【普通攻击键】 的同时点按 【闪避键】 发动：
挑飞前方敌人，造成冰属性伤害；
招式的攻击和敌人的攻击发生相撞时，会触发[溯寒]；
招式攻击命中处于失衡状态下的敌人，且闪能足够时，会触发[追碾]；
触发[溯寒]或[追碾]时，立刻提升蓄力等级至最大值；
招式发动期间点击 【普通攻击键】 ，伊德海莉会基于当前蓄力等级立刻发动[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的下砸终结攻击。
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] while charging or spinning during Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace, or press [Dodge] while holding [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Ice DMG.
When the skill's attack collides with an enemy's attack, it triggers Surging Cold.
If the skill hits a Stunned enemy, and with sufficient Adrenaline, it triggers Crushing Pursuit.
Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit instantly raises the charge level to maximum.
During this skill, press [Basic Attack] and Yidhari will immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on the current charge level.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：极寒重碾
skills.description:
触发[溯寒]或[追碾]，且闪能足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 或 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方冲刺、快速上挑并腾空跃起，随后发动强力的下砸攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]若成功命中敌人，会在招式发动结束时回复生命值，回复量相当于伊德海莉已损失生命值的33%；
若在[溯寒]后发动招式，额外回复15闪能，1秒内最多触发1次。
招式发动后，点击 【普通攻击键】 ，会基于当前蓄力等级立刻发动[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的下砸终结攻击。
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit, and with enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] or [Basic Attack] to activate:
Dash forward with an upward attack, then leap into the air before delivering a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush hits an enemy, Yidhari heals at the end of the skill for 33% of her missing HP.
If the skill is used after Surging Cold, it grants an additional 15 Adrenaline. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on the current charge level.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：迁梦
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：霜华突撼
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行打击，造成冰属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Strike forward, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：冰曳回震
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：踱寒践约
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]中时，会召唤触手进行协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike against enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, tentacles join in the assault, further enhancing the skill's power.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 以太帷幕·涌泉
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]、[强化特殊技：缠霜]、[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]、[连携技：踱寒践约]最后一击命中敌人时，将消耗3000喧响值，并开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效期间，全队角色最大生命值提升5%，持续30秒，重复触发延长持续时间，最多延长至300秒；
伊德海莉处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]中时，[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的蓄力速度增加、蓄力消耗生命值速度增加。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, the final hit of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace, EX Special Attack: Frost Coil, EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush, and Chain Attack: Frostbound Oath will consume 3,000 Decibels to activate an Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5% for 30s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 300s.
While Yidhari is within Ether Veil: Wellspring, the charge speed of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace increases, and HP is consumed faster during charging.

skills.name: 终结技：终幕·惘事渡却
skills.nameEn: Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret
skills.description:
伊德海莉消耗喧响值开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]后，在30秒内点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人进行强力打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
伊德海莉每次消耗喧响值开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，最多发动1次[终结技：终幕·惘事渡却]。
skills.descriptionEn:
After Yidhari expends Decibels to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring, press [Ultimate] within 30s to activate:
Deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Each time Yidhari expends Decibels to activate an Ether Veil: Wellspring, she can use Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret once.

skills.name: 快速支援：撼霜驰援
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：闪震格拒
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：冰袭痛击
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动冰片锤击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Execute an ice shard hammer attack against enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：拾梦空想
skills.description:
伊德海莉会额外根据自身最大生命值提高贯穿力，每1点最大生命值将提高0.1点贯穿力；
伊德海莉发动招式造成的冰属性伤害均为贯穿伤害，无视敌人防御，使用贯穿力作为招式伤害倍率；伊德海莉进入战场时即可恢复60闪能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，
伊德海莉的当前生命值百分比越低，招式造成的伤害越高；
当伊德海莉生命值低于50%时，获得的增益效果达到最大值，攻击造成的伤害最多提升50%，伊德海莉生命值重新回到50%后，最大值增益效果仍会持续5秒；
伊德海莉通过招式命中获得喧响值降低，伊德海莉生命值降低时，获得喧响值，每降低1%生命值会获得10点喧响值。
skills.descriptionEn:
Yidhari gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Ice DMG dealt by Yidhari deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier. When Yidhari enters battle, she immediately gains 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to 50%. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.
Yidhari gains fewer Decibels from landing skills. Instead, she gains Decibels as her HP decreases, with every 1% HP lost granting 10 Decibels.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

skills.name: 额外能力：完形叙事
skills.description:
队伍中存在[击破]角色或[支援]角色时触发：
伊德海莉生命值低于50%时，暴击伤害提升30%，受到的伤害降低25%；
伊德海莉处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]中时，额外获得以下效果：
伊德海莉的[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]第三段蓄力攻击、[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]的招式结束后，将召唤寒冰触手进行攻击，造成额外伤害，每12秒最多触发1次；
发动上述招式视为发动[强化特殊技]，伤害倍率跟随强化特殊技的技能等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
When Yidhari's HP falls below 50%, CRIT DMG increases by 30% and DMG taken is reduced by 25%.
While Yidhari is within Ether Veil: Wellspring, she gains the following additional effect:
After the level 3 charged attack of Yidhari's Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace or EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush, an icy tentacle is summoned to attack, dealing extra damage. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
The above skill is considered an EX Special Attack, the DMG multiplier increases based on the EX Special Attack's level.

cinema.name: 过往沉溺于渊下
cinema.nameEn: The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss
cinema.description: 伊德海莉发动[强化特殊技]所需消耗的闪能减少10点；发动[强化特殊技：缠霜]或[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]后，保持长按「普通攻击」或「特殊攻击」按键，可以消耗35闪能，放弃回复生命值并立即衔接1次[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]，并使本次[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]回复的生命值额外提升100%；伊德海莉的[普通攻击]、[强化特殊技]无视目标20%冰属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Adrenaline cost to activate Yidhari's EX Special Attack is reduced by 10. After using EX Special Attack: Frost Coil or EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush, keeping hold of the Basic Attack or Special Attack button consumes 35 Adrenaline to forgo healing and immediately chain into another EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush. The HP restored by this EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush is increased by 100% of the original value. Yidhari's Basic Attacks and EX Special Attacks ignore 20% of targets' Ice RES.
cinema.story:
她在跌入深不可测的秘境。
——这里是何处，又将跌向何方？
心下生出这份疑惑时，黑暗里好像有个声音在答：
「这里是未知之处，将通向尽知之方。」
还有阴影紧跟身边一同坠下，重重叠叠，无有穷尽。
——他们又是什么人，为什么他们的影子在这里落下？
脑海浮现这般不解后，那个声音便再道：
「他们是命运断绝之人，这里落下的是他们的过往。」
于是，小小的女孩孤独地拥抱着自己，为那无数逝去的过往裹挟着，向下坠落。
她茫然地睁大眼睛，放眼望去，在这渊底绽放的尽是冰冷、死寂、孤独。
cinema.storyEn:
She plunged into an unfathomable abyss.
—What is this place, and where will it carry her?
The moment doubt arose, a voice whispered from the darkness:
"This is the realm of the unknown, opening the path to all that is known."
Endless shadows tumbled down with her.
—Who are they, and why do their shadows fall here?
As the question rose in her thoughts, the voice replied once more:
"They are those cut off from fate. What falls here are the remnants of their past."
And so, the little girl hugged herself in solitude, carried downward by countless bygone memories.
Her eyes widened in bewilderment, seeing only cold, stillness, and loneliness blooming at the bottom of the abyss.

cinema.name: 何人于此遐思
cinema.nameEn: Who Lingers Here, Lost in Thought?
cinema.description: 伊德海莉的暴击伤害提升40%；成功触发[溯寒]或[追碾]后，持续回复闪能，每秒回复0.5点，最多30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: Yidhari's CRIT DMG increases by 40%. Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit grants Adrenaline regen of 0.5/s for up to 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
黑暗里沉睡着女孩的遐思。
并非童真的奇思妙想，并非无拘的天马行空。
她在思考那些能见的过往。
「需要我做些什么？需要我来承担什么？」
「幸好是我，不是其他人。」
「我很擅长处理这份孤独…大概吧。」
翻阅着那些过往，女孩坦然地接受这份有些沉重的天赋。
cinema.storyEn:
In the darkness lay the girl's slumbering thoughts.
They were not innocent daydreams, nor carefree flights of fancy.
Her mind was fixed on the memories she had witnessed.
"What must I do? What must I bear?"
"Good thing it's me, and not someone else."
"I know how to deal with being alone... I think."
As she sifted through those pasts, the girl calmly accepted this heavy gift.

cinema.name: 无人聆听的故事
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
人类原来是这样复杂的存在。
一辈子可以有这么多的欢喜，有那么多的悲伤。
可如今它们尽数落入这片虚无，将被吞没，将被泯灭，将被埋葬。
无人会再在意这些欢欣的笑声，那些悲恸的哭泣。
可是啊，这些无人聆听的故事啊，它们都被刻在了这座心渊。
cinema.storyEn:
So this is what humanity is — such a complex existence.
A lifetime can hold so much joy, and just as much sorrow.
Yet now, all of it has fallen into this void, to be swallowed, erased, and buried.
No one will ever care again for those joyful laughs, or those grief-stricken cries.
Still... every one of those untold stories has been etched into this abyss of the soul.

cinema.name: 在静默中盛放
cinema.description: [核心被动：拾梦空想]中，生命值降低时，伊德海莉获得的喧响值增加10%；处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]中时，伊德海莉的最大生命值额外提升5%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Yidhari gains 10% more Decibels when losing HP for Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection. While in Ether Veil: Wellspring, Yidhari's Max HP is further increased by 5%.
cinema.story:
那朵花在黑暗中颤巍巍地绽放着，白色的、透明的，像是照着这座渊底唯一的光。
——原来那是一个脆弱又坚强的灵魂。
在那无数下坠的黑影之中，在那层层冲刷而下的过往中…她没有被浸染，依然坚强地绽放着自我。
可终究…她也会在无依的飘摇中消散？
cinema.storyEn:
The flower trembled as it bloomed in the dark, white and translucent, as though it reflected the lone light of the abyss's depths.
—It was, in truth, a soul, fragile yet unyielding.
Amid the countless falling shadows, amid the flood of cascading memories... she remained untouched, still blooming with her own strength.
But in the end... will she too fade away, drifting with nothing to hold on to?

cinema.name: 并非虚构的慰藉
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「好漂亮的眼睛…我还在梦里吗…」
这是初次的相见，也是与「真实」的相遇。
在那虚妄，怪诞，好似能将吞噬一切的荒芜渊底，她望见了那双眼睛。
就好似炎热沙漠里钻出的一抹绿意，干涸河床中涌出的一眼清泉。
「我好像得到了呢…会主动予以我回应的期待。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Such beautiful eyes... am I still inside a dream?"
It was their first meeting, and her first brush with something real.
Amid the emptiness and the grotesque, in the barren abyss that threatened to devour everything, she caught sight of those eyes.
They were like a hint of green breaking through the burning desert, like a clear spring rising from a parched riverbed.
"I think I've found it... the hope of someone who will willingly respond to me."

cinema.name: 终逢安宁之梦
cinema.description: 伊德海莉消耗喧响值开启或延长[以太帷幕·涌泉]后，将获得[启谛]，持续30秒；[启谛]期间，伊德海莉造成的贯穿伤害提高25%，首次受到致命伤害时，生命值最多降低至1，在5秒内不会战败退场并持续回复25%生命值。
cinema.descriptionEn: After Yidhari spends Decibels to activate or extend Ether Veil: Wellspring, she gains Erudition for 30s. While Erudition is active, her Sheer DMG increases by 25%. Also, upon taking fatal DMG for the first time, her HP is reduced to at most 1, and for the next 5s, she cannot be defeated and will restore 25% HP over time.
cinema.story:
沉溺在那些翻涌的过往时，她不曾有须臾安宁。
唯有向孤独索取——避开繁世的嘈杂，沉浸在怪诞的故事里，在朦胧的雨雾遮蔽下，亦或是温暖的水流拥护中，求取片刻静谧。
可如今她能安然漫步于人潮之中，不再烦恼声色的喧闹，阳光的灼烈，因为「虚妄」不再困囿她的精神，「真实」使她的灵魂得以依托。
cinema.storyEn:
Immersed in the tide of memories, she had never found even fleeting rest.
Her only refuge was solitude, escaping the bustle of the world, losing herself in strange tales, seeking quiet beneath veils of misty rain or within the embrace of warm waters.
But now, she can walk calmly among the crowds, no longer troubled by noise or the burning sun, for "illusion" no longer binds her spirit, and "reality" has become the anchor of her soul.

profile.description: 可琳的市民健康档案显示，在加入维多利亚家政之前，她曾有过一段病危经历，接受了某个重大手术后才得以恢复健康。
profile.descriptionEn: Corin's health record reveals that before joining Victoria Housekeeping, she faced a critical illness and underwent major surgery.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JUN 2

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
可琳明明就很优秀，为什么总是这么不相信自己呢…
真想把我的自信分一半给她~
profile.descriptionEn:
Corin is excellent at her work, but why does she lack confidence in herself...?
If only I could share half of my confidence with her!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
有些人的性格生来就是更内向敏感一些的，还好可琳的同伴们都完全信任她的能力。
铃，我们以后有机会的话，也多多鼓励她吧。
profile.descriptionEn:
Some people are just introverted and sensitive. Fortunately, Corin's companions have complete faith in her capabilities.
Belle, let's encourage her whenever we have the opportunity.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对可琳的印象：
 · 可琳好像不太自信？不管做什么都慌慌张张的…
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Corin:
 · Corin seems to be lacking confidence...? She always panics about everything she does...

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 只要给与足够的鼓励，可琳总能爆发强大的实力。当然，足够的惊吓也是可以的…
profile.descriptionEn: · With enough encouragement, Corin will always spring into action. Of course, a little shock will also do the trick...

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 可琳鼓足勇气完成委托的样子，实在是太可爱了！
profile.descriptionEn: · Corin looks so adorable when she musters up the courage to complete a commission!

1061.description:
可琳，维多利亚家政的女仆之一。
是非常乖巧听话的女仆，但是极度缺乏自信，害怕被其他人讨厌。总是慌慌张张的模样，着急的时候说话还会有些小结巴。
不管发生了什么事，可琳都常常把道歉的话挂在嘴边。
「对对对对不起！像我这样的人…果然还是不行吧…」

实际上可琳总是能把任务完成得很好，是维多利亚家政组内非常靠谱且值得信任的成员之一。
但即使完美完成了任务，可琳依然对自己的能力充满了怀疑，时刻担心自己会拖同伴们的后腿。这一点也常常让莱卡恩感到头疼。
思考：可琳这样的性格到底是生来如此，还是由环境造就？
1061.descriptionEn:
Corin is one of the maids working for Victoria Housekeeping Co.
She is a highly obedient maid but lacks confidence and often fears being disliked by others. When in a rush, she becomes flustered and stutters.
Corin is always apologizing no matter what happens.
"I... I... I'm so sorry! I'm so incompetent... I'll never get things right..."

Corin never, however, fails to fulfill her tasks with excellence and is one of the most reliable members of Victoria Housekeeping Co.
Despite her flawless performance, Corin remains skeptical about her abilities, constantly worrying about being a burden to her colleagues, which can sometimes frustrate Lycaon.
Thoughts: Is Corin's personality innate, shaped by her life experiences?

skills.name: 普通攻击：扫除开始
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害；

Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button during the 3rd and 5th hits to extend the chainsaw slash attack.

Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of slashes upon enemies in front, before detonating the chainsaw, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash attack.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful slashes upon enemies in front, before detonating the chainsaw, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash attack at the cost of Energy if the attack connects.
Character is invulnerable during the spinning slash.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the extended slash, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：快速清扫

cinema.name: 开放性创伤
cinema.description: [连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，可琳对目标造成的伤害提升12%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Corin's Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, her DMG against the target increases by 12% for 15s.
cinema.story:
「大小姐说，做事情的时候一定要专注，不能被周围影响。」
「可琳练习了很久，终于可以做到了！」
「可是…你看到了吗，大小姐…」
cinema.storyEn:
"The young mistress always said, if something's worth doing, it's worth focusing on."
"I've been practicing, and I can do it now!"
"But... are you watching me...?"

cinema.name: 裂解效应
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，目标的物理伤害抗性下降0.5%，最多叠加20层，持续5秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Corin's EX Special Attack, Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, the target's Physical RES is reduced by 0.5%, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
cinema.story:
「对不起，以骸先生或者以骸女士！」
「但是可琳需要完成自己的任务…真的很抱歉！」
少女真诚而愧疚地对着面前的怪物道歉——
一边挥动着手上的电锯，将面前的敌人们尽数消灭。
cinema.storyEn:
"Sorry, Mr. or Ms. Ethereal!"
"But I've got work to do... I really am sorry!"
Feeling guilty, Corin sincerely apologizes to the monster — as she wields her savage chainsaw, slicing through the enemies in her way.

cinema.name: 初级女仆
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「为、为了成为能独当一面的女仆，可琳会加油努力的！」
——可琳手持锯子，一边走向以骸一边说道
cinema.storyEn: "I—I'll do my best to become a good maid!" Corin said, walking towards the Ethereals, chainsaw in hand.

cinema.name: 战场随侍
cinema.description: 发动[快速支援]、[招架支援]或[连携技]时，可琳回复7.2点能量，16秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Corin uses a Quick Assist, Defensive Assist, or Chain Attack, she recovers 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 16s.
cinema.story:
勤恳认真的女仆小姐，对待任何事情都是一心一意的。
当然，也包括在战场上面对敌人的时候。
cinema.storyEn:
A diligent and serious young maid, Corin always puts her heart and soul into everything she does.
Of course, that includes taking out enemies in combat.

cinema.name: 特勤女仆
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「唔…对、对不起，可琳笨手笨脚的，没办法把东西切得很均匀…」
——看着脚下遍布的以骸残块，可琳沮丧地说道
cinema.storyEn:
"Uh... sorry, I'm so clumsy. I don't know how to make sure my cuts are even..."
—Said Corin as she looked down at the bits of Ethereal scattered across the ground.

cinema.name: 厚积薄发
cinema.description: 持续斩击命中敌人时，可琳获得1层充能（最多40层）；在[闪避反击]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]、[快速支援]、[支援突击]中，引爆电锯命中敌人时，消耗所有充能，每层充能使本次攻击额外造成可琳3%攻击力的伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Corin's extended slash hits an enemy, she obtains a stack of Charge (max 40 stacks).
During a Dodge Counter, Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, when her chainsaw detonation hits an enemy, consumes all stacks of Charge. Each stack consumed causes the attack to deal an additional 3% of ATK as DMG.
cinema.story:
可琳知道，自己并不是最厉害的女仆，也不是最聪明的女仆。
但她希望能成为最努力的女仆。
过去积累的每一份努力，都有存在的意义。
cinema.storyEn:
Corin knows that she isn't the most powerful of maids, nor the smartest. But she hopes to become the hardest working.
She puts to good use everything she's ever learned.

1071.name: 凯撒

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
凯撒的父亲是原外环组织「卡吕冬」的首领，「卡吕冬」在外环也曾拥有过一段辉煌的故事，「卡吕冬之子」的名字也源于此。
凯撒的弱点是打针。
「又细，又小，扎的时候就痛一下，但是却能轻易见血，感觉阴阴的，这太奇怪了，一点都不光明磊落！」
profile.descriptionEn:
Caesar's father was the leader of a biker gang called "Calydon," which carved out a legendary reputation in the Outer Ring. The "Sons of Calydon" take their name from this legacy.
Caesar has a fear of needles.
"They're so tiny and thin, and it only stings for a second when you're pricked — but then all this blood comes out. It's so weird — and definitely not straightforward at all!"

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: MAR 16

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
大老爹看起来就是个文化人，凯撒却和他不太一样呢…
不过就算是说错成语的凯撒，也很可爱哦！
profile.descriptionEn:
Big Daddy looks cultured and sophisticated, but Caesar's a different kettle of fish...
But even though she often gets her idioms wrong, Caesar's still very cute!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
能获得外环霸主的信任是一件很难得的事，我们要珍惜。
当然，如果凯撒发信息的时候能少一些错别字就更好了。
profile.descriptionEn:
Earning the trust of the Outer Ring's Overlord is a pretty big deal. We should really appreciate that.
Of course, it'd be nice if Caesar could make fewer typos in her DMs to us.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对凯撒的印象：
 · 好像比之前更了解凯撒…的弱点了？
profile.descriptionEn:
Impression of Caesar:
 · It seems like we now know more about Caesar's... weakness?

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 总觉得和凯撒不仅是朋友，更是难友…？
profile.descriptionEn: · It feels like we're not just Caesar's friend, but also comrades in hardship...?

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 和凯撒在一起时总是很放松，「好伙计」之间就是这样。
profile.descriptionEn: · I always feel more relaxed with Caesar. That's just how it is between "buddies."

1071.description:
凯撒，卡吕冬之子的领导者，机车族的首领，同时也是一位正在成长中的「君王」。
强大的实力和直爽豪放的性格，让她受到外环人们的尊重和喜爱。
看似我行我素，实际上很愿意听取他人的意见。只要是有效意见，无论是什么人提出的，凯撒都会积极听取并践行。
对自己相信的人毫无防备。当她承认某个人之后，就会把对方划分到自己的麾下，绝对信任且不设防。
（推测：凯撒目前对您就属于此种状态。）

凯撒有记忆的时候父亲就已经失踪，母亲也因为疾病早逝，从小在大老爹的陪伴下长大。
而大老爹对她的教育态度属于散养派，并不会做出过多的限制，因此培养出了自由的凯撒。

除此之外，凯撒似乎对恋爱相关的事有奇妙的兴趣。
如果您想要和她拉近关系的话，或许可以尝试以此为话题和她聊天。
1071.descriptionEn:
Caesar: Leader of the Sons of Calydon biker gang and a "monarch" in the making.
Her combination of formidable strength and bold, straightforward personality has earned her the love and respect of the Outer Ring's residents.
Although she appears to do things in her own way, she is actually very willing to listen to others' opinions. Caesar actively listens to and implements any valid suggestion she hears — regardless of who it comes from.
She is completely defenseless against those she trusts. Once she accepts someone, she considers them part of her inner circle, treating them with absolute trust.
(Assumption: Caesar currently views you in this way.)

Caesar's father has been missing for as long as she can remember, and her mother passed away from illness when she was young. She was raised by Big Daddy, who took a very hands-off approach to raising her, allowing her to grow up freely and independently.

In addition, Caesar seems to have a curious interest in matters related to romance.
If you wish to get closer to her, you might want to try discussing this topic with her.

skills.name: 普通攻击：横行斩打
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多六段的斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 6 slashes ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：此路不通！
skills.description:
[支援点数]足够时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
消耗1点[支援点数]，丢出手中的盾牌对四周进行攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When there are sufficient Assist Points, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Consume 1 Assist Point to toss the shield and attack nearby enemies in all directions, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：震荡盾击
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用盾牌向前方进行打击，造成物理伤害；
若在招式发动初期的较短时间内受到敌方攻击，将触发[精准格挡]，抵挡此次攻击伤害，并自动衔接发动[特殊技：喧嚣直刺]；
招式发动后，凯撒将进入格挡架势，期间自身受到的伤害降低40%，受到敌人攻击时将持盾格挡并被击退，随后点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以触发[防御反击]，发动[特殊技：喧嚣直刺]或[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]；
触发[防御反击]时，招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Strike forward with the shield, dealing Physical DMG.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill's activation, it will trigger a Perfect Block, negating the damage once and automatically following up with a Special Attack: Roaring Thrust.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks with the shield and gets slightly knocked back. Press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to trigger Retaliation, activating Special Attack: Roaring Thrust or EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
When Retaliation is triggered, Caesar is invulnerable while using the skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：喧嚣直刺
skills.description:
[特殊技：震荡盾击]发动后，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行刺击，造成物理伤害；
未触发[精准格挡]和[防御反击]时，招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；
触发[精准格挡]或[防御反击]时，招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After activating Special Attack: Shockwave Shield Bash, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
If Perfect Block or Retaliation is not triggered, the Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill when Perfect Block or Retaliation is triggered.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：招架反击
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用盾牌向前方进行打击，随后发动强力刺击，造成大量物理伤害；
若在招式发动初期受到敌方攻击，或通过盾牌打击触发[破招]时，将触发[精准格挡]，抵挡此次攻击伤害，并挥盾反击；触发[精准格挡]后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以发动[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]，且无需消耗能量；
招式发动后，凯撒将进入格挡架势，期间自身受到的伤害降低40%，受到敌人攻击时将持盾格挡并被击退，随后点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以触发[防御反击]，发动[特殊技：喧嚣直刺]或[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, followed by a powerful thrust, dealing massive Physical DMG.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an Interrupt is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger Perfect Block, negating incoming damage once and countering with a shield attack. After triggering Perfect Block, press [EX Special Attack] to activate EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash without consuming energy.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks the attack and is knocked back. Press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to trigger Retaliation and activate Special Attack: Roaring Thrust or EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：超强力盾击
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
skills.description:
[强化特殊技：招架反击]发动后，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用盾牌向前方进行打击，造成大量物理伤害；
若在招式发动初期受到敌方攻击，或通过盾牌打击触发[破招]时，将触发[精准格挡]，抵挡此次攻击伤害，并返还发动招式所消耗的能量；
以[精准格挡]或[防御反击]的方式发动时，无法再次触发[精准格挡]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After activating EX Special Attack: Parry Counter, with enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, dealing massive Physical DMG.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an Interrupt is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger Perfect Block, negating incoming damage once and recovering the Energy used to activate the skill.
When the skill is activated through Perfect Block or Retaliation, it cannot trigger Perfect Block again.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：漂移
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：猪突猛进
skills.description:

使用盾牌向前方进行打击，造成物理伤害。
招式发动期间自身受到的伤害降低40%，受到敌人攻击时将持盾格挡并被击退，随后点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以触发[防御反击]，发动[特殊技：喧嚣直刺]或[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, dealing Physical DMG.
During skill activation, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks with the shield and gets knocked back. Following that, press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to trigger Retaliation and activate Special Attack: Roaring Thrust or EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash.

skills.name: 闪避反击：以牙还牙
skills.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Eye For an Eye
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动刺击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Stabs at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：路怒震打
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方范围敌人发动强力下落打击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful downward strike at enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：暴君猛击
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出手中的盾牌对前方敌人发动强力旋转攻击，随后发动下落打击，造成大量物理伤害；
命中持有护盾的敌人时，招式造成的失衡值提升45%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning attack on enemies in front, followed by a downward strike, dealing massive Physical DMG.
When hitting shielded enemies, the Daze dealt is increased by 45%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

丢出手中的盾牌对前方敌人发动强力旋转攻击，随后发动下落打击，造成大量物理伤害；
命中持有护盾的敌人时，招式造成的失衡值提升55%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
levels.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning attack on enemies in front, followed by a downward strike, dealing massive Physical DMG.
When hitting shielded enemies, the Daze dealt is increased by 55%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：变道支援
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动刺击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：守御之盾
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：支援之锋
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
丢出手中的盾牌对前方敌人发动强力旋转攻击，随后发动斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动后点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以触发[防御反击]，发动[特殊技：喧嚣直刺]或[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning attack on enemies in front, followed by a slash that deals Physical DMG.
After activating the skill, press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to trigger a Retaliation, activating Special Attack: Roaring Thrust or EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：坚韧之壁
skills.description:
凯撒发动[强化特殊技：招架反击]、[连携技]、[终结技]或以[防御反击]的方式发动[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]时，为全队提供等同于自身300%初始冲击力+200点的护盾[荣光之盾]，持续60秒，[荣光之盾]由当前操作中的角色持有，护盾值为全队共享，单次受到的伤害不会超过护盾值；
[荣光之盾]存在期间，持有者的抗打断等级提升；
[荣光之盾]存在期间，持有者的攻击力提升40点，[荣光之盾]效果结束后，该增益效果仍然保留，持续5秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Caesar activates EX Special Attack: Parry Counter, Chain Attack, Ultimate, or triggers EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash through Retaliation, she buffs all squad members with a Radiant Aegis shield equal to 300% of her base Impact + 200. The shield lasts for 60s and is equipped by the active character, with its value shared among all squad members. Any single instance of DMG will not exceed the shield value.
While Radiant Aegis is active, the shield bearer's Anti-Interrupt level is increased.
While Radiant Aegis is active, the shield bearer's ATK is increased by 40. After Radiant Aegis expires, this buff remains for an additional 5s.
