skills.name: 额外能力：战意激昂
skills.description:
队伍中存在其他可发动[招架支援]的角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
凯撒触发[精准格挡]、[防御反击]、[招架支援]或发动[普通攻击：此路不通！]时，对自身附近7米范围内的敌人施加减益效果，使全队角色对其造成的伤害提升25%，持续30秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad can activate Defensive Assist or shares the same Faction:
When Caesar activates Perfect Block, Retaliation, Defensive Assist, or Basic Attack: Dead End, she applies a Debuff effect to enemies within a 7m radius, increasing the damage they take from all squad members by 25% for 30s.

cinema.name: 楔式进军
cinema.description: 成为接战状态下的当前操作角色时，凯撒立即为全队提供[荣光之盾]，300秒内最多触发一次；[荣光之盾]存在期间，持有者附近5米范围内敌人的全属性伤害抗性降低15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Caesar becomes the active character in combat, she instantly buffs all squad members with a Radiant Aegis shield. This effect can trigger once every 300s. While Radiant Aegis is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% All-Attribute RES reduction.
cinema.story:
「大老爹教过我，这时候就该以强大的兵力构成楔子般的队形，向敌方最薄弱之处进行攻击——」
「当然，是由我来打头阵！」
cinema.storyEn:
"Big Daddy taught me that this is when you form a spearheaded formation with overwhelming force and strike at the enemy's weakest point—"
"And I'll be leading the charge, of course!"

cinema.name: 异域传承
cinema.description: [核心被动：坚韧之壁]中，[荣光之盾]存在期间，凯撒的能量获得效率提升10%，持有者的攻击力提升效果提升至原本的150%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While Radiant Aegis from Core Passive: Barrier of Resilience is active, Caesar's Energy Generation Rate increases by 10%, and the shield bearer's ATK boost is increased to 150% of its original value.
cinema.story:
凯撒的战斗方式与新艾利都或是外环的风格都略有不同，继承成自流浪者集团最厉害的武者们。
在恰当的时候收敛锋芒，在恰当的时候一击毙命——这向来是流浪者们的生存之道。
而凯撒一直是个好学生。
cinema.storyEn:
Caesar's combat style stands out from those of New Eridu or the Outer Ring, drawing from the techniques of the most skilled warriors among the wanderers.
Knowing when to hold back and when to strike decisively — that has always been the wanderer's way of survival. And Caesar has always been a good student of this philosophy.

cinema.name: 绝对信任
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
一旦认可某个人之后，凯撒就会把对方划到自己的麾下，并予以其绝对的信任，毫不设防…
一如她现在对待你那样。
cinema.storyEn:
Once Caesar recognizes someone as one of her own, she fully accepts them as part of her inner circle. She gives them absolute trust, letting her guard down completely...
Just like she does with you now.

cinema.name: 阿瑞斯攻城锤
cinema.description: 凯撒发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，额外回复3点[支援点数]；凯撒的能量值不足20点时，可以消耗1点[支援点数]作为代替，发动[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]，代替效果5秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Caesar uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, she gains 3 additional Assist Points. If her Energy is below 20, she can activate EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash with 1 Assist Point instead. This substitution can trigger once every 5s.
cinema.story:
凯撒在流浪者集团导师教育下学会的战术之一。
「无论如何，我会战到最后一刻！」
cinema.storyEn:
One of the tactics Caesar mastered under the guidance of the wanderers.
"No matter what, I'll fight till the last moment!"

cinema.name: 浪漫征伐
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
与外表不同，凯撒拥有特别的浪漫情怀。
例如她总是对一些恋爱戏码充满了好奇心。
但如果你和她更「深入」地聊这个话题…凯撒则会难得红了脸。
cinema.storyEn:
Behind Caesar's carefree and unpolished appearance lies a romantic at heart.
She's always curious about love stories.
But if you dig a little deeper into the subject... you might just catch her blushing.

cinema.name: 霸主之志
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：超强力盾击]和[支援突击：支援之锋]必定触发暴击，招式造成的伤害提升50%，对主要目标造成的伤害额外提升50%；凯撒发动[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]或[支援突击：支援之锋]时，自身暴击率提升30%，暴击伤害提升60%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash and Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade are guaranteed to trigger a critical hit. The skill's DMG is increased by 50% and deals additional 50% DMG to the primary target. When Caesar uses EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash or Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade, her CRIT Rate is increased by 30% and her CRIT DMG is increased by 60% for 15s.
cinema.story:
「我曾只看向前方。我以为只要自己够强，就没有办不到的事。」
「但要成为优秀的霸主，这还远远不够。」
「我还需要守护好后方的同伴——他们才是我最大的底气。」
cinema.storyEn:
"I used to keep my eyes straight ahead, thinking that as long as I was strong enough, I could do anything."
"But being a great leader takes more than just power."
"I need to protect my friends behind me — they are the reason I can keep going."

1081.name: 比利

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
和安比相似，比利的个人履历中也存在部分空白区域。
有信息显示，在加入狡兔屋之前比利曾经长期效忠于另一个神秘的组织。
截至目前为止，比利似乎仍然和盘踞于新艾利都外环的某组织老大之间保有密切联系。
profile.descriptionEn:
Similar to Anby, there are gaps in Billy's personal history that remain unfilled. 
The available information indicates that before joining Gentle House, Billy spent an extended period serving with another mysterious gang.
As of now, it appears Billy still maintains a close connection with a certain gang leader from the Outer Ring of New Eridu.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 男
profile.descriptionEn: Male

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: NOV 25

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
「星徽骑士」系列的特摄片，哥哥小时候好像也曾经痴迷过？
啊，真怀念呢，哥哥叉着腰大喊「星徽荣耀幻影！」的时候…
profile.descriptionEn:
Weren't you obsessed with the Starlight Knight series as a kid, Wise?
That brings me back. You shouting "Starlight Mirage!" with your arms crossed...

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
并没有那种时候。请把这些不存在的记忆从你的大脑里清空。
我已经脱离那个年龄段很久了，毕竟我的名字里可没有「kid」。
profile.descriptionEn:
There was never such a time. Please erase such non-existent memories from your mind.
It's been a long time since I was that age, after all, and my name doesn't have "kid" in it.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对比利的印象：
 · 比利对待武器，就像对自己一样爱护
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Billy:
 · Billy cares for his weapons like he cares for himself.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 他真的很爱星徽骑士，是因为正义还是因为特摄？
profile.descriptionEn: · He sure loves the Starlight Knights, but does he love the sense of justice or just the special effects?

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 比利的过去，也藏着让人难以想象的秘密
profile.descriptionEn: · Billy's past hides unimaginable secrets

1081.description:
比利·奇德，是一台通过了禁果测试的智能构造体。简言之，拥有自我意志的机器人。
人如其名，虽然有着机器人的外表，他的内心却（幼稚的）像个孩子。
钟爱一部名为「星徽骑士」的特摄片。希望自己也能成为剧中主角那样的英雄，于是总是以星徽骑士自居，还会用较为夸张的姿态模仿剧中台词。
但这样的行为似乎只能造成一些（适合用来调节气氛的）喜剧效果。
「不要把我说的好像笨蛋一样啊！我明明是很聪明的！」——by比利
1081.descriptionEn:
Billy Kid, an AI construct that has passed the forbidden fruit test, is essentially a self-aware machine. 
True to his name, despite having the appearance of a robot, he is quite childlike.
He's a big fan of the visual FX show "Starlight Knight" and wishes to be a hero like the main characters of the show. He often refers to himself as a Starlight Knight and imitates the lines in the show.
Such behavior appears to be only for comedic effect, however.
"Don't make me sound like an idiot! I'm obviously very smart!" — Billy.

skills.name: 普通攻击：火力全开
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
连点或长按时，可以进入蹲姿射击，延长射击的持续时间；
蹲姿射击途中拖曳摇杆时，可以发动翻滚射击，调整身位并造成物理伤害；
蹲姿射击途中停止连点或松开长按时，对前方敌人发动终结射击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold to enter Crouching Shot to extend the attack duration.
Drag the joystick during Crouching Shot to launch Rolling Shot and adjust the character's position, dealing Physical DMG.
Stop pressing or holding during Crouching Shot to launch Finishing Shot at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 特殊技：乖乖站好
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方直线区域进行至多三段的穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs up to 3 piercing attacks in a line, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：清场时间
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方直线区域进行强力穿透攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a powerful piercing attack in a line, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：好险好险
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：星-徽-制-裁
skills.description:
拖曳摇杆发动闪避后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向身周大范围区域进行穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
未拖曳摇杆发动闪避后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方直线区域进行穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
When dragging the joystick during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Launches a piercing attack at nearby enemies within a large area, dealing Physical DMG.
When not dragging the joystick during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Launches a piercing attack at enemies in a line, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：公平决斗
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：星徽荣耀幻影
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对身周大范围敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful piercing attack at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：星徽在此闪耀
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对身周大范围敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful piercing attack at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：星徽-同伴之力
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a piercing attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 回避支援：闪转步伐
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：要害射击
skills.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Pierces enemies in a large area in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：稳定据枪
skills.description: 比利在[普通攻击]中进入蹲姿射击后，自身造成的伤害提升25%，进行移动、回到待机、被击退或被击飞时增益效果结束。
skills.descriptionEn: Billy's DMG increases by 25% when he enters Crouching Shot during his Basic Attack. The effect ends if he moves, returns to standby, or is knocked back or launched by an attack.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.descriptionEn: Billy's DMG increases by 50% when he enters Crouching Shot during his Basic Attack. The effect ends if he moves, returns to standby, or is knocked back or launched by an attack.

skills.name: 额外能力：骑士战队
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
比利发动[连携技]后，下次发动[终结技]时，招式造成的伤害提升50%，最多叠加2次，发动[终结技]后效果重置。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
After Billy uses a Chain Attack, the DMG of his next Ultimate is increased by 50%, stacking up to 2 times. This effect resets whenever an Ultimate is activated.

cinema.name: 闪亮登场
cinema.description: [冲刺攻击]或[闪避反击]命中敌人时，比利额外回复2.7点能量，5秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Billy hits an enemy with a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, he gains an additional 2.7 Energy. Can trigger once every 5s.
cinema.story:
「作为反派，你们也太老实了！」
「就像为了配合主角登场，故意设置的固定靶一样！」
cinema.storyEn:
"You guys are way too honest to be bad guys!"
"All lined up, like NPCs at the shooting range!"

cinema.name: 游斗射术
cinema.description: [闪避反击]造成的伤害提升25%；[普通攻击]中的翻滚射击将被视为闪避动作，在招式发动期间获得无敌效果，并且能够触发[极限闪避]，翻滚射击触发[极限闪避]时，将自动衔接[闪避反击]。
cinema.descriptionEn: Billy's Dodge Counter DMG increases by 25%. Rolling Shots during his Basic Attacks count as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during skill activation and able to trigger Perfect Dodges. When a Rolling Shot triggers a Perfect Dodge, it will automatically follow up with a Dodge Counter.
cinema.story:
「星徽骑士从来不会逃避危险，那叫做战术游走射击！」
——星徽闪耀-交流区，会员「哦梦中的莫妮卡」留言。
cinema.storyEn:
"The Starlight Knights never run from danger. That's what we call tactical repositioning for better aim!"
— User "Dreamgirl Monica" from the Starlight Radiance messageboards.

cinema.name: 星徽骑士的教导
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 绝不懈怠训练，绝不停止进步！这是星徽骑士倡导的精神。比利真的相信，而且真的在遵守。
cinema.storyEn: Never neglect your training, and never stop improving! This is the philosophy of the Starlight Knights. Billy believes in it wholeheartedly, and practices it sincerely.

cinema.name: 星徽-惩戒弹药
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]命中敌人时，招式的暴击率随自身与目标之间的距离而提升；比利与目标距离越近，提升效果越显著，最高提升32%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Billy hits an enemy with his EX Special Attack, the skill's CRIT Rate increases based on the distance from the enemy. The closer he is to the target, the greater the effect, up to a maximum increase of 32%.
cinema.story:
比利独创的爆破型子弹，
在近身战时有着惊人的威力。
不过比利改造子弹的本意，是让开枪时的演出效果更加帅气。
cinema.storyEn:
These explosive bullets of Billy's own invention are incredibly lethal at close range.
Their performance far outstrips Billy's original intention of simply making them cooler.

cinema.name: 失落技术构造体
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 未知的精密元件和独特的构造设计带给了比利远超同侪的性能…和维修养护费用。
cinema.storyEn: Unknown precision components and unique structural design have given Billy performance far beyond his peers... And maintenance costs far beyond his means.

cinema.name: 星徽-英雄时刻
cinema.description: 累计命中敌人10次或触发[极限闪避]时，比利造成的伤害提升6%，最多叠加5层，被敌方击退或击飞后增益效果重置。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Billy accumulates 10 hits on enemies or triggers a Perfect Dodge, his DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 5 times and lasting until he's knocked back or launched by an attack.
cinema.story:
「呼~感觉来了！安比你让开，现在是我的主场！」
「呃，安比，能帮忙放一下星徽骑士片头曲吗？」
——狡兔屋内部「十大禁句」评选，安比的提案。
cinema.storyEn:
"Hooboy~ Feelin' great! Move aside, Anby, it's my time to shine!"
"Yo, Anby — can you play the Starlight Knight theme?"
—excerpt from Cunning Hares' "Top 10 Forbidden Sentences," selected by Anby

1091.name: 雅
1091.faction: 对空洞特别行动部第六课

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
星见雅是新艾利都知名武家的继承人。
据知情人士透露，雅的母亲早逝。而雅与父亲的关系，似乎十分微妙。
备注：雅的父亲并未担任新艾利都内任何公共职务。
profile.descriptionEn:
Hoshimi Miyabi is the heir to a famed martial arts family in New Eridu.
According to an insider, Miyabi's mother died when she was young and Miyabi's relationship with her father is rather odd.
Note: Miyabi's father has not taken any civil or administrative positions within New Eridu.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 身高
profile.description: 170（包括耳朵）
profile.descriptionEn: 170 (Ears Included)

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JUN 19

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: Fairy，帮我找一下「珍贵的影像」！我哥想看！
profile.descriptionEn: Fairy! Find that "precious visual recording"! My brother wants to see it!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: Fairy，不必麻烦了。铃如果想看，她会自己向雅小姐开口的…
profile.descriptionEn: There's no need to trouble yourself, Fairy. If Belle wants to see it, she'll ask Miss Miyabi herself...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对星见雅的印象：
 · 到底为什么，雅会认为喵吉长官是海獭…？
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Hoshimi Miyabi:
 · Why in New Eridu does she think Officer Mewmew is a sea otter...?

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 偶尔，雅在过度修行后会陷入放空模式。
profile.descriptionEn: · Sometimes, she enters a semi-conscious meditative state after training.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 雅的力量是为了守护而存在的。她愿意为此付出代价。
profile.descriptionEn: · The purpose of Miyabi's power is to protect, and she's willing to pay the price for it.

1091.description:
星见雅，对空洞事务特别行动部第六课课长。
雅常出外勤，至今不知道部内每月例会的会议室在几楼。
即使在办公室内看到雅，雅也多半没有在处理文书工作，而是专注于保养佩刀。

因出色功勋荣获「虚狩」之名的她，是对空六课强者中的强者。
在市民中亦颇有威望。
某次，迷路的雅误入一场「星见雅后援会」的线下活动现场。
雅被视为变装水平出神入化的粉丝，留下了珍贵的影像。

星见雅个性坦诚务实，并非耽溺修行、不通世务的武痴。
了解她的人都会明白，她一直在追寻心中的正义——哪怕这正义终将掀起变革。
1091.descriptionEn:
Hoshimi Miyabi, the Chief of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Miyabi goes on a lot of field missions and still doesn't know which floor the regular monthly meeting is on.
Even if you see Miyabi in the office, it's unlikely she's dealing with paperwork, and more likely polishing her sword.

Being conferred the title of Void Hunter due to her outstanding contributions, she's an elite amongst elites in Section 6.
She has great prestige amongst the citizens.
Once, Miyabi accidentally wandered into a "Miyabi Fan Club" hosted offline event.
Miyabi was thought to be a fan with godlike impersonation skills, and that event resulted in a precious visual recording.

Hoshimi Miyabi is honest and pragmatic. She is not simply a martial artist obsessed with her art and without care for the world around her.
Anyone who knows her will realize she's always pursued justice in her heart... even if it may eventually cause a revolution.

skills.name: 普通攻击：风花
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，前两段造成物理伤害，后三段造成烈霜伤害；
第五段[普通攻击]发动期间可以格挡敌人的攻击。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to five slashes ahead, the first two deal Physical DMG, and the last three deal Frost DMG.
Block enemy attacks during the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

skills.name: 普通攻击：霜月
skills.description:
拥有2点或以上[落霜]时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
星见雅收刀进入[霜月架势]并开始蓄力，每段蓄力会消耗2点[落霜]，最多可以进行三段蓄力，松开 【普通攻击键】 或[落霜]耗尽时，星见雅将根据当前蓄力段数，拔刀向前方发动强力斩击，造成大量烈霜伤害，随后退出[霜月架势]；
[霜月架势]期间拥有无敌效果；
星见雅最多拥有6点[落霜]，进入战场时，星见雅立刻获得3点[落霜]。
skills.descriptionEn:
With at least 2 points of Fallen Frost, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Hoshimi Miyabi sheaths her blade, enters Shimotsuki Stance and starts to charge up. Every level of charge will consume 2 points of Fallen Frost, up to a maximum of three levels of charge.
When releasing [Basic Attack], or when Fallen Frost is completely depleted, Hoshimi Miyabi will draw her blade and unleash a powerful slash ahead based on the current charge level, dealing massive Frost DMG. She then exits Shimotsuki Stance.
Character is invulnerable during Shimotsuki Stance.
Hoshimi Miyabi can have up to 6 points of Fallen Frost. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 3 points of Fallen Frost.

skills.name: 特殊技：深雪
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速拔刀向前方进行斩击，造成烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly draws her blade and slashes ahead, dealing Frost DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：飞雪
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
快速突进，对路径上的敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动时，获得2点[落霜]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
招式发动后，能量足够时，再次点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
额外消耗能量，对前方范围内的敌人发动强力追击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动时，获得2点[落霜]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Rush forward, unleashing powerful slashes against enemies along the way, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of Fallen Frost.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] again to activate:
Consume extra Energy and unleash a powerful follow-up attack against enemies in front, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of Fallen Frost.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：水鸟
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
闪避时，连点或长按 【闪避键】 发动：
长距离的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
While dodging, repeatedly press or hold [Dodge] to activate:
A dash dodge that covers a lot of ground.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：冬蜂
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成物理伤害；
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：寒雀
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Frost DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：春临
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：名残雪
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，略作延迟后发动终结一击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动时，获得3点[落霜]，自身造成的冰属性伤害提升30%，持续12秒；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area then pauses, before unleashing a Finishing Move, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gain 3 points of Fallen Frost and increase Ice DMG by 30% for 12s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：花信风
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Frost DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：花筏
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：花辞
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进斩击，造成烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charges and slashes enemies in front, dealing Frost DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：寒炎
skills.description:
星见雅对敌人造成烈霜伤害时，将会为目标附着[冰焰]，持续30秒；对附着[冰焰]的敌人累积烈霜异常积蓄值时，会基于星见雅暴击率的100%提升烈霜异常积蓄效率，最多提升80%；星见雅累积烈霜异常积蓄值时，具有独立的属性异常积蓄槽，随之触发的[冻结]、[碎冰]和[霜寒]效果，可以与包括冰属性异常效果在内的其他属性异常效果互相结算[紊乱]；
星见雅对附着[冰焰]的敌人施加[霜寒]效果时，将会消除[冰焰]并触发[霜灼·破]，对目标造成星见雅750%攻击力的烈霜伤害，同时使目标进入[霜灼]状态；[霜灼]状态下，所有单位对目标累积的属性异常积蓄值提升14%，但星见雅无法再次为其附着[冰焰]；[霜灼]状态将会随本次[霜寒]效果一起结束，状态持续期间，对敌人重新施加属性异常效果可以覆盖[霜寒]并消除[霜灼]；
触发[霜灼·破]时，星见雅获得1点[落霜]，10秒内最多触发一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Hoshimi Miyabi deals Frost DMG, she applies Icefire to the target, lasting 30s. When accumulating Frost Anomaly Buildup against targets with Icefire, increases Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates Frost Anomaly Buildup, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers Freeze, Shatter, and Frostbite that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including Ice Attribute Anomaly, to trigger Disorder.
When Hoshimi Miyabi applies Frostbite to enemies with Icefire, it will consume the Icefire to trigger Frostburn - Break, dealing Frost DMG equal to 750% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the Frostburn state. All units accumulate 14% more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the Frostburn state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply Icefire to these enemies. The Frostburn state ends when Frostbite expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite Frostbite and remove Frostburn.
Upon triggering Frostburn - Break, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of Fallen Frost. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

All units accumulate 17% more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the Frostburn state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply Icefire to these enemies. The Frostburn state ends when Frostbite expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite Frostbite and remove Frostburn.
Upon triggering Frostburn - Break, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of Fallen Frost. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

skills.name: 额外能力：同沐霜雪
skills.description:
队伍中存在[支援]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色或其他[异常]角色时触发：
[普通攻击：霜月]造成的伤害提升60%；队伍中任意角色触发[紊乱]效果时，星见雅获得2点[落霜]，且在下一次[霜月架势]期间，[普通攻击：霜月]将无视目标30%冰属性伤害抗性。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Anomaly character, or shares the same Faction:
Basic Attack: Shimotsuki DMG increases by 60%. When any squad member triggers Disorder, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 2 points of Fallen Frost and Basic Attack: Shimotsuki during the next Shimotsuki Stance will ignore 30% of the target's Ice RES.

cinema.name: 雪上加霜
cinema.description: 在[霜月架势]期间，每消耗1点[落霜]，[普通攻击：霜月]将无视目标6%防御力，最多叠加6层，退出[霜月架势]后增益效果结束；在[普通攻击：霜月]中进行三段蓄力，斩击命中处于[霜灼]状态下的敌人时，可以立即消除目标的[霜灼]状态，并使全队角色属性异常积蓄效率提升20%，持续10秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in Shimotsuki Stance, every 1 point of Fallen Frost consumed will allow Basic Attack: Shimotsuki to ignore 6% of DEF, stacking up to 6 times and lasting until Shimotsuki Stance ends. When the slash for charge level three of Basic Attack: Shimotsuki hits an enemy under Frostburn, it will immediately remove the Frostburn state and increase all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20% for 10s.
cinema.story:
雅自幼起便喜欢吟诵霜雪相关的诗句。
即使初见时不能完全理解，但她依旧日复一日地思索着。
不知不觉间，她已明悟出其中的真意。
不是在某个清朗的雪夜，而是在刀刃相向的战场上。
cinema.storyEn:
Miyabi has loved reciting poems about the cold since she was a child. She might not understand them completely, but she still does it every day.
Before long, she came to realize their true meaning.
She found clarity not on a still and snowy night, but rather upon the battlefield.

cinema.name: 吐纳法
cinema.description: [普通攻击：风花]和[闪避反击]造成的伤害提升30%；第五段[普通攻击：风花]最后一击命中敌人时，星见雅获得1点[落霜]；进入战场时，星见雅立刻获得6点[落霜]，自身暴击率提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack: Kazahana and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 30%. Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 point of Fallen Frost when the final move of the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Kazahana hits an enemy. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 6 points of Fallen Frost and her CRIT Rate increases by 15%.
cinema.story:
「刀刃如常，心亦如是。」这是星见流剑术的训诫之一。
击倒敌人只是致胜的第一步，在战斗中不失从容之心、
保持毫不懈怠的仪态始终如一，才是武者的修行之道。
cinema.storyEn:
"As goes the sword, so goes the heart." This is a key disciplinary concept of the Hoshimi school of swordsmanship.
Defeating the enemy is but the first step on the path to victory. 
Maintaining constant vigilance at all times is the true way of a warrior.

cinema.name: 武者修养
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 武家出身的雅有着极好锻炼习惯，剑术修行是不能断的。什么？要开会？那就翘掉开会。
cinema.storyEn: Miyabi, whose family has a tradition of martial arts, has excellent training habits. Her commitment to swordsmanship practice is unwavering. What? A meeting? She won't be going.

cinema.name: 皲裂
cinema.description: [霜灼·破]造成的伤害提升30%，触发[霜灼·破]时，星见雅额外获得250点喧响值。
cinema.descriptionEn: Frostburn - Break DMG increases by 30%. Upon triggering Frostburn - Break, Hoshimi Miyabi generates 250 more Decibels.
cinema.story:
战斗时轻吟诗句，可以调节呼吸的节律。
无论是心境还是呼吸，少女都时刻保持在盛开前的最佳状态。
cinema.storyEn:
Reciting poems during the heat of battle can regulate one's respiratory rhythm.
Whether it's her mindset or breathing, Miyabi always keeps calm.

cinema.name: 纪念日
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
少女带着鲜花来到那个熟悉的地方，呼出的气化作白雾，融化在冰冷的空气里。
她的指尖轻轻抚过纪念碑上的那个名字。
周围的一切都很安静，如同最沉默的见证者。
cinema.storyEn:
The girl arrives at that all too familiar place with flowers, her breath misting and then vanishing into the cold air.
Her fingers ghost over that name on the monument.
Everything is quiet, like that most silence observer.

cinema.name: 天资卓越
cinema.description: 在[霜月架势]期间，星见雅将获得[极意]效果，使[普通攻击：霜月]造成的伤害提升30%，获得[极意]效果后，消耗[落霜]时，星见雅会根据当前蓄力段数，自动拔刀向前方发动强力斩击；在[落霜]耗尽前，拔刀斩击不会打断[霜月架势]下的蓄力进度；在一次[霜月架势]期间，最多连续发动3次拔刀斩击。
cinema.descriptionEn: During Shimotsuki Stance, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains Polar, which increases Basic Attack: Shimotsuki DMG by 30%. After obtaining Polar, Hoshimi Miyabi will automatically draw her blade and unleash powerful slashes based on the current charge level upon consuming Fallen Frost. Before Fallen Frost is completely depleted, the draw and slashes will not interrupt charging under Shimotsuki Stance. Each occurrence of Shimotsuki Stance can perform up to 3 draws and slashes.
cinema.story: 经历的战斗数量越多，越是能让外人察觉到一个事实：若是有刀剑的神灵存在，那他们一定颇为偏爱星见雅。
cinema.storyEn: The more she battles, the more it becomes evident to outsiders: If there is a god of swordsmanship, it must greatly favor Hoshimi Miyabi.

1101.name: 珂蕾妲

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
根据相关行为分析可知，珂蕾妲其实很喜欢甜食，但是却不愿意坦率承认。
推测原因为：她认为喜欢甜食很幼稚，不想让其他人觉得自己幼稚。
此外，珂蕾妲似乎对所有与「小孩子」相关的形容词都表现出了过度的敏感，一旦提及就有可能遭受她的怒视：
「先提醒你，我现在能轻松地敲到你的胫骨，所以『像个小孩子啊』之类的话你最好想清楚了再说！」
profile.descriptionEn:
From analysis of her behavior, it's evident that Koleda is actually quite fond of sweets, even though she's hesitant to openly admit it. 
The suspected rationale behind this is that she views enjoying sweets as a childish inclination and doesn't want others to perceive her as immature. 
Furthermore, Koleda seems particularly sensitive to any descriptors associated with children, and mentioning such terms could trigger her annoyance. 
"Just remember, I'm the perfect height for your shinbone, so you might wanna reconsider before labeling me as childish."

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: AUG 10

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
哥哥，我们以前看的那个侦探片里的名言是怎么说的来着？
「虽然外表看似小孩…」呃，实际上不管年龄还是外表，珂蕾妲也确实就是小孩子嘛，很可爱呀！
profile.descriptionEn:
What's that line from that detective movie we watched again?
"She may look like a child..." Well, no matter how old she is or how she looks, Koleda really is a kid, and she's so cute!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 你的这句评价一定不能被当事人看到，不然我们的录像店招牌可能都会被她一怒之下用锤子砸了。
profile.descriptionEn: I hope your comment isn't seen by a certain someone, or our video store will be end up smashed to bits by a hammer.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对珂蕾妲的印象：
 · 珂蕾妲总是不肯坦率地承认她对甜品的爱
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Koleda:
 · Koleda never openly admits her love for desserts.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 在下属面前，她想成为最可靠的社长
profile.descriptionEn: · She wants to be the most reliable president in front of her colleagues.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 珂蕾妲的眼罩下——并不是会毁灭世界的魔眼，真是可喜可贺
profile.descriptionEn: · Good news — what lies under her eye patch is not a demonic eye that possesses the power to destroy the world.

1101.description:
珂蕾妲，白祇重工的现任社长。同时也是公司创始人霍尔斯的亲生女儿。
父亲霍尔斯因涉嫌「卷款潜逃事件」失踪，导致公司遭受巨大冲击，几近一蹶不振。在那之后，达到法定年龄的珂蕾妲主动接过「烂摊子」，整合仅剩的公司人员和资产，重新开始经营资金和声誉都岌岌可危的白祇重工。
在新的骨干成员们的协助下，白祇重工终于在业界相关领域内再次崭露头角。虽不及全盛时期的辉煌，但现在的白祇重工也称得上是业内值得瞩目的新星。
在此过程中，珂蕾妲积累了实实在在的生活和工作阅历，也收获了一群始终追随她的如同家人般贴心的工友们。不过为了让娇小的自己能有个「领袖的样子」，珂蕾妲似乎总是会刻意用严厉的口吻和大家说话。
这样特殊的成长经历，也使得珂蕾妲在某些方面远比同龄人更加成熟。
当然，也会在某些方面看起来更加幼稚。
推测：或许珂蕾妲相较同龄人更加单薄的身材，是由于长期在空洞内活动所产生的影响而造成的。
目前尚未搜索到可以支撑此观点的公开论文及研究，我将会持续关注此议题。
1101.descriptionEn:
Koleda is the current head of Belobog Industries, and the biological daughter of the company's founder, Khors.
Her father, Khors, vanished due to a scandal involving embezzlement and fled, which severely shook the company, nearly driving it to the brink of collapse. Once she came of age, Koleda willingly stepped up to untangle the mess, rallying the remaining company workforce and resources to revive the financially and reputationally vulnerable Belobog Heavy Industries.
With the help of new invaluable team members, Belobog eventually managed to regain its prominence in relevant sectors. Though not as resplendent as its prime, Belobog in its current state is still a notable newcomer in the field.
Throughout her journey, Koleda amassed practical life experiences and professional know-how, building a circle of colleagues who back her up like family. Yet, to present herself as a leader, Koleda appears to intentionally adopt a stern tone when communicating with others.
This distinct growth trajectory has also contributed to Koleda's heightened maturity in certain aspects compared to her peers. 
Naturally, she might display a bit of childishness in certain aspects as well.
Hypothesis: Koleda's comparatively smaller stature among her peers may stem from her prolonged involvement in the Hollows. 
Currently, there aren't any publicly accessible papers or research substantiating this theory, but I will continue to track this topic.

skills.name: 普通攻击：砸扁，粉碎
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害；
当珂蕾妲拥有[熔炉升温]效果时，能够在第二段攻击后发动强化[普通攻击]，消耗[熔炉升温]效果并造成大量火属性伤害；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战，发动强化[普通攻击]时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
[普通攻击]第四段和强化[普通攻击]发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.
When Koleda has the Furnace Fire effect, she can launch an enhanced Basic Attack after the 2nd hit, consuming the Furnace Fire effect and dealing massive Fire DMG.
When Koleda and Ben are deployed together, executing an enhanced Basic Attack will trigger a coordinated attack from both, further increasing the move's power;
Koleda is invulnerable during the Basic Attack's 4th hit and enhanced Basic Attack.

variants.name: 普通攻击：砸扁，粉碎
variants.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害；
当珂蕾妲拥有[熔炉升温]效果时，能够在第二段攻击后发动强化[普通攻击]，消耗[熔炉升温]效果并造成大量火属性伤害；
强化[普通攻击]分为两段，发动第一段后点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第二段，且第一段强化[普通攻击]的追击效果增强；
[熔炉升温]效果最多可拥有2层，发动强化[普通攻击]会消耗所有的[熔炉升温]；
消耗[熔炉升温]时，全队代理人造成的伤害提升35%，持续40秒，重复触发刷新时间，且每消耗一层[熔炉升温]，第二段强化[普通攻击]造成的伤害提升10%，造成的失衡值提升20%；

variants.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.
When Koleda has the Furnace Fire effect, she can launch an enhanced Basic Attack after the 2nd hit, consuming the Furnace Fire effect and dealing massive Fire DMG.
Enhanced Basic Attack consists of two hits. After performing the first hit, press or hold [Basic Attack] to follow up with the second hit. The pursuit effect of the enhanced Basic Attack's first hit is also strengthened.
Furnace Fire can stack up to 2 times. Performing an enhanced Basic Attack consumes all stacks of Furnace Fire.
When Furnace Fire is consumed, all Agents deal 35% more damage for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of Furnace Fire consumed, the second hit of the enhanced Basic Attack deals 10% more damage and inflicts 20% more Daze.
When switching Agents during the first hit of the enhanced Basic Attack, Koleda remains on-field and automatically launches the second hit of the enhanced Basic Attack.
When Koleda and Ben are both in the squad, using an enhanced Basic Attack without switching Agents during the first hit of the enhanced Basic Attack causes the two to perform a Coordinated Attack, further increasing the skill's power.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th hit of her Basic Attack and her enhanced Basic Attack.
The invulnerability duration of the second hit of her enhanced Basic Attack is increased.

cinema.name: 锤击节奏
cinema.description: 当衔接在[普通攻击]第二、第四段或强化[普通攻击]后，快速发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，招式造成的失衡值提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or her enhanced Basic Attack, quickly use a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to increase the Daze dealt by 15%.
cinema.story: 火爆的脾气只是表象，其实珂蕾妲心思很细腻。比如她知道什么时候挥锤能打得更痛。
cinema.storyEn: Her fiery temper is just a facade. In reality, Koleda's thoughts are quite intricate. For example, she knows when to swing her hammer for a more painful strike.

cinema.name: 动能回收
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]命中敌人时，珂蕾妲回复60点能量，45秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Koleda's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.
cinema.story:
对珂蕾妲来说，完美的锤击自有独特的节奏。
像是加速敲击手鼓，每一击都在为下一次更强的节拍蓄力。
当然，面前的「玩具」能够撑住几下，就不好说了。
cinema.storyEn:
Koleda believes perfect hammering has its own natural rhythm.
It's like tapping a tambourine, with each hit building up the tempo of the next beat.
Of course, it's hard to say how many taps her "toys" can endure.

cinema.name: 「别惹我！」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
作为合格的「玩具」，当珂蕾妲逐渐找到挥锤的手感时，
最好不要节外生枝惹麻烦，只要老老实实挨锤就好。
——毕竟，反抗又有什么用呢？
cinema.storyEn:
As a qualified "toy," you better not cause trouble when Koleda starts to get a feel for swinging her hammer. Just take the beating.
—After all, what's the point of resisting?

cinema.name: 熔炉余温
cinema.description: 消耗[熔炉升温]发动强化[普通攻击]时，珂蕾妲获得1层充能（上限2层）；[连携技：天崩-地裂]或[终结技：锤进地心]命中敌人时，消耗所有充能，每层充能使当前招式造成的伤害提升18%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Koleda gains one stack of Charge (max 2 stacks) when consuming Furnace Fire to use her Enhanced Basic Attack. When her Chain Attack: Natural Disaster or Ultimate: Hammerquake hits an enemy, she consumes all stacks of Charge to increase the attack's DMG by 18% per stack.
cinema.story:
当炽热的挥锤让周围温度上升后，珂蕾妲便进入了作战状态。
现在，她比以太炸药更易燃易爆。
cinema.storyEn:
Koleda feels the flames of war as her hammer swings raise the surrounding temperature.
She's now even more flammable and explosive than Ether.

cinema.name: 「敢小瞧我？」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 珂蕾妲非常在意自己这个年轻的首领会让外人小瞧白祇重工。为了弥补这一点，她总是悄悄努力训练。
cinema.storyEn: Koleda cares deeply about her role as a young leader potentially causing others to underestimate Belobog Heavy Industries. To compensate, she consistently trains diligently in secret.

cinema.name: 饱和爆破
cinema.description: 在[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]中，引发爆炸命中敌人时，额外造成珂蕾妲360%攻击力的伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: When EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate triggers an explosion that hits an enemy, it deals additional DMG equal to 360% of Koleda's ATK.
cinema.story:
在珂蕾妲眼里，讨厌的人分为两种：
笨蛋，和无可救药的笨蛋。
万幸的是，白祇重工向来不缺烈性以太炸药。
多余的份正好可以用在这些笨蛋头上。
cinema.storyEn:
There are two types of people that Koleda really hates:
Stupid people, and hopelessly stupid people.
Luckily for her, Belobog always has a good supply of strong Ether explosives — plenty to use on the stupid.

1111.name: 安东

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
在此记录另一段日常观测片段：
深夜的工地，安东低头对着自己的钻头自言自语：好累啊，兄弟……
「动力冲击锤」启动嗡嗡嗡，安东点点头：「不行，真男人可不能说累！谢谢你的提醒，兄弟——等等，真男人也不能说不行！」
原来安东给工人们定下了一些严苛的试炼任务，希望他们突破自己的潜力。但是在看到大家无法完成试炼逐渐失去自信的样子，于心不忍，于是在一个漆黑的夜晚帮助大家完成了任务。
结果被试炼的人变成了安东自己。

*安东珍爱的「兄弟」，又名「动力冲击锤」，似乎与他曾经的工友们相关。
profile.descriptionEn:
Here is a video recording depicting Anton's life:
Late at night at the construction site, Anton gazes down at his jackhammer and mutters to himself, "Dang, this is exhausting, Bro..."
As the jackhammer buzzed to life, Anton nodded in acknowledgment. "No, a real one doesn't complain about being tired! Thanks for reminding me, buddy! You can never back down from a challenge!"
The truth is, Anton had set up demanding tasks for the construction workers, hoping to push them to their limits and unlock their true potential. However, witnessing their struggles and diminishing confidence, he couldn't bear to see them suffer any longer, so he secretly completed all the tasks in the dead of night.
In the end, Anton became the one who accepted all the trials.

* Anton's beloved "bro," aka his jackhammer, appears to have a connection to his former colleagues.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 男
profile.descriptionEn: Male

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: MAY 2

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
安东好像一直说自己「钻探业绩全司第二」…
所以第一是谁来着？
profile.descriptionEn:
Anton keeps saying he's the "second-best driller in the company."
So... who's the first?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 似乎是他们公司的那台重工钻探机，我听他说过「下次一定要赢过它」之类的话。
profile.descriptionEn: I think it's the heavy drill machine from their company. I've heard him say something like "I gotta win next time" against it.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对安东的印象：
 · 打架的时候喊台词最大声的人，第二大声的是他兄弟。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Anton:
 · The one who shouts the loudest slogans during a fight, and the second loudest is his bro.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 哄安东话术提要：「热血」、「羁绊」、「兄弟」。
profile.descriptionEn: · Keywords for dealing with Anton: "Passion," "Bond," and "Bro."

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 就算碰上主角黑化的剧情，也会无条件把背后交给你。
profile.descriptionEn: · He will have your back no matter what, even if the protagonist takes a dark path.

1111.description:
安东，白祇重工的主力建设人员，珂蕾妲的亲信之一。
「有搞不定的活儿？让我来！」
身体先于头脑的热血青年，白祇重工的干部之一，是被老社长霍尔斯招募入行的「老员工」。
是个一根筋的好人，总是用充沛的精力鼓舞着其他工友们。

除此之外，安东似乎总是会和自己手上的「动力冲击锤」进行对话，并称其为「兄弟」。
在此记录一段观测到的日常片段：
安东（低头自言自语）：「你觉得呢，兄弟？」
动力冲击锤：「轰隆隆隆隆——」
安东（恍然大悟状）：「原来如此，我明白了。不愧是你，兄弟！」 
对于此种情况，我目前尚未得到充足的信息，无法进行分析。
1111.descriptionEn:
Anton is a key member of construction staff at Belobog Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"Got a job you can't handle? Leave it to me!"
 Anton is one of the top brass at Belobog, handpicked by its former president Khors, which makes him a "senior employee."
A genuine, straightforward man, always boosting the morale of his coworkers with his surplus of energy.

Apart from this, it seems Anton is always talking to his jackhammer, affectionately calling it, "Bro."
An instance from Anton's everyday life goes like this:
Anton, seemingly in dialogue with himself, asks, "Whaddaya think, Bro?" 
The jackhammer replies, "Vroom vroom vroom—"
Anton, apparently enlightened, responds, "I see, I see! You still got it, Bro!"
Unfortunately, I have not collected enough information on such occurrences and am not able to deliver further analysis.

skills.name: 普通攻击：热血上工操
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的混合攻击，造成物理伤害；
第四段攻击为[打桩攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 mixed attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG.
The 4th hit is a Piledriver Attack.

skills.name: 普通攻击：热血上工操（爆发状态）
skills.description:
[爆发状态]下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的混合攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
在第二段[电钻攻击]和第三段[打桩攻击]期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] while Anton is in Burst Mode to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 mixed attacks in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During the 2nd Drill Attack and 3rd Piledriver Attack, press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] to extend the skill duration.

skills.name: 特殊技：兄弟，转起来！
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
对前方直线区域内敌人发动[打桩攻击]，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a Piledriver Attack against enemies in a line in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：兄弟，突破天际！
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Smash the Horizon, Bro!
skills.description:
能量足够时，若点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
对前方直线区域内敌人发动多段[打桩攻击]，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，安东将进入[爆发状态]；在[爆发状态]下，安东会使用更加强力的招式，造成大量电属性伤害，并随招式命中目标，逐渐消耗能量，持续至能量耗尽。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launches several Piledriver Attacks at enemies in a line in front of him, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Anton enters Burst Mode after using this skill. When in Burst Mode, Anton's attacks become more powerful, dealing massive Electric DMG while continually consuming Energy upon hitting an enemy. Burst Mode remains active until his Energy is depleted.

skills.name: 特殊技：爆发钻击（爆发状态）
skills.description:
[爆发状态]下，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动[打桩攻击]，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] while in Burst Mode to activate:
Launches a Piledriver Attack at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：动起来
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：硬碰硬
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行撞击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Rams into enemies in front of him, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：回敬拳击
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续重拳，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Continuously strikes enemies in front with heavy punches, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避反击：过载钻击（爆发状态）
skills.description:
[爆发状态]下，触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人使用[电钻攻击]，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in Burst Mode, press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launches a Drill Attack at enemies in front of him, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

skills.name: 连携技：转转转！
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方地面进行大范围[打桩攻击]，对区域内的敌人造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a Piledriver Attack onto the ground in front of him over a large area, dealing massive Electric DMG to enemies within range.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：转转转转转！
skills.nameEn: Ultimate: Go Go Go Go Go!
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方地面进行大范围[打桩攻击]，对区域内的敌人造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a Piledriver Attack onto the ground in front of him over a large area, dealing massive Electric DMG to enemies within range.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：并肩作战
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Continuously strikes enemies in front of him with heavy punches, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：援护钻击（爆发状态）
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动[电钻攻击]，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Attacks enemies in front with a Drill Attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

skills.name: 招架支援：钢腕
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：极限突进

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launches a Drill Attack that ends in a Piledriver Attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：兄弟齐心！

skills.name: 额外能力：通力合作
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
安东进入[爆发状态]后，每触发4次暴击，下一次攻击命中处于[感电]状态下的敌人时，能够额外结算一次[感电]伤害，伤害效果等同于原本的45%，0.5秒内最多触发一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
While Anton is in Burst Mode, for every 4 critical hits, the next attack hitting Shocked enemies triggers an additional bout of Shock DMG at 45% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

cinema.name: 热身运动
cinema.description: [电钻攻击]命中敌人时，能够额外回复能量；同一招式内，该效果最多为安东回复5点能量。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Drill Attack hits an enemy, Anton gains additional Energy, up to a maximum of 5 Energy per skill use.
cinema.story:
「醒了吗？转起来，兄弟！」
「跟上节奏，现在是早操时间！」
cinema.storyEn:
"Are you awake? Get spinning, bro!"
"Try and keep up. It's time to do our stretches!"

cinema.name: 气势如虹
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]进入[爆发状态]时，获得等同于安东7.5%生命值上限的护盾；在[爆发状态]下进入接战状态或换入前场时，将刷新护盾效果，15秒内最多触发一次；退出[爆发状态]时，该护盾效果结束。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Anton uses his EX Special Attack and enters Burst Mode, he gains a Shield that equals to 7.5% of his Max HP. While in Burst Mode, entering combat or switching in reapplies the Shield effect. This effect can trigger once every 15s. The Shield dissipates when Burst Mode ends.
cinema.story:
经过长期的艰苦训练，有少部分幸运儿在进行高强度运动时，会爆发绝佳气势，超水平发挥自身能力，俗称「领域」。
现在，你准备好一起动起来，进入「领域」了吗？
——燃油饮独家冠名节目，「早安，热血上班族！」
cinema.storyEn:
After arduous training, a few lucky individuals will display exceptional vigor and perform above their usual level during high-intensity activities, entering a state of flow commonly known as "being in the zone."
Are you ready to get moving and enter the zone?
— Nitro-Fuel's exclusive program "Good Morning, Zealous Office Workers!"

cinema.name: 轮岗培训
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 什么都会一点只能叫平庸，但在情况复杂多变的空洞作业现场，多一个技能有时就意味着多一个突破困境的可能。
cinema.storyEn: Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but in a complex and ever-changing Hollow worksite, having a wide skillset can present an opportunity to overcome difficulties.

cinema.name: 一起燃烧！
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，全队角色暴击率提升10%，持续12秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Anton uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, all squad members' CRIT Rate increases by 10% for 12s.
cinema.story:
「想想平时训练的感觉，一起动起来！」
当安东开始认真时，所有人的动作都会跟着变得利索起来。
毕竟，如果跟不上他的节拍，明天的早操是要单独加练的。
cinema.storyEn:
"Find your rhythm, and let's get moving!"
When Anton starts to get serious, everyone becomes more nimble.
They have to keep up or else they will be training alone the next day.

cinema.name: 全栈专家
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 什么都会一点只能叫平庸，但如果你足够坚定，从「会一点」变成「很擅长」，那你就是全能！
cinema.storyEn: Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but if you are resolute enough to change from "knowing a bit" to "being excellent," then you become omnipotent!

cinema.name: 突破极限
cinema.description: [打桩攻击]造成暴击时，[普通攻击：热血上工操（爆发状态）]和[闪避反击：过载钻击（爆发状态）]造成的伤害提升4%，最多叠加6层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Anton's Piledriver Attack triggers a critical hit, his Basic Attack: Enthusiastic Drills (Burst Mode) and Dodge Counter: Overload Drill (Burst Mode) deal 4% more DMG for 30s, stacking up to 6 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
「哦，兄弟！你也想燃烧吗！」
每当安东想要突破极限时，
「兄弟」便会爆发出惊人的转速，以嗡鸣声应和着他的意志。
cinema.storyEn:
"Yeah bro, can you feel the burn?"
Whenever Anton wants to exceed his limits,
his "bro" starts spinning at an astonishing pace, its buzzing echoing Anton's resolution.

1121.name: 本

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description: 根据相关数据推测，本现有的服装风格是为了更好地服务于白祇重工，并非出自自身喜好。
profile.descriptionEn: Deducing from relevant data, Ben's current outfit and style is chosen to better serve Belobog Industries rather than from his own preference.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 男
profile.descriptionEn: Male

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: DEC 23

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
第一次看到他的时候确实吓了一跳…
不过没想到本意外的是个软乎乎毛茸茸，性格温和的好熊呢！
profile.descriptionEn:
The first time I saw him, I was definitely taken aback...
Who would've thought Ben was unexpectedly a soft, furry, gentle-natured bear!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
以貌取人是很不好的行为。
虽说如此，但是本好像也经常被要求摆出一副很凶的姿态，用来对敌方进行威慑…似乎效果还挺好的。
profile.descriptionEn:
Never judge a book by its cover.
That said, it seems he's often required to present a menacing image to deter the enemy... and it appears to be quite effective.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对本的印象：
 · 在意的东西：发票，安全帽，鱼子酱。讨厌的东西：发票，按键小过头的计算器，鱼。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Ben:
 · Things he values: Receipts, safety hats, caviar. Things he dislikes: Receipts, calculators with small buttons, fish.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 「毛发养护」是第二重要的日常任务，第一名是「账单核算」。
profile.descriptionEn: · In terms of daily tasks, "fur care" is the second most important. The most important task is "settling the accounts."

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 万兽之王的身躯，操着万兽之王的老妈的心。
profile.descriptionEn: · He has the body of the king of the beasts and the caring heart of the king of the beasts' mother.

1121.description:
本，白祇重工的人（熊）力财务兼资产管理负责人，珂蕾妲的亲信之一。
「我喜欢算术，但这也不妨碍我可以一巴掌拍碎歹徒。」
魁梧健壮的熊希人。
看起来凶狠，实际上出乎意料的心思细腻，对数字相关问题有着天生的敏感性。
原本是白祇重工的一线机械操作工，被珂蕾妲慧眼识英提拔为干部，负责公司的财务工作。
因为感激珂蕾妲对自己的信任，本对她非常忠诚。
喜欢的食物是黑鱼子酱，但是不喜欢鱼。

曾观测到这位壮硕的身影坐在小小的办公椅上，戴着小小的眼镜，用粗大的手指边按计算器边核对白祇重工资产信息的画面。
提问：用绳网上的话来说，这就是所谓的「反差萌」吗？
1121.descriptionEn:
Ben is the financial and asset management director at Belobog Heavy Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"I enjoy mathematics, but that doesn't stop me from giving thugs a good smack."
He's a burly and strong Thiren. Despite his tough exterior, he's of a surprisingly sensitive and detail-oriented nature, especially when it comes to numbers.
Originally a frontline mechanical operator at Belobog, his talents caught Koleda's discerning eye, leading to his promotion to a managerial position responsible for the company's finances.
Grateful for Koleda's trust in him, he remains profoundly loyal to her.
His favorite food is black caviar, but he dislikes fish.

I once witnessed this imposing figure seated in a small office chair, wearing small glasses, and carefully cross-referencing Belobog's asset records while mashing away at a calculator with his huge fingers.
Question: Is that what they call on Inter-Knot a "Kawaii Curveball?"

skills.name: 普通攻击：对账
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的打击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 特殊技：拳债统计
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
架起武器格挡敌人的攻击，随后对前方进行打击，造成物理伤害，若在格挡期间成功格挡敌人的攻击，将提升招式的威力，发动格挡反击，造成大量物理伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 能够维持格挡；
维持格挡时获得护盾，护盾值随时间衰减；
退出格挡后移除护盾，护盾值随时间回复；
护盾值最高不超过本生命值上限的16%；
格挡发动时拥有无敌效果；
打击发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Ben lifts his weapon, blocking the enemy's attack before unleashing a forward strike, dealing Physical DMG. Successfully blocking an attack enhances the power of this skill and triggers Block Counter, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] to remain in the Blocking stance.
While in the Blocking stance, Ben gains a Shield that weakens over time.
After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time.
The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP.
Ben is invulnerable when activating Block.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while launching strikes.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：到期还拳
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
架起武器格挡敌人的攻击，随后对前方进行打击，造成火属性伤害，若在格挡期间成功格挡敌人的攻击，将提升招式的威力，发动格挡反击，造成大量火属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 能够维持格挡；
维持格挡时获得护盾，护盾值随时间衰减；
退出格挡后移除护盾，护盾值随时间回复；
护盾值最高不超过本生命值上限的16%；
招式发动时，回复护盾至最大值；
招式发动后，再次点按 【强化特殊技键】 ，能够向前方追加强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
格挡发动时拥有无敌效果；
打击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Ben lifts his weapon, blocking the enemy's attacks before unleashing a forward strike, dealing Fire DMG. Successfully blocking an attack enhances the power of this skill and triggers Block Counter, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to remain in the Blocking stance.
While in the Blocking stance, Ben gains a Shield that weakens over time.
After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time.
The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP.
When this skill is activated, the Shield is restored to its maximum value.
After activating the skill, press [EX Special Attack] again to follow up with a powerful forward strike, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Ben is invulnerable when activating Block.
Ben is invulnerable while launching strikes.

skills.name: 闪避：发票漏洞
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：前来报销
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行打击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front of him, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：清算
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：盖章，结算
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：拳债，全面清偿
skills.description:

招式发动时，额外回复3点支援点数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
When activating the skill, additionally recover 3 Assist Points.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：联合追债
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

skills.name: 招架支援：分摊风险
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：违约惩罚
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

levels.label: F
levels.description:
本的初始攻击力随初始防御力提升，提升效果等同于自身初始防御力的80%；
在[强化特殊技]中追加强力打击时，为全队角色提供等同于自身30%防御力+550点护盾，持续30秒。
levels.descriptionEn:
Ben's initial ATK increases along with his initial DEF. He gains 80% of his initial DEF as ATK.
When Ben launches a powerful follow-up strike during his EX Special Attack, all squad members gain a Shield of 30% of his DEF +550, lasting for 30s.

skills.name: 额外能力：协议合同
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
拥有[核心被动：守卫]施加的护盾时，角色的暴击率提升16%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
While the Shield from Core Passive: Guardian is in effect, the character's CRIT Rate is increased by 16%.

cinema.name: 反作用力
cinema.description: 发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]，成功格挡敌人的攻击时，攻击者造成的伤害降低30%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When successfully Blocking an enemy with Ben's Special Attack or EX Special Attack, the DMG dealt by the blocked enemy is reduced by 30% for 15s.
cinema.story:
「力的作用是相互的，为什么还要正面撞过来？」
「看来你没有好好计算过」
cinema.storyEn:
"Every action has an equal and opposite reaction. So why do you have to bash things head-on?"
"Looks like your calculations are off."

cinema.name: 以守为攻
cinema.description: 在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]中，成功触发格挡反击时，额外造成本300%防御力的伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: When successfully triggering a Block Counter during Ben's Special Attack or EX Special Attack, inflict an additional 300% of Ben's DEF as DMG.
cinema.story:
不像其他熊希人，战斗时的本非常有耐心。
因为他相信，只要做好防护，一定能等到敌人露出破绽的时刻。
cinema.storyEn:
Unlike other bear Thirens, Ben remains patient when fighting.
He believes if he keeps his defenses up, he can wait until the enemy reveals their weakness.

cinema.name: 精打细算
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 担当财务负责人必须学会精打细算，用一切可用的资源强化大家和自己。
cinema.storyEn: Financial responsibility demands mastering cost-efficiency and utilizing every available resource to enhance both the team and oneself.

cinema.name: 灵活应变
cinema.description: 在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]中，通过无敌效果成功格挡攻击时 ，后继反击造成的伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When successfully blocking enemy DMG with Ben's invulnerable effect during his Special Attack or EX Special Attack, the following counter deals 30% more DMG.
cinema.story:
出于会计的职业本能，
本总是会根据形式，动态调整自己的对策。
无论是账目还是对敌，务必以最小成本达到最佳效果。
cinema.storyEn:
Ben's professional accounting instincts let him adapt dynamically based on the situation.
Whether dealing with accounts or enemies, it's important to achieve the best results at the lowest cost.

cinema.name: 巨细靡遗
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 本敏锐的眼光不会放弃任何报表上的错误，同样也不会放过自己战斗方式上的失误，在纠错中逐渐变强。
cinema.storyEn: Ben's keen eye doesn't miss a single error in statements. The same goes for combat, where he gets progressively stronger as he corrects mistakes.

cinema.name: 野性斗志
cinema.description: 在[强化特殊技]中发动攻击或追加强力打击后，[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]造成的失衡值提升20%，持续12秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: After launching an attack or follow-up attack during Ben's EX Special Attack, Daze inflicted by Basic Attacks, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter is increased by 20%, lasting 12s.
cinema.story:
熊希人与犬希人不同，
并不能用食物安抚他们躁动的情绪。
当他们发脾气时，你唯一能做的就是跑快一点，跑远一点…
——下架书籍《做个好邻居！与希人相处的100个小窍门》
cinema.storyEn:
Bear Thirens are different from canine Thirens.
They can't be appeased with food alone.
When they lose their temper, the only thing you can do is run for your life...
—The discontinued "Be a Good Neighbor! 100 Tips for Getting Along With Thirens"

skillCultivationRecommendation.label: 技能培养建议分组
skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.

1131.name: 苍角
1131.faction: 对空洞特别行动部第六课

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
除监护人月城柳外，苍角似乎还有一名被其称为「姐姐」的亲人。未能在新艾利都任何民事档案中查询到此人的相关信息。
通过交叉查询，比对月城柳与苍角档案的时间轴，可以确认在二人相遇前不久，当时就任于防卫军的月城柳参与了一场对鬼族军事行动并立下首功。
由此推测，月城柳或许掌握苍角「姐姐」的信息。
profile.descriptionEn:
Apart from her legal guardian Tsukishiro Yanagi, Soukaku appears to have another family member whom she refers to as "sister." No information regarding this individual was found in any New Eridu citizen records.
Through cross-referencing records including the timeline on Tsukishiro Yanagi and Soukaku's records, it can be confirmed that Tsukishiro Yanagi was awarded for her outstanding contribution in a military operation against the oni.
Deduction: Tsukishiro Yanagi has more information on the sister of Soukaku.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JAN 23

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 好多避免怎样和不要怎样…光看这些信息搞不好会以为小苍角很难相处呢，明明是个很可爱很好相处的孩子！
profile.descriptionEn: So many "avoid doing this" and "don't do thats"... It makes it look like Soukaku's difficult to get along with, but she's a super cute and sweet kid!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 那是因为我们确实避免了Fairy警告的这些事吧…我是不会冒险去尝试的，嗯。
profile.descriptionEn: That's probably because we've always avoided the things Fairy warns us about... At least, I won't be taking the risk and trying anything.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对苍角的印象：
 · 鬼族都是这么能吃的吗？！还是只有苍角是这样…
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Soukaku:
 · Do all oni eat that much?! Or is it just Soukaku...?

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 虽然喜欢食物，但好像对美味并没有执着的追求…
profile.descriptionEn: · Though she loves food, she doesn't seem bothered as to whether it actually tastes good...

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 虽然很强大，但也还是个孩子呢。多爱她一些吧。
profile.descriptionEn: · She's strong, but she's still just a kid. We should watch out for her.

1131.description:
苍角，对空洞事务特别行动部第六课成员，对空六课副课长月城柳是苍角目前的监护人。
苍角的出身记载在调查协会档案与新艾利都市民认证档案中均缺失，查询到的记录皆自其与月城柳共同生活起始。
同时，在市政学籍系统中亦未查询到苍角的就学记录。根据补充信息，推测苍角仍在接受家庭教育。

苍角性格开朗天真，不拘小节，唯独对于食物似乎存在特殊的执念，需要留意避免苍角陷入饥饿状态。
同时，需要避免让苍角见到浪费食物的情况，对于苍角来说，这是不可接受的。推测苍角曾经历过极端物资匮乏的处境。

苍角对于都市生活、乃至人类社会生活的常识皆较为有限，对于生死的观念似乎也不同于常人。
通常情况下，苍角会相信他人告知自己的任何信息，但这并不意味着她无法分辨谎言。
实际上，根据过往信息判断，除非拥有堪比对空六课某成员般的逃脱、躲藏能力，否则最好不要试图欺骗苍角。
1131.descriptionEn:
Soukaku is a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6 and currently under the guardianship of Section 6's Deputy Chief, Tsukishiro Yanagi.
Soukaku's birth records cannot be found in either the HIA archives or the New Eridu Citizen Verification Profiles. Her records only date back to when she started living with Tsukishiro Yanagi.
There are also no records of her schooling. According to supplementary information, Soukaku is currently homeschooled.

Soukaku is naive, innocent, and carefree, but she possesses an uncharacteristic obsession with food. Please be careful not to let Soukaku become too hungry.
At the same time, please do not let Soukaku see food being wasted. This is unacceptable behavior to Soukaku. Deduction: Soukaku has experienced famine before.

Soukaku's understanding of city life and human society is limited, and her view of life and death differs from most people.
Usually, Soukaku is willing to believe anything other people say, but that doesn't mean she can't tell when something is a lie.
In fact, prior data shows that unless one has the ability to run and hide on par with Section 6, it would be in one's best interest to avoid lying to Soukaku.

skills.name: 普通攻击：打年糕
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：打年糕（霜染刃旗）
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Making Rice Cakes (Frosted Banner)
skills.description:
[霜染刃旗]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段更快速的攻击，造成冰属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Frosted Banner is active, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 faster attacks in front, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.name: 特殊技：吹凉便当
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方扇出风场，随后释放终结一击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间长按 【特殊技键】 ，可以快速衔接[展旗]攻击。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Soukaku releases a wind current in front of her and unleashes her finishing move, dealing Ice DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Holding [Special Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：扇走蚊虫
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方扇出范围更远的风场，造成大量冰属性伤害；
多次点按可以连续发动招式，每次发动时将消耗一定能量，能量不足或停止点按时会自动释放终结一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间长按 【特殊技键】 ，可以快速衔接[展旗]攻击。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Releases wind currents of extended range in front of her, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill can be triggered consecutively by pressing repeatedly. Each use consumes a specified amount of Energy. When Soukaku's Energy is depleted, or you stop pressing the button, she unleashes a powerful finishing move that deals massive Ice DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Holding [Special Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

skills.name: 特殊技：集合啦！
skills.description:
长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
将武器插入地面变形为旗帜，发动[展旗]攻击，造成冰属性伤害，[展旗]攻击命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
[展旗]攻击后再次点按 【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 ，将发动一次特殊的收旗攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
发动[展旗]攻击时，若拥有三层[涡流]，则会消耗所有[涡流]，进入[霜染刃旗]状态；[霜染刃旗]状态下，苍角能够发动强化[普通攻击]和强化[冲刺攻击]，造成大量冰属性伤害，最多持续45秒或触发6次；
苍角的武器在以下情况下会获得[涡流]：
发动[强化特殊技]时，获得一层[涡流]；
发动[连携技]时，获得一层[涡流]；
发动[终结技]时，获得三层[涡流]；
[涡流]上限为三层。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Soukaku plunges her weapon into the ground, morphs it into a flag, and launches Fly the Flag, dealing Ice DMG. Hitting an enemy with Fly the Flag triggers a Quick Assist.
Pressing [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] after Fly the Flag activates a Special Attack as she retracts the flag, dealing Ice DMG.
If Soukaku owns 3 stacks of Vortex on using Fly the Flag, she consumes all 3 stacks and enters the Frosted Banner state. In the Frosted Banner state, she can unleash an enhanced Basic Attack or an enhanced Dash Attack, dealing massive Ice DMG. This effect can last up to 45s or stack up to 6 times.
Soukaku's weapon gains Vortexes in the following circumstances:
Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching an EX Special Attack,
Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching a Chain Attack,
Gains 3 stacks of Vortex when launching an Ultimate.
Soukaku can accumulate a maximum of 3 stacks of Vortex.

skills.name: 闪避：抢食
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：对半分
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：对半分（霜染刃旗）
skills.description:
[霜染刃旗]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成冰属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Frosted Banner is active, press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：别抢零食
skills.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Away From My Snacks
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：鹅鸡斩
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
快速对前方敌人发动多次打击，随后衔接[展旗]攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Soukaku quickly unleashes a series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：大份鹅鸡斩
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
快速对前方敌人发动更多次打击，随后衔接[展旗]攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，苍角会进入[鬼面]状态，使自身的暴击率提升15%，持续15秒；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复10点能量，下一名换入前场的角色额外回复20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Soukaku quickly unleashes an extended series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Soukaku enters the Masked state, increasing her CRIT Rate by 15% for 15s.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in gains an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：双人套餐
skills.nameEn: Quick Assist: A Set for Two
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：防守战术
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：席卷打击
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
招式发动期间长按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以快速衔接[展旗]攻击。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Holding [Basic Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

skills.name: 核心被动：刃旗助威
skills.description: 苍角发动[展旗]时，自身攻击力提升，提升数值等同于苍角10%初始攻击力，最高不超过500点，持续22秒，发动[展旗]并消耗[涡流]时，该增益效果翻倍，最高不超过1000点。队伍中其他角色通过[展旗]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，该增益效果将传递给对应的角色，并刷新其持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn: When Soukaku launches Fly the Flag, her ATK is increased by 10% of her initial ATK, up to 500, for 22s. When consuming Vortex during Fly the Flag, the ATK increase is doubled, up to a max of 1,000. This buff can be passed along to characters switching in via Quick Assists or Chain Attacks triggered by Fly the Flag, and it refreshes the duration of the buff.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.label: 基础
levels.description: 苍角发动[展旗]时，自身攻击力提升，提升数值等同于苍角10%初始攻击力，最高不超过500点，持续22秒，发动[展旗]并消耗[涡流]时，该增益效果翻倍，最高不超过1000点。队伍中其他角色通过[展旗]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，该增益效果将传递给对应的角色，并刷新其持续时间。
levels.descriptionEn: When Soukaku launches Fly the Flag, her ATK is increased by 10% of her initial ATK, up to 500, for 22s. When consuming Vortex during Fly the Flag, the ATK increase is doubled, up to a max of 1,000. This buff can be passed along to characters switching in via Quick Assists or Chain Attacks triggered by Fly the Flag, and it refreshes the duration of the buff.

levels.label: A
levels.description: 苍角发动[展旗]时，自身攻击力提升，提升数值等同于苍角12.5%初始攻击力，最高不超过500点，持续22秒，发动[展旗]并消耗[涡流]时，该增益效果翻倍，最高不超过1000点。队伍中其他角色通过[展旗]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，该增益效果将传递给对应的角色，并刷新其持续时间。
levels.descriptionEn: When Soukaku launches Fly the Flag, her ATK is increased by 12.5% of her initial ATK, up to 500, for 22s. When consuming Vortex during Fly the Flag, the ATK increase is doubled, up to a max of 1,000. This buff can be passed along to characters switching in via Quick Assists or Chain Attacks triggered by Fly the Flag, and it refreshes the duration of the buff.

levels.label: B
levels.description: 苍角发动[展旗]时，自身攻击力提升，提升数值等同于苍角15%初始攻击力，最高不超过500点，持续22秒，发动[展旗]并消耗[涡流]时，该增益效果翻倍，最高不超过1000点。队伍中其他角色通过[展旗]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，该增益效果将传递给对应的角色，并刷新其持续时间。

When consuming Vortex during Fly the Flag, the ATK increase is doubled, up to a max of 1,000. This buff can be passed along to characters switching in via Quick Assists or Chain Attacks triggered by Fly the Flag, and it refreshes the duration of the buff.

skills.name: 额外能力：团膳套餐
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
苍角消耗[涡流]发动[展旗]时，全队角色造成的冰属性伤害提升20%，持续22秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Soukaku consumes Vortex to activate Fly the Flag, the Ice DMG of all squad members is increased by 20% for 22s.

cinema.name: 振奋汇流
cinema.description: 苍角触发[核心被动：刃旗助威]或[额外能力：团膳套餐]时，增益效果的持续时间提升8秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Soukaku triggers Core Passive: Blade Banner or Additional Ability: Group Set Meal, the buff duration is increased by 8s.
cinema.story:
蓄能完毕后，特制充能模块可以形成以太能量风场，为周围的以太设备充能。
对苍角来说，这就像她最喜欢的聚餐时刻。
「大家~来吃自助餐咯！」
cinema.storyEn:
When charged, the special charging module can generate a wind current of Ether energy to charge surrounding Ether devices.
To Soukaku, it's just like having a buffet with friends.
"Guys~ It's all-you-can-eat time!"

cinema.name: 实验型充能模块
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]命中敌人时，苍角有15%的概率获得一层[涡流]，1秒内最多触发一次；[涡流]层数到达上限后，若再次获得[涡流]，将改为苍角回复1.2点能量。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Soukaku's Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist hits an enemy, there's a 15% chance she gains 1 stack of Vortex, triggering up to once per second.
When Vortex reaches max stacks, any additional stacks grant Soukaku 1.2 Energy instead.
cinema.story:
充能模块能够在战斗中不断积蓄能量，
因此被研发部门视作划时代的新概念战术兵器。
但对苍角来说，蓄能完毕，只意味着开饭的时间到了。
cinema.storyEn:
A charging module is able to continuously accumulate energy during battle.
Therefore, it is regarded as an era-defining conceptual tactical weapon by the R&D department.
But for Soukaku, fully charging it simply means it's time to eat.

cinema.name: 出勤餐补
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 要激励苍角努力锻炼的方法非常简单：提高出勤的餐饮补助标准就行。
cinema.storyEn: The best way to motivate Soukaku to train harder is simple: just increase her attendance meal allowance.

cinema.name: 失温症
cinema.description: [展旗]攻击命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性降低10%，持续8秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: If an enemy is hit by Fly the Flag, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 10% for 8s.
cinema.story: 特制武装战鬼刃旗内置强大的制冷装置，产生冷气的催化剂中含有以太物质，能深度伤害被击中的敌人。
cinema.storyEn: The custom-made weapon Oni Banner features a powerful built-in cooling system. Its Ether-infused catalyst generates cold air, dealing significant DMG to enemies it hits.

cinema.name: 夜宵福利
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 要进一步激励苍角努力锻炼的方法也很简单：在出勤餐补之外再追加夜宵。
cinema.storyEn: To further incentivize Soukaku to train is simple: just add a late-night snack top of the attendance meal allowance.

cinema.name: 朔风侵袭
cinema.description: [霜染刃旗]状态下，强化[普通攻击]和强化[冲刺攻击]的可发动次数提升至12次，且招式造成的伤害提升45%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Frosted Banner state, the number of usable enhanced Basic Attacks and enhanced Dash Attacks is increased to 12, and also deal 45% more DMG.
cinema.story: 解开刃旗内的保险装置，让武器以最大功率模式运转，不仅战斗没问题…用来吹凉便当也没问题。
cinema.storyEn: Unlocking the safety device within the blade banner allows it to operate at full capacity. It's not just for combat... it's also handy for cooling down a meal.

skillCultivationRecommendation.label: 技能培养建议分组
skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.
