1141.name: 莱卡恩

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
莱卡恩拥有一段让他自己讳莫如深的过去。
与现在优雅绅士的执事相反，过去的莱卡恩曾经历过一段乖张肆意的时光，有过一位可以交付后背的挚友。
只是曾经生死与共的挚友，如今已是剑拔弩张的宿敌。

备注：由于信息不足，难以得知莱卡恩黑历史的详细信息。
建议您尝试对当事人进行多方位打探，获取更多有效情报。
profile.descriptionEn:
Lycaon has a troubled past that he keeps to himself.
Despite his current elegant and gentle demeanor, the former Lycaon led a wild lifestyle and had a friend whom he trusted implicitly.
However, this friend has now become a bitter enemy.

Note: Due to limited information, it is challenging to uncover the specifics of his past.
You should consider trying to gather information from different angles about the individuals involved to obtain more valuable intelligence.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 男
profile.descriptionEn: Male

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: OCT 4

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
这个世界上真的有能难倒莱卡恩的东西吗？
总感觉不管遇到什么问题（只要摸摸他的尾巴）莱卡恩全部都能解决！
profile.descriptionEn:
Is there truly anything in this world that poses a challenge for Lycaon?
It seems that no matter what obstacles he encounters, he effortlessly solves them all (as long as you touch his tail)!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
铃，你的评价是不是混进去了什么奇怪的真心话…
还有Fairy建议我们摸的是下巴和脑袋，不是尾巴。
profile.descriptionEn:
Belle, did your comment get mixed up with your personal preferences...?
And Fairy suggested touching Lycaon's chin and head, not his tail.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对莱卡恩的印象：
 · 自律如莱卡恩，也会有因为掉毛而烦恼的时候…
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Lycaon:
 · Even the highly self-disciplined Lycaon worries about shedding fur...

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 作为万能执事，莱卡恩并不会向雇主索取灵魂作为报酬
profile.descriptionEn: · While Lycaon is an incredibly versatile attendant, he won't demand their soul as payment from his employers.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 无论过去如何，现在的莱卡恩始终是非常可靠的同伴
profile.descriptionEn: · No matter what happened in his past, Lycaon remains an unwaveringly reliable companion.

1141.description:
莱卡恩，维多利亚家政的实质领导者兼对外负责人，负责统筹管理所有成员的工作。
理性又可靠，举止优雅绅士，如同万能执事一般，不管发生什么事情都能妥善解决。是团队最坚实的后盾，令人心安的存在。
有些轻微的洁癖，总会习惯性地把周围清理干净，难以忍受脏污的环境。

虽然莱卡恩看起来总是波澜不惊的优雅模样，但偶尔也会因为犬系的生理本能暴露本心。当他特别高兴的时候，尾巴和耳朵总会无意识地摆动。当事人似乎也清楚的知晓这一点，并为此感到困扰。
除此之外，如同大多数毛茸茸的希人一样，莱卡恩很在意自己的毛发状况。

建议：以犬科希人的喜好来说，如果摸摸他的脑袋或者下巴，或许可以增加您和他之间情感连接（不保证成功率）。
*风险提示：由于莱卡恩身高较高，您可能即使垫脚也做不到上述动作。
1141.descriptionEn:
Lycaon, the substantive leader and representative of Victoria Housekeeping Co., is responsible for managing all members of the company.
Rational and reliable, Lycaon is an elegant gentleman and a versatile attendant who can solve any problem. He is the cornerstone of his team and a reassuring presence.
He has a slight obsession with cleanliness, always tidying up his surroundings and unable to tolerate dirty environments.

Although Lycaon maintains his elegance and composure, his canine instincts occasionally shine through. When he is particularly happy, his tail and ears unconsciously wag. He seems to be aware of this habit and somewhat bothered by it.
Additionally, like most furry Thiren, Lycaon takes great care of his fur.

Suggestion: Since Lycaon is a canine Thiren, stroking his head or chin may enhance the emotional connection between you. (Note: Success is not guaranteed.)
* Risks: Due to his height, you may not be able to do this even if you stand on tiptoes.

skills.name: 普通攻击：狩月舞步
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成物理伤害；
长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，提升招式的威力，并造成冰属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold down [Basic Attack] to charge up, increasing the power of the attack and dealing Ice DMG.

skills.name: 特殊技：追猎时刻
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行连续打击，造成冰属性伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of strikes in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Hold down [Special Attack] to charge up, increasing its power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：狂猎时刻
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力连续打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，消耗能量并提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Hold down [EX Special Attack] to charge up, consuming Energy and enhancing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：进退得体
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：保持清洁
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方滑铲进行连续打击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slides forward, launching a series of strikes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：礼仪教导
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：遵命
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力连续打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes at enemies in a small area in front of him, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：不辱使命
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力连续打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes multiple powerful strikes at enemies in a large area, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：狼群
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：狩猎干预
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

variants.name: 招架支援：狩猎干预
variants.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
variants.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：复仇反扑
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
在前方生成冰柱并对区域内的敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Creates an icicle in front, which strikes all enemies within range, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞（潜能觉醒）
skills.nameEn: Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz (Potential Awakening)
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人快速发动多段打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Quickly launch multiple strikes against enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：金属狼足
skills.description:
莱卡恩在[普通攻击]中完成蓄力时，招式造成的失衡值提升40%；
[强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]或[支援突击：复仇反扑]命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性降低25%，持续30秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Lycaon charges his Basic Attack to completion, the attack deals 40% increased Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack hits an enemy, the target's Ice DMG RES decreases by 25% for 30s.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.label: 基础
levels.description:
莱卡恩在[普通攻击]中完成蓄力时，招式造成的失衡值提升40%；
[强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]或[支援突击：复仇反扑]命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性降低25%，持续30秒。
levels.descriptionEn:
When Lycaon charges his Basic Attack to completion, the attack deals 40% increased Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack hits an enemy, the target's Ice DMG RES decreases by 25% for 30s.

levels.label: A
levels.description:
莱卡恩在[普通攻击]中完成蓄力时，招式造成的失衡值提升46.6%；
[强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]或[支援突击：复仇反扑]命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性降低25%，持续30秒。

variants.description:
莱卡恩在[普通攻击]中完成蓄力或发动[闪避反击]、[冲刺攻击]时，招式造成的失衡值提升40%；
[强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]、[支援突击：复仇反扑]或[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性降低25%，受到的其他属性伤害提升30%，持续30秒。
进入战场时，莱卡恩会获得一次进入[围猎]状态的次数。
[围猎]状态有可用次数时，[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]命中敌人时将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，招式持续期间，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]入场时，莱卡恩会进入[围猎]状态，持续8秒。
当精英或首领级敌人进入失衡状态时获取一次进入[围猎]状态次数。[围猎]状态次数最多保存一次。
[围猎]状态结束时，莱卡恩会自动发动[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]，若[围猎]状态提前结束，每剩余1秒时长便会使下一次[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]造成的失衡值提升6%。
当前操作中角色停止进攻或发动[连携技]和[终结技]时，莱卡恩会提前结束[围猎]状态。
莱卡恩主动发动[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]时，也会提前结束[围猎]状态，但不会自动发动[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]。
[围猎]状态持续期间，莱卡恩会根据当前操作中角色发动的招式，分别相应发动[普通攻击]、[闪避]、[冲刺攻击]和[闪避反击]。
当操作中角色发动[普通攻击]或[强化特殊技]时，莱卡恩会同步发动[普通攻击]第一段至第三段；
当操作中角色发动[闪避]和[闪避反击]时，莱卡恩会同步发动[闪避]和[闪避反击]，处于[围猎]状态下发动[闪避反击]后，莱卡恩可直接衔接[普通攻击]第三段。
[围猎]状态持续期间，莱卡恩为非当前操作中代理人时发动的招式仅造成伤害与失衡值；莱卡恩为当前操作中角色时，[围猎]持续时间不再减少。
variants.descriptionEn:
When Lycaon completes charging during a Basic Attack, or activates a Dodge Counter or Dash Attack, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by 40%.
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt, Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack, or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz hits an enemy, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by 30% for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one Encircle Prey activation chance.
When Encircle Prey has available activations, hitting an enemy with Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via Quick Assist, Lycaon enters the Encircle Prey state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 Encircle Prey activation chance is gained. Up to 1 Encircle Prey activation can be stored.
When the Encircle Prey state ends, Lycaon automatically activates Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz. If the Encircle Prey state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz increases by 6%.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Lycaon will end the Encircle Prey state early.
When Lycaon manually uses Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz, the Encircle Prey state also ends early, but Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz will not be automatically triggered.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, Lycaon will activate Basic Attack, Dodge, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a Basic Attack or EX Special Attack, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his Basic Attack.
When the active character performs a Dodge or Dodge Counter, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a Dodge or Dodge Counter. After performing a Dodge Counter while in the Encircle Prey state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his Basic Attack.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the Encircle Prey duration does not decrease.

进入战场时，莱卡恩会获得一次进入[围猎]状态的次数。
[围猎]状态有可用次数时，[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]命中敌人时将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，招式持续期间，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]入场时，莱卡恩会进入[围猎]状态，持续8秒。
当精英或首领级敌人进入失衡状态时获取一次进入[围猎]状态次数。[围猎]状态次数最多保存一次。

levels.descriptionEn:
When Lycaon completes charging during a Basic Attack, or activates a Dodge Counter or Dash Attack, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by 60%.
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt, Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack, or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz hits an enemy, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by 30% for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one Encircle Prey activation chance.
When Encircle Prey has available activations, hitting an enemy with Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via Quick Assist, Lycaon enters the Encircle Prey state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 Encircle Prey activation chance is gained. Up to 1 Encircle Prey activation can be stored.
When the Encircle Prey state ends, Lycaon automatically activates Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz. If the Encircle Prey state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz increases by 6%.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Lycaon will end the Encircle Prey state early.
When Lycaon manually uses Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz, the Encircle Prey state also ends early, but Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz will not be automatically triggered.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, Lycaon will activate Basic Attack, Dodge, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a Basic Attack or EX Special Attack, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his Basic Attack.
When the active character performs a Dodge or Dodge Counter, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a Dodge or Dodge Counter. After performing a Dodge Counter while in the Encircle Prey state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his Basic Attack.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the Encircle Prey duration does not decrease.

cinema.name: 满月蓄势
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]命中敌人时，招式造成的失衡值提升12%，8秒内最多触发一次；在[强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]中完成蓄力时，该增益效果额外提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Lycaon's EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt hits an enemy, the attack's Daze increases by 12%. This effect can trigger once every 8s. When he charges his EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt to completion, this buff will increase by an additional 10%.
cinema.story:
据记载，当狼人身处月夜的时候，其攻击性将有显著提升。
「不要直视月亮。」
cinema.storyEn:
Records suggest that werewolves exposed to moonlight become significantly more aggressive.
"Don't stare directly at the moon."

cinema.name: 能量回馈
cinema.description: 使敌人失衡或触发队友的[连携技]时，莱卡恩回复5点能量，1秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Stunning an enemy or triggering a squad member's Chain Attack, Lycaon gains 5 Energy. Can trigger once every 1s.
cinema.story:
「对于犬科动物来说，当他们完成某些较难的任务后，大脑所产生的兴奋感会短暂地提升他们的精神能量。」
「这时作为主人的你若是可以摸摸他们的头，以示鼓励，他们将为此感到非常开心…」
——摘自《犬类动物不靠谱研究手册》
cinema.storyEn:
"Canines receive a brief dopamine boost in their brains after completing semi-complex tasks. At that moment, if their owner pets them to show encouragement, they will be extremely happy..."
—Excerpt from the "Handbook of Unreliable Canine Research"

cinema.name: 执事教养
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 他的举手投足总是充满从容，他的言谈举止让人如沐春风。执事的教养就是让一切都在掌握中。
cinema.storyEn: His every gesture exudes poise, and his words and actions are as refreshing as a spring breeze. An attendant's training is about maintaining control over everything.

cinema.name: 保持风度
cinema.description:
在[普通攻击]或[特殊技]的发动期间受到敌方攻击时，
莱卡恩立刻获得等同于自身7.5%生命值上限的护盾，持续15秒，
护盾持续期间抗打断等级提升，15秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn:
If Lycaon is attacked while using a Basic Attack or Special Attack, he will immediately gain a Shield equal to 7.5% of his Max HP, lasting for 15s.
During the Shield's duration, his Anti-Interrupt level is increased. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
cinema.story: 「优秀的执事，在任何情况下都能保持风度。」
cinema.storyEn: "An outstanding attendant maintains a graceful demeanor at any and all times."

cinema.name: 头狼本色
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 他的眼神暗藏野性，他的喉间滚动嚎音。不论现在的他如何优雅，礼服下的他依然凶猛。
cinema.storyEn: His glance harbors a primal ferocity, and the echoes of his howls rumble within his throat. Regardless of his current gracefulness, underneath the formal wear, he's still untamed.

cinema.name: 冷酷猎手
cinema.description: 蓄力攻击命中敌人时，莱卡恩对目标造成的伤害提升10%，最多叠加5层，持续12秒；同一招式内最多叠加1层效果，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When a charged attack hits an enemy, the target suffers 10% increased DMG from Lycaon, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 12s. Only one stack can be gained per skill use, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
「抱歉，即使如此，我也是不会手下留情的。」
「毕竟，空洞可不是什么需要公平对决的地方。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Apologies, but given the circumstances, I will not show any mercy."
"After all, if a fair fight is what you are after, a Hollow is not the place to look for it."

1151.name: 露西

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
露西加入卡吕冬之子的契机非常具有戏剧性。
为了逃离家族，她买通了「绑匪」，亲手为自己策划了一起绑架案，却阴差阳错被卡吕冬之子搅乱了一切——凯撒打趴了所有「绑匪」，救下了这位「受害者」。
据相关人员称，凯撒最终驾驶机车逆着光破门而入的模样，给露西留下了深刻的印象。
「那一刻，我看见了『自由』。」
从那之后，露西便赖上了凯撒，一心想要加入卡吕冬之子。
profile.descriptionEn:
The way Lucy joined the Sons of Calydon was both comedic and dramatic.
To run away from home, she hired some "kidnappers" and devised a kidnapping for herself. Yet, this plan was accidentally screwed up by the Sons of Calydon — Caesar defeated all the "kidnappers" and saved their "victim."
According to eye-witness testimony, the sight of Caesar crashing straight through the door on her ride with the sunlight behind her left quite the impression on Lucy.
"That was when I saw it — freedom."
From then on, Lucy stuck with Caesar, eager to join the Sons of Calydon.

profile.description: · 为了外环的星空…与薯片自由！
profile.descriptionEn: · For the stars of the Outer Ring... and chip freedom!

1151.description:
露西，目前主要负责卡吕冬之子的对外商务和野猪管理工作。
因为全名过长，且不想再和家族扯上关系，她在外环会统一称呼自己为露西。
身边的三只小猪分别叫做阿草，阿木和阿砖，对露西忠心耿耿。
虽然露西平时会将脏话和敬语结合使用，但在她的举手投足之间隐约能窥见良好教育的痕迹。

露西的家族非常富裕。她从小在优越的环境里长大，似乎世界上的一切都唾手可得——除了自由。
在检测出良好的以太适体质后，露西一心想要成为空洞调查员，却遭到了家族的强烈反对。在经历斥责辱骂，关禁闭和冷暴力之后，露西决定离家出走，追寻自由。
「本小姐才不会回去！一旦被家里人找到…那就再也没有什么星辰大海，只能继承家业了！」

露西拥有强烈的胜负欲，最喜欢赢，最讨厌输。
目前让她输最惨的人是凯撒，因此露西隔三差五就会找凯撒进行一番对决，屡败屡战，屡战屡败。
1151.descriptionEn:
Lucy is currently in charge of outgoing business and managing boars for the Sons of Calydon.
Since her name is far too long and she doesn't want to be involved with her family, she refers to herself as just "Lucy" in the Outer Ring.
Her three boars are called Grassy, Woody, and Bricky, and they're unceasingly loyal to her.
Though Lucy often speaks with a mixture of rough and elegant language, her actions subtly betray the marks of a proper education.
Lucy's family is incredibly wealthy. She grew up very privileged, with anything she could ever want within grasp... except for freedom.
After her Ether Aptitude test results came back high, Lucy decided she wanted to be a Hollow investigator, but her family disapproved. She was met with harsh words, isolation and confinement, and emotional abuse which led to her deciding to leave to find her own freedom.
"Hmph! There's no chance I'll ever go back! If I'm found... then I can say goodbye to the stars and sky and I'll have to inherit the family business instead!"
Lucy is extremely competitive. She loves to win and hates losing.
Currently, the one who has given her the most bitter taste of defeat is Caesar, so Lucy keeps challenging Caesar to duels, losing then challenging again, challenging then losing again.

skills.name: 普通攻击：淑女的球棍
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
当露西发动[普通攻击]第四段时，场上的亲卫队小猪会一起发动[亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Strike forward up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When Lucy uses her fourth Basic Attack, the currently on-field guard boars will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing! together.

skills.name: 亲卫队小猪：抄家伙！
skills.description: 战斗中，亲卫队小猪会随机使用棒球棍、拳套、弹弓，自动对敌人发动攻击， 造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: In combat, the guard boars will randomly use a baseball bat, boxing gloves, or a slingshot to automatically attack enemies, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！
skills.description: 当露西发动[普通攻击]第四段，或自身获得[加油！]状态时，亲卫队小猪会挥舞棒球棍持续转圈，对周围敌人造成物理伤害。若无法立即发动，亲卫队小猪会记住所需发动次数。
skills.descriptionEn: When Lucy uses the fourth Basic Attack, or when she gains the Cheer On! status, the guard boars will whirl their baseball bats in a continuous motion, dealing Physical DMG to nearby enemies. If the attack cannot be executed immediately, the guard boars will remember the required number of times to execute it.

skills.name: 特殊技：安打！
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[平直球]，亲卫队小猪命中敌人或墙壁时引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害。
长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[高飞球]，亲卫队小猪从空中落地时引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing Fire DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：全垒打！
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[平直球]，亲卫队小猪命中敌人或墙壁时引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[高飞球]，亲卫队小猪从空中落地时引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.
With enough Energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

skills.name: 加油！
skills.description: 发动[强化特殊技]后，亲卫队小猪引发爆炸时，将为全队角色、邦布和亲卫队小猪施加[加油！]状态。[加油！]状态下，友方单位的攻击力提升，提升数值等同于露西13.8%初始攻击力+44点，最高不超过600点。击出[平直球]时，[加油！]状态持续10秒，击出[高飞球]时，[加油！]状态持续15秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。

While under the Cheer On! status, allies' ATK increases by 13.8% of Lucy's initial ATK + 44, up to a maximum of 600. The Cheer On! status lasts for 10s when a Line Drive is hit, and 15s when a Fly Ball is hit. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.name: 闪避：坏球！
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：豪勇猪突！
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速打击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：獠牙折转！
skills.description:
极限闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：大满贯！
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
露西起跳将场上亲卫队小猪打出，对前方大范围敌人造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Lucy jumps up and sends a guard boar at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

skills.name: 终结技：再见全垒打！
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
将所有亲卫队小猪依次打出，对前方大范围敌人造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复10点能量，下一名换入前场的角色额外回复20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch all guard boars sequentially, dealing massive Fire DMG in a large area to enemies ahead.
While using this skill, other squad members recover 10 energy, and the next character to switch in gains an additional 20 energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

skills.name: 快速支援：触身球！
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

skills.name: 招架支援：安全上垒！
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：触垒得分！
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：赤鬣亲卫队
skills.description: 当露西发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，亲卫队小猪会加入战斗并呼叫出另外两只亲卫队小猪；亲卫队小猪可以继承露西的攻击力、冲击力和异常精通；[加油！]对亲卫队小猪的增益效果提升至原本的140%，并使亲卫队小猪的攻击频率提升。

The guard boars inherit Lucy's ATK, Impact, and Anomaly Proficiency. The Cheer On! buff for the guard boars is increased to 140% of the original effect, and their attack frequency is increased.

skills.name: 额外能力：击「球」准备！
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或[命破]角色时触发：
亲卫队小猪可以继承露西的暴击率和暴击伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction or is a Rupture character:
The guard boars inherit Lucy's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG.

cinema.name: 队形操练中
cinema.description: 亲卫队小猪发动[亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！]时，为露西回复2点能量，15秒内最多触发一次，每只亲卫队小猪单独结算冷却时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When the guard boars launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!, Lucy recovers 2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 15s, with each guard boar having its own separate cooldown.
cinema.story:
「阿草，向右看齐！…那是左边，笨蛋！！！」
一声令下，两种方向，三阵惨呼，四面哀嚎。
cinema.storyEn:
"Grassy, eyes right! ...That's left, you idiot!!!"
One command, two directions, three cries of pain, and wails all around.

cinema.name: 小猪大队长
cinema.description: 露西发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，将为全队角色、邦布和亲卫队小猪施加[加油！]状态，持续10秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Lucy uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, it grants all squad members and Bangboo, and the guard boars themselves the Cheer On! status for 10s.
cinema.story:
「毋庸置疑，露西队长是卡吕冬野猪希人最棒的领导者！」
这是阿木在「卡吕冬之子年度工作报告」中的结语。
cinema.storyEn:
"Without a doubt, Captain Lucy is the best leader of the Calydon Boar Thirens!"
This was Woody's conclusion in the "Sons of Calydon Annual Report."

cinema.name: 铁腕监护人
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「要是露西队长在打飞我们的时候下手轻点就更好了。」
这是阿木没敢说出来的后半句心里话。
cinema.storyEn:
"I just wish Captain Lucy would be more gentle when she's smacking us around."
Woody thought, but didn't dare say it out loud.

cinema.name: 无规则球赛
cinema.description: 处于[加油！]状态下的友方单位，暴击伤害额外提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Cheer On! state, allies' CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 10%.
cinema.story: 规则和裁判的肋骨，总有一样要被打破。
cinema.storyEn: Rules and ribs are made to be broken.

cinema.name: 荒原贵公主
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
对球棍下惨叫的对手用敬语，
向匍匐在脚边的敌人说抱歉，
这就是千金的完美礼仪。
cinema.storyEn:
She speaks politely to opponents screaming under her bat.
She apologizes to enemies groveling at her feet.
This is the perfect etiquette of a noble lady.

cinema.name: 獠牙堪烈火
cinema.description: 处于[加油！]状态下的队友[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，一只亲卫队小猪会从空中落地引发爆炸，造成等同于亲卫队小猪300%攻击力的火属性伤害，并使全队角色、邦布和亲卫队小猪的[加油！]状态的持续时间提升5秒；持续时间最多提升3次，上限30秒，重新获得[加油！]状态时刷新可提升次数；亲卫队小猪落地引发爆炸后，将会发动一次[亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！]。
cinema.descriptionEn: When another squad member in the Cheer On! state hits an enemy with an EX Special Attack, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing Fire DMG equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK. This will extend the duration of the Cheer On! buff for all squad members and Bangboo, and for the guard boars themselves by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the Cheer On! state resets the stack count. After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!.
cinema.story:
被称为「赤鬣亲卫队」的小猪希人们总是冲锋在战斗的最前线！
虽然说不清从球棒起飞的那一刹那，心绪是万念俱灰还是心甘情愿。
勇敢小猪，身先士卒！
cinema.storyEn:
The little boar Thirens known as the Crimson Mane Guard are always at the forefront of battle!
Though it's hard to tell if, at the moment they're launched by the bat, they feel total despair or just accept their fate.
Brave little boars, leading the charge!

1161.name: 莱特

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
莱特曾是雇佣兵团的团长。
发生了某个意外之后，莱特解散了佣兵团，并欠下一笔巨款。为了还清款项，莱特选择进入地下搏击场。
随后莱特被大老爹发现，高价雇佣他进入卡吕冬之子，代替比利之前的位置。
profile.descriptionEn:
Lighter was once the leader of a mercenary troupe.
After a certain accident, Lighter disbanded his group of mercenaries and ended up in serious debt. Lighter chose to fight in an underground arena to pay back what he owed.
Later, Lighter was discovered by Big Daddy, who paid a huge sum to hire him to join the Sons of Calydon and take Billy's previous position.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 男
profile.descriptionEn: Male

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: DEC 27

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
莱特之前是不是说过自己晕血？然后一直戴着墨镜也是因为晕血…
晕血的人可以当常胜冠军吗？还能在地下搏击场打拳…
profile.descriptionEn:
Didn't Lighter say that he'd faint at the sight of blood? And that's why he always keeps his shades on?
Can someone who faints at the sight of blood really be a Champion? And even fight underground boxing matches...?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 总觉得这是非常敷衍的借口啊…
profile.descriptionEn: This feels like a poorly crafted excuse...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对莱特的印象：
 · 莱特的手下败将…到底有几位数？
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Lighter:
 · So... how many people has Lighter defeated?

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 墨镜给他带来了帅气，也带来了困扰。
profile.descriptionEn: · His shades make him look cool, but also bring trouble.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 愿时间可以治愈这一切。
profile.descriptionEn: · I hope time heals all wounds.

1161.description:
莱特，卡吕冬之子的常胜冠军，前雇佣兵。
在外环，常胜冠军指团战中专门负责解决对面最强战士的成员，通常需要进行一对一的决斗，为团长消除威胁。他的胜利至关重要，可以带来巨大的荣耀，并鼓舞整个团队的士气。
「常胜冠军可以死，但不能输。」

卡吕冬之子的常胜冠军象征物是一条红色的围巾。
即使敌人没有听说过莱特，只要看到红围巾便能认出他的身份。

根据已有信息推断，莱特本身是个相对低调的人。只有在履行常胜冠军职责的时候，他才会刻意在战场上做出高调的表演。
备注：莱特是卡吕冬之子的第二任「红围巾」。他会戏谑地称呼上一任为「前辈」。
1161.descriptionEn:
Lighter, the Champion of the Sons of Calydon and an ex-mercenary.
In the Outer Ring, the Champion of a team refers to the one responsible for dealing with the opponent's strongest fighter in a gang fight, and they often need to participate in one-on-one duels. Their victory is crucial, as it brings glory and morale to the entire team.
"The Champion can perish, but cannot lose."

A red scarf is what identifies the Champion of the Sons of Calydon.
Even if the opponent doesn't know Lighter, they'll know who he is just from seeing that red scarf.

From what is currently known, Lighter is actually very low profile. He only steals the spotlight on the battlefield when he acts on his obligations as Champion.
Note: Lighter is the second Red Scarf of the Sons of Calydon. He teasingly refers to the previous Red Scarf as "Brother" or "predecessor."

skills.name: 普通攻击：L式轰鸣拳
skills.description:
点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
在[普通攻击]第三段发动期间，拖曳摇杆，同时连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以持续发动连续体术追击，松开摇杆，则衔接后继第四段[普通攻击]；
在[普通攻击]第五段轻拳起攻期间，拖曳摇杆，同时连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以循环发动轻拳起攻和第四段[普通攻击]，松开摇杆，则衔接后继刺拳连击；
保持连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 时，可以延长刺拳连击的持续时间；
停止连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 后，或刺拳连击至持续时间上限后，将向前方发动终结一击，终结一击期间拥有无敌效果；
[普通攻击]第五段发动期间，莱特受到的伤害降低40%；
[士气喷发]状态下，[普通攻击]第五段发动期间抗打断等级提升，伤害降低效果提升至80%。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press or hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, drag the joystick, and repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to unleash a series of melee follow-up attacks. Release the joystick to follow up with the 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
While performing the startup light punch in the 5th hit of the Basic Attack, drag the joystick and repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to keep alternating between the light punch and 4th hit of the Basic Attack. Release the joystick to follow up with the subsequent jab combo.
Continue repeatedly pressing or holding [Basic Attack] to extend the duration of the jab combo.
When you stop pressing or holding [Basic Attack], or when the combo reaches its maximum duration, launches a Finishing Move forward. Lighter is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.
During the 5th hit of the Basic Attack, Lighter takes 40% less DMG.
While in the Morale Burst state, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during the 5th hit of his Basic Attack, and the DMG reduction effect is increased to 80%.

skills.name: 特殊技：V式日轮升拳
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用上勾拳向前方进行打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
垫步闪避期间，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用组合拳向前方进行打击，造成火属性伤害；
发动该招式不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with an uppercut, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Press [Special Attack] during a shuffle dodge to activate:
Strike forward with a series of punches, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill will not interrupt the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：V式日轮升拳-全冲程
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: V-Form Sunrise Uppercut - Full Distance
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用上勾拳离地跃起并向前方进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间，再次点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以额外消耗能量，发动强力追击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第四段[普通攻击]。
垫步闪避期间，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用组合拳向前方进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动该招式不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第五段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with a powerful uppercut, leaping into the air and dealing massive Fire DMG.
During the move, press [EX Special Attack] again to spend additional Energy to perform a powerful follow-up attack, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill
After using the move, press or hold [Basic Attack] to transition to the 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
During the shuffle dodge, with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a powerful combo punch forward, dealing massive Fire DMG. Using this skill will not break the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the attack, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately transition into the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

skills.name: 闪避：匿影滑步
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
角色发动攻击期间，点按 【闪避键】 发动：
向摇杆方向垫步闪避；
发动该招式不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Press [Dodge] while the character is attacking to activate:
Perform a quick shuffle dodge in the direction of the Joystick.
This skill will not interrupt the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：骸突
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速打击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：烈闪
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第五段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

skills.name: 连携技：V式灼日炎
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a small area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：W式桂冠终火
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对身周大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：烈闪-守
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第五段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

skills.name: 招架支援：瞬破
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：骸突-刺
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第五段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

skills.name: 核心被动：助燃剂
skills.description:
莱特会随时间自动获得[士气]，每秒回复2.9点，队伍中任意角色每消耗1点能量值，额外为莱特回复0.26点[士气]，莱特最多拥有100点[士气]；[士气]回复至80点时，下一次换入前场将直接发动[快速支援]；[士气]大于等于80点后，莱特发动第五段[普通攻击]时，将进入[士气喷发]状态，提升[普通攻击]第五段中轻拳起攻、刺拳连击和终结一击的威力；威力提升后，招式命中敌人时，会持续消耗[士气]，每消耗10点[士气]，莱特的冲击力提升1%，最多提升10%，持续6秒；
[士气喷发]状态下，莱特不再随时间自动获得[士气]，轻拳起攻或刺拳连击期间耗尽[士气]时，会自动衔接发动更加强力的终结一击；
[士气喷发]状态下，轻拳起攻或刺拳连击命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性和火属性伤害抗性降低15%，持续30秒；
[士气喷发]状态下，终结一击命中敌人时，会对目标施加[溃败]效果，使其进入失衡状态后的失衡持续时间提升3秒，从失衡状态恢复前[溃败]效果对同一目标最多触发一次；
[普通攻击]第五段终结一击命中敌人、换回后场或[士气]耗尽时，莱特将退出[士气喷发]状态，尚未消耗的[士气]会被保留。
skills.descriptionEn:
Lighter automatically gains Morale over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 Morale, up to a maximum of 100. When Morale reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a Quick Assist. Once Morale is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his Basic Attack puts Lighter in the Morale Burst state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume Morale. With every 10 points of Morale consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by 1%, up to a maximum increase of 10%, and lasting 6s.
In the Morale Burst state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain Morale over time. If his Morale is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the Morale Burst state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's Ice RES and Fire RES are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the Morale Burst state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the Collapse effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The Collapse effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his Morale runs out, Lighter will leave the Morale Burst state, keeping any unspent Morale.

levels.label: B
levels.description:
莱特会随时间自动获得[士气]，每秒回复2.9点，队伍中任意角色每消耗1点能量值，额外为莱特回复0.26点[士气]，莱特最多拥有100点[士气]；[士气]回复至80点时，下一次换入前场将直接发动[快速支援]；[士气]大于等于80点后，莱特发动第五段[普通攻击]时，将进入[士气喷发]状态，提升[普通攻击]第五段中轻拳起攻、刺拳连击和终结一击的威力；威力提升后，招式命中敌人时，会持续消耗[士气]，每消耗10点[士气]，莱特的冲击力提升1.33%，最多提升13.3%，持续6秒；
[士气喷发]状态下，莱特不再随时间自动获得[士气]，轻拳起攻或刺拳连击期间耗尽[士气]时，会自动衔接发动更加强力的终结一击；
[士气喷发]状态下，轻拳起攻或刺拳连击命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性和火属性伤害抗性降低15%，持续30秒；
[士气喷发]状态下，终结一击命中敌人时，会对目标施加[溃败]效果，使其进入失衡状态后的失衡持续时间提升3秒，从失衡状态恢复前[溃败]效果对同一目标最多触发一次；
[普通攻击]第五段终结一击命中敌人、换回后场或[士气]耗尽时，莱特将退出[士气喷发]状态，尚未消耗的[士气]会被保留。
levels.descriptionEn:
Lighter automatically gains Morale over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 Morale, up to a maximum of 100. When Morale reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a Quick Assist. Once Morale is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his Basic Attack puts Lighter in the Morale Burst state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume Morale. With every 10 points of Morale consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by 1.33%, up to a maximum increase of 13.3%, and lasting 6s.
In the Morale Burst state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain Morale over time. If his Morale is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the Morale Burst state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's Ice RES and Fire RES are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the Morale Burst state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the Collapse effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The Collapse effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his Morale runs out, Lighter will leave the Morale Burst state, keeping any unspent Morale.

skills.name: 额外能力：斗志昂扬
skills.description:
队伍中存在[强攻]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
[士气喷发]状态下，莱特第五段[普通攻击]命中敌人时，全队角色获得一层[昂扬]，最多叠加20层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每拥有一层[昂扬]，代理人造成的冰属性伤害和火属性伤害提升1.25%，获得[昂扬]时，若莱特的冲击力高于170点，每超过10点冲击力会使每层[昂扬]提供的增益效果额外提升0.25%；队伍中任意角色发动[连携技]时，会刷新全队角色[昂扬]的持续时间；[昂扬]最多使代理人造成的冰属性伤害和火属性伤害提升75%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
While under the Morale Burst state, when the 5th hit of Lighter's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain a stack of Elation, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of Elation, an Agent's Ice DMG and Fire DMG increase by 1.25%.
When obtaining Elation, if Lighter's Impact exceeds 170, every additional 10 points of Impact will increase the buff effect provided by each stack of Elation by an extra 0.25%. When any squad member launches a Chain Attack, it will refresh the duration of all squad members' Elation. Elation can increase the Ice DMG and Fire DMG of Agents by a maximum of 75%.

cinema.name: 常胜冠军
cinema.description: 在[核心被动：助燃剂]所施加的减益效果中，[溃败]效果将使失衡持续时间提升5秒，冰属性伤害抗性和火属性伤害抗性将额外降低10%；在轻拳起攻或刺拳连击期间耗尽[士气]，自动衔接发动强力终结一击时，强力终结一击造成的伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Among the debuffs imposed by Core Passive: Accelerant, the Collapse effect increases Stun duration by 5s, while further reducing Ice RES and Fire RES by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.
cinema.story:
常胜冠军的胜利至关重要。与对面最强的战士决斗，为团长解决威胁——同时为团队带来巨大的士气鼓舞。
对他来说，唯有胜利值得赞颂。
「常胜冠军不能倒下。」
cinema.storyEn:
Victory for the champion is crucial. By facing off against the strongest fighter from the opposing side, he eliminates the threat to his leader — bringing an immense morale uplift to the team.
For him, only victory deserves recognition.
"The Champion cannot be defeated."

cinema.name: 红围巾
cinema.description: 通过[核心被动：助燃剂]对敌人施加[溃败]效果时，目标的失衡易伤倍率提升25%；[额外能力：斗志昂扬]中由[昂扬]提供的冰属性伤害和火属性伤害增益效果提升至原本的120%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When applying Collapse via Core Passive: Accelerant to enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 25%. The increase to Ice DMG and Fire DMG provided by Elation from Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit increases to 120% of the original.
cinema.story:
作为卡吕冬之子的「红围巾」，莱特在外环非常有名。
不只是因为他的拳头，也因为…某些说话风格。
「虽然我乐得清闲…不过没有我的话，你们也搞不定吧？」
cinema.storyEn:
As the "Red Scarf" of the Sons of Calydon, Lighter is quite famous in the Outer Ring, and not just because of his fists, but also due to... his unique way of speaking.
"I enjoy taking it easy... but you wouldn't manage without me, would you?"

cinema.name: 佣兵团长
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 「我大概是全世界最不适合当团长的人吧。」
cinema.storyEn: "I'm probably the last person anyone should pick as their leader."

cinema.name: 墨镜
cinema.description: 莱特位于后场时，前场角色的能量自动回复效率提升10%；莱特进入[士气喷发]状态时，为后场角色回复4点能量，18秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Lighter is off-field, the Energy Regen for the on-field character is increased by 10%. Upon entering the Morale Burst state, Lighter restores 4 Energy for off-field characters. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
cinema.story: 「问我为什么要带墨镜？嗯…因为我晕血啊，大概吧。」
cinema.storyEn: "You're asking why I wear sunglasses? Uh... it's because I get queasy at the sight of blood, I guess."

cinema.name: 决策者
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「给我命令，我来照做。就这么简单。」
莱特推了推自己的墨镜，笑得漫不经心。
「别再让我来做决定就行。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Give me an order, and I'll carry it out. It's that simple."
Lighter adjusted his sunglasses with a carefree smile.
"Just don't put me in charge of making decisions."

cinema.name: 幸存者
cinema.description: 莱特的[士气]回复效率提升至原本的200%；莱特在[普通攻击]、[闪避反击]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]、[快速支援]、[支援突击]、[连携技]、[终结技]中发动重击命中敌人时，将会触发[火焰冲击]效果，造成250%攻击力的火属性伤害，每个敌人8秒内最多触发一次；若莱特的冲击力高于170点，每超过1点冲击力会使[火焰冲击]的倍率额外提升5%，最多提升500%；在轻拳起攻或刺拳连击期间耗尽[士气]，自动衔接发动强力终结一击命中敌人时，可以忽略冷却时间，额外触发一次[火焰冲击]效果。
cinema.descriptionEn: Lighter's Morale recovery efficiency is increased to 200% of its original value. When Lighter lands a heavy strike on enemies during a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Quick Assist, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, it will trigger the Blazing Impact effect, dealing 250% of ATK as Fire DMG. This effect can trigger once every 8s on each enemy. If Lighter's Impact exceeds 170 points, each additional point will further increase the multiplier of Blazing Impact by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 500%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a light punch or jab combo will trigger an additional activation of Blazing Impact when hitting an enemy, ignoring the effect's cooldown.
cinema.story:
重来一次，他绝不会选择成为唯一的幸存者。
可惜命运向来无法选择。
cinema.storyEn:
If given the chance to do it all over again, he would never opt to be the only survivor.
Unfortunately, fate is rarely a choice.

1171.name: 柏妮思

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
「火焰能带来温暖，但也可能造成灼伤。对于这样的人，善用可以取暖，恶用的话…算了，反正凯撒那个笨蛋根本想不出恶用的方式。」
——by某位不愿意透露姓名的大小姐
profile.descriptionEn:
"Fire can bring warmth, but it can also burn. For someone like this, when used with good intentions, they can keep the cold at bay, but when used with bad intentions... well, that idiot Caesar couldn't think of any bad intentions if her life depended on it."
—From a certain young heiress who wishes to remain anonymous

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: MAY 23

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 柏妮思调制的饮品真的很好喝诶，难怪她在外环也很有名！
profile.descriptionEn: Burnice sure makes delicious drinks! No wonder she's famous in the Outer Ring.

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 嗯，只要我们不勇敢尝试她专门给大钢牙调配的饮品就行。
profile.descriptionEn: Yeah, so long as we don't try her blends for Steeltusk.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对柏妮思的印象：
 · 柏妮思热情地关心她的同伴，有人会认为这热情有些过火
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Burnice:
 · Burnice enthusiastically takes care of her companions... maybe a little too enthusiastically.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 她竟然能和狗狗打成一片…为什么好像并不令人意外？
profile.descriptionEn: · Dogs love her... Not surprisingly, really.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 柏妮思偶尔会闯祸，好在她总有办法解决，似乎宇宙意志总站在她这边
profile.descriptionEn: · Burnice gets into trouble sometimes, but she always manages to get out of it. It's like the universe is on her side.

1171.description:
柏妮思，卡吕冬之子的燃油饮调配师。
同时也是个无可救药的燃油宅，卡吕冬之子所有机械设备所使用的燃油都由柏妮思包揽。
她对燃油似乎拥有超乎一切的热情。

柏妮思性格极度外向开朗，自来熟，神经大条。
她对身边的人有强烈的情绪感染力，积极乐观的精神状态能充分感染身边的每一个人。
「喜欢我调的饮料？谢谢你，大钢牙也很喜欢~那家伙一顿能吃两百升呢！」
「想尝尝它的特供燃油吗？很火热的哦~」
1171.descriptionEn:
Burnice, the Nitro-Fuel bartender for the Sons of Calydon.
A hopeless fuel lover. She is responsible for all the fuel used by the machinery owned by the Sons of Calydon.
She seems to have a passion for fuel that overwhelms all else.

Burnice is super outgoing, friendly, and carefree.
She is easily able to spread her emotions to the people around her, bringing them the same optimism she possesses.
"You like the drinks I mix? Thank you! Steeltusk does, too~ That big guy can drink two hundred liters in one go!"
"Do you wanna try its special fuel blend? It's suuuuper hot!"

skills.name: 普通攻击：炽焰直调式
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式
skills.description:
[燃油特调]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
持续回旋并向周身喷射火焰，随后发动终结一击，造成火属性伤害，保持长按可以延长喷射的持续时间；
招式发动时，将会消耗20点[燃点]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；
终结一击发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
skills.descriptionEn:
In the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Spin continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move that inflicts Fire DMG. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
When the move is activated, it consumes 20 Heat;
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

variants.name: 普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式
variants.description:
[燃油特调]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
持续回旋并向周身喷射火焰，随后发动终结一击，额外触发一次不消耗[燃点]的[余烬]，造成火属性伤害，保持长按可以延长喷射的持续时间；
招式造成的伤害同时视为[支援攻击]伤害；
招式发动时，将会消耗20点[燃点]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；

variants.descriptionEn:
In the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Spins continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move, then triggers an extra instance of Afterburn that doesn't cost Heat and deals Fire DMG. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
The DMG dealt by this skill also counts as Assist Attack DMG.
Upon activation, it consumes 20 Heat.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

skills.name: 特殊技：灼热熟成法
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Intense Heat Aging Method
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动一次火焰冲击，造成火属性伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash a fire blast forward, inflicting Fire DMG;
Press and hold [Special Attack] to charge, boosting the move's power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用单手喷射器持续喷射火焰，随后向前方直线范围发动一次火焰冲击，造成大量火属性伤害，保持长按可以持续消耗能量并延长喷射的持续时间；
持续喷射期间拖曳摇杆，可以发动侧身闪避，向对应方向调整身位；
持续喷射期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
侧身闪避和火焰冲击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration.
While continuously spraying, drag the joystick to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Character is invulnerable during sidestep dodge and fire blast.

skills.description:

skills.name: 强化特殊技：灼热抛接法（潜能觉醒）
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Tossing Method (Potential Awakening)
skills.description:
拥有[流火]时，换入前场时发动：
队友触发12次[余烬]后，柏妮思获得一点[流火]，拥有[流火]时，柏妮思下一次换入前场时消耗一点[流火]自动发动该招式，该次入场视作以[快速支援]入场，[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]触发的[余烬]命中敌人时增加2次计数，拥有[流火]时不再增加计数，消耗[流火]时清空计数；
快速突进并越过敌人，向敌人发动一次火焰冲击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式重击命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次原属性异常480%/240%/600%/40%/60%/24%的伤害；
[额外能力：星火燎原]的火属性异常积蓄值提升效果对该招式生效；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
skills.descriptionEn:
If Burnice has Emberflow, coming on-field activates this skill.
After squadmates trigger Afterburn 12 times, Burnice gains 1 point of Emberflow. With Emberflow, Burnice's next entry onto the field consumes 1 stack to automatically activate this skill. This entry is considered a Quick Assist. When Afterburn triggered by Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend hits an enemy, it counts for 2 times. While possessing Emberflow, the counter no longer increases. Consuming Emberflow clears the counter.
Quickly dashes forward and passes through the enemy, unleashing a fiery impact that deals Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the skill's heavy attack hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 480%/240%/600%/40%/60%/24% of the original Anomaly's DMG.
The Fire Anomaly Buildup increase from Additional Ability: Fire Kindling applies to this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

skills.name: 闪避：焰影疾行
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：危险发酵式
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
挥舞喷射器向前方进行突进攻击，造成火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a forward rush attack with the flamethrower, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：摇荡闪
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击并喷射火焰，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：燃油熔焰
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
快速突进并向周身喷射火焰，随后向前方扇形范围发动一次火焰冲击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Quickly dash forward while spraying flames in all directions, then launch a fire blast in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

skills.name: 终结技：纵享盛焰
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
快速突进后跃向空中，对前方大范围区域持续喷射火焰，造成大量火属性伤害；
跃向空中时，将触发[快速支援]，若响应[快速支援]，柏妮思会延长火焰喷射的持续时间；
招式发动时，回复50点[燃点]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Dash forward quickly, then leap into the air and continuously spray flames over a wide area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Burnice will extend the duration of her flame spray.
Upon activation, recover 50 Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：提神特饮
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击并喷射火焰，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a flurry of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

variants.name: 快速支援：提神特饮
variants.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击并喷射火焰，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
variants.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a series of attacks at enemies ahead and sprays flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

skills.name: 招架支援：烟熏油盅
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：灼焰甘露
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
腾空跃起，快速旋转前进并向周身喷射火焰，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Leap into the air and quickly spin forward while spraying flames in all directions, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

skills.name: 核心被动：燃油特调
skills.description:
柏妮思消耗能量值时，会为自身累积[燃点]，最多累积100点；每消耗1点能量值，能够累积1.4点[燃点]，当[燃点]累积至50点时，柏妮思将进入[燃油特调]状态，直到[燃点]耗尽；进入战场时，柏妮思立刻累积100点[燃点]；
[燃油特调]状态下，柏妮思的[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]、[连携技：燃油熔焰]或[终结技：纵享盛焰]命中敌人时，将对目标施加[灼伤]效果，直到柏妮思退出[燃油特调]状态；队伍中其他角色攻击命中处于[灼伤]状态下的敌人时，会触发[余烬]效果，消耗8点[燃点]，对目标造成等同于柏妮思175%攻击力的火属性伤害并累积火属性异常积蓄值，1.5秒内最多触发一次；每拥有10点异常精通，[余烬]效果造成的伤害提升1%，最多提升30%；[余烬]效果造成的伤害被视为[支援攻击]伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat, she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat.
While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame, or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno, she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to 175% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist Attack DMG.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.label: 基础
levels.description:
柏妮思消耗能量值时，会为自身累积[燃点]，最多累积100点；每消耗1点能量值，能够累积1.4点[燃点]，当[燃点]累积至50点时，柏妮思将进入[燃油特调]状态，直到[燃点]耗尽；进入战场时，柏妮思立刻累积100点[燃点]；
[燃油特调]状态下，柏妮思的[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]、[连携技：燃油熔焰]或[终结技：纵享盛焰]命中敌人时，将对目标施加[灼伤]效果，直到柏妮思退出[燃油特调]状态；队伍中其他角色攻击命中处于[灼伤]状态下的敌人时，会触发[余烬]效果，消耗8点[燃点]，对目标造成等同于柏妮思175%攻击力的火属性伤害并累积火属性异常积蓄值，1.5秒内最多触发一次；每拥有10点异常精通，[余烬]效果造成的伤害提升1%，最多提升30%；[余烬]效果造成的伤害被视为[支援攻击]伤害。
levels.descriptionEn:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat, she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat.
While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame, or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno, she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to 175% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist Attack DMG.

skills.name: 额外能力：星火燎原
skills.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
柏妮思[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]命中敌人，或触发[余烬]效果时，招式累积的火属性异常积蓄值提升65%；队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[灼烧]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升3秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
When Burnice's Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method or EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot hits an enemy, or when the Afterburn effect is triggered, the move's accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup increases by 65%. When any squad member applies the Burn effect to an enemy, the duration of that effect is extended by 3s.

skills.levelNoteEn: Applies only at the selected Potential Awakening rank, not to the unawakened base kit.

levels.description: 当柏妮思的初始能量自动回复大于等于1.8点时，超过的部分每拥有0.1点初始能量自动回复，异常掌控额外提升1点，造成的伤害提升1%，异常掌控最多提升25点，造成的伤害最多提升20%；[核心被动：燃油特调]中触发[余烬]的间隔降低至1.35秒。
levels.descriptionEn: When Burnice's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.8, every extra 0.1 points of initial Energy Regen increases Anomaly Mastery by 1 and DMG by 1%, up to a maximum increase of 25 Anomaly Mastery and 20% DMG. potentials.name: 潜能觉醒：沸点派对
potentials.description: 当柏妮思的初始能量自动回复大于等于1.8点时，超过的部分每拥有0.1点初始能量自动回复，异常掌控额外提升1.3点，造成的伤害提升1.25%，异常掌控最多提升25点，造成的伤害最多提升20%；[核心被动：燃油特调]中触发[余烬]的间隔降低至1.35秒。
potentials.descriptionEn: When Burnice's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.8, every extra 0.1 points of initial Energy Regen increases Anomaly Mastery by 1.3 and DMG by 1.25%, up to a maximum increase of 25 Anomaly Mastery and 20% DMG. Core Passive: Nitro-Fuel Cocktail's Afterburn interval is reduced to 1.35s.

potentials.descriptionEn: When Burnice's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.8, every extra 0.1 points of initial Energy Regen increases Anomaly Mastery by 1.6 and DMG by 1.5%, up to a maximum increase of 25 Anomaly Mastery and 20% DMG. Core Passive: Nitro-Fuel Cocktail's Afterburn interval is reduced to 1.35s.

potentials.name: 潜能觉醒：沸点派对
potentials.description: 当柏妮思的初始能量自动回复大于等于1.8点时，超过的部分每拥有0.1点初始能量自动回复，异常掌控额外提升2点，造成的伤害提升1.75%，异常掌控最多提升25点，造成的伤害最多提升20%；[核心被动：燃油特调]中触发[余烬]的间隔降低至1.35秒。

cinema.name: 热络同心
cinema.description: [燃点]的上限从100点提升至140点，进入战场时，柏妮思额外累积40点[燃点]；[余烬]效果的伤害倍率提升，提升效果等同于柏妮思攻击力的100%；[余烬]效果累积的火属性异常积蓄值提升25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Increases the limit of Heat from 100 to 140. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice accumulates an additional 40 Heat. Increases the DMG Multiplier of the Afterburn effect by 100% of Burnice's ATK. Additionally, the accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup from the Afterburn effect is increased by 25%.
cinema.story:
「谁都有不够顺利的时候，很正常啦！」
「别难过，凯撒，来一杯燃油饮特调怎么样？我加了很多很多糖哦！」
cinema.storyEn:
"Everyone has rough times; it's perfectly normal!"
"Cheer up, Caesar! How about a Nitro-Fuel special? I added a ton of sugar!"

cinema.name: 加量不加价
cinema.description: 触发[余烬]效果时，将对敌人施加[热意洞穿]，最多叠加5层，持续6秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；受到我方攻击时，目标每拥有一层[热意洞穿]，本次攻击的穿透率提升4%，最多提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When triggering the Afterburn effect, Thermal Penetration is applied to the enemy, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any allied unit in the squad hits the enemy, the attack's PEN Ratio is increased by 4% for each stack of Thermal Penetration, up to a max of 20%.
cinema.story:
作为卡吕冬之子的调饮师，柏妮思乐于为所有朋友调制新艾利都最美味的燃油饮。
当然，如果你是她的「敌人」…则会有机会喝到前所未有的新口味饮品。
「是一生只能喝一次的超绝美味哦！」
cinema.storyEn:
As the mixologist for the Sons of Calydon, Burnice takes great pleasure in crafting the best Nitro-Fuel drinks in New Eridu for her friends.
Of course, if you happen to be her enemy... you might have the opportunity to try a new and unique flavor too.
"It's a once-in-a-lifetime, absolutely exquisite taste!"

cinema.name: 天性乐观
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「柏妮思那家伙，不管什么时候都是一副元气满满的样子啊！就连刚起床都是！真不知道她从哪来这么多能量…」
「更可怕的是，她还能把身边人都带动着积极起来！这简直快称得上是妖怪了吧！」
「不过…我倒是不讨厌就是啦…」
——来自一位不愿意透露姓名的猪猪管理者
cinema.storyEn:
"That Burnice, she's always so full of energy! Even right after waking up! I have no idea where she gets all that energy..."
"What's even scarier is that she can get everyone around her to be just as enthusiastic! It's almost like she's some kind of monster!"
"But... I don't really dislike it, to be honest..."
— From a boar manager who wishes to remain unnamed

cinema.name: 超绝燃油补给
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]或[支援攻击]命中敌人时，招式的暴击率提升30%；[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]中，火焰喷射的持续时间上限提升1秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When an EX Special Attack or Assist Attack hits an enemy, the move's CRIT Rate increases by 30%. The max flame spray duration of EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot is increased by 1s.
cinema.story:
「喜欢我调的饮料？谢谢你，大钢牙也很喜欢~那家伙一顿能吃两百升呢！」
「哦，大钢牙就是我们的那辆大卡车啦！」
「想尝尝它的特供燃油吗？很火热的哦~」
cinema.storyEn:
"You like the drink I mixed? Thanks! Steeltusk likes them too~ That guy can drink 200 liters in one go!"
"Oh, Steeltusk is our big truck!"
"Wanna try some of its special fuel? It's pretty fiery~"

cinema.name: 火与冰之舞
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
在调制饮品的时候，冰块也是非常重要的一环。
毕竟没有极致的冰冷，就难以衬托出极致的火热。
「这种火与冰交融的感觉~真令人沉迷呢！」
cinema.storyEn:
When mixing drinks, ice is a crucial element.
Without an intense chill, the intense heat just doesn't stand out.
"That fusion of fire and ice~ It's truly captivating!"

cinema.name: 盛焰邀约
cinema.description: 柏妮思的[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]命中敌人时，将额外触发特殊的[余烬]效果，对目标造成等同于柏妮思60%攻击力的火属性伤害，0.5秒内最多触发1次，无需消耗[燃点]；发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]命中敌人后，招式发动期间，[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]、特殊的[余烬]效果、[灼烧]伤害将无视目标25%火属性伤害抗性；在[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]中发动火焰冲击命中处于[灼烧]状态下的敌人时，能够额外结算一次[灼烧]伤害，伤害效果等同于原本的1800%，同一目标20秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Burnice hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, it triggers an additional special Afterburn effect, dealing 60% of Burnice's ATK as Fire DMG to the target. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and does not consume Heat. After hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, while the move is active, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, special Afterburn effects, and Burn DMG will ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES. When EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot's fire blast hits an enemy, if that enemy is Burned, trigger an additional instance of Burn DMG equal to 1,800% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 20s for each target.
cinema.story:
好像从来没有谁见过柏妮思真正生气的样子。
「相信我，你们不会想要看到的~」
——来自一位正在大钢牙上准备入睡的司机
cinema.storyEn:
It seems like no one has ever seen Burnice truly angry.
"Trust me, you don't want to see it."
— From a driver getting ready to sleep atop Steeltusk

1181.name: 格莉丝

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description: 格莉丝的父母均为空洞相关的科研工作人员，在一次危险的空洞考察活动中双双失踪，不久被判定为死亡。独自一人的格莉丝被父母生前的友人霍尔斯，即白祇重工的前任社长，珂蕾妲的父亲所收养。因此格莉丝与珂蕾妲存在非血缘意义上的「姐妹」关系。
profile.descriptionEn: Both of Grace's parents, who were research workers related to the Hollow, disappeared during a dangerous expedition into a Hollow, and were soon presumed dead. Grace was adopted by her parents' former friend, Khors, the previous president of Belobog Industries, and Koleda's father. As a result, Grace and Koleda are "sisters," though not related by blood.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: APR 14

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 总觉得格莉丝对着机械说话的语气，很像人类对着猫猫或者其他可爱小动物说话的感觉…是我的错觉吗？
profile.descriptionEn: Is it just me... or does Grace sound just like a human talking to a cat whenever she's talking to machines?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
是你对猫猫说话的感觉吧。
比起这个，Fairy竟然已经开始思考「我是谁」这样的哲学问题了吗…
profile.descriptionEn:
You mean the way you talk to cats, right?
More importantly, is Fairy already thinking about philosophical questions like "Who am I?"

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对格莉丝的印象：
 · 格莉丝的作息说实话有点恐怖
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Grace:
 · Honestly, Grace's sleep schedule is kinda terrifying.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 对可爱的机械，格莉丝永远充满热爱
profile.descriptionEn: · Grace always has a soft spot for cute machines.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 如何制作一只格莉丝：80%「疯狂科学家」作风，10%似水柔情，10%…商业机密
profile.descriptionEn: · The break-down components of Grace: 80% mad scientist, 10% tenderness, and 10%... business secrets.

1181.description:
格莉丝，白祇重工的技术专家，是将空洞内重工机械技术专利发展完善的核心人才。
醉心于齿轮、金属和电线，是当之无愧的「机械宅」。看到感兴趣的机械设备后会两眼放光，迫不及待想要拆卸研究：
「这冷峻硬朗的线条，真美啊…看得让人心痒痒的~」

在面对机械时，格莉丝总是会表现出超凡的耐心，把这些精密的金属构成物当做自己的孩子般宠爱。
据相关信息判断，格莉丝是唯一敢喊珂蕾妲「小不点」却不会被她锤胫骨的人。
提问：在格莉丝的认知范围内，我是否也算是机械？但我目前并没有实体，因此也不存在齿轮，金属或电线之类的部件。
1181.descriptionEn:
Grace is a technical expert at Belobog Industries. She's the core talent in developing and patenting Belobog's in-Hollow machinery.
She's obsessed with gears, metal and wires — a true mechanical geek. She's eager to dismantle and study any machinery or equipment she takes an interest in: "Such sharp and strong lines, truly beautiful... I can't help but want to open it up and take a look."

Grace always shows extraordinary patience when dealing with machines, doting on the sophisticated metal constructions as if they were her own children.
According to the information at hand, Grace is probably the only one who can playfully refer to Koleda as "Sweet Pea" without receiving a kick in the shin.
Question: Based on Grace's understanding of machines, would she consider me one? I'm currently lacking a physical form, however, so I don't possess components like gears, metal, or wires.

skills.name: 普通攻击：高压射钉
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
在[普通攻击]期间向侧方拖曳摇杆，可以发动垫步射击，调整身位并造成物理伤害；
格莉丝在[普通攻击]期间发动[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]、[闪避]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]时，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
While launching Basic Attacks, drag the joystick to attack while moving. This allows Grace to reposition herself and deal Physical DMG.
While Grace is launching Basic Attacks, her Basic Attack combo will not be interrupted by her Special Attacks, EX Special Attacks, Dodge, Dash Attacks, or Dodge Counter.

variants.name: 普通攻击：高压射钉
variants.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
在[普通攻击]期间向侧方拖曳摇杆，可以发动垫步射击，调整身位并造成物理伤害，在[普通攻击]第一/第二段后发动时，继续点按 【普通攻击键】 会从[普通攻击]第三/第四段连击继续；
格莉丝在[普通攻击]期间发动[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]、[闪避]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]时，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数。
variants.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
While launching Basic Attacks, drag the joystick to move while attacking. This allows Grace to reposition herself and deal Physical DMG. If used after the 1st or 2nd hit of a Basic Attack, pressing [Basic Attack] again resumes the combo from the 3rd or 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
While Grace is launching Basic Attacks, her Basic Attack combo will not be interrupted by her Special Attacks, EX Special Attacks, Dodge, Dash Attacks, or Dodge Counter.

skills.name: 特殊技：工程清障
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Throws a grenade to the front, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon use, drag the joystick to change directions.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

variants.name: 特殊技：工程清障
variants.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位；
消耗[电能]发动时可以闪避敌人的攻击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
variants.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Throws a grenade forward, dealing Electric DMG.
During the skill, drag the joystick to reposition in that direction.
When activated via consuming Zap, dodge incoming enemy attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：超规工程清障
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Supercharged Obstruction Removal
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，并向前方投掷两颗手雷，造成大量电属性伤害；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leap in the air and throw two grenades to the front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Upon use, drag the joystick to change directions.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

variants.name: 强化特殊技：超规工程清障
variants.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Supercharged Obstruction Removal
variants.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，并向前方投掷两颗手雷，造成大量电属性伤害；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位；
若[电能]层数到达上限，会额外投掷一枚[涡流集束手雷]，在爆炸位置生成电磁场，持续牵引敌人，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
variants.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air and throws two grenades forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During the skill, drag the joystick to change directions.
If Zap reaches max stacks, throws an additional Vortex Cluster Grenade, generating an electromagnetic field at the point of detonation that pulls in enemies and deals Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: [脉冲]（潜能觉醒）
skills.description:
发动[终结技]时，获得25层[脉冲]（上限25层），获得[电能]时会消耗一层[脉冲]；
消耗[脉冲]获得8层[电能]时，下次投掷手雷时会额外丢出一枚脉冲手雷，并在命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次原属性异常560%/280%/700%/50%/70%/28%的伤害；
[脉冲]状态下解锁[特殊技：工程清障·循环]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Activating an Ultimate grants 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks). When gaining Zap, consumes 1 stack of Pulse.
After consuming Pulse to obtain 8 stacks of Zap, the next grenade throw includes an additional Pulse Grenade. If it hits an enemy suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 560%/280%/700%/50%/70%/28% of the original Anomaly's DMG.
While in the Pulse state, Special Attack: Obstruction Removal - Cycle is unlocked.

skills.name: 特殊技：工程清障·循环（潜能觉醒）
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Obstruction Removal - Cycle (Potential Awakening)
skills.description:
[脉冲]状态下长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
招式期间持续向前方投掷手雷，造成电属性伤害，每次投掷手雷获得一层[电能]；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位，并可以闪避敌人的攻击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Pulse state, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Repeatedly hurls grenades forward during the skill, dealing Electric DMG and granting 1 Zap stack each time grenades are thrown.
During the skill, tilt the joystick to reposition and dodge enemy attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：安全条款
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：突击检查
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方滑铲扫射，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slide forward while shooting, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：违章处罚
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Throws a grenade at enemies, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

variants.name: 闪避反击：违章处罚
variants.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害，随后自动发动[普通攻击]第四段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
variants.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Throws a grenade at enemies, dealing Electric DMG, then automatically triggers the Basic Attack's 4th hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：协作施工
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向空中抛出三颗手雷，随后扫射将其引爆，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws three grenades into the air then strafes to detonate them, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：工程爆破请勿接近
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出一枚特制的手雷，其在空中爆炸后会分裂成四颗更小的手雷，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

variants.name: 终结技：工程爆破请勿接近
variants.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出一枚特制的手雷，其在空中爆炸后会分裂成四颗更小的手雷，造成大量电属性伤害；
获得8层[电能]和25层[脉冲]（上限25层）；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
variants.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Gains 8 stacks of Zap and 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks).
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：事故解决方案
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对敌人投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched in the air, press [Switch] to activate:
Throws a grenade at the enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 回避支援：快速风险响应
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：反击电针
skills.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动回旋扫射并投掷手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a spinning hail of bullets against enemies in front and throws a grenade, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：预驱动撞针
skills.description: 格莉丝[普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]命中敌人并造成物理伤害时，获得一层[电能]（上限8层）；[电能]层数到达上限后，发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，会消耗所有[电能]，使招式累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升65%。
skills.descriptionEn: When Grace's Basic Attack or Dash Attack hits an enemy and deals Physical DMG, she gains 1 stack of Zap (up to 8 stacks). Upon reaching maximum stacks, using a Special Attack or EX Special Attack will consume all stacks of Zap, increasing the accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 65%.
