skills.name: 额外能力：技术支持班组
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
格莉丝[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，目标下次被施加[感电]效果时，受到的[感电]伤害提升18%，最多叠加2层，同一招式内每个敌人最多触发一次效果，[感电]状态结束时效果重置。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
Upon hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack, the next Shock effect inflicted on the target has increased Shock DMG by 18%. This effect can stack up to 2 times, and each enemy can trigger it once per skill use. Resets when the Shock effect ends.

variants.name: 额外能力：技术支持班组
variants.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或其他[异常]角色时触发：
格莉丝[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，目标下次被施加[感电]效果时，受到的[感电]伤害提升18%，最多叠加2层，同一招式内每个敌人最多触发一次效果，[感电]状态结束时效果重置。
variants.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction, or is an Anomaly character:
When Grace's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, the next time that target is afflicted with Shock, that instance of Shock DMG is increased by 18%, stacking up to 2 times. This effect can trigger on each enemy only once per skill use, and all stacks reset when the Shock state ends.

cinema.name: 再充能弹膛
cinema.description:
[普通攻击]第四段每次命中敌人时，全队角色回复0.25点能量；
同一招式内，该效果最多为全队回复2点能量。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When the 4th hit of Grace's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain 0.25 Energy.
Within the same move, this effect can grant a max of 2 Energy to all squad members.
cinema.story: 效率是工程学的生命。在格莉丝的枪膛里，回响着工程学的心跳声。
cinema.storyEn: Efficiency is the lifeblood of engineering, and within Grace's gun barrel resonates its heartbeat.

cinema.name: 电致击穿
cinema.description: 在[普通攻击]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]等招式中投掷手雷命中敌人时，目标的电属性伤害抗性降低8.5%，电属性异常积蓄抗性降低8.5%，持续8秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Grace's thrown grenade hits an enemy during a Basic Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, the target's Electric RES is reduced by 8.5%, and Electric Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 8.5%, lasting for 8s.
cinema.story:
「解剖」复杂的机械结构是格莉丝最大的爱好，即使是在战斗之中。
被解剖者会作何感想呢？当它们每一方寸的破绽都如此赤裸。
cinema.storyEn:
"Dissecting" complex mechanical structures is Grace's greatest hobby, even in the midst of battle.
How does it feel to get taken apart, with every vulnerability laid bare?

cinema.name: 首席机械师
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
格莉丝亲自参与编写了《白祇重工安全施工指南》，
并且成为了违反「禁止在施工场地携带危险爆炸物」条例次数最多的员工。
cinema.storyEn:
Grace was personally involved in writing the "Belobog Industries' Construction Safety Guidelines."
She's also the employee who violated the "no dangerous explosives at construction sites" policy the most times.

cinema.name: 爆破电容
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]时，格莉丝获得6层充能（上限6层）；[普通攻击：高压射钉]或[冲刺攻击：突击检查]命中敌人时，消耗1层充能，使当前招式的能量获得效率提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Grace uses her EX Special Attack, she gains 6 stacks of Charge (max 6 stacks). When her Basic Attack: High-Pressure Spike or Dash Attack: Quick Inspection hits an enemy, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing her Energy Generation Rate of the attack by 20%.
cinema.story:
安东怀疑，在被格莉丝称为「电脉冲回收模块」的元件里，其实有一只以太仓鼠在不分昼夜地鼠力发电。
「能在我兄弟上也整一个吗？」
cinema.storyEn:
Anton suspected within the component Grace referred to as the "Electropulse Recycling Module," there was, in fact, an Ether hamster tirelessly generating energy around the clock.
"Can you equip my bro with one too?"

cinema.name: 「冰冷铁魔女」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 「冰冷铁魔女」能够驯服任何机械造物，至少起这个名字的匿名粉丝是这么认为的。
cinema.storyEn: The "Frosty Cold Iron Witch" is capable of taming any mechanical beast, or at least that's what the anonymous fan who came up with the name thinks.

cinema.name: 起爆扳机
cinema.description: 消耗所有[电能]发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，能够强化招式效果，额外投掷一颗手雷，并使每颗手雷造成的伤害提升至原本的200%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When all Zap stacks are consumed to activate a Special Attack or EX Special Attack, Grace's skill is enhanced, tossing an extra grenade and increasing each grenade's DMG to 200%.
cinema.story:
白祇重工旗下员工的平均血液温度是九十八摄氏度，格莉丝总是被当作沸腾前的降温阀。
当格莉丝放弃了克制，大家就知道，是时候把耳朵捂上了。
cinema.storyEn:
The average blood temperature of Belobog Heavy Industries' employees is ninety-eight degrees Celsius. Grace is often viewed as the safety valve keeping them all from boiling.
When even Grace gives up control, it's a sign for everyone to cover their ears.

skillCultivationRecommendation.label: 技能培养建议分组
skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.

1191.name: 艾莲

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
艾莲似乎拥有与常人不同的超级味觉：队友丽娜总是会烹饪出各种「奇妙的」食物，而艾莲是唯一一位能够面不改色吃下这些食物的人。

提议：或许您也可以找机会品尝一下丽娜制作的食物，我会将您和艾莲的反应进行对比研究，获取更多重要数据。
profile.descriptionEn:
Ellen appears to possess a unique sense of taste that differs from that of ordinary people. Her teammate Rina consistently prepares various "whimsical" dishes, and Ellen is the only one who can consume them without breaking a sweat.

Suggestion: Perhaps you could also sample Rina's dishes. I will compare your reaction with Ellen's to gather more significant data.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JAN 4

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
之前看到常服的艾莲，还真是吓了一跳呢…
所以对艾莲来说，维多利亚家政的工作莫非就和课外打工一样？真厉害呀！
profile.descriptionEn:
I was somewhat surprised to see Ellen in her school uniform...
For her, working in Victoria Housekeeping is something like a part-time job outside of school, right? That's impressive!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 铃，从某种意义上来说，我们其实也在打两份工…
profile.descriptionEn: In a way, we're also working a part-time job, Belle...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对艾莲的印象：
 · 鲨鱼准则一：卡拉OK的优惠券越多越好！
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Ellen:
 · Shark Rule #1: The more karaoke coupons, the better!

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 鲨鱼准则二：逃课这种事，必须拉上共犯！
profile.descriptionEn: · Shark Rule #2: If you want to skip class, grab an accomplice!

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 鲨鱼准则三：体重和绰号，是不可以说的秘密！
profile.descriptionEn: · Shark Rule #3: Weight and nickname are top-secret!

1191.description:
艾莲，维多利亚家政女仆，也是最后一位加入组织的成员。
节能主义，几乎不喜欢一切需要耗费精力的事情。但在队友们的配合下，可以在关键时刻充分发挥自身的强大战力。
战斗方式具有高耗能特质，通常需要补充糖分，常把棒棒糖叼在嘴里。
虽然嘴上总是说着「麻烦，想换工作」，实际上非常珍惜现在维多利亚家政的队友们。

艾莲在新艾利都的某所学校读书，有一帮普通的朋友们。
除了维多利亚家政的工作之外，艾莲也常常会和朋友们待在一起，过着平凡而快乐的学生生活。

思考：身兼数职的艾莲，需要平衡学生生活和维多利亚家政的工作。
或许这也是艾莲常常感觉到疲惫的原因之一？
1191.descriptionEn:
Ellen is a maid working for Victoria Housekeeping Co. and its latest member.
She is a laid-back individual who dislikes activities that require energy. However, with the full support of her teammates, she can unleash her formidable power during critical moments.
Since her fighting style leads to high energy consumption, she always carries a lollipop in her mouth to ensure an adequate sugar intake.
While she frequently expresses her desire to change jobs due to the hassle, she genuinely values her companions at Victoria Housekeeping.

Ellen attends a school in New Eridu and has a group of ordinary friends.
Apart from her role as a maid at Victoria Housekeeping, Ellen spends a significant amount of time with her friends, leading an ordinary and contented student life.

Thoughts: As a multitasker, Ellen must balance her student life with her job at Victoria Housekeeping Co.
Perhaps this is one of the reasons why she often feels tired?

skills.name: 普通攻击：利齿修剪法
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
第三段攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Physical DMG.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

skills.name: 普通攻击：急冻修剪法
skills.description:
激活[急冻]效果后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
每段攻击消耗1点[急冻充能]；
第三段攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn:
While Flash Freeze is active, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to 3 attacks at enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Each attack consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

skills.name: 普通攻击：冰刃浪（潜能觉醒）
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave (Potential Awakening)
skills.description:
第三段[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]、[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]蓄力剪击、[闪避反击：暗礁]和[快速支援]发动后，若艾莲拥有[急冻充能]，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动[普通攻击：冰刃浪]，造成冰属性伤害；
招式消耗2点[急冻充能];
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush's charged scissor strike, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Quick Assist, if Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, pressing [Basic Attack] will launch Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave, dealing Ice DMG.
This skill consumes 2 points of Flash Freeze Charge.
After use, it can be directly followed up with the 3rd hit of her Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：霜锋（潜能觉醒）
skills.description:
第三段[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]、[强化特殊技：鲨卷风]、[闪避反击：暗礁]和[支援突击]发动后，将自动发动[普通攻击：霜锋]，对前方大范围敌人造成多段冰属性伤害，且对中/大体型的敌人会分别额外造成多段冰属性伤害；
招式发动后，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果；
[普通攻击：霜锋]不影响原本招式派生;
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, EX Special Attack: Sharknami, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Assist Follow-Up, automatically launch Basic Attack: Icy Blade, dealing multiple instances of Ice DMG to all enemies in a large area ahead. It inflicts additional instances of Ice DMG against Medium and Large foes.
After the skill, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect.
Basic Attack: Icy Blade does not affect the branch or form of the original skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：摆尾
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行快速甩尾攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Use a quick tail sweep attack in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：横扫
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力甩尾攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，获得1点[急冻充能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a forceful tail whip attack that deals massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：鲨卷风
skills.description:
[强化特殊技：横扫]发动后，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力连续斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，获得1点[急冻充能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy and after executing EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes ahead that deal massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 闪避：涡漩
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
触发[极限闪避]时，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果，缩短[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]的蓄力时间，最多持续5秒或触发一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A rapid dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When Perfect Dodge is triggered, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, reducing the charge time of Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5 seconds or until it triggers.

skills.name: 冲刺：狩猎巡游
skills.description:
长按或双击 【闪避键】 发动：
进入[巡游]状态，快速冲刺移动；
在[巡游]状态下使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下；
招式发动瞬间拥有短暂的无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold or double-press [Dodge] to activate:
Enter the Roaming state, allowing dashing movement.
In the Roaming state, drag the joystick to control Ellen's direction, and release to stop.
Ellen is invulnerable for a brief time after activation.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭
skills.description:
在[巡游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动快速剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
快速剪击命中时，获得1点[急冻充能]。

在[巡游]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动蓄力剪击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
蓄力剪击命中时，获得3点[急冻充能]，若敌人处于[冻结]状态下，则必定触发[碎冰]效果；
招式蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Roaming state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Gain 1 point of Flash Freeze Charge when the Swift Scissors strike hits.

While in the Roaming state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissors strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Gain 3 points of Flash Freeze Charge when the Charged Scissors strike hits. If the enemy is Frozen, it always triggers Shatter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

variants.name: 冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭
variants.description:
在[巡游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动快速剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
快速剪击命中时，获得1点[急冻充能]。

在[巡游]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动蓄力剪击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
蓄力剪击命中时，获得3点[急冻充能]，若敌人处于[冻结]状态下，则必定触发[碎冰]效果；
招式蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式蓄力期间受到敌人伤害时，可以免疫该次伤害，并立即完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
variants.descriptionEn:
While in the Roaming state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Gain 1 point of Flash Freeze Charge when the Swift Scissors strike hits.

While in the Roaming state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Gain 3 points of Flash Freeze Charge when the Charged Scissor strike hits. If the enemy is Frozen, it always triggers Shatter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
When taking DMG from enemies while the skill is charging, that instance of DMG is nullified, and charging instantly completes.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 急冻
skills.description: 拥有[急冻充能]时，将激活[急冻]效果；激活[急冻]效果后，[普通攻击]和[冲刺攻击]将消耗[急冻充能]，造成大量冰属性伤害；艾莲最多可以拥有6点[急冻充能]。
skills.descriptionEn: When Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, the Flash Freeze effect is activated. Once Flash Freeze activates, Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks expend Flash Freeze Charges, dealing massive Ice DMG. Ellen can have up to a maximum of 6 Flash Freeze Charges.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：骇浪
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突进斩击，造成物理伤害；
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing slash attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：寒潮
skills.description:
激活[急冻]效果后，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突进斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
消耗1点[急冻充能]。
skills.descriptionEn:
While Flash Freeze is active, press [Basic Attack] during dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing slash attack at enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge.

skills.name: 闪避反击：暗礁
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速穿过敌人，拉开剪刀进行剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Rapidly move through enemies with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：雪崩
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
从空中下砸并生成一阵冰风暴，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：永冬狂宴
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
从空中下砸并生成一阵冰风暴，随后使用剪刀进行强力一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm before a powerful scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：护卫鲛
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
快速穿过敌人，拉开剪刀进行剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，拖曳摇杆，点按 【切换键】 发动：
进入[巡游]状态，快速冲刺移动；
在[巡游]状态下使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下；
招式发动瞬间拥有短暂的无敌效果。
发动[快速支援]时，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果，缩短[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]的蓄力时间，最多持续5秒或触发一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Speedily move through the enemy with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the character on the field is launched, drag the joystick and press [Switch] to activate:
Enter the Roaming state, enabling dashing movement.
While in the Roaming state, use the joystick to change directions and release to stop.
Character is invulnerable briefly when triggering the skill.
Upon triggering a Quick Assist, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, shortening the charging time of Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5s or until it triggers once.

skills.name: 招架支援：迎头浪
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cinema.name: 凛冬前兆
cinema.description: 在[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]中发动快速剪击命中敌人时，获得的[急冻充能]提升至3点；在[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]中发动蓄力剪击命中敌人时，获得的[急冻充能]提升至6点；每消耗1点[急冻充能]，艾莲的暴击率提升2%，持续15秒，最多叠加6层，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon hitting an enemy with a Swift Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 3. Upon hitting an enemy with a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 6. For each Flash Freeze Charge consumed, Ellen's CRIT Rate is increased by 2% for 15s, stacking up to 6 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
cinema.story:
寒风是凛冬的前兆，也是艾莲请长假冬眠的信号。
话说回来，鲨鱼真的需要冬眠吗？
cinema.storyEn:
Chilling winds are an omen of winter, and a signal that Ellen is about to apply for extended leave to hibernate.
Speaking of which, do sharks actually need to hibernate?

cinema.name: 冰洋掠食者
cinema.description: 发动第三段[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]后，可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：鲨卷风]；发动[强化特殊技]时，每拥有1点[急冻充能]，当前招式造成的暴击伤害提升20%，最多提升60%。
cinema.descriptionEn: The 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming can be directly followed up with EX Special Attack: Sharknami. For each point of Flash Freeze Charge when using an EX Special Attack, the current attack's CRIT DMG is increased by 20%, up to a max of 60%.
cinema.story:
虽然沾染鲜红，艾莲所持的巨剪并无半分温热。
彻骨的寒意来自铁铸的凶器，也来自面对捕食者的恐慌。
cinema.storyEn:
Despite being freshly stained with red, the massive shears held by Ellen lacked any trace of warmth.
The icy cold stems from her iron-forged instrument, as well as the fear of facing a predator such as herself.

cinema.name: 永不加班
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「效率」的意义就是今天可以早点回家睡觉。
所以要更快地斩击，更用力地出刀。
cinema.storyEn:
The whole point of "efficiency" is being able to go home early and sleep.
So strike harder and strike faster.

cinema.name: 无休寒潮
cinema.description: 队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[冻结]效果或使敌人失衡时，自身获得6点[急冻充能]和[快蓄]效果，并回复4点能量，能量回复效果10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Whenever a squad member Freezes or Stuns an enemy, Ellen gains 6 Flash Freeze Charges and the Quick Charge effect. She also recovers 4 Energy. The Energy recovery effect can trigger once per 10s.
cinema.story:
凌冽的攻势不曾止休，
可怖的造物们得以在艾莲的刀下领受冬的美与残酷。
不过相比起来，还是作为女仆节假日无休的工作更加残酷…
cinema.storyEn:
A relentless assault of piercing cold. Terrifying monstrosities will learn the beauty and cruelty of winter under Ellen's blade.
But, actually, the endless work that maids have during holidays is far more cruel...

cinema.name: 睡眠充足
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
除非是最艰难的战斗中，艾莲永远都是一副「如果不是在工作我立刻深度睡眠」的样子。
因此掉以轻心而完蛋的敌人不在少数。
cinema.storyEn:
Except for when in the toughest of battles, Ellen always seems to have that "I can fall asleep at any moment" look.
Many an enemy has met their demise after underestimating Ellen because of it.

cinema.name: 盛宴时分
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或获得[快蓄]时，艾莲的穿透率提升20%，持续6秒，同时获得1层[盛宴]，[盛宴]最多叠加3层；拥有3层[盛宴]后，在[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]中发动蓄力剪击命中敌人时，消耗所有[盛宴]，使当前招式造成的伤害提升250%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Ellen uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or gains Quick Charge, her PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 6s. She also gains 1 stack of The Feast Begins, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. With 3 stacks of The Feast Begins, using a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush consumes all stacks, increasing the DMG of the current attack by 250%.
cinema.story: 一道伤口，一滴鲜血。一次狩猎，一场盛宴。一纸薄命，一刻满足。
cinema.storyEn: An open wound, a drop of blood. A thrilling hunt, a grand feast. A fragile life, a moment of satisfaction.

1201.name: 悠真
1201.faction: 对空洞特别行动部第六课

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
浅羽悠真患有一种罕见疾病：「以太适性衰竭综合征」。
该疾病会导致患者身体某些部位产生病变，体质变差，但也能让他们拥有比常人更强大的以太适性。
在病程达到晚期后，患者的身体会迅速衰竭，在剧烈的疼痛下失去一切以太适性和感官能力，最终死亡。若患者晚期发病时身处空洞内，则会迅速被侵蚀变为以骸。
以太适性衰竭综合征的患者通常寿命较短，现有案例中寿命最长的患者在26岁那年去世。
目前尚未存在完全治愈该疾病的方法。
profile.descriptionEn:
Asaba Harumasa has a very rare illness, Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome.
This illness causes certain parts of the patient's body to mutate, wrecking their constitution, but also giving them unusually exceptional Ether aptitude.
In the late stages of the illness, the patient's body will rapidly deteriorate, losing their Ether aptitude and sensory functions while under immense pain, eventually resulting in death. If the patient's illness worsens in late stages while in a Hollow, they'll quickly be corrupted into an Ethereal.
Those who suffer from Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome do not live long. Currently, the longest-lived person with this illness died at the age of 26.
There is no known method to completely cure this disease.

1201.description:
浅羽悠真，对空洞事务特别行动部第六课成员。
从小拥有极强的以太适性体质，常被称作「天才」，在学校毕业后以格外优异的成绩进入对空部。
原本隶属于对空部某王牌部门，后因各种原因退出，加入了雅的团队。

性格自由散漫，我行我素，追求以最小的成本达到任务及格标准。
在高效率地完成最低可交付标准的工作后，就会心安理得抓紧一切时间休息（摸鱼）。
声称自己选择使用弓作为武器是因为方便偷懒，可以有效减少跑动的频次。

浅羽悠真的身体状况不好，在过度消耗的情况下有概率发病。
他经常以此为理由申请病假，没有人知道他用这些假期到底做了什么，但多半不是在休息。
1201.descriptionEn:
Asaba Harumasa, a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Possessing exceptional Ether aptitude since he was young and being dubbed a prodigy, he entered HSO after graduating with outstanding merit.
Was originally a member of a certain ace division within HSO, but later left due to various reasons, joining Miyabi's team instead.

He possesses a carefree and laidback attitude, and his only wish is to achieve acceptable results with minimum effort.
After efficiently taking care of his work to the lowest acceptable standard, he will hurry to use all the remainder of his available time to rest (slack off).
He claims he uses a bow to better slack off, as it effectively lowers the amount of running he has to do.

Asaba Harumasa has poor health, and over-exercise sometimes triggers his illness.
He often uses this reason to apply for sick leave, though no one knows what he does with this time off. Either way, it's probably not resting.

skills.name: 普通攻击：穿云
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的穿透攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，可生成2枚[电壶]；
发动[连携技]后，悠真下一次发动[普通攻击：穿云]第五段命中敌人时，可生成6枚[电壶]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 Electro Quivers.
After activating a Chain Attack, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

skills.name: 普通攻击：穿云·移形
skills.description:
[普通攻击：穿云]发动期间，拖曳摇杆并点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
发动远程穿透攻击，并向拖曳方向调整身位，对前方敌人造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
During Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, drag the joystick and press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Shoot a ranged piercing attack and reposition towards the corresponding drag direction, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：落羽
skills.description:
第五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]或[连携技]发动后，长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
立即向前方敌人发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
长按 【普通攻击键】 瞄准目标，松开 【普通攻击键】 发动：
引弓瞄准敌人后，向目标发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
After the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, a Special Attack, an EX Special Attack, or a Chain Attack, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Immediately shoot Falling Feather at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Hold [Basic Attack] to aim at a target and release [Basic Attack] to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot Falling Feather at the target, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：甲乙矢
skills.description:
第五段[普通攻击：穿云]/[强化特殊技]/[连携技]命中敌人或地面时，可生成2/6/6枚[电壶]；
若场上不存在[电壶]，队伍中任意角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，可生成6枚[电壶]，12秒内最多触发一次；
[电壶]同一时间内最多存在6枚，悠真发射[落羽]命中敌人时，若场上存在[电壶]，则会将其激活，向被[落羽]命中的目标发射[甲乙矢]，造成电属性伤害；
[甲乙矢]命中敌人时，会为其施加[电囚]效果，最多叠加8层，持续10秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，[电囚]效果大于等于2层时，将在目标身上生成[十文字]标记。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer/EX Special Attack/Chain Attack hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 Electro Quivers. If there are no Electro Quivers on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 Electro Quivers. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 Electro Quivers present at a time. If there are any Electro Quivers present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with Falling Feather, the Electro Quivers will activate and fire Ha-Oto no Ya at the enemies hit by Falling Feather, dealing Electric DMG.
Ha-Oto no Ya will apply Electro Prison to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of Electro Prison, they will be X-Marked.

skills.name: 特殊技：天罗
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射箭矢，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launch an arrow forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：地网
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射飞刃和强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：地网·巡弋（潜能觉醒）
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol (Potential Awakening)
skills.description:
能量足够时，在第四/五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[终结技]、[闪避反击：藏锋]、[快速支援：穿弦]发动后点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方连续发射强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
第一发强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]，最后一发强化箭矢命中敌人时，激活场上的[电壶]，向目标发射[甲乙矢]，造成电属性伤害；
命中的目标持有的[电囚]效果层数接近上限时，会激活更少的[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] after using the 4th/5th attack of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, an Ultimate, Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge, or Quick Assist: Braced Bow to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 Electro Quivers are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the Electro Quivers on the field, firing Ha-Oto no Ya at the target, dealing Electric DMG.
When the target's Electro Prison stacks are close to the maximum, fewer Electro Quivers will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：瞬闪
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行多段穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：藏锋
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：会·离
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿透攻击，并发射强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
箭矢命中地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：残心
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 残心·散华（潜能觉醒）
skills.description:
[终结技：残心]发动后自动派生：
对前方敌人发动大范围穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害，视为[终结技]伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Activates ALT automatically after Ultimate: Zanshin:
Unleashes a wide-area piercing attack against enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG. This is considered Ultimate DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：穿弦
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：构身
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：构身·斩
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩
skills.nameEn: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
skills.description:
当场上存在拥有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真会进入[醒觉]状态，并将[冲刺攻击：飞弦]替换为[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]。
[醒觉]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进至距离自身最近的带有[十文字]标记的敌人身前，发动强力斩击，造成电属性伤害；
斩击命中目标时会消耗2层[电囚]效果，[电囚]效果少于2层时，将消除[十文字]标记；在[十文字]标记耗尽前，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可连续发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；当场上不存在带有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真将退出[醒觉]状态；
[醒觉]状态下，[普通攻击：落羽]发动后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以快速衔接发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Electric DMG.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison. With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison, X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to repeatedly use Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state.
While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] after Basic Attack: Falling Feather to quickly follow up with Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

variants.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩
variants.nameEn: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
variants.description:
当场上存在拥有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真会进入[醒觉]状态，并将[冲刺攻击：飞弦]替换为[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]。
[醒觉]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进至距离自身最近的带有[十文字]标记的敌人身前，发动强力斩击，造成电属性伤害，命中处于失衡状态的敌人时会触发[逐雷]，造成1次额外的电属性伤害；
斩击命中目标时会消耗2层[电囚]效果，[电囚]效果少于2层时，将消除[十文字]标记；在[十文字]标记耗尽前，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可连续发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；当场上不存在带有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真将退出[醒觉]状态；
[醒觉]状态下，[普通攻击：落羽]发动后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以快速衔接发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；
第一段招式期间可以格挡敌人攻击，第二、第三段招式的追击效果增强；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
variants.descriptionEn:
While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rush forward to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Electric DMG. Hitting a Stunned enemy triggers Chasing Thunder, dealing 1 instance of additional Electric DMG.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison. With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison, X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to repeatedly use Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state.
While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] after Basic Attack: Falling Feather to quickly follow up with Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.
Enemy attacks can be blocked during the 1st hit of the skill. The pursuit effect of the second and third hits is increased.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: 核心被动：破晓
skills.description: [冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]的暴击率提升10.6%，悠真的[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]命中敌人并触发暴击时，将获得1层[锋芒]，同一招式内最多获得3层，[锋芒]最多叠加6层，持续5秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每层[锋芒]会使[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]造成的暴击伤害提升6%。
skills.descriptionEn: The CRIT Rate of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 10.6%, and when Harumasa's Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1 stack of Gleaming Edge, for up to a maximum of 3 stacks per use of the skill and stacking up to 6 times, lasting 5s, repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Gleaming Edge increases the CRIT DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash by 6%.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.label: 基础
levels.description: [冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]的暴击率提升10.6%，悠真的[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]命中敌人并触发暴击时，将获得1层[锋芒]，同一招式内最多获得3层，[锋芒]最多叠加6层，持续5秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每层[锋芒]会使[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]造成的暴击伤害提升6%。
levels.descriptionEn: The CRIT Rate of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 10.6%, and when Harumasa's Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1 stack of Gleaming Edge, for up to a maximum of 3 stacks per use of the skill and stacking up to 6 times, lasting 5s, repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Gleaming Edge increases the CRIT DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash by 6%.

skills.name: 额外能力：超频
skills.description:
队伍中存在[击破]角色或[异常]角色时触发：
悠真攻击命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升40%；悠真发射[落羽]命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人时，会为其施加2层[电囚]效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Anomaly character:
When Harumasa's attacks hit Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomaly, his DMG increases by 40%. When Harumasa's Falling Feather hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomaly, it will apply 2 stacks of Electro Prison to the target.

When activating an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, increases ATK by 8%. Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash and Chasing Thunder ignore 10% of the target's Electric RES for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Extends the duration of Core Passive's Gleaming Edge to 10s.

potentials.label: 例无虚发 V
potentials.name: 潜能觉醒：贯注
potentials.description:
发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]时，攻击力提升10%，[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]和[逐雷]无视目标12.5%的电属性伤害抗性，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
[核心被动]中[锋芒]的持续时间延长至10秒。
potentials.descriptionEn:
When activating an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, increases ATK by 10%. Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash and Chasing Thunder ignore 12.5% of the target's Electric RES for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Extends the duration of Core Passive's Gleaming Edge to 10s.

potentials.label: 例无虚发 VI
potentials.name: 潜能觉醒：贯注
potentials.description:
发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]时，攻击力提升12%，[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]和[逐雷]无视目标15%的电属性伤害抗性，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
[核心被动]中[锋芒]的持续时间延长至10秒。
potentials.descriptionEn:
When activating an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, increases ATK by 12%. Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash and Chasing Thunder ignore 15% of the target's Electric RES for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Extends the duration of Core Passive's Gleaming Edge to 10s.

cinema.name: 「意气风发」
cinema.description: [普通攻击：甲乙矢]中，[电囚]效果的叠加层数上限提升至14层；[电壶]被激活时，将会向目标连续发射2支[甲乙矢]。
cinema.descriptionEn: The maximum stack limit of Electro Prison from Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya increases to 14 stacks. When an Electro Quiver is triggered, 2 consecutive Ha-Oto no Ya will be fired at the target.
cinema.story:
「我才不像某些死心眼的家伙一样，总之执着于正面战。」
「不管是明枪还是暗箭，能让我早点下班的都是好孩子~」
cinema.storyEn:
"I'm not like some stubborn idiots who insist on facing the enemy head-on."
"Be it a straightforward assault or an underhanded attack from the shadows, anything that gets me off work earlier is good in my eyes~"

cinema.name: 挥霍
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，悠真获得7层[电掣]，最多叠加7层；拥有[电掣]时，[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]造成的伤害提升50%；[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]结束后，消耗1层[电掣]。
cinema.descriptionEn: When using an Chain Attack or Ultimate, Harumasa gains 7 stacks of Electro Blitz, up to a max of 7 stacks. While possessing Electro Blitz, the DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 50%. Consume 1 stack of Electro Blitz once Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash ends.
cinema.story:
「别看我这样，我其实很弱很弱的~」
悠真懒洋洋地趴在了办公桌上。
「所以这次的任务，换个人怎么样？」
cinema.storyEn:
"Don't look at me like that, I'm actually real frail, y'know~"
Harumasa lazily sprawls across his office desk.
"So... how 'bout picking someone else for this mission?"

cinema.name: 白色谎言
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「…放心，暂时死不了。」
他笑着抹了一把嘴角溢出的鲜血，再次架起了弓。
「我可是要遗千年的。」
cinema.storyEn:
"...Don't worry, this isn't enough to kill me."
He wipes the blood from the corner of his mouth with a smile and readies his bow once more.
"After all, I'm going to live to make it everyone's problem."

cinema.name: 偶有充盈
cinema.description: [电囚]效果的持续时间提升至20秒；[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]命中敌人时，悠真获得30点喧响值，同一招式内最多触发一次；发动[终结技]时，将为场上所有敌人施加满层[电囚]效果。
cinema.descriptionEn: Electro Prison now lasts for 20s. When Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash hits enemies, Harumasa gains 30 Decibels once per use of this skill. Upon activating Ultimate, apply the maximum stacks of Electro Prison to all on-field enemies.
cinema.story:
悠真偶尔也有干劲满满的时候——
在距离下班还有五分钟之前。
cinema.storyEn:
Harumasa is occasionally full of energy and motivation...
When there's only five minutes left until he can get off work.

cinema.name: 无人知晓
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「我想要假期，要自由，要每天都开开心心——」
「骗你的。我想活着。」
cinema.storyEn:
"I want vacations, freedom, to be happy every day!"
"Just kidding. I want to live."

cinema.name: 会心
cinema.description: [甲乙矢]命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人后，悠真将无视其15%电属性伤害抗性，持续12秒；[甲乙矢]每命中同一名敌人12次，将额外触发1次电磁爆炸，对目标造成悠真1500%攻击力的电属性伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: After Ha-Oto no Ya hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomalies, Harumasa will ignore 15% of the target's Electric RES for 12s. Every 12 times an enemy is hit by Ha-Oto no Ya, trigger an extra electromagnetic explosion, dealing 1,500% of Harumasa's ATK to the target as Electric DMG.
cinema.story:
「师父曾教过我很多事。如何拉弓，如何用刀，如何…在这个世界里幸存下来。」
「…你问后来？」
「后来啊…他也离开我了。」
cinema.storyEn:
"My master taught me a lot of things, like how to draw a bow, how to wield a blade, and how to survive in this world with this body of mine."
"...What happened after that?"
"Well, after that... he left me."

skillCultivationRecommendation.label: 技能培养建议分组
skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.

icon.note: Existing local portrait asset; not downloaded from Gachabase.

1211.name: 丽娜
1211.fullName: 亚历山德丽娜·莎芭丝缇安

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
为了维护自身的形象，即使遇到最难缠的客人，丽娜依然会保持专业和温柔的态度。
但杜苏拉有时会不分场合地说出她的真心话。

*丽娜的家族似乎拥有深厚行业背景，向来是某些大人物手下的执事/女仆。
莱卡恩的一些执事技能就是由丽娜所传授的。
profile.descriptionEn:
To protect her impeccable image, Rina maintains a professional and gracious demeanor even with the most challenging clients.
Drusilla, however, may occasionally express her true thoughts regardless of the situation.

* Rina's family holds significant influence within the industry, as all of its members have served as attendants or maids to some of the most prominent figures.
Lycaon learned some of his attendant skills from Rina.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: SEP 23

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 哥哥你看，Fairy这家伙怎么越来越坏了，竟然建议我们吃丽娜做的饭！
profile.descriptionEn: Look here, Wise! Can you believe Fairy wants us to try Rina's dishes? She just keeps getting meaner!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 我们现在并不需要做风险如此大的事情，建议Fairy下次不要建议了。
profile.descriptionEn: We don't need to take on such a high level of risk at the moment. I suggest Fairy refrain from making such suggestions next time.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对丽娜的印象：
 · 最近丽娜来六分街的频率也多了起来，是因为我们的原因吗？
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Rina:
 · Recently, Rina's been coming to Sixth Street more often. Is it because of us?

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 丽娜时常驻足在各种店铺前，看起来像是为了拓展自身服务范围在做实地调查…
profile.descriptionEn: · Rina often stops in front of all kinds of stores. Almost as if she's doing field research to expand her own field of services...

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 看得出丽娜非常在意同事们，不管在工作还是生活中都经常会提到他们。
profile.descriptionEn: · It's clear Rina cares deeply about her colleagues at Victoria Housekeeping, as she often mentions them when talking about work and personal stuff.

1211.description:
丽娜，维多利亚家政的女仆长，同时也是组织资历最深的成员。
漂亮端庄，从头到脚都非常完美，气质高贵，脸上总是带着淡淡的笑意。
很在意自己在他人眼中的印象。

丽娜身边漂浮着两个邦布分别名为安娜塔莎（棕发）和杜苏拉（金发），都拥有独立的人格。
杜苏拉与丽娜一起的时间较长，非常聪明，能够读懂丽娜当下内心的情绪和真实想法。
安娜塔莎刚加入不久，通常说话只会应和，总是被杜苏拉欺负。

丽娜最大的爱好是烹饪，但似乎很少有人能承受丽娜烹饪的食物。
建议：可以找机会尝尝丽娜烹饪的食物，以此来测试自己是否是天选之子。
1211.descriptionEn:
Rina, the head maid of Victoria Housekeeping Co., and the most senior member of the organization.
She possesses beauty and grace, appearing immaculate from head to toe, with a noble demeanor and a gentle smile on her face.
She places considerable importance on how she is perceived by others.

Rina is always accompanied by two Bangboo named Anastella (brown hair) and Drusilla (blonde hair), both of whom have distinct personalities.
Drusilla has been with Rina for a significant period of time and displays high intelligence, capable of discerning Rina's true emotions and thoughts.
Anastella, a recent addition, usually responds rather than initiates conversation and is frequently teased by Drusilla.

Rina's favorite hobby is cooking, but only a few individuals are capable of enduring the dishes she prepares.
Suggestion: You may try tasting Rina's dishes as a test to determine if you are the Chosen One.

skills.name: 普通攻击：痛打呆子
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎发动至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
在杜苏拉和安娜塔莎攻击期间，丽娜执行其他行动，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to attack up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
Performing other actions with Rina during Drusilla and Anastella's attacks will not interrupt Rina's Basic Attack combo count.

skills.name: 普通攻击：赶走傻瓜
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 发动：
召回杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，在身边回旋后进行范围攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Calls back Drusilla and Anastella to swing them around for a ranged attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：砸扁笨蛋
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
指派安娜塔莎发动下砸攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：笨蛋消失魔法
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎发动持续下砸攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，将触发[快速支援]。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to unleash a continuous downward smash attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

skills.name: 闪避：抚平裙摆
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：突然惊吓
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：邦布回魂
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方旋转飞出并触发爆炸，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：侍者守则
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方持续推进并生成球形电场，造成大量电属性伤害；
杜苏拉和安娜塔莎在推进期间无法响应[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]的指令，但可以通过发动[普通攻击：赶走傻瓜]将其召回丽娜身边；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, Special Attacks, and EX Special Attacks, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

skills.name: 终结技：女王的侍从们
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方持续推进并发动高速回旋，造成大量电属性伤害；
杜苏拉和安娜塔莎在推进期间无法响应[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]的指令，但可以通过发动[普通攻击：赶走傻瓜]将其召回丽娜身边；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复10点能量，下一名换入前场的角色额外回复20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，将触发[快速支援]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

skills.name: 快速支援：二拍的阿勒芒德
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方旋转飞出并触发爆炸，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 回避支援：三拍的库朗特
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：四拍的加沃特
skills.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方持续推进并生成涡旋电场，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间，可以快速衔接[强化特殊技：笨蛋消失魔法]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to continuously advance while generating a vortex of electricity, dealing Electric DMG.
While using this skill, Rina can quickly chain into EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：晨间清扫（潜能觉醒）
skills.description: 当丽娜发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]后，进入[一尘不染]状态，持续13秒，期间杜苏拉或安娜塔莎会每间隔2.5秒，攻击敌人1次，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害，并获得1层[惊吓]，至多获得6层[惊吓]；招式发动后重置杜苏拉和安娜塔莎离场倒计时。
skills.descriptionEn: After Rina uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Spotless state for 13s. During this time, Drusilla or Anastella attacks an enemy once every 2.5s, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG, and grants 1 stack of Fright, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

skills.name: 普通攻击：午夜清扫（潜能觉醒）
skills.description: 当[惊吓]达到6层时，杜苏拉或安娜塔莎下一次发动[普通攻击：晨间清扫]会消耗全部[惊吓]，改为发动[普通攻击：午夜清扫]，造成电属性伤害；招式发动后重置杜苏拉和安娜塔莎离场倒计时。
skills.descriptionEn: When Fright reaches 6 stacks, the next Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup performed by Drusilla or Anastella consumes all Fright stacks and is replaced with Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup, dealing Electric DMG. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

skills.name: 核心被动：迷你毁灭拍档
skills.description: 指派杜苏拉或安娜塔莎进行攻击时，队伍中其他角色的穿透率随丽娜自身的穿透率提升，提升效果等同于丽娜25%穿透率+6%，最高提升30%，杜苏拉和安娜塔莎均返回丽娜身边后，对应增益效果结束。
skills.descriptionEn: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + 6%, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.label: 基础
levels.description: 指派杜苏拉或安娜塔莎进行攻击时，队伍中其他角色的穿透率随丽娜自身的穿透率提升，提升效果等同于丽娜25%穿透率+6%，最高提升30%，杜苏拉和安娜塔莎均返回丽娜身边后，对应增益效果结束。
levels.descriptionEn: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + 6%, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.

cinema.name: 双人领舞
cinema.description: 被指派并发动攻击后，返回丽娜身边前，杜苏拉和安娜塔莎会在原处额外逗留5.5秒；在杜苏拉或安娜塔莎附近10米范围内的角色，从[核心被动：迷你毁灭拍档]中获得的增益效果提升至原本的130%。
cinema.descriptionEn:
After being sent out to launch an attack, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.
The effect gained from Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner by characters within 10m is increased to 130% of the original value.
cinema.story:
「干不完活就要挨揍！」杜苏拉总是这样鼓励大家。
「挨揍挨揍！」安娜塔莎总是如此附和。
cinema.storyEn:
"Get your work done, or you're in for a beating!" is how Drusilla tries to encourage everyone.
"Yeah, a beating!" Anastella always chimes in.

cinema.name: 主人的典范
cinema.description: 成为接战状态下的当前操作角色时，丽娜造成的伤害提升15%，持续12秒，18秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon becoming the active character in combat, Rina's DMG increases by 15% for 12s. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
cinema.story:
「只有卓越的女仆长能够带领卓越的女仆，
只有模范的主人能够培养模范的邦布。」
——丽娜在「维多利亚家政人力资源管理暨邦布培养心得分享讲座」上的讲话
cinema.storyEn: "It takes an excellent head maid to lead excellent maids, and an exemplary master to raise exemplary Bangboo." — Excerpt from Rina's speech at the "Victoria Housekeeping Human Resource Management and Bangboo Training Insight Seminar."

cinema.name: 女仆长的专长
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
丽娜总是有做好任何事的自信和毁灭任何事的本领。
不过，在毁灭敌人的好心情这件事上，她的信心和能力得到了统一。
cinema.storyEn:
Rina always has the confidence to excel at anything and the ability to annihilate everything.
However, when it comes to being in the mood to annihilate enemies, both her confidence and capability align.

cinema.name: 针与锤
cinema.description: 杜苏拉和安娜塔莎均被指派在外时，丽娜的能量自动回复速度提升0.5点/秒；杜苏拉或安娜塔莎返回丽娜身边时，对应增益效果结束。
cinema.descriptionEn: Rina's Energy Regen increases by 0.5/s when both Drusilla and Anastella are deployed. The effect ends when Drusilla or Anastella returns to Rina.
cinema.story:
杜苏拉和安娜塔莎从未达成任何一致的意见，
「殴打前面那个傻瓜」是一个例外。
cinema.storyEn:
Drusilla and Anastella can never agree on anything.
"Beating up the dummy in front" is an exception.

cinema.name: 完美主义女仆长
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「『丽娜』在邦布的语言里是完美的意思。」
完美主义是维多利亚家政员工手册的第一准则。
而对于「完美」的评判，丽娜自有准绳。
cinema.storyEn:
"Rina" means perfection in the Bangboo language.
Perfectionism is the number one rule in the Victoria Housekeeping handbook.
And Rina has her own criteria for judging "perfection."

cinema.name: 雷雨夜惊魂
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，全队角色造成的电属性伤害提升15%，持续8秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, the entire squad's Electric DMG is increased by 15% for 8s.
cinema.story:
雨夜的古堡，雷声隆隆。长廊的深处，诡影憧憧。 
恐惧电路超载，惊悚电影开拍。
cinema.storyEn:
Thunder rumbles in the old castle on a rainy night. The depths of the long corridors are filled with eerie shadows.
Fear circuits overloaded, the filming of a thriller commences.

1221.faction: 对空洞特别行动部第六课

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description: 由于多年前的一场意外，月城柳体内流淌着一部分不属于她自己的血液。
profile.descriptionEn: Due to an accident long ago, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to possess blood that does not belong to her, flowing through her veins.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: SEP 21

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: Fairy这是从哪里搞来的情报，原来那么完美的柳竟然也会有迷糊的时候吗！能不能详细讲讲？
profile.descriptionEn: Where did Fairy even get this info? So even a perfect person like Yanagi has her clumsy moments? Got any specifics to share?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 怎么说呢…从这些内容来看，六课没了柳好像真的会散架。
profile.descriptionEn: How should I put this...? From this data, it feels like Section 6 would fall apart without Yanagi.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对月城柳的印象：
 · 这个女人的歌唱实力令人意外
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Tsukishiro Yanagi:
 · Her singing skills sure are shocking.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 她对红豆包的执着有理有据
profile.descriptionEn: · Her obsession with red bean buns seems perfectly reasonable.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 柳的眼睛…似乎不仅是高度近视而已
profile.descriptionEn: · Yanagi... she doesn't seem to just suffer from simple nearsightedness.

1221.description:
月城柳，对空洞事务特别行动部第六课所属副课长兼情报官。
主要负责六课的人事管理、任务跟进与反馈、情报收集和现场支援等工作。
与此同时，月城柳还是六课成员苍角的「保护者」。除了在日常生活上对苍角进行照顾之外，柳还需要对苍角在工作中的一切行为负责。

六课课长星见雅性格较为特殊，成员浅羽悠真总是过于散漫随性，成员苍角在心性上还是个大大咧咧的「孩子」——综合以上原因，六课绝大多数工作安排都落在了月城柳的肩上。
严谨认真，办事一丝不苟的月城柳，某种意义上算是六课唯一的「正常人」。也正是由于她的引导与指挥，才促使六课三名主要外勤队员的「武力」转变为「战斗力」。
整体来看，月城柳是一位综合能力超群，处理事物利落高效的优秀执行官。
但根据部分信息判断，月城柳在生活中似乎也会有迷糊的一面。
1221.descriptionEn:
Tsukishiro Yanagi, Hollow Special Operations Section 6 Deputy Chief and intelligence officer.
Primarily responsible for personnel management, mission management and feedback, collecting intel, on-site support, etc.
At the same time, Yanagi is also Section 6 member Soukaku's Protector. Apart from taking care of Soukaku's day-to-day affairs, she is also responsible for and takes responsibility for all of Soukaku's behavior at work.

Section 6 Chief Hoshimi Miyabi possesses a rather eccentric personality; Asaba Harumasa, a member of Section 6, is overly relaxed and carefree; and Soukaku, another member of Section, 6 is still an innocent and excitable child, so most of the team's work falls upon Yanagi's shoulders.
Serious, diligent, and meticulous, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the only "normal" person on the team, so to speak. It is only due to her guidance and leadership that the strength of the three who make up Section 6's primary on-field force can be transformed into true combat power.
Overall, Tsukishiro Yanagi is a talented and highly efficient executive officer, whose abilities are both exceptional and comprehensive.
However, from certain data, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to have a somewhat clumsy side to her when it comes to day-to-day affairs.

skills.name: 普通攻击：夜见尊神乐
skills.description:
月城柳拥有[上弦]和[下弦]两种架势；
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
根据当前架势，向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
在战斗中，月城柳可根据当前架势类型获得对应的架势增益：
[上弦]架势增益：自身造成的电属性伤害提升10%，[普通攻击]发动期间抗打断等级提升；
[下弦]架势增益：自身穿透率提升10%，[普通攻击]的打断等级提升；
架势切换后，月城柳仍可继续保有上一架势的架势增益，持续8秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
Yanagi has two stances: Jougen and Kagen.
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Execute up to five forward slashes based on the current stance, causing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
During combat, Yanagi gains the corresponding stance buff based on her current stance:
Jougen stance buff: Electric DMG increases by 10%. Anti-Interrupt Level increases during Basic Attacks.
Kagen stance buff: PEN Ratio increases by 10%. Interrupt Level increases for Basic Attacks.
For 8s after switching stances, Yanagi retains the bonus from the previous stance.

skills.name: 特殊技：流转
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成电属性伤害，并切换当前架势；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第三、四、五段之后发动，则能够触发[快速流转]，以更快的速度进行斩击并切换当前架势；
[快速流转]发动期间可以格挡敌人的攻击；
触发[快速流转]后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a forward slash, dealing Electric DMG, and switch the current stance.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
If activated after the 3rd, 4th, or 5th hit of a Basic Attack, it activates Swift Ruten, speeding up the slashes while switching her current stance.
Block enemy attacks while Swift Ruten is active.
Upon activating Swift Ruten, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Basic Attack.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：月华流转
skills.description:
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
积蓄力量向前快速突刺，随后发动下落攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
突刺发动时，月城柳会切换当前架势，并进入[森罗万象]状态，持续15秒，状态持续期间，从[普通攻击]第五段或其他招式衔接后继[普通攻击]时，将直接从第三段[普通攻击] 起手；
下落攻击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，将会触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果15%的伤害，并额外附加月城柳725%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Charge up power for a quick forward thrust, followed by a downward attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Upon executing the thrust, Yanagi switches stances and enters the Shinrabanshou state, lasting 15s. For the duration of this state, when following up with a subsequent Basic Attack from the 5th hit of a Basic Attack or other skills, the combo will begin directly from the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack.
If the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly, it triggers a special Disorder effect, Polarity Disorder, dealing 15% of the original Disorder effect's DMG to the target, plus an additional 725% of Yanagi's Anomaly Proficiency. Polarity Disorder will not remove the target's Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。

skills.name: 终结技：雷影天华
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
激发自身能力，在极短时间内对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，并追加落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
落雷攻击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，将会触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果15%的伤害，并额外附加月城柳725%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Yanagi unleashes her potential and delivers a powerful slash to a large area of enemies in front in a very short time, followed by an additional lightning strike, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the lightning strike hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers a special Disorder effect called Polarity Disorder. This deals DMG equal to 15% of the original Disorder effect plus an additional 725% of Yanagi's Anomaly Proficiency. Polarity Disorder will not remove the target's Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Basic Attack.

skills.name: 核心被动：月蚀

When her EX Special Attack hits an enemy, Yanagi's Electric DMG against the target is increased by 13.3% for 15s.

skills.name: 额外能力：月相
skills.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身属性相同的角色时触发：
架势切换后，月城柳发动[普通攻击：夜见尊神乐]命中敌人时累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升45%，持续8秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same attribute:
After switching stances, when Yanagi hits an enemy with Basic Attack: Tsukuyomi Kagura, Electric Anomaly Buildup increases by 45% for 8s.

cinema.name: 知己知彼
cinema.nameEn: Know Thy Self, Know Thy Enemy
cinema.description: 队伍中任意角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，月城柳会获得1层[洞悉]，持续15秒，最多叠加3层，重复触发时刷新持续时间；受到敌方攻击时，月城柳将消耗1层[洞悉]并获得无敌效果，持续1秒；拥有1层或以上[洞悉]时，月城柳的异常精通提升80点。
cinema.descriptionEn: When any squad member inflicts an Anomaly on an enemy, Yanagi gains 1 stack of Clarity, lasting 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon being hit by an enemy attack, Yanagi consumes 1 stack of Clarity to gain invulnerability for 1s. When Yanagi has 1 or more stacks of Clarity, her Anomaly Proficiency increases by 80.
cinema.story:
「洞悉敌人的弱点，等同于为自己赢得更多的保障…和胜算。」
柳推了推眼镜，即使已然胜券在握，她依然如像往常一般不动声色。
cinema.storyEn:
"Having the clarity to see your enemy's weakness is like an extra safety net... and it increases your chances at victory."
Yanagi adjusts her glasses, remaining as composed as ever, even when victory is already assured.

cinema.name: 卓越适应性
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]中，快速突刺累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升20%；快速突刺命中敌人时，保持长按「特殊攻击」按键，可以额外消耗10点能量，再次发动突刺攻击，能量不足或停止长按后将自动衔接下落攻击；下落攻击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人并触发[极性紊乱]效果时，对目标造成的伤害倍率提升至原本[紊乱]效果的20%，每额外发动一次突刺攻击，该伤害倍率额外提升15%，伤害倍率额外提升效果最多触发2次。
cinema.descriptionEn: During her EX Special Attack, the rapid thrust's Electric Anomaly Buildup increases by 20%. Holding down the Special Attack button after a rapid thrust hits an enemy will consume 10 additional Energy to launch another thrust. If Energy is insufficient or the button is released, the attack automatically follows up with the downward attack. When the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly and triggers Polarity Disorder, the DMG multiplier increases to 20% of the original Disorder effect. Each additional thrust increases this multiplier by 15%, up to a maximum of 2 extra thrusts.
cinema.story:
「柳的话…无论被丢到怎样异常的环境，一定都能处理好的。」
「我比相信自己更加相信她。」
——来自一位正在进行「斩断面前所有落叶」修行的武者
cinema.storyEn:
"Yanagi can handle any unfamiliar environment thrown her way."
"I believe in her more than I believe in myself."
— From a martial artist practicing "the cutting of fallen leaves."

cinema.name: 月城氏管理学
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
人人都说对空六课聚集了一帮怪人和天才，其中唯一的「正常人」便是月城柳了。
但也正是她的存在，把怪人和天才们「粘合」了起来。
cinema.storyEn: Everyone says Section 6 is gathering oddballs and geniuses, with Tsukishiro Yanagi being the only "normal" one. But it's precisely her presence that holds the oddballs and geniuses together.

cinema.name: 掌棋者
cinema.description: 月城柳对敌人造成属性异常伤害时，会为其施加[识破]效果，持续15秒；处于[识破]效果下的敌人受到攻击时，本次攻击的穿透率提升16%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Yanagi inflicts Attribute Anomaly DMG on an enemy, they suffer the Exposed effect, lasting 15s. Attacks on enemies under the Expose effect will have 16% increased PEN Ratio.
cinema.story: 无论在何种情况下，月城柳都能以最快的速度掌握当下所有信息，并据此做出最合适的判断。
cinema.storyEn: No matter the situation, Tsukishiro Yanagi can rapidly grasp all the information at hand and make the most appropriate decision.

cinema.name: 鬼「妈妈」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
目前，月城柳是苍角的唯一指定监护人。
「苍角，这是课长的饭团，不可以随便吃——算了，过来，我给你加热一下。」
「之后再买个一样的还给课长吧…」
cinema.storyEn:
At present, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the sole designated guardian of Soukaku.
"Soukaku, this is the Chief's riceball, you mustn't eat it... forget it, come here, I'll heat it up for you."
"We'll just buy a similar one for the Chief later."

cinema.name: 非人之血
cinema.description: 在[强化特殊技]中发动突刺攻击后，[森罗万象]状态的持续时间提升至30秒，状态持续期间，[强化特殊技]造成的伤害提升20%；[卓越适应性]中，[极性紊乱]伤害倍率额外提升效果的触发次数上限提升至4次，前4次额外发动突刺攻击时所需的能量消耗减半。
cinema.descriptionEn: After a thrust attack during her EX Special Attack, the duration of the Shinrabanshou state increases to 30s. While the state is active, EX Special Attack DMG increases by 20%. The maximum number of times the additional DMG multiplier increase effect for Polarity Disorder in Outstanding Adaptability can be triggered increases to 4, and the Energy cost for the first 4 additional thrust attacks is halved.
cinema.story:
月城柳的身体中流淌着一部分不属于她的血液。
这些血曾让她在绝境中获得了新生，也因此拥有了一些特殊的力量。
「但如你所知，一切本不属于我的东西…终有代价。」
cinema.storyEn:
Flowing through Tsukishiro Yanagi's veins is blood that isn't entirely her own. This blood once granted her new life in the face of despair, and with it, she gained certain special powers.
"But as you know, something that isn't mine... comes with a price."

1241.name: 朱鸢
1241.factionEn: Public Security: Criminal Investigation Special Response Team

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
有完美主义倾向，对「整齐」、「满分」有着相当强烈的执念，似乎是其唯一的弱点（？）。其生活上的前辈，工作上的下属治安官青衣常常吐槽朱鸢「不治将恐深」。但也正因为她对自我极高的要求，所积累的实力足以支撑起刑侦特勤组的工作，吸引优秀的人才追随其后。

此外，似乎有热爱种植的兴趣爱好。在办公室培育着一株番茄，经常遭到一对常驻在治安局的小浣熊母子的偷盗。
思考：可否为潜入治安局提供某种思路？

是非常罕见的、不热衷于毛茸茸小动物的人类。
profile.descriptionEn:
She has a tendency to be a perfectionist and exhibits a strong obsession with "neatness" and "perfection," which may be considered her only weakness (?). Officer Qingyi, her mentor in life and subordinate at work, often remarks that Zhu Yuan's perfectionism complex will worsen unless someone can talk her out of it. However, due to her high standards for herself, she has gained ample experience and skills to lead the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team and attract exceptional talents.

Zhu Yuan seems to have a passion for gardening. She is currently growing a tomato plant in her office, which is often pilfered by a raccoon family residing near the Public Security office.
Thoughts: Could this provide a potential avenue for infiltrating Public Security?

Zhu Yuan is a rarity among humans, showing no particular fondness for small furry animals.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: SEP 1

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 是模板级别的「优秀人类」。和这样的对手「周旋」了那么久的我们，是不是也挺厉害的？
profile.descriptionEn: An exemplary human. We've been dealing with such an opponent for so long. Aren't we amazing?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 那毕竟是你+我+Fairy，一对一的话——我不是很想知道结果…
profile.descriptionEn: That's because it's me + you + Fairy. I wouldn't wanna know the outcome if it was one on one...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对朱鸢的印象：
 · 认真可靠负责专注正直，形容朱鸢的正面词汇可以像这样无限叠下去…
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Zhu Yuan:
 · Serious, reliable, responsible, dedicated, honest... Any positive word fits Zhu Yuan perfectly.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 相处到现在总以为可以发现一些朱鸢的「缺点」之类。然而，完全不存在…
profile.descriptionEn: · One may think that they could uncover some of Zhu Yuan's flaws over time, but such things simply don't exist...

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 朱鸢偶尔害羞的样子实在是…等等！这可是治安官大人，不可以忘记了！
profile.descriptionEn: · Zhu Yuan's occasional shyness is really... Wait a minute! She's a Public Security Officer! Can't forget that!

1241.description:
朱鸢，治安局精锐中的精锐，被认为是「假以时日，必然能接任治安局长的人物」而重点培养。目前的职务为雅努斯区分局都市秩序部刑侦特勤组组长，组内已知的成员有：青衣、赛斯，以及保密。
备注：针对治安局系统内安保级别较高的文件，需进一步调查，排期等级-低。

刑侦、战斗力及自我管理（加班）能力卓越。任职至今经手的案件，尚无未结案的记录。
建议：与朱鸢相处就是在危险的边缘疯狂试探，请时刻牢记自己「绳匠」的身份，时刻牢记自己「绳匠」的身份，牢记自己「绳匠」的身份。
1241.descriptionEn:
Zhu Yuan, an exceptional officer at Public Security, is a highly skilled individual expected to become the next commissioner. She currently leads the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team at the Janus Precinct within the Metropolitan Order Division. Her team members include Qingyi, Seth, and [redacted].
Note: For documents with higher security levels within the Public Security system, further investigation is required; scheduling priority - low.

Zhu Yuan possesses excellent skills in criminal investigation, combat, and self-management (including working overtime). She has no unresolved cases on record.
Suggestion: Approaching Zhu Yuan is an ill-advised decision that may compromise your cover. Always remember your true identity as a Proxy. Remember your true identity as a Proxy. Remember your true identity as a Proxy.

skills.name: 普通攻击：不许动！
skills.description:
[突击模式]
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
交替使用体术、手枪和以太鹿弹，向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
第四、第五段攻击命中敌人时，获得1枚[强化霰弹]，同一招式中最多获得1枚；
招式发动期间，拖曳摇杆并点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以发动[冲刺攻击：火力奇袭]，向对应方向调整身位；
[突击模式]下，长按 【普通攻击键】 时，将会切换攻击方式，进入[压制模式]。
skills.descriptionEn:
[Assault Mode]
Press [Basic Attack] to activate.
Unleash a flurry of martial arts, bullets, and Ether Buckshots in a series of up to 5 attacks, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
When the 4th or 5th hit strikes an enemy, obtain 1 Enhanced Shotshell per hit. A max of 1 can be obtained per activation of this Basic Attack.
While using this skill, drag the joystick and press [Basic Attack] to activate Dash Attack: Firepower Offensive and readjust to face the selected direction.
While under Assault Mode, hold [Basic Attack] to switch to Suppressive Mode.

skills.name: 普通攻击：请勿抵抗
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist
skills.description:
[压制模式]
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
使用霰弹枪向前方进行至多三段的穿透射击，造成物理伤害；开火时若拥有[强化霰弹]，则会消耗1枚[强化霰弹]，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动期间，拖曳摇杆可以发动[冲刺攻击：火力压制]，向对应方向调整身位；
[压制模式]下，松开 【普通攻击键】 时，将会切换攻击方式，回到[突击模式]。
skills.descriptionEn:
[Suppressive Mode]
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleash up to 3 Shotshell piercing attacks, dealing Physical DMG. If Zhu Yuan has Enhanced Shotshells upon firing, 1 Enhanced Shotshell will be consumed, dealing massive Ether DMG.
While using this skill, drag the joystick to activate her Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower and readjust to face the selected direction.
While in Suppressive Mode, release [Basic Attack] to return to Assault Mode.

skills.name: 特殊技：鹿弹射击
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用以太鹿弹进行射击，造成以太伤害，连续点按 【特殊技键】 ，可以重复射击三次；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Shoots Ether Buckshots that deal Ether DMG. This can be repeated 3 times by repeatedly pressing [Special Attack].
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：全弹连射
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用以太鹿弹进行连续射击，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得3枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Shoots a series of Ether Buckshots, that explode and deal massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：迂回
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：火力奇袭
skills.description:
[突击模式]
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
使用手枪进行射击，造成以太伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Assault Mode
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Uses handgun to attack, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：火力压制
skills.description:
[压制模式]
在[普通攻击：请勿抵抗]发动期间，拖曳摇杆发动：
使用霰弹枪进行穿透射击，造成物理伤害；开火时若拥有[强化霰弹]，则会消耗1枚[强化霰弹]，造成大量以太伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Suppressive Mode
Drag the joystick during Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist to activate:
Unleashes a Shotshell piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG. If Zhu Yuan has Enhanced Shotshells when firing, 1 Enhanced Shotshell will be consumed, dealing massive Ether DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：火力震爆
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
使用以太鹿弹对前方敌人发动射击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得1枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate.
Shoots enemies in front with an Ether Buckshot, dealing Ether DMG.
Gain 1 Enhanced Shotshell on skill use.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：歼灭模式
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
使用完全变形武器进行饱和攻击，发射直线激光和追踪导弹，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得3枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Uses Modified Master Firearm to execute a saturated attack, firing lasers and seeking missiles to deal massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：歼灭模式MAX
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
使用完全变形武器进行饱和攻击，发射直线激光和追踪导弹，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得3枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Uses Modified Master Firearm to execute a saturated attack, firing lasers and seeking missiles to deal massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：掩护射击
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
使用以太鹿弹对前方敌人发动射击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得1枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Shoots enemies in front with an Ether Buckshot, dealing Ether DMG.
Gain 1 Enhanced Shotshell on skill use.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 回避支援：警戒援护
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：自卫还击
skills.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
交替使用体术和霰弹枪进行攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得3枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Attack with a combination of martial arts and shotshells, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：特种弹药
skills.description: 朱鸢在[压制模式]下，消耗[强化霰弹]进行攻击时，招式造成的伤害提升20%，攻击处于失衡状态下的敌人时，该增益效果额外提升20%；进入战场时，朱鸢立刻获得6枚[强化霰弹]。
skills.descriptionEn: When Zhu Yuan is under Suppressive Mode, using Enhanced Shotshells increases her DMG by 20%. When attacking Stunned enemies, this DMG buff is increased by an additional 20%. When Zhu Yuan enters the battlefield, she immediately gains 6 Enhanced Shotshells.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.
