skills.name: 额外能力：武装协同
skills.description:
队伍中存在[支援]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
朱鸢发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]时，自身暴击率提升30%，持续10秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support character or shares the same Faction:
Zhu Yuan's CRIT Rate is increased by 30% for 10s after using an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate.

cinema.name: 快速装填
cinema.description: 朱鸢发动[连携技]/[终结技]时，将获得[快速装填]效果；当朱鸢拥有[快速装填]效果时，耗尽所有[强化霰弹]后，将消耗[快速装填]效果，立刻获得6/9枚[强化霰弹]。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhu Yuan activates Chain Attacks/Ultimates, gain the Quick Reload effect. When Zhu Yuan has the Quick Reload effect and uses up all Enhanced Shotshells, the Quick Reload effect will be consumed to instantly gain 6/9 Enhanced Shotshells.
cinema.story:
朱鸢曾经参加过雅努斯区治安官能力比拼大赛，并凭借着魔术般的装填技巧拔得头筹。
同事对此评价道：无他，惟手熟尔。
cinema.storyEn: Zhu Yuan once competed in the Janus Quarter's Public Security Officer Contest, clinching first place with her extraordinary reloading techniques. Her colleague commented: "It's nothing but sheer practice."

cinema.name: 以太余烬
cinema.description: [压制模式]下，朱鸢的抗打断等级提升，受到伤害降低10%；消耗[强化霰弹]攻击命中敌人时，[普通攻击：请勿抵抗]与[冲刺攻击：火力压制]造成的以太伤害提升10%，最多叠加5层，持续5秒，每次开火最多获得一层效果，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: In Suppressive Mode, Zhu Yuan's Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG taken reduced by 10%. When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, deal 10% more Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower Ether DMG, stacking up to 5 times and lasting for 5s. Each shot adds one stack of this effect, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
朱鸢装配有治安局特制的以太子弹，一旦击中敌人，则会对其造成不可逆的侵蚀伤害。
所以，朱鸢在开枪前会喊话让敌方乖乖投降、放弃抵抗，真的是为了对方的安全着想…
cinema.storyEn:
Zhu Yuan is equipped with Ether bullets specially designed by Public Security, which cause irreversible corruption upon hitting the enemy.
This is why Zhu Yuan always warns her enemies to surrender and stop resisting before she fires. It really is for their own health and safety...

cinema.name: 治安官特训
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 作为精英治安官，朱鸢接受的训练只有一个目的：全面提升空洞内各项作战能力，碾压一切不法之徒。
cinema.storyEn: As an elite Public Security Officer, Zhu Yuan's training focused on a single objective: to enhance all aspects of her combat abilities within the Hollow, ensuring she could outmatch any criminal.

cinema.name: 以太侵彻
cinema.description: 朱鸢消耗[强化霰弹]攻击命中敌人时，[普通攻击：请勿抵抗]与[冲刺攻击：火力压制]无视目标25%以太伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, her Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower ignore 25% of the target's Ether RES.
cinema.story:
在交战的时候，空洞的匪帮们喜欢暗中计算对方还剩多少子弹；
但他们绝对想不到，朱鸢配备的特制弹匣，能够利用周围的以太为自己持续供电…
cinema.storyEn: When in battle, the gangs in the Hollows often try to quietly calculate how many bullets their enemies have left. What they don't know is that Zhu Yuan's custom magazine can recharge itself with the Ether in the air...

cinema.name: 特勤经验
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
老练的特勤组治安官，更能懂得审时度势，高效发挥作战能力。
有时候甚至只需要一个充满震慑力的眼神，就能让敌人打消抵抗的念头。
cinema.storyEn: A seasoned Public Security Officer excels at reading the battlefield, striking precisely and maximizing combat efficiency. Sometimes, one stern look is enough to make her enemies think twice about putting up a fight.

cinema.name: 扩容能源包-叁型
cinema.description: 朱鸢累计消耗12枚[强化霰弹]时，将获得[以太余温]效果，并使下次发动的[强化特殊技]能量消耗降低30点；发动[强化特殊技]时，将消耗[以太余温]效果，额外发射总计4枚以太鹿弹，每枚额外发射的以太鹿弹将造成朱鸢220%攻击力的伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhu Yuan consumes a total of 12 Enhanced Shotshells, she receives the Ether Afterglow effect, and the Energy cost of the next EX Special Attack is reduced by 30. Launching an EX Special Attack will consume Ether Afterglow and shoot an additional 4-bullet Ether Buckshot. Each extra bullet deals DMG equal to 220% of Zhu Yuan's ATK.
cinema.story:
朱鸢会经常在意自身装备的剩余电量，在电量下降至红色区域时感到紧张，并刻意节省电量。
直到治安局为其配备了超大容量持续续航的能源包，才彻底解决了这个烦恼。
cinema.storyEn: Zhu Yuan often worries about her gear's remaining battery, getting nervous when the power dips into the red zone and consciously saving power. Public Security finally equipped her with an energy pack that offered both high capacity and long-lasting endurance.

skillCultivationRecommendation.label: 技能培养建议分组
skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.

icon.note: Existing local portrait asset; not downloaded from Gachabase.

1251.name: 青衣
1251.factionEn: Public Security: Criminal Investigation Special Response Team

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
青衣的学名为：01  Neo-Genesis Ⅵ (01号源生型第六代素体)
这个标码贴在青衣的初始素体某处，简写是：01NG Ⅵ
发现她的怀斯塔学会研究者把这一串字符化用成了：QING YI，遂叫她「青衣」。
profile.descriptionEn:
Qingyi's full name is officially designated as "01 Neo-Genesis VI."
This code is marked on a specific location of Qingyi's body, abbreviated as "01NG Ⅵ."
The researcher from White Star Institute who discovered her thought her code name looked like QING YI, so that's what he called her — Qingyi.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JAN 1

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 为什么青衣这边Fairy就只提示了一句？朱鸢的时候她可是重复了整整三遍「时刻牢记自己绳匠的身份」！
profile.descriptionEn: Why does Fairy only warn us once when it comes to Qingyi? She warned us to "remember our true identity" three whole times when she gave suggestions about Zhu Yuan!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
因为青衣好像就算知道了也会当做不知道吧…
倒不如说，她可能已经猜到了。
profile.descriptionEn:
Because even if she knew, she'd pretend she didn't...
She might even have already guessed.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对青衣的印象：
 · 高级人工智能，拥有各种令人羡慕的功能模块…
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Qingyi:
 · Advanced artificial intelligence equipped with all kinds of enviable function modules...

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 话说青衣究竟多少岁来着…？如果真问她的话，估计也会用「机密」这种搪塞过去吧…
profile.descriptionEn: · Just how old is Qingyi exactly...? If you ask her directly, she'll probably fob you off by saying it's "top secret"...

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 认识至今也被青衣捉弄好几回了，为什么从来不会生气呢？这难道就是前辈才能掌握的「分寸」么？
profile.descriptionEn: · She's teased me a bunch of times, but her pranks never really bothered me. How? Is this that "restraint" we're promised comes with maturity?

1251.description:
刑侦特勤组的新人探员，青衣。
并不是原生人类，其人格意识是基于旧文明的古老文化典籍塑造出来的拟造人格。而青衣的身体是基于生物材料制造的智能构造体，俗称「钰偶」。
由怀斯塔学会推荐给治安局，被以新人探员的身份配属为朱鸢的搭档。

青衣总是会表现出豁达，悠闲的长者做派，行事较为随意，不会被规则束缚。
同受到当下社会影响的现代人相比，青衣常常能提出很多意想不到的问题解决方式。

青衣随身携带水杯，时不时会拿出来喝几口。
「多喝热水，养生~」
提示：与青衣相处同样是在危险的边缘疯狂试探，请时刻牢记自己「绳匠」的身份。
1251.descriptionEn:
Qingyi is a new officer in the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team.
As an artificial human, her personality is derived from ancient cultural texts from the old civilization. Her body, known as an "Automaton," is an intelligent construct composed of biological materials.
Recommended by White Star Institute, she was assigned to Public Security as a new officer partnered with Zhu Yuan.

Qingyi always exhibits an easygoing, laid-back demeanor, not restricted by rules.
In contrast to modern individuals affected by today's society, Qingyi frequently proposes unexpected solutions to problems.

Qingyi always carries a cup of hot water and takes occasional sips.
"Drinking hot water is good for your health."
Suggestion: Approaching Qingyi is also an ill-considered decision that may compromise your cover. Please remember your true identity as a Proxy.

skills.name: 普通攻击：一煞
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第三段攻击期间，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 可以维持连击，持续打击敌人，在此期间发动[闪避]，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
第三段攻击期间，停止点按 【普通攻击键】 将会中断连击，自动衔接第四段攻击，维持连击超过一定时间后，第四段攻击将会得到强化；
第三、第四段攻击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to four strikes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to continue the attack, continuously striking the enemy. Using Dodge during this period will not interrupt Qingyi's Basic Attack combo count.
During the 3rd hit, stop pressing [Basic Attack] to interrupt the continuous attack, transitioning automatically to the 4th hit. If the continuous attack lasts for a certain time, the 4th hit will be enhanced.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the 3rd and 4th hit.

skills.name: 普通攻击：醉花云
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动一次突进攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches a forward rush attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪络
skills.description: 青衣发动招式造成电属性伤害时，会累积[闪络电压]，当[闪络电压]累积至75%时，青衣将进入[闪络]状态。发动[普通攻击：醉花月云转]时，青衣会消耗所有[闪络电压]并退出[闪络]状态，所消耗的[闪络电压]中超过75%的部分，每1%能够使本次招式造成的伤害/失衡值额外提升1%/0.5%。[普通攻击：醉花月云转]本身不会累积[闪络电压]。
skills.descriptionEn: When Qingyi deals Electric DMG with a skill, she accumulates Flash Connect Voltage. When Flash Connect Voltage reaches 75%, she will enter the Flash Connect state. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, Qingyi will consume all Flash Connect Voltage and exit the Flash Connect state. For every 1% of Flash Connect Voltage consumed over 75%, her Damage and Daze inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms itself does not accumulate Flash Connect Voltage.

skills.name: 普通攻击：醉花月云转
skills.description:
[闪络]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方连续发动五次突进攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量电属性伤害，招式发动期间松开 【普通攻击键】 ，可以提前发动终结一击；
在角色即将受到攻击时发动终结一击，可以触发[极限闪避]；
突进攻击发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，终结一击发动期间具有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
During the Flash Connect state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch five consecutive forward rush attacks, then execute a Finishing Move that inflicts massive Electric DMG. Release [Basic Attack] during the move to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Activate the Finishing Move just before the character is attacked to trigger Perfect Dodge.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the rush attack. Qingyi is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.

skills.name: 特殊技：昼锦堂
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方快速上挑，随后发动下砸攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly swings upward, followed by a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：月上海棠
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方快速上挑后腾空跃起，转身连打后发动强力的下砸攻击，造成大量电属性伤害，长按 【强化特殊技键】 时，可以额外消耗能量，提升转身连打的攻击次数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly swings upward and leaps into the air, turning around to launch a series of attacks, then follows up with a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to consume additional energy to increase the number of hits of the series of attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 闪避：雁过声
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：入破
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前突进后发动上挑攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Rush forward and then launch an upward attack, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：意不尽
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
腾空跃起后发动下落攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leap into the air and then perform a downward attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：太平令
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围区域发动强力连续打击，造成大量电属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，目标每拥有一层[核心被动：千秋岁]中的[羁服]，招式对其造成的伤害提升3%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, dealing massive Electric DMG
When this attack hits an enemy, the skill's DMG increases by 3% for every stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons the target has.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：八声甘州
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围区域发动强力连续打击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：风入松
skills.nameEn: Quick Assist: Wind Through the Pines
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
腾空跃起后发动下落攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Leap into the air and perform a downward attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：锦上花
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：清江引
skills.nameEn: Assist Follow-Up: Song of the Clear River
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方快速突进攻击并向地面注入电能，随后拔起引发爆炸，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Rush forward with an attack and inject electrical energy into the ground, then pull back to trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：千秋岁
skills.description: 青衣在[普通攻击：醉花月云转]中发动终结一击命中敌人时，会对敌人施加5层[羁服]，最多叠加20层，每层[羁服]能够使目标的失衡易伤倍率提升2%；在[普通攻击：醉花月云转]中每发动一次突进攻击，终结一击将额外施加1层[羁服]，在发动终结一击时，若触发[极限闪避]，可以直接施加10层[羁服]；对普通或精英敌人施加[羁服]时，施加的层数翻倍；目标从失衡状态恢复时，对应[羁服]层数重置。
skills.descriptionEn: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, it applies 5 stacks of Subjugation to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of Subjugation increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 2%. For each rush attack performed during Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the Finishing Move will apply 1 extra stack of Subjugation. If Perfect Dodge is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies 10 stacks of Subjugation. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of Subjugation are reset.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

skills.name: 额外能力：阳关三叠
skills.nameEn: Additional Ability: Three Verses of Farewell at Yang Pass
skills.description:
队伍中存在[强攻]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
[普通攻击]造成的失衡值提升20%；此外，若青衣的冲击力高于120点，每超过1点冲击力会使自身的攻击力提升6点，通过这种方式最多使自身的攻击力提升600点。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
Basic Attacks deal 20% increased Daze. If Qingyi's Impact is greater than 120, each point over increases her ATK by 6, up to a maximum of 600.

cinema.name: 介电击穿
cinema.description: 青衣进入战场时，立即使[闪络电压]回复至上限，并使其后继累积效率提升30%；发动[普通攻击：醉花月云转]时，若[闪络电压]已累积至上限，则使本次招式命中的敌人防御力降低15%，且自身对该目标的暴击率提升20%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Qingyi enters combat, Flash Connect Voltage is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, if Flash Connect Voltage is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.
cinema.story:
「虽不会有生命危险，不过还请不要拒捕…」
电流的方向和强度都经过精密的计算，保证每位嫌疑犯都能获得安全的电击体验。
cinema.storyEn:
"While there will be no threat to your life, we kindly request you do not resist arrest..."
The direction and intensity of the current have been precisely calculated to ensure that every suspect receives a safe electric shock experience.

cinema.name: 四两拨千斤
cinema.description: [核心被动：千秋岁]中每层[羁服]提供的失衡易伤倍率提升效果提升至原本的135%；青衣攻击命中敌人时，若对其施加的[羁服]已叠加至层数上限，则自身对其造成的失衡值提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons increases to 135% of its original value. When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of Subjugation she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.
cinema.story:
旧文明典籍中记载的一种搏击技术，起初似乎是一种拳术而非棍术的技巧。
「不必拘泥，其实手臂也是一种三节棍，嗯。」
cinema.storyEn:
An ancient combat technique mentioned in old civillization texts. It seems to have started as a martial arts technique, rather than a staff technique.
"Don't be so constrained, the arm itself can be used like a three-section staff, mhm."

cinema.name: 多喝热水
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「年轻人要注意养生，还是多喝热水吧。」
每次青衣捧着保温杯啜饮的时候，都给人以非常温暖的感受。但接过她递上的热水时一定要小心——
「就算是100度的开水前辈也能不动声色地喝下…」某位中过招的治安官留下了这样的记录。
cinema.storyEn:
"Young people should be mindful their health, and drinking more hot water is a good start."
Qingyi always appears comforted when she drinks from her flask. But be careful if she offers you a drink—
"Even 100-degree Celsius boiling water doesn't faze her..." One Public Security Officer who encountered this left such a note.

cinema.name: 稳态电弧屏障
cinema.description: 进入或退出[闪络]状态时，获得等同于青衣10%生命值上限的护盾；护盾效果刷新时，如果上一次获得的护盾仍然存在，则为青衣回复5点能量，能量回复效果10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering or exiting Flash Connect state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP. If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.
cinema.story:
怀斯塔学会逆向研究旧文明的钰偶而开发出的电弧屏障，是集防御、攻击、电能转换于一体的技术。
「俗话说：水能载舟，亦能覆舟。物理学俗话又说：电流如水流。并联得到：电流进可攻退可守。真是相当好的结合。」
cinema.storyEn:
By reverse-engineering Automatons from the old civilization, the White Star Institute developed the Arc Barrier, a technology that combines defense, attack, and electrical energy conversion.
"As the saying goes: Water can float a boat or sink it. Physics has a saying: Electric current flows like water. Therefore: Electric current can be used both offensively and defensively. It's a fantastic combination."

cinema.name: 童心未泯
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「善，年轻人就要勇于尝试新的事物，加油！」
虽然有时候会觉得青衣的鼓励里带着几分摸鱼、几分捉弄。但如果真的不幸捅了娄子，只要信赖她就可以了。
毕竟是活了几百上千年的老家伙了，什么都能摆平。
cinema.storyEn:
"Great, young people should be courageous and try new things. Keep it up!"
It sometimes feels like Qingyi's encouragement is lazy and teasing, but if you really get into trouble, just rely on her.
After all, she's been around for centuries and can handle anything.

cinema.name: 奇经八脉
cinema.description: [普通攻击：醉花月云转]的打断等级大幅提升，招式的暴击伤害额外提升100%；青衣[普通攻击：醉花月云转]命中敌人时，目标的全属性伤害抗性降低20%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Interrupt Level of Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms is greatly increased, and the CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 100%. When Qingyi hits an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the target's Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 20% for 15s.
cinema.story:
旧文明典籍中记载的对人体循环系统的一种学说，据说完整掌握这一理论后，可以在搏击中瞬间让对手失去行动能力。
「下次试试让人发痒的穴位吧，找谁来试验呢？店长？还是朱鸢？」
cinema.storyEn:
A theory about the human circulatory system documented in ancient texts from the old civilization. It's said those who fully master this theory can instantly disable an opponent in a fight.
"How about trying the pressure points that cause itching next time? Who should be the guinea pig? Manager? Or Zhu Yuan?"

skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.

1261.name: 简
1261.factionEn: Public Security: Criminal Investigation Special Response Team

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
简属于彻底的夜行生物。习惯在夜晚工作，是非常乐意上夜班的人。
似乎有一些囤积癖，总是把家里堆得满满当当（通常是大量速食品）。

简腰后的包包看似是化妆包，其实是工具包，里面放着各种符合她身份的「必备用具」。
profile.descriptionEn:
Jane is a total night owl. She loves working the night shift and is most alive after dark.
She's also a bit of a hoarder, constantly filling her home with stuff (usually a bunch of junk food).

The pouch at her waist might look like a makeup bag, but it's actually her toolkit, packed with all the "essentials" for her work.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: FEB 16

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: Fairy，其实你不用特别强调的，我们都已经接受简的名字就是简了。
profile.descriptionEn: Fairy, you don't have to reiterate anything. We've all come to terms with Jane's name being Jane.

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 毕竟我们还见过不少比这更潦草的名字…
profile.descriptionEn: I mean, it's far from the worst name we've seen...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对简的印象：
 · 她好像经常在深夜忙碌…
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Jane:
 · She seems to always be busy at night...

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 简究竟是做了无心之举的无名氏，还是精心伪装的布局者呢…
profile.descriptionEn: · Is Jane a bystander who acted on accident, or a mastermind who planned it all...?

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 对她而言，「晚安好梦」和「一起早餐」，似乎是分量很重的两句话。
profile.descriptionEn: · To her, "good night, sweet dreams" and "let's have breakfast together" are two very significant phrases.

1261.description:
简，犯罪行为学专家，有着相当「精彩」的个人履历，常年作为顾问与治安局合作。
精通伪装模仿，潜入调查等工作。
有点恶趣味，喜欢捉弄他人，会做一些无伤大雅的恶作剧。
擅长模仿他人，能同时做到形象和性情百变，但也因此让人疑惑「真实的她到底在哪里」。

简的人生经历丰富，总是能无缝融入各式各样的环境，好像对什么都有所涉猎。
但如果就这一点详细询问她的话，每次都会得到不同的答案。
谁也不知道哪个答案才是正确的，又或者根本没有正确答案。

提示：简目前并不知道我们的真实身份。请务必不要在她面前露馅。
再备注：虽然「简·杜」这个名字一看就是假名，但目前并未能搜索到简的真名亦或是曾用名的相关信息。
这不是我的问题。推测由于简的特殊身份，她的真名已被彻底处理。
再重申一遍，这不是我的问题。
1261.descriptionEn:
Jane, a criminal behavior specialist, has had a "colorful" career as a consultant with Public Security over the years.
She is an expert in disguise, infiltration, and other investigative work.
She has a bad habit of trolling others and sometimes plays harmless pranks.
She's a skilled mimic, able to change her appearance and demeanor at will, making people wonder what the "real" Jane is like.

Jane has a wealth of life experience and can seamlessly blend into any environment, as though she has dabbled in everything there is to do.
However, if you ask her for any further details, she'll give you a different story every time.
Who knows which, if any, are true.

Note 1: Jane does not know our true identity. Do not reveal this to her under any circumstances.
Note 2: Despite "Jane Doe" being an obvious alias, we haven't found any information about her real or former name.
This is not my problem. My guess is that her true identity has been completely erased due to her special status.
Let me reiterate: This is not my problem.

skills.name: 普通攻击：跳步刃舞
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多六段的攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 6 attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG.

variants.name: 普通攻击：跳步刃舞
variants.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多六段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
发动第六段[普通攻击]同时视为发动[冲刺攻击]，且招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
variants.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to six consecutive attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.
The sixth Basic Attack is also treated as a Dash Attack, and Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 狂热
skills.description:
简触发[极限闪避]、[招架支援]或发动招式对敌人造成伤害时，会累积[狂热心流]，当[狂热心流]累积至上限时，简将进入[狂热]状态；
[狂热]状态下，简的物理异常积蓄效率提升25%，此外，若简的异常精通高于120点，每超过1点异常精通会使自身的攻击力提升2点，通过这种方式最多使自身的攻击力提升600点；
简在[狂热]状态下发动招式造成伤害时，会消耗[狂热心流]，触发[极限闪避]或[招架支援]时，可以回复[狂热心流]，当[狂热心流]耗尽时，将退出[狂热]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Jane triggers Perfect Dodge, Defensive Assist, or performs a move that deals DMG to the enemy, she accumulates Passion Stream. Upon reaching the maximum Passion Stream, Jane enters the Passion state.
While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Anomaly Proficiency exceeds 120, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600.
In the Passion state, Jane's skills that deal damage consume Passion Stream. Activating a Perfect Dodge or Defensive Assist regenerates Passion Stream. Jane exits the Passion state when all of her Passion Stream is consumed.

skills.name: 普通攻击：萨霍夫跳
skills.description:
进入[狂热]状态时，简将获得一次[普通攻击：萨霍夫跳]的可使用次数；
当有可使用次数时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动快速的连续攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成物理伤害；
连续攻击期间，保持长按可以延长招式的持续时间，松开 【普通攻击键】 可以提前发动终结一击；
连续攻击发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，终结一击发动期间具有无敌效果；
在[狂热]状态下发动[普通攻击：萨霍夫跳]对敌人造成伤害时，可以回复[狂热心流]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Entering the Passion state grants Jane one use of Basic Attack: Salchow Jump.
When available, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to extend the skill duration. Release [Basic Attack] to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.
Using and damaging an enemy with Basic Attack: Salchow Jump while in the Passion state generates Passion Stream.

variants.name: 普通攻击：萨霍夫跳
variants.description:
进入[狂热]状态时，简将获得一次[普通攻击：萨霍夫跳]的可使用次数；
当有可使用次数时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动快速的连续攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成物理伤害；
连续攻击期间，保持长按可以大幅延长招式的持续时间，松开 【普通攻击键】 可以提前发动终结一击；
连续攻击发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，终结一击发动期间具有无敌效果，且发动时可触发极限闪避；
若触发极限闪避，则提升终结一击命中敌人时回复的[狂热心流]；
在[狂热]状态下发动[普通攻击：萨霍夫跳]对敌人造成伤害时，可以回复[狂热心流]。
variants.descriptionEn:
Entering the Passion state grants Jane one use of Basic Attack: Salchow Jump.
When available, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to greatly extend the skill duration. Release [Basic Attack] to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move, which can also trigger a Perfect Dodge upon activation.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered, the Finishing Move restores more Passion Stream on hit.
Using and damaging an enemy with Basic Attack: Salchow Jump while in the Passion state generates Passion Stream.

skills.name: 特殊技：掠空
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，向前方发动连续踢击后横扫，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：掠空-横扫
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Clearout
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，向前方发动多次连续踢击后横扫，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

variants.name: 强化特殊技：掠空-横扫
variants.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Clearout
variants.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，向前方发动多次连续踢击后横扫，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，且同时视为发动[冲刺攻击]。
variants.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, which also counts as a Dash Attack.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：掠空-强袭（潜能觉醒）
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught (Potential Awakening)
skills.description:
[狂热]状态下，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，向前方发动多次连续踢击后横扫，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，且同时视为发动[冲刺攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Passion state and with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, which also counts as a Dash Attack.

skills.name: 闪避：残影
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的滑步闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
简拥有一次额外的闪避次数，在进入[狂热]状态前，简会交替使用两段闪避，在进入[狂热]状态后，简在闪避时可以穿过前方的敌人。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to trigger.
A quick slide dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Jane has an extra dodge. Before she enters the Passion state, she alternates between the two dodges. After entering the Passion state, Jane can pass through enemies in front when dodging.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：刀刃跳
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
若衔接在一段闪避后，将向前方进行上挑斩击，造成物理伤害；
若衔接在二段闪避后，将向前方进行连续斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
If after the first dodge, launch an upward slash in front, dealing Physical DMG.
If after the second dodge, perform a consecutive slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：虚像突刺
skills.description:
[狂热]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行三次快速的突进斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Passion state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch three quick rushing slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：疾影
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
若衔接在一段闪避后，将对前方敌人发动多次斩击，随后向下突刺，造成物理伤害；
若衔接在二段闪避后，将会跃起并对前方敌人发动三次连续攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
If after the first dodge, unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing Physical DMG.
If after the second dodge, leap up and deliver three consecutive attacks to enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避反击：疾影连舞
skills.description:
[狂热]状态下，触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多次快速斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Passion state, press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slash enemies in front quickly multiple times, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：罪孽生花
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿梭斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，简将直接进入[狂热]状态，并使[狂热心流]回复至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Weaves between and slashes enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Jane directly enters the Passion state upon activating the skill, and gains max Passion Stream.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：终幕演出
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力穿梭斩击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，简将直接进入[狂热]状态，并使[狂热心流]回复至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Weaves between and slashes enemies with a powerful attack in a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Jane directly enters the Passion state upon activating the skill, and gains max Passion Stream.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：乌刺
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多次斩击，随后向下突刺，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：勾手跳
skills.description:
[狂热]状态下，当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多次快速斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Passion state, when the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slash enemies in front quickly multiple times, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：最后防线
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：疾风扫
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
腾空跃起后对敌人发动快速斩击，随后在前方大范围内再次发动横扫斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Leap up and swiftly slash the enemy, then execute a wide sweeping slash across a large area in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：洞察
skills.description: 简攻击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[啮咬]状态，持续10秒；队伍中任意角色对处于[啮咬]状态下的敌人触发[强击]并施加[畏缩]效果时，[畏缩]效果的持续时间提升5秒；对处于[啮咬]状态下的敌人造成的[强击]伤害有概率触发暴击，基础暴击率为20%，暴击伤害为50%，简的每点异常精通会使该效果的暴击率额外提升0.1%。
skills.descriptionEn: When Jane's attacks hit an enemy, it causes them to enter the Gnawed state, lasting for 10s. If any squad member triggers Assault on an enemy in the Gnawed state and causes the Flinch effect, the Flinch effect duration is extended by 5s. Assault DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit against enemies in the Gnawed state, with a base CRIT Rate of 20% and CRIT DMG of 50%. Each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency further increases this CRIT Rate by 0.1%.

Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 20%. When the enemy is already suffering from an Attribute Anomaly, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup towards the target is increased by an additional 15%.

cinema.name: 犯罪顾问
cinema.description: [普通攻击：萨霍夫跳]的可使用次数上限增加一次；在[狂热]状态下，简的物理异常积蓄效率额外提升15%，同时每点异常精通将会使自身造成的伤害提升0.1%，最多提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: The maximum uses of Basic Attack: Salchow Jump are increased by one. While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by an extra 15% and each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency increases her DMG by 0.1%, up to a maximum increase of 30%.
cinema.story:
「犯罪顾问，是指研究犯罪行为学的顾问，不是精通如何犯罪的顾问。」
简忽然凑近，眨了眨眼睛。
「当然，你要理解成后者的话…我也不反对哦。」
cinema.storyEn:
"A criminal consultant advises on criminology, not on how to actually commit crimes."
Jane suddenly leaned closer and blinked.
"Of course, if you see it as the latter... I won't mind."

cinema.name: 近朱者赤
cinema.description: 简攻击命中处于[啮咬]状态下的敌人，或队伍中任意角色对处于[啮咬]状态下的敌人触发[强击]时，将会无视其15%防御力，当[强击]伤害触发暴击时，其暴击伤害额外提升50%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Jane's attack hits an enemy in the Gnawed state, or when any squad member triggers Assault on an enemy in the Gnawed state, 15% of the enemy's DEF is ignored. Additionally, when Assault DMG triggers a critical hit, the CRIT DMG dealt is increased by an additional 50%.
cinema.story:
凝视深渊时会被深渊回以凝视，这只是第一步。
「然后要靠近它、进入它、理解它，这是第二步。」
「最后一步…不要成为它。」
cinema.storyEn:
Gaze into the abyss, and it gazes back. That's only the first step.
"Then you must approach, enter, and understand it. This is the second step."
"The final step... is to resist becoming it."

cinema.name: 无名氏
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「无名氏，意味着我可以成为任何人。比如你最喜欢的人~」
「或者，你最恐惧的人？」
cinema.storyEn:
"Anonymity — that means to become anyone. Your favorite person, perhaps~"
"Or maybe, your worst fear?"

cinema.name: 因势利导
cinema.description: 队伍中任意角色触发[强击]或[紊乱]效果时，全队角色造成的属性异常伤害提升18%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When any squad member triggers the Assault or Disorder effects, all squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG is increased by 18%, lasting 15s.
cinema.story:
「是猎人还是猎物，往往取决于你选择的视角。不过，我更喜欢另一个简单的判断方式——」
「输的人，就是猎物。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Whether you're a hunter or the hunted usually depends on your perspective. However, I favor a more straightforward assessment—"
"The Loser is the prey."

cinema.name: 囤积癖好
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
简的房间里永远塞满了各式各样的东西，其中最多的是速食食品。
「这里很不错吧？到处都是触手可及的食物哦~」
cinema.storyEn:
Jane's room is filled with all sorts of things, especially fast food.
"Isn't it nice here? There's food within reach everywhere~"

cinema.name: 「肮脏」技巧
cinema.description: [狂热]状态下，简的暴击率提升20%，暴击伤害提升40%；队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[强击]效果时，简将直接进入[狂热]状态，并使[狂热心流]回复至上限，此次[强击]伤害触发暴击时，将会对目标发动一次额外攻击，造成等同于简1600%异常精通的物理伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Passion state, Jane's CRIT Rate increases by 20%, and CRIT DMG by 40%. After any squad member inflicts Assault, Jane instantly enters the Passion state, and gains max Passion Stream. When that instance of Assault triggers a critical hit, Jane performs an additional attack on the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 1,600% of her Anomaly Proficiency.
cinema.story:
街头可不在乎手段脏不脏，只在乎结果赢没赢。
「看清最黑暗的欲望，才能推演出最痛切的弱点。」
cinema.storyEn:
On the streets, the means don't matter, only the outcome.
"Seeing the darkest desires reveals the most crucial weaknesses."

1271.name: 赛斯
1271.factionEn: Public Security: Criminal Investigation Special Response Team

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
履历中显示，赛斯有一位兄长，同样任职于治安局，官阶较高。
在一部分不怀好意的人眼里，赛斯似乎是治安局体系内的「关系户」。但实际上赛斯考入治安局这件事完全与哥哥无关。
目前兄弟之间的关系微妙，是即使在治安局内碰面也会彼此装作不认识的状态。
赛斯似乎单方面把哥哥当成了自己的假想敌，正在为了赢过哥哥而努力。
profile.descriptionEn:
The profile shows that Seth has an older brother who holds a higher position in Public Security.
To some, Seth is a rookie riding on family connections within Public Security, but he got in on his own merit and has nothing to do with his brother's influence.
Currently, they are not on good terms. When they encounter each other at work, they pretend not to know one another.
Seth views his brother as a rival he must surpass, and is working hard to achieve that goal.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 男
profile.descriptionEn: Male

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: APR 8

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 赛斯果然是猫科希人呢！他好像很容易吸引到猫猫。
profile.descriptionEn: Seth really is a feline Thiren! He's like a kitty magnet.

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
之前好像在街上看到过他被流浪猫团团围住寸步难行的样子。
真好啊，能被猫这么喜欢。
profile.descriptionEn:
I remember seeing him being completely surrounded by stray cats on the street once.
Must be nice to be so loved by cats.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对赛斯的印象：
 · 一不留神已经成为了朋友…赛斯真是好懂的人
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Seth:
 · Somehow, we became friends? Seth is really easy to understand.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 为什么赛斯总能请客！？治安官待遇有这么好？
profile.descriptionEn: · How come Seth is always treating people to meals? Do Pub Sec officers make that much?

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 「很高兴被赛斯看作朋友」…直到那一天来临之前
profile.descriptionEn: · "I'm very happy to be Seth's friend"... Until that day arrives.

1271.description:
赛斯，治安局刑侦特勤组的实习探员，是所属队伍抓捕犯人时的重要火力支援。
在校时期成绩优异，原本可以进更高层的部门实习，但是本人坚持选择了较为辛苦的刑侦特勤组。
优秀的履历看起来像是天才类型，实际上意外的是个努力家，也有过一遍一遍哭着练习自己不擅长科目的时候。
虽然脑子不差，但因为性格原因，在与狡猾的犯罪分子或是同事（？）交涉沟通时常常明里暗里吃亏。
赛斯最不擅长的科目是伪装潜入。有小道消息称，赛斯一直是校内伪装潜入任务「最快被戳穿」记录的保持者。

根据现有视频资料推测，赛斯似乎有些迟钝。
具体表现为：当有人对他进行一些阴阳怪气的嘲讽时，赛斯通常会在很长时间之后才能反应过来。
1271.descriptionEn:
Seth, a rookie officer in the Public Security Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, is a key player in providing fire support during criminal investigations.
He graduated at the top of his class in the academy and could have landed a higher position, but he chose the tougher path of the Special Response Team.
His impressive profile makes him seem like a genius, but he's actually a hard worker who has had his own struggles. There have been times when he practiced the subjects he wasn't good at until he cried.
Seth is quite smart, but his personality often leads to him being taken advantage of by cunning criminals, or sometimes, coworkers (?).
The subject he's worst at is infiltration. Rumor has it that he holds the academy record for "fastest to get busted" in infiltration tasks. Based on the video intel we have, he seems a bit slow to catch on. For instance, when someone is being sarcastic, it takes him a long time to realize it.

skills.name: 普通攻击：雷霆击
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：雷霆击-感电
skills.description:
[意气]大于等于75%时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
消耗75%[意气]向前方发动持续攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成电属性伤害；
终结一击命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Resolve is above or equal to 75%, hold [Basic Attack] to activate.
Consume 75% Resolve to launch consecutive attacks in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Electric DMG.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the squad member positioned before Seth.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：电光盾冲
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动两次盾击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launch two shield attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动连续斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，蓄力完成后赛斯将向前方突进，发动高量级的连续斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动时，会为自身累积75%[意气]；
招式蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
连续斩击期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack]to charge the move, and Seth will dash forward, unleashing a series of powerful slashes, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging this skill, and damage taken is reduced by 40%.
Seth is invulnerable during the consecutive slashes.

skills.name: 闪避：避障
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：电光突袭
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行盾冲攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间受到的伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Charge forward with a shield attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Damage received during the move is decreased by 40%.

skills.name: 闪避反击：以退为进
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动快速的下砸斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleash a quick downward slash on enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
After the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：最终制裁
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方进行连续斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动时，会为自身累积75%[意气]；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of slashes in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve.
After the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：正义必胜
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行连续上挑攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动时，会为自身累积75%[意气]，额外回复3点支援点数；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a series of upward attacks in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve, and grants 3 additional Assist Points.
After the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：武力支援
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动快速的下砸斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a quick downward slash on enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
After the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：迅雷盾
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动时，会为自身累积25%[意气]；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Upon activation, gain 25% Resolve.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：治安裁决
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动突刺攻击，随后进行两次横扫斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch a forward thrust attack, followed by two horizontal slashes, dealing Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the squad member positioned before Seth.
After activating the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to transition to EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage and charge faster.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：守望者
skills.description: 赛斯发动[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，会获得等同于自身40%初始攻击力的护盾[匪石之盾]，最高不超过3000点，持续25秒，10秒内最多触发一次；队伍中其他角色通过[普通攻击：雷霆击-感电]或[支援突击：治安裁决]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，会为该队友提供等同于赛斯40%初始攻击力的护盾[匪石之盾]，最高不超过3000点，持续25秒，10秒内最多触发一次；拥有[匪石之盾]时，持有者的异常精通提升50点。
skills.descriptionEn: When Seth uses EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, he gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 40% of his initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified or Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling triggers a Quick Assist or Chain Attack, causing another squad member to enter the field, that squad member gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 40% of Seth's initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a Shield of Firm Resolve increases Anomaly Proficiency by 50.

skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

skills.name: 额外能力：意气风发
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
赛斯发动[连携技：最终制裁]命中敌人或在[普通攻击：雷霆击-感电]中发动终结一击命中敌人时，目标的全属性异常积蓄抗性降低20%，持续20秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Seth's Chain Attack: Final Judgment or Finishing Move during Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified hits an enemy, the target's Anomaly Buildup RES to all Attributes is reduced by 20%, lasting 20s.

cinema.name: 英雄主义
cinema.description: [匪石之盾]提供的护盾及其上限提升30%，[匪石之盾]失效时，[核心被动：守望者]提供的异常精通提升效果额外维持10秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: The shield value provided by Shield of Firm Resolve and its maximum limit is increased by 30%. When Shield of Firm Resolve ends, the Anomaly Proficiency increase provided by Core Passive: Protector lasts an additional 10s.
cinema.story:
团队行动的时候，赛斯永远是冲在最前面的人。
「逮捕犯人就交给我吧！我的近身擒拿成绩是99分，扣掉的那一分是因为不小心扭伤了教官的手腕。」
cinema.storyEn:
When it comes to team missions, Seth is always leading the charge.
"Let me handle the arrests! I scored a 99 in close-quarters arrests, and the only point deducted was because I accidentally sprained the instructor's wrist."

cinema.name: 年少轻狂
cinema.description: 进入战场时，赛斯立刻为自身累积75%[意气]；发动[普通攻击：雷霆击-感电]命中敌人时，招式累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升35%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering battle, Seth immediately gains 75% Resolve. Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified increases the move's accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 35%.
cinema.story:
赛斯很容易被各种犯罪者小看。
或许是因为他的眼神太过清澈，又或许是因为那无害的毛茸茸耳朵和尾巴——
无论如何，所有看低他的人，最终都会付出相应的代价。
cinema.storyEn:
Many criminals make the mistake of underestimating Seth.
It might be his pure, clear eyes or those innocent-looking furry ears and tail. Whatever the reason, everyone who underestimates him eventually pays the price.

cinema.name: 钝感力
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「像你这么厉害的治安官，肯定做什么都是靠自己吧？绝对没依赖其他人吧？」
即使被这么说了，赛斯依然不动声色。
直到半夜，他才忽然惊醒：
「那家伙白天的话…莫非是在讽刺我？」
cinema.storyEn:
"A skilled officer like you must handle everything on your own, right? No help from others, surely?"
Even after hearing this, Seth remained composed and didn't say a word.
It wasn't until midnight that he suddenly woke up: "Could that guy's comment earlier... have been a dig at me?"

cinema.name: 初心
cinema.description: [招架支援：迅雷盾]造成的失衡值提升25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Daze caused by Defensive Assist: Thundershield is increased by 25%.
cinema.story:
「放下你那愚蠢的善恶观。世上没有一种方式可以守护所有人。有时候，你必须做出选择。」
「这就是我的选择，也是治安官最基本的职责——是你变了，哥哥。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Put aside your foolish notions of good and evil. You can't protect everyone. Sometimes, you have to make a choice."
"This is my choice, and it's the core responsibility of an officer — you're the one who has changed, Brother."

cinema.name: 憧憬的距离
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
对于自己的兄长，赛斯曾抱有极度的憧憬和尊敬。
但就像你知道的那样——「憧憬」是距离「理解」最遥远的距离。
「总有一天，我会成为最厉害的治安官…让那家伙收回之前的话！」
cinema.storyEn:
Seth used to deeply admire and respect his older brother. But as you know, "admiration" is the furthest thing from "understanding."
"Someday, I'll become the finest officer... and make him eat his words!"

cinema.name: 理想主义
cinema.description: 赛斯在[普通攻击：雷霆击-感电]中发动终结一击命中敌人时，额外造成自身500%攻击力的伤害，本次攻击必定触发暴击，且暴击伤害提升60%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Seth lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.
cinema.story:
少年人眼里的一切很清晰，黑白分明，善恶有别。
一定会有人想告诉他世界的颜色是混沌的灰。但黑白分明善恶有别的世界…不值得追求吗？
cinema.storyEn:
To a young person, everything is clear-cut, with a stark contrast between black and white, right and wrong.
There will always be someone who tries to tell him that the world is a murky gray. But is a world where everything is clear-cut and distinct really not worth striving for?

1281.name: 派派

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
因为很喜欢卡车启动的轰鸣声，派派把大钢牙的启动声录了下来，每天起床的时候需要先听一遍手机里的录音才能完全清醒过来。
如果开会的时候派派睡着了，播放卡车轰鸣声可以高效率将她唤醒（此条信息由露西提供）。
profile.descriptionEn:
Piper has a love for the sound of truck engines starting up, so she recorded the sound of Steeltusk starting up. She has to listen to the recording to fully wake up in the morning.
If Piper falls asleep during a meeting, playing a recording of a truck engine can quickly get her wide awake again (this intel was provided by Lucy).

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: OCT 21

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 派派有时候会用「这个人」而不是「我」来称呼自己呢，是在开玩笑吗，又或者…是在害羞吗！
profile.descriptionEn: Sometimes Piper says "lil ol' me" instead of "I"... Is she trying to be funny...? Or maybe she's shy!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
应该就是单纯的口癖吧。
说起来，看这段内容，总感觉Fairy在隐晦地向我们抱怨什么…
profile.descriptionEn:
I think it's probably just a catchphrase.
By the way, that last part... Is Fairy trying to complain about us...?

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对派派的印象：
 · 是因为开卡车所以性格像大叔，还是因为性格像大叔所以热爱开卡车？
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Piper:
 · Is her personality like a middle-aged man cause she drives a truck? Or does she drive a truck because her personality is like a middle-aged man?

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 派派似乎运气很好…多找派派一起玩的话，说不定可以沾到光呢！
profile.descriptionEn: · Piper seems to be really lucky... Maybe it'll rub off if we hang out with her more.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 说着要向前看的人，一定有不愿回头的理由。
profile.descriptionEn: · Someone who says that people have to look forward must have some reason they're unwilling to look back.

1281.description:
派派，卡吕冬之子的卡车司机。除了开卡车之外，也会负责车辆维修相关的工作
小小的身体软萌的声音（虽然不开车的时候总是睡眼惺忪），可爱而毫无攻击性的外表（虽然很宅很懒散且完全不在乎自己形象），让人完全想象不到她竟然有如此狂野的驾驶方式。
往往在她说「坐~稳~咯~」的时候，「稳」字发音还没结束，卡车就已经嗖地一下开出很远了。
派派是外环传闻中「从来不需要刹车」的司机。虽然坐她的车一定会让人心惊胆战，但也总能在最短的时间内把你安全送到目的地——当然，精神损失不算在内。

派派拥有很多和年龄不符的爱好。例如看报，买彩券，收集车辆杂志等。
派派最大的愿望是每一天都能悠闲地度过。
备注：这也是我的愿望，望您知悉。
1281.descriptionEn:
Piper is a truck driver for the Sons of Calydon. Apart from driving, she's also responsible for vehicle maintenance and other related jobs.
Her tiny stature, cute voice (though she always seems half-asleep when not driving), and adorably harmless appearance (though she's a shut-in who can't be bothered to take care of her own appearance) make it hard to imagine that she would have such a crazy driving style.
Usually, by the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
Rumor has it, Piper is a driver who doesn't need brakes. Though riding with her is a terrifying experience, she will always get you where you need to go safely, and in the shortest time possible. Of course, "safely" doesn't include any trauma that may be induced.

Piper has many hobbies that don't seem to match her age, such as reading newspapers, buying lottery tickets, and collecting car magazines.
Piper's biggest wish is to live each day slowly and leisurely.
Note: Please keep in mind, Master, that this is also my wish.

skills.name: 普通攻击：准备发车
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Load Up and Roll Out
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 特殊技：轮胎转
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
转动身体向周围发动旋转斩击，造成物理伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 可以延长招式的持续时间，发动越来越强的旋转斩击，并提升招式的蓄力等级，最多提升2次；
若衔接在[普通攻击]前三段、[冲刺攻击]或[闪避反击]之后，则能够以提升后的蓄力等级快速发动[特殊技：轮胎转]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Piper spins and launches a sweeping slash around her, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] to extend the skill duration, unleashing increasingly powerful spinning slashes and increasing the charge level of the skill up to 2 times.
If the skill is used after the first 3 hits of a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, or Dodge Counter, you can quickly activate Special Attack: Tire Spin of an increased charge level.
During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: 特殊技：有亿点重
skills.description:
在[特殊技：轮胎转]发动期间，松开 【特殊技键】 发动：
根据[特殊技：轮胎转]的蓄力等级，向前方发动下砸攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While Special Attack: Tire Spin is active, release [Special Attack] to trigger a downward smash attack based on the charge level of Special Attack: Tire Spin, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：引擎转
skills.description:
能量足够时，在[特殊技：轮胎转]达到最高蓄力等级后，继续长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
快速转动身体，向周围发动旋转斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
发动期间持续消耗能量，最多持续3秒；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, continue holding [EX Special Attack] after Special Attack: Tire Spin reaches maximum charge level to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes around her and dealing massive Physical DMG.
This skill consumes Energy continuously for up to 3s.
During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：非常重
skills.description:
在[强化特殊技：引擎转]发动期间，松开 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动强力的下砸攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
在[强化特殊技：引擎转]发动期间，持续时间达到上限或能量降低至20点时，将会自动发动[强化特殊技：非常重]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
During EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, release [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Piper unleashes a downward smash attack, dealing massive Physical DMG.
If the duration of EX Special Attack: Engine Spin reaches its limit or Energy drops to 20, EX Special Attack: Really Heavy will automatically activate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：手刹漂移
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：一脚油门
skills.nameEn: Dash Attack: Pedal to the Metal
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：动力漂移
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动下砸攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleash a downward smash attack in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：系好安全带
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方敌人发动强力下砸攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful downward smash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：坐~稳~啦~
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
快速转动身体，对前方大范围敌人发动强力的旋转斩击，随后发动下砸攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, followed by a downward smash, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：点刹
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动下砸攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a downward smash attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：极限刹车
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：弯道超车
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：动力蓄能
skills.description: 派派在[强化特殊技：引擎转]或[终结技]中发动旋转斩击命中敌人时，获得1层[动力]，最多叠加20层，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每拥有一层[动力]，派派的物理异常积蓄效率提升2%。
skills.descriptionEn: When Piper's EX Special Attack: Engine Spin or Ultimate hits an enemy, she gains 1 stack of Power, up to a maximum of 20 stacks, lasting for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For every stack of Power, Piper's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 2%.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

skills.name: 额外能力：同步疾驰
skills.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或其他[异常]角色时触发：
派派拥有20层或以上[动力]时，全队角色造成的伤害提升18%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character, or shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Piper has 20 or more stacks of Power, all squad members' DMG is increased by 18%.

cinema.name: 悠闲一刻
cinema.description: 派派在[特殊技：轮胎转]、[强化特殊技：引擎转]或[终结技]中发动旋转斩击命中敌人时，有50%概率额外获得1层[动力]，[动力]的叠加层数上限提升至30层。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Piper's Special Attack: Tire Spin, EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, or Ultimate hits an enemy with a spinning slash, there is a 50% chance to gain an additional stack of Power. The maximum stack limit of Power is increased to 30.
cinema.story:
卡吕冬之子某个平常的上午，派派慢悠悠地打了个哈欠。
「早上好——」
「今天也能悠闲地度过吧？养生可是很重要的，不然这个人会过劳死哦——」
cinema.storyEn:
One ordinary morning at Sons of Calydon, Piper lets out a lazy yawn.
"Good morning—"
"Can we have another relaxing day today? It's important to take it easy, or else lil ol' me might end up working meself to death—"

cinema.name: 上进心
cinema.description: 在[特殊技：轮胎转]和[强化特殊技：引擎转]发动期间，派派的移动速度有所提升；在[特殊技：有亿点重]、[强化特殊技：非常重]和[终结技]中发动下砸攻击命中敌人时，招式造成的物理伤害提升10%，每拥有1层[动力]，该增益效果额外提升1%。
cinema.descriptionEn: During Special Attack: Tire Spin and EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, Piper's movement speed increases. When using Special Attack: One Trillion Tons, EX Special Attack: Really Heavy, or Ultimate to launch a downward smash that hits an enemy, the Physical DMG dealt by the move is increased by 10%. For each stack of Power, this buff is further increased by 1%.
cinema.story:
暂时的努力，是为了更加长久的休憩。
当然，如果能一直都不努力就更好了——派派伸了个懒腰，拍了拍卡车里的柔软床铺，躺了下来。
cinema.storyEn:
A bit of effort now means more rest later.
Though, it'd be even better if I didn't have to put in any effort at all — Piper stretches, pats the soft bed in her truck, and lies down.

cinema.name: 卡车专家
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
派派总是对卡车的一切充满兴趣。
即使是在熟睡的状态下，只要引擎声响起，少女就能瞬间清醒：
「100马力，载重5吨，这是…三门重工新发售的轻型卡车！」
cinema.storyEn:
Piper is always all about trucks.
Even when she's fast asleep, the rumble of an engine snaps her awake in an instant:
"100 horsepower, 5-ton capacity... must be the new light truck from Three Gates Industries!"

cinema.name: 技巧娴熟
cinema.description: 队伍中任意角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，派派回复20点能量，30秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Piper recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 30s.
cinema.story:
成为派派的乘客是一件让人心惊胆战的事。
通常在她慢悠悠地提醒「坐~稳~咯~」的时候，「稳」字发音还没结束，卡车就已经向前行驶了惊人的距离。
当然，她总能在最短的时间内把你安全送到目的地——精神损失不算在内。
cinema.storyEn:
Riding with Piper is a heart-pounding experience.
By the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
She always gets you to your destination fast—though your nerves might take a hit.

cinema.name: 私人爱好
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
派派似乎拥有一些不太符合外表的私人爱好。
「这匹马好像很能跑的样子…唔，但是买的人好少，果然还是那匹胜率更高吗…」
「嗝——燃油饮…我才没喝多…再来一杯！」
cinema.storyEn:
Piper seems to have some hobbies that are not what you'd expect from her.
"This horse looks like a real runner... Hmm, but not many people are betting on it. Guess the one with the higher win rate is the safer bet..."
"Burp— Nitro-Fuel... I can drink more... Gimme another one!"

cinema.name: 轻度兴奋
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：引擎转]的持续时间上限提升2秒，[动力]的持续时间提升4秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: Increases the duration limit of EX Special Attack: Engine Spin by 2s and extends the duration of Power by 4s.
cinema.story:
如你所知，派派最大的愿望是永远都能悠闲度日。
但此刻，少女总是半睁着的双眸竟少有的精神奕奕。
「如果是为了你…这个人稍微努力一下下，也可以哦~」
cinema.storyEn:
As you may already know, Piper's biggest dream is to live a life of perpetual relaxation.
But right now, her usually half-closed eyes are surprisingly bright and alert.
"If it's for you... I suppose lil ol' me can try a little harder~"

skillCultivationRecommendation.label: 技能培养建议分组
skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.

icon.note: Existing local portrait asset; not downloaded from Gachabase.

1291.name: 雨果

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
在拉文洛克家族时期，雨果曾因为吃了一块「哥哥」喜爱的蛋糕，而被那些孩子们逼迫吞下了整整一桌的甜品。
自那之后，只要尝到甜味就会令他想要呕吐（推测为某种创伤后应激反应）。
但因为低血糖，他需要通过补充糖分来让自己的身体机能维持稳定状态。雨果选择逼迫自己一遍一遍吃下各种甜品，战胜这种痛苦。
备注：莱卡恩和薇薇安都不知道这段信息，雨果曾要求您对他们保密。
profile.descriptionEn:
Back during his time with the Ravenlock family, Hugo once ate a piece of cake that his older brother liked. In retaliation, the other children forced him to eat an entire table's worth of desserts.
Ever since, the taste of anything sweet makes him want to throw up — likely due to PTSD.
But due to his hypoglycemia, he needs sugar to keep his body functioning properly. Hugo forces himself to eat sweets over and over, pushing through the nausea to overcome the pain.
Note: Neither Lycaon nor Vivian knows about this, and Hugo once asked you to keep it a secret from them.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 男
profile.descriptionEn: Male

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: AUG 20

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 该怎么说呢…感觉雨果至今能保持相对的心理健康，没有发疯也没有变成反社会人格，已经很了不起了？
profile.descriptionEn: Let's just say, the fact that Hugo hasn't gone off the deep end or become a sociopath is already quite the achievement.

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
有点好奇，如果雨果是在一个普通家庭长大的话，会变成什么样的人…
但也正是因为经历了这些，他才成为他自己吧。
profile.descriptionEn:
Sometimes I wonder what Hugo would've been like if he'd had a normal upbringing...
But then again, it's those very experiences that made him who he is.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对雨果的印象：
 · 他从深渊中爬起，看见了真正的自己。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Hugo:
 · He climbed out of the abyss and saw his true self.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 从来没有什么罪恶的种子。
profile.descriptionEn: · There never was any seed of evil.

profile.name: 印象 3

1291.description:
雨果，自称是一位收藏家，名下有一间生意不错的画廊，游走在新艾利都「上等人」之间。
真实身份是怪盗组织反舌鸟的首领，莱卡恩的前搭档。
虽然嘴上总是说着很多残酷（又中二）的话，但本质上对「公平」和「正义」有自己的追求。

相关信息显示，雨果有一段扭曲的童年经历。
作为TOPS老牌家族拉文洛克的私生子，他从小因为异色的眼睛遭到母亲的厌弃。
父亲将他像一件廉价商品一样买了回来，利用他来刺激自己的孩子们进行继承人竞争。在残忍的竞争中，唯一对雨果友善的妹妹塞蕾娜成为了牺牲品，而谋害了她的孩子们却把一切罪行推给了雨果，以为这样就可以置他于死地，却没想到父亲竟然赞扬了雨果的行为，认为这才是合格的继承人应该具有的手段。
逃离了家族后，雨果遇到了莱卡恩和老杰克，学到了一些怪盗技巧。老杰克去世后，莱卡恩和雨果共同成立了最初的反舌鸟。

而后，在反舌鸟的某次行动中，雨果遭遇了他的父亲。因为一瞬间的犹豫，雨果没有选择杀死自己的父亲复仇，却因此导致了更多无辜者的死亡。挚友莱卡恩也因为一些误解与他决裂，最终离开反舌鸟。
独自漂泊一段时间后，雨果收留了和妹妹塞蕾娜相似的薇薇安，重组了反舌鸟组织。
1291.descriptionEn:
Hugo calls himself a collector and runs a fairly successful gallery, mingling with the "elite" of New Eridu.
In truth, he's the leader of the phantom thieves syndicate, Mockingbird — and Lycaon's former partner.
Despite his cruel (edgy and dramatic) words, deep down he has his own sense of fairness and justice.

Records suggest that Hugo had a troubled childhood.
As the illegitimate son of the Ravenlocks, a long-established TOPS family, he was rejected by his mother from an early age because of his heterochromatic eyes.
His father bought him back like a cheap commodity, using him to provoke a cutthroat succession battle between his children. In that brutal struggle, the only one kind to Hugo — his sister, Serena — became the first to fall. The ones who orchestrated her death pinned the blame on Hugo, thinking it would destroy him. But to their shock, their father actually praised Hugo's actions, calling them the very traits a worthy heir should possess.
After running away from his family, Hugo met Lycaon and Jack and learned to be a phantom thief. After Jack passed away, Hugo and Lycaon formed Mockingbird together.

Later, during one of Mockingbird's missions, Hugo came face-to-face with his father. In a brief moment of hesitation, he chose not to take his revenge and kill him — an act of mercy that ended up costing the lives of many innocent people. His close friend Lycaon, due to a misunderstanding born from those circumstances, broke ties with him and ultimately left Mockingbird.
After drifting on his own for a while, Hugo met Vivian, a girl who reminded him of his sister Serena. He took her under his wing and reformed the Mockingbird syndicate.

skills.name: 普通攻击：暗渊四重奏
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和冰属性伤害；
招式第四段攻击为射击攻击，射击攻击发动期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，从而发动蓄力射击；
第四段攻击招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to four attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ice DMG.
The fourth attack is a shot. During this attack, hold [Basic Attack] to charge and perform a charged shot.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the fourth attack, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: 普通攻击：暗渊协奏曲
skills.description:
发动[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]第四段后、发动[闪避反击：诡影·斩]的射击攻击后、发动[快速支援：葬歌]的射击攻击后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
扔出镰刀向前方发动斩击，随后发动射击攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
射击攻击期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，从而发动蓄力射击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
After the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet, the shot of Dodge Counter: Phantasm - Slash, or the shot of Quick Assist: Elegy, press or hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Throw the scythe forward to perform a slash, followed by a shot, dealing Ice DMG.
During the shot, hold [Basic Attack] to charge and perform a charged shot.
During this skill, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: 特殊技：魂狩·断罪
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
旋转镰刀后向前方发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Spins the scythe and then unleashes a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：魂狩·惩戒
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
旋转镰刀攻击，随后进行终结一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为非重击；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Spins the scythe to attack and then executes a powerful Finishing Move, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：诡影
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：诡影·破
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突进攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch a dashing attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：诡影·斩
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动射击攻击，射击攻击期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，从而发动蓄力射击；
发动射击攻击视为发动一次普通攻击，伤害视为普通攻击伤害；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式射击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%;
招式斩击期间与射击后撤期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
During the skill, hold [Basic Attack] to launch a shot. During the shot, hold [Basic Attack] to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.

skills.name: 连携技：命运戏法
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
快速突进向前方发动大范围斩击，随后发动射击攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动的射击攻击视为蓄力射击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Dash forward to perform a slash across a large area, then launch a shot, dealing massive Ice DMG.
The shot activated by this skill is considered a charged shot.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：渎神者
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出镰刀对前方敌人发动强力旋转攻击，随后进行终结一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为非重击；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Throws the scythe in a powerful spinning attack, then launches a Finishing Move, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：葬歌
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动射击攻击，射击攻击期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，从而发动蓄力射击；
发动射击攻击视为发动一次普通攻击，伤害视为普通攻击伤害；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式射击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%;
招式斩击期间与射击后撤期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
During the skill, hold [Basic Attack] to launch a shot. During the shot, hold [Basic Attack] to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：死期未至
skills.nameEn: Defensive Assist: The End Has Not Come
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：王牌反转
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进并发动两次斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Dash forward and perform two slashes, dealing Ice DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：终末裁决
skills.description:
[连携技：命运戏法]命中敌人或雨果的攻击使敌人失衡时，雨果获得[暗渊回响]状态，持续6秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，该状态下雨果的暴击率提升12%，暴击伤害提升25%；
队伍中存在其他1/2名[击破]角色时，雨果的攻击力提升25/75点；
[强化特殊技：魂狩·惩戒]或[终结技：渎神者]的终结一击命中敌人时，若敌人处于失衡状态，会对其触发[决算]效果，使得招式的终结一击伤害倍率提升500%，此外[决算]效果会根据触发时敌人剩余的失衡时间，使得该招式伤害倍率进一步提升：敌人失衡时间小于等于5秒的部分，每剩余1秒，招式伤害倍率提升140%，5秒到15秒的部分，每剩余1秒，招式伤害倍率提升50%，总共最多可以提升1700%的招式伤害倍率；
雨果触发[决算]效果后，敌人的失衡状态会立即结束，并且根据[决算]效果触发时该敌人剩余的失衡时间立即累积一定失衡值，失衡时间每剩余1秒，则积累5%失衡值，最多累积等同于敌人失衡值上限25%的失衡值；
[强化特殊技：魂狩·惩戒]命中敌人时，若敌人处于非失衡状态，招式累积的失衡值提升20%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Chain Attack: Trick of Fate hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the Dark Abyss Reverb state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 Stun characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by 25/75.
When the Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment or Ultimate: Blaspheme hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the Totalize effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by 500%. Additionally, the Totalize effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 140%; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 50%. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of 1,700%.
After Hugo triggers the Totalize effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment Totalize is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.

skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment Totalize is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.
