cinema.name: 仇恨之子
cinema.description: [暗渊回响]状态下，触发[决算]效果时招式的暴击率额外提升12%，暴击伤害额外提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When triggering the Totalize effect in the Dark Abyss Reverb state, the skill's CRIT Rate is increased by an additional 12%, and CRIT DMG by 30%.
cinema.story:
「不要否认你的欲望，不要抗拒你的野心。那是你与生俱来的天赋，是命运送给你最好的礼物！」
「承认吧，你的内心埋着一枚火种，它早就迫不及待地想要点燃一场熊熊大火，将一切燃烧殆尽——」
「我就是那颗种子。」

「嗯，我知道。我一直都知道。」
cinema.storyEn:
"So, do not deny your own desires, do not resist your own ambition. This is the talent you were born with, the best gift fate has ever given you!"
"Admit it, deep within your heart lies a spark, yearning to ignite a raging inferno that will burn everything down—"
"And I, am that spark."

"Yeah, I know. I've always known."

cinema.name: 内在小孩
cinema.description: [终结技：渎神者]触发[决算]效果时不会使敌人的失衡状态结束；此外，触发[决算]效果时招式将会无视其15%防御力。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Ultimate: Blaspheme triggers Totalize, it will not end the enemy's Stunned state. Additionally, when Totalize is triggered, the skill will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF.
cinema.story:
「家族是刻在一个人身上永恒不灭的诅咒。」
「无论你成长为何种模样，无论你去往何处，这份诅咒终将如影随形。」
「在你跌入谷底，亦或是爬上巅峰的时候，它总会突然出现，把你变回那个无力的，无能的，只敢躲在衣柜里颤抖哭泣的孩子。」

「除非你真正地看见他，拥抱他。」
有些痛苦只有被看见，被接受，才会消弭。
cinema.storyEn:
"Family is an everlasting, unavoidable curse placed upon a person."
"No matter how much you grow, no matter where you go, that curse will forever follow you like a shadow."
"When you fall to rock bottom or climb to your peak, it will appear, turning you back into that helpless, powerless child who can do nothing but hide in the closet and weep."

"Unless you truly see him, embrace him."
Some pain can only be healed when it is seen and accepted.

cinema.name: 毒树之果
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
他们说，深渊里开出的花必然浸透恶意，就像有毒的树上结不出无毒的果。
但所有果实都会坠落。
于是，他把自己摔成一场破碎的雨。
雨水浸没大地，在每一颗露珠上折射崭新的黎明。
cinema.storyEn:
They say that the flowers that bloom in the abyss are always soaked in malice, just like how a poisonous tree can't bear safe fruit.
But all fruit falls.
So, he broke himself into a rain of shattered pieces.
The rain covered the earth, and each dewdrop reflected a fresh new dawn.

cinema.name: 拟剧论
cinema.description: 蓄力射击命中敌人后，雨果的攻击对该目标无视12%冰属性伤害抗性，持续15秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: After a Charged Shot hits an enemy, Hugo's attacks against that target will ignore 12% of that target's Ice RES for 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
正义，邪恶，疯狂，理智，圆滑，固执。
他由千万重面相组成。
「那么，真正的你在哪里？」
「这不重要。不如由你来告诉我，莱卡恩——」
「你眼里看到的，又是怎样的我？」
cinema.storyEn:
Justice, evil, madness, reason, charm, stubbornness.
He's composed of countless faces.
"So, which is the real you?"
"That's not important. How about, instead, you tell me, Lycaon—"
"What kind of person do you see in me?"

cinema.name: 涅槃
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
世界不需要被毁灭再重建，也没有谁有资格这么做。
但人可以。
所以，他将自己打碎再重生。
「如果必须坠落，就让我坠落。我会成为的那个人，一定会接住我。」
cinema.storyEn:
The world doesn't need to be destroyed and rebuilt, and no one has the right to do such.
But a person can.
So, he shattered himself and was reborn.
"If I must fall, let me fall. The person I am meant to become will surely catch me."

cinema.name: 荆棘王冠
cinema.description: 所有射击攻击命中敌人时，均可触发[暗渊回响]状态，最多持续6秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；此外，任意招式触发[决算]效果时，此次伤害额外提升60%；[强化特殊技：魂狩·惩戒]的终结一击命中非失衡状态下的敌人时也可触发[决算]效果，使得招式的终结一击伤害倍率固定提升1000%。
cinema.descriptionEn: All shooting attacks that hit enemies trigger the Dark Abyss Reverb state, lasting up to 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. Additionally, whenever any skill triggers the Totalize effect, that DMG is further increased by 60%. The Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment also triggers the Totalize effect when hitting an enemy that isn't Stunned, boosting the DMG multiplier of the Finishing Move by a fixed 1,000 %.
cinema.story:
他欣然走向无尽深渊，任由满地荆棘划破伤口。
血色蔓延处，破碎的尊严与执念自创口抽芽。
而他捡起浸满血渍的荆棘，为自己加冕。
「能杀我的人，能救我的人，从来都只有我自己。」
cinema.storyEn:
He walked willingly toward the endless abyss, letting the thorns on the ground tear at his wounds.
Where the blood spread, broken dignity and stubbornness began to sprout from the wounds.
He picked up the blood-soaked thorns to crown himself.
"There's only ever been one person who can kill me or save me... And that is me."

profile.description:
看似是「鬼火」队长在指挥和命令奥菲丝，但实际上，奥菲丝也在另一层意义上微妙地制衡着「鬼火」。
奥菲丝与「鬼火」互相作为「另一个自己」，拥有一些共同的弱点。然而在「鬼火」身上，它们表现得并不十分明显。

备注：即便如此，主人也已经发现了不少被「鬼火」隐藏起来的弱点。在您的火眼金睛面前，一切秘密都无处遁形！
profile.descriptionEn:
It may seem like Captain Magus is the one giving orders and calling the shots, but in truth, Orphie quietly keeps her in check in her own way.
They see each other as reflections of themselves, sharing certain vulnerabilities, though Magus tends to keep hers well concealed.

Note: Even so, you've already uncovered plenty of weaknesses Magus tried to keep hidden. Nothing escapes your keen eyes!

奥菲丝的性格很好，和她在一起，心情会很放松！
不过她的粗神经让「鬼火」遭了不少罪，而且奥菲丝本人似乎没意识到这一点…
profile.descriptionEn:
Orphie has a great personality — being around her really puts you at ease!
But her obliviousness has caused Magus a fair share of grief, and she seems totally unaware of it...

profile.name: 哲的评价

她们俩的相处模式是很有意思。
如果以这一人一枪为主角拍部电影，应该会获得不低的票房。
profile.descriptionEn:
The way those two interact is pretty entertaining.
If someone made a movie starring that girl and her gun, it'd probably do pretty well at the box office.

1301.description:
奥菲丝·马格努森，隶属新艾利都防卫军·黑曜石营·奥波勒斯小队，是枪械形态的智能构造体「鬼火」的持枪人。

「鬼火」是奥波勒斯小队的队长，曾由于旧都陷落事件身受重伤、性命垂危；在参与军方研究计划后，其意识被转移至武器之中，以智能生命的方式得以继续存活。自奥波勒斯小队组建以来，她一直作为灵魂人物发挥着作用，虽然脾气火爆、行事偶有冲动，但深受小队成员的尊敬和信赖。
奥菲丝似乎与「鬼火」有着不一般的关系，两人相识多年，其情谊无法用简单的「搭档」一词形容。「鬼火」时常如同母亲一般关心与教导奥菲丝，而奥菲丝也不遗余力试图回应前者的期待，渴望能够成为如「鬼火」队长般独当一面的军人。

确切来说，奥菲丝有许多「鬼火」并不赞许的兴趣爱好，她喜欢漂亮的甜点、温暖的小动物、外形花哨的玩具，而所有这些在她的队长看来都是过于软弱的东西。不过，「鬼火」虽会在人前毫不松懈地管教奥菲丝，以「士兵」的美德和纪律要求她，私底下又经常打着「休眠模式」的幌子，默许奥菲丝不符合「完美士兵准绳」的出格举动。据这位声明自己「铁面无私」的队长所言，她的行为严格遵循着网络视频「天才少女养成计划」中所提到的育儿经验。
1301.descriptionEn:
Orphie Magnusson serves in the New Eridu Defense Force's Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. She is the wielder of Magus, an Intelligent Construct in gun form.

Magus is the captain of Obol Squad. She was gravely injured during the fall of the old capital and on the brink of death. After taking part in a military research project, her consciousness was transferred into a weapon, allowing her to survive as an Intelligent Construct. Since the squad's formation, she has remained its heart and soul — hot-tempered and impulsive at times, yet deeply respected and trusted by her comrades.
Orphie shares an extraordinary bond with Magus — one that goes far beyond that of just "partners." The two have known each other for years, and Magus often acts like a mother, offering guidance and care. In return, Orphie does everything she can to meet Magus' expectations, aspiring to become a strong, independent soldier like her captain.

Strictly speaking, Orphie enjoys many things Magus disapproves of: fancy desserts, cute animals, and overly decorative toys. Her captain sees them as signs of softness, unfit for a soldier. Still, while Magus enforces discipline in public and imposes the expectations of a perfect soldier, she pretends to be in "sleep mode" just to turn a blind eye to Orphie's less-than-perfect behavior. According to this supposedly "strict and impartial" captain, she's simply following the parenting advice laid out in an online series titled "Raising a Child Prodigy."

skills.name: 普通攻击：高压火枪
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段攻击，随后向前发起强力火刀攻击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, followed by a powerful flame blade strike, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.

skills.name: 特殊技：热血满膛
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前突刺并进行尾巴攻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Thrust forward and perform a tail attack, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：蚀光一闪
skills.description:
队友攻击时自动发动：
进行四次激光追加攻击，造成火属性伤害；
每5秒最多触发一次；
招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
发动招式期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Unleashes 4 laser Aftershock attacks, dealing Fire DMG.
Triggers once per 5s.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：小心脚下
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行激光扫射，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接普通攻击中的强力火刀攻击；
招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a sweeping laser attack forward, dealing Fire DMG.
After using this skill, immediately follow up with the powerful fire blade from the Basic Attack.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：灼红旋涡
skills.description:
位于后台且能量大于等于60点时，队友攻击时自动发动：
向四周进行激光扫射，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When off-field with 60 or more Energy, automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Performs a sweeping laser attack in an area around, dealing Fire DMG.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：蓄热充能
skills.description:
[蓄炎]大于等于100点时，长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
消耗100点[蓄炎]，向前方持续发射激光，造成火属性伤害；
开始喷射时，将触发[快速支援]；
持续喷射一段时间后将会加大火力，使得招式的打断等级大幅提升；
喷射期间受到攻击时，将会招架敌人的攻击，并直接加大火力；
喷射达到最大时间时，自动发动[强化特殊技：燥焰迸射]；
低火力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害减少40%，高火力期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Bottled Heat is greater than or equal to 100, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume 100 Bottled Heat to continuously fire a laser forward, dealing Fire DMG.
When firing begins, triggers Quick Assist.
After continuous firing for a period, firepower increases, greatly boosting the skill's Interrupt Level.
When attacked during firing, will parry enemy attacks and immediately increase firepower.
When maximum firing duration is reached, automatically activates EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption.
During the low firepower phase, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken is reduced by 40%, while character is invulnerable during the high firepower phase.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：燥焰迸射
skills.description:
[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]喷射至最大时间后自动发动：
向前发动旋转攻击，然后向前方发射激光，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Heat Charge reaches maximum firing time:
Performs a spinning attack forward, then fires a laser ahead dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：摇曳火光
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：突袭命令
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前发动快速攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward attack, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：反攻战机
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：枪管过热
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前发动旋转攻击，然后向前方发射激光，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 points of Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：与火共舞
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前发动旋转攻击，然后向前方发射激光，造成火属性伤害;
跃向空中时，将触发[快速支援]，若响应[快速支援]，奥菲丝&「鬼火」会延长激光喷射的持续时间；
招式发动时，回复20点[蓄炎]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Orphie & Magus will extend the laser firing duration.
Upon activating this skill, recover 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：焦痕劈斩
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：炙刃炽铳

前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：沸热穿刺
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多次攻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash multiple attacks against enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.nameEn: Core Passive: Taming Wind and Fire
skills.description:
奥菲丝&「鬼火」的暴击率提升12.5%，[追加攻击]造成的伤害提升42.5%；
奥菲丝&「鬼火」初始获得100点[蓄炎]，最多获得125点；
奥菲丝&「鬼火」处于后台时，若可释放[特殊技：蚀光一闪]且能量大于等于60点时，改为消耗30点能量自动释放[强化特殊技：灼红旋涡];
[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]的激光命中敌人时，使全队角色获得[准星聚焦]效果，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，代理人拥有[准星聚焦]效果时，攻击力提升130点，当奥菲丝&「鬼火」的初始能量自动回复大于等于1.6点时，超过的部分每拥有0.1点初始能量自动回复，攻击力额外提升20点，初始提升与额外提升总共不超过340点，拥有[准星聚焦]的代理人发动[追加攻击]时，将会使自身的[准星聚焦]效果延长4秒，最多延长20秒；
[普通攻击：高压火枪]的火刀攻击、[强化特殊技：小心脚下]、[强化特殊技：灼红旋涡]、[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]、[强化特殊技：燥焰迸射]、[连携技：枪管过热]、[终结技：与火共舞]造成的伤害均视为追加攻击伤害，发动上述招式视为发动[追加攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Orphie & Magus's CRIT Rate increases by 12.5%, and Aftershock DMG increases by 42.5%.
Orphie & Magus initially gain 100 Bottled Heat, up to a maximum of 125.
When Orphie & Magus are off-field, if Special Attack: Corrosive Flash is available and Energy is greater than or equal to 60, consume 30 Energy to automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex instead.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge hits enemies, all squad members gain Zeroed In for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Zeroed In increases Agent ATK by 130. When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. The total increase from both initial and additional ATK increases cannot exceed 340. When an Agent with Zeroed In triggers Aftershock, their Zeroed In duration extends by 4s, up to a maximum extension of 20s.
The fire blade attack from Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption, Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel, and Ultimate: Dance With Fire all count as Aftershock DMG, and using these skills counts as triggering Aftershock.

cinema.name: 豪华猫屋
cinema.description: 奥菲丝&「鬼火」发动[特殊技：蚀光一闪]、[强化特殊技：灼红旋涡]、[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]、[强化特殊技：燥焰迸射]造成的伤害无视15%火属性伤害抗性，且拥有[准星聚焦]的代理人攻击造成的伤害提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's Fire RES, and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.
cinema.story:
奥菲丝的房间角落堆满了为猫猫购买的各类用品：一套供它上下的猫爬架、一张柔软的垫子、一块抓不坏的猫抓板，还有精心挑选的玩具…
「我总是很担心在哨站附近遇到一只无家可归的生病猫猫…如果提前备好这些东西，就可以方便它住在这里…」
「不过营中不能养猫…到时候我肯定会在队长的规定期限内，为它找到善良的主人！」
「但奥菲丝，那些东西都已经在宿舍三年了，还没有遇到过这样的猫！」
cinema.storyEn:
The corners of Orphie's room are filled with all sorts of cat supplies: a cat tree for climbing, a soft cushion, a scratching post that won't break, and carefully selected toys...
"I'm always worried about finding a sick, homeless cat near the outpost... If I have these things ready in advance, it'll be easier for them to stay here..."
"Though we can't keep cats in the camp... I'll definitely find a kind owner for them within the captain's deadline!"
"But Orphie, those things have been in the dorm for three years, and you still haven't found such a cat!"

cinema.name: 怪味食品清单
cinema.description: 奥菲丝&「鬼火」每次发动[追加攻击]时回复65点喧响值，4秒内最多触发一次；奥菲丝&「鬼火」发动[终结技]后，自身的攻击力提升20%，最多持续45秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Orphie & Magus launch an Aftershock, restore 65 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 4s. After Orphie & Magus use their Ultimate, their ATK increases by 20% for up to 45s.
cinema.story:
海葡萄爆米花、樱花蜜桃海鲜粥、麻辣草莓烧豆腐…奥菲丝有时会尝试一些口味奇怪的食物，而它们都被杂乱无章地列在她桌角的愿望清单上。
「虽然好吃的东西很吸引人，但有趣的味道也值得一试嘛！…不过，最好不要有苦味！」
「对了绳匠，要不要尝尝我最爱的激辣草莓椰奶糖？我已经替你剥开包装啦——」
「奥菲丝队员，你的怪癖总有一天会吓走所有朋友！」
cinema.storyEn:
Sea grape popcorn, sakura peach seafood porridge, spicy strawberry braised tofu... Orphie sometimes tries foods with bizarre flavors, all chaotically listed on the list at the corner of her desk.
"While tasty food is tempting, interesting flavors are worth trying too! ...Just as long as they're not bitter!"
"Hey Proxy, wanna try my favorite ultra-spicy strawberry coconut candy? I've already unwrapped it for you—"
"Soldier Orphie, your weird tastes are gonna scare away all your friends one day!"

cinema.name: 《战术手册》
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
摆在少女床头的《战术手册·奥菲丝特别拓展篇》究竟写了些什么，就连「鬼火」队长也不清楚…
「『歼灭·一』、『撤退·三』、『巡逻·二』…对了，还有『约会·五』！」
「等等，奥菲丝，什么时候关于约会的战术对策已经拓展到第五条了？！」
「刚才是想检验一下队长对《战术手册》有没有足够熟悉，嘿嘿！队长过关啦！」
cinema.storyEn:
No one knows what's written in the "Tactics Manual: Orphie's Special Extension" sitting on the young lady's bedside table, not even Captain Magus...
"'Annihilation-1', 'Retreat-3', 'Patrol-2'... Oh, and 'Social Rendezvous-5'!"
"Hold up, Orphie, since when did the tactical strategies for social rendezvous expand to five entries?!"
"I was just testing if you were familiar enough with the Tactics Manual, hehe! You passed, Captain!"

cinema.name: 粉红色枪套
cinema.description: [准星聚焦]的初始时间提高至16秒，且奥菲丝&「鬼火」发动[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]或[终结技：与火共舞]造成的伤害提高40%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Initial duration of Zeroed In increases to 16s, and Orphie & Magus's EX Special Attack: Heat Charge and Ultimate: Dance With Fire DMG increases by 40%.
cinema.story:
「鬼火」从来不会回应虚张声势的威胁，这就是为什么奥菲丝真的买来了一个粉红色的枪套。
它被放在储物柜最底下的抽屉里，时刻提醒着「鬼火」谨言慎行——虽然效果有限。
「队长，我都说了，说话前要三思，不然很容易伤害到别人的！」
「像那些小混蛋，吃我几发子弹怎么了？等等，奥菲丝…奥菲丝队员，我命令你不许给我套上那个粉色的玩意儿！！」
cinema.storyEn:
Magus never responds to empty threats, which is exactly why Orphie actually bought a pink holster.
It sits in the bottom drawer of the storage locker, serving as a constant reminder for Magus to watch her words — though with limited success.
"Captain, I've told you before, think thrice before speaking, or you'll end up hurting others!"
"Those punks deserved those bullets! Wait, Orphie... Squad Member Orphie, I order you to put that horrendously pink thing down!"

cinema.name: 渡河的钱币
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
那枚泛着银色光芒的纪念币，被奥菲丝摆在进门一眼就能看到的地方。
「渡过冥河的那枚银币，到底在哪里呢~」
「不如…定做一套这样的纪念币？采用队章的图案，也作为小队精神的象征。」
「漆黑的火焰中，也能诞生月光的勋章吗…」
「别再说那些让人听不懂的话了，『11号』！不过『扳机』姐的建议很好，背面还可以写上小队所有成员的名字！队长觉得怎么样？」
「批准。」
cinema.storyEn:
It was Orphie who placed the silver, gleaming commemorative coin right at the entrance where anyone could see it.
"Where could that silver coin for crossing the River of the underworld be~"
"How about... making a set of commemorative coins like this? Using the squad emblem as the design, as a symbol of our squad spirit."
"So a badge of moonlight can be born from black flames...?"
"Stop saying things nobody understands, Soldier 11! But Trigger's idea is great! We could even put all the squad members' names on the back! What do you think, Captain?"
"Approved."

cinema.name: 魔法种子
cinema.description: 能量足够时，[普通攻击：高压火枪]的火刀攻击后可点按 【强化特殊技键】 直接衔接[强化特殊技：灼红旋涡]；[普通攻击：高压火枪]的火刀攻击发动时，回复10点[蓄炎]，[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]低火力期间打断等级也会提高；[强化特殊技：蓄热充能]或[终结技]的激光命中敌人时，额外对敌人造成等同于奥菲丝&「鬼火」250%攻击力的火属性伤害，该效果每0.5秒最多触发一次，该伤害视为[强化特殊技]和[追加攻击]伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: With enough energy, after the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex. When the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower is activated, recover 10 Bottled Heat, and the Interrupt Level during the low firepower phase of EX Special Attack: Heat Charge will also increase. When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge or Ultimate hits enemies, it deals additional Fire DMG equal to 250% of Orphie & Magus's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and is counted as EX Special Attack and Aftershock DMG.
cinema.story:
「队长，这颗种子种不出来花。就像奥菲丝一样，无论怎么努力都没有结果…」
「奥菲丝，这是一颗有魔法的种子。它虽然自己无法开花发芽，却能让别的种子长成大树…只要把它带在身边，就会获得好运。」
「它会像队长一样，始终陪着奥菲丝，见证你一点一点成为最优秀的士兵。」
——面对那个用手掌胡乱擦着眼泪、委屈而伤心的小小身影，「鬼火」的枪口流泻出了之前从未有过的温柔嗓音。
cinema.storyEn:
"Captain, this kind of seed won't grow into a flower. Just like me... no matter how hard I try, nothing ever comes of it..."
"Orphie, this is a magic seed. Though it can't bloom or sprout on its own, it helps other seeds grow into mighty trees... Just keep it with you, and it will bring you good fortune."
"Like me, it will always stay by your side, Orphie, watching as you gradually become the finest soldier."
—Facing that tiny figure who clumsily wipes away tears with her palms, her face twisted with hurt and sadness, Magus's voice flowed from her muzzle with a gentleness never heard before.

1311.name: 耀嘉音

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
嘉音对「Random Play」情有独钟。但她的行踪受到各方的高度关注，目前似乎还能以「这是一家提供各种珍稀版本老电影的店铺，嘉音选片的品味那么好，当然会喜欢啊！」这样的借口搪塞过去。但毕竟是丽都第一大明星，如此频繁地出入录像店，十分不利于隐藏身份。

但，谁在乎这种事呢？身份暴露就暴露吧，嘉音不能不来。
思考：创造各种状况撮合嘉音和主人，是获取主人欢心的好方法。
profile.descriptionEn:
Astra is particularly fond of Random Play. However, her whereabouts are closely monitored. For now, it seems she can still use an excuse like, "The store offers rare versions of old movies, and I've got such good taste in movies, so of course I'd love it!" But being the biggest celebrity in Ridu, such frequent visits to a video rental store are not exactly conducive to keeping our identity under wraps.

But, who cares about that! If our identity gets exposed, so be it — Astra can't not come.
Contemplation: Creating various situations to bring Astra and Master together is a great way to win the Master's favor.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JAN 31

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 嘉音又发敲敲给我了——哇！是为《嫉妒》拍的泳装写真！呜呜，这身材也太棒了吧~
profile.descriptionEn: Astra just sent me another message on Knock Knock! It's a swimsuit photoshoot for "Jealous"! Wow, she's got a great body~

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 什么？！为什么我没有…咳，我手机好像坏了。铃，你的借我用一下…
profile.descriptionEn: What?! Why don't I... Ahem, I think my phone is broken. Belle, can I borrow yours for a moment?

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对耀嘉音的印象：
 · 与在聚光灯下的「女王」完全不同，平日里的耀嘉音更接近普通女孩…不过，她有着数倍于普通女孩的好奇心。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Astra Yao:
 · Completely different from The Queen she is under the spotlight, Astra Yao is more like an ordinary girl in her daily life... Though she has a curiosity that far exceeds that of a typical girl.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 对于公司规章之类的事，嘉音似乎不是很在意…她更喜欢偷偷溜上街和粉丝们玩成一片。
profile.descriptionEn: · Astra doesn't seem to care much for things like company rules... She prefers sneaking out to hang out with her fans.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 强势的「女王」和活泼的「女孩」，哪个才是真正的嘉音呢？总觉得她的内心包裹着什么东西，驱使着她成为现在的样子…
profile.descriptionEn: · The imposing Queen and the bubbly girl — which one is the real Astra Yao? I can't help but feel like there's something inside her that drives her to be the way she is now...

1311.description:
耀嘉音是公认的「丽都第一歌姬」，凭借其超凡的嗓音、舞台感染力和创作才华，引领了整个时代的音乐风潮。「如果音乐是灵魂的共鸣，那耀嘉音就是点燃这一切的火花。」某知名乐评人曾如此评价她。

尽管耀眼如斯，嘉音却保持着难得的真诚与纯粹。舞台上，她的歌声直抵人心。这种特质，让她得以拥有庞大的忠实粉丝群「加饭」，当然嘉音的光芒，也离不开经纪人伊芙琳的悉心守护。而舞台之下，似乎只是一个在生活上依赖着伊芙琳，在空洞里依赖着哲和铃的可爱女孩。

「现在挠伊埃斯咯吱窝的话，你会大笑吧？」抱起连接着H.D.D.系统的绳匠，嘉音这样好奇地发问。

似乎格外宠爱伊埃斯。
思考：人类的情感的确是有趣的课题。嘉音究竟是因为伊埃斯爱屋及乌主人，还是因为主人才爱屋及乌伊埃斯，尚且无法判断。
1311.descriptionEn:
Astra Yao is widely regarded as Ridu's most iconic singer. With her extraordinary voice, stage presence, and songwriting talent, she has led the musical trends of an entire era. "If music is the resonance of the soul, then Astra Yao is the spark that ignites it all," said one famous music critic.

As brilliant as she is, Astra remains remarkably sincere and pure. On stage, her voice resonates deeply with the audience, which has allowed her to amass a large and loyal fanbase known as her "Astranauts." Of course, Astra's brilliance wouldn't be possible without the careful protection of her manager, Evelyn. Offstage, she appears to be just a cute, hapless girl who depends on Evelyn in her daily life, and on Wise and Belle in the Hollows.

"If I tickled Eous, would it make you laugh?" Astra asked curiously while lifting the Proxy, who was linked via the HDD system.

She seems to have a particular fondness for Eous.
Contemplation: Human emotions are indeed an interesting subject. It's still hard to determine whether Astra likes Eous because of the owner, or whether she likes the owner because of Eous.

skills.name: 普通攻击：《随想曲》
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成以太伤害；
第三段攻击期间，可长按 【普通攻击键】 进行蓄力，持续聚集敌人，提升攻击范围，释放更加强力的攻击；
其他招式发动后，可长按 【普通攻击键】 直接发动第三段攻击。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.
During the 3rd hit, hold [Basic Attack] to charge, drawing enemies in and expanding the attack range for a stronger attack.
After using other skills, hold [Basic Attack] to initiate the 3rd hit directly.

skills.name: 普通攻击：间奏
skills.description:
[咏叹华彩]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方释放[震音]进行攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Release Tremolo forward to attack, dealing Ether DMG.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

skills.name: 普通攻击：副歌
skills.description:
[咏叹华彩]状态下，触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多道[震音]进行攻击，造成大量以太伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch multiple Tremolo attacks at enemies in front, dealing massive Ether DMG.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：终曲
skills.description:
[咏叹华彩]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方释放[震音]进行攻击，造成以太伤害，并退出[咏叹华彩]状态；
招式发动时，会对自身施加[核心被动：《如歌的行板》]中的增益效果；
能量足够时，会消耗能量追加释放1道[震音]和3枚[音簇]进行攻击，该次[震音]会被视为[强化特殊技]。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Release Tremolo forward to attack, dealing Ether DMG and exit the Idyllic Cadenza state.
Upon activation of the skill, it grants Astra Yao the buff from Core Passive: "Graceful Andante".
With enough Energy, consumes Energy to follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters. This Tremolo attack released is considered an EX Special Attack.

skills.name: 特殊技：《风铃与旧约》
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】  发动：
快速位移，随后释放[震音]造成以太伤害，并进入[咏叹华彩]状态；
发动时若拖曳摇杆，可以向对应方向位移；
发动时可长按 【特殊技键】 进行蓄力，持续聚集敌人，并根据蓄力时长追加释放1~4道[震音]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
快速位移期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly move away, then release Tremolo, dealing Ether DMG, and enter the Idyllic Cadenza state.
During activation, dragging the joystick enables movement in the direction held.
Hold [Special Attack] to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 Tremolos depending on the charge duration.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable when quickly moving away.

skills.name: 咏叹华彩
skills.description:
耀嘉音进入[咏叹华彩]状态后，全队角色造成的伤害提升9%，全队角色暴击伤害提升8.5%;
[咏叹华彩]状态下，耀嘉音无法移动，但可以点按 【普通攻击键】 发动[普通攻击：间奏]，或点按 【闪避键】 发动闪避，触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以发动[普通攻击：副歌]；
状态持续期间，耀嘉音的抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，切换至其他角色后，耀嘉音会继续留在前场，并获得无敌效果，切换回耀嘉音时，则会自动衔接发动[特殊技：《风铃与旧约》]；
状态持续期间，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动[普通攻击：终曲]，或长按 【闪避键】 ，可以退出[咏叹华彩]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
After entering the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG by 9% and CRIT DMG by 8.5%.
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing [Basic Attack] will activate Basic Attack: Interlude, and pressing [Dodge] will activate a dodge. After triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Basic Attack] to activate Basic Attack: Chorus.
While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths".
During this state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate Basic Attack: Finale, exiting the Idyllic Cadenza state, or hold [Dodge] to exit the Idyllic Cadenza state directly.

skills.name: 和弦
skills.description:
每拥有25点能量，耀嘉音将拥有1点[和弦]；
[咏叹华彩]状态下，耀嘉音拥有[和弦]时，能够在以下情况中触发[快速支援]：
· 操作中的角色攻击命中敌人时，3秒内最多触发一次；
· 操作中的角色重击命中敌人时，1秒内最多触发一次；
队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]、[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场时，耀嘉音将消耗25点能量，并追加释放1道[震音]进行攻击，该次[震音]会被视为[强化特殊技]；
触发[快速支援]后，短时间内点按 【切换键】 切换角色，将触发[精准支援]，耀嘉音会额外追加释放3枚[音簇]进行攻击，队伍中其他角色通过[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场时，将直接触发[精准支援]。
skills.descriptionEn:
For every 25 Energy, Astra Yao will have 1 Chord.
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when Astra Yao has Chords, a Quick Assist can be triggered in the following situations:
· When the active character's attack hits an enemy, once per 3s.
· When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, once per 1s.
When other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, Astra Yao will consume 25 Energy and release 1 Tremolo to attack. This Tremolo attack released is considered an EX Special Attack.
After triggering a Quick Assist, quickly press [Switch] to switch characters and trigger a Precise Assist, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 Tone Clusters to attack. When other squad members switch in through a Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, it will automatically trigger a Precise Assist.

skills.name: 闪避：《小华尔兹》
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：《蚀月奏》
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行攻击，造成以太伤害；
发动时若拖曳摇杆，可以向对应方向位移。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Attack ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
When triggered, dragging the joystick allows movement in the corresponding direction.

skills.name: 闪避反击：《折伞华尔兹》
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方敌人发动攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：《微醺协奏》
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
用歌声引导能量轰击，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后，耀嘉音将进入[咏叹华彩]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state.

skills.name: 终结技：《幻想式奏鸣》
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
用歌声引导能量轰击，造成大量以太伤害，并为全队角色回复200点生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后，耀嘉音将进入[咏叹华彩]状态；
招式发动后，下两次发动的[快速支援]，将被替换为[连携技]；
次数耗尽前，全队角色[连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG, and restoring 200 HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state.
After the skill, the next two Quick Assists will be replaced by Chain Attacks.
Before all replacement chances are used up, a Quick Assist is triggered whenever any squad member hits an enemy with a Chain Attack or Ultimate.
skills.levelNote: 显示基础技能等级 1–12；影画带来的额外等级不计入此选择。
skills.levelNoteEn: Base skill levels 1–12; bonus levels from Mindscapes are excluded.

用歌声引导能量轰击，造成大量以太伤害，并为全队角色回复700点生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后，耀嘉音将进入[咏叹华彩]状态；
招式发动后，下两次发动的[快速支援]，将被替换为[连携技]；
次数耗尽前，全队角色[连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
levels.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG, and restoring 700 HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state.
After the skill, the next two Quick Assists will be replaced by Chain Attacks.
Before all replacement chances are used up, a Quick Assist is triggered whenever any squad member hits an enemy with a Chain Attack or Ultimate.

当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方敌人发动攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：《三生初见》

发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发出能量光束，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Release an energy beam forward, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：《如歌的行板》
skills.description: [咏叹华彩]状态下，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]、[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场，耀嘉音消耗能量追加释放[震音]进行攻击时，耀嘉音和入场角色的攻击力提升，提升效果等同于耀嘉音初始攻击力的22%，最高不超过1200点，持续20秒，重复触发时延长持续时间，最多不超过30秒。
skills.descriptionEn: During the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, and if Astra Yao expends Energy to release Tremolo to attack, both Astra Yao and the incoming character's ATK are increased. The increase is equal to 22% of Astra Yao's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,200. The effect lasts for 20s and can be extended up to 30s with repeated triggers.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。

skills.name: 额外能力：《月华乱舞》
skills.description:
队伍中存在[强攻]、[异常]或[命破]角色时触发：
消耗能量发动[精准支援]或[普通攻击：终曲]时，耀嘉音将额外追加释放1道[震音]和3枚[音簇]进行攻击。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Anomaly, or Rupture character:
When Energy is consumed to trigger a Precise Assist or Basic Attack: Finale, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters.

cinema.name: 十二平均律
cinema.description: 耀嘉音攻击命中敌人时，目标的全属性伤害抗性降低6%，最多叠加3层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；进入战场时，耀嘉音立刻获得1000点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；发动[终结技]时，全队角色各自获得1层[庇佑之音]效果，持续60秒，受到敌方攻击时，将消耗[庇佑之音]并获得无敌效果，持续1秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Astra Yao's attack hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 6%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon entering the battlefield, Astra Yao immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. When activating her Ultimate, all squad members gain 1 stack of Song of Protection for 60s. When attacked by an enemy, consume Song of Protection, granting Invulnerability for 1s.
cinema.story:
「老师老师，什么是十二平均律？」
「十二平均律是一种音乐的律式，就像小朋友们要排队队一样，声音也要排队队。」
「那声音肯定也和小朋友一样，不爱排队队！」
——嘉音六岁时的音乐老师，在她成名之后回忆道。
cinema.storyEn:
"What is the 12-tone equal temperament?"
"12-tone equal temperament is a musical tuning system, just like how children have to line up, sounds need to be in order too."
"But sounds probably don't like lining up, just like children!"
—Astra Yao's music teacher, recalling when she was six.

cinema.name: 贪心艺术
cinema.description: [核心被动：《如歌的行板》]中的攻击力提升效果额外提升19%，上限额外提升400点；[咏叹华彩]状态下，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]、[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场时，耀嘉音将额外追加释放1道[震音]和3枚[音簇]进行攻击，3秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: The ATK buff from Core Passive: "Graceful Andante" is further increased by 19%, with an increased maximum of 400. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters to attack. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
cinema.story:
「这个世界上最闪亮的东西，当然是爱！」
像筑巢的小鸟，想要收集亮晶晶的东西。艺术家内心的那份小贪心，就是收集世界上所有的爱吧？只要将所有的爱汇聚在一起，就能创作出最动人的旋律。
cinema.storyEn:
"The shiniest thing in the world is, of course, love!"
Just like a bird gathering shiny things for its nest, an artist's inner greed is probably to gather all the love in the world. By gathering all the love, one can create the most beautiful melody.

cinema.name: 交错五线谱
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
空白的五线谱，是永不相交的平行线，就像未曾相遇的灵魂，静静等待着彼此的旋律交织成曲。
「那就用音符填满它好了！还要很多很多连音符，会是一首很棒的歌吧？」
就这样创作了一首从头到尾用连音符横跨了136小节的新歌…
cinema.storyEn:
A blank musical staff is a set of parallel lines that never intersect, like souls that have never met, quietly waiting for their melodies to intertwine into a song.
"Let's fill it with notes! And lots and lots of tied notes. It'll make a fantastic song!"
And that's how a new song was created, stretching across 136 bars, all connected with ties...

cinema.name: 《后颈的碎发》
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]后，15秒内，耀嘉音未拥有[和弦]时也能够触发[快速支援]，且攻击命中敌人时触发[快速支援]的间隔缩短至1秒；[咏叹华彩]状态下，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]入场时，将根据自身特性获得不同的增益效果，全队3秒内最多触发一次：[强攻]：下一次[快速支援]重击命中敌人时，额外造成等同于耀嘉音300%攻击力的伤害；[异常]：下一次[快速支援]累积的属性异常积蓄值提升50%；[击破]：下一次[快速支援]造成的失衡值提升50%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, within 15s, Astra Yao can trigger a Quick Assist even if she does not have Chords. When the attack hits an enemy, the interval for triggering a Quick Assist is reduced to 1s. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members enter the field via a Quick Assist, they will receive different buffs based on their specialty, and this effect can be triggered once every 3s for the entire squad: Attack: The next Quick Assist heavy attack on an enemy will deal extra DMG equal to 300% of Astra Yao's ATK; Anomaly: The next Quick Assist will have 50% increased Anomaly Buildup; Stun: The next Quick Assist will inflict 50% increased Daze.
cinema.story:
一只手悬在钢琴上
不知该按下哪一个键
是悲伤的小调
还是悠扬的思念？
在音符间寻觅你的影子
闭上眼，就能看到
你后颈的碎发
cinema.storyEn:
One hand hovers over the piano
Not sure which note will bring me peace
A sad minor key
Or gentle melody of longing?
I seek your shadow through the score
I close my eyes, and see you more
Such as the hair upon your nape

cinema.name: 绳匠与丝弦
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「伊芙！我有一个重大发现——伊芙和哲／铃都是长条形的！」
「…这两者的共性是什么？」
「你们都是我最喜欢的人啊！」
嘉音像发现了什么不得了的机密一般，开心而明媚。
cinema.storyEn:
"Eve! I've just realized something huge — both you and Wise / Belle are tall and slim!"
"...And your point being...?"
"You're both my favorite people!"
Astra beamed with joy, as if she had uncovered an earth-shattering secret.

cinema.name: 我们即是世界
cinema.description: 在[咏叹华彩]状态下释放和追加释放的[震音]和[音簇]的伤害倍率提升至原本的200%，暴击率提升80%；触发[精准支援]时，耀嘉音会自动追加发动蓄力完成后的[普通攻击：《随想曲》]第三段攻击，并使该招式的暴击率提升80%，10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, the DMG multiplier for Tremolo and Tone Clusters released or followed up with will increase to 200% of the original, and CRIT Rate is increased by 80%. When triggering a Precise Assist, Astra Yao will automatically follow up with the charged 3rd-hit of Basic Attack: "Capriccio", with a 80% increased CRIT Rate. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
cinema.story:
世界的纷纷扰扰，都是源自人心的孤寂。如果每个人的心都可以得到回音，会不会，这个世界的苦难、悲伤、沉默都可以被统统抹去？
若能用歌声编织起这份连结，是否所有的裂痕都会愈合，所有的痛楚都会化作悠扬的音律，在寂静中响起？那时，整个世界，便不再是任何一座孤岛。
「这首歌，献给这个世界！」
cinema.storyEn:
The turmoil in the world originates from the solitude of the human heart. If everyone's heart was reciprocated, perhaps all the suffering, sadness, and silence in the world would vanish?
If we could weave this connection with song, would all the cracks heal, and all the pain turn into a beautiful melody, filling the silence? At that point, the world would no longer be a lonely island.
"This song is dedicated to the world!"

1321.name: 伊芙琳

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
关于伊芙琳所隶属的「组织」，情报较为匮乏，目前仅知伊芙琳年幼时被纳入「组织」，接受过严苛的训练，习得了在任何环境中都能快速决策与执行任务的技能。虽然这些经历在她身上留下了不少隐秘的伤痕，但也让她拥有了不凡的身手和冷静的头脑。

思考：需要调查「组织」究竟是什么组织。
profile.descriptionEn:
Information about the "organization" Evelyn is affiliated with is scarce. Currently, it is only known that she was brought into the "organization" at a young age, where she underwent harsh training and developed skills to make quick decisions and carry out tasks in any environment. While these experiences have left numerous hidden scars on her, they also gave her remarkable abilities and composure.

Consideration: We need to look into what kind of "organization" it actually is.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: OCT 7

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 伊芙琳好帅哦，真的不能跟嘉音一起出道吗？两个人一起拍写真，好想看！
profile.descriptionEn: Evelyn is so cool! Can't she debut as a celebrity with Astra? I'd love to see them do a photo shoot together!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 真羡慕女孩子，铃就可以很自然地说出这种愿望，我说的话大概会被打吧…
profile.descriptionEn: I really envy you. You can say that so easily, but if I said it, I'd probably get hit...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对伊芙琳的印象：
 · 任何想要靠近嘉音的动作，都逃不过伊芙琳的眼睛…
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Evelyn:
 · Any attempt to get close to Astra doesn't escape Evelyn's watchful eyes...

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 在日复一日的相处中，伊芙琳逐渐放下了深藏的防备。
profile.descriptionEn: · Over the course of their daily interactions, Evelyn has slowly lowered her deep-seated caution.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 她在这个世界上所需要依靠的东西并不多，而我们，正是其中之一。
profile.descriptionEn: · There are few things she depends on in this world, but we are one of them.

1321.description:
伊芙琳是丽都第一歌姬耀嘉音的经纪人兼贴身保镖，以其冷静果断的决策力和专业干练的风格闻名。是嘉音背后无可取代的支柱，「说到商业价值，耀嘉音如果是那个源头的1，那伊芙琳就是跟在后面的全部的0。」某娱乐杂志记者这样评论道。

既能规划周全的行程和代言，又能在各种突发事件中保障嘉音的安全。「想要接近嘉音？要先过伊芙琳 · 舒瓦利耶那一关才行…」尽管工作繁忙，伊芙琳从不显得慌乱。她对细节有着近乎苛刻的要求，无论是嘉音的每一场演出，还是代言产品的品质，都必须经过她的严格把关。但奇怪的是，如此优秀的经纪人，却并不受到其母公司帝高娱乐的信任。

情报：伊芙琳的身份似乎不仅仅是经纪人兼贴身保镖这么简单，背后似乎有一个「组织」。

嘉音的核心加饭群里，嗑这一对CP的人似乎相当多。
1321.descriptionEn:
Evelyn is the manager and personal bodyguard of Ridu's most iconic singer, Astra Yao. Known for her calm, decisive decision-making and professional, efficient style, she's an irreplaceable pillar behind Astra. "In terms of commercial value, if Astra Yao represents the 1, then Evelyn is all the 0s that follow," a reporter from an entertainment magazine stated.

Evelyn is skilled at planning comprehensive schedules and product endorsements, while also ensuring Astra Yao's safety during any unexpected situations. "Want to get close to Astra Yao? You'll have to get past Evelyn Chevalier first..." Though she's always busy with work, Evelyn never seems overwhelmed, and she has an almost obsessive attention to detail, ensuring that every performance and every product endorsement goes through her strict scrutiny. But strangely, such an exceptional manager is not trusted by her parent company, Odeum HAE.

Intel: Evelyn's role seems to go beyond just being a manager and personal bodyguard; there seems to be an "organization" behind her.

It seems a lot of people in Astra Yao's central Astranauts group ship them together.

skills.name: 普通攻击：割弦
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.

skills.name: 被动：绑缚
skills.description:
伊芙琳发动招式对敌人造成伤害时，会累积[燎火]；
伊芙琳消耗[燎火]发动[绞勒式]，或消耗[喧响值]发动[终结技]时，会累积1点[燎索点]；
拥有3点[燎索点]后，伊芙琳下一次发动[绞勒式]时，会消耗所有[燎索点]，并将招式替换为打断等级较弱的[连携技：月辉丝·绊]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate Burning Embers.
When Evelyn consumes Burning Embers to activate Garrote or consumes Decibels to perform an Ultimate, she gains 1 Burning Tether Point.
Once Evelyn has 3 Burning Tether Points, her next use of Garrote will consume all Burning Tether Points to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare.

skills.name: 普通攻击：绞勒式·I型
skills.description:
[燎火]大于等于50%时，长按 【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 发动：
消耗50%[燎火]，使用[月辉丝·弦]进行斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动后，累积1点[燎索点]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Burning Embers is at 50% or higher, hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a slashing attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.name: 普通攻击：绞勒式·II型
skills.description:
[燎火]大于等于50%时，[普通攻击：绞勒式·I型]发动后，继续长按  【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 发动：
消耗50%[燎火]，使用[月辉丝·弦]进行追击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动后，累积1点[燎索点]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Burning Embers is 50% or higher, after using Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form, continue to hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.name: 特殊技：锁系控位
skills.description:
未进入[牵缠禁制]前，点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】  发动：
使用[月辉丝·弦]牵引敌人并突进踢击，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Before entering Binding Seal, press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：束裂式·I型
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form
skills.description:
进入[牵缠禁制]后，点按或长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
以被[牵缠禁制]的目标为中心，牵引周围敌人并引爆，造成火属性伤害，引爆后将退出[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动时，可以闪避敌人的攻击，若成功触发[极限闪避]，将额外累积25%[燎火]；
牵引周围敌人后，点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以取消引爆，直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
After entering Binding Seal, press or hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing Fire DMG. Binding Seal will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers.
After tethering surrounding enemies, press [Basic Attack] to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Basic Attack's 3rd hit.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：束裂式·终型
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
skills.description:
进入[牵缠禁制]后，能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
以被[牵缠禁制]的目标为中心，牵引周围敌人并引爆，造成大量火属性伤害，引爆后将退出[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动时，可以闪避敌人的攻击，若成功触发[极限闪避]，将额外累积25%[燎火]；
牵引周围敌人后，点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以取消引爆，直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After entering Binding Seal and with enough Energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Binding Seal will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press [Basic Attack] to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Basic Attack's 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：弧步
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：穿梭潜袭
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
踢击前方敌人，造成物理伤害；
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：绞缢反制
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
挥动[月辉丝·弦]斩击周围敌人，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Fire DMG;
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：月辉丝·绊
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
使用复数[月辉丝·弦]连续斩击前方范围内敌人并引爆，造成大量火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：月辉丝·弦音
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
使用复数[月辉丝·弦]连续斩击前方范围内敌人并引爆，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，伊芙琳将脱掉风衣，并进入[焰舞觉醒]状态，持续整场战斗，[焰舞觉醒]状态下，伊芙琳消耗[燎索点]发动[连携技：月辉丝·绊]时，将会保留1点[燎索点]；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，累积1点[燎索点]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the Dance of Awakened Fire state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the Dance of Awakened Fire state, when Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Points to activate Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, she will retain 1 point of Burning Tether Point. When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target, entering Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.name: 终结技：月辉丝·弦影
skills.description:
[焰舞觉醒]状态下，喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
使用复数[月辉丝·弦]连续斩击前方范围内敌人并引爆，造成大量火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，累积1点[燎索点]。
skills.descriptionEn:
While under the Dance of Awakened Fire state, and when Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.name: 快速支援：烈锋
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
挥动[月辉丝·弦]斩击周围敌人，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：静默掩护
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：轨迹干涉
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
挥动[月辉丝·弦]进行斩击，随后在前方引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Evelyn slashes with Lunalux Garrote, then triggers an explosion ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：缠丝
skills.description: 进入[牵缠禁制]时，伊芙琳的暴击率提升12.5%，退出[牵缠禁制]后，伊芙琳仍可继续保有增益，持续10秒；在[牵缠禁制]期间切换至其他角色时，伊芙琳将自动衔接[特殊技：束裂式·I型]。
skills.descriptionEn: Upon entering Binding Seal, Evelyn's CRIT Rate increases by 12.5%. After leaving Binding Seal, she retains the buff for 10s. If Evelyn switches to another character while in Binding Seal, she will automatically follow up with Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。

skills.name: 额外能力：潜袭支点
skills.description:
队伍中存在[击破]角色或[支援]角色时触发：
伊芙琳的[连携技]和[终结技]造成的伤害提升30%；当伊芙琳的暴击率大于等于80%时，[连携技：月辉丝·绊]、[终结技：月辉丝·弦音]和[终结技：月辉丝·弦影]的伤害倍率提升至原本的125%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Evelyn's Chain Attack and Ultimate DMG increases by 30%. When Evelyn's CRIT Rate is at or over 80%, the DMG multiplier for her Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre and Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Shadow increases to 125% of the original value.

cinema.name: 织梦
cinema.description: 进入战场时，伊芙琳立刻获得1500点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；敌人进入[牵缠禁制]后，将被施加[禁锢]效果，伊芙琳攻击带有[禁锢]效果的敌人时，无视目标12%防御力；伊芙琳发动[特殊技：束裂式·I型]或[强化特殊技：束裂式·终型]时，会将[禁锢]效果扩散给所有被招式命中的敌人，被扩散的[禁锢]效果持续10秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1,500 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. Enemies affected by Binding Seal will be Bound. When Evelyn attacks Bound enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF. When Evelyn uses Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form or EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form, the Bound effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread Bound effect lasts for 10s.
cinema.story:
远方模糊的光亮，似乎是她编织出的梦，一个无法触碰的未来。那不是为了赎罪，而是对自由的渴求。
「你果然也是想要的吧？真正的生活。」——一位匿名的前同事曾对伊芙琳这样说道。
cinema.storyEn:
The distant, blurred light seemed to be a dream she had crafted, an unreachable future. It wasn't about atonement, but a yearning for freedom.
"You want it too, don't you? A real life." An anonymous former coworker once asked Evelyn.

cinema.name: 赴火之舞
cinema.description: 伊芙琳的攻击力提升15%；伊芙琳发动[普通攻击：绞勒式·I型]或[普通攻击：绞勒式·II型]时，将返还所消耗的[燎火]，25秒内最多触发一次；伊芙琳消耗[燎索点]发动[连携技：月辉丝·绊]时，招式的打断等级提升。
cinema.descriptionEn: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form or Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form, the Burning Embers consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Point to trigger Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.
cinema.story:
「对我来说，那种光是陌生的，我本该避开，可它却穿透了所有防线，像是要提醒我，黑暗之外还有什么值得追寻。」
回忆起第一次见到嘉音的情景，伊芙琳的语气里夹杂着一丝罕见的柔软。
cinema.storyEn:
"To me, that light was unfamiliar, something I should have steered clear of, but it broke through every barrier, as though it was trying to remind me that beyond the darkness, there was something worth chasing."
When Evelyn recalls the first time she met Astra Yao, there's a rare softness in her tone.

cinema.name: 破茧
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
那一刻，她从禁锢中脱身，成为更真实的自己。
绷紧的绳索断裂，曾经的枷锁化作破碎的茧壳。伊芙琳站在新生的边界，冷冽的目光里，一丝柔光若隐若现。
cinema.storyEn: At that moment, she frees herself from her restraints and becomes her truest self. The tightened ropes snap, and the chains turn into a broken cocoon. Evelyn stands at the boundary of rebirth, and in her cold, sharp gaze, there is the flicker of a faint, soft glow.

cinema.name: 命运的弦音
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，伊芙琳立刻获得等同于自身10%生命值上限的护盾，持有该护盾时，伊芙琳的暴击伤害提升40%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
cinema.story:
「伊芙，你知道吗？每次遇到对我的生命而言至关重要的人时，我心里都会『噔噔！』这样响一下~」
伊芙琳叹了口气，示意时间已经不早了，嘉音慌忙拉上礼服的后襟，推门而出。
「…噔噔。」独自留在化妆间的伊芙琳，低声重复了一遍。
cinema.storyEn:
"You know, Eve? Every time I meet someone important to me, my heart goes 'thump-thump!'"
Evelyn sighs, signaling that it was getting late. Astra quickly fastens the back of her gown and rushed out the door.
"Thump thump," Evelyn mutters to herself, left alone in the dressing room.

cinema.name: 丹缕如霞
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
她的丝线，如同被晨曦染成赤红的云霞。
每一次攻击后潇洒地回身，炽焰如霞光般散落。无需言语，伊芙琳早已将守护化为燃烧的光辉。
cinema.storyEn:
Her threads, dyed crimson like the clouds at dawn.
After each attack, she spins elegantly, blazing flames scattering like the morning light. No words are needed — Evelyn's protection has turned into a radiant flame.

cinema.name: 光与影的牵绊
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，伊芙琳将获得[弦影绝锋]，持续20秒；[弦影绝锋]期间，伊芙琳发动[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]命中主要攻击目标时，将额外释放一段[月辉丝·弦]进行追击，对范围内敌人造成等同于伊芙琳375%攻击力的火属性伤害，该伤害会被视为[连携技]伤害，最多触发16次，再次获得[弦影绝锋]时刷新可触发次数。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon launching a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn gains Shadowstring Edge for 20s. During Shadowstring Edge, when Evelyn hits her primary target with a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, she additionally executes a Lunalux Garrote follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG equal to 375% of her ATK to enemies in the area. This DMG is considered Chain Attack DMG and can trigger up to 16 times. Gaining another Shadowstring Edge will refresh the trigger count.
cinema.story:
有光的地方，永远有影。
它无声无息地隐匿，追随着光的轨迹，守护每一次明亮的绽放。
影从不试图夺走光的辉煌，却在每一个转身间，默默填补它未及的角落。
两者从未分离，也无法分离——光因影而完整，影因光而存在。这是一场永无止息的追随，也是一份不可言说的羁绊。
cinema.storyEn:
Where there is light, there will always be shadow.
It silently hides, tracing the light's path, guarding each bright burst. The shadow never tries to steal the light's brilliance, but at every turn, it quietly fills those corners the light cannot reach. The two have never been separated, nor can they be — light is whole because of shadow, and shadow exists because of light. It's an eternal pursuit, an unspeakable connection.

1331.name: 薇薇安

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
薇薇安年幼时曾被称颂会内名为兰登的人收养，并结识了幼年好友蒂娜。
兰登所做的恶事曝光后，蒂娜依旧维护其父兰登，薇薇安逃出称颂会，与之分道扬镳。
薇薇安曾一度自暴自弃，在人生最低谷时，您曾回复过她一条留言，让她又有了重新萌生努力生活的希望。
为尊重薇薇安本人意愿，我无法告知您，具体是哪一则留言。
或许，我无法完全理解人类的情感，但我很肯定，您确实曾为她带去了希望和慰藉。
profile.descriptionEn:
As a child, Vivian was adopted by a man named Landon, a member of the Exaltists, and became close friends with a girl named Dina.
After Landon's crimes were exposed, Dina continued to defend her father, while Vivian broke away from the Exaltists and cut ties with her.
Vivian fell into despair for a while, hitting rock bottom — until you responded to one of her messages. That single reply gave her the hope to start trying again.
Out of respect for Vivian's wishes, I cannot tell you which message it was.
I may not fully understand human emotions, but I am certain you gave her hope and comfort when she needed it most.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: APR 10

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 薇薇安认识的朋友好多，打过工的地方也好多…这和她给人的第一印象完全不同呢！
profile.descriptionEn: Vivian knows so many people and has worked in so many places... Not at all what you'd expect from how she first comes across!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 在知道她是丝琪的前辈时，很多疑问其实已经有答案了…
profile.descriptionEn: Once I found out she was Sjal's senior, a lot of things suddenly made sense...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对薇薇安的印象：
 · 她所处之处，荒谬当道，但爱拯救之。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Vivian:
 · She lives in a world ruled by chaos, yet love is her salvation.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 大多人都活在阴沟中，但她仍愿仰望星空。
profile.descriptionEn: · Though most dwell in darkness, she still chooses to look up at the stars.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 她会给你一个从未有过信仰的人的忠诚。
profile.descriptionEn: · She offers a kind of loyalty only someone without past beliefs could give.

1331.description:
薇薇安是反舌鸟的成员之一，擅长收集各类情报，且拥有多工种技能，包括但不限于烹饪，调饮，翻译，艺术品仿制，电子产品维修…
但据闻，早年间她居无定所，四处漂泊，且被视为「带来灾难的人」，是「不幸」的化身。
她似乎可以通过眼泪预知是否会发生不幸，但此能力并未得到科学证据的佐证。
她是「法厄同」的忠实追随者，自从「法厄同」账号不再在绳网活跃后，她曾试图多方探听您的下落，并且高强度在绳网搜索关于您的蛛丝马迹，但并未有收获，当然，主人，这多亏我为您的网络安全保驾护航。
提议：在未明确其寻找您的真实目的前，不要轻易暴露「法厄同」身份。
如若您已经不小心暴露请记得锁好房门，并穿好睡衣再入睡，根据其过往个人博客发文来看，她很有可能会用过于热情且猛烈的方式，向您表达敬仰之情。
1331.descriptionEn:
Vivian is a member of Mockingbird, skilled in gathering all kinds of intel. She's also a jack of many trades — cooking, mixology, translation, art forgery, electronics repair, and more.
In the past, she apparently wandered without a home and was viewed as one who "brought disaster," almost like a living omen of bad luck.
It's said she can predict incoming misfortune through her tears, though there's no scientific proof of this ability.
A loyal follower of Phaethon. Ever since your original account went inactive on Inter-Knot, she's been trying to track you down — digging for clues, running intense searches across the network. However, Master, she didn't find anything... all thanks to my efforts in keeping your cybersecurity airtight.
Suggestion: Until her true intentions are clear, do not reveal your identity as Phaethon.
In case you've already let your identity slip, be sure to lock your doors and wear proper sleepwear before going to bed. Based on her old blog posts, she's likely to express her admiration in... overly passionate and intense ways.

skills.name: 普通攻击：翎羽拂击
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
发动第四段攻击后进入[淑女礼仪]状态；
拥有[飞羽]时，在第四段攻击过程中保持按住 【普通攻击键】 可进入[裙裾浮游]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
After triggering the fourth attack, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, holding [Basic Attack] during the fourth attack will activate the Fluttering Frock state.

skills.name: 普通攻击：淑女礼仪·舞步
skills.description:
[淑女礼仪]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前突进攻击，造成以太伤害，并在命中目标时回复1点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
若突进期间触发极限闪避，会额外回复1点[飞羽]；
招式发动后若拥有[飞羽]，会进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 取消。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] while in the Noblewoman state to activate:
Dash forward with an attack that deals Ether DMG and restores 1 Flight Feather upon hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered during the dash, gain 1 additional Flight Feather.
If Flight Feathers are available after the skill, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge] when the skill is used.

skills.name: 普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落
skills.description:
[裙裾浮游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动范围攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后消耗全部[飞羽]，每消耗1点[飞羽]，都会获得1点[护羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
在[裙裾浮游]状态下切换角色时，薇薇安会自动发动[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]；
在[裙裾浮游]状态下点按 【闪避键】 可以退出[裙裾浮游]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] while in the Fluttering Frock state to activate:
Attack an area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
After activation, this skill consumes all Flight Feathers, and each one consumed grants 1 Guard Feather.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When switching characters during the Fluttering Frock state, Vivian will automatically perform Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension.
While in the Fluttering Frock state, press [Dodge] to exit the state.

skills.name: 普通攻击：落羽生花
skills.description:
队伍中任意角色发动[强化特殊技]命中目标后，薇薇安会消耗1点[护羽]并对目标发动一次[普通攻击：落羽生花]，造成以太伤害，同一招式最多触发一次，这一效果可以在薇薇安处于后场时触发；
[护羽]最多持有5点。
skills.descriptionEn:
After any squad member hits a target with an EX Special Attack, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Basic Attack: Featherbloom against the target, dealing Ether DMG, triggering at most once per use of a skill. This effect can trigger even while Vivian is off-field.
A maximum of 5 Guard Feathers can be stored.

skills.name: 特殊技：银羽咏叹
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Song of Silver Wings
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速向前方进行攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly attack forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：堇花悼亡
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动强力攻击，造成大量以太伤害，并回复3点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 进入[淑女礼仪]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash a powerful forward attack that deals massive Ether DMG and grants 3 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Enter the Fluttering Frock state after using the skill. Hold [Dodge] during the skill to enter the Noblewoman state.

skills.name: 闪避：流光
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：银刺舞曲
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突刺，造成物理伤害；
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launches a forward thrust at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：羽刃反振
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[淑女礼仪]状态；
拥有[飞羽]时，在招式发动过程中保持按住 【普通攻击键】 可进入[裙裾浮游]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After activating the skill, enter the Noblewoman state.
When there are Flight Feathers available, hold [Basic Attack] during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

skills.name: 闪避：淑女滑步
skills.description:
[淑女礼仪]状态下即将受到攻击时，会进行自动闪避，期间拥有无敌效果，但不会触发[极限闪避]；
每次进入[淑女礼仪]状态仅能触发一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
When in the Noblewoman state and about to be attacked, an automatic dodge will trigger, during which the character will be Invulnerable, but a Perfect Dodge will not be triggered.
This can trigger once each time the Noblewoman state is entered.

skills.name: 连携技：星羽和声
skills.nameEn: Chain Attack: Chorus of Celestial Wings
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力攻击，造成大量以太伤害，并回复2点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 取消。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 2 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge] during the skill.

skills.name: 终结技：飞鸟鸣颂
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力攻击，造成大量以太伤害，并回复5点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 取消。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 5 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill is activated, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge] during the skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：凛羽之护
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[淑女礼仪]状态；
拥有[飞羽]时，在招式发动过程中保持按住 【普通攻击键】 可进入[裙裾浮游]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, hold [Basic Attack] during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

skills.name: 招架支援：银伞列阵
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：裁决羽刃
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动攻击，造成以太伤害，并回复2点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 取消。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch an attack at enemies ahead, dealing Ether DMG and gaining 2 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge] during the skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：命运悲歌
skills.description:
[普通攻击：落羽生花]命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，相对于原属性异常伤害的比例为每10点异常精通3.07%/1.6%/4%/0.37%/0.54%/0.16%；
[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]或[普通攻击：落羽生花]命中处于任意属性异常状态的目标时，使目标陷入[薇薇安的预言]，每0.55秒受到薇薇安55%攻击力的以太伤害，该伤害可以触发属性异常效果的额外伤害；当目标不再处于属性异常状态时，[薇薇安的预言]结束；
进入战场时，薇薇安获得2点[飞羽]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 3.07%/1.6%/4%/0.37%/0.54%/0.16% per 10 points of Anomaly Proficiency of the original Anomaly's DMG.
When Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension or Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering any Attribute Anomaly, apply Vivian's Prophecy to the target, causing the target to take Ether DMG equal to 55% of Vivian's ATK every 0.55s. This DMG can trigger the additional DMG of Attribute Anomalies. When the enemy is no longer suffering an Attribute Anomaly, Vivian's Prophecy expires.
Upon entering the battlefield, Vivian gains 2 Flight Feathers.

[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]或[普通攻击：落羽生花]命中处于任意属性异常状态的目标时，使目标陷入[薇薇安的预言]，每0.55秒受到薇薇安55%攻击力的以太伤害，该伤害可以触发属性异常效果的额外伤害；当目标不再处于属性异常状态时，[薇薇安的预言]结束；
进入战场时，薇薇安获得2点[飞羽]。
levels.descriptionEn:
When Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 6.15%/3.2%/8%/0.75%/1.08%/0.32% per 10 points of Anomaly Proficiency of the original Anomaly's DMG.
When Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension or Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering any Attribute Anomaly, apply Vivian's Prophecy to the target, causing the target to take Ether DMG equal to 55% of Vivian's ATK every 0.55s. This DMG can trigger the additional DMG of Attribute Anomalies. When the enemy is no longer suffering an Attribute Anomaly, Vivian's Prophecy expires.
Upon entering the battlefield, Vivian gains 2 Flight Feathers.

skills.name: 额外能力：预言之泪
skills.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身属性相同的角色时触发：
队伍中其他角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，薇薇安会消耗1点[护羽]并对目标发动一次[普通攻击：落羽生花]，0.5秒内至多触发一次；
全队角色造成的[侵蚀]伤害和[侵蚀]状态被结算的[紊乱]伤害提升12%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same attribute:
Whenever another squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Basic Attack: Featherbloom on the target. This can trigger once every 0.5s.
Corruption DMG dealt by all squad members and the Corruption status' Disorder DMG increases by 12%.

cinema.name: 《在春天走进果园》
cinema.description: 累计消耗4点[护羽]时回复1点[飞羽]；处于[薇薇安的预言]下的目标受到的所有属性异常伤害和[紊乱]伤害提升16%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When a total of 4 Guard Feathers are consumed, gain 1 Flight Feather. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG received by targets under Vivian's Prophecy increases by 16%.
cinema.story:
「每个清晨都是与你的初遇，每个夜晚都是重逢。」
她曾窥得命运无常，无法改变的结局总是被泪水侵染。
但因你的出现，她不愿再成为那预言灾厄的飞鸟，她愿让自己消失在火里，沉眠于光中，用自己的一切改变关于你的结局。
所以，请不要关上窗，飞鸟会为你衔来爱意，衔走死亡。
cinema.storyEn:
"Every morning is like our first encounter, every night a reunion."
She had once seen fate's fickleness, with the inevitable ending always tainted by tears.
She no longer wishes to be the prophetic bird of disaster. She's willing to vanish in the fire, sleep in the light, and change your fate with all she has.
So, please don't close the window; the bird will bring you love and carry away death.

cinema.name: 《暴风雨夜，暴风雨夜》
cinema.description: 薇薇安的以太异常积蓄效率提升25%；[异放]从精通中获得的收益提升至原本的130%，且无视目标15%全属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: Vivian's Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 25%. The benefits of Abloom from Anomaly Proficiency are raised to 130% of the original value, and 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES is ignored.
cinema.story:
「假如我不曾见过太阳 我本可以忍受黑暗。」
救赎者这个词汇太过沉重，好心人这个词又稍显轻率。
所以，不如说，你曾是她的撑船人。
在那场名为恶意与自我懊悔的暴风雨中，你是一束光，引她渡过洪流。
于是那之后，她无法再忍受诅咒与噩梦，她走向追寻你的旅程。
cinema.storyEn:
"If I had never seen the sun, I could have endured the darkness."
The word "savior" feels too heavy, and "good person" seems too light.
So, perhaps it's better to say, you were once her boatman.
In that storm called malice and self-regret, you were a ray of light, guiding her through the flood.
From that moment on, she could no longer bear the curse or the nightmares. She set out on a journey to find you.

cinema.name: 《另一个，同一个》
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「我们用黄昏丈量彼此的阴影，发现完全重叠。」
在你不知道的无数个黄昏里，她曾与你看着同一个太阳西沉，将一片海煮沸至瑰丽暖色。
在无数分岔的路径中，她坚定地选择了走到你身边的方向。
而今天，她终于与你影子相叠。
而今天，夕阳依旧。
cinema.storyEn:
"We measure each other's shadows with the dusk, discovering they completely overlap."
In countless dusks you were unaware of, she watched the same sun set with you, turning the sea into a beautiful warmth.
Amid countless diverging paths, she resolutely chose the one that led to your side.
And today, she finally stands with her shadow overlapping yours.
And today, the sunset remains unchanged.

cinema.name: 《苇间风》
cinema.description: [普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]和[普通攻击：落羽生花]命中时必定暴击，并使薇薇安的攻击力提升12%，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；进入战场时，薇薇安立即获得5点[护羽]。
cinema.descriptionEn:
Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension and Basic Attack: Featherbloom will always CRIT on hit, and they will also increase Vivian's ATK by 12% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When entering the battlefield, Vivian immediately gains 5 Guard Feathers.
cinema.story:
「将我的真心，如月光铺满你脚下的路。」
在追赶你的路上，她已自成穹顶。
她没有如此博爱，拥有的也并不算多。
但为你，只为你，她可倾泻月光，覆盖黑暗，修补裂痕。
你是她唯一的慷慨，是她最大的勇气。
cinema.storyEn:
"I will lay my true heart, like moonlight, to cover the path beneath your feet."
In chasing after you, she has already formed her own sky.
She is not one of vast love, nor does she have much.
But for you, only for you, she can spill moonlight, cover the darkness, and repair the fractures.
You are her only generosity, her greatest bravery.

cinema.name: 《十四行诗》
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「能否将你比作夏日？」
她如飞鸟，带着悸动与期盼从深秋启航，羽翼掠过冬雪，在春日里采衔一枝花，就这么撞入夏日炙阳中。
只因你的眼中藏着千万个太阳，让她永爱烈阳，不惧寒霜侵袭。
cinema.storyEn:
"Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?"
She is like a bird, flying from late autumn with excitement and anticipation, her wings sweeping across the winter snow. In the spring, she picks a flower and flies straight into the scorching sun of summer.
All because your eyes hide a thousand suns, she loves the fierce sunlight and fears no frost.

cinema.name: 《薇薇安》
cinema.description: 薇薇安造成的以太伤害提升40%；[普通攻击：淑女礼仪·舞步]突进期间触发极限闪避、发动[强化特殊技：堇花悼亡]时，均额外回复1点[飞羽]；发动[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]时会消耗全部[护羽]，下落攻击的范围大幅增加，并在命中时触发一次特殊的[异放]，额外消耗的[护羽]会提高此次[异放]结算的额外异常伤害的比例，最多消耗5点[护羽]，使伤害比例提高至原本的5倍。
cinema.descriptionEn: Vivian's Ether DMG increases by 40%. When triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz's dash, or using EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem, gain 1 additional Flight Feather. Launching Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension consumes all Guard Feathers, the downward attack's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of Abloom. Each additional Guard Feather consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomaly DMG dealt by that instance of Abloom, consuming a maximum of 5 Guard Feathers to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.
cinema.story:
「薇薇安是一首只送给你的情诗。」
「我们拥有世界上所有的时间。」
「所以，请允许我把余生写成你的注脚。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Vivian is a love poem written only for you."
"We have all the time in the world."
"So, please allow me to write the rest of my life as your footnotes."
