1341.name: 照

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
照从小生活在一个贫穷困顿又人数众多的家族中，大部分时候，亲情与信任加起来都敌不过一句「谁能带来利益，谁就能有更多食物。」

照的长相讨喜，但也会让人觉得好欺负。在那种弱肉强食的环境中容易被一眼判定为「低价值」的存在。因此在家族中，照被长辈们判定为无法派上用场的人，难逃被轻视和抛弃的命运。直到她遇到了某位来自黑枝的掌权人，她潜藏的能力被一眼发掘了出来。自此，她将家族的过往密封起来，加入了黑枝，立志要展现真正的价值。
「只要你有价值，就能在泥沼中被看见。」
profile.descriptionEn:
Zhao grew up in a large family that was both poor and struggling, where affection and trust never outweighed the rule of survival: "Whoever can bring the most benefit gets more to eat."

She looked sweet and likeable, but that only made others think she was easy prey. In that harsh, predatory environment, people quickly labeled her as "low value." So her elders wrote her off as someone who'd never amount to anything, leaving her to a fate of being dismissed and abandoned. Everything changed when she met a Krampus official who saw her hidden potential instantly. From that moment on, she sealed away her past with her family, joined Krampus, and vowed to prove her true worth.
"Once you have value, you'll be seen even if you're crawling in the mud."

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: OCT 14

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 和小照一起进行调查行动时特别有安全感，就觉得…她和任何人打交道时都不会吃亏。
profile.descriptionEn: I feel especially safe when I'm out investigating with Xiao'Zhao. Like... she's the kind of person who never loses out when dealing with others.

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 大家做出的每个选择，如果小照没有提出异议，那就一定是衡量过得失后，最有尝试价值的选择。
profile.descriptionEn: Whenever the group decides on something and Xiao'Zhao raises no objections, you can bet she's judged the pros and cons and found it worth attempting.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对照的印象：
 · 对于重视价值的小照而言，交易伙伴是一种非常可靠的人际关系。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Zhao:
 · To someone like Xiao'Zhao, who cares deeply about value, a trading partner is a very dependable connection.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 而当伙伴不求回报地提供帮助时，小照则会有些不适应。并非不喜欢伙伴，只是想不出有什么有价值的东西可以拿来完成这桩「交易」。
profile.descriptionEn: · But when a partner offers help without asking for anything in return, Xiao'Zhao gets a bit uncomfortable. It's not that she dislikes them — she just can't figure out what she's supposed to offer back to complete the "transaction."

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 随着这样的伙伴逐渐增加，小照最终明白，被别人喜欢并不是一件坏事，这与自己价值的高低无关。
profile.descriptionEn: · As more partners like that appeared in her life, Xiao'Zhao eventually realized that being liked isn't a bad thing at all, and it has nothing to do with how much value she holds.

1341.description:
照，坎卜斯黑枝的裁决官，早期加入黑枝的精锐成员之一。

外表看起来单纯可爱，其实心思细腻缜密，有原则。重视「价值」与「等价交换」。并非指用金钱来衡量某个单位的价格，而是分析目标的能力与潜力，对其能产生的作用进行更客观与长远的评估。

据说这并不是照进入黑枝之后因为工作原因树立的观念，而是在孩童时代便已萌生的想法。照不仅对他人会做出评估，对自己也是这么要求的。「只有存在价值的人才能被看见。」

虽然不会明显表露，但照对没有缘由的外来善意抱有警惕心。因为这有悖于她「等价交换」的观点，会认为对方是有更深层的目的所以才提供帮助。
因此与照打交道时，建议以实现共同利益为首要考量，如果想要以纯粹的善意与热忱打破她的防备，恐怕需要花费很大的精力。

另有一条无法明确证实的情报：照很喜欢吃蔬菜，并且不喜欢吃肉类食物，但她似乎在假装自己也爱吃肉。
1341.descriptionEn:
Zhao, a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge, was one of the elite members who joined in the early days.

Though she looks innocent and cute on the outside, she's actually sharp-minded, meticulous, and principled. She puts great importance on "value" and "equivalent exchange" — not in the sense of pricing things with money, but in analyzing someone's ability and potential, giving an objective and long-term assessment of the impact they can make.

It's said this mindset didn't come from Zhao's work at Krampus, but had already taken root during her childhood. She evaluates not only others, but herself as well. "Only those with value deserve to be seen."

Though she rarely shows it openly, Zhao remains cautious toward kindness that comes without reason. It conflicts with her belief in "equivalent exchange," and she tends to assume the other person must have a deeper motive for offering help.
As such, when dealing with Zhao, it's best to focus on mutual benefit first. If you want to break through her defenses with sheer sincerity and goodwill, you'll be fighting an uphill battle.

There's also one piece of intel that can't be fully confirmed: Zhao loves vegetables and dislikes meat, but she seems to be pretending she enjoys meat as well.

skills.name: 普通攻击：凛冽裁决
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，第一段造成物理伤害，后四段造成冰属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to five slashes forward, the first dealing Physical DMG, and the following four Ice DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：最终裁决
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
预备后进入蓄力，松开时向前方进行斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
蓄力时，照将累积最多5秒蓄力时长，[普通攻击：最终裁决]、[连携技]或[支援突击]的终结一击命中时，将消耗蓄力时长造成额外伤害，每有1秒蓄力时长，造成照13%最大生命值的额外伤害；
照处于任意[以太帷幕]中时，如果在蓄力中成为非当前操作中角色，可以继续进行蓄力；
招式发动时，如果[霜寒值]满，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，并触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
不为当前操作中角色时，招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive Ice DMG.
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of Basic Attack: Final Verdict, Chain Attack, or Assist Follow-Up hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals 13% of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any Ether Veil, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If Frostbite Points are maxed out when the skill activates, all Frostbite Points are consumed to trigger Ether Veil: Wellspring and a Quick Assist. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

levels.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
预备后进入蓄力，松开时向前方进行斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
蓄力时，照将累积最多5秒蓄力时长，[普通攻击：最终裁决]、[连携技]或[支援突击]的终结一击命中时，将消耗蓄力时长造成额外伤害，每有1秒蓄力时长，造成照15%最大生命值的额外伤害；
照处于任意[以太帷幕]中时，如果在蓄力中成为非当前操作中角色，可以继续进行蓄力；
招式发动时，如果[霜寒值]满，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，并触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
不为当前操作中角色时，招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
levels.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive Ice DMG.
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of Basic Attack: Final Verdict, Chain Attack, or Assist Follow-Up hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals 15% of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any Ether Veil, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If Frostbite Points are maxed out when the skill activates, all Frostbite Points are consumed to trigger Ether Veil: Wellspring and a Quick Assist. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：碎冰溢寒
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗5%当前生命值，使全队角色每秒基于照1.06%最大生命值回复生命值，持续5秒，[特殊技：碎冰溢寒]和[强化特殊技：流霜冻土]的消耗生命效果每30秒最多触发一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to 1.06% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.
skills.levelNote: 显示基础技能等级 1–12；影画带来的额外等级不计入此选择。
skills.levelNoteEn: Base skill levels 1–12; bonus levels from Mindscapes are excluded.

Launches a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to 1.18% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.

levels.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗5%当前生命值，使全队角色每秒基于照1.24%最大生命值回复生命值，持续5秒，[特殊技：碎冰溢寒]和[强化特殊技：流霜冻土]的消耗生命效果每30秒最多触发一次。

skills.name: 强化特殊技：流霜冻土
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方连续发动斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗5%当前生命值，使全队角色每秒基于照1.06%最大生命值回复生命值，持续5秒，[特殊技：碎冰溢寒]和[强化特殊技：流霜冻土]的消耗生命效果每30秒最多触发一次；
招式发动时，积攒20点[霜寒值]，如果[霜寒值]满，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
招式发动时，如果处于任意[以太帷幕]中，将触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launches multiple forward slashes, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to 1.06% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.
Upon activating this skill, gain 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
skills.levelNote: 显示基础技能等级 1–12；影画带来的额外等级不计入此选择。

levels.descriptionEn:

Launches multiple forward slashes, dealing massive Ice DMG.

Upon activating this skill, gain 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ice DMG.

Performs a falling slash ahead, dealing Ice DMG.

When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Zhao has maximum Frostbite Points, and is in combat, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks forward, followed by a slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：查漏补缺

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a falling slash in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Launch multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：最佳同事
skills.description:
照会额外根据初始最大生命值提高暴击率，每1000点初始最大生命值提高0.8%暴击率；
进入战场时，照获得100点[霜寒值]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，[霜寒值]的上限为100点；
当前操作中角色攻击命中敌人时，照积攒6点[霜寒值]，每3秒最多触发一次；
[霜寒值]满时，如果处于接战状态下，将照换入前场可以发动[登场技]；
照发动[登场技]时，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效期间，全队角色最大生命值提升5%，持续40秒，照重复开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
照开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]时，使全队角色的攻击力提升100点，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining 0.8% CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 Frostbite Points. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of Frostbite Points is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 Frostbite Points. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When Frostbite Points are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her Entry Skill.
When Zhao activates her Entry Skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Wellspring ends the existing instance before applying a new Ether Veil: Wellspring.
When Zhao activates Ether Veil: Wellspring, all squad members' ATK increase by 100 for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 Frostbite Points. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When Frostbite Points are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her Entry Skill.
When Zhao activates her Entry Skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Wellspring ends the existing instance before applying a new Ether Veil: Wellspring.
When Zhao activates Ether Veil: Wellspring, all squad members' ATK increase by 550 for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.name: 额外能力：凝聚力
skills.description:
队伍中存在[强攻]或[异常]或[支援]角色时触发：
照处于任意[以太帷幕]中时，使全队造成的伤害提升10%，照的初始最大生命值高于15000点时，每超过400点初始最大生命值，可使增伤效果额外提升1%，初始效果与额外提升最大总共提升至40%，当初始最大生命值达到27000点时，上述增益效果达到最大值。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Anomaly, or Support character:
When Zhao is within any Ether Veil, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10%. If Zhao's initial Max HP exceeds 15,000, every additional 400 initial Max HP increases this DMG bonus by an additional 1%, up to a total maximum increase of 40%. This bonus reaches its maximum when Zhao's initial Max HP reaches 27,000.

cinema.name: 凛然裁决
cinema.description: 照被切换为非当前操作角色时，使全队角色造成的伤害无视目标15%全属性伤害抗性，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.
cinema.story:
「别被那可爱的外表迷惑了！我永远记得那场大会上，她当着几十号人的面挥着手指，用最可爱的样子说出最冷酷的裁决：『以上整改条目如有任何一条不接受，那贵司必将被剔除出TOPS，这不是威胁，是绝对正确的评估。』这个画面我一辈子都忘不掉！…唉，但还是感谢照小姐。」
——接受毁灭式整改后起死回生的某位企业管理者扶着额头，表情复杂地说道。
cinema.storyEn:
"Don't let that cute face fool you! I'll never forget that meeting — right there in front of a few dozen people, she pointed her finger and, with the sweetest expression, delivered the coldest verdict: 'If your company refuses any single item in this rectification list, you will be removed from TOPS. This isn't a threat — it's the objectively correct conclusion.' That image is forever etched in my mind! ...Still, I have to thank Miss Zhao."
—A company manager who revived his business after a brutal restructuring, speaking with a conflicted look as he rubbed his temples.

cinema.name: 黑枝前辈
cinema.description: 照的生命值回复时，提升20%攻击力，并使队伍中其他角色提升15%攻击力，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhao recovers HP, her ATK increases by 20%, and other squad members' ATK increases by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story: 小照在早期就加入了黑枝，哪怕在精锐中的精锐——坎卜斯黑枝中也要被尊称一声「大前辈」，事情本应如此…怎奈后续加入的后辈同事们，都是一些遵循个性远大于遵守规矩的人。
cinema.storyEn: Xiao'Zhao joined Krampus very early on, and even within the elite of the elite, the Krampus Compliance Authority, she's still addressed as "senior." That's how it should be... if only the juniors who came after weren't all the type who value personality over protocol.

cinema.name: 霜婵冰刃
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 小照的武器名为「霜婵」，是TOPS秘密研发项目所提供的实验资产。使用这把武器时，并非单纯地释放冰属性以太造成打击，而是将以太转化为武器本身的一部分。通常状态下，「霜婵」只有同规格武器一半的重量，但在进入战斗状态时，快速凝结的前端冰刃能获得更强的破坏力，这个特性简直是为小照量身定做的。
cinema.storyEn: Xiao'Zhao's weapon, "Frostveil," is an experimental asset supplied through a confidential TOPS research project. Rather than merely projecting Ice-aligned Ether into strikes, the weapon channels Ether into its own structure. Under normal conditions, Frostveil is only half the weight of comparable weapons, but once in combat, its rapidly condensed ice edge gains far greater destructive power. The design might as well have been tailor-made for Xiao'Zhao.

cinema.name: 轻盈踏痕
cinema.description: 照开启[以太帷幕]时，获得250点喧响值；[终结技]、[连携技]和[普通攻击：最终裁决]的暴击伤害提升40%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhao activates an Ether Veil, she gains 250 Decibels. The CRIT DMG of her Ultimate, Chain Attack, and Basic Attack: Final Verdict increase by 40%.
cinema.story: 灵活、轻盈、难以捕捉。这些本是描述小兔子的词汇，正被用来描述一位手持巨刃，无坚不摧的可怕战士…
cinema.storyEn: Agile, light, and hard to pin down. Words once used to describe a little rabbit are now being used to describe a terrifying warrior wielding a massive blade, capable of cutting through anything...

cinema.name: 毛茸茸聆听者
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 如果小照的耳朵不自觉地抖了一下并且微微竖起，说明她听到了最在意的话语。可能是情报、任务、交易…或者夸奖。
cinema.storyEn: If Xiao'Zhao's ears twitch unconsciously and perk up slightly, it means she's heard that which matters to her most. It could be intel, a mission, a deal... or praise.

cinema.name: 无价亦是价值
cinema.nameEn: No Value Has Its Own Value
cinema.description: [核心被动：最佳同事]提高暴击率的效果提升至原本的125%；[普通攻击：最终裁决]累积蓄力时长的额外伤害提升至原本的140%，并使累积的蓄力时长不会在攻击中被消耗。
cinema.descriptionEn: The CRIT Rate buff from Core Passive: Ideal Colleague increases to 125% of the original value. The extra DMG gained from charging during Basic Attack: Final Verdict increases to 140% of the original value, and accumulated charge time is no longer consumed when attacking.
cinema.story:
自儿时起受无数人影响所筑成的观念壁垒，正因与一个人的相遇产生裂隙。
小照对于「价值」的想法有了改变：有些东西没有标价，并非是它无用，而是珍贵到不存在对等的东西能与之交换。
cinema.storyEn:
The wall of beliefs she'd built since childhood, molded by so many people, has begun to crack because of one encounter.
Xiao'Zhao now sees value differently: when something carries no listed price, it isn't useless, it's simply too precious for anything to stand as its equivalent.

1351.name: 波可娜

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
在两个已解散数年的外环雇佣兵团队中找到了波可娜的受雇记录，与其一同受雇的还有一位名为米莱娜的年轻女性，该女性的信息记录于八年前左右完全消失。
同样在八年前，波可娜曾短暂成立过一支小型雇佣兵队伍，并未检索到队伍成员名单与解散原因。此后，波可娜的个人事业突然开始蒸蒸日上起来。
profile.descriptionEn:
Employment records for Pulchra were found for two Outer Ring mercenary groups that disbanded years ago. She was hired alongside a young woman named Milena, but her records completely vanished about eight years ago.
Around eight years ago, Pulchra briefly formed a small mercenary group, but no records were found regarding the team members or the reason for its dissolution. Her personal career suddenly began to take off after this.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JUN 19

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 我觉得她好像也没Fairy评价的那么危险，还挺有亲和力的，毕竟小猫咪能有什么坏心思呢？
profile.descriptionEn: I don't think she's as dangerous as Fairy suggests. She seems pretty approachable. I mean, what harm could a little kitten cause?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 你有这种想法就已经很危险了…啊，她发信息说，帮我弄到想要的游戏限定版了。
profile.descriptionEn: Just having that thought already makes it dangerous... Oh, she sent me a message saying she got me the limited edition of the game I wanted.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对波可娜的印象：
 · 对波可娜来说，敌人或朋友并不重要，它们只是由工作临时决定的角色扮演。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Pulchra:
 · For Pulchra, the distinction between enemies and friends is irrelevant; they're simply temporary roles determined by her current job.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 她似乎对自己利益之外的任何事都毫不在乎，但这会不会只是假象？
profile.descriptionEn: · She seems to care about nothing beyond her own interests, but perhaps it's all just an act?

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 某个人至今仍盘踞在她的回忆里，那是一段美好的往事，还是一场噩梦？
profile.descriptionEn: · Someone still lingers in her memories to this day. Is it a beautiful past, or a nightmare?

1351.description:
波可娜，原外环雇佣兵，现为卡吕冬之子成员，物流公司猪突猛进挂职职位：普通员工。
警告，检测到外环多个机车族阵营和不法帮派与波可娜存在过资金往来，在加入卡吕冬之子后，此类记录有所减少，但来自新艾利都的资金转入记录大量增加，推测是由于波可娜的新身份能更方便地出入新艾利都。
此外有资料表明，波可娜与数起外环重大事件存在间接关联，包括并不限于：帮派火并，车队重要物资情报泄露，道路离奇损毁，重要物资涨价…
波可娜并未与卢修斯有过深的联系，目前也不存在身为其他机车族阵营内应的风险，但她的人际关系极为复杂，建议与其接触时提高警惕，尤其注意保护个人隐私。
1351.descriptionEn:
Pulchra, formerly a mercenary from the Outer Ring, is now a member of the Sons of Calydon. She works as an ordinary employee at the logistics company Leaps and Bounds.
Warning: Financial transactions have been detected between Pulchra and several biker and criminal gangs from the Outer Ring. These records have reduced since joining the Sons of Calydon, but there has been a large increase in funds transferred from New Eridu. This is likely because Pulchra's new position allows for easier access to New Eridu.
Further information indicates Pulchra has indirect involvement in several major events in the Outer Ring, including but not limited to: gang conflicts, leaks of crucial convoy supply intel, mysterious road damage, and price surges of essential goods...
Pulchra does not have deep connections with Lucius, and there is no current risk of her being an insider for any other biker gangs. However, her interpersonal network is highly complicated. Caution is advised when interacting with her, especially in protecting personal privacy.

skills.name: 普通攻击：捷击
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：跃击
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前跃进并发动连续斩击，造成物理伤害；
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Leap forward and unleash a series of slashes, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 特殊技：噬爪
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方快速来回穿刺，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a rapid back-and-forth piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：噬爪·噩梦袭影
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow
skills.description:
波可娜进入[猎步]状态后，队伍中其他操作中的角色的[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]重击命中敌人时触发：
围绕目标敌人，快速来回穿刺，造成物理伤害；
招式发动后，队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动任意攻击命中敌人时，波可娜会重复发动攻击，最多额外触发5次，且最后一次攻击会被替换为更加强力的终结一击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
[特殊技：噬爪·噩梦袭影]为[追加攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
While Pulchra is in the Hunter's Gait state, and when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with a heavy attack from a Special Attack or EX Special Attack:
Dash back-and-forth piercing enemies centered on the target, dealing Physical DMG.
After using this skill, if another active character in the squad hits an enemy, Pulchra will repeat the attack up to 5 additional times, with the final attack being a more powerful Finishing Move.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow is an Aftershock attack.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：噬爪·瞬步
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方多次来回穿刺，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Pierce back and forth times, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：翻正反射
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：先下手为强
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方突进斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward and slash, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：睚眦必报
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突刺并衔接快速斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, then follow up with a swift slash, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：嗨，想不到吧
skills.nameEn: Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方发动蓄力射击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a charged shot forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：噢，游戏时间
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方大范围敌人发动强力射击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleash a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：雇佣合同·保镖业务

当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突刺并衔接快速斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, followed by rapid slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 回避支援：雇佣合同·作战外包

前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：单独计价

向前腾空跃起后开枪射击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时，将消耗1点[支援点数]，使自身进入[猎步]状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Leap forward into the air and fire, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 1 Assist Point to enter the Hunter's Gait state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：猎手本能

skills.descriptionEn: When Pulchra activates an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Hunter's Gait state, increasing the Daze she deals by 15% for 6s. While in the Hunter's Gait state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a Quick Assist from the previous character in the squad.

skills.name: 额外能力：业务搭档
skills.description:
队伍中存在[强攻]或[命破]角色或自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
波可娜发动[特殊技：噬爪·噩梦袭影]、[强化特殊技：噬爪·瞬步]、[支援突击：单独计价]、[连携技：嗨，想不到吧]、[终结技：噢，游戏时间]命中敌人时，将对敌人施加[困迹]效果，持续15秒；被施加[困迹]效果后，所有单位发动[追加攻击]对目标造成的伤害提升30%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character or shares the same Faction:
When Pulchra hits enemies with Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow, EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep, Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing, Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?, or Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?, it applies the Binding Trap effect for 15s. After applying Binding Trap, all units' Aftershock DMG against the target is increased by 30%.

cinema.name: 利己主义
cinema.description: 对被施加[困迹]效果的敌人造成伤害时，自身暴击率提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When dealing DMG to enemies affected by Binding Trap, increase own CRIT Rate by 10%.
cinema.story:
「利己主义是一种本能，但其实也可以在后天习得。」
「如何习得？」
「多吃点亏自然就明白了。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Self-interest is an instinct, but it can also be learned over time."
"How do you learn it?"
"Get burned a few times and you'll figure it out."

cinema.name: 借势而为
cinema.description: 处于[核心被动：猎手本能]的[猎步]状态时，波可娜的攻击力额外提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Hunter's Gait state from Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct, Pulchra's ATK is increased by an additional 10%.
cinema.story:
「一个雇佣兵最重要的素质不是忠诚，而是懂得借势而为。挑选合适的雇主，接下合适的委托，完成分内工作，绝不签长期合同。即使跳槽去对手那边，原雇主也没什么话好说。」
「波可娜，刚才又有人来找你麻烦，被我打发走了。你怎么会得罪这么多人？」
「是感情用事的人太多了。所以你看，他们都是一群拈不清自己斤两的失败者。」
cinema.storyEn:
"A mercenary's most valuable trait isn't loyalty - it's knowing when an opportunity appears. Picking the right employer, taking the right commissions, doing what's required, and never signing long-term contracts. Then even if you switch sides to work for the competition, your former employer can't say a thing."
"Pulchra, someone else came looking for trouble just now. I sent them packing. How did you manage to make so many enemies?"
"Too many people let their emotions get the better of them. See? That's why they're all just losers who don't know their own lack of worth."

cinema.name: 领地意识
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
波可娜居住的卡车车厢门上贴着一张大纸。上面用红色的大字写着：这是我的地盘！进来要敲门！敲门！敲门！
纸下方还贴有一张稍小的纸，上面用黑色的大字写着：凯撒，赔我的锁！10万丁尼！
黑色的大字下还有一行歪歪扭扭的小字：我问过绳匠了，那锁2万！
cinema.storyEn:
There's a large note posted on the door of Pulchra's car. Written in big red letters: THIS IS MY TURF! KNOCK BEFORE ENTERING! KNOCK! KNOCK!
Below it, there's a slightly smaller note with big black letters that reads: Caesar, you'd better pay for breaking my lock! 100,000 Dennies!
Under the black letters, there's a crooked line of small text: I asked Proxy, lock's only worth 20,000!

cinema.name: 狩猎乐趣
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技：噬爪·瞬步]时的能量消耗降低5点。
cinema.descriptionEn: Reduces Energy Cost of activating EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep by 5.
cinema.story:
「挑战强者有什么意思，我又不是自虐狂。对我而言知道自己稳赢的时候，才能体会真正的狩猎乐趣！」
5分钟后。
「这游戏的AI太弱了吧，没劲。」
cinema.storyEn:
"What's the point of challenging strong opponents? I'm not a masochist. For me, the real joy of the hunt comes when I know I'm gonna win!"
5 minutes later...
"Man, this game's AI is way too weak. Boring."

cinema.name: 尾巴游戏
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
波可娜童年最早的模糊回忆，是一条温暖的大尾巴。在她刚学会爬行的时候，最喜欢玩追逐它的游戏。
「后来呢？」
「他们告诉我，那条尾巴就是我自己的。」
但波可娜知道，那条尾巴不是她的。因为除了尾巴游戏，晚上它还会紧紧地包裹住她，度过每一个寒冷的夜晚。可能是空洞把它夺走了，或者是别的什么…哎，无所谓，反正她早就不玩这个游戏了。
cinema.storyEn:
Pulchra's earliest blurry childhood memory was of a warm, big tail. When she first learned to crawl, she loved to chase after it.
"And then what?"
"They tell me it was my own tail."
But Pulchra knew it wasn't hers. Aside from the tail game, at night, it would wrap tightly around her, keeping her warm through each cold night. Maybe the Hollow took it, or maybe something else... But it doesn't matter - she stopped playing that game long ago.

cinema.name: 面具之下
cinema.description: [特殊技：噬爪·噩梦袭影]造成的伤害提升15%，重复攻击的可触发次数额外提升2次；[额外能力：业务搭档]中[困迹]的效果对[追加攻击]以外的伤害类型也会生效。
cinema.descriptionEn: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2. Additional Ability: Business Partner's Binding Trap effect now also applies to all damage types, not just Aftershock DMG.
cinema.story:
覆面式呼吸过滤器挡住了以太粒子和花粉，阻隔了或好奇或畏惧或不怀好意的视线，却让人再也没办法蜷缩起来舒服地睡个好觉了。好想去一个温暖的地方，毫无防备地睡一个午觉…
车厢的门被毫无征兆地推开了，从梦中惊醒的她立刻抓起老搭档扣在脸上，「你们能不能学会敲门？！」
…啊，原来现在她已经可以摘掉它了。
cinema.storyEn:
The respirator mask blocks out Ether particles and pollen, and shields her from curious, fearful, or malicious gazes — but it makes it impossible to curl up and get a good night's sleep. How she longs to find a warm place and take a carefree afternoon nap...
The car door suddenly swings open without warning. Startled awake, she instantly grabs her old partner and straps it to her face. "Would it kill you to knock?!"
...Ah, right. She can actually take it off now.

1361.name: 「扳机」

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
据资料显示，「扳机」原本从属于艾利都防卫军·猫眼石营的里拉小队，该小队的其他成员在旧都陷落中遭遇了全灭，她的眼睛也是在此次灾难中遭遇了侵蚀。「扳机」眼下正与现小队的其他成员共同追查着旧都陷落的真相中。

「扳机」的同伴意识极强，有着为了同伴赴汤蹈火的觉悟。主人，根据对她的行为分析，她正坚定地将您认定为同伴，并对您抱持着明显的高好感度。推测存在某个事件，令您给她留下了极好的印象。

提议：以红豆包不限量供应、全天候提供隔音房间用于口琴吹奏作为条件，尝试与其谈成长期合作。这将使您以最低的支出，收获极其可靠的战力。
profile.descriptionEn:
According to records, Trigger originally served in the Lyre Squad of the Eridu Defense Force, Chrysoberyl Division. The other members of the squad were all killed during the fall of the old capital. Her eyes were also corrupted during this disaster. Trigger is currently working alongside the other members of her new squad to investigate the truth behind the fall of the old capital.

Trigger has a deep sense of loyalty to her companions, willing to go to great lengths for them. Master, from her actions, it is evident that she considers you a companion and has a noticeably high level of affection for you. It is likely that some event has occurred, which has left a strong, positive impression on her.

Suggestion: Offering unlimited red bean buns and round-the-clock access to soundproof rooms for harmonica playing as conditions, try negotiating a long-term partnership. This would enable you to secure extremely dependable combat strength with minimal expenditure.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: APR 21

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 上回独自看家时发烧了，「扳机」突然就出现在店里，体温都没测就确定我烧到了38.6度，照顾了我一下午…她到底是怎么知道的？
profile.descriptionEn: The last time I was alone at home and running a fever, Trigger unexpectedly showed up at the store. Without even checking my temperature, she knew I had a fever of 38.6 and took care of me the whole afternoon... How did she know?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 你是指知道你发烧，还是知道你具体烧到了几度？我也不清楚，但前阵子我在车库崴到脚时她也带着冰袋迅速出现了…
profile.descriptionEn: Are you asking how she knew you had a fever, or how she knew the exact temperature? I'm not sure either, but a little while ago when I sprained my ankle in the parking lot, she showed up with an ice pack almost immediately...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对「扳机」的印象：
 · 得体，温柔，敏锐，可靠，足以概括「扳机」留给人的第一印象。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Trigger:
 · Well-mannered, gentle, perceptive, and dependable — these are the qualities that best sum up the first impression Trigger leaves on people.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 和「扳机」的缘分开始得很早，而她似乎将这段往事视为最珍贵的回忆。
profile.descriptionEn: · Our bond with Trigger started early on, and she appears to view this past experience as her most cherished memory.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 有些过于关心我们的行程，用各种方法制造偶遇…似乎这才是王牌狙击手最真实的一面。
profile.descriptionEn: · She's a bit too invested in our plans, orchestrating random encounters in every way possible... Seems this is the true face of this ace sniper.

1361.description:
「扳机」，新艾利都防卫军·黑曜石营·奥波勒斯小队的狙击手。「扳机」是其于艾利都时期入伍所持有的代号，一直沿用至今。

有着极其特殊的双眼，虽然无法看到绝大部分事物，但在空洞环境下可以清晰辨别一切具备以太波动事物的方位与变化。注意：具备以太波动的事物，泛指生命体、原生以太物质、以太制品以及以骸。

作为广义上的「盲人」，「扳机」将视觉以外的五感锻炼到了极致，因此可以如正常人般活动，甚至敏锐地洞悉周遭环境的一切变化。这使她高度适配狙击手的战术定位，并可胜任潜行、监视、暗杀等一系列隐秘任务。

不同于精准而致命的战斗表现，她的性格相当无害。除了有时会悄无声息地出现在录像店内、对第二助手造成突然的惊吓以外，基本可以认为不存在任何危险性。
1361.descriptionEn:
Trigger is a sniper of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division's Obol Squad. Trigger is the code name she was assigned when enlisting in Eridu, and she's used it ever since.

She has extremely unique eyes. While she cannot see most things, in Hollow environments, she can distinctly identify the position and changes of any entities that emit Ether fluctuations. Note: Such entities include living beings, native Ether substances, Ether products, and Ethereals.

As a visually challenged person in the broadest sense, Trigger has honed her other senses to the utmost, allowing her to move and act as if she could see. She can even detect subtle changes in her environment with precision. This makes her highly adept in the tactical position of a sniper, capable of handling a variety of covert tasks such as stealth, surveillance, and assassination.

In contrast to her precise and deadly combat abilities, her personality makes her seem rather unassuming. Aside from occasionally appearing silently in the video store and giving the Second Assistant a sudden scare, she can generally be considered harmless.

skills.name: 普通攻击：冷膛射击
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的射击，前三段造成物理伤害，第四段造成电属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 shots ahead. The first 3 hits deal Physical DMG, the 4th hit deals Electric DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：无音狙杀
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
「扳机」进入[狙击姿态]，向前方连续射击，造成电属性伤害；
连续射击期间，受到敌方攻击时，「扳机」将自动回避攻击，8秒内最多触发一次；
连续射击期间，可以拖曳摇杆，向左侧/右侧/后方调整身位；
自动回避攻击或在即将受到攻击时调整身位，将触发[极限闪避]，随后自动衔接发动蓄力反击；
松开 【普通攻击键】 后，「扳机」将后撤架枪并发动终结一击，随后退出[狙击姿态]；
蓄力反击和终结一击发动期间拥有无敌效果；
连续射击或蓄力反击命中敌人时，「扳机」将获得25点[绝意]值，[绝意]值上限100点；
终结一击命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，通过这种方式发动的[快速支援]25秒内最多触发一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Trigger enters the Sniper Stance and fires forward continuously, dealing Electric DMG.
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the joystick to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a Perfect Dodge, followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing [Basic Attack], Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit Sniper Stance.
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 Purge, up to a maximum of 100 Purge.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. A Quick Assist can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.

skills.name: 普通攻击：协奏狙杀
skills.description:
「扳机」拥有[绝意]值后，队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]、[特殊技]、[快速支援]命中敌人时触发：
围绕目标敌人，连续发动两次快速射击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗3点[绝意]值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]为[追加攻击]；
全队3秒内最多触发1次[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Trigger has Purge, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, Dash Attack or Quick Assist to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fire two shots at the enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 3 Purge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot is an Aftershock attack.
The squad can trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot once every 3s.

skills.name: 普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱
skills.description:
「扳机」拥有[绝意]值后，队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动[强化特殊技]、[支援突击]、[终结技]重击命中敌人时触发：
围绕目标敌人，连续发动三次快速射击，随后发动终结一击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗5点[绝意]值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
[普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱]为[追加攻击]；
全队同一类型的招式，20秒内最多触发2次[普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱]；
[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]发动期间，触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱]会直接发动。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Trigger has Purge, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a heavy attack from an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, or Ultimate to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fires three shots at the enemy, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 5 Purge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus is an Aftershock attack.
The same skill type can trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus up to 2 times within 20s for the entire squad.
During Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot, Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus will immediately activate instead if triggered.

skills.name: 特殊技：幽闪
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动突进斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：幽闪花葬
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动突进斩击，并在跃起后向地面追加一段强力射击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式命中敌人时，「扳机」将进入[协战状态]，期间队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动任意攻击命中敌人时，即可触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]，无需消耗[绝意]值，且没有冷却时间的限制，持续8秒，可触发4次，重复进入[协战状态]时延长持续时间，并获得可触发次数；最多持续20秒，可触发10次。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

skills.name: 闪避：魂隐
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：怨魂返
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速举枪射击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly lift the gun and fire, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：极魂罚
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
转身回旋并对前方敌人发动快速射击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：冥河之引
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方连续发动强力射击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes continuous powerful shots forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：冥府挽歌
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力射击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式命中敌人时，「扳机」将进入[协战状态]，期间队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动任意攻击命中敌人时，即可触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]，无需消耗[绝意]值，且没有冷却时间的限制，持续12秒，可触发6次，重复进入[协战状态]时延长持续时间，并获得可触发次数；最多持续20秒，可触发10次。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

skills.name: 快速支援：冷枪援护
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
转身回旋并对前方敌人发动快速射击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：死线偏移
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：殛雷穿心
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，随后落地蓄力并追加一段强力射击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, followed by a powerful charged shot after landing, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：破隙幽瞳
skills.description: 「扳机」发动[追加攻击]命中敌人时，目标的失衡易伤倍率提升20%，持续5秒，通过这种途径施加的失衡易伤倍率提升效果，在目标未进入失衡状态时亦可生效。
skills.descriptionEn: When Trigger's Aftershock hits an enemy, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20% for 5s. This Stun DMG Multiplier increase will apply even if the target isn't stunned.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.descriptionEn: When Trigger's Aftershock hits an enemy, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35% for 5s. This Stun DMG Multiplier increase will apply even if the target isn't stunned.

skills.name: 额外能力：灵目银灯
skills.description:
队伍中存在[强攻]角色或与自身属性相同的角色时触发：
「扳机」的暴击率高于40%时，每超过1%暴击率会使自身发动[追加攻击]造成的失衡值提升1.5%，最多提升75%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same attribute:
When Trigger's CRIT Rate exceeds 40%, each 1% CRIT Rate above this threshold increases her Daze dealt by Aftershocks by 1.5%, up to a maximum increase of 75%.

cinema.name: 精准感知
cinema.description: 通过[核心被动：破隙幽瞳]施加的失衡易伤倍率额外提升20%；发动[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]时，触发的冷却时间降低至2秒；在[狙击姿态]下发动连续射击或蓄力反击命中敌人时，获得的[绝意]值提升25%，[绝意]值上限提升至125点。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze is increased by an additional 20%. When activating Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. Purge gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in Sniper Stance increases by 25%. Maximum Purge increases to 125.
cinema.story:
能分辨微风的每一丝变化的听觉，能感知地面的每一次震动的触觉。为了弥补视觉上的缺憾，少女将其余的五感磨练到了极致。
「除了狙击，我别无所长…至少在狙击上，我不想败给任何人。」
cinema.storyEn:
Hearing that can distinguish every subtle change in the wind, touch that can sense every tremor in the ground. To compensate for her visual limitations, the young lady honed her other senses to perfection.
"Being a sniper is the only thing I excel at... At least in this, I refuse to lose to anyone."

cinema.name: 「以太视域」
cinema.description: 发动[追加攻击]时，「扳机」将获得1层[猎眸]；在[狙击姿态]下发动终结一击时，「扳机」将获得2层[猎眸]；每拥有1层[猎眸]，全队角色暴击伤害提升6%，最多叠加4层，持续10秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon using an Aftershock, Trigger gains 1 stack of Hunter's Gaze. When executing a Finishing Move in Sniper Stance, Trigger gains 2 stacks of Hunter's Gaze. Each stack of Hunter's Gaze increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
置身于空洞内时，周围的一切以太波动都将成为她观测空间的助力。
「曾经的我一直觉得这是双充满痛苦的、被诅咒的眼睛。」
「但现在…它们是我达成目标的通行证，更是我不曾忘却往日的证明。」
cinema.storyEn:
When inside the Hollow, every Ether fluctuation around her becomes an aid to her spatial observation.
"I used to think these eyes were cursed, bringing nothing but pain."
"But now... they're my ticket to reaching my goals, and proof that I haven't forgotten my past."

cinema.name: 《归乡》
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
能够归去的家，已经尘封于昨日。
她有些冰凉的双唇抵住口琴，孤寂的旋律是记忆铭刻下的唯一证明。
cinema.storyEn:
The home she could return to is now sealed away in the past.
Her cold lips pressed against the harmonica, the lonely melody the only testament to her memories.

cinema.name: 匿息隐踪
cinema.description: 「扳机」进入或延长[协战状态]后，状态持续期间，队伍中其他角色下一次触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]或[普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱]时，将会在招式命中敌人时触发[断离]效果，额外造成「扳机」200%攻击力的伤害，并累积「扳机」120%冲击力的失衡值；招式具有较高的打断等级。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Trigger enters or extends Coordinated Support, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot or Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus, it will trigger Disconnect upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.
cinema.story:
脚步，呼吸，心跳。扼杀自己的一切气息，直至整个身形完全与环境融为一体。她如神出鬼没的死神一般游走于战场。
而在战场外，由于这种悄无声息的行动方式已经给队友造成了数次惊吓，因此被禁止使用。
当然，找不到见面机会而频繁使用此行动方式在录像店周边观察店内这种事，或许应该大概也是没做过的…吧？
cinema.storyEn:
Footsteps, breaths, heartbeats. She smothers every trace of her own aura until her entire form blends seamlessly with the environment. She moves through the battlefield like a ghostly reaper.
Outside of combat though, this silent way of moving has been strictly forbidden after scaring her teammates one too many times.
Of course, she definitely hasn't been using these stealth tactics to observe the video store when she can't find an opportunity to meet someone there... right?

cinema.name: 锁定的意志
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
一旦锁定目标，哪怕躯体破损腐朽、刺痛力竭，也绝不会将准心挪开。从复仇对象到保护对象，从敌军到同伴均是如此——此为狙击手的意志。
唯有那对在至暗之刻为自己洒下阳光的绳匠。与其说是锁定，不如说是被吸引，哪怕找不到继续注视的理由，也绝不想将准心挪开——此为少女的意志。
cinema.storyEn:
Once a target is locked, even with a broken, decaying body or through excruciating pain, never let your crosshair waver. From the targets of her revenge to those she must protect, from enemies to allies — this is the will of a sniper.
But with the Proxy, the one who gave her light in her darkest hour, it's not about locking in but being drawn in. Even if there's no reason to keep watching, she will never divert her aim — this is the will of a young lady.

cinema.name: 冥河彼岸
cinema.nameEn: Beyond the River of the Dead
cinema.description: 进入战场时，「扳机」可获得5枚[破甲凶弹]，每消耗25点[绝意]值，「扳机」可额外获得1枚[破甲凶弹]，上限5枚；拥有[破甲凶弹]时，「扳机」在[狙击姿态]中命中目标时，将消耗1枚[破甲凶弹]，额外对目标造成「扳机」1200%攻击力的电属性伤害，且[破甲凶弹]造成的伤害额外提升50%，0.2秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 Armor Break Rounds. For every 25 Purge consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional Armor Break Round, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. While possessing Armor Break Rounds, when Trigger hits a target in Sniper Stance, 1 Armor Break Round is consumed to deal additional Electric DMG equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK. Armor Break Round DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.
cinema.story:
「你知道吗？在战斗中沾染血腥之人，死后能去往的地方只有冥界。」
「渡过冥河的彼岸，一定能见到无比美丽的景色。绽放的曼珠沙华簇拥着我，熟悉的故人们陪伴我迎接最后的安宁与归宿。」
「但…因为有你，因为有想守护的事物，或许我还不希望那一天那么早到来。」
cinema.storyEn:
"You know what? Those who are stained with blood in battle can only go to the underworld after death."
"Beyond the river of the dead lies a sight of unparalleled beauty. Flowers bloom all around me, while familiar faces from my past accompany me to my final, peaceful place of rest."
"But... because of you, because I have something to protect, perhaps I don't want that day to come so soon."

1371.name: 仪玄

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
仪玄小时候喜欢和姐姐一起吃叉烧包，只不过在旧都陷落之后一夜之间对其失去了兴趣，从那之后便很少吃过了。

云岿山的弟子们并不知道这件事，只是觉得师父有些挑食而已。

当然，这件事最好对其他人保密。许多往事和执念，就让它们随着时间慢慢消逝吧。
profile.descriptionEn:
When Yixuan was young, she loved eating char siu buns with her sister. but after the fall of the old capital, she lost all interest in them overnight and hasn't eaten them much since.

The disciples of Yunkui Summit are unaware of this, and just think their master is a bit picky.

Naturally, it's best to keep this a secret. Some memories and attachments should just be left to fade away with time.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: DEC 3

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 师父看起来总是比较随性，好像没有什么执念和想法。也许她四处游历给人算卦的时候，见过了太多人的喜怒哀乐，命运波折了吧。
profile.descriptionEn: Shifu always seems quite laid-back, as if she doesn't have any strong attachments or opinions. Perhaps, through her travels and divinations, she's seen too many people's joys, sorrows, and struggles, and fate has taken its toll on her.

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 师父既然能起卦算命，恐怕很多事对她而言就失去了惊喜和未知，一切变化都能被精准预料。可能这就是她平日里波澜不惊，无欲无求的原因吧。
profile.descriptionEn: Since Shifu can do divinations and tell fortunes, many things must no longer surprise her. Every change can be predicted with precision. Perhaps that's why she remains so calm and indifferent, with no desires or demands.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对仪玄的印象：
 · 既无牵挂，何不随心而行？
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Yixuan:
 · With no burdens, why not just do as you please?

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 一切命途波折，最终只会指向本应该有的结局。
profile.descriptionEn: · All the twists and turns of fate will ultimately lead to the conclusion that was always meant to be.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 最为珍重的事，更要深埋心底，切不可表露心迹。
profile.descriptionEn: · The things you hold most dear should remain deep in your heart, and you must never let your true emotions show.

1371.description:
仪玄是云岿山第十三代门主，也是被市长梅弗劳尔亲自认可的虚狩级调查员。

她曾经是一名孤儿，自小与姐姐一同流浪。后来两人被当时的云岿山门主收留，成为弟子学习术法。在此期间，仪玄展现出了极高的天赋。无论何种术法，她总能以极快的速度掌握，不仅能够融会贯通，还能创造出属于自己的特殊术法。而「青溟鸟」则是她和姐姐合作研发的特殊术法之一，在各种困难和险境中，辅助她消灭敌人，铲除邪祟。在成为门主之后，她接受了梅弗劳尔市长的邀请，以合作的方式加入了空洞调查协会，成为了特遣调查员。

自成为门主之后，仪玄也招收了不少颇有天赋的徒弟，继续延续云岿山的传承。可怎奈她行事风格颇为随意，很多时候即使是言传身教，弟子们也只能用「揣测」的方式，了解师父的本意究竟是什么…不过仪玄对此并不感到苦恼，毕竟对她而言，所谓的「正道」从来没有什么标准答案。让弟子们各自寻找到属于自己的「正道」，这才是她想传授的真意。当然，如果徒弟们能够自己领悟，自己学习自然最好。作为师父，只需要顺其自然而已。
1371.descriptionEn:
Yixuan is the 13th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit and a Void Hunter-level investigator, officially recognized by Mayor Mayflower.

She was once an orphan, wandering the world with her sister from a young age. Later, the then-High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit took them in, and they became disciples, learning the craft of Yunkui Summit. During this time, Yixuan demonstrated exceptional talent. No matter the technique, she would quickly master it, not only understanding it thoroughly but also creating her own unique techniques. The Qingming Bird was one of the special techniques she and her sister developed together, which helped her eliminate enemies and banish evil spirits in various difficult and dangerous situations. After becoming the sect's High Preceptor, she accepted an invitation from Mayor Mayflower and joined the Hollow Investigative Association as a partnered special investigator.

After becoming High Preceptor, Yixuan took in many talented disciples to continue Yunkui Summit's lineage. However, her approach is rather casual, and often, even when teaching by example, her disciples can only guess her intentions... Yet, Yixuan isn't troubled by this, as she believes there's no standard answer to the so-called "right path." What matters to her is that her disciples find their own "right path." Of course, if they can understand and learn on their own, that's even better. As their Shifu, she simply lets things unfold naturally.

skills.name: 普通攻击：霄云劲
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成玄墨伤害，
招式第三段与第四段期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five attacks forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
This skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

skills.name: 普通攻击：墨影凝云
skills.description:
长按 【闪避键】 发动：
展开大太极阵，造成玄墨伤害；
招式结束时自动释放[普通攻击：霄云劲]第五段攻击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Dodge] to activate:
Deploy a Grand Tai Chi Formation, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, automatically launch the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: 普通攻击：玄墨极阵
skills.description:
拥有[玄墨值]时在[闪避：清霄同游]招式期间点按 【普通攻击键】 或拥有[玄墨值]时长按 【闪避键】 发动：
展开阵法，持续造成玄墨伤害；
招式结束时自动释放[普通攻击：青溟震击]；
动作持续引导期间，持续回复闪能，每秒回复7点，最多3秒；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果且进入极限视域状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
While possessing an Auric Ink Point: tap [Basic Attack] during Dodge: Nimbus Step, or hold [Dodge] to activate:
Deploy an array, continuously dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, it automatically triggers Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption.
While channeling, continuously recover Adrenaline, recovering 7/s, for up to 3s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, and enters the Vital View state.

skills.name: 普通攻击：青溟震击
skills.description:
发动[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]达到最大时长自动释放：
张开翅膀发动爆炸攻击，造成大量玄墨伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Automatically activates when Basic Attack: Auric Array reaches the max duration:
Spreads her wings to launch an explosive attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：烬影诀
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速后撤后向前方发动攻击，造成玄墨伤害；
后撤期间可触发极限闪避效果，但不能衔接闪避反击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Swiftly retreat, then attack forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
While retreating, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Dodge Counter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：墨痕化形
skills.description:
闪能足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
持续蓄力，松开 【强化特殊技键】 时发动翅膀上挑攻击，造成大量玄墨伤害；
蓄力期间，若受到敌人攻击，则可自动格挡并触发翅膀上挑攻击；
蓄力开始瞬间受到敌人攻击时，可触发完美格挡效果，免疫该次伤害，提高招式的打断等级至与重招架支援一致，回复10点闪能；
翅膀上挑攻击命中出现红色闪光或黄色闪光的敌人时，也可触发完美格挡效果，免疫该次伤害，提高招式的打断等级至与重招架支援一致，回复10点闪能；
完美格挡效果每0.5秒最多触发一次；
若蓄力至闪光或触发完美格挡效果，则翅膀上挑攻击后可额外追加符箓攻击；
招式发动后，可点按 【特殊技键】 发动[强化特殊技：霄云迅击-破]；
发动[强化特殊技：霄云迅击-破]后，若闪能足够，可点按 【强化特殊技键】 额外消耗20点闪能发动[强化特殊技：青溟震击-破]；
[强化特殊技：青溟震击-破]发动后，若[玄墨值]足够，长按 【闪避键】 可快速衔接[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]；
翅膀上挑攻击时拥有无敌效果，蓄力期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Charge continuously, and release [EX Special Attack] to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press [Special Attack] to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：凝云术
skills.description:
闪能足够时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
持续蓄力，在敌人身边引导能量汇聚，持续造成伤害，最多持续2秒，造成大量玄墨伤害；
蓄力至最长时间或提前中断后，自动释放[强化特殊技：墨烬影消]；
招式发动瞬间可触发极限闪避，触发极限闪避后可进入极限视域；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Continuously charge up, channeling energy around enemies to deal DMG over time, up to a max of 2s, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Once fully charged or if interrupted, automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows.
At the moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered. After the Perfect Dodge, enter the Vital View state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：墨烬影消
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows
skills.description:
[强化特殊技：凝云术]过程中自动发动：
能量球出现与收缩时，均会造成玄墨伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Triggers automatically during EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper:
When the energy orb appears and contracts, it deals Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：隐云身法
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：凌云破
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突进攻击，造成玄墨伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch a forward rush attack, dealing Auric Ink DMG.

skills.name: 闪避：清霄同游
skills.description:
拖曳摇杆时长按 【闪避键】 发动：
进入可高速移动的[轻身]状态，当处于勘域模式中，在[轻身]状态下可自动收集一定范围内的物资收集点；
在[轻身]状态下使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下；
发动招式瞬间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When dragging the joystick, hold [Dodge] to activate:
Enter a high‐speed Light as Air state. While in the Light as Air state in Investigation Zone Mode, automatically collect from all resource pickup points within range.
While in the Light as Air state, use the joystick to steer. Release the joystick to stop.
Character is invulnerable at the moment this skill activates.

skills.name: 闪避反击：除祟一击
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击，造成玄墨伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：玄墨迅击
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
快速突进向前发动攻击，随后进行展翅爆炸，造成大量玄墨伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Rapidly dash forward and attack, followed by an explosive wing burst, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：青溟云影
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
持续发动羽翼攻击，随后引导万千符箓进行攻击，造成大量玄墨伤害；
释放招式时，仪玄会平均分配队伍中角色的生命值；
招式发动后，若[玄墨值]足够，长按 【闪避键】 可快速衔接[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a barrage of wing attacks, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：符法千重
skills.description:
[术法值]足够时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
消耗120点[术法值]，张开羽翼，随后引导万千符箓进行攻击，造成大量玄墨伤害；
[术法值]与[喧响值]同时足够时，优先释放该招式；
招式发动后，若[玄墨值]足够，长按 【闪避键】 可快速衔接[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]；
释放招式时，仪玄会平均分配队伍中角色的生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Technique Points, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Consumes 120 Technique Points to spread her wings, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
With both enough Technique Points and Decibels, this skill triggers with priority.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：流云影身
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击，造成玄墨伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：清霄劲
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：霄云迅击
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进并发动攻击，造成玄墨伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：术法宗师
skills.description:
仪玄会额外根据自身最大生命值提高贯穿力，每1点最大生命值将提高0.1点贯穿力；
仪玄发动招式造成的玄墨伤害均为贯穿伤害，无视敌人防御，使用贯穿力作为招式伤害倍率；
仪玄累积玄墨异常积蓄值时，具有独立的属性异常积蓄槽，触发属性异常效果时，额外回复10点闪能，每10秒最多触发一次；
仪玄进入战斗时即可恢复全部闪能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，触发极限闪避时额外回复5点闪能，每1秒最多触发一次；
消耗闪能时，仪玄会积累[术法值]，每消耗一点闪能，积累0.667点[术法值]，[术法值]足够时，可额外释放终结技：[终结技：符法千重]，[术法值]上限为120点；
仪玄施展[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]、[普通攻击：青溟震击]、[强化特殊技]、[支援突击]、[连携技]、[终结技]造成的伤害提升30%；
释放[终结技：符法千重]后，仪玄获得一点[玄墨值]，仪玄可消耗一点[玄墨值]，释放[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Auric Ink DMG Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by 30%.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
