skills.name: 额外能力：玄墨暗涌
skills.description:
队伍中存在[击破]角色或[支援]角色或[防护]角色时触发：
队友释放终结技时，仪玄持续回复2点闪能，持续10秒；仪玄被极限支援换下场时，仪玄会自动追加一道落雷，造成等同于仪玄225%贯穿力的伤害并额外回复5点闪能；
[强化特殊技：凝云术]与[强化特殊技：墨烬影消]命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，伤害提升30%；
发动[终结技]后，仪玄进入[凝神]状态，[凝神]状态下，仪玄的暴击伤害提升40%，持续15秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun, Support, or Defense character:
When a fellow squad member uses an Ultimate, Yixuan continuously recovers 2 Adrenaline for 10s. If Yixuan is switched out by a Perfect Assist, she automatically follows up with a lightning strike attack, dealing DMG equal to 225% of her Sheer Force and restoring an additional 5 Adrenaline.
EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows deal 30% increased DMG to Stunned enemies.
After activating her Ultimate, Yixuan enters the Meditation state, increasing her CRIT DMG by 40% for 15s.

cinema.name: 清灵道心
cinema.description: 进入战场时，暴击率提升10%，立即获得120点[术法值]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；队伍中任意角色命中敌人时，仪玄会自动追加一道落雷，造成等同于仪玄50%贯穿力的伤害并额外回复5点闪能，6秒内最多追加一次落雷。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering combat, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 Technique Points. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.
cinema.story:
「命运多变，前路难测，守恒不变的唯有清灵心境而已。纵使沧海桑田，依旧无悔。」
「术法万千，其本质不变；歧路难行，唯心志不改。」
「无论身处何等险境，遭逢何种强敌，皆可随机应变，以平常心应敌。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Fate is ever-changing and the path ahead uncertain. Only a pure, peaceful spirit holds firm. Even through the tides of time, I harbor no regrets."
"The mystic arts take a thousand forms, yet its core stays the same; the road may fork and falter, but the spirit stays steadfast."
"No matter the peril you face or the foe you meet, improvise as needed and face them with composure."

cinema.name: 消灾渡厄
cinema.description: [终结技]或[强化特殊技]造成伤害时，无视目标15%以太伤害抗性；发动[终结技：青溟云影]时，使所有处于失衡状态的敌人失衡持续时间提升3秒，敌人在一次失衡期间内只会受到一次该效果，且同类效果不可叠加；此外，发动[终结技：符法千重]时，获得一层[聚墨]效果，发动[普通攻击：青溟震击]、[强化特殊技：墨烬影消]后点按普通攻击键，发动[强化特殊技：青溟震击-破]后点按特殊技键，可消耗一层[聚墨]发动[强化特殊技：符法千重-破]，最多造成等同于1200%贯穿力的伤害，[聚墨]效果最多维持一层。
cinema.descriptionEn: When an Ultimate or EX Special Attack deals DMG, it ignores 15% of the target's Ether RES. Triggering Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade extends all enemies' Stunned state by 3s. In a single Stun state duration, enemies can only have this effect applied once, and it does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, when using Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, gain one stack of the Condensed Ink effect. After Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption or EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows, press the Basic Attack button, or after EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break, press the Special Attack button to consume one stack of Condensed Ink and launch EX Special Attack: Endless Talisman Suppression - Break, dealing DMG up to 1,200% of Sheer Force. Only one stack of Condensed Ink can be held at a time.
cinema.story:
「世事难测，即使是卜算者也只能知其一二。」
「所谓消灾祈福，只不过是因势象形，趋利避害而已。」
「若能通晓避祸之术，便自然也能做到加祸于敌…只需将对方未曾遭逢的劫数，提前招来而已。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Life's twists are unpredictable — at best, the diviner discerns but a fraction."
"Dispelling misfortune and blessing rituals are merely reading the signs to pursue gain and avoid peril."
"Once you understand how to sidestep misfortune, you can just as easily cast it upon your foe... just call forth the calamity they've yet to face."

cinema.name: 阴阳相生
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「万事万物皆有其相生相克之道，若能窥见其中真谛，则可阴阳相生，克敌制胜。」
「以简单的技巧达到最佳效果，这不是走捷径，而是顺势引导的结果。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Everything in the world follows laws of mutual generation and restraint; by understanding that principle, you can balance yin and yang to overpower your foes."
"Achieving optimal results with simple techniques isn't cutting corners, but a natural result of following the flow."

cinema.name: 术道归一
cinema.description: 发动[终结技]时，获得一层[静心]效果，最多拥有2层；每有一层[静心]效果，下一次[强化特殊技：凝云术]和[强化特殊技：墨烬影消]造成的伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Activating an  Ultimate grants one stack of Tranquility, up to a max of 2 stacks. For each stack of Tranquility, the next EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper DMG and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows DMG increase by 30%.
cinema.story:
「正所谓百变不离其中，学习术法不可拘泥于形，更需通晓其意。」
「若能领悟其中真谛，则一招一式，皆可相互转化，此所谓术法之道，万变归一。」
cinema.storyEn:
"It's said that countless transformations arise from a single principle. In studying the mystic arts, one must not be bound by forms but must grasp their underlying meaning."
"If you can perceive the core principles, each technique flows into another. Such is the path of the mystic: infinite forms converge into unity."

cinema.name: 静观流云
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「若要修习术法，除去勤学善思之外，更要懂得保持灵台清明，闲时听风，静时观云。」
「进入物我两忘的境地，不知不觉间对以太的掌握便能愈发精进。」
「长此以往，无论遇到何事，都能稳住心性，以不变应万变。」
cinema.storyEn:
"To master the mystic arts, diligent study and reflection are but the start — you must learn to maintain a pure mind, listening to the wind and watching the clouds."
"When you transcend self and world, your command of Ether grows ever stronger, almost without effort."
"As you persist, you'll be able to maintain inner poise through any trial, meeting any change with unshakable calm."

cinema.name: 动静相宜
cinema.description: 发动[终结技：青溟云影]后，获得一层[调息]效果，[调息]状态下，可无视[术法值]发动一次[终结技：符法千重]，发动[终结技：符法千重]后[调息]状态结束，该效果每30秒最多获得一次，[调息]效果最多维持一层；此外，[凝神]状态下，仪玄的贯穿伤害提高20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After using Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade, gain a stack of the Regulated Breathing effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the Technique Point cost to launch Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression once. The Regulated Breathing effect ends after Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of Regulated Breathing can be held. Additionally, while in the Meditation state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.
cinema.story:
「以静制动，动静相宜。而动中有静，静中亦有动。」
「无论何时，只要守得灵台清明，就能以不变应万变，抓住时机一招致胜。」
「你…学会了吗？」
「就算没有学会也无妨…静静领悟之后，总有那一刻会突然顿悟。这，也是另一种『动静相宜』。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Tranquility to govern force, motion and calm coexist. In every movement there lies a pause, and in every pause a potential for energy."
"At any moment, if your mind remains clear, you can meet endless change with unchanging focus — and strike for victory at just the right moment."
"Do you understand?"
"If not, that's okay... after silent contemplation, there comes that instant of awakening. This is yet another expression of 'swift yet still.'"

skillCultivationRecommendation.label: 技能培养建议分组
skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.

icon.note: Existing local portrait asset; not downloaded from Gachabase.

1381.name: 零号·安比

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
另有小道消息称，安比是妮可在旧都附近的废墟中「捡到」的。因为看上了她不知从何而来的强大战力。
「才不是因为看她厉害！我收留她是因为我人好~」——by妮可
根据安比的日常行为和战斗表现分析推测，她的身上存在一定军事训练的痕迹。
考虑到其履历中的可疑空白，建议：对此人保持一定程度的警惕。
profile.descriptionEn:
Rumors suggest Nicole found Anby near the ruins of the old capital and took her in because she was impressed by her formidable combat abilities.
"It's not because she's strong! I took her in because I'm kind~" — Nicole
Anby's behavior and combat performance suggest she has had military training.
Due to the suspicious gaps in her history, it's advised to maintain a certain level of vigilance towards her.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: FEB 20

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
安比经常来录像店借影片呢，而且每次还得都很快，看起来阅片量很大啊。
有危机感了吗，哥哥？身为录像店店长，我们的阅片量要是不如客人，那可就太丢脸了。
profile.descriptionEn:
Anby often comes to the video store to borrow movies and returns them quickly, so she seems to watch a lot of movies.
Feelin' the pressure, bro? As the manager of the video rental store, it'd be embarrassing if the amount of movies we watch falls behind our customers.

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 说实话，我最好奇的是安比的歌单。因为她一直戴着耳机…到底是在听什么呢？
profile.descriptionEn: Honestly, I'm most curious about Anby's playlist. She's got her headphones on constantly... but what exactly is she listening to?

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对安比的印象：
 · 作为唯一担忧狡兔屋财政的人，安比操碎了心
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Anby:
 · As the only one who's worried about the Cunning Hares' finances, Anby really has it hard.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 电影或许才是安比真正的生活…
profile.descriptionEn: · Maybe movies are Anby's real life...

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 「喜欢电影的不会是坏人」，安比也一样
profile.descriptionEn: · "Movie Lovers Can't be Bad Guys" — Just like Anby

1381.description:
安比，狡兔屋成立最初的雇员（没有之一）。
根据新艾利都居民档案可知，「安比·德玛拉」这一身份在其加入狡兔屋后才凭空出现，且「德玛拉」的姓氏明显取自妮可。而在以狡兔屋雇员的身份进行相关登记之前，安比的个人履历及相关数据全部呈现可疑的空白。
安比虽然极度缺乏常识，但却精通战斗相关事宜，属于狡兔屋最强战力（之一）。

安比最大的兴趣爱好是电影，且涉猎范围极其广泛。或许是因为过度痴迷，她常把电影中的故事当真。
和看起来一副喜怒不形于色的模样不同，安比很容易被一些并不存在的故事情节感动。
最钟意的食物是汉堡，因为「同时包含蛋白质，碳水和绿叶菜，味道好吃，甚至还价格低廉的食物，除了汉堡之外没有其他。」
1381.descriptionEn:
Anby, the original member of Gentle House.
According to the New Eridu resident records, her identity as "Anby Demara" only exists after joining Gentle House, the name obviously being taken from Nicole. Before registering as an employee of Gentle House, all data relating to Anby is suspiciously blank.
Despite her extreme lack of common sense, Anby is well-versed in matters related to combat and is among the strongest combatants of the Cunning Hares.

Anby's greatest interest is movies, of which she likes an extensive range of genres. Due to an excessive obsession, she tends to take the stories in movies as reality.
Contrary to her seemingly emotionless appearance, Anby is easily moved by movie storylines.
Her favorite food is hamburgers because "they contain protein, carbs, and greens, taste good, and are even affordable — there's nothing else besides hamburgers."

skills.name: 普通攻击：电击穿
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段斩击，造成电属性伤害；
第四段攻击命中敌人后，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 时，可以快速穿过前方敌人，最多重复发动5次。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing Electric DMG. After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

variants.name: 普通攻击：电击穿
variants.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段斩击，造成电属性伤害；
第三段普通攻击会持续聚集敌人；
第四段攻击命中敌人后，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 时，可以快速穿过前方敌人，最多重复发动5次。
variants.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
On the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, enemies are continuously pulled in.
After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

skills.name: 特殊技：星雷
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向斜前方快速突进，随后进行交叉斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Dash diagonally forward, then unleash a cross slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：苍光
skills.description:
零号·安比攻击命中敌人时，会对目标施加[银星]标记，并为其进行充能；
每拥有三分之一充能，敌人将被施加1层[白雷]，最多叠加3层；
敌方目标拥有[白雷]时，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速向前方位移，穿过敌人并进行斩击，对命中的敌人造成多段电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将消耗1层[白雷]，发动[追加攻击]，造成1次额外的电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the Silver Star mark and charges the target 
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of White Thunder, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has White Thunder, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of White Thunder to trigger an Aftershock that deals 1 extra instance of Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：雷殛
skills.description:
针对同一名敌人，连续触发3次[白雷]的额外伤害时发动：
在敌方位置降下落雷，对范围内的敌人造成电属性伤害；
该伤害被视为[追加攻击]伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the additional damage from White Thunder triggers 3 times on the same enemy:
A lightning strike will fall at the enemy's location, dealing Electric DMG to enemies within range.
This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.

skills.name: 特殊技：苍光·临界（潜能觉醒）
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary (Potential Awakening)
skills.description:
触发[特殊技：雷殛]伤害时：
若正在发动[强化特殊技：极雷断空]或[特殊技：苍光]，会在当前招式结束时自动发动[特殊技：苍光·临界]，连续斩击敌人造成多段电属性伤害，招式为[追加攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Special Attack: Thunder Smite DMG is triggered:
If EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt or Special Attack: Azure Flash is currently being used, then Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will automatically trigger when the current skill ends, unleashing a flurry of slashes that deal multiple instances of Electric DMG. This skill counts as an Aftershock.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：极雷断空
skills.description:
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将双剑拼接后向前方丢出进行高速斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：频闪
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：奔流
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方横向斩击后，衔接突刺攻击，造成电属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a horizontal slash forward, then follow up with a thrust attack, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：地闪回击
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

variants.name: 闪避反击：地闪回击
variants.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；命中敌人时获得15秒[电荷超载]状态，重复获得刷新持续时间；
[电荷超载]状态期间闪避性能提升，且发动[普通攻击]/[冲刺攻击]/[闪避反击]时敌方目标若拥有[白雷]，点按 【特殊技键】 可以随时打断当前招式并发动[特殊技：苍光]；
状态期间点按 【强化特殊技键】 时，若敌人未拥有[白雷]，能直接发动[强化特殊技：极雷断空]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
variants.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform consecutive slashes at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG. On hit, gain the Voltage Overload state for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
While in the Voltage Overload state, dodge performance is enhanced. Additionally, when using Basic Attack/Dash Attack/Dodge Counter, if the enemy target has White Thunder, pressing [Special Attack] will immediately cancel the current skill and launch Special Attack: Azure Flash.
While in this state, if the enemy does not have White Thunder, press [EX Special Attack] to directly launch EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：疾跃落雷
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方跃起，随后快速俯冲并发动交叉斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Leap forward, then quickly dive and perform a cross slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：斩空掠电
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力连斩，并追加落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：云闪
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：逆极反袭
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；

cinema.name: 静滞电荷
cinema.description: 零号·安比发动[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，将会连续触发3次[白雷]的额外伤害，该效果不会消耗[白雷]层数。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an EX Special Attack to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from White Thunder 3 times. This effect does not consume any White Thunder stacks.
cinema.story:
「我在这里的事，请不要让妮可他们知道。」
「好的。今天你睡楼下沙发，还是楼上？」
「…绳匠…谢谢。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Please keep my business here a secret from Nicole and the others."
"Alright. Are you sleeping on the couch downstairs or upstairs?"
"...Proxy... Thank you."

cinema.name: 冗余协议
cinema.description:
零号·安比的暴击率提升12%；发动[终结技]时，零号·安比会获得6层[电鸣]（上限6层）；拥有[电鸣]后，零号·安比[特殊技：苍光]命中拥有[白雷]的敌人时，将改为消耗1层[电鸣]作为代替，同一招式命中多名敌人时最多消耗1层[电鸣]，消耗[电鸣]时仍会触发[白雷]的额外伤害；
激发潜能后，每消耗3层[电鸣]，下次发动[特殊技：苍光·临界]时速度加快。
cinema.descriptionEn:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her Ultimate, she gains 6 stacks of Thunder's Cry (max 6 stacks). With Thunder's Cry, when using Special Attack: Azure Flash to hit an enemy with White Thunder, it will consume 1 stack of Thunder's Cry instead. Only 1 stack of Thunder's Cry will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming Thunder's Cry will still activate the additional DMG from White Thunder.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of Thunder's Cry consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.
cinema.story:
「怎么了？你看起来很累。」
「我…没事。」
「如果需要帮忙，随时开口。」
cinema.storyEn:
"What's wrong? You look really tired."
"I'm... fine."
"If you need help, just say the word."

cinema.name: 旧日荣光
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「安比，我们刚刚还在聊你的事。你——真的撑得住吗？」
「我，没…」
「再想用『没事』敷衍，小心我对你不客气。」
「绳匠的不客气…会是怎样的？」
cinema.storyEn:
"Anby, we were just talking about you. Are you really okay?"
"I... I'm..."
"If you try to brush it off with 'I'm fine' again, I might not be so kind."
"What does 'not being kind' from you look like, Proxy?"

cinema.name: 银白残响
cinema.description: 攻击命中拥有[银星]标记的敌人时，零号·安比无视目标12%电属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: When hitting an enemy marked with Silver Star, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's Electric RES.
cinema.story:
「安比，你刚从空洞里回来，要洗澡吗？」
「绳匠先洗吧。我还有些情报，需要再整理一下…」
「哈。」
「唔？」
「为什么觉得安比，好像已经在这个家里住了很久了呢…」
cinema.storyEn:
"Anby, you just came back from the Hollow. Do you want to take a shower?"
"You go ahead, Proxy. I still need to organize some information..."
"Ha."
"Hmm?"
"Why do I feel like Anby has been living in this house for a long time..."

cinema.name: 导演剪辑版
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「原来如此。安比的事，还有白银小队的事…」
「对不起。我本来不想让这些事成为绳匠的负担。」
「所以——今晚想看什么电影？」
「诶…？」
「你的事，永远不会是负担。看吧，我们的日常生活还是可以继续下去。」
cinema.storyEn:
"I get it now. About Anby and Silver Squad..."
"Sorry. I never meant for all of this to become your burden, Proxy."
"So — what movie do you feel like watching tonight?"
"Huh...?"
"Your troubles will never be a burden. See? Normal life can go on as usual."

cinema.name: 前传主角
cinema.description: 触发6次[白雷]的额外伤害时，将会引发电磁涡流，对目标及其周围的敌人造成零号·安比1000%攻击力的电属性伤害，该伤害被视为[追加攻击]伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon triggering 6 instances of White Thunder's additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as Electric DMG against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.
cinema.story:
「那么…我要回去了，绳匠。谢谢你一直以来的照顾。」
「我知道你答应过妮可，不再离家出走。但这样，对我有点不公平吧？
——我也很怀念和安比两个人一起看电影到天亮的日子。」
「对…对绳匠不公平？那么，我会想出补偿的方法的。」
「快点想。」
「零号，遵命。…诶、诶…」
cinema.storyEn:
"Well... I should be heading back, Proxy. Thanks for everything you've done for me."
"I know you promised Nicole you wouldn't run away from home again, but isn't this a little unfair to me?
—I miss those days when you and I would watch movies together until dawn."
"Unfair... to you? Well, I'll just have to come up with a way to make up for it."
"Hurry up and think of something."
"Soldier 0, at your service... Huh, huh...?"

skillCultivationRecommendation.label: 技能培养建议分组
skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.

1391.name: 橘福福

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
虎希人，曾群聚在远离新艾利都城区的山林中定居的希人种族，据我以雅努斯区数个街区监控记录为样本进行的推算，目前于新艾利都范围内活动的虎希人市民不超过二十位。

旧都陷落事件中，零号空洞的次生空洞灾害亦在虎希人聚居地爆发。据档案记载，突然形成并吞没了聚居地的空洞中出现了复数头恶名以骸，98%登记在册的虎希人市民在此次空洞灾害中丧生，幸存者多为老病幼弱者——若非所属云岿山的修者小队在半小时内抵达聚居地开展救灾工作，「橘福福」的名字大概并不会出现在您的代理人档案中。

结合修者组织云岿山档案所记录之日期，可以推测橘福福在旧都陷落时期即已拜入现任云岿山领袖仪玄门下。
profile.descriptionEn:
Tiger Thirens, a Thiren race living in the mountains far from New Eridu's urban areas. Using the security camera footage in Janus Quarter, it can be extrapolated that there are no more than twenty tiger Thirens currently active in New Eridu.

During the fall of the old capital, a Hollow Zero companion Hollow disaster erupted in the tiger Thiren settlement. Records show that multiple notorious Ethereals appeared in this Hollow that swallowed up their settlement, killing 98 percent of all registered tiger Thirens. Most of the survivors were the sick, young, or elderly. If it hadn't been for a team of mystics from Yunkui Summit arriving within half an hour for search and rescue, the name Ju Fufu would likely have never appeared in your Agent records.

From Yunkui Summit's records and dates, Ju Fufu was already a disciple of the leader of Yunkui Summit, Yixuan, when the disaster happened.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JAN 6

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 「神通广大大师姐，仗义行侠好威风！」——福福师姐私下也有得意洋洋的一面，可爱！嗯…总觉得哥哥也干过这种事？
profile.descriptionEn: "The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might!" I didn't expect senior Fufu to have such a side... so adorable! Hm... why does this feel like something Wise would've said?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 我才没干过那种事——虽然还是有些不习惯个子小小的福福一口一个「小师弟」地叫我，但不管是在行动中还是在生活里，福福都真的很有大师姐的才华和风范——下次不小心让她看到我们的备注如何？福福一定会一边脸红怕羞一边心里得意吧？
profile.descriptionEn: I've never said anything like that! I still haven't totally gotten used to Fufu calling me junior when she looks so small herself, but both in life and in missions, Fufu truly is a reliable senior... How about we accidentally on purpose show her our comments? I bet she'll get really shy but feel super smug inside.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对橘福福的印象：
 · 云岿山的小老虎，最善降妖除魔，心系惩奸除恶。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Ju Fufu:
 · The Little Tiger of Yunkui Summit excels at subduing demons and dispelling evil, driven by a deep resolve to punish the wicked and wipe out all evil.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 随便观的小师父，神通果然广大，做派务必威风。
profile.descriptionEn: · This young master of Suibian Temple has immense powers, and her bearing is nothing short of majestic.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 法厄同的大师姐，捣蛋了给你撑腰，闯祸了替你求情。
profile.descriptionEn: · Phaethon's senior will have your back when you're up to mischief and plead your case if you get into trouble.

1391.description:
橘福福，新艾利都少见的虎希人，个子和年纪小小却是随便观的大师姐，最早拜入仪玄门下的弟子之一。

「什么事情都能办妥」、「甚至能让师父乖乖听话」、「指导课业最为耐心细致」、「团建餐厅的选择总是很有品味」。
——云岿山修者考评档案，弟子互评页

「师父交代的差事总是出纰漏」、「不管说话还是打架都没有气势」、「不会跟反派放狠话」、「诸位师弟师妹都比我更成器」。
——云岿山修者考评档案，弟子自评页

「神通广大大师姐，仗义行侠好威风——路过寝舍的时候，我听她自己这么念叨的。不过，我很赞同。」
——云岿山修者考评档案，师父评价页

另外：建议您建议云岿山加强网络安全建设工作，减少弟子隐私泄露风险。
1391.descriptionEn:
Ju Fufu, a rare tiger Thiren of New Eridu. She looks small and is still young, but she's the most senior disciple of Suibian Temple and one of Yixuan's first disciples.

"Able to deal with anything," "can even make Shifu listen," "super patient and meticulous teacher," "has great taste when choosing restaurants for teambuilding."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, peer evaluation

"Always messing up the tasks given by Shifu," "doesn't command respect in speech or combat," "doesn't know how to act tough against bad guys," "juniors are more skilled."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, self-evaluation

"'The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might' is what I heard her say when I passed by her room. Hm... I concur."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, Shifu's evaluation

Other: I suggest you suggest Yunkui Summit improve their network security to avoid the risk of disciples' personal data being stolen or leaked.

skills.name: 普通攻击：恶虎七式·燎身爪
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
第三段攻击期间，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 可以维持连击，持续打击敌人；
第三段攻击期间，长按或停顿后点按 【普通攻击键】 ，将衔接第四段攻击；
第三段攻击期间抗打断等级提升，受到伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Slash forward up to four times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to maintain the combo and keep striking the enemy.
During the 3rd hit, hold or pause before pressing [Basic Attack] to chain into the 4th hit.
During the 3rd hit, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: 普通攻击：「虎威」
skills.description:
战斗中，「虎威」会自动对敌人发动攻击， 造成火属性伤害；
命中敌人时，获得20点[威风]，招式内最多触发一次；[威风]上限为200点。
skills.descriptionEn:
During combat, Hu Wei will automatically attack enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
Upon hitting an enemy, gain 20 points of Might, triggering up to once per use of a skill. The maximum for Might is 200.

skills.name: 特殊技：恶虎七式·下山虎
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain-Descending Tiger
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行旋转斩击后发动下落斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash forward, followed by a falling slash, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：恶虎七式改·下山猛虎
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms Alt - Mountain-Descending Savage Tiger
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
挥舞「虎威」向前方进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动时获得3点[威势]和80点[威风]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Swing Hu Wei forward for a powerful strike, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 points of Momentum and 80 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：恶虎七式·风从虎
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：恶虎七式·虎奔
skills.nameEn: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前发动快速斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick slash forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：恶虎七式·山君鼎戏
skills.nameEn: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game
skills.description:
[冲刺攻击：恶虎七式·虎奔]发动后，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
进入高速旋转状态，该状态下可以拖曳摇杆进行移动，接触敌人时造成物理伤害；
橘福福通过其他招式获得[威势]后，会在高速旋转状态下带有火焰；接触敌人时消耗1点[威势]，改为造成火属性伤害并获得25点[威风]，[威势]上限为15点；
橘福福消耗[威势]造成火属性伤害时，若[威风]高于100点，会自动消耗100点[威风]发动[连携技：虎釜震煞]；
松开 【普通攻击键】 可退出旋转状态，并丢出「虎威」攻击敌人，造成火属性伤害；切换至其他角色时，橘福福会继续处于旋转状态，尝试撞击最近的敌人；
橘福福为当前操作中角色时，招式发动期间受到伤害降低40%，抗打断等级提升，不为当前操作中角色时，获得无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After using Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the joystick to move and deal Physical DMG upon contact with enemies.
After Ju Fufu gains Momentum from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state. Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of Momentum is consumed, changing the DMG to Fire DMG and granting 25 points of Might. The maximum for Momentum is 15.
When consuming Momentum to deal Fire DMG, if Might is above 100 points, 100 points of Might will be automatically consumed to trigger Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron.
Releasing [Basic Attack] will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw Hu Wei to attack enemies, dealing Fire DMG. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy.
While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes Invulnerable.

skills.name: 闪避反击：恶虎七式·离火回峰
skills.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Tiger Seven Forms - Reignited Mountain
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多次斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform multiple slashes on enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：虎釜崩
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
挥舞「虎威」对前方小范围敌人进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Swing Hu Wei to deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：虎釜震煞
skills.description:
拥有至少100点[威风]时，触发[连携技]后自动发动：
消耗100点[威风]，打开「虎威」对前方小范围敌人发射火焰和爆米花打击敌人，造成大量火属性伤害；
拥有[威势]且不为操作中角色时，招式结束会进入高速旋转状态；
招式为[追加攻击]，发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With at least 100 points of Might, after triggering a Chain Attack, automatically activate:
Consume 100 Might to open Hu Wei and fire flames and popcorn at enemies, striking them in a small area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
If Momentum is available, and while not the active character, the high-speed spinning state will activate after the skill ends.
This is an Aftershock. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：恶虎七式·猛虎炸开花
skills.nameEn: Ultimate: Tiger Seven Forms - Raging Tiger Explosion
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
使用「虎威」进行两次下落攻击，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动时获得6点[威势]和100点[威风]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform two downward attacks with Hu Wei, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 6 points of Momentum and 100 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：怒决蹯
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：岿然虎踞
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：彪形焰颌
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击后，使用「虎威」追加一次下落攻击，造成火属性伤害；
发动时获得1点[威势]，10秒内最多获得1次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, then use Hu Wei to follow up with a downward attack, dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 1 point of Momentum upon activation at most once every 10s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：虎虎生威
skills.description:
橘福福未使用「虎威」时，「虎威」会自动攻击敌人，并在命中敌人时获得[威风]；
「虎威」命中敌人时，若拥有至少100点[威风]且橘福福不为当前操作中角色，橘福福会围绕目标敌人，发动[连携技：虎釜震煞]；发动时，全队角色获得[虎啸]效果：暴击伤害提升10%，橘福福的初始攻击力大于等于2800点时，每超过100点攻击力会使暴击伤害额外提升5%，最多额外提升30%；

[虎啸]状态持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，橘福福处于[虎啸]效果中，冲击力提升25点。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Ju Fufu isn't using Hu Wei, it will automatically attack enemies and gain Might upon hitting them.
When Hu Wei hits an enemy and has at least 100 Might, and Ju Fufu is not the currently active character, Ju Fufu will launch Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron centered around the target enemy. Upon activation, all squad members gain the Tiger's Roar effect: CRIT DMG increases by 10%, and when Ju Fufu's initial ATK is greater than or equal to 2,800, every additional 100 ATK further increases CRIT DMG by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%.
While in the Tiger's Roar state, character Chain Attack/Ultimate DMG increases by 10%/20%.
The Tiger's Roar state lasts for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, Impact increases by 25.

cinema.name: 超级可怕小老虎
cinema.description: 进入战场时，橘福福的暴击率提升12%，立即获得100点[威风]；橘福福的[连携技]命中敌人时，目标处于失衡状态下时，失衡易伤倍率提升35%，持续30秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 Might. When Ju Fufu's Chain Attack hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.
cinema.story:
「告别与死生的课题，对孩子来说太难懂，对大人来说太沉重，对长者来说太残酷。」
「但我不害怕——我是不会害怕的虎希人，早早地知晓这一课。」
「我是超级可怕的大老虎，可爱小动物们请不要直视我的目光！」
cinema.storyEn:
"The topic of farewells and life and death is too difficult for children to understand, too heavy for adults to bear, and too cruel for the elderly."
"But I'm not afraid — I'm the fearless Tiger Thiren who learned this lesson early."
"I'm a super scary big tiger, little critters, so please don't look directly into my eyes!"

cinema.name: 神通广大青溟客
cinema.description: 处于[虎啸]状态下角色的暴击伤害额外提升22%；任意角色发动[终结技]时，橘福福回复3点[威势]。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Tiger's Roar state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an Ultimate, Ju Fufu gains 3 points of Momentum.
cinema.story:
「师父教我的术法真是神奇，虽然比不过那些童话和传说。」
「如果我厉害一点——再厉害一点，是不是可以将那些命定的过往全都重来过，就像童话和传说。」
「我一开始确实也摸不着头脑，但其实把握了关窍就很简单啦。我来教你吧，小师妹／小师弟！」
cinema.storyEn:
"The techniques Shifu taught me are truly amazing, though it can't compare to those of fairy tales and legend."
"If I were a little stronger — just a little stronger — could I rewrite those fated pasts, like in the stories and legends?
"At first, I was just as puzzled, but once you grasp the trick, it's actually quite simple! Let me teach you, Junior!"

cinema.name: 仗义行侠少年郎
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「那一刻的善，那一刻的恶，或许都是一念之差。一念之差留下好多遗憾好多如果——还有好多牺牲与爱。」
「我不聪明，大道理我不懂得许多，只好去做我觉得正确的选择。」
「有福福大侠的地方，就有公义！」
cinema.storyEn:
"Good or evil, in that moment, perhaps it's all just a matter of a single thought. A single thought leaves behind so many regrets, so many 'what ifs' — and so much sacrifice and love."
"I'm not smart, I don't understand many of those grand principles, so I just do what I think is right."
"Wherever the great hero Fufu goes, there's justice!"

cinema.name: 降妖伏魔虎修者
cinema.description: 橘福福处于[虎啸]状态下时，自身的暴击伤害提升35%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.
cinema.story:
「以骸好可怕，强盗好可怕，空洞好可怕，没有星星的黑夜好可怕——可我是云岿山绝顶厉害的修者，我不可以退缩，不可以再看到我的故事发生。」
「那堪黯晦绝此景，不忍山与月与云。」
「我是云岿山绝顶厉害的修者！魑魅魍魉速速伏诛！」
cinema.storyEn:
"Ethereals are terrifying, bandits are terrifying, Hollow Raiders are terrifying, the dark night without stars is terrifying — and yet, I'm the most powerful mystic of Yunkui Summit. I cannot retreat, I cannot let my story repeat."
"The dark and gloom is a blanketing shroud, unbearable for mountain, moon, and cloud."
"I am the strongest mystic of Yunkui Summit, evil spirits and demons, meet your end!"

cinema.name: 神威盖世大师姐
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「诸位安心——大师姐来了！」
「小时候的那个我没有等到一直在等待的英雄，我不会让你等——我会成为你的英雄。」
「福福可欺而师弟师妹不可欺！我去跟他拼了！嗷——！」
cinema.storyEn:
"No need to fear — your senior is here!"
"The hero I longed for when I was a child never came, but I won't make you wait — I will be your hero."
"You can bully me, but not my juniors! I'll take you on! Rwaar!"

cinema.name: 知我心中虎啸声
cinema.description: 橘福福的[连携技]造成的伤害提升30%；橘福福在高速旋转状态下时，消耗[威势]命中敌人时，会发射3个爆米花，每个爆米花造成福福攻击力160%的伤害，且造成的伤害视为[连携技]伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: Ju Fufu's Chain Attack DMG increases by 30%. Upon consuming Momentum and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as Chain Attack DMG.
cinema.story:
「威风摇落山上月，气宇踏平洞中窟——师姐这句诗写得如何？有没有把师姐威风八面的气概写出来？」
「侠名不重要，遗憾不重要，泪水不重要，总有一天会到来的离别也没关系。」
「只要有你还记得，我曾勇敢咆哮过。」
cinema.storyEn:
"My might shakes the moon down from the mountain, my aura levels caves — how's this line? Does it capture the grandeur of my imposing presence?"
"The name of a hero doesn't matter, their regrets don't matter, their tears don't matter, and even the inevitable farewell doesn't matter."
"As long as you remember, I once roared with bravery."

1401.name: 爱丽丝

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
据调查，爱丽丝的对称强迫症是其自幼就有的倾向，但在经历了儿时对称的发卡丢失、随后父亲意外身亡的变故后，她将事故归因于对称事物的丢失，进而强化了在对称性上的偏执。
作为以研究以太科学而知名的名门，泰姆菲尔德家族当前正面临没落的危机。爱丽丝的父母早逝、祖父抱恙，在为了拯救朋友而免费开放家族专利后，她决心重新开始，以自己的力量振兴家族。
尽管她性格胆小，但一旦认定要完成某件事情，就一定会坚定地推进到底。同时，她极其重视同伴，绝不会坐视同伴的困难不管…因此，主人，极力推荐您与爱丽丝搞好关系，并向她透露我们当前电费账单支付困难的经济情况。
profile.descriptionEn:
According to my investigations, Alice has been obsessed with symmetry ever since she was young, but after experiencing the loss of her symmetrical hairpin and her father's subsequent death, she subconsciously attributed the tragedy to the loss of a symmetrical object, which intensified her obsession with symmetry.

As a prestigious family known for their Ether science research, the Thymefield family is currently facing a decline. With Alice's parents passing away early and her grandfather falling ill, and after giving away the family's patents to save a friend, she's determined to start anew and revive the family through her own strength.

Despite her timid nature, once she sets her mind on accomplishing something, she'll pursue it with unwavering determination. Moreover, she values her companions deeply and would never ignore their difficulties... Therefore, Master, I strongly recommend improving relations with Alice and informing her about our current financial struggles with paying the electricity bills.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 身高
profile.description: 163（包括耳朵）
profile.descriptionEn: 163 (Ears Included)

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: AUG 30

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 难得有人和哥哥一样对恐怖电影毫无抗性呢~不过即便如此，爱丽丝还是会忍不住好奇心观看我推荐的最新恐怖片，并抱着我吓得大叫。反观总是找借口落跑的哥哥…
profile.descriptionEn: It's rare to find someone who's just as bad with horror movies as my brother~ But even so, Alice still can't help but let her curiosity get the better of her, watching the latest horror flicks I recommend, and screaming while clinging to me. Unlike my brother, who always finds excuses to bail...

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 你哥没有冒险精神还真是对不起…不过爱丽丝真的很痴迷于灵异呢。难道她就那么喜欢一次次被惊吓的感觉吗？
profile.descriptionEn: Sorry for my lack of courage... But Alice really is obsessed with the paranormal. Does she really enjoy getting scared out of her wits over and over again?

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对爱丽丝的印象：
 · 感觉爱丽丝似乎把掏出巨款帮助朋友当作了一件很疏松平常的事…
profile.descriptionEn:
Impression of Alice:
 · It seems Alice thinks shelling out huge sums of money to help friends is normal...

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 如此容易受惊吓的人，究竟是以怎样的心态加入了一个怪谈组织？
profile.descriptionEn: · How did someone who gets scared so easily end up joining a paranormal investigation group anyway?

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 在对称的星座下视线交汇，她不再迷惘的微笑何等炫目。
profile.descriptionEn: · Under the symmetrical constellation, their gazes meet. Her smile, no longer lost, is utterly dazzling.

1401.description:
爱丽丝·泰姆菲尔德，怪啖屋的新晋成员，新艾利都名门泰姆菲尔德家族的千金大小姐。
爱丽丝自幼修习击剑与以太科学，在以上领域表现出优秀的天赋。她当前就读于高志院下属的圣星女子学院，是一名品学兼优的标准优等生；推定，其有朝一日会继承家业，成为新艾利都新世代的以太学者。
她极为重视秩序与规律，尤其在事物的对称上表现出近乎偏执的追求。对称强迫症甚至对她的审美造成了影响，令她将事物对称与否置于判断其美丑的第一顺位。
此外，她极其容易受惊吓，对闹鬼怪谈的抗性几乎为0。即便如此，她似乎对接触怪谈表现出相当高的兴致。提议，主人可以寻找怪谈作为与她的共同话题，无论她前期怎么拒绝，推定最终都会凑过来一探究竟。
1401.descriptionEn:
Alice Thymefield, a new member of Spook Shack, is a young lady from the prestigious Thymefield family of New Eridu.

Alice has studied fencing and Ether science since childhood, showing exceptional talent in both fields. She currently attends Celestia School for Girls, a subsidiary of High Ambitions Academy, where she's a model student excelling in both academics and conduct. It is predicted that she will one day inherit the family business and become a next-generation Ether scholar of New Eridu.

She places extreme importance on order and patterns, showing an almost obsessive pursuit of symmetry in particular. This even affects her aesthetic judgment, making symmetry the primary criterion in determining whether something is beautiful or ugly.

Furthermore, she's easily frightened, with practically zero resistance to ghost stories and supernatural tales. Despite this, she seems to show considerable interest in encountering such phenomena. Suggestion: Master can use ghost stories as a topic of conversation with her. No matter how much she initially refuses, it is likely that she will eventually come closer to investigate.

skills.name: 普通攻击：星仪序曲
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
爱丽丝通过属性异常积蓄触发[强击]时，下一次发动的[普通攻击]第五段获得强化。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to 5 slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG.
When Alice triggers Assault through Attribute Anomaly Buildup, the 5th hit of her next Basic Attack is enhanced.

skills.name: 普通攻击：星芒圆舞曲
skills.description:
爱丽丝的[剑仪]达到1格时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
长按进入蓄力，消耗至多3格[剑仪]，松开 【普通攻击键】 或[剑仪]不满1格时，爱丽丝将根据当前蓄力段数以目标敌人为中心发动多段斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
三段蓄力的[普通攻击：星芒圆舞曲]的终结一击命中敌人时，触发特殊的[强击]效果[极性强击]，无视属性积蓄进度造成一次原本[强击]效果100%的伤害，并可以与包括物理异常效果在内的其他属性异常效果互相结算[紊乱]；
命中敌人时，不累积[剑仪]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Alice's Blade Etiquette reaches 1 bar, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Hold to charge, expending up to 3 bars of Blade Etiquette. Release [Basic Attack] or when Blade Etiquette is below 1 bar, Alice performs a series of slashes in an area centered on the target enemy, with the number of hits determined by charge level, dealing massive Physical DMG.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz hits, it triggers a special Assault effect: Polarity Assault. This deals DMG equal to 100% of the original Assault, ignoring Anomaly Buildup, and can interact with other Attribute Anomalies, including Physical, to trigger Disorder.
Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：破晓突刺
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
丢出剑攻击并穿过前方敌人，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时可以触发[极限闪避]；
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以衔接发动第五段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Hurl the blade to strike and pass through enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered.
After triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 5th hit of a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：极光突刺·北十字
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross
skills.description:
能量足够时，向前拖曳摇杆并点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
突刺攻击并穿过前方敌人，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时可以触发[极限闪避]，并回复10点[剑仪]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, drag the joystick forward and press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
A thrust attack that goes through enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Dodge and restores 10 Blade Etiquette.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：极光突刺·南十字
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Southern Cross
skills.description:
能量足够时，不拖曳或者向后方拖曳摇杆并点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
后退并发动斩击随后向前穿刺，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时可以触发[极限闪避]，并回复10点[剑仪]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, and without moving the joystick or when dragging it backwards, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Back away with a slash, then thrust forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Dodge and restores 10 Blade Etiquette.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：动若脱兔
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：剑舞之风
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：剑闪之仪
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击和踢击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：星落间章
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方敌人发动强力多段斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes powerful consecutive slashes at enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：星芒终章
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力多段斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，回复200点[剑仪]；
命中敌人时，不累积[剑仪]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating this skill restores 200 Blade Etiquette.
Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：交替穿刺
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击和踢击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：对抗防守
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：交叉还击
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge forward and slash enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：剑心双虹
skills.nameEn: Core Passive: Twin Rainbows of the Swordheart
skills.description:
队伍中任意角色对敌人施加物理异常状态后，在异常状态的持续期间，爱丽丝每0.95秒对其额外造成基于该物理异常伤害比例2.5%的伤害，并使物理异常状态下的敌人被触发[紊乱]效果时，每有1秒物理异常状态剩余时间，[紊乱]效果的伤害倍率提升18%，最多提升180%；
爱丽丝攻击命中敌人时，累积[剑仪]，爱丽丝通过属性异常积蓄触发[强击]时，回复10点[剑仪]，[剑仪]的上限为300点，每100点为1格；
三段蓄力的[普通攻击：星芒圆舞曲]的终结一击命中敌人时，触发特殊的[强击]效果[极性强击]，无视属性积蓄进度造成一次原本[强击]效果100%的伤害，并可以与包括物理异常效果在内的其他属性异常效果互相结算[紊乱]；
爱丽丝触发[强击]时，物理异常积蓄效率提升12.5%，持续30秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
After any squad member inflicts a Physical Anomaly on an enemy, Alice deals additional DMG each 0.95s of its active duration, equal to 2.5% of the original Physical Anomaly DMG. If Disorder is triggered while the enemy is suffering a Physical Anomaly, for every 1s of remaining Physical Anomaly duration, the Disorder DMG multiplier increases by 18%, up to a max of 180%.
When Alice's attacks hit an enemy, she builds up Blade Etiquette. When she triggers an Assault through Anomaly Buildup, she gains 10 Blade Etiquette. Blade Etiquette has a maximum of 300, with each 100 being 1 bar.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz lands, it triggers a special Assault effect: Polarity Assault, dealing 100% of the original Assault DMG, ignoring Anomaly Buildup progress. This can be combined with any Attribute Anomaly, including Physical Anomaly, to trigger Disorder.
When Alice triggers Assault on an enemy, her Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 12.5% for 30s.

skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

When another character in your squad is an Anomaly or Support character:

If Alice's Anomaly Mastery exceeds 140, each additional point grants her 1.6 Anomaly Proficiency.
Upon entering the battlefield, Alice gains 300 Blade Etiquette. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.

cinema.name: 掌心的芫荽
cinema.description: 爱丽丝触发[极性强击]时，回复25点[剑仪]；爱丽丝触发[强击]时，目标的防御力降低20%，持续30秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Alice triggers a Polarity Assault, she gains 25 Blade Etiquette. When she triggers Assault against an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 30s.
cinema.story:
一株芫荽摇曳如新生的绿星，
指尖仿佛下一秒便能将它穿透。
她摊开微微颤抖的双手，
将那丝悸动拥入掌心。
少女的心跳如雨后晨曦破土的春芽。
cinema.storyEn:
A sprig of coriander sways like a newborn green star,
So fragile her fingertips felt they might pass through it.
She slowly opened her trembling hands,
And held that flicker of feeling in her palms.
Her heart beat like a spring bud breaking the earth at dawn, just after the rain.

cinema.name: 剑尖的鼠尾草
cinema.description: [终结技：星芒终章]的终结一击命中敌人时，触发[极性强击]；全队角色造成的[强击]伤害提升15%；物理异常状态下的敌人被结算的[紊乱]伤害提升15%；进入战场时，爱丽丝立刻获得1000点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Ultimate: Starfall Finale's Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers Polarity Assault. All squad members' Assault DMG increases by 15%. Disorder DMG against enemies suffering from Physical Anomaly increases by 15%. Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
cinema.story:
银色的剑尖低吻着鼠尾草叶上的霜痕，
战前的行礼是少女余裕的体现。
恐惧与无力已被冰封于昨日的故梦中，
佩剑跃动着，将要勾勒出繁星的轮廓。
破晓就要到来，花蕾等待着盛开。
cinema.storyEn:
The silver blade dips low, kissing the frost-lined sage leaf.
This pre-battle salute is the girl's quiet show of composure.
Fear and helplessness lie frozen in the faded dreams of yesterday.
Her sword stirs, ready to trace the outline of the stars.
Dawn is near, and the flower bud waits to bloom.

cinema.name: 对称主义
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
她无法拒绝完美的对称。
对称之中，存在着秩序与规律。若看不到对称，她的兔耳和尾巴将会丧失柔顺与光泽，仿佛美好的事物下一秒就会离她而去。
「所以…这就是你非得提我的堆堆袜，还想卸掉我腿环的理由？」
「我实在受不了你的不对称啦！就一下，我保证就一下！」
cinema.storyEn:
She couldn't resist perfect symmetry.
In symmetry, there was order, balance, and meaning. Without it, her bunny ears and tail would dull and droop, as if something lovely were about to vanish from her world.
"So... that's why you had to bring up my mismatched socks, and tried to take off my leg band?"
"I just can't stand your asymmetry! Just for a second, I swear — just one second!"

cinema.name: 唇间的迷迭香
cinema.description: 爱丽丝无视目标10%物理伤害抗性；强化后的[普通攻击：星仪序曲]累积的物理异常积蓄值提升25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Alice ignores 10% of the target's Physical RES. Enhanced Basic Attack: Celestial Overture accumulates 25% more Physical Anomaly Buildup.
cinema.story:
双唇间残留着迷迭香的香气，
誓言滚烫且坚定，烙印于吐出的白息之中。
纵使吸入肺内的空气冰冷而沉重，
少女也绝不会忘却名为爱的咒语。
「以泰姆菲尔德之名…我绝不背弃。」
cinema.storyEn:
The scent of rosemary lingered between her lips,
A vow searing and resolute, carried on every breath of frost.
Even as the air in her lungs turned cold and heavy,
The girl would never forget the spell called love.
"In the name of the Thymefields... I will never betray it."

cinema.name: 灵异渴求
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
她无法拒绝恐怖的灵异。
灵异之中，隐藏着未知与危险。若能感受到灵异，她的兔耳和尾巴都会在战栗中炸毛，却又在平复过后欲罢不能地变得更加顺滑。
「所以…这就是你每回怪谈冒险明明怕得要死，还是要紧跟着我的理由？」
「我只是好奇会发生什么…但是好恐怖，我已经后悔了！就一次，下次绝对不来了！」
cinema.storyEn:
She couldn't resist scary paranormal things.
Within the paranormal hid the unknown and the dangerous. When she felt it, her bunny ears and tail would bristle in fright — only to become irresistibly smooth once she calmed down.
"So... that's why you always tag along on my ghost-hunting trips, even though you're scared out of your mind?"
"I just wanted to see what would happen... but it's so scary, I totally regret it! Just this once — I swear I'm not coming next time!"

cinema.name: 心中的百里香
cinema.description: 爱丽丝发动三段蓄力的[普通攻击：星芒圆舞曲]或[终结技：星芒终章]时，进入[决胜状态]，持续30秒，在持续期间，队伍中任意角色攻击命中目标后的短时间内，爱丽丝对目标发动1次额外攻击，造成等同于爱丽丝3300%异常精通的物理伤害，必定暴击，该效果1秒内最多触发一次，最多触发6次，再次获得[决胜状态]时刷新可触发次数。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Alice uses a third-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz or Ultimate: Starfall Finale, she enters the Victory State for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra attack against the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3,300% of her Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the Victory State again refreshes the available trigger count.
cinema.story:
百里香漫放的那片庄园，
天体观测的那个夜晚，
知晓勇气为何物的那个瞬间。
熏风驱散了乌云，阳光掩盖了水晶灯的华彩，
少女向往日轻轻行了个礼。
她缓缓消失在百里香的花田。
cinema.storyEn:
The thyme-scented manor,
The night spent watching the stars,
The moment she came to understand what courage truly meant.
A fragrant wind swept the clouds away, and sunlight outshone the crystal chandelier.
The girl gave a gentle bow to the days gone by.
Then, slowly, she vanished into the field of thyme.

1411.name: 柚叶

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
据柚叶所说，她从记事起就一直在法努斯区流浪，生活在一个由数个孩子组成的流浪帮派中。儿时的柚叶没有名字，因为营养不良患有夜盲症，晚上总要端着烛台，因此外号叫做「小蜡烛」。
柚叶参与的实验项目名为「新叶计划」，由于她一直没有正式称呼，某个负责照顾她的研究人员给她起名「柚叶」，但除了这些日常接触实验儿童起居的底层研究人员之外，菲洛克斯和其他研究所上层并不知道这个名字存在，始终以ES-07来称呼她。虽然是在实验室获得的名字，柚叶却始终觉得，这个名字中含有的生命力，也是自己幸运的一部分。
柚叶的两个妹妹都是在婴儿时期被收养，宝荣叔在给她们起名字时也延续了使用植物意象的习惯。
profile.descriptionEn:
According to Yuzuha, she's been wandering the Faunus Quarter for as long as she can remember, living as part of a small gang of street kids. She didn't have a name back then. Due to malnutrition, she had night blindness and always carried a candlestick after dark, so the others nicknamed her "Little Candle."
Yuzuha was part of an experimental project called "Project New Leaf." Since she never had a proper name, one of the lower-level researchers assigned to care for the children gave her the name "Yuzuha." However, this name was never known to Ferox or the other higher-ups — they only ever referred to her as ES-07. Despite the name coming from the lab, Yuzuha has always felt the name carried a spark of life — and that spark was part of her luck.
Both of Yuzuha's younger sisters were adopted as infants, and when Baorong named them, he continued his tradition of using names inspired by plants.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: NOV 2

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 最开始接触柚叶的时候，总觉得她虽然看起来爽朗，实际上却和人保持着一定距离..但现在已经没事了！
profile.descriptionEn: When I first met Yuzuha, she seemed cheerful on the surface, but I always felt like she kept a certain distance from people... but that's not the case anymore.

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 上次遇见柚叶的妹妹小枫的时候，她还问我柚叶是不是这学期考得特别好，说姐姐最近明显笑得比之前多了呢。
profile.descriptionEn: When I saw Yuzuha's younger sister Kaede the other day, she asked me if Yuzuha had aced her exams this term. She mentioned how Yuzuha's been noticeably happier lately.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对浮波柚叶的印象：
 · 恶作剧大师，但并非为了取乐。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impression of Ukinami Yuzuha:
 · A master of mischief — but not for fun.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 可靠的伙伴，但也会有脆弱的时候。
profile.descriptionEn: · A dependable companion, though not without her moments of vulnerability.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 愿你的人生始终自由而明亮。
profile.descriptionEn: · May your life always be free and full of light.

1411.description:
浮波柚叶，卫非地澄辉坪居民，目前就读于市内一所学费低廉的企业校，除了绳网子论坛「怪啖屋」之外并未加入任何其他组织——当然，按照新艾利都的一般认知，网络论坛并不能被视作正式的组织，更应被称为同好会。
柚叶是辉瓷工艺品店释诡斋店主黎宝荣的养女。根据澄辉坪流传的小道消息，宝荣叔在旧都陷落时失去了妻子和两个女儿。旧都陷落后，他先后收养了五个孩子，柚叶排行第二，有一个哥哥，一个弟弟和两个妹妹。柚叶家位于店铺所在的公寓楼二楼，由于家中只有两间卧室，柚叶一直和两个妹妹共用一个房间，男孩们则和宝荣叔住在一起。最近，由于哥哥已离家独立，柚叶也大多数时间住在学校宿舍，所以家里显得不那么拥挤了。但周末和假期，柚叶一般会从学校返回澄辉坪，帮助父亲打理店铺。
柚叶从小就有着与年龄不相符的成熟，因为能说会道、性格开朗，深受邻里喜爱，在澄辉坪和泅珑围的小孩子中间也很受欢迎。
柚叶在怪啖屋论坛使用的网名是「柚子胡椒」，在论坛上交好的除了现实中认识的真斗和爱丽丝之外，还有网名是「夜魔使者」和「草莓芭菲」的两位用户。
1411.descriptionEn:
Ukinami Yuzuha, a resident of Waifei Peninsula's Failume Heights, currently attends a low-tuition company affiliated school in the city. Aside from being part of the Inter-Knot subforum Spook Shack, she's not affiliated with any other groups — though in New Eridu, such forums aren't typically seen as formal organizations, and are, instead, more like hobby clubs.
Yuzuha is the adopted daughter of Li Baorong, owner of the Mystic Wares Porcelume store. Word around Failume Heights is that Baorong lost his wife and two daughters when the old capital fell. In the years that followed, he took in five children. Yuzuha is the second oldest, with an older brother, a younger brother, and two younger sisters. The family lived on the second floor above the store, and with just two bedrooms, Yuzuha shared one with her sisters, while the boys stayed with Baorong. Now that her older brother has moved out and she mostly stays in the school dorm, the apartment feels a bit less crowded. But on weekends and holidays, Yuzuha usually returns from school to help her father at the store.
Even as a child, Yuzuha showed a surprising level of maturity. Her eloquence and cheerful nature have made her a favorite among neighbors — and a hit with the kids around Waifei Peninsula and Sailume Bay.
On the Spook Shack forum, Yuzuha goes by the username "Yuzupepper." In addition to her real-life friends Manato and Alice, she is also close with two other users known as "Night Emissary" and "Strawberry Parfait" on the forums.

skills.name: 普通攻击：狸之爪
skills.description:

skills.description:

进入防御姿态，最多持续1.5秒，期间如果受到敌人攻击，会招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；

Successfully parrying an attack gains 1 Sugar Points.

skills.description:
当柚叶拥有[甜度点]时，其他操作中的角色攻击命中敌人时，柚叶会围绕敌人旋转伞持续攻击后射出一发强力炮弹，造成物理伤害，该攻击重击命中敌人时，柚叶会消耗1点[甜度点]；
[普通攻击：硬糖射击]为[追加攻击]；
[普通攻击：硬糖射击]每8秒最多触发一次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Yuzuha has Sugar Points, landing a hit with other active characters' attacks will have Yuzuha continuously twirl her umbrella and attack centered around the target before launching a powerful shell, dealing Physical DMG. When this attack lands a heavy attack, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point.
Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot is considered an Aftershock.
Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot can be triggered once every 8s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Fire a cannon shot forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：小心蛀牙
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向敌人扔出炸弹，造成物理伤害；
重击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[甜蜜惊吓]状态；
发动时，获得2点[甜度点]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the Sweet Scare state.
Gains 2 Sugar Points upon activation.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：小心蛀牙，就是现在！
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!
skills.description:
在[闪避反击：报复开始~]、[快速支援：甜点时间]、[支援突击：来块曲奇]、[支援突击：夹心硬糖射击]攻击后或触发[极限闪避]时，点按  【强化特殊技键】  发动：
向敌人快速扔出炸弹，造成物理伤害；
重击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[甜蜜惊吓]状态；
发动时，获得2点[甜度点]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After using Dodge Counter: Time for Payback~, Quick Assist: Dessert Time, Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies, or Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot, or when a Perfect Dodge is triggered, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
On hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the Sweet Scare state.
Gains 2 Sugar Points upon activation.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 甜蜜惊吓
skills.description:
[甜蜜惊吓]状态持续18秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
处于[甜蜜惊吓]状态下的敌人，首次被操作中的角色以与其属性相同的攻击命中时，将对该敌人触发[十人十色]，使得[普通攻击：彩糖花火]和[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]对该敌人的攻击属性转变为触发此次[十人十色]的角色的属性；
当敌人的[甜蜜惊吓]状态被重复触发时，原本的[十人十色]状态会被移除，可再次重复上述操作，改变[普通攻击：彩糖花火]和[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]的属性。
skills.descriptionEn:
The Sweet Scare state lasts for 18s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by Sweet Scare is first hit by an active character using an attack of their attribute, Flavor Match is triggered against that enemy, changing the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max against that enemy to match that of the character who triggered Flavor Match.
When Sweet Scare is triggered again on an enemy, their existing Flavor Match state is removed. The process can be repeated to change the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max again.
skills.levelNote: 显示基础技能等级 1–12；影画带来的额外等级不计入此选择。
skills.levelNoteEn: Base skill levels 1–12; bonus levels from Mindscapes are excluded.

当敌人的[甜蜜惊吓]状态被重复触发时，原本的[十人十色]状态会被移除，可再次重复上述操作，改变[普通攻击：彩糖花火]和[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]的属性。
levels.descriptionEn:
The Sweet Scare state lasts for 40s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by Sweet Scare is first hit by an active character using an attack of their attribute, Flavor Match is triggered against that enemy, changing the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max against that enemy to match that of the character who triggered Flavor Match.
When Sweet Scare is triggered again on an enemy, their existing Flavor Match state is removed. The process can be repeated to change the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max again.

A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：你要倒霉了！

skills.name: 闪避反击：报复开始~

skills.name: 终结技：不投降就捣乱

skills.descriptionEn:

skills.name: 核心被动：奇巧缤纷
skills.description:
进入战场时，柚叶立刻获得3点[甜度点]；
柚叶最多持有6点[甜度点]；
柚叶的[强化特殊技：小心蛀牙]、[强化特殊技：小心蛀牙，就是现在！]和[终结技：不投降就捣乱]攻击命中敌人时，为全队角色施加[狸之愿]效果；
[狸之愿]效果会提供等同于柚叶的40%初始攻击力的攻击力加成，最多提升600点，并使拥有者造成的伤害提升15%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
当柚叶的初始攻击力达到1500点时，为全队角色提供的攻击力增益效果达到最大值。
skills.descriptionEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, Yuzuha immediately gains 3 Sugar Points.
Yuzuha can have up to 6 Sugar Points.
When Yuzuha's EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!, or Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief hits an enemy, all squad members receive the Tanuki Wish effect.
Tanuki Wish grants an ATK increase equal to 40% of Yuzuha's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of 600, and increases the DMG dealt by those with the effect by 15%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Yuzuha's initial ATK reaches 1,500, she grants the full ATK bonus to all squad members.

cinema.name: 幸运体质
cinema.description: 柚叶进入战场时，回复30点能量，在勘域模式中该效果每180秒最多触发一次；处于[甜蜜惊吓]状态下的敌人全属性伤害抗性降低10%；[额外能力]中属性异常伤害和[紊乱]伤害增益效果提升至原本的130%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Yuzuha regains 30 Energy when she enters the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180s. Enemies in the Sweet Scare state have their All-Attribute RES reduced by 10%. The Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG buff from her Additional Ability is increased to 130% of its original value.
cinema.story:
「唉，这下完蛋了！」
「柚叶你也考砸了吗？呜哇，92！这真是靠蒙能蒙出来的分数吗，你这完全是在炫耀吧！」
「不不不，幸运最重要的就是适度，这一科明明没必要考这么高的…直觉告诉我，这下下午的考试肯定没有选择题了！」
cinema.storyEn:
"Ugh, I'm done for!"
"Yuzuha, you failed too? ...Hold up, a 92?! Are you seriously telling me you guessed your way to that score? You're just showing off!"
"No, seriously! Luck only works if you don't overdo it. I had no reason to get such a high score on this one... I can feel it — there's no way the next test will have multiple choice!"

cinema.name: 趣友云集
cinema.description: 柚叶的[强化特殊技：小心蛀牙]、[强化特殊技：小心蛀牙，就是现在！]和[终结技：不投降就捣乱]攻击命中敌人时，会使全队角色造成的伤害提升15%，属性异常积蓄效率提升15%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，重击命中不处于失衡状态的敌人时，会强制触发[连携技]，通过该种方式发动的[连携技]，打断等级降低，强制触发[连携技]的效果每20秒最多触发一次；其他角色通过[连携技]入场时，柚叶会获得1点[甜度点]；柚叶触发[普通攻击：硬糖射击]的冷却时间减少25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Yuzuha's EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!, or Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomaly Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, it will trigger a forced Chain Attack. Chain Attacks triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced Chain Attacks can only occur once every 20s. Whenever another character enters through a Chain Attack, Yuzuha gains 1 Sugar Points. Yuzuha's Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot cooldown is reduced by 25%.
cinema.story:
「阿釜明明没离开过我的视线，可一瞬间这么多东西都被掉包了，到底是怎么做到的？」
「哼哼~阿釜也是有很多朋友的呀！来来来，大家都出来，给你介绍一下，从左到右依次是：竹之助、伊之助，百之助…」
「等等，说太快了！」
「那再来一次，信之助、喜之助、春之助…」
「名字跟之前完全不一样啊！」
cinema.storyEn:
"Kama, you've never left my sight, but how did you swap so many things like just like that?"
"Heh heh~ Kama's got a lot of friends too! Come on out, everyone! Let me introduce them — left to right: Takenosuke, Inosuke, Hyakunosuke..."
"Wait, you're going too fast!"
"Okay, one more time: Shinnosuke, Kinosuke, Harunosuke..."
"Those names are completely different!"

cinema.name: 幽城童话
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「…公主的每一天都很忙碌，清晨，老成沉默的侍女们就会为她穿上华服，戴上沉重的魔法头冠和其他首饰，簇拥着她前往王座。在那里，她将施展神奇的力量，将平平无奇的石头变为价值连城的珍宝。」
「姐姐，公主每天都要把石头变成宝石吗？比一边看店一边写作业还无聊呢。」
「嗯…可如果公主不做这些，贫穷的王国就要灭亡了呀。」
「只靠公主一个人拼命的没用王国，就让它灭亡好了！」
她忍不住大笑起来。是呀，那样没用的王国，就让它灭亡好了。
cinema.storyEn:
"...The princess led a busy life. At sunrise, her silent and stoic maids would adorn her with lavish garments, a weighty magical crown, and layers of jewelry before guiding her to the throne where she used her powers to turn mundane stones into priceless gems."
"Does the princess really have to turn stones into gems every single day? That sounds even more boring than doing homework while minding the shop."
"Well... if she doesn't, the poor kingdom will collapse."
"If a kingdom can only survive by overworking the princess, then let it collapse!"
She bursts into laughter. Yes — let such a useless kingdom fall.

cinema.name: 坠落魔法
cinema.description: 柚叶的[支援突击：夹心硬糖射击]和[支援突击：来块曲奇]造成的伤害提升30%，属性异常积蓄效率提升20%，且该招式命中敌人时将触发[快速支援]。
cinema.descriptionEn: The DMG of Yuzuha's Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot and Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies increases by 30%, Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20%, and triggers a Quick Assist when it hits an enemy.
cinema.story:
从狭窄的通风口看到的那个女孩，闪亮得就像是从童话书里走出来的一样。
她才是真正的公主，而我只不过是一个囚徒。
神啊，她已经拥有那么多东西了，即使分给我一点点也没关系吧？
然后，那个发卡就无声地落了下来。
cinema.storyEn:
The girl I saw through the narrow vent shone like she'd stepped right out of a fairytale.
She was the real princess — and I was just a prisoner.
Lord, she has so much already... would it be so wrong if I had just a tiny bit of it too?
That's when the hairpin silently fell.

cinema.name: 残冬梦迹
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
TOPS高层和督导调查团来的那天，她和真斗也刚好从学校返回，为了给贵客们的座驾腾位置，他们乘坐的空艇在附近盘旋了好久才降落。在二人满头大汗地穿过天桥时，大批记者正簇拥着贵客们从下方经过，她一眼就看到了那个女孩。那天晚上，她做了一个梦，被记者簇拥着从天桥下走过的人变成了她，然而在路的尽头，她看到了那把专门为她准备的王座…
已经很久没有再梦到类似的事了。她爬起来喝水，回想起白天听到的话：「什么专家组成的调查团，竟然让有钱人家的小姐混在里面充数！」
「阿釜，阿釜！」她拉开窗户小声呼唤，一个毛茸茸的身影立刻从窗外探出头来。「我有个好主意，明天晚上，我们去做点有趣的事吧。」
cinema.storyEn:
The day the TOPS executives and the Inspection Team arrived, she and Manato had just returned from school. Their airship had to circle overhead for ages, waiting for a place to land because the guests' vehicles took priority. Sweating as they hurried across the skybridge, they passed just above a throng of reporters surrounding the guests. That's when she spotted the girl. That night, she had a dream: it was her being swarmed by reporters, walking that same path under the bridge. And at the end of it... stood a throne, waiting just for her.
It had been a long time since she'd had a dream like that. She got up for a drink of water, replaying the words she'd overheard during the day: "A so-called expert Inspection Team, and they've got some rich girl tagging along just for show!"
"Kama, Kama!" She cracked open the window and whispered. A fuzzy little face popped up instantly from outside. "I've got a great idea. Tomorrow night... let's go do something fun."

cinema.name: 落地生根
cinema.description: 通过[招架支援]或[普通攻击：狸之帐]成功招架敌人攻击时额外获得1点[甜度点]，发动[支援突击：夹心硬糖射击]时可以长按【普通攻击键】进行蓄能，最多持续0.8秒，松开【普通攻击键】或蓄能至最大时间时，柚叶会额外发射强力炮弹攻击敌人。每蓄能0.4秒，柚叶都会消耗1点[甜度点]追加发射一枚强力炮弹，每颗追加强力炮弹攻击造成柚叶300%攻击力的物理伤害；[支援突击：夹心硬糖射击]的任意强力炮弹命中敌人时，会使全队角色[紊乱]效果的伤害倍率提升105%，持续40秒，最多叠加3层，每层单独结算持续时间，额外强力炮弹命中处于[甜蜜惊吓]状态的敌人时也会触发1次[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]攻击；柚叶蓄能过程中如果受到敌人攻击，会自动闪避敌人攻击并直接发动最大蓄能攻击。
cinema.descriptionEn: Gain 1 additional Sugar Points when successfully parrying an enemy attack using a Defensive Assist or Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak. When using Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot, hold [Basic Attack] to charge for up to 0.8 seconds. Releasing [Basic Attack] or reaching full charge fires an extra powerful shell at the enemy. For every 0.4s charged, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point to fire an additional powerful shell, each dealing 300% of her ATK as Physical DMG. If any powerful shell from Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot hits an enemy, all squad members' Disorder DMG Multiplier increases by 105% for 40s, and stacking up to 3 times, with each stack duration being calculated separately. In addition, if the powerful shell hits an enemy under Sweet Scare, it'll trigger 1 Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max attack. If Yuzuha is attacked while charging, she will automatically dodge the attack and immediately unleash the max-charged attack.
cinema.story:
听证会结束那天晚上，宝荣叔说要庆祝小枫拿到奖学金，于是释诡斋早早关了店，全家人一起去了饮茶仙。
席间，远在法努斯区的哥哥也打来电话祝贺，小堇和阿文则绘声绘色地讲着白天发生的事：学校里那只花斑猫丢了孩子，大家怎么找都找不到，今天中午，小猫竟然自己回来了。哥哥在电话里叹气：「阿文，一问你成绩你就转移话题，爸和柚叶不管你，我可要替他们管了！」全家人都笑了起来，只有宝荣叔不住地喃喃道：「返嚟就好啦，返嚟就好啦…」
cinema.storyEn:
The night the hearing ended, Baorong said they should celebrate Kaede getting a scholarship, so Mystic Wares closed early and the whole family went to Yum Cha Sin.
During the meal, her brother called from the far-off Faunus Quarter to offer his congratulations. While Sumire and A-Wen animatedly recounted the day's events: a calico cat at school had lost her kitten, and no one could find it — until, miraculously, it came back on its own at noon.
On the phone, her brother sighed, "A-Wen, every time I ask about your grades, you change the subject. If Dad and Yuzuha won't say anything, then I will!"
Everyone laughed — except Baorong, who just kept murmuring, "It came back, that's what matters... that it came back..."

1421.name: 潘引壶

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
作为放眼整个新艾利都也极为罕见的熊猫希人，潘引壶自儿时起便无任何亲人帮衬，独自在新艾利都摸爬滚打。没真正被饿过的人不会知道饥饿有多可怕，为了混口饭吃，潘引壶把自己能尝试的职业都做了一遍，最终因以太适性良好而成为了盗洞客。
成为盗洞客的他因一次偶然遇到了仪玄，在被暴打及点化后选择拜入云岿山门下，通过修炼术法净化自己日渐暴戾的心性。
由于拜入门下的时间较晚，他的师弟师妹实际上很少，主人，您就是其中之一，因此他会用给您开小灶、塞给您商店优惠券等方式来表达身为师兄对您的关爱。
profile.descriptionEn:
Being a Panda Thiren, an exceedingly rare sight in New Eridu, Pan Yinhu has scraped by on his own since he was a child. Only someone who's truly known starvation understands its terror, and to fill his belly he sampled every trade he could find. In the end, his remarkable Ether aptitude led him to become a Hollow Raider.
As a Hollow Raider, he had a chance encounter with Yixuan. Following a harsh beating and a sudden spiritual awakening, he opted to become a disciple of Yunkui Summit, where he now practices the mystic arts to cleanse his then-increasingly violent nature.
Because he joined the sect later than most, he actually has very few junior disciples — and you, Master, are one of them. As your senior, he shows his care by cooking special dishes just for you and constantly sneaking store coupons into your pockets.

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 每回想点外卖的时候，潘师兄都会跳出来阻止，说外卖不健康，想吃什么他下厨做给我们吃…都有好几个月没吃上外卖了！
profile.descriptionEn: Every time we're about to order takeout, Senior Yinhu immediately pipes up to stop us, saying takeout isn't good for you, then offers to whip up whatever we want in the kitchen... We haven't ordered takeout in months!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 但他的手艺确实没得挑剔，除了时不时肉会下得比较少…我都想多跟他学几道菜了。
profile.descriptionEn: His cooking really can't be beat, except for the fact he occasionally holds back on the meat... I really want to learn some of his recipes.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对潘引壶的印象：
·作为随便观的财务总管，每一枚丁尼都要花在刀刃上！
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Pan Yinhu:
· As the manager of Suibian Temple's funds, he makes sure not a single Denny goes to waste!

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: ·作为随便观的掌勺大厨，每一块叉烧都要攻陷同伴的味蕾！
profile.descriptionEn: · As Suibian Temple's head chef, he ensures every piece of char siu conquers his companions' taste buds!

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: ·作为随便观的新晋师兄，师弟师妹的想法都要无条件地支持！
profile.descriptionEn: · As Suibian Temple's newest senior, he's obliged to support his juniors' suggestions without question!

1421.description:
潘引壶，云岿山门下弟子，随便观的首席大厨兼财务管理人，使得一手好拳法，精通点穴术。
作为随便观里管钱的人，他深谙节流生财之道，5000丁尼的肉他能讲价到500丁尼，能在家自己做出来的物品他绝不会到外面购买，各大超市商店的优惠券他都能随手从身上掏出来。
拜他所赐，随便观的成员每天都能吃到美味而实惠的饭菜。作为掌勺大厨，他对于菜品的口味要求严格，且高度重视同伴们的评价。
此外，推测由于他长期的省钱行为，无论是随便观的总经费还是他自己的私人小金库，其数额都已经积攒到了能让人两眼一直的程度。
1421.descriptionEn:
Pan Yinhu, disciple of Yunkui Summit, serves as both the head chef and financial manager of Suibian Temple. He's proficient in martial arts, and an expert in pressure-point techniques.
As the one managing Suibian Temple's money, he's a master at keeping costs down and can bargain a 5,000 Denny piece of meat down to 500. If he can make something at home, he refuses to purchase it at a store, and no matter which big supermarket or shop you name, he's got a coupon for it tucked in his pocket.
Thanks to him, the members of Suibian Temple enjoy delicious yet budget-friendly meals every day. As the head of the kitchen, he demands precise flavor profiles and pays keen attention to his friends' opinions.
What's more, given his years of frugality, it's safe to assume that both the group's treasury and his secret piggy bank have ballooned to jaw-dropping levels.

skills.name: 普通攻击：极意连打
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的体术攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive melee attacks, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 特殊技：爆音点穴指
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前释放体术并丢出鞭炮，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a forward melee technique while tossing firecrackers, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：断脉破穴手
skills.description:
拥有[破劲]时点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
[特殊技：断脉破穴手]围绕怪物进行攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式可连续发动三次，每发动一次[特殊技：断脉破穴手]攻击，将消耗1点[破劲]。
潘引壶为当前操作中的角色时，招式发动期间受到伤害降低40%，抗打断等级提升，不为当前操作中的角色时，获得无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With Break Force, press [Special Attack]to activate:
Special Attack: Touch of Death attacks centered on the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
The skill can be chained up to three times. Each use of Special Attack: Touch of Death consumes 1 point of Break Force.
When Pan Yinhu is the active character, DMG received during the skill is reduced by 40% and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If he isn't the active character, he becomes Invulnerable.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
[强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠]向前方进行强力打击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时将获得3点[破劲]，当招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
通过此次[快速支援]上场的代理人将会获得核心被动提供的贯穿力加成，潘引壶会在换人后留在场上自动释放[特殊技：断脉破穴手]直至[破劲]耗尽后下场；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike unleashes a powerful strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Gain 3 points of Break Force on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
Agents who enter the field via this Quick Assist will gain the Sheer Force bonus from the Core Passive. After switching out, Pan Yinhu will stay on the field and automatically launch Special Attack: Touch of Death until his Break Force runs out, where he then leaves the field.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：身轻如燕
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：热油鼎盛
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前发动快速体术攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward melee attack, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：移峰倒海
skills.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Moving Mountains and Seas
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动体术攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：锅气灌顶
skills.nameEn: Chain Attack: Anointed with Wok Steam
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
坐上[铁锅]快速旋转冲撞，对路径上敌人造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hop onto the Iron Wok and spin rapidly to ram into enemies, dealing massive Physical DMG to all enemies on the way.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：满汉全席！
skills.nameEn: Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
施展术法将气劲凝作炒饭掀出，对敌人造成大量物理伤害，为全队角色回复160点生命值，并为全队角色施加8秒持续回复生命值的效果，每秒回复0.85%生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a technique that compresses qi into fried rice and catapults it at foes, dealing massive Physical DMG and healing all squad members for 160 HP, while also applying a 8s heal over time on all squad members, recovering 0.85% HP/s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
skills.levelNote: 显示基础技能等级 1–12；影画带来的额外等级不计入此选择。
skills.levelNoteEn: Base skill levels 1–12; bonus levels from Mindscapes are excluded.

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to 13.5% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.
