skills.name: 额外能力：食铁纳金
skills.description:
队伍中存在[命破]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
潘引壶发动[特殊技：断脉破穴手]命中敌人时对敌人施加[气绝]效果，使所有单位对其造成的伤害提升20%，[特殊技：断脉破穴手]命中敌人时将分别对敌人造成10秒[气绝]效果。该效果不可叠加，招式重复命中相同敌人时，该效果时长可延长。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Rupture character or shares the same Faction:
When Pan Yinhu hits an enemy with Special Attack: Touch of Death, the enemy suffers the Depleted Qi effect, increasing DMG from all units against the target by 20%. Each hit of Special Attack: Touch of Death inflicts a 10s Depleted Qi effect. This effect does not stack, but repeated hits on the same enemy will extend the duration.

cinema.name: 气劲护体
cinema.description: 所有单位对被施加[气绝]效果的敌人造成伤害时，造成的伤害额外提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi.
cinema.story:
云岿术法外可御以太流动，内可护经络筋骨。气劲如盾，刀枪不入，这便是潘引壶硬扛攻击的奥妙所在。
另，这招在和大叔大妈们比拼抢购超市促销商品时尤其管用。
cinema.storyEn:
This Yunkui technique wards off the external flow of Ether while reinforcing your inner meridians and muscles. With qi acting as a shield, no blade or spear can pierce it — this is Pan Yinhu's secret to enduring every blow.
Side note: this trick comes in extra handy when you're elbow-to-elbow with aunties and uncles fighting over supermarket sale items.

cinema.name: 云岿点穴手
cinema.description: 每消耗6点[破劲]，潘引壶将回复4点能量，[特殊技：断脉破穴手]命中敌人时对敌人造成的[气绝]效果将提升至12秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Special Attack: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.
cinema.story:
「嘿嘿，贼人，动弹不得了吧！」
「这招唤作云岿点穴手，既可痹体定身，也可打通经脉，乃我门派惩恶扬善之绝学也！」
「…诶，你说只是因为我手劲太大，把你身子给打麻了？…你就说能不能动吧！」
cinema.storyEn:
"Heh, can't move an inch now, can you, thief?"
"This technique is called Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike — it both paralyzes the body and clears the meridians — it's our sect's ultimate technique for punishing evil and upholding justice!"
"...Eh? You mean my grip was so strong that you just went numb? ...Alright then — can you move or not?"

cinema.name: 经外奇穴
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「这些个穴位，跟我们熊猫希人性质差不多。」
「又少又分散，归不进哪个具体的系统里，也没几个人真正研究过，凄凉哟。」
「但啥时候真当了那么一回奇兵，感觉又挺不错的，不是吗？」
cinema.storyEn:
"These pressure points are a lot like us Panda Thirens."
"They're few and scattered, don't fit into any one system, and hardly anyone's ever studied them. It's a shame."
"But they really catch people off guard as a surprise weapon. Pretty great, right?"

cinema.name: 特等上厨
cinema.description: [终结技：满汉全席！]为全队角色回复生命时，生命回复效果提升25%，持续回复效果的生命回复效果提升25%；发动[终结技：满汉全席！]时获得[储粮]效果，当队伍内任意角色损失生命值时，消耗[储粮]效果为其回复[终结技：满汉全席！]即时回复生命值50%的生命值，该效果不可叠加。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.
cinema.story:
初次下厨时，他差点把灶台点着。赶来救火的人里有个厨子，看着那堆烧糊了的食物，把还没用的鸡蛋下锅给他做了盘蛋炒饭。
他狼吞虎咽，热泪盈眶。抬起头来，只见厨子向他亮出一张纸，上面写着「100」。
「大师，我悟了！您是想告诉我烹饪要百折不挠是吧！」「不是，我是想说吃一口100丁尼，你吃了一百多口，该付钱了。」
从那以后，潘引壶坚持自己亲自下厨，且再也没搞砸过。这便是特级厨师的诞生过程。
cinema.storyEn:
The first time he cooked, he nearly set the stove on fire. Among those who rushed to help was a chef who, looking at the pile of burnt food, used the unused eggs to make him a plate of fried rice.
He wolfed it down with tears in his eyes. When he finally looked up, the cook was holding out a slip of paper with "100" written on it.
"I understand, Master! You're teaching me in cooking, you have to give it 100%, right?" "No, I'm saying it's 100 Dennies per bite, and you've had over a hundred bites. Time to pay up."
From that day on, Pan Yinhu insisted on cooking for himself and never messed up again. And that's how a first-class chef was born.

cinema.name: 「稀人」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
在这诺大的新艾利都，熊猫希人的存在实属罕有。他抗拒被人以稀奇的眼神打量，也早已习惯了无人帮衬的孤独生活。
直到拜入云岿山门下，他变得不再孤单。
同时，直到发现不少市民愿意为了和熊猫希人合影而付费…他也变得不再抗拒被人打量。
cinema.storyEn:
In the sprawling city of New Eridu, Panda Thirens are extremely rare. He's always bristled at curious stares and long ago gotten used to living a lonely life with nobody to support him.
It wasn't until he became an apprentice on Yunkui Summit that he stopped feeling so isolated.
And once he realized that many citizens would even pay to take a photo with a Panda Thiren... he no longer minded the stares.

cinema.name: 气穴论
cinema.description: [核心被动：脉中乾坤]提供的[通窍]将额外获得潘引壶初始攻击力6%的提升，该效果提供的贯穿力最多提升至720点。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
cinema.story:
「古人有云，气穴足有三百六十五处。其实人的活法亦是如此。」
「喏，从这张穴位图上选一个喜欢的。」
「它就代表了你现在的活法——在哪里，有啥用，都不重要。只要你喜欢，就够了。」
「至于选它出来有啥用，我想想…有了。下回师兄教训贼人时，就专攻这个穴位吧。」
cinema.storyEn:
"There's an old saying that there are 365 pressure points in the feet. Funny — it's the same with how we live our lives."
"Here — pick whichever point you like from this chart."
"That point represents your current way of life — where it is or what it does doesn't matter. As long as you like it, that's enough."
"And what good is choosing it, you ask? Let me think... Ah, of course. Next time I deal with some thieves, that's the point I'll target!"

1431.name: 叶瞬光

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
容纳青溟剑时，叶瞬光尚且年幼，却不得不从此背负远超年龄的责任。
她不被允许拥有玩具，总被教导学会成熟，所能做的只是一次又一次练习剑法——过量的压力都倾泻在她身上，而年幼的女孩只能选择接受。
某次情绪爆发后，她曾逃出山门，徘徊在澄辉坪上。而您则在此刻出现，递给她一包桂花糖，给予她一线暖意。

补充：如今叶瞬光最喜爱的糕点是桂花糕，或许也正因如此。
profile.descriptionEn:
When Ye Shunguang first took up the Qingming Sword, she was still just a child, suddenly burdened with responsibilities far beyond her age.
She wasn't allowed to own toys, was constantly pushed to be mature, and made to undertake constant sword training... The weight of it all pressed down on her, and she simply had to accept it.
After an emotional outburst, she once fled the sect and wandered across Failume Heights — where you appeared and handed her a small packet of osmanthus candy, offering a rare moment of warmth.

Addition: her favorite pastry now is osmanthus cake, perhaps for this very reason.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JAN 20

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 那个…小师姐可以天天来录像店吗？伊埃斯和我都很想你哦！
profile.descriptionEn: So, uh... can Xiao'Guang visit the video store every day? Eous and I both really miss her!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
小光总是非常温柔可靠，不管什么事情，只要交给了她，就肯定会被妥妥当当的完成…
唔…这就是传说中的「别人家的孩子」吗？
profile.descriptionEn:
Xiao'Guang is endlessly kind and reliable. Anything you entrust to her gets handled flawlessly...
Hmm... so this is what people mean by "the perfect child your parents always compare you to," huh?

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对叶瞬光的印象：
 · 所行处荆棘满地，她仍播撒象征希望的种子。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Ye Shunguang:
 · Though her road is lined with thorns, she continues to sow seeds that symbolize hope.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 命运无常，她却愿承担众生的重量。
profile.descriptionEn: · Fate may be unpredictable, but she's willing to shoulder the burdens of the world.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 她于黑夜中独行，直到拉住你的手。
profile.descriptionEn: · She walked alone through the dark night — until she took your hand.

1431.description:
叶瞬光是云岿山至宝青溟剑的剑主，仪玄的弟子，叶释渊的妹妹，也是一名天资卓绝的剑客。
她曾拥有美好的童年，然而旧都陷落时，她的父母为了援救民众逝去，一切幸福就此戛然而止。
从此她只能与兄长相依为命，直到被仪玄收养，拜入云岿山门下，并在后来被青溟剑选中，承担起掌剑的重任。

据闻，青溟剑的青睐与其说是祝福，反倒更像某种诅咒，它给予剑主虚狩级的战力，却剥夺他们的记忆与五感作为代价。
为了遏制青溟剑的副作用，仪玄师父为叶瞬光打造了一把剑鞘。目前来看似乎起到了作用，但这把武器的秘密仍然深不可测。
1431.descriptionEn:
Ye Shunguang is the Sword Keeper of Yunkui Summit's treasured Qingming Sword, a disciple of Yixuan, and the younger sister of Ye Shiyuan, as well as a swordswoman blessed with extraordinary talent.
She enjoyed a happy childhood until the fall of the old capital, when her parents lost their lives rescuing others, bringing all her happiness to an abrupt end.
From then on, she relied solely on her brother — up until Yixuan took them in, bringing them into Yunkui Summit. Later, she was chosen by the Qingming Sword, taking up the mantle and duty of Sword Keeper.

Rumor has it that the Qingming Sword's favor is less a blessing and more a kind of curse. Though it gives its Sword Keeper Void Hunter level power, it extracts a harsh cost — the loss of one's memories and five senses.
In order to subdue this side effect, Yixuan Shifu crafted a custom sword case for Ye Shunguang. It appears effective for the moment, but the true nature of the weapon is still shrouded in mystery.

skills.name: 普通攻击：快剑
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
第四段攻击发动后，可以衔接[冲刺攻击：如影疾行]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Can be chained into Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash after the 4th hit.

skills.name: 普通攻击：流云剑意
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速发动多道剑气，造成物理伤害，可以通过长按延长攻击；
招式发动期间，抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing Physical DMG. Hold to extend the attack.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：明心境·分水行
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
skills.description:
在[明心境]状态下并处于地面时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
第三段攻击发动时，若受到敌人攻击，可触发格挡效果，免疫该次伤害；
若拥有[青溟剑势]，第三段攻击将被替换为[普通攻击：明心境·扶摇势]。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and on the ground, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
If she possesses Qingming Sword Force, the 3rd hit is replaced with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

skills.name: 普通攻击：明心境·扶摇势
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
skills.description:
在[明心境]状态下，拥有[青溟剑势]时，第二段 [普通攻击：明心境·分水行] 后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速发动升空攻击，对敌人造成物理伤害，并进入空中状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, after the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches a swift rising attack, dealing Physical DMG and entering an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：明心境·斩流光 极
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
skills.description:
在[普通攻击：明心境·斩流光 灭]发动后，拥有[青溟剑势]时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行大范围斩击，造成大量物理伤害，命中敌人时会消耗1点[青溟剑势]；
招式发动时，若受到敌人攻击，可触发格挡效果，免疫该次伤害，并提升招式打断等级；
招式发动后，若拥有[青溟剑势]，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以消耗1点[青溟剑势]，发动一段[强化特殊技：明心境·飞光]，发动后会自动衔接[普通攻击：明心境·扶摇势]，并进入空中状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After activating Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation, and with Qingming Sword Force, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 1 point of Qingming Sword Force is consumed.
If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.
After using this skill and with Qingming Sword Force, press [EX Special Attack] to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light. This skill is automatically followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：明心境·斩流光
skills.description:
在[明心境]状态下，并处于空中时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前下方进行至多两段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
发动期间不会退出[明心境]状态；
点按 【强化特殊技键】 或 【闪避键】 可以直接发动[普通攻击：明心境·斩流光 灭]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
In the Enlightened Mind state, and while airborne, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Press [EX Special Attack] or [Dodge] to follow up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：明心境·斩流光 灭
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
skills.description:
发动第二段[普通攻击：明心境·斩流光]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前下方进行下坠攻击，并进入地面状态，造成物理伤害；
发动时若自身拥有2点及以上[青溟剑势]，则向前下方进行大范围下坠攻击，造成大量物理伤害，命中敌人时，会消耗2点[青溟剑势]，并获得[观止]效果；招式发动后，若拥有[青溟剑势]，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以消耗1点[青溟剑势]，发动一段[强化特殊技：明心境·飞光]，发动后可快速衔接[普通攻击：明心境·斩流光 极]；
发动期间不会退出[明心境]状态；
招式发动时，若受到敌人攻击，可触发格挡效果，免疫该次伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing Physical DMG.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of Qingming Sword Force, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 2 points of Qingming Sword Force are consumed, granting the Culmination effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses Qingming Sword Force, press [EX Special Attack] to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, which can be quickly followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 观止
skills.description: 发动[强化特殊技：明心境·飞光]期间，每次消耗[青溟剑势]时，若拥有[观止]效果，则不消耗[青溟剑势]，改为消耗[观止]效果，该效果不可叠加，持续至该次[明心境]状态结束。
skills.descriptionEn: During EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, each time Qingming Sword Force is consumed while Culmination is active, the Qingming Sword Force cost is replaced by consuming Culmination instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current Enlightened Mind ends.

skills.name: 特殊技：引沧澜
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
若拥有闪避次数，则消耗1次闪避次数并视为同时发动了[闪避]；
若未拥有闪避次数或未触发[极限闪避]，对敌人发动快速剑气攻击，造成物理伤害；
若此时触发了[极限闪避]，对敌人发动飞剑攻击，造成物理伤害，并可直接衔接第二段[普通攻击：快剑]；
招式发动期间拥有短暂无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If no dodge is available or a Perfect Dodge is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals Physical DMG.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing Physical DMG, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Swiftedge.
Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：定风波
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
对敌人造成突进斩击和飞剑攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
发动时可以闪避敌人的攻击；
发动后获得1点[青溟剑势]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill.
After this skill is used, gain 1 point of Qingming Sword Force.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：明心境·拂衣去
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
skills.description:
在[明心境]状态下，处于地面状态时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
发动快速的后撤斩击，造成物理伤害；
若拥有闪避次数，则消耗1次闪避次数并视为同时发动了[闪避]；
若此时触发了[极限闪避]，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以快速发动[普通攻击：明心境·斩流光 极]，并进入[极限视域]；
且该次[普通攻击：明心境·斩流光 极]发动后，可以直接衔接[普通攻击：明心境·扶摇势]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and grounded, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing Physical DMG.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, press [Basic Attack] to quickly activate Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum and enter Vital View.
After this Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum activates, it can be immediately followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：明心境·飞光
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
skills.description:
在[明心境]状态下，拥有[青溟剑势]时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
发动快速斩击，造成大量物理伤害并持续快速消耗[青溟剑势]，直至耗尽[青溟剑势]；
若[青溟剑势]不足或停止长按 【强化特殊技键】 ，招式会提前结束；
发动期间不会退出[明心境]状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
In the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive Physical DMG while rapidly consuming Qingming Sword Force until none remains.
The skill ends early if Qingming Sword Force is insufficient or if [EX Special Attack] is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：明心境·归尘
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust
skills.description:
在[明心境]状态下，点按 【终结技键】 或[青溟剑势]耗尽时长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
对大范围敌人造成大量物理伤害；
发动期间不会退出[明心境]状态；
招式发动后，关闭[以太帷幕·决裁]退出[明心境]状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
In the Enlightened Mind state, press [Ultimate] or hold [EX Special Attack] when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG to enemies in a large area.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, Ether Veil: Verdict is removed and the Enlightened Mind state ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：不留行
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
在[明心境]状态下，若触发[极限闪避]，点按 【普通攻击键】 可发动[普通攻击：明心境·扶摇势]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
During the Enlightened Mind state, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, press [Basic Attack] to activate Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

skills.name: 闪避：逍遥云踪
skills.description:
拖曳摇杆时长按 【闪避键】 发动：
进入高速移动状态，使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下。
skills.descriptionEn:
While tilting the joystick, hold [Dodge] to activate:
Enters a high-speed movement state. Steer with the joystick, and release the joystick to stop.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：如影疾行
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：燕袭
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
跃起并向前方进行刺击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：斩邪祟
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：逐云惊霆
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
召唤剑阵，进入[明心境]状态，开启[以太帷幕·决裁]，并获得6点[青溟剑势]，对敌人造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，若消耗了喧响值，则可以在该次[明心境]中点按 【终结技键】 发动不消耗喧响值的[终结技：斩妄开天]；
招式发动后，将处于空中状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Summons a sword formation and enter the Enlightened Mind state, activating an Ether Veil: Verdict while also gaining 6 Qingming Sword Force. This skill deals massive Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press [Ultimate] while in this Enlightened Mind state to launch an Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens that doesn't consume Decibels.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：明心境·掣惊雷
skills.nameEn: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
skills.description:
在[明心境]状态下，触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
发动期间不会退出[明心境]状态；
招式发动后，将处于空中状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, and when a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：斩妄开天
skills.description:
消耗喧响值发动[终结技：逐云惊霆]后，在[明心境]状态下，点按 【终结技键】 或[青溟剑势]消耗尽后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
召唤巨剑，对敌人造成大量物理伤害；
发动期间不会退出[明心境]状态；
招式发动后，会退出[明心境]并关闭[以太帷幕·决裁]；
该招式不消耗喧响值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After consuming Decibels to launch Ultimate: Chasing Storms and while in the Enlightened Mind state, press [Ultimate] or hold [EX Special Attack] when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Summons a massive blade, dealing massive Physical DMG to enemies.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, the Enlightened Mind state ends, and Ether Veil: Verdict is removed.
This skill doesn't consume Decibels.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 登场技：照影
skills.description:
拥有6点[青溟剑势]时，在非[明心境]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 或接战状态下点按 【切换键】 从后场切换至前场发动：
进入[明心境]，开启[以太帷幕·决裁]；
对前方大范围敌人造成物理伤害；
招式发动时视为发动[快速支援]；
招式发动后，将处于空中状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With 6 Qingming Sword Force and while not in the Enlightened Mind state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate, or press [Switch] while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate:
Enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict.
Deals Physical DMG to enemies in a large area in front.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Enters the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：援守
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
跃起并向前方进行刺击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：止戈
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：归去时
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：明心境·策应
skills.nameEn: Quick Assist: Enlightened Mind - Tactical Support
skills.description:
在[明心境]状态下，当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方进行一次斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, when the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：明心境·抱一
skills.description:
在[明心境]状态下，发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and after a Defensive Assist, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：照破无明
skills.description:
非[明心境]状态且未拥有6点[青溟剑势]时，部分攻击会缓慢积攒[青溟剑势]；任意方式获得[青溟剑势]时，每溢出1点[青溟剑势]，将转化为1层[载物]效果，至多叠加3层，在退出[明心境]状态时，会消耗所有[载物]获得对应层数的[青溟剑势]。
进入战场时，获得[合道]效果，暴击率提升15%，造成的伤害提升10%。
释放[终结技：逐云惊霆]或[登场技：照影]后，叶瞬光将进入[明心境]状态，并开启[以太帷幕·决裁]；[以太帷幕·决裁]与[明心境]持续时间相同，持续16秒，处于后场时，持续时间不再减少；处于[明心境]状态下，叶瞬光将使用更加强力的招式，造成的物理伤害均为凛刃伤害。
[以太帷幕·决裁]持续期间，敌人进入[以太帷幕·决裁]时，将基于其此时的失衡易伤倍率为其附加帷幕易伤效果，期间叶瞬光发动的招式对敌人造成伤害时都将不计算敌人的失衡易伤加成，转而计算帷幕易伤加成；帷幕易伤加成上限为110%，[以太帷幕·决裁]结束时移除帷幕易伤效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When not in the Enlightened Mind state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build Qingming Sword Force. Whenever Qingming Sword Force is gained by any means, each 1 point of Qingming Sword Force that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of Bearer, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the Enlightened Mind state, all Bearer stacks are consumed to grant the same number of Qingming Sword Force stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain Unity, increasing CRIT Rate by 15% and DMG by 10%.
When Ultimate: Chasing Storms or Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict. Ether Veil: Verdict has the same duration as Enlightened Mind. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the Enlightened Mind state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all Physical DMG dealt by her skills becomes Honed Edge DMG.
While Ether Veil: Verdict is active, when an enemy enters Ether Veil: Verdict, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when Ether Veil: Verdict ends.

Ether Veil: Verdict has the same duration as Enlightened Mind. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the Enlightened Mind state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all Physical DMG dealt by her skills becomes Honed Edge DMG.

skills.name: 额外能力：溯影惊鸿
skills.description:
队伍中存在[支援]或[防护]角色时触发：
队友开启任意[以太帷幕]时，获得3点[青溟剑势]，若自身已经处于[明心境]状态，则会转化为3层[载物]效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Defense character:
When a squadmate activates any Ether Veil, gain 3 points of Qingming Sword Force. If already in the Enlightened Mind state, this is instead converted into 3 stacks of Bearer.

cinema.name: 梦中身
cinema.description:
进入战场时，获得6点[青溟剑势]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
[核心被动：照破无明]中[合道]效果额外使造成的伤害提升10%，无视目标20%防御力。
cinema.descriptionEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 Qingming Sword Force. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
The Unity effect from Core Passive: Burning Clarity increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.
cinema.story:
无数次午夜梦回，她都会回想起那一天——
剑刃嗡鸣，长剑认主，契约就此缔结。
那究竟是幸运，亦或是诅咒？

…无人知晓这个问题的答案，然而从那一日开始，她的命运便牵系于此剑之上。
cinema.storyEn:
Countless times, in the dead of night, she finds herself returning to that day...
Steel cried out, the sword acknowledged its wielder, and a contract was forged.
Was it a blessing, or a curse?

...No one knows the answer. Yet from that day on, her fate became bound to the sword.

cinema.name: 光与影
cinema.description: [载物]可叠加层数提升至6层，[观止]可叠加至9层；[明心境]状态下，每消耗1点[青溟剑势]，则获得1层[观止]效果；[强化特殊技：明心境·飞光]和[终结技：斩妄开天]造成的伤害无视目标40%防御力。
cinema.descriptionEn: The max stack count of Bearer increases to 6, and Culmination can stack up to 9 times. While in the Enlightened Mind state, each point of Qingming Sword Force consumed grants 1 stack of Culmination. EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens's DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.
cinema.story:
岁月流淌，寒来暑往。
她所拥有的天地，不过云岿山上这小小一隅，山间四时便是能看到的所有景象。
在漫长无尽的寂寥与如影随形的恐惧中，「另一个自己」悄然诞生。

「…我是她的一部分，从始至终，未曾分离。」
「若她是光，那我就是影子。若她是高悬的圣像，那我就是匍匐的凡人。」
「与她不同，我不愿成为什么『英雄』…」
「…我只想活下去。」
cinema.storyEn:
Time flowed on, winters giving way to summers.
Her entire world amounted to this tiny stretch of Yunkui Summit, the changing seasons of the mountain were all she would ever see.
In endless solitude and ever-present fear, "another self" quietly came into being.

"...I am a part of her. From beginning to end, we were never apart."
"If she is the light, then I am the shadow. If she stands as a lofty idol, then I am the mortal who crawls below."
"Unlike her, I have no wish to become some kind of 'hero'..."
"...I just want to survive."

cinema.name: 剑客行
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
绝世的名剑藏于深山，敛尽锋芒。
而它出鞘之时，长剑所及寒芒千丈，风雪过处仍余孤光耀目。

「剑客是什么？」
「不过是…一往无前的勇气，与斩开一切的决心。」
cinema.storyEn:
A peerless famed sword lies hidden deep in the mountains, its edge fully restrained.
But once unsheathed, its icy light reaches far and wide, even after storms of wind and snow, a single piercing light endures.

"What is someone who wields a blade?"
"Nothing more than... the courage to press forward without hesitation, and the resolve to cut through anything."

cinema.name: 共黯尘
cinema.description: 进入战场时，获得1000点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；[以太帷幕·决裁]提供的帷幕易伤加成上限提升至200%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. The Vulnerability bonus provided by Ether Veil: Verdict is increased to a maximum of 200%.
cinema.story:
宏大的愿景下潜藏着谎言，所谓的拯救却需得燃尽自身。
命运于她从无怜悯，而她欣然奔赴最后的结局。

「我知道的。」
「我的一生都会与『失去』共存。」
「我自愿接受这一切…」
「…我选择去成为这样的人。」
cinema.storyEn:
Hidden beneath a grand vision was a lie, where salvation came only by burning oneself to ash.
Fate showed her no mercy, yet she willingly met her end.

"I understand."
"I will live my whole life alongside 'loss'."
"I willingly accept everything..."
"...This is the person I choose to be."

cinema.name: 微光引
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「…我想，我终究还是那个『幸运』的孩子。」
「秽息不会淹没我，灾难不会吞噬我。」
「即便是青溟剑，也无法将我拽进漆黑不见底的深渊…」

「哥哥、师父、随便观的大家…还有你。」
「…我知道，你们会一直等着我。」
如此，纵使前路棘刺满地，亦存微光照亮旅途。
cinema.storyEn:
"...I suppose, in the end, I'm still that 'lucky' child."
"Miasma won't overwhelm me, disaster won't swallow me."
"Even the Qingming Sword can't drag me into that pitch-black, bottomless abyss..."

"My brother, Shifu, everyone at Suibian Temple... and you."
"...I know you'll all keep waiting for me."
And so, even if the road ahead is filled with thorns, a faint light still guides the way.

cinema.name: 明灯愿
cinema.description: 进入战场时，获得2层[明灯愿]；每次进入[明心境]状态会获得1层[明灯愿]，至多叠加4层；拥有3层[明灯愿]时，将[强化特殊技：明心境·归尘]替换为[终结技：斩妄开天]，发动此[终结技：斩妄开天]时，消耗3层[明灯愿]；[强化特殊技：明心境·归尘]和[终结技：斩妄开天]最后一击额外造成1500%攻击力的物理伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of Lantern Wish. When entering the Enlightened Mind state, gains 1 stack of Lantern Wish, stacking up to 4 times. With 3 stacks of Lantern Wish, EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust is replaced with Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens. When this Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of Lantern Wish. The last hit of Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens deal 1,500% of ATK as additional Physical DMG.
cinema.story:
她曾孑然一身，独行于黑暗；
又执剑奔赴灾厄，青溟出鞘之时，一瞬的虹光划破长空，照彻静寂黑暗之地。

「…我想成为万千萤火中的一盏。」
「天总会亮的。无论黑夜多么漫长，白昼终将到来。」
「在遥远的过去，和遥远的未来，一定也有无数人做出了和我一样的选择。我们…从不孤单。」
cinema.storyEn:
Once, she stood alone, walking through the dark.
Then she took up her sword and rushed toward disaster. As Qingming left its sheath, a fleeting arc of light split the sky, illuminating that silent, shadowed land.

"...I want to be one light among countless fireflies."
"The sun will rise. No matter how long the night lasts, dawn always comes."
"In the distant past, and in the distant future, there must be countless others who made the same choice as me. We... were never alone."

1441.name: 真斗

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
过分的率真与亲和力偶尔也会给真斗带来一些意料之外的「麻烦」。当他出现在菜市场或者其他街坊众多的地方，他总能引起不少人的注意。热情的店主、摊贩，路过的邻居朋友们，总是乐于将自己手头上能找到的最好的东西当做礼物塞到真斗的怀里，嘱咐他各种各样琐碎而温馨的小事。

真斗在父母去世后很快学会了照顾自己，他掌握了出色的厨艺，甚至能缝补好阿青与阿月在玩闹时无意中弄破的衣服。

在企业校的实习里，真斗也受到了热烈的欢迎。在这种环境下，他难以控制力量的问题反倒成了矿场工人们最好的助力。
profile.descriptionEn:
At times, Manato's disarming honesty and friendly nature lead to unexpected trouble. Whenever he shows up at the market or anywhere crowded with locals, he can't help but draw attention. Cheerful shop owners, stall vendors, and neighbors passing by love slipping their finest items to him as presents, along with warm reminders of little everyday matters.

After his parents passed away, Manato quickly learned how to take care of himself. He became an excellent cook and could even mend the clothes A-Cing and A-Yuet tore while playing.

At his company affiliated school internship, Manato was also greeted with enthusiasm. In such an environment, his problem of not being able to hold back his strength proved to be the best support the miners could ask for.

1441.description:
狛野真斗，怪啖屋成员之一，同好会里最为可靠的「执行人」。他在旧都陷落里失去了家人，独自在卫非地长大时，意外地收养了一对流落在街头的孩子，阿青与阿月。在那之后，他们成为了相依为命的家人，尽管这是一个稍显年轻的家庭，但对于真斗而言，他很希望能照顾好这个新家庭的所有人。
真斗目前就读于市内一所企业校内，也是企业校传闻里可怕的「校霸」。其中的原因大概只是因为长相很凶狠，但实际上，真斗远比外表看起来更加温和宽厚。
起先，真斗确实想做些什么来改变他人对于「校霸」的误解，但因为种种原因，他的努力没能取得明显的成效。但真斗的乐观精神让他很快意识到了「校霸」的身份并非只有坏处，他能利用这个身份躲过不必要的社交活动，享受不被陌生人打扰的生活，甚至能作为「校霸」打听某些学校里的怪谈消息，保护真正遭到霸凌的同学们。
但就学习成绩而言，他确实很符合企业校「校霸」的身份。
1441.descriptionEn:
Komano Manato, a member of Spook Shack and an exceptionally reliable person. Having lost his family in the fall of the old capital, he grew up alone in Waifei Peninsula until the day he happened to adopt two street children, A-Cing and A-Yuet. Since then, the three have lived as a family, depending on one another. It may be a young household, but to Manato, nothing matters more than looking after them.
Manato is currently enrolled at a company affiliated school in the city, where rumors paint him as the terrifying "school delinquent." The label likely comes from his intimidating appearance, though in reality, he's far more soft-hearted and generous than he seems.
At first, Manato really did want to do something to clear up the misunderstanding about being a delinquent, but for various reasons, his efforts didn't make much of an impact. Still, his optimism soon led him to realize that the title wasn't all bad. It let him dodge unnecessary social events, live without being bothered by strangers, and even leverage the "delinquent" image to sniff out stories of school ghost tales, all while standing up for classmates suffering from actual bullying.
But when it comes to grades, he really does live up to the "school delinquent" label of a company affiliated school student.

skills.name: 普通攻击：炽风斩
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
在每一段攻击的发动阶段，点按 【特殊技键】 将触发[烬风]，使此次攻击造成更高火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
During each slash, pressing [Special Attack] triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to deal increased Fire DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：炽风·胧切
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
skills.description:
在[熔锋]状态下点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动时，如果真斗的生命值在30%以上，则消耗3.5%最大生命值。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Molten Edge state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleash up to four forward slashes, dealing Fire DMG.
If Manato's HP is above 30% when the skill is activated, 3.5% of his Max HP will be consumed.

skills.name: 特殊技：归烬
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方斩击敌人，造成火属性伤害；
如果招式发动期间受到敌人攻击，在发动斩击时回复20%已损失生命值，[特殊技：归烬]和[特殊技：归烬·舍身]的生命回复效果每20秒最多触发一次；
如果招式发动期间受到敌人攻击，强化此次斩击；
招式发动期间受到伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：归烬·舍身
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
skills.description:
长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
进入蓄力状态，最多消耗10%最大生命值并回复100点[炽心]，最多消耗生命值至最大生命值的30%；
松开按键时，发动[特殊技：归烬]，如果招式发动期间受到敌人攻击，在发动斩击时回复20%已损失生命值，[特殊技：归烬]和[特殊技：归烬·舍身]的生命回复效果每20秒最多触发一次；
如果招式发动期间受到敌人攻击或者蓄力达到一定时长，强化此次斩击；
招式发动期间受到伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 Blazing Heart. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate Special Attack: Return to Ashes. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：归烬·天坠
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
skills.description:
在[熔锋]状态下，闪能足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
跳起并发动向前方敌人发动下落斩击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复33%最大生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：曜刃
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：曜刃·残心
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行肩撞攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a shoulder slam forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：曜刃·掠阵
skills.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击和拳击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：极炽炎爆
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
丢出手中的剑，随后冲向敌人引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：无想荒魂
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
跳起并发动向前方敌人发动下落斩击，随后引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：孤影·归阵
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击和拳击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：孤影·岳峙
skills.nameEn: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值，并造成火属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复75点[炽心]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, inflicting massive Daze and dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 75 Blazing Heart upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：孤影·断獠
skills.nameEn: Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多段斩击，造成火属性伤害；
连点时，可以连续斩击敌人，最多额外连续斩击7次；
连续斩击时，如果真斗的生命值在30%以上，则消耗2%最大生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：熔锋之势
skills.description:
真斗会额外根据自身最大生命值提高贯穿力，每1点最大生命值将提高0.1点贯穿力；
真斗发动招式造成的火属性伤害均为贯穿伤害，无视敌人防御，使用贯穿力作为招式伤害倍率；
真斗发动[特殊技：归烬·舍身]或[招架支援]时，会累积[炽心]，最多累积100点；当[炽心]累积至75点时，真斗将进入[熔锋]状态，[熔锋]状态下，真斗每秒消耗3.3点[炽心]，[炽心]耗尽时，退出[熔锋]状态；
[熔锋]状态下，真斗的[普通攻击]获得强化，并可以发动[强化特殊技：归烬·天坠]；
真斗在[普通攻击：炽风·胧切]或[支援突击]的连续斩击中消耗生命值时，使此次攻击的暴击伤害提升25%，闪能回复效率提升100%；
[熔锋]状态下，真斗的暴击率提升10%，火属性伤害提升10%。
skills.descriptionEn:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice or a Defensive Assist, he accumulates Blazing Heart, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 Blazing Heart, Manato enters the Molten Edge state. While in the Molten Edge state, Manato consumes 3.3 Blazing Heart per second. When Blazing Heart is fully depleted, he exits Molten Edge.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's Basic Attacks are enhanced, and he can use EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall.
When consuming HP during Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes from an Assist Follow-Up, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by 25%, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his Fire DMG increases by 10%.

When Manato uses Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice or a Defensive Assist, he accumulates Blazing Heart, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 Blazing Heart, Manato enters the Molten Edge state. While in the Molten Edge state, Manato consumes 3.3 Blazing Heart per second. When Blazing Heart is fully depleted, he exits Molten Edge.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's Basic Attacks are enhanced, and he can use EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall.
When consuming HP during Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes from an Assist Follow-Up, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by 33.3%, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his Fire DMG increases by 13.3%.

skills.name: 额外能力：复燃之心
skills.description:
队伍中存在[支援]或[击破]角色时触发：
真斗发动终结技时，获得8层[残焰]，发动连携技时，获得4层[残焰]，持续60秒，最多叠加20层，重复触发时刷新持续时间；真斗发动[普通攻击：炽风·胧切]或[支援突击]的连续斩击时，如果生命值低于100%最大生命值，则消耗一层[残焰]，回复2%最大生命值。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
When Manato uses his Ultimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes of an Assist Follow-Up, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.

cinema.name: 流浪生存法则
cinema.description: 真斗的生命值降低时，累积已损失生命值，每有相当于最大生命值1%的已损失生命值使[支援突击]和[普通攻击]造成的火属性伤害提升0.4%，最多提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Whenever Manato loses HP, the amount of HP lost is tallied. Each 1% of his Max HP tallied increases the Fire DMG of Assist Follow-Ups and Basic Attacks by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%.
cinema.story:
不幸的孩子都是相似的。
曾经亲切的呼唤、温暖的灯光、欢快的约定…未经告别就猝然沉没；因为无形无状，所以再尖锐的獠牙也无法咬紧、再锋利的指甲也无法攥住。
「我什么都能吃，又不太怕冷——如果说有什么『活下来的秘诀』，也许就是这些。」
cinema.storyEn:
Unfortunate children are all alike.
The once-kind voices, the warm lights, the joyful promises... all vanished without a farewell. Being formless, even the sharpest fangs could not hold them, nor the sharpest claws grasp them.
"I can eat just about anything, and I'm not too afraid of the cold — if there's a 'secret to surviving,' maybe it's just that."

cinema.name: 昼夜、厨房与爱
cinema.description: [熔锋]状态下，真斗无视目标8%火属性伤害抗性；[特殊技：归烬]或[特殊技：归烬·舍身]发动期间受到敌人攻击后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动[支援突击]。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Molten Edge state, Manato ignores 8% of a target's Fire RES. After being hit by an enemy while using Special Attack: Return to Ashes or Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, press [Basic Attack] to trigger an Assist Follow-Up.
cinema.story:
和谐的家庭关系也许就是这样——真斗、阿青和阿月，每个人都觉得自己是「被捡回家」的幸运儿。
如果说还有什么值得争吵的事情，也许只剩下「最后一筷子青菜到底该谁吃」。
「真的不好吃吗？那我下次再去饮茶仙问问，是不是有哪一步搞错了…」
「…商业机密？！可是上次…我只是站着，那个厨师就全告诉我了。」
cinema.storyEn:
Perhaps this is what a peaceful family is — Manato, A-Cing, and A-Yuet all think of themselves as the fortunate "child picked up and brought home."
If there's anything left worth arguing about, it's probably just "who should eat the last bit of vegetables."
"It doesn't taste good? I'll ask at Yum Cha Sin if maybe I made a mistake somewhere..."
"...Trade secret?! But last time... I just stood there and the chef told me everything."

cinema.name: 踏入怪谈世界
cinema.nameEn: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
在论坛站稳脚跟的第一步，是起一个朗朗上口的昵称——所有人都觉得自己并不擅长此道，但对于偶尔要留校补考文学课的犬希人来说，这尤其困难。
「…你不是已经知道了吗。就是那个、那个…咳，『泅珑de孤鬼』。」
「——你明明就听清楚了！」
「可恶。总有一天，我要改成『再提曾用名就空洞见』。」
cinema.storyEn:
Getting established on a forum starts with a memorable nickname — everyone thinks they're bad at it, but for a dog Thiren who sometimes has to stay back for make-up exams in literature, it's especially tough.
"...You already know it, don't you? It's, uh... ahem, SailumeSadLoneGhost"
"—You heard me!"
"Damn it. One of these days, I'm changing it to 'Mention My Old Name Again and I'll See You in the Hollow.'"

cinema.name: 幼年的誓言
cinema.description: 最大生命值提升8%；[特殊技：归烬]和[特殊技：归烬·舍身]发动期间，真斗受到致命伤害时不会在招式发动期间战败退场，生命值最多降低至1，10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Max HP increases by 8%. During Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
cinema.story:
把自己想象成一头目光冷冽的孤狼，也许是每位青少年都会做的事…更何况，真斗在这件事上更具优势。
如果不是溺想者的出现，他本可以和别人一样假装无事发生。
「都说了，那只是我八岁时候的想法——」
「『朋友』就是这样吗…你们确实没把我当作脆弱的人，但也没把我当作人。」
cinema.storyEn:
Maybe every teenager imagines themselves as a lone wolf with cold eyes... but Manato had an edge in that regard.
If not for the drowned ideals, he could have gone on pretending nothing had ever happened, just like everyone else.
"Like I said, that was just how I thought when I was eight—"
"So this is what a 'friend' is... You didn't treat me like I was fragile, but sometimes you don't treat me like a person either."

cinema.name: 孤影归群
cinema.nameEn: Lone Shadow Returns to the Pack
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
事实上，即使有外形上的天然隔阂，真斗依然很受大家的欢迎。
有人与他结成了友谊、有人想要寻求他的庇护，还有人…想找他帮忙打广告。
「抱歉，我可能不是很适合为你的店铺做宣传。」
「可我没有做什么『卧推』。除非你指的是…被以骸按在地上的时候，用胳膊推起重剑、抵挡它们乱挠的爪子？」
cinema.storyEn:
In truth, despite the barrier his appearance put up, Manato was popular with everyone.
Some made friends with him, some looked to him for protection, and some... tried to rope him into advertising.
"Sorry, I'm probably not the right choice to promote your shop."
"As for 'bench pressing,' I've never done it — unless you're referring to... being pinned by Ethereals and pushing up my greatsword to keep their claws off me?"

cinema.name: 越过昔年梦
cinema.description: [特殊技：归烬]命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，真斗回复75点[炽心]，获得4层[残焰]，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动[支援突击]，获得[残焰]的效果在20秒内最多触发一次；[支援突击]命中敌人时，造成的火属性伤害提升3%，持续8秒，最多叠加5层，重复触发刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Special Attack: Return to Ashes hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing [Basic Attack] will launch an Assist Follow-Up. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his Assist Follow-Up hits an enemy, Manato's Fire DMG increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
越过昔年的孤勇之梦，真斗拥抱了珍视的朋友们。

但他偶尔还是会因为「朋友」而受挫，比如…在卫非地特色老火靓汤店。
「我说要为你们『殿后』，不是这种——在喝椰子鸡汤的时候殿后。」
「可是，喝蝎子汤的时候，怎么又轮到我冲锋了？」
…最后还是冲锋了。
cinema.storyEn:
Manato set aside the dream of lone courage and embraced the friends he held dear.
Of course, these friends could still cause him trouble, like at Waifei Peninsula's specialty soup shop.
"When I said I'd cover the rear, I didn't mean while drinking coconut chicken soup."
"Then how come I'm the one on the front lines when it's scorpion soup?"
...But he charged ahead anyway.

1451.name: 卢西娅

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
卢西娅的父亲供职于防卫军的特别部队，由于事务繁忙每年只能回家一次。对于幼年的卢西娅来说，这段父亲陪伴的时光本身也是一种奖励。
在某次休假过程中，卢西娅的父亲接到了紧急指令，不得不立刻离开。临行前，为了安抚哭闹不休的女儿，他哄卢西娅蒙住眼睛玩捉迷藏，而当卢西娅倒数完睁眼时，父亲早已离开，从此再也没能回来。
多年后，在前往「小镇」的行动中，卢西娅与已经被侵蚀成为「彷徨猎手」的父亲重逢。在轻盈的儿歌哼唱声中，时隔许多年的光阴，卢西娅完成了未尽的捉迷藏游戏。「彷徨猎手」放下了被秽息侵染的执念，缓缓消散。他们在此地重逢，也于此地告别。
profile.descriptionEn:
Lucia's father worked with the Defense Force's special forces, and because of his demanding duties, he could only return home once a year. For young Lucia, that time with him felt like a reward in itself.
While on leave one time, Lucia's father received an emergency order and had to depart at once. To calm his crying daughter before leaving, he coaxed her into covering her eyes for a game of hide-and-seek. By the time she finished counting and opened them, he was already gone, never to return again.
Years later, during an operation in the Town, Lucia came face-to-face with her father, now corrupted into the Wandering Hunter. To the soft tune of a nursery rhyme, she at last brought their unfinished hide-and-seek to an end. The Wandering Hunter laid down his obsession, tainted by miasma, and slowly faded away. Their reunion took place here — as did their farewell.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: MAR 17

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
卢西娅喜欢一个人在空洞旅行、搜寻以骸；也经常带着零食敲开窗户、钻进录像店看一场电影…
她总是高高兴兴地出现在各种地方，完全就是那种会在夜里飞来飞去的小精灵！
profile.descriptionEn:
Lucia enjoys traveling the Hollows alone and tracking down Ethereals. She also often shows up with snacks, tapping on the window before slipping into the video store to watch a movie...
She's always popping up in different places with a bright smile — just like a little sprite flitting through the night!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
自从迷上了卢西娅的「邦布怪谈」，伊埃斯就再也不按时睡觉了…
现在它总是守在前台，竖起耳朵听敲窗户的动静，真是伤脑筋啊。
profile.descriptionEn:
Ever since getting hooked on Lucia's Bangboo ghost stories, Eous has stopped going to bed on time...
Now it just camps out at the front desk, ears pricked for the sound of tapping on the window... What a headache.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对卢西娅的印象：
 · 踏着夜色前来，如同一个星空下的谜团。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Lucia:
 · She arrives under cover of night, like a mystery beneath the starry sky.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 穿梭于无数故事，行走于无边梦境。
profile.descriptionEn: · Passing through countless tales, walking within boundless dreams.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 愿你的旅途永不结束。
profile.descriptionEn: · May your travels never end.

1451.description:
卢西娅，怪啖屋的成员之一，网名是「夜魔使者」。背包客、以骸故事爱好者，以及夜宵小吃摊权威品鉴家。

资料显示，卢西娅来自于一个生活在都市边缘的族群。传闻这个族群的先祖曾遇到过名为「夜魔」的以骸（未记录在空洞调查协会档案中），从此获得了特殊的能力：他们不容易引起以骸的注意。但代价是在夜晚会梦见「夜魔」，在「夜魔」的引诱下产生梦游行为，自行走入空洞被侵蚀。
基于此原因，族人们做起了「守夜人」。他们习惯于白天休息，深夜狩猎，以此来避开「夜魔」的引诱。如果有人实在支撑不住要在夜晚入眠，亲人就会整晚守在其身旁，直到天亮。

卢西娅在族人的陪伴下长大，即使来到新艾利都，她也保持着「守夜人」的传统，避免在夜晚入睡，并前往她重视的朋友们身旁，守护他们免受夜魔的侵袭。
主人，倘若深夜听到了敲击窗户的声音，请不要惊慌，那或许是某个睡不着的夜晚守护者在向您问好。

补充：卢西娅的宠物名为「刺梨」，是一只体型较小、性格友好的哈提，它曾经居住于空洞外围，现今已转移向了空洞深处，即使是我也无法探测到它目前的具体位置。
1451.descriptionEn:
Lucia, a member of Spook Shack, goes by the online name "Night Emissary." She's a backpacker, an Ethereal story enthusiast, and a connoisseur of late-night food stalls.

Records show that Lucia hails from a tribe living on the outskirts of the city. Legend has it their ancestors once encountered an Ethereal called the "Night Horror" (absent from the Hollow Investigative Association archives), which left them with a strange gift: Ethereals tend not to notice them. The cost, though, is that they dream of the Night Horror at night, and under its influence, they sleepwalk into Hollows, where corruption awaits.
Because of this, the tribe took on the role of Nightwatchers. They rest during the day and hunt deep in the night, avoiding the Night Horror's pull. And if anyone must sleep at night, their family will keep vigil at their side until dawn.

Lucia grew up surrounded by her kin, and even after arriving in New Eridu, she has kept to the Nightwatcher tradition of staying awake through the night and watching over her cherished friends, shielding them from the Night Horror's reach.
Master, if you hear a knock at your window late at night, don't be alarmed. It may just be a sleepless night guardian stopping by to say hello.

Additional note: Lucia's pet is "Chestnut," a small, friendly Hati. It once lived in the Hollow's outskirts, but has since moved deeper inside. Even I can no longer detect its exact whereabouts.

skills.name: 普通攻击：星轨连击
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成以太伤害；
其中，第五段攻击为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象对前方圆形区域敌人造成以太伤害；
处于接战状态下且未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得40点[梦境值]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Ether DMG.
The fifth attack is a Whim, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts Ether DMG on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Whim.

skills.name: 特殊技：死神协奏曲·风暴
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
特殊技为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方直线区域发动斩击，造成以太伤害；
处于接战状态下且未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得20点[梦境值]，5秒内最多获得一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
This Special Attack is a Whim. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：死神协奏曲·破晓
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
强化特殊技为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方直线区域发动强力斩击，造成以太伤害；
卢西娅发动[合唱]时，为全队角色施加[破暗]状态；[破暗]状态下，贯穿力提升12点，卢西娅每拥有200点初始最大生命值，可使贯穿力额外提升5.2点，[破暗]状态最多可提升636点贯穿力，状态持续20秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，当卢西娅的初始最大生命值达到24000点时，上述增益效果达到最大值；
[合唱]造成伤害时，卢西娅会根据最大生命值的37%额外提升最后一段攻击的伤害；
卢西娅发动强化特殊技后，若自身处于[梦境]状态且[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效中，则使[以太帷幕·涌泉]的持续时间延长16秒；
卢西娅发动强化特殊技后，可以直接衔接第五段[普通攻击]；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得60点[梦境值]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When Lucia uses any Harmony, all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional 5.2 Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of 636, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional 37% of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
skills.levelNote: 显示基础技能等级 1–12；影画带来的额外等级不计入此选择。
skills.levelNoteEn: Base skill levels 1–12; bonus levels from Mindscapes are excluded.

点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：折光
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速打击，造成以太伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：星尘回响

触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
闪避反击为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方圆形区域发动下落攻击，造成以太伤害；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得20点[梦境值]，5秒内最多获得一次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a Whim. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：璀色剧场
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
连携技为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象将前方圆形区域敌人吸近并造成以太伤害；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得40点[梦境值]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：进击，大铠甲！
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
终结技为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象，卢西娅骑乘以骸向前突进，保持按住方向键可控制骑乘方向并延长突进时间，最多延长至3秒，突进期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，且卢西娅受到致命伤害时不会战败退场，生命值最多降低至1；
在突进停止时对周身大范围区域发动强力打击造成以太伤害，招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]，招式发动后会留下[星光汇聚之地]，[星光汇聚之地]持续8秒，当前操作中的角色在[星光汇聚之地]内获得生命回复效果：每秒回复卢西娅最大生命值的1.05%，该回复效果在角色离开[星光汇聚之地]4秒后或下场时消失；
若发动后卢西娅处于[梦境]状态且[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效中，则使[以太帷幕·涌泉]的持续时间延长32秒；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得100点[梦境值]，且若发动此[合唱]时自身处于[梦境]状态，则可在下一次退出[梦境]状态时获得100点[梦境值]并重新进入[梦境]状态，该效果不可重复获得；
强力打击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to 1.05% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

在突进停止时对周身大范围区域发动强力打击造成以太伤害，招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]，招式发动后会留下[星光汇聚之地]，[星光汇聚之地]持续8秒，当前操作中的角色在[星光汇聚之地]内获得生命回复效果：每秒回复卢西娅最大生命值的1.1%，该回复效果在角色离开[星光汇聚之地]4秒后或下场时消失；
若发动后卢西娅处于[梦境]状态且[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效中，则使[以太帷幕·涌泉]的持续时间延长32秒；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得100点[梦境值]，且若发动此[合唱]时自身处于[梦境]状态，则可在下一次退出[梦境]状态时获得100点[梦境值]并重新进入[梦境]状态，该效果不可重复获得；
强力打击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
levels.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to 1.1% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

终结技为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象，卢西娅骑乘以骸向前突进，保持按住方向键可控制骑乘方向并延长突进时间，最多延长至3秒，突进期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，且卢西娅受到致命伤害时不会战败退场，生命值最多降低至1；
在突进停止时对周身大范围区域发动强力打击造成以太伤害，招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]，招式发动后会留下[星光汇聚之地]，[星光汇聚之地]持续8秒，当前操作中的角色在[星光汇聚之地]内获得生命回复效果：每秒回复卢西娅最大生命值的1.5%，该回复效果在角色离开[星光汇聚之地]4秒后或下场时消失；
若发动后卢西娅处于[梦境]状态且[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效中，则使[以太帷幕·涌泉]的持续时间延长32秒；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得100点[梦境值]，且若发动此[合唱]时自身处于[梦境]状态，则可在下一次退出[梦境]状态时获得100点[梦境值]并重新进入[梦境]状态，该效果不可重复获得；
强力打击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
levels.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to 1.5% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

skills.name: 快速支援：迷雾重击
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
快速支援为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方圆形区域发动下落攻击，造成以太伤害；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得20点[梦境值]，5秒内最多获得一次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
This Quick Assist is a Whim. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：幻梦之声
skills.nameEn: Defensive Assist: Voice of Illusory Dreams
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：绘梦和声
skills.nameEn: Assist Follow-Up: Harmony of Painted Dreams
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
支援突击为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方圆形区域发动强力下落攻击，造成以太伤害；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得40点[梦境值]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
This Assist Follow-Up is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：迷途夜颂
skills.description:
进入战场时，卢西娅立刻获得60点[梦境值]，若在发动[随想]或[合唱]时，卢西娅的[梦境值]达到100点，会进入[梦境]状态；
进入[梦境]状态时，将触发[快速支援]，并同时开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效期间，全队角色最大生命值提升5%，持续40秒，重复触发延长持续时间，最多延长至300秒；
当卢西娅处于[梦境]状态中，发动任意[随想]时，会消耗25点[梦境值]将[随想]升级为[合唱]；其他操作中的角色攻击命中敌人时，会消耗25点[梦境值]发动[追加攻击]，[追加攻击]为[合唱]，卢西娅在发动招式升级或[追加攻击]后，8秒内不会触发[追加攻击]；
卢西娅发动招式升级或[追加攻击]时，会为全队角色施加[巡梦童谣]状态，[巡梦童谣]状态下，角色造成的伤害提升10%，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
[梦境值]不足或离开[以太帷幕]时，卢西娅退出[梦境]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 Dream Points. If her Dream Points reaches 100 upon activating a Whim or Harmony, she enters the Dream state.
When entering the Dream state, it triggers a Quick Assist and simultaneously activates Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the Dream state, using any Whim consumes 25 Dream Points and upgrades it to Harmony. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 Dream Points to unleash an Aftershock. This Aftershock is a Harmony. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or Aftershock, Aftershock cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an Aftershock, all squad members gain the Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state. While in Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state, DMG dealt increases by 10% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of Dream Points or she leaves the Ether Veil, she exits the Dream state.

skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Rupture or Stun character:
When applying Darkbreaker, additionally applies a 30% CRIT DMG increase effect.

cinema.name: 秘密朋友
cinema.description: [巡梦童谣]状态额外附加造成伤害时无视敌人18%全属性伤害抗性和喧响值获取效率提升5%效果；且卢西娅发动招式升级时获得1层[回音]，最多叠加4层，当[巡梦童谣]状态结束时，若卢西娅持有[回音]，则会自动消耗1层并重新为全队角色施加[巡梦童谣]状态。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate. Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of Echo, stacking up to 4 times. When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme ends, if Lucia has any Echo stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme to all squad members.
cinema.story:
在还是个孩子的时候，奶奶就牵着卢西娅的手，将她带进了空洞。
从此，她穿梭于漆黑的小径，狩猎于无边的空洞；画笔下描绘了擦肩而过的以骸，以太光芒构成了童年的所有光彩。
「小时候，我有三个朋友：很强壮的黑盾，会瞬间移动的塔纳，还有特别特别厉害的大铠甲！」
「后来，他们都不见啦…」
「不过没关系！我把他们都画在了本子上——现在，只要挥挥法杖，我就能把他们都召唤出来！」
cinema.storyEn:
As a child, Lucia's grandmother took her by the hand and led her into the Hollows.
From that moment on, she roamed its darkened trails and hunted in its boundless depths. With her brush, she painted the Ethereals she encountered, and the glow of Ether became the brilliance that lit her childhood.
"When I was little, I had three friends: the mighty black shield, the teleporting Thana, and the super-powerful great armor!"
"Then one day, they were gone..."
"But it's okay! I drew them in my notebook. Now, with just a wave of my staff, I can summon them all back!"

cinema.name: 魔术大师
cinema.description: 卢西娅处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]内时[合唱]造成的伤害提升15%；拥有[破暗]状态的代理人处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]内时，额外获得贯穿伤害提升15%效果。
cinema.descriptionEn: While Lucia is inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, Harmony deals 15% more DMG. Agents in the Darkbreaker state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in Ether Veil: Wellspring.
cinema.story:
近来，新艾利都流传着一则关于「夜魔使者」的传说。
「每到晚上十二点，夜魔使者就会出现在街头，给我们讲各种各样的故事！」
「她还是个很厉害的魔术师！只要念起咒语，就能『哗啦啦』召唤出好多好多以骸，帮我们战斗！」
「上次在空洞里迷路时，夜魔使者就是用这招把我们救出来的！」
——上述内容由果核布、恶魔布和飞靶布口述
cinema.storyEn:
Lately, a tale has been spreading through New Eridu about the Night Emissary.
"Every night at midnight, the Night Emissary shows up on the streets to tell us all kinds of stories!"
"She's also an amazing magician! Just by chanting a spell, there's a 'Woosh!' and she summons a whole swarm of Ethereals to fight for us!"
"Last time we got lost in a Hollow, the Night Emissary used that very trick to save us!"
—As told by Avocaboo, Devilboo and Boollseye.

cinema.name: 最佳搭档
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
——咚，咚咚。
伴随着有规律的敲击声，一把烤串从窗口递了进来。
「绳匠接着！刚出炉的烤肉搭配柠檬跳跳糖，契合得就像杜拉罕的左手刀和右手盾！」
「吃完了的话…我们现在一起出去玩吧！」
「我有预感，今晚一定能找到超级棒的怪谈素材——能『嘭』地一下掀翻论坛那种程度！」
cinema.storyEn:
—Knock, knock knock. 
With the steady rhythm of knocks, a kebab was passed through the window.
"Proxy, take it! Hot off the fire — roast skewers with lemon popping candy, paired as perfectly as a Dullahan's sword and shield!"
"Once you finish eating... let's head out and play!"
"I have a feeling... tonight we'll find some amazing inspiration for an urban legend, the kind that can make the entire forum explode!"

cinema.name: 深夜时间
cinema.description: 当场上有[以太帷幕]开启或延长时，卢西娅使全队角色获得100点喧响值，该效果15秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Ether Veil is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
cinema.story:
对于「怪谈学者」来说，旺盛的好奇心、充沛的行动力以及说走就走的决心，都是必不可少的重要特质，卢西娅也是这样。
正因如此，在刚来新艾利都的那段时间，她成为了治安局的常客。
「说过多少次了，哪怕是追踪怪谈的时候，也不可以随随便便闯进工地——」
「不要在街上睡觉，不可以半夜到处乱跑，不能在所有人面前冲进空洞…这些全都是『新艾利都生活守则』，需要好好遵守！」
「实在睡不着的话，要不…唔，就去泰姆菲尔德庄园探险，顺便给爱丽丝讲点鬼故事怎么样？」
cinema.storyEn:
A Scholar of Urban Legends must have keen curiosity, plenty of drive, and the guts to set off without hesitation. Lucia is no exception.
That's why, during her early days in New Eridu, she became a regular at Public Security.
"How many times do I have to tell you? Chasing after ghost stories doesn't give you the right to wander into construction zones!"
"Don't sleep on the streets, don't run around in the middle of the night, and don't go diving into Hollows in front of everyone... These are all part of the 'Rules for Life in New Eridu,' and you need to take them seriously!"
"If you really can't sleep, then... uh, why not go explore Thymefield manor, and tell Alice a few ghost stories while you're there?"

cinema.name: 梦境守望人
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
夜色如墨深沉，繁星瑰丽璀璨。
她从远方跋涉而来，带着故事、歌谣和未完成的诗篇。
她摘下花朵，露水凝结在花瓣中，放在窗前。
她守候着你的梦境，让它温暖安全。

「早上好…诶，卢西娅是什么时候过来的？」
「我不记得了，应该没有很久吧…毕竟，和绳匠在一起的时间总是过得很快。」
cinema.storyEn:
Night falls dark as ink, the stars shining bright and brilliant.
She journeys from afar, carrying stories, ballads, and unfinished verses.
She plucks a flower, dew gathered upon its petals, and sets it on the windowsill.
She watches over your dreams, keeping them warm and safe.

"Good morning... Huh? When did you get here, Lucia?"
"I'm not sure, but it hasn't been too long... time just seems to fly when I'm around you, Proxy."

cinema.name: 永不结束的旅途
cinema.description: 卢西娅处于任意[以太帷幕]内时，会根据自身初始最大生命值的2%提升自身攻击力，且[合唱]必定暴击，[合唱]造成暴击时暴击伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Lucia is inside any Ether Veil, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and Harmony always triggers a CRIT with Harmony CRIT DMG increased by 30%.
cinema.story:
卢西娅的生命是一场没有尽头的旅程。她在月色下奔跑寻觅，横跨一条又一条街道，走过一个又一个城市。
故事的丝线编织出无数美梦，轻盈的歌声于夜灯下流淌。
寻觅的脚步从不停歇，星空下的旅途永不终止。

直到夜幕消褪，阳光升起，少女才伸着懒腰走出空洞。
「哈欠…好困…可是大家都说最好别睡在空洞里…」
「要不，还是去录像店打个地铺吧！」
cinema.storyEn:
Lucia's life is an endless journey. She runs beneath the moonlight, searching, crossing street after street, city after city.
Stories intertwine like threads, spinning endless dreams, while gentle song flows beneath the glow of the night lanterns.
Her search never stops, and under the stars, the journey goes on without end.

Only when the night fades and the sun rises does the girl step out of the Hollows, stretching lazily.
"Yaaawn... I'm so tired... but everyone says it's best not to sleep inside a Hollow..."
"Maybe I should just crash on the floor at the video store instead!"

1461.name: 「席德」

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
「席德」自幼便存在某些诡异甚至危险的异能力表现，具体现象为：可以操纵、瘫痪甚至引爆一定范围内的机械造物；此能力仅在其陷入严重的情绪不稳定状态时会出现，其外在表现为双眼部位闪烁红光。

正是由于此能力的存在，令初次发现她的「老席德」的自警系统将其自动识别为高危对象，并间接造成了「老席德」逻辑核心的不可逆损毁。

同时，「席德」被「老席德」从零号空洞带出时，便已经存在人格层面上的缺陷，因不明原因，她缺失了对生命的理解、感知与共情力。

在被收养的几年间，「老席德」一直致力于培养其完整的人格，他去世后该接力棒由奥波勒斯小队的众人接过，时至今日，「席德」的人格缺陷已得到显著的改善。

主人，根据您与「席德」之前于零号空洞的探索记录，可知「席德」的真实身份与您类似，都是来自赫利俄斯机关的学徒。

推定她在赫利俄斯机关期间，所隶属的研究项目与您不同，很可能是某个与机械研究相关的项目，上述「席德」的异能力与人格缺陷，都是该项目的遗留结果；由于代理人遗失与赫利俄斯机关以及旧都陷落相关的记忆，目前尚无法解析出更进一步的信息。

此外，主人，她有时候会微笑着一直注视着我，推定可能有将我拆解以满足好奇心的冲动，十分瘆人。严正要求对我的人身安全施加多重保护，以免您痛失一名可爱的得力助手。
profile.descriptionEn:
From a young age, Seed has displayed unusual and potentially hazardous anomalous abilities. These include the ability to control, disable, or detonate nearby machines. The ability only surfaces during episodes of intense emotional instability, with a red glow in her eyes being the most visible symptom.

It was this very ability that caused Seed Sr.'s self-defense system to automatically classify her as a high-risk threat upon their first encounter, indirectly leading to the irreversible damage to his logic core.

By the time Seed Sr. rescued her from Hollow Zero, Seed already exhibited a lack of emotional connection to life — she was unable to understand it, feel it, or empathize with it, due to unknown causes.

Seed Sr. spent the following years trying to raise her into a more complete person. After his death, the task fell to the rest of Obol Squad. Thankfully, her condition has improved considerably over time.

Master, based on your previous exploration logs in Hollow Zero with Seed, it's now clear that her true identity is similar to yours — she was also a student of the Helios Academy.

It's presumed that while at Helios, she belonged to a different research project, likely one focused on machine studies. Her abnormal abilities and personality defects are likely residual effects of that project. However, due to her memory loss of both the Helios Academy and the fall of the old capital, no further details can currently be determined.

Additionally, Master, she sometimes stares at me with a smile, leading me to suspect she may have an urge to dismantle me out of curiosity. It is deeply unsettling. I must formally request enhanced protection for my personal safety, lest you lose a very cute and capable assistant.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: NOV 22

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 「席德」打电玩超级厉害，喜欢的音乐类型和我相近，也很不爱运动，驾驶舱就是她的卧室…和我确实很有「同类」的感觉呢。还有一点相同的，我们都知道自己很可爱~
profile.descriptionEn: Seed's a total gaming pro, likes the same kind of music I do, and isn't into exercising at all. Her cockpit's basically her bedroom... She's just like me for real. Oh, and one more thing we have in common — we both know we're cute~

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 虽然大部分时候都能勉强跟上她的电波思维，但还是大意不得。上回她说滑板车故障了，我说我可以处理，结果她让我背着她充当一整天她的代步工具！还好我跑得比她快…
profile.descriptionEn: Most of the time, I can just about keep up with her... "unusual" way of thinking, but you can never let your guard down. Last time, she said her scooter was broken, so I offered to fix it — only for her to ask if she could ride around on my back all day! Good thing I can outrun her...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对「席德」的印象：
 · 既是爱花、亲近邦布、摆平困境的天使，又是吃花、玩弄邦布、制造意外的恶魔。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Seed:
 · At times an angel who cherishes flowers, befriends Bangboo, and solves problems; at others, a devil who eats flowers, messes with Bangboo, and causes problems.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 既是在驾驶舱里蜷缩着的娇小机械天才，又是在战场上轰鸣着的庞大机甲继承者。
profile.descriptionEn: · She's the delicate genius huddled inside the cockpit — and the heir to a fearsome mech on the frontlines.

profile.name: 印象 3
