1461.description:
「席德」，新艾利都防卫军·黑曜石营·奥波勒斯小队的火炮手。本名芙罗拉，「席德」这一代号继承自其监护人、防卫军战斗用智能构造体「席德」，后者则已将代号变更为「老席德」。

根据多方证言，「席德」是「老席德」于旧都陷落时，从零号空洞内营救出的、身份不明的孤儿，「老席德」收养了她并在防卫军宿舍内独自将其抚养成人。

距今数年前，「老席德」通过申请成功编入奥波勒斯小队，随后不久便因逻辑核心的不可逆损坏而死亡，「席德」也因此接替他成为奥波勒斯小队的成员。当前我们所能听到的「老席德」语音，均为其自带的系统预载语音。

在机械改造与研究方面，「席德」具有远超常人的天赋，可以设计并制造出许多常人无法想象的发明；同时，她具备超高的以太适性，并能以驾驶、远程操作、加装战斗模组等方式将「老席德」的战斗力发挥至极致。

因此尽管体能训练严重不达标、身份来历全是谜团，军方还是默许了接收她作为一名精英军人服役。

日常中的「席德」行为模式异于常人，她以「老席德」的驾驶舱为休憩的固定地点，喜好钻进狭窄的地方，极度反感与同伴以外的人进行接触交谈，且言行的逻辑跳跃性极强，具有很高的沟通难度。

幸运的是，主人，不知为何，她对您和助手二号表现出异常的亲近，您既省了取得她信任与喜欢的冗长流程，也不用担心她不时表现出的危险破坏性会波及到您。可喜可贺。

提议：多以花朵、机器人等该代理人最喜欢的事物作为沟通话题，用平常心看待其对话中无法理解逻辑或含义的部分，可以有效拉近您与她的关系。
1461.descriptionEn:
Seed, heavy weapons specialist of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. Her real name is Flora. The codename "Seed" was passed down from her guardian, the combat-grade Intelligent Construct formerly known by the same name, who now goes by "Seed Sr."

According to multiple sources, Seed is an unidentified orphan Seed Sr. rescued from Hollow Zero during the fall of the old capital. Seed Sr. adopted her and raised her alone in the Defense Force dormitories.
A few years ago, Seed Sr. successfully applied to join Obol Squad, but not long after, he passed away due to irreversible damage to his logic core. As a result, Seed took his place in the squad. Any voice lines heard from Seed Sr. today are system-preloaded audio files.

Seed possesses an extraordinary gift for mechanical engineering and research, capable of designing and building inventions far beyond the imagination of most. She also has an exceptional adaptability for Ether, able to push Seed Sr.'s combat capabilities to the limit by piloting him, through remote control, and by using custom combat modules.

And so, despite her extraordinarily substandard physical capabilities and entirely mysterious origins, the military still gave tacit approval for her to serve as an elite soldier.

Seed behaves quite differently from most people in everyday situations. She uses Seed Sr.'s cockpit as her bed, prefers confined spaces, and strongly dislikes talking to or interacting with anyone outside her immediate circle. Her logic jumps wildly, making meaningful conversation difficult.

The good news? For some reason, she's taken a special liking to you, Master, and the second assistant. You've been spared the long ordeal of earning her trust — and you don't have to worry about her occasional bouts of destructive behavior turning your way. Congratulations.

Suggestion: Focus on topics like flowers and robots — her favorite things — when engaging in conversation. Stay calm when parts of her logic or meaning don't make sense; treating such moments as normal can help strengthen your bond with her.

skills.name: 普通攻击：霜蕊轮舞
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，前两段造成物理伤害，第三第四段造成电属性伤害；
第三段后撤动作至第四段攻击发动前受到攻击，可触发自动闪避。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG for the first two hits and Electric DMG for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.

skills.name: 普通攻击：落华·重戮
skills.description:
[普通攻击]第四段、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]、[支援突击]后，可通过长按或点按 【普通攻击键】  发动：
召唤机甲，进行蓄力冲拳攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
[钢能]值达到120点时，可获得一次快速释放[普通攻击：落华·重戮]的机会，长按 【普通攻击键】 直接发动；[钢能]值不足120点或通过上述方式发动一次[普通攻击：落华·重戮]后，该效果移除；
命中敌人时不累积[钢能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After the 4th hit of a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, hold or press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Summon the mech to perform a charged punch attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When Steel Charge reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter by holding [Basic Attack]. This effect expires when Steel Charge is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter once.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：落华·崩坠
skills.description:
「席德」拥有[钢能]值，自身招式命中敌人可累积[钢能]；
[钢能]最大150点，初始拥有60点[钢能]，达到120点时，在[普通攻击：落华·重戮]或[终结技：机芯花园·绽放！]发动后，可点按或长按 【普通攻击键】  消耗60点[钢能]释放[普通攻击：落华·崩坠一式]，并自动消耗60点[钢能]衔接发动[普通攻击：落华·崩坠二式]；
操控机甲，扫射并释放强力跳砸，造成大量电属性伤害；
命中敌人时不累积[钢能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Seed has Steel Charge, which she can accumulate by hitting enemies with her skills.
Steel Charge has a maximum value of 150, and an initial value of 60. Upon reaching 120 Steel Charge and triggering Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter or Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!, press or hold [Basic Attack] to consume 60 Steel Charge and unleash Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form, then automatically consume 60 Steel Charge to follow up with Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form.
Pilots the mech to fire sweeping shots and perform a jumping smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：苍霜零落
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
扔出钢轮，划出曲线轨迹造成电属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Throw a steel wheel that traces a curved path, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
进入飞行模式，可进行四向移动，连续发射弹幕对敌人造成大量电属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以延长弹幕发射时间并持续消耗能量；
飞行期间，松开 【强化特殊技键】 可发动[强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕·离]；
一次飞行消耗60点能量时，自动发动[普通攻击：落华·重戮]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Enter flight mode, where Seed can move in four directions, and unleash a continuous barrage of missiles, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to extend the barrage duration while continuously consuming Energy.
During flight, release [EX Special Attack] to trigger EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away.
Upon consuming 60 Energy points in one flight, automatically trigger Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕·离
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away
skills.description:
[强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕]发动期间，松开 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
释放快速的炮击，造成电属性伤害；
命中敌人时不累积[钢能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
During EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, release [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash rapid cannon fire, dealing Electric DMG.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：踏瓣花游
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：磁陨轮舞
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方扔出钢轮，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Throw steel wheels forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：裂萼纷华
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续的激光打击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：落霰风暴
skills.nameEn: Chain Attack: Tempest of Frosty Petals
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
召唤机甲，护住自身后，向前方发射炮击与大量导弹，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Summons her mech for protection, then launches cannon shots and a barrage of missiles, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：机芯花园·绽放！
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
亲自驾驭机甲，倾泻出大量导弹与流星般的致命光弹，并释放强力跳砸，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动后，累积60点[钢能]；
命中敌人时不累积[钢能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Seed will pilot the mech personally, raining down missiles and a meteor shower of rockets, then performing a jumping smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, accumulate 60 Steel Charge.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：花雨齐射
skills.nameEn: Quick Assist: Barrage of Raining Flowers
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续的激光打击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：雏华屏障
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：绯芯爆裂
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续浮游炮攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash continuous floating turret attacks at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：花链协议
skills.description:
「席德」将初始攻击力最高的[强攻]队友视为[正兵]；
[正兵]释放[强化特殊技]时，使「席德」获得[强袭]状态，提升「席德」100点攻击力和15%暴击伤害，「席德」释放[强化特殊技]时，使[正兵]获得[明攻]状态，提升[正兵]100点攻击力和15%暴击伤害；
[明攻][强袭]同时存在时，「席德」与[正兵]同时获得[围杀]状态，造成的伤害提升12.5%；
[强袭]，[明攻]与[围杀]的增益效果可在角色为当前操作中角色时生效，角色切换为非当前操作角色时，增益效果依然生效，直到角色退场或增益效果维持3秒后，增益效果失效，角色切换为当前操作角色时，重新使增益效果生效；
进入战场时若存在[正兵]，「席德」立刻获得[强袭]与[围杀]状态，[正兵]立刻获得[明攻]与[围杀]状态；
[明攻]与[强袭]状态持续40秒，重复获得刷新持续时间；
[正兵]作为操作中角色消耗能量时或「席德」消耗能量时，每消耗1点能量，可为「席德」回复0.5点[钢能]。
skills.descriptionEn:
The Attack teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's Vanguard.
When the Vanguard unleashes an EX Special Attack, Seed gains Onslaught status, increasing Seed's ATK by 100 and CRIT DMG by 15%. When Seed unleashes an EX Special Attack, the Vanguard gains Direct Strike status, increasing the Vanguard's ATK by 100 and CRIT DMG by 15%.
When Direct Strike and Onslaught are both active, Seed and the Vanguard simultaneously gain Besiege status, increasing DMG dealt by 12.5%.
Onslaught, Direct Strike, and Besiege buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a Vanguard, Seed immediately gains Onslaught status and Besiege status, while the Vanguard immediately gains Direct Strike status and Besiege status.
Direct Strike and Onslaught status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the Vanguard consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of Steel Charge.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

cinema.name: 「冻眠期」
cinema.description: 「席德」[钢能]达到100点时，即可发动[普通攻击：落华·崩坠]且总计消耗的[钢能]降低至100点；获得一次快速释放[普通攻击：落华·重戮]机会所需的[钢能]降低至100点；进入战场/发动[终结技]时，额外累积40/20点[钢能]；[普通攻击：落华·崩坠]造成的暴击伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Seed's Steel Charge reaches 100, Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall can be triggered, and the total Steel Charge consumed is reduced to 100. The amount of Steel Charge required to gain one chance to quickly release Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter is reduced to 100. Accumulate an additional 40/20 Steel Charge when entering the battlefield/using Ultimate. Increases Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall CRIT DMG by 30%.
cinema.story:
这儿是一处与外界隔绝的，肃穆而神秘的建筑。
洁白的她属于这里。她瑟缩着，小心翼翼地朝着铁丝网外探出头。外面的世界是什么样的呢？
她的好奇心漫过无菌的房间，越过崩裂的高楼，躲开天空中粉色的巨花。
流呀流……
「看起来很像一个破壳的臭鸡蛋呢～」
「但我想在这儿待一会儿…」
cinema.storyEn:
This is a solemn and mysterious building, isolated from the outside world.
The pure white one belongs here. She shrinks back, carefully peering out through the wire fence. What's the world outside like?
Her curiosity flows beyond the sterile room, past the crumbling towers, dodging the pink giant flowers in the sky.
Flowing further and further...
"Looks just like a cracked, stinky egg~"
"But I want to experience it for a while..."

cinema.name: 「汲光法」
cinema.description: 代理人[围杀]状态的增益效果生效时，该代理人造成的伤害无视20%防御力；发动[强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕]时，在累计消耗60点能量后，可继续消耗能量延长招式，直到松开按键或累计消耗120点能量；[强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕]每消耗5点能量会使本次衔接的[普通攻击：落华·重戮]造成的伤害提升5%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Besiege is active for an Agent, that Agent's DMG ignores 20% of DEF. When activating EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, after consuming a total of 60 Energy, Seed can continue consuming Energy to extend the duration of the skill until the button is released or a total of 120 Energy is consumed. For every 5 Energy consumed by EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, the following Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter's DMG increases by 5%.
cinema.story:
这儿是一片钢筋错落的、连绵的废墟。
莫名的、无法表达的情绪梗住了喉头，口舌却无法发声…
视线悄悄模糊，某种古怪的液体顺着脸颊流了下来。
揉揉眼眶，眨眨眼睛…
那刺眼的、笨拙地凑近过来的，究竟是什么呢？
「不要害怕…我来…救你了…」
「你有…名字吗？我的代号是…『席德』。」
cinema.storyEn:
This is a sprawling ruin of twisted steel.
An inexplicable, indescribable emotion chokes her throat, yet her tongue remains silent...
Her vision blurs as some alien liquid trickles down her cheeks.
Rubbing her eyes, blinking...
What is this blinding thing clumsily drawing closer?
"Don't be afraid... I'm here... to save you..."
"Do you have... a name? My codename is... 'Seed.'"

cinema.name: 「抽芽说」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
这儿是一所军营里再普通不过的休息间。
她们向她打着招呼，尝试着打开她的心扉。
怯生生的红头发少女，大呼小叫的奇怪枪管，戴着眼罩的金毛狗狗…
大个子机器人告诉她，她们都是她的朋友。
「什么是朋友？」
「朋友啊…是一回头就能看见的人。」
cinema.storyEn:
This is just another break room in a military camp.
They greeted her, trying to open her heart.
A shy redheaded young lady, a strange chatty gun barrel, a golden retriever with an eye cover...
The big robot told her that they were all her friends.
"What are friends?"
"Friends... they're the ones you see when you look behind you."

cinema.name: 「芳香调」
cinema.description: 「席德」[围杀]状态的增益效果生效时，喧响值获取效率提升10%，[终结技]造成的伤害提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Seed's Besiege status buff is active, her Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%, and Ultimate DMG increases by 20%.
cinema.story:
这儿是一处盛大的、人头攒动的广场。
比所有人都要高的台子上，有人叽里咕噜地说着什么。
有声音喊了她的名字，很多人簇拥了过来，茫然的花儿被移植到了舞台，甚至还没洗去发梢上的硝烟。
黑匣子闪烁着比星星更亮的光，一枚小小的金属贴片被别在了同样手足无措的老朋友与小朋友身上。
这份表彰也意味着，从这一刻起，她成为了「『席德』」，一直陪伴着她的机器人成为了「老『席德』」。
「我做的很好吗？」
「当然，你是我们的骄傲…这个代号就是证明，『席德』。」
cinema.storyEn:
This is a grand, bustling plaza.
On a stage towering above everyone else, someone is muttering something.
A voice calls out her name, and many people crowd around. The dazed flower is transplanted onto the stage, gunpowder still fresh in her hair.
The black box flickers with light brighter than stars, and small metal patches are pinned onto both the older and the younger one, both equally at a loss for what to do.
This recognition also means that from this moment on, she is "Seed," and the robot that has always been by her side is now "Seed Sr."
"Did I do well?"
"Of course, you're our pride... this codename is proof of that, Seed."

cinema.name: 「绽蕊时」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
这儿是一所几乎无人知晓的、狭小的安全屋。
零碎的、杂乱无章的东西填满了整个空间。箱子、沙发、相框、一盆又一盆的花朵，红的，黄的，粉的，站得笔直的，蓬松的，耷拉脑袋的。
闭上眼睛，捂紧嘴巴，一定会忍住的——她保证。
「再给它们一点时间，好吗？」
「它们会长得很好的…就像你一样。」
cinema.storyEn:
This is a tiny safe house that almost no one knows about.
The entire space is filled with scattered, miscellaneous items. Boxes, sofas, picture frames, and pots upon pots of flowers — red ones, yellow ones, pink ones, some standing straight, some fluffy, some drooping.
Close your eyes, cover your mouth, you'll hold it in for sure — she promised.
"Give them a little more time, okay?"
"They'll grow up beautifully... just like you."

cinema.name: 「有心论」
cinema.description:
「席德」的暴击伤害提升50%；
发动[普通攻击：落华·重戮]时，额外发射3道激光，每道激光造成165%攻击力的伤害，3秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn:
Seed's CRIT DMG increases by 50%.
When using Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter, fires 3 additional laser beams, each dealing 165% of ATK as DMG. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
cinema.story:
这儿是一片鲜花漫野的、灿烂的花海。
她记起了这里最开始的样子，光秃秃，连一棵小草也没有。
是谁做的坏事呢？是谁把荒芜的、阴郁的零号空洞变成了这样呢？是谁在苍白的土壤里种出了一颗茁壮的心呢？
「原来你走了这么大的一个圈呢…」
「下次再见，『老席德』。」
cinema.storyEn:
Here lies a vast sea of flowers, blooming wild and brilliant.
She remembers how this place once looked — barren, without even a single blade of grass.
Who could have done such mischief? Who transformed this desolate, gloomy Hollow Zero into this? Who planted such a strong heart in this pale soil?
"So you've come such a long way on this circle..."
"Until we meet again, Seed Sr."

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
般岳的真实身份，是多年前由TOPS秘密开发的、专门用于镇压秽息的杀戮机械，代号「肃灭单元·零型」。其所植入的算法指令会使其基于消灭秽息的最合理方案进行行动，这往往意味着他会无差别抹杀连同秽息与受灾民众在内的视线内所有可动目标。

在某次行动失败后，作为杀戮机械的般岳被TOPS所遗弃，却又被某位莅临莱姆尼安空洞的智者遇到，改写了他的核心，为他构筑了新的智能逻辑，这也使得般岳逐渐拥有了自我意识。后面般岳被卫非地矿区旧址当时的居民们所接纳，让他融入了「为人」的生活。

十年前矿区旧址秽息大爆发那次浩劫，般岳赶往救援民众，但在绝对合理化的算法逻辑的作用下舍弃了部分被判断为无法得救的居民。他救出了年幼的叶瞬光与叶释渊，却也种下了对自身「见死不救」罪孽的心结。般岳也因此未能主动接受禁果测试，哪怕其已经符合广义上智能构造体的特征，却仍未被正式认定为智能构造体。

在接受来自坎卜斯黑枝的裁决官琉音的裁定后，般岳决心以未来的守护，弥补往昔的悔意。经琉音引荐，现今他已经成为坎卜斯黑枝裁决官的一员，开启了全新的旅程。
profile.descriptionEn:
Banyue's true identity is that of a killing machine secretly developed years ago by TOPS, specifically designed to suppress Miasma and codenamed "Purge Unit - Type Zero." The algorithm implanted within him drives him to act according to the most logical solution for eliminating Miasma, which often results in indiscriminate annihilation of all moving targets within sight, including both the Miasma and affected civilians.

After a failed operation, Banyue, then still a mere machine, was abandoned by TOPS, but was then discovered by a sage visiting the Lemnian Hollow, who rewrote his Core and constructed new intelligent logic for him, allowing Banyue to gradually develop self-awareness. Later, Banyue was accepted by the residents of the old mining site in Waifei Peninsula, where he integrated into "human" life.

During the catastrophic Miasma outbreak at the old mining site ten years ago, Banyue rushed to rescue the civilians, yet under the influence of his perfectly rational algorithms, he abandoned those he deemed beyond saving. Though he saved the young Ye Shunguang and Ye Shiyuan, this planted a deep-seated guilt within him for "abandoning those in need." As a result, Banyue never took the Forbidden Fruit test, and despite meeting the criteria of an Intelligent Construct, he remains officially unrecognized as one.

After receiving judgment from Dialyn, a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, Banyue resolved to atone for his past regrets by protecting the future. Through Dialyn's recommendation, he has now become a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, embarking on a completely new journey.

1471.description:
般岳，一位在卫非地开设武馆、门下学徒众多的智能构造体，存活于世已有很长时间，人称「般岳师父」。他有着如石狮子般威严的外表，武艺高强，与云岿山现任门主仪玄有着多年的交情。

作为武术高手，般岳寡言而可靠，行事风格与观念古朴，对门下习武的学徒严以管教，是因材施教、授人以渔的武学宗师。他有着名为「怒相」的战斗特殊形态，一旦开启，可将眼前邪祟尽皆诛伏。

作为长期居住于卫非地的普通居民，平日的般岳则性格温和沉稳，不善情感表达，言辞举止颇有古人之风。他自知跟不上人类时尚潮流的发展，私下正学习着各类网络新潮用语中，然而因为理解不到位，时常会造成一些让人哭笑不得的误会。

此外，般岳似乎很喜欢石墩子等球状物体。若与其独处因其沉默而陷入冷场，推荐以球状物来唤起其好奇心。
1471.descriptionEn:
Banyue is an Intelligent Construct who runs a martial arts school in Waifei, known to many as "Banyue Shifu." He has lived for a long time, his stone-lion-like presence commanding respect. A martial arts expert of great skill, he shares a long-standing friendship with Yunkui Summit's current High Preceptor, Yixuan.

As a martial master, Banyue is quiet but dependable. His methods and beliefs are rooted in tradition, and he disciplines his students with strict yet thoughtful guidance, teaching them not just how to fight, but how to learn. Known as a true master of the martial arts, in battle, he can assume a special form known as the Visage of Wrath to vanquish all evil.

A long inhabitant of Waifei, Banyue is quiet and even-tempered. He doesn't express emotions easily and has the manner of someone from another era. Knowing he's out of touch with modern trends, he's been secretly trying to learn the latest internet slang... yet his half-baked grasp of it tends to end in funny little misunderstandings.

Banyue also appears to have a strange liking for round things — stone balls, spherical bollards, and the like. If the conversation ever goes silent while you're alone with him, bringing up something spherical usually does the trick.

skills.name: 普通攻击：峥嵘
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间，打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：崔巍
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间，抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：焚身
skills.description:
不处于[怒相]状态且拥有120点[嗔火]时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对周身敌人造成火属性伤害，随后进入[怒相]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
While not in the Visage of Wrath state and with at least 120 Wrathful Fires, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Deals Fire DMG to nearby enemies, then enters the Visage of Wrath state.

skills.name: 普通攻击：引火
skills.description:
不处于接战状态、生命值大于50%且[嗔火]不足120点时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
般岳主动消耗生命值回复[嗔火]，[嗔火]回复至120点时般岳将直接进入[怒相]状态；
进入战场时，获得一次释放该招式的机会，在勘域模式中该效果180秒内最多触发一次；
般岳最多消耗生命值至最大生命值的50%。
skills.descriptionEn:
While not in combat and with more than 50% HP and less than 120 Wrathful Fires, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Banyue consumes HP to recover Wrathful Fires. Upon reaching 120 Wrathful Fires, Banyue immediately enters the Visage of Wrath state.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain one chance to use this skill. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once per 180s.
HP consumption will at most reduce Banyue's HP to 50% of Max HP.

skills.name: 普通攻击：倾山
skills.description:
当般岳处于[怒相]状态时，长按 【普通攻击键】 消耗120点[嗔火]发动：
般岳轰出巨大的山体攻击敌人，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动该招式后，般岳退出[怒相]状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Banyue is in the Visage of Wrath state, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 120 Wrathful Fires and activate:
Banyue hurls a massive mountain at the enemy, dealing massive Fire DMG.
After using this move, Banyue exits the Visage of Wrath state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：摧岳
skills.description:
当般岳处于[怒相]状态时，通过普通攻击派生或者快速键入指令的方式释放两次不同的[强化特殊技]后，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
般岳向前方打出珠子禁锢敌人造成大量火属性伤害；
随后般岳将自动释放[普通攻击：倾山]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While Banyue is in the Visage of Wrath state and after performing two different EX Special Attacks through Basic Attack branches or quick input commands, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Banyue launches his beads forward to imprison enemies, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Banyue automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：不动如山
skills.description:
攻击过程中不拖曳摇杆点按 【闪避键】 发动：
般岳进入防御姿态，期间如果受到敌人攻击，会招架敌人攻击，累积失衡值；
如果在招式发动的瞬间受到敌人的攻击，则可以触发完美格挡；
成功招架敌人攻击时拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While attacking, press [Dodge] without moving the joystick to activate:
Banyue enters a defensive stance. If attacked during this time, he parries the enemy's attack and accumulates Daze.
If attacked at the exact moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Block occurs.
Character is invulnerable during a successful parry.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：地动
skills.description:
闪能足够时，可通过以下三种方式发动：
在第三段或第四段[普通攻击：峥嵘]后点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动；
在[支援突击]、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]后长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动；
在发动任意[强化特殊技]、[普通攻击：焚身]、[连携技]、[终结技]、[支援突击]、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]时，快速键入指令 【普通攻击键】 【强化特殊技键】 【普通攻击键】 发动；
般岳连续重击地面，对敌人造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
After an Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input [Basic Attack] [EX Special Attack] [Basic Attack] in sequence to activate:
Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：山摇
skills.description:
闪能足够时，可通过以下两种方式发动：
在第一段或第二段[普通攻击：崔巍]后点按 【普通攻击键】 发动；
在发动任意[强化特殊技]、[普通攻击：焚身]、[连携技]、[终结技]、[支援突击]、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]时，快速键入指令 【强化特殊技键】 【强化特殊技键】 【普通攻击键】 发动；
般岳掀出山体，对敌人造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input [EX Special Attack] [EX Special Attack] [Basic Attack] in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws a mountain, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：论道
skills.description:
闪能足够时，可通过以下三种方式发动：
在第三段或第四段[普通攻击：崔巍]后点按 【普通攻击键】 发动；
在[支援突击]、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]后长按 【普通攻击键】 发动；
在发动任意[强化特殊技]、[普通攻击：焚身]、[连携技]、[终结技]、[支援突击]、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]时，快速键入指令 【强化特殊技键】 【普通攻击键】 【强化特殊技键】 发动；
般岳扔出珠子对前方敌人造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
After an Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input [EX Special Attack] [Basic Attack] [EX Special Attack] in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out his beads, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：狮子吼
skills.description:
闪能足够时，可通过以下两种方式发动：
在第一段或第二段[普通攻击：峥嵘]后点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动；
在发动任意[强化特殊技]、[普通攻击：焚身]、[连携技]、[终结技]、[支援突击]、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]时，快速键入指令 【普通攻击键】 【普通攻击键】 【强化特殊技键】 发动；
般岳向前方发动音波攻击，对敌人造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input [Basic Attack] [Basic Attack] [EX Special Attack] in sequence to activate:
Banyue sends out a sonic wave forward, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：山摇·怒
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath
skills.description:
闪能足够时，在发动[强化特殊技：地动]时快速键入指令 【强化特殊技键】 【强化特殊技键】 【普通攻击键】 发动：
般岳掀出更巨大的山体，对敌人造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline when using EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker, quickly input [EX Special Attack] [EX Special Attack] [Basic Attack] in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out an even larger mountain, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：狮子吼·怒
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath
skills.description:
闪能足够时，在发动[强化特殊技：论道]时快速键入指令 【普通攻击键】 【普通攻击键】 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
般岳向前方发动更强力的音波攻击，对敌人造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline when using EX Special Attack: One's Path, quickly input [Basic Attack] [Basic Attack] [EX Special Attack] in sequence to activate:
Banyue releases a powerful sonic wave in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 取消
skills.description:
当般岳通过快速键入指令的方式派生[强化特殊技]时，可以打断正在发动的[强化特殊技]，每一种[强化特殊技]都存在特殊的完美打断节点，在完美打断节点之后打断[强化特殊技]，被打断的[强化特殊技]的攻击效果将不会受到影响，在完美打断节点时打断[强化特殊技]，被视为触发了[完美取消]；
处于[怒相]状态且拥有[山威]时，更容易触发[完美取消]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Banyue activates an EX Special Attack ALT through quick input commands, the currently activating EX Special Attack can be interrupted. Each EX Special Attack has its own Perfect Interrupt window. Interrupting an EX Special Attack after its Perfect Interrupt window will not affect the interrupted EX Special Attack's effect. Interrupting an EX Special Attack during the Perfect Interrupt window is equal to triggering a Perfect Cancel.
While in the Visage of Wrath state and with Mountain's Might, Perfect Cancel is easier to trigger.

skills.name: 闪避：越岭
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：叫阵
skills.description:
拖曳摇杆半周并点按 【闪避键】 发动：
向后闪避并挑衅敌人；
在任意[强化特殊技]后衔接派生[闪避：叫阵]，可在[闪避：叫阵]期间快速键入对应指令继续派生[强化特殊技]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Rotate the joystick in a half-circle and press [Dodge] to activate:
Dodges backward and taunts enemies.
After any EX Special Attack, follow up with Dodge: Battle Cry and quickly execute the required inputs during Dodge: Battle Cry to then follow up with the corresponding EX Special Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：飞砂
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 或在[闪避：叫阵]时长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方打出珠子，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：峥嵘]的第二段攻击或[普通攻击：崔巍]的第二段攻击。
skills.descriptionEn:
During a dodge, press [Basic Attack], or during Dodge: Battle Cry, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches beads forward, dealing Fire DMG.
After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks or the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit.

skills.name: 闪避反击：扬砾
skills.description:
通过[闪避：越岭]触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 或通过[闪避：叫阵]触发[极限闪避]后，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动攻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：峥嵘]的第三段攻击或[普通攻击：崔巍]的第三段攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After a Perfect Dodge is triggered through Dodge: Overcome Peaks, press [Basic Attack], or after a Perfect Dodge is triggered though Dodge: Battle Cry, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches a forward attack that deals Fire DMG.
After using this skill, can be chained into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks or the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：怒焰
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方发动大范围攻击，造成大量火属性伤害；
若般岳的[嗔火]大于120点，攻击结束后般岳会自动进入[怒相]状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
If Banyue has more than 120 Wrathful Fires, he automatically enters the Visage of Wrath state after the attack.

skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方发动大范围攻击，造成大量火属性伤害；
若般岳的[嗔火]大于120点，攻击结束后般岳会自动进入[怒相]状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进并发动攻击，造成火属性伤害；

Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: 支援突击：冲霄
skills.description:
通过[闪避：不动如山]成功招架敌人攻击后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进并发动攻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing Fire DMG

skills.name: 核心被动：群山如我
skills.nameEn: Core Passive: One With the Mountains
skills.description:
般岳会额外根据自身最大生命值提高贯穿力，每1点最大生命值将提高0.1点贯穿力；
般岳发动招式造成的火属性伤害均为贯穿伤害，无视敌人防御，使用贯穿力作为招式伤害倍率；
般岳进入战场时即可回复60闪能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次。
般岳可以通过以下方式回复[嗔火]：
每消耗1点闪能，回复0.5点[嗔火]；
发动[招架支援]时，回复4点[嗔火]；
通过[闪避：不动如山]成功招架敌人攻击时，回复4点[嗔火]，若触发完美格挡，则改为回复6点[嗔火]，每1秒最多触发一次；
触发[极限闪避]时，回复4点[嗔火]，每1秒最多触发一次。
般岳最多拥有150点[嗔火]，拥有120点[嗔火]时，般岳可以通过发动[普通攻击：焚身]进入[怒相]状态，处于[怒相]状态时，般岳无法再获得[嗔火]，当般岳发动[普通攻击：倾山]后，会退出[怒相]状态；
进入[怒相]状态时，般岳会获得4点[山威]，若般岳拥有[山威]，则发动[强化特殊技]时，不再消耗闪能，转而消耗1点[山威]并回复10点闪能，否则仍会消耗闪能，退出[怒相]状态时，会清空[山威]；
处于[怒相]状态且有[山威]时，可以长按 【特殊技键】 按固定顺序自动打出四种[强化特殊技]及[普通攻击：倾山]；
般岳发动[强化特殊技]或[支援突击]时，贯穿力提升150点，造成的火属性伤害提升18%，暴击伤害提升18%，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover Wrathful Fires through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 Wrathful Fires for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon activating Defensive Assist;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires when parrying an enemy with Dodge: Immovable Mountain, and recover 6 Wrathful Fires instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon triggering a Perfect Dodge, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 Wrathful Fires. When he possesses at least 120 Wrathful Fires, Banyue can enter the Visage of Wrath state by using Basic Attack: Immolate. While in Visage of Wrath state, Banyue can no longer gain Wrathful Fires. After Banyue uses Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, he exits the Visage of Wrath state.
When entering the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue gains 4 Mountain's Might. If Banyue has Mountain's Might, launching an EX Special Attack no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 Mountain's Might and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the Visage of Wrath state, remove all Mountain's Might.
When possessing Mountain's Might in Visage of Wrath state, hold [Special Attack] to launch four different EX Special Attacks and Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an EX Special Attack or Assist Follow-Up, he increases his Sheer Force by 150, Fire DMG by 18%, and CRIT DMG by 18% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。

般岳可以通过以下方式回复[嗔火]：
每消耗1点闪能，回复0.5点[嗔火]；
发动[招架支援]时，回复4点[嗔火]；
通过[闪避：不动如山]成功招架敌人攻击时，回复4点[嗔火]，若触发完美格挡，则改为回复6点[嗔火]，每1秒最多触发一次；
触发[极限闪避]时，回复4点[嗔火]，每1秒最多触发一次。
般岳最多拥有150点[嗔火]，拥有120点[嗔火]时，般岳可以通过发动[普通攻击：焚身]进入[怒相]状态，处于[怒相]状态时，般岳无法再获得[嗔火]，当般岳发动[普通攻击：倾山]后，会退出[怒相]状态；
进入[怒相]状态时，般岳会获得4点[山威]，若般岳拥有[山威]，则发动[强化特殊技]时，不再消耗闪能，转而消耗1点[山威]并回复10点闪能，否则仍会消耗闪能，退出[怒相]状态时，会清空[山威]；
处于[怒相]状态且有[山威]时，可以长按 【特殊技键】 按固定顺序自动打出四种[强化特殊技]及[普通攻击：倾山]；
般岳发动[强化特殊技]或[支援突击]时，贯穿力提升250点，造成的火属性伤害提升30%，暴击伤害提升30%，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
levels.descriptionEn:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover Wrathful Fires through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 Wrathful Fires for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon activating Defensive Assist;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires when parrying an enemy with Dodge: Immovable Mountain, and recover 6 Wrathful Fires instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon triggering a Perfect Dodge, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 Wrathful Fires. When he possesses at least 120 Wrathful Fires, Banyue can enter the Visage of Wrath state by using Basic Attack: Immolate. While in Visage of Wrath state, Banyue can no longer gain Wrathful Fires. After Banyue uses Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, he exits the Visage of Wrath state.
When entering the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue gains 4 Mountain's Might. If Banyue has Mountain's Might, launching an EX Special Attack no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 Mountain's Might and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the Visage of Wrath state, remove all Mountain's Might.
When possessing Mountain's Might in Visage of Wrath state, hold [Special Attack] to launch four different EX Special Attacks and Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an EX Special Attack or Assist Follow-Up, he increases his Sheer Force by 250, Fire DMG by 30%, and CRIT DMG by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.description:
队伍中存在[支援]或[击破]角色时触发：
处于[怒相]状态时，若通过普通攻击派生或者快速键入指令的方式消耗[山威]发动[强化特殊技]时 ，般岳会获得一层[明王]，每层[明王]会使自身造成的火属性伤害提升5%，最多叠加3层，持续8秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
While in the Visage of Wrath state, when Banyue consumes Mountain's Might to unleash an EX Special Attack through a Basic Attack branch or quick input commands, he gains one stack of Vidyaraja. Each stack of Vidyaraja increases his Fire DMG by 5%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

cinema.name: 贪欲如火
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：论道]和[强化特殊技：地动]命中敌人时，会使敌人陷入[战栗]状态，处于该状态的敌人火属性伤害抗性降低10%，持续30秒；[强化特殊技：狮子吼]、[强化特殊技：狮子吼·怒]、[强化特殊技：山摇]、[强化特殊技：山摇·怒]、[普通攻击：倾山]和[普通攻击：摧岳]命中处于[战栗]状态的敌人时，造成的贯穿伤害提高10%；[普通攻击：摧岳]命中处于失衡状态的敌人时，会使其此次失衡的失衡持续时间提升2秒，敌人在一次失衡期间内只会受到一次该效果，且同类效果不可叠加。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Banyue hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: One's Path or EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker, he inflicts the Tremor state. In this state, enemies' Fire RES is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s. When EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar, EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits an enemy in the Tremor state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%. When Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.
cinema.story:
般岳师父可有过什么欲求么，他在澄辉坪开着家武馆，似乎也只因为某位宗师提议他开家武馆。
那座武馆连名字都没有，既不为名，更不图利，甚至连什么要传宗授艺之类的口号都没教学生喊过。
只有般岳师父自己知道，名为「赎罪」的执妄日夜灼烧着他钢铁铸成的心，一着不慎便是迷途。

「贪欲如火，恰当的欲望能够成为前行的炬火，不加收敛便会自受其焚。」
cinema.storyEn:
Did Banyue Shifu ever have any desires of his own? He runs a martial arts school in Failume Heights, apparently only because a certain grandmaster once suggested he open one.
The school doesn't even have a name, he isn't looking for fame for fortune, and he's never once told his students to shout slogans about passing down his art.
Only Banyue Shifu himself knows that the obsession called repentance burns that iron heart, day and night. A single mistake could send him spiralling.

"Greed is like fire. When kept in check, it lights the way forward, but left unchecked, it burns you instead."

cinema.name: 嗔恨如刀
cinema.description: [核心被动]中的暴击伤害增益效果额外提升15%，火属性伤害增益效果额外提升15%；处于[怒相]状态时，般岳消耗[山威]发动[强化特殊技]时，额外回复5点闪能。
cinema.descriptionEn: The CRIT DMG bonus from the Core Passive is increased by an additional 15%, and the Fire DMG bonus is increased by an additional 15%. While in the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue restores an additional 5 Adrenaline when consuming Mountain's Might to unleash an EX Special Attack.
cinema.story:
武馆的学生们从未见过般岳师父生气——更别说是发怒，即使对于最驽钝或最轻狂的学生，般岳师父似乎也拥有无限的耐心。
山脉怎么会轻易发怒呢，它过分厚重的沉稳总使人们几乎忘记它的暴烈。
但当它引动天倾的怒火，即使最嚣狂的恶兽，也要因此而战栗。

「嗔恨如刀，平日要好生藏于鞘中，莫要伤了身边的人。」
cinema.storyEn:
The students at the martial arts school had never seen Banyue Shifu lose his temper, let alone fly into a rage. Even with the dullest or most reckless students, he seemed endlessly patient. After all, how could a mountain ever grow angry? Its deep, immovable calm makes people almost forget the fury it can hold.
But when it stirs with the wrath of the heavens, even the fiercest of beasts will tremble in fear.

"Anger is like a blade — keep it sheathed in daily life, lest it wound those around you."

cinema.name: 痴愚如锁
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
般岳师父不止是武人，更是位智者——不管是武馆的学生们还是相熟的邻里，都这么说。
毕竟般岳师父平常看起来就很深沉的样子嘛，寡言少语的他一开口，总是些让人耐人寻味的格言般的句子。
武道不止修身，更是修心，而般岳师父常说，自己皆不过是学徒。

「般岳鲁钝，也曾踏入歧途，但为阁下开辟这一程的道路…尚有双拳可付。」
cinema.storyEn:
Banyue Shifu was not just a warrior, but a wise man — or so said both his students and the neighbors who knew him.
After all, he always looked so composed and thoughtful. Though he spoke little, every word that left his mouth sounded like a proverb worth pondering.
Martial arts, he often said, are not only a way to train the body but also the heart. And as he would always add, he himself was still just a student.

"I, Banyue, have been slow and foolish, once straying from the right path. But to clear the way for you on this journey... these fists are still yours to command."

cinema.name: 肃灭单元·零型
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：狮子吼·怒]、[强化特殊技：山摇·怒]、[普通攻击：倾山]和[普通攻击：摧岳]造成的伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks DMG increase by 30%.
cinema.story:
命运或许是天定或许是人为，但有些人的宿命与罪责，从不曾有幸被自由意志粉饰。
在获得如今的姓名之前，被称为「零型」的作战构造体不过是字面意义的杀戮机器。
而「心」是何时诞生的呢？是代码的桎梏被她抹去的那天，还是当你获得背负这一切前行的勇气？

「忏悔太过轻巧，比起逃避曾经的罪孽，不如背负这如山的过往…为如今挥拳吧。」
cinema.storyEn:
Fate may be ordained by the heavens or shaped by human hands. Yet for some, destiny and guilt were never granted the mercy of free will.
Before ever having a name, the combat construct known as "Type Zero" was, in the truest sense, nothing more than a killing machine.
And when did a "heart" form? Was it the day she erased the chains of his code, or the moment he found the courage to carry it all and keep moving forward?

"Repentance is too easy. Rather than fleeing from past sins, shoulder the mountain of your past... and throw a punch."

cinema.name: 学徒
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
听说了么？山上开了家武馆，教功夫的是个大个子构造体。
从那武馆里出来的学徒都颇有些真功夫呢，连以骸都能过上几招。
那位铁铸的师父也常跑到空洞里救灾救人，想必也是位武道的宗师吧？

「我不过也还是个稚拙的学徒…各位虽然称我一声师父，却也教会我许多为『人』的道理 。」
cinema.storyEn:
Did you hear? There's a martial arts school up in the mountain taught by some big construct.
The students there are no joke; they can even hold their own against Ethereals.
Their iron-bodied Shifu often heads into the Hollows to help with rescues, too. Must be quite the martial arts master, huh?

"I'm still just a clumsy student myself... Though you all call me 'Shifu,' it's you who have taught me what it means to be a person."

cinema.name: 降世明王
cinema.description: 任意时刻，般岳发动[强化特殊技]都可获取[明王]；[明王]提供的火属性伤害增益效果额外提升8%，持续时间提升至30秒；发动[普通攻击：摧岳]时，般岳会对周身敌人造成等同于自身600%贯穿力的火属性伤害；衔接在[强化特殊技]后释放[闪避：叫阵]也可以获取[明王]。
cinema.descriptionEn: At any time, when Banyue uses an EX Special Attack, he also gains Vidyaraja. The Fire DMG bonus from Vidyaraja is increased by an additional 8%, and its duration is extended to 30s. When activating Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks, Banyue deals Fire DMG equal to 600% of his Sheer Force to nearby enemies. Using Dodge: Battle Cry immediately after an EX Special Attack also grants Vidyaraja.
cinema.story:
「用性命抵债很轻松吧大块头？可你前面还有很长的赎罪之路要走呢！」
「这是我对你…最终的裁决！」
那个女孩的身形实在纤细，但那掷地有声的判词却似乎拨开如山的重负与迷雾。

「我仍在思索自己是否具备裁决的智勇…但那不是我驻足不前的借口。」
cinema.storyEn:
"Dying's the easy way out, isn't it, big guy? You've still got a long path of redemption ahead of you!"
"This... is my final verdict!"
Her frame was delicate, yet her words landed with a weight that seemed to cut through a mountain of burden and doubt.

"I still question whether I have the wisdom and courage to judge... but that's no excuse to stop moving forward."

1481.name: 琉音

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
「诅咒」——不只是对于空洞中无处不在的亡者之声对身心折磨的形容，也用于描述这份「不祥」的天赋所带来的厄运。

某次次生空洞灾害爆发的前夕，琉音所在街区的民众在城建公司的蛊惑下，将身怀「不祥」的年幼琉音作为「祭品」送入了空洞，希图保全自己的性命。

对人性之恶知之甚少，却身怀天生的善良的少女，甘愿用自己的性命换来大家的性命。但当她迈入空洞，这份受诅咒的天赋却让她得知了残酷的真相：一切皆是城建公司的阴谋，被购买了巨额保单的居民们注定要死在空洞中，而琉音只是被利用为诱骗居民们留下的工具。

她听到自己的不祥隐秘如何被出卖，听到身死居民们对她的怨恨，听到了所有亡者的心声和生者的谎言…她已经忘记自己是如何跋涉过那片荒原，但当她被黑枝所接纳的那一日起，她已经做好了万全的准备：在谎言与真相的无休挣扎之间，她将学会用自己的方式裁决善恶。
profile.descriptionEn:
"Curse" — not just a word for the torment of those endless voices of the dead echoing through the Hollows, but also for the ill fate brought by such a sinister gift.

Before a secondary Hollow outbreak, Dialyn's neighbors, misled by a construction company, turned on her, sending the "ill-omened" child into a Hollow as a sacrifice for their own safety.

Naive to humanity's cruelty but kind at heart, the young Dialyn willingly offered her life to save everyone, but upon stepping into the Hollow, her accursed gift revealed the cruel truth: it had all been a scheme by the construction company. The residents — whose lives had been covered by massive insurance policies — were doomed to die within the Hollow, and Dialyn was simply the bait to keep them from fleeing.

She heard her secret curse betrayed, the hatred the dead had towards her, the voices of all who perished, and the lies of those who lived. She can no longer recall how she made it through that barren wasteland. But ever since Krampus took her in, she's been ready: Amid the unending struggle between lies and truth, she would learn to pass her own judgment on good and evil.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: MAY 28

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 虽然好像总是在玩笑和毒舌之间切换，但若有耐心去聆听琉音在其中隐藏的真心，就能明白她是一个非常有原则和勇气的人哦！
profile.descriptionEn: She might seem to switch back and forth between jokes and sarcasm, but if you have the patience to listen closely, you'll find that deep down, Dialyn is someone with strong principles and real courage!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 虽然琉音说话总让人觉得「是不是太有攻击性」了，但她总能面对不公仗义执言，面对朋友坦诚相待——铃背着我和代理人们出去玩的事情也是她告诉我的。
profile.descriptionEn: Dialyn may come across as a little harsh sometimes, but she's the type to always speak up against injustice and be honest with her friends. She's even the one who told me about Belle sneaking out to hang out with our Agents without me.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对琉音的印象：
 · 亲亲您好，这里是您独一无二的金牌客服~
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Dialyn:
 · Hi there! This is your one and only top-rated customer service rep~

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 每位厉害角色都难免收到数不清的投诉报告。
profile.descriptionEn: · Every remarkable person ends up getting countless complaints.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 来自过往的来电和遗憾，由我替昨天接听。
profile.descriptionEn: · Calls and regrets from the past — I'll answer them in yesterday's place.

1481.description:
琉音，TOPS「跨部门响应客服中心」的客服人员，更鲜为人知的身份则是坎卜斯黑枝的「裁决官」。

虽然自诩是TOPS的金牌客服，收到的投诉却是部门之中最多的那一位。虽然从不声张自己作为裁决官的权力，却总能做出最接近真相的裁断。

琉音天生便能听到空洞中人类濒死前的声音，对于亡者之语的聆听是一种无双的天赋——对年幼的琉音来说却也是痛苦的诅咒。

但无论是天赋还是诅咒，琉音都已经将其化为裁决真相的利器，无论背负了怎样的命运和劫难，她都已行路至此。
1481.descriptionEn:
Dialyn works as a customer service representative for TOPS' Cross-Department Customer Service Center, though few know her other identity — a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge.

She calls herself TOPS' top-rated representative, yet she also tops the list for the most complaints in the department. Despite never flaunting her authority as a Judge, she always delivers verdicts that cut closest to the truth.

Dialyn was born with the ability to hear the voices of those on the brink of death within the Hollows — a talent that's unmatched. Yet to a young Dialyn, it was a tormenting curse.

Be it gift or curse, she has long turned it into a blade for discerning the truth. Despite the trials and tribulations she's borne, she's come far.

skills.name: 核心被动：五星客服热线
skills.description:
进入战场时，琉音初始拥有60点[好评]，初始暴击率超过50%时，每超过1%，冲击力提升1.4点，最多提升100点；
发动[强化特殊技：石头]后，下一次发动的[强化特殊技]变为[强化特殊技：剪刀]，持续8秒；
发动[强化特殊技：剪刀]后，下一次发动的[强化特殊技]变为[强化特殊技：布！]，持续8秒；
[强化特殊技：布！]命中敌人时，敌人获得[恶意投诉]效果，[恶意投诉]效果下敌人进入失衡状态后的失衡持续时间提升2秒，失衡易伤倍率提升15%，从失衡状态恢复前[恶意投诉]效果对同一目标最多触发一次，失衡持续时间提升效果与同类效果不可叠加，拥有[恶意投诉]效果的敌人失衡结束时[恶意投诉]效果结束；
处于接战状态下，琉音每秒积攒0.6点[好评]，发动[强化特殊技：石头]、[强化特殊技：剪刀]、[强化特殊技：布！]的重击命中敌人时将积攒7.5点[好评]，同一招式内最多积攒一次，最多积攒120点；
当[好评]满90点且琉音利用[连携技：迎宾踏垫]、[强化特殊技：送客！]、[快速支援：呼叫转移]打开[连携技]窗口时，下一位出场的角色会将此次[连携技]强制升级为[终结技]，队友以此方式发动[终结技]时，琉音消耗60点[好评]；
当[好评]满90点且琉音发动[强化特殊技：送客！]命中未打开[连携技]窗口的敌人时，将消耗90点[好评]强制打开[连携技]窗口，下一位出场的角色会将此次[连携技]强制升级为[终结技]；
每当[好评]积攒至90点或发动[终结技]时，琉音获得1点[客诉]，最多拥有1点[客诉]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, Dialyn starts with 60 Positive Reviews. If her initial CRIT Rate surpasses 50%, her Impact increases by 1.4 for each additional 1%, up to a maximum increase of 100.
After using EX Special Attack: Rock, the next EX Special Attack becomes EX Special Attack: Scissors for 8s.
After using EX Special Attack: Scissors, the next EX Special Attack becomes EX Special Attack: Paper! for 8s.
When EX Special Attack: Paper! hits an enemy, it applies the Malicious Complaint effect. While under Malicious Complaint, if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 15%. Before recovering from Stun, Malicious Complaint can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Malicious Complaint recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 Positive Reviews per second. When a heavy attack of EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits enemies, she gains 7.5 Positive Reviews. Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 Positive Reviews, when Dialyn triggers the Chain Attack window using Chain Attack: Welcome Mat, EX Special Attack: Get Lost!, or Quick Assist: Forward Call, the next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate. When an ally launches an Ultimate this way, Dialyn consumes 60 Positive Reviews.
With at least 90 Positive Reviews, when Dialyn hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: Get Lost! and doesn't trigger a Chain Attack window, she consumes 90 Positive Reviews to forcibly trigger a Chain Attack window. The next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate.
Each time Positive Reviews reaches 90 or an Ultimate is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 Customer Complaint. A maximum of 1 Customer Complaint can be held at a time.

skills.name: 额外能力：场外连线
skills.description:
队伍中存在[强攻]角色或[命破]角色时触发：
琉音造成的[强化特殊技]伤害的暴击伤害提升50%；
发动[强化特殊技]或[终结技]时全队角色获得[好评如潮]效果，[好评如潮]状态下的角色造成的伤害提升40%，持续15秒，琉音在[好评如潮]状态下发动[强化特殊技]或[终结技]时，若当前[好评如潮]的剩余持续时间小于35秒，则将该状态的持续时间延长10秒；
[强化特殊技：石头]、[强化特殊技：剪刀]、[强化特殊技：布！]重击命中时会根据队伍中琉音的上一位队友的特性造成额外伤害：
队友为[强攻]代理人时，[强化特殊技：石头]、[强化特殊技：剪刀]、[强化特殊技：布！]额外造成等同于该[强攻]代理人320%攻击力的伤害；
队友为[命破]代理人时，[强化特殊技：石头]、[强化特殊技：剪刀]、[强化特殊技：布！]额外造成等同于该[命破]代理人400%贯穿力的伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character:
Dialyn's EX Special Attack CRIT DMG is increased by 50%.
When an EX Special Attack or Ultimate is activated, all squad members gain the Overwhelmingly Positive effect. While Overwhelmingly Positive is active, DMG dealt is increased by 40% for 15s. When Dialyn uses an EX Special Attack or Ultimate while Overwhelmingly Positive is active, if the remaining duration of Overwhelmingly Positive is less than 35s, its duration is extended by 10s.
When a heavy attack from EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits, additional DMG is dealt based on the previous squad member's Specialty:
If the squad member is an Attack Agent, EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, and EX Special Attack: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 320% of that Attack Agent's ATK.
If the squad member is a Rupture Agent, EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, and EX Special Attack: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that Rupture Agent's Sheer Force.

cinema.name: 服务热情保持饱满
cinema.description: 每秒积累的[好评]与发动[强化特殊技：石头]、[强化特殊技：剪刀]、[强化特殊技：布！]命中敌人时积累的[好评]提升16%，[好评如潮]状态下的角色无视敌人15%全属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: The amount of Positive Reviews accumulated each second and gained when EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits an enemy increase by 16%. While the Overwhelmingly Positive effect is active, characters ignore 15% of enemy All-Attribute RES.
cinema.story:
欢迎来到「跨部门响应客服中心」！
我们的服务宗旨是，永远保持笑容，永远对客户充满热情~！
笑容？曾经最不熟练的表情，什么时候成了最习以为常的皮肤呢？
「亲亲~有什么可以帮到您吗？当然~我的意思不是说我真的可以帮到您哦~！」
cinema.storyEn:
Welcome to the Cross-Department Customer Service Center!
Our motto is simple: always wear a smile, always greet every customer with passion~!
A smile... the one expression I once found hardest to fake. When did it become second nature to me?
"Hello there, darling~ How can I help you? Well~ not that I really can do anything for you!"

cinema.name: 7×24热线畅通
cinema.description: [恶意投诉]效果下敌人进入失衡状态后的失衡易伤倍率额外提升20%，所有单位对[恶意投诉]效果下的敌人造成的伤害提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Enemies affected by Malicious Complaint gain an additional 20% Stun DMG Multiplier when Stunned, and all units deal 15% increased DMG to targets affected by Malicious Complaint.
cinema.story:
TOPS是全新艾利都最~大~的企业联合体，我们工作关乎着这座城市的生息~！
我们是这座巨型机械最~重要~的润滑剂，所以我们的服务热线7×24小时要随时保持畅通！
无时无刻从不停止的喧噪杂音么？没问题，那是我最熟悉的东西。
「请您随时联系我~！反正不管您什么时候联系，我都是这么讨您嫌的样子呢~！」
cinema.storyEn:
TOPS is the biggest corporate alliance in New Eridu, and our work keeps this city alive~!
We're the essential lubricant that keeps this great machine turning, so our service hotline must stay open 24/7, no matter what!
Endless noise and constant chatter? No problem — that's what I know best.
"Please feel free to contact me anytime~! No matter when you do, I'll still be just as annoying~!"

cinema.name: 空洞来电
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
空洞是一座巨大的坟墓，所有生命的响亮，都在漆黑的棺椁中寂静。
但唯独对我来说，它是无法回绝的通话，是每一本日记的最后一页，是执念与痴怨的备忘录。
虽然所有那些释怀或痴心的台词，都与我自己的故事无关。
「没关系没关系~！我跟很多比您更无法沟通的客户沟通过呢~！」
cinema.storyEn:
The Hollows are a vast tomb, where every echo of life falls silent within its pitch-black coffin.
But to me, it's a call I can never refuse, the final page of every diary, a memo of obsession and lingering resentment.
Even if... all that talk of letting go or holding on, they've got nothing to do with my own story.
"It's alright! I've talked with plenty of clients far harder to communicate with than you~!"

cinema.name: 往事从不如烟
cinema.description: 进入战场时，琉音回复20点能量，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；[好评如潮]效果下，琉音攻击力提升500点。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering combat, Dialyn recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. While the Overwhelmingly Positive effect is active, Dialyn's ATK increases by 500.
cinema.story:
因为个子小一点总是被当成小孩子，可我的童年早就结束了。
那一天是哪一天呢？是第一次听到亡灵的絮语时么？是被当作牺牲者送入空洞时么？还是啼哭的第一个夜晚？ 
无人庇护只好独自学步，忘不掉过往只好装作释怀。
「我无意了解您人格的缺陷~但我很关心您童年创伤对我投诉率的影响~！」
cinema.storyEn:
People always treat me like a kid because I'm small, but my childhood is long since over.
Which day did it end, though? The first time I heard the whispers of the dead? When I was sent into the Hollow as a sacrifice? Or that first night I cried myself to sleep?
With no one to protect me, I had to find my own footing. Unable to forget the past, I pretended to let it go.
"I don't care about your personal issues~ but I am very concerned about how your childhood trauma might affect my complaint rate~!"

cinema.name: 谎话
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
人总是在被人在乎的时候说谎，却又在被人遗忘的时候吐露真相。
这些不明智的抉择总是带来悔恨，我的工作不过是用昨天的悔恨，来让今天的悔恨少一些。
我知道人总是讲谎话，但至少还有人愿意对我说谎。
「我的策略建议是：在您人身攻击的间隙中，插入对您有利的胡说八道~！」
cinema.storyEn:
We lie when others still care about us, and only tell the truth once they've stopped.
Such foolish choices always lead to regret. My job is simply to use yesterday's regrets to make today's a little lighter.
I know people always lie, but at least there are still some who bother to lie to me.
"My suggestion? Mix a bit of flattering nonsense in between your insults — it'll work in your favor~!"

cinema.name: 真言
cinema.description: 通过[核心被动]使其他队友以终结技入场后，该队友获得[余音]效果，攻击命中敌人时琉音对敌人造成额外一次物理属性伤害，等同于琉音480%攻击力，该伤害被视为[强化特殊技]伤害，1秒内最多触发一次，最多触发12次，重复获得[余音]效果时刷新次数，同时只能有一名队友获得[余音]效果。
cinema.descriptionEn: When an ally enters the field with an Ultimate through the Core Passive's effect, that ally gains the Aftertone effect. With this effect, landing an attack causes Dialyn to deal an additional instance of Physical DMG equal to 480% of Dialyn's ATK. This DMG is treated as EX Special Attack DMG, and can trigger once every second, up to 12 times. Gaining Aftertone again refreshes its trigger count. Only one ally can have Aftertone at a time.
cinema.story:
但骤然降临的死亡就像时间的标本，将真相框定、凝结成了不会变更的模样。
我从亡灵的手中取回这些标本， 把他们的死亡证明当作裁决书的底本。
绝对客观的「真相」是唯一可以信赖的准绳，是指引我前路的唯一绳索，直到…
「绳匠，我也可以说谎么？」
cinema.storyEn:
A sudden death is like a moment preserved in time, capturing truth in its final, immutable form.
I take these specimens from the hands of the dead, using their death certificates as the foundation for my judgments.
Pure, objective "truth" is the only rule I can depend on, the only thread guiding my way forward... until—
"Proxy, can I lie as well?"

skillCultivationRecommendation.label: 技能培养建议分组
skillCultivationRecommendation.note: 按来源保留建议分组与适用影画；同组内不宣称严格的升级先后。
skillCultivationRecommendation.noteEn: Source groups and applicable Mindscapes are preserved; no strict priority is implied within a group.

icon.note: Existing local portrait asset; not downloaded from Gachabase.

1491.name: 千夏

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
千夏喜欢看上去可爱的甜食，因此经常会买到徒有其表、糖度超标的食物，而这一点总是遭到南宫的嘲笑。即便如此，南宫和爱芮在为千夏挑选礼物时，仍然会心照不宣地选择外形花哨的小蛋糕。
千夏还喜欢气味馨香的东西，会亲手制作香薰蜡烛，因为这些东西会帮她收凝神思、激发灵感。在进入自己的「音乐王国」时，千夏会格外专注，以至于难以听到外界的任何声音。
备注：据爱芮所说，千夏曾因为写歌而烧干了南宫的限量版茶壶，并为了向后者道歉，为其端茶送水超过两周时间。
profile.descriptionEn:
Sunna has a weakness for sweets that look cute, which often leads her to buy treats that are all looks and far too sugary — something Nangong never misses a chance to tease her about. Even so, when Nangong and Aria pick out gifts for Sunna, they always settle on cupcakes with colorful, eye-catching designs.
Sunna also loves things with gentle, fragrant scents and often makes scented candles herself, as they help her focus her thoughts and spark inspiration. Once she enters her own "musical kingdom," she becomes so absorbed that she can barely hear anything from the outside world.
Note: According to Aria, Sunna once burned Nangong's limited-edition teapot dry while writing a song. To make it up to her, Sunna spent more than two weeks serving tea and running errands for Nangong as an apology.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JUL 18

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
总感觉千夏就像游戏里的某种稀有动物一样，只有在特定条件下才能被刷新出来！
上次为了叫她和我出去买衣服，我烦了她整整一周呢！
profile.descriptionEn:
Sometimes Sunna reminds me of some kind of rare creature in a game — she only spawns under very specific conditions!
Last time, I had to bug her for a whole week just to get her to go clothes shopping with me!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 嗯，我领教过不少次铃死缠烂打的功力…想必千夏也对此无法招架吧。
profile.descriptionEn: Yeah, I've had my fair share of Belle's nonstop badgering... I bet Sunna couldn't handle it either.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对千夏的印象：
 · 她像山间小鹿轻盈跃过困难种种，脚印里也会浮起音符。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Sunna:
 · She moves like a little deer in the mountains, lightly leaping over every hardship, with musical notes rising from where she steps.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 妄想伸出细长的枝芽，把一个人的白日梦偷偷捆进三个人的盛大故事。
profile.descriptionEn: · Delusions stretch out long, slender branches, quietly binding one person's daydream into a grand story shared by three.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 就这样一边哼着歌，一边在粉红色的夏日里朝前走去吧。
profile.descriptionEn: · Lets keep humming along and walk forward into this pink-tinted summer.

1491.description:
千夏是「妄想天使」偶像组合的成员之一，同时也是团队发行所有音乐的作曲人。既要保证高质量的音乐创作，又要跟上大家的练习进度、配合舞台演出，这对千夏并不是什么容易的事情。面对难以承受的压力，她有时会行使「三十六计跑为上计」的谋略，以逃避队长南宫羽的魔鬼排期。
备注：据可靠情报推测，大部分时间该谋略得以施行，都多亏了南宫羽本人的故意放水。

与同为「妄想天使」组合一员的南宫羽自小认识，与对方相伴一同长大，二人虽然看似喜欢互相打闹，其实十分依赖彼此。与另一位成员爱芮则在音乐话题上颇有共同语言，据爱芮所言，她们经常在录音棚讨论一整天新歌的曲调处理方式，直到不觉间头挨着头沉沉睡去。

千夏性格较为内向，相比团体活动更喜欢一人独处。不过，她的两位队友深谙她「难以拒绝他人」和「经不起夸赞」的性格弱点，正在通过脱敏训练逐步帮她克服社交恐惧症（进度约为25%）。

虽然在大部分粉丝看来，千夏的「废柴」属性是个不可多得的萌点，但她本人似乎很想撕下这一标签，成为自信满满的「合格偶像」。作为乐曲的幕后创作者，她时常想逃下舞台，但千夏事实上又并非像她声称的那样对台前演出毫无眷恋。
证据：千夏床头的便利签，上面写着如下内容——绝对不可以让粉丝失望，要给他们最好的舞台！
1491.descriptionEn:
Sunna is a member of the Angels of Delusion idol group and the composer behind all of the group's music. Maintaining top-tier songwriting while keeping pace with rehearsals and stage performances is anything but easy for her. When the pressure piles up, she occasionally employs the tactic of "retreat is the best option" to dodge Captain Nangong Yu's brutal scheduling.
Note: Reliable intelligence suggests that this tactic works largely because Nangong Yu intentionally lets it slide.

Sunna and Nangong Yu, another member of the Angels of Delusion, have known each other since they were young and grew up together. While they appear to always squabble, the two are in fact deeply dependent on one another. When it comes to music, Sunna shares a strong connection with their final member, Aria. As Aria puts it, the two frequently spend whole days in the studio discussing melodies for new songs, only to drift off to sleep without even realizing it, heads resting against each other.

Sunna is fairly introverted and prefers spending time alone over group activities. That said, her two teammates know her weaknesses all too well — she finds it hard to say no and can't handle praise — and are helping her gradually overcome her social anxiety through desensitization training (progress: about 25%).

While most fans see Sunna's "hopeless" side as endearing, she herself seems eager to tear off that label and become a confident, "proper idol." As the creative force behind the music, she often wants to flee the stage — yet in truth, she's not as indifferent to performing as she claims to be.
Evidence: A sticky note by Sunna's bedside that reads "I can't disappoint the fans. I need to give them my very best on stage!"

skills.name: 普通攻击：鬼马流星锤
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：坏猫出没
skills.description:
战斗中，千夏位于后场，且场上没有持有[猫的凝视]的敌人时，泡泡会消耗1个[磨爪器]并自动发动攻击， 造成物理伤害；
队伍中任意角色开启[以太帷幕]时，千夏获得2个[磨爪器]；
队伍中任意角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，千夏获得1个[磨爪器]，10秒内最多触发1次；
泡泡可以继承千夏的初始攻击力，千夏最多持有6个[磨爪器]。
skills.descriptionEn:
During combat, when Sunna is off-field and there are no enemies with Cat's Gaze, Bubblegum consumes 1 Claw Sharpener to automatically launch an attack, dealing Physical DMG.
When any squad member activates Ether Veil, Sunna gains 2 Claw Sharpeners.
When any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, Sunna gains 1 Claw Sharpener. This effect can trigger at most once every 10s.
Bubblegum inherits Sunna's initial ATK. Sunna can hold up to 6 Claw Sharpeners.

skills.name: 特殊技：星星发射
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用气枪发射泡泡攻击前方敌人， 造成物理伤害；技能发动后，泡泡会加入战斗。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Shoots Bubblegum to attack enemies in front using an air gun, dealing Physical DMG. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：泡泡糖轰炸
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
扔出泡泡，砸向目标并造成物理伤害；技能发动后，泡泡会加入战斗；
技能发动时，为全队代理人添加[天使协律]效果，持续40秒；
招式重击命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Hurls Bubblegum at the target, dealing Physical DMG. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.
Upon activating this skill, all Agents in the squad gain Angelic Chord-ination for 40s.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：特别拍照技巧
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique
skills.description:
进入[天使协律]状态后，点按  【强化特殊技键】 可以发动，或在[强化特殊技：泡泡糖轰炸]发动期间，保持长按  【强化特殊技键】 快速发动：
与泡泡协同攻击目标敌人，造成物理伤害；技能发动后，泡泡会加入战斗；
重击发动前，开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]，[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]生效期间，全队角色攻击力额外提升50点，持续40秒，千夏重复开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]；
招式重击命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，每次进入[天使协律]，只能发动1次[强化特殊技：特别拍照技巧]。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Angelic Chord-ination state, press [EX Special Attack] to activate, or during EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, keep holding [EX Special Attack] to quickly activate:
Attacks the target enemy in coordination with Bubblegum, dealing Physical DMG. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.
Before the heavy attack is executed, activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will cancel the existing instance of Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique can be used once each time Sunna enters the Angelic Chord-ination state.

skills.name: 闪避：打不着我
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：冲天锤
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
挑飞前方敌人，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：妄想三振
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
连续锤击前方敌人，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with a series of hammer blows, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：可爱即正义
skills.description:
处于[天使协律]状态下的角色的攻击力提升，提升数值等同于千夏30%初始攻击力，最高不超过525点；当千夏的初始攻击力达到1750点时，为全队角色提供的攻击力增益效果达到最大值；
[普通攻击：坏猫出没]、[强化特殊技：泡泡糖轰炸]、[强化特殊技：特别拍照技巧]、[连携技：别惹猫咪]、[终结技：通通砸碎！]攻击命中敌人时，为目标添加[猫的凝视]，持续12秒，千夏为当前操作中角色时，会不断刷新[猫的凝视]的持续时间；持有[猫的凝视]的部分普通怪物对千夏的攻击欲望降低；
队伍中的[强攻]或[异常]角色持续攻击命中持有[猫的凝视]的敌人时，会触发并清除[猫的凝视]：
[强攻]角色触发时，对范围内敌人造成150%攻击力的代理人属性伤害；
[异常]角色触发时，对范围内敌人造成240%攻击力的代理人属性伤害，此次伤害必定暴击，且暴击伤害增加80%；
[猫的凝视]造成的伤害，视为由[触发代理人]造成的伤害；
场上存在多名持有[猫的凝视]的怪物时，只会触发主要攻击目标的[猫的凝视]，触发时会清除全场的[猫的凝视]；
敌人处于失衡状态下时，[猫的凝视]触发所需的攻击次数大幅减少。
skills.descriptionEn:
Characters in the Angelic Chord-ination state gain increased ATK, equal to 30% of Sunna's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 525 ATK. When Sunna's initial ATK reaches 1,750, the ATK bonus granted to all squad members reaches its maximum.
When attacks from Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted, EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, or Ultimate: Smash It All! hit an enemy, apply Cat's Gaze to the target for 12s. While Sunna is the currently active character, the duration of Cat's Gaze is continuously refreshed. Some normal enemies affected by Cat's Gaze show reduced aggression toward Sunna.
When Attack or Anomaly characters in the squad continuously land attacks on enemies affected by Cat's Gaze, Cat's Gaze is triggered and removed:
When triggered by an Attack character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to 150% of ATK to enemies in an area.
When triggered by an Anomaly character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to 240% of ATK to enemies in an area. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT, and the CRIT DMG is increased by 80%.
DMG dealt by Cat's Gaze is treated as DMG dealt by the triggering Agent.
When multiple enemies on the field have Cat's Gaze, only the primary attack target's Cat's Gaze is triggered. Upon triggering, Cat's Gaze is removed from all enemies on the field.
When an enemy is Stunned, the number of attacks required to trigger Cat's Gaze is significantly reduced.

处于[天使协律]状态下的角色的攻击力提升，提升数值等同于千夏30%初始攻击力，最高不超过705点；当千夏的初始攻击力达到2350点时，为全队角色提供的攻击力增益效果达到最大值；
[普通攻击：坏猫出没]、[强化特殊技：泡泡糖轰炸]、[强化特殊技：特别拍照技巧]、[连携技：别惹猫咪]、[终结技：通通砸碎！]攻击命中敌人时，为目标添加[猫的凝视]，持续12秒，千夏在前场时，会不断刷新[猫的凝视]的持续时间；持有[猫的凝视]的部分普通怪物对千夏的攻击欲望降低；
队伍中的[强攻]或[异常]角色持续攻击命中持有[猫的凝视]的敌人时，会触发并清除[猫的凝视]：
[强攻]角色触发时，对范围内敌人造成200%攻击力的代理人属性伤害；
[异常]角色触发时，对范围内敌人造成320%攻击力的代理人属性伤害，此次伤害必定暴击，且暴击伤害增加100%；
[猫的凝视]造成的伤害，视为由[触发代理人]造成的伤害；
场上存在多名持有[猫的凝视]的怪物时，只会触发主要攻击目标的[猫的凝视]，触发时会清除全场的[猫的凝视]；
敌人处于失衡状态下时，[猫的凝视]触发所需的攻击次数大幅减少。
levels.descriptionEn:
Characters in the Angelic Chord-ination state gain increased ATK, equal to 30% of Sunna's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 705 ATK. When Sunna's initial ATK reaches 2,350, the ATK bonus granted to all squad members reaches its maximum.
When attacks from Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted, EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, or Ultimate: Smash It All! hit an enemy, apply Cat's Gaze to the target for 12s. While Sunna is on-field, the duration of Cat's Gaze is continuously refreshed. Some normal enemies affected by Cat's Gaze show reduced aggression toward Sunna.
When Attack or Anomaly characters in the squad continuously land attacks on enemies affected by Cat's Gaze, Cat's Gaze is triggered and removed:
When triggered by an Attack character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to 200% of ATK to enemies in an area.
When triggered by an Anomaly character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to 320% of ATK to enemies in an area. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT, and the CRIT DMG is increased by 100%.
DMG dealt by Cat's Gaze is treated as DMG dealt by the triggering Agent.
When multiple enemies on the field have Cat's Gaze, only the primary attack target's Cat's Gaze is triggered. Upon triggering, Cat's Gaze is removed from all enemies on the field.
When an enemy is Stunned, the number of attacks required to trigger Cat's Gaze is significantly reduced.

skills.description:

处于[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]内的角色攻击命中敌人时，目标的失衡易伤倍率提升30%，持续40秒；

skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
When characters inside Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise land attacks on enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% for 40s.
When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone mode, the effect can trigger once every 180s.

cinema.name: 《孤独侵蚀症》
cinema.description: 千夏进入战场时，回复15能量，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；[猫的凝视]触发并命中敌人时，使目标的防御力降低7%，持续40秒，最多叠加3层，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Cat's Gaze triggers and damages an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 7% for 40s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
cinema.story:
不被理解没有关系，只要有音乐就够了。没有人主动搭话也没关系，反正女孩本就未曾对此抱有期待…
身处人群的紧张让她从世界仓皇逃开，以妄想填补被余留下来的空白——她是自己小小天地的国王，在领土边界竖起了「生人勿入」的警戒线，然后用音符将那里涂抹得色彩缤纷。
「我是和他们不一样的小孩，是…是孤独的天才！」 
她鼓起脸，用掌心悄悄抹去眼角钻出的那滴寂寞。
cinema.storyEn:
It didn't matter if no one understood her. As long as she had music, that was enough. It didn't matter if no one ever talked to her first, either. She'd never expected them to anyway...
Being surrounded by people made her so nervous that she fled the world, using delusions to fill the empty space it left behind. She was the master of her own tiny realm, setting up "keep out" warnings at the edges, then painting everything bright with music.
"I'm not like them. I—I'm a lonely genius!"
She puffed out her cheeks and quietly wiped away the lonely tear that slipped from the corner of her eye.

cinema.name: 《猫的随波逐流》
cinema.description:
千夏处于任意[以太帷幕]内时，使全队角色攻击力提升10%，每10秒获得1个[磨爪器]；[猫的凝视]触发所需的攻击次数减少；触发造成的伤害倍率提升：
[强攻]角色触发时，伤害倍率增加200%；
[异常]角色触发时，伤害倍率增加300%。
cinema.descriptionEn:
While Sunna is within any Ether Veil, all squad members gain 10% ATK and she obtains 1 Claw Sharpener every 10s. The number of attacks required to trigger Cat's Gaze is reduced, and the DMG Multiplier on trigger is increased:
When triggered by an Attack character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 200%.
When triggered by an Anomaly character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 300%.
cinema.story:
「那孩子是异类，总是只身一人在角落哼着古怪的歌…」
她早已习惯旁人如此这般话语，因此也从未期许过其他的评价。
而在那个暖融融的午后，垂下眼睑的黑发女孩像天使，朝她伸出了手。
啊，啊，原来她一直在寻求这份理解。一直在…等待一个能称之为同伴的存在。
即使已反复练习寂寞到熟稔，原来所谓人类仍旧是社会动物。那个人从湿漉漉的孤独中将她打捞起来，从此她有了一个羽毛搭成的避难所。
cinema.storyEn:
"That kid's an odd one, always humming strange songs alone in the corner..."
Having heard such remarks all her life, she stopped hoping for any other kind of judgment.
Then, one warm and gentle afternoon, a dark-haired girl stretched her hand out like an angel.
Ah... so she had always been seeking this sense of being understood. Always... waiting for someone she could call a friend.
Even having grown accustomed to loneliness from endless practice, humans are still, in the end, social animals. That person lifted her out of damp, clinging solitude, and from then on, she had a shelter made of feathers.

cinema.name: 《变身苹果》
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
在此之前，她从未得到过如此多陌生人的赞许。
「温柔的歌，给予了我力量。」
「在最悲伤的时候，遇到能令我共鸣的曲子，感动…」
「音乐风格也太可爱了吧！！」
少女紧张地盯住屏幕，消息栏标示提醒的小红点正伴随她的心跳声不住颤抖，她操纵着手中的鼠标，一次又一次点开那个窗口——
再多一点吧，再多一点人看到我的音乐，再多一点人看到这个除了写歌一无是处的我…
再多一点人，能汲取到这份小小的力量就好了。
cinema.storyEn:
She has never before received praise from so many strangers.
"Those gentle songs gave me strength."
"Finding music I could resonate with at my saddest moment was so moving..."
"This style of music is so cute!!"
The girl stares nervously at the screen. The small red dot marking new messages quivers along with her heartbeat, as she opens the same window over and over again—
Just a little more... just a few more people seeing my music... a few more people seeing me, someone who's good for nothing but writing music...
All I want is for a few more people to take power from this.

cinema.name: 《妄想调查队》
cinema.description: 千夏发动[终结技]时，使全队角色造成的伤害提升18%，持续60秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Sunna uses her Ultimate, all squad members deal 18% increased DMG for 60s.
cinema.story:
从被南宫拉出门，到在那张合同上签好名字…对少女来说，这一天过得如同夏日划过雨夜的闪电般迅疾。
就好像做梦一样，就好像过家家一样…总之，那都是存在于「妄想」中的事情。
迈出这里，她们就不再是独立的三个人，而是作为一个组合的「妄想天使」。迈出这里，她就不再只是幕后的创作者千夏，还是台前面对粉丝演绎自我的偶像。
——这份盛大降临的妄想，是她迄今为止所收到过最不可思议的礼物。
cinema.storyEn:
From being dragged out the door by Nangong to signing her name on that contract... to the girl, the entire day passed as swiftly as a flash of summer lightning cutting through a rainy night.
Like a dream, like playing house... in the end, it all belonged to the realm of "delusion."
The moment they walked out, they were no longer three separate individuals, but a group: the Angels of Delusion. And the moment she walked out, she stopped being only Sunna, the songwriter working behind the scenes, and became an idol standing before her fans, expressing herself onstage.
—This overwhelming delusion descending upon her was the most incredible gift she had ever known.

cinema.name: 《银河电车》
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2

cinema.story:
那些星星悬挂于夜幕之上，好像一盏盏黄昏时分被点亮的汽灯。
她想象在偌大的银河里，有人驾驶着一辆哼哧哼哧的电车，从淡色的晨曦出发一路驶向无限。
乘客都是猫猫狗狗小兔子之类可爱的家伙，列车长精通深海鱼和猫头鹰的语言。
离开仓促的生活，离开琐碎的日常——
「如果乘着妄想天使的翅膀，就能把大家带进这样的音乐里吧！」
在香薰蜡烛甜甜的气味里，她啊呜一声伸个懒腰，在曲谱上写下这场浪漫的梦。
cinema.storyEn:
The stars were strung across the night like gas lamps lit at dusk.
She imagined that somewhere in the vast galaxy, someone was driving a clattering electric tram, setting off from pale morning light and heading straight toward infinity.
The passengers were all adorable little creatures like cats, dogs, and bunnies, and the conductor was fluent in the languages of deep-sea fish and owls.
Leaving behind the rush of everyday life, stepping away from mundane routines—
"If I could borrow the wings of the Angels of Delusion, maybe I could bring everyone into a world of music like this!"
Surrounded by the sugary aroma of a scented candle, she stretched with a soft yawn, then wrote this romantic dream onto the sheet music.

cinema.description:
千夏发动[强化特殊技]时，进入[潜心创作中！]状态，持续8秒；
[潜心创作中！]状态下，千夏发动的攻击必定暴击，并根据自身初始攻击力的0.03%提升自身的暴击伤害，最多提升105%；

[潜心创作中！]状态下，千夏可以触发[猫的凝视]，以[强攻]代理人规则结算伤害；如果触发[猫的凝视]时，千夏拥有[磨爪器]，则立即消耗[磨爪器]并再次给敌人添加[猫的凝视]；
[潜心创作中！]状态下，全队触发[猫的凝视]造成的伤害提升50%。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Sunna uses an EX Special Attack, she enters the Focused Creation! state for 8s.
While in the Focused Creation! state, all attacks Sunna performs are guaranteed to CRIT, and her CRIT DMG increases by 0.03% of her initial ATK, up to a maximum of 105%.
While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna can trigger Cat's Gaze, its DMG being calculated using Attack Agent rules. If Cat's Gaze is triggered while Sunna has a Claw Sharpener, the Claw Sharpener is immediately consumed, and Cat's Gaze is reapplied to the enemy.
While in the Focused Creation! state, DMG dealt when any squad member triggers Cat's Gaze increases by 50%.
cinema.story:
「你是为什么而站上舞台的？」
是为了粉丝吗？是为了享受舞台上的荣光吗？还是为了那个在角落看着别人玩耍、不敢上前的自己？
也许全都有，但或者也许全都没有。
少女只知道握住话筒的时候心跳会变慢，四周会变得寂静…直到鼓点奏响，乐声如波纹漫过舞台的那一刹那，属于音乐的微光会照亮这段被大家所共享的时间。
那种感觉就像是——她们都是天使，拥有带着所有人飞出「此刻」的翅膀。
cinema.storyEn:
"Why did you choose to step onto the stage?"
Was it for the fans? For the glory under the spotlight? Or for that version of yourself who stayed in the corner, watching others play, too afraid to step forward?
Maybe it was all of those. Or maybe it was none of them.
All the girl knew was that the moment she gripped the microphone, her heartbeat would slow, and the world around her would fall quiet... until the drums kicked in, and the music rippled across the stage. In that split second, music's gentle light illuminated the time they all shared together.
It felt as if they were angels, with wings capable of carrying everyone away from "the here and now."

1501.name: 爱芮

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
和舞台上光鲜亮丽的形象不同，爱芮的本体其实是为作战而生的「A-H0L0」型高智能战术构造体；但随着一次次战斗行动，她逐渐开始抗拒这种「给他人带去痛苦」的感觉。
在和同型号的战友们一起被遗弃在空洞中后，她又因为瑟汐的歌声而苏醒；在艾利都，她看到那样的歌声能让人们萌生出「希望」、沉醉于「妄想」，于是逐渐萌生了自己唱歌的想法；机缘巧合下，她担任过瑟汐的「替声」，又在瑟汐隐退后回归人群。直到因为南宫和千夏的邀请加入妄想天使，爱芮才真正站到了台前，与热爱她声音的「梦想家」面对面互动。
也许是出于过去经历的影响，爱芮对自己的构造体身份深感自卑；切换到构造体形态后，她会变得胆小怕生，说话也慢吞吞的。然而，一旦开启元气偶像的虚拟投影，她又会马上回归热情开朗、充满活力的状态，像小太阳一般照耀身边的队友与台下的「梦想家」们。
profile.descriptionEn:
Unlike her bright, glamorous stage persona, Aria's true form is an A-H0L0 Type Intelligent Tactical Construct, built for combat. However, as she took part in more combat operations, she slowly grew to hate the feeling of "bringing pain to others."
After being abandoned in a Hollow alongside others of the same model, she was awakened once more by Cersea's singing. In Eridu, she saw how such a voice could spark hope in people and draw them into "delusions," and it was then that the desire to sing began to take root within her. By chance, she once served as Cersea's "voice double," but after Cersea retired, she returned to normal life. It was only after being invited by Nangong and Sunna to join the Angels of Delusion that Aria truly stepped onto the stage, meeting the Delulus who loved her voice face-to-face.
Perhaps shaped by her past experiences, Aria feels deeply insecure about her identity as a construct. When she switches to her construct form, she becomes shy and timid, speaking slowly and hesitantly. But the moment she activates her energetic idol projection, she instantly returns to her bright, outgoing, high-energy self, shining like a little sun on her teammates and the Delulus in the audience.
