1501.description:
爱芮，「妄想天使」组合的主唱和门面担当。阳光元气的她总能在舞台上闪闪发光，为「梦想家」们带来治愈和能量。
爱芮有着近乎完美的声线，但其实她几乎没有受到过专业训练；曾经的爱芮只是出于对自己偶像——隐退歌后「瑟汐」——的喜爱，开始模仿和跟唱对方的作品，但也由此发现了自己的歌唱天赋。
虽然爱芮的歌唱水平非常专业，但她在舞蹈方面却有些缺乏基础；虽然进行了努力练习，但面对一些复杂动作还是会手足无措。好在粉丝们十分认可她「即便跳不好，也要努力跳」的态度。
「拼劲全力，也要驯服自己跟不上节奏的四肢，这就是我们『妄想天使』的主唱大人！」——某位「梦想家」在演唱会后涕泪横流地说道。
1501.descriptionEn:
Aria is the lead vocalist and center of the Angels of Delusion. Bright and full of energy, she always shines on stage, bringing warmth and strength to all Delulus.
She has a near-perfect voice, even though she was never professionally trained. At first, Aria only sang because she loved her idol, the retired songstress Cersea, copying her performances and singing along, until she realized she had a gift for song of her own.
Though Aria's vocal skills are undeniably professional, she lacks a solid foundation in dance. Even with dedicated practice, she can still get flustered when faced with more complex moves. Still, fans deeply appreciate her attitude of "even if I can't dance well, I'll still give it everything I've got."
"Pushing herself to the limit, wrestling with her own limbs to try and keep up with the rhythm... that's our Angels of Delusion lead vocalist!" —One Delulu sobbing after a show.

skills.name: 普通攻击：甜心律动
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成以太伤害；
第四段攻击若命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成1个[应援能量]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.
After hitting an enemy with the fourth hit, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the attack ends.

skills.name: 普通攻击：绝对音准
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
爱芮进入蓄力状态，最多可进行三段蓄力，松开 【普通攻击键】 或达到最大蓄力时间时，爱芮将根据当前蓄力段数，向前方发动强力下落攻击，造成大量以太伤害；
若爱芮在蓄力时，自身附近有[应援能量]，则会吸收[应援能量]，每成功吸收1个[应援能量]可立即提升蓄力等级1段，且获得1层增益效果：下一次[普通攻击：绝对音准]造成的以太异常积蓄值提升10%。该增益效果最多叠加2层，攻击结束后效果移除；
在[普通攻击：甜心律动]第四段、[特殊技：全糖电音·不加冰]、[强化特殊技]、第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]、[快速支援]、[连携技]、[终结技]后，若附近的[应援能量]大于等于2个，则可通过长按 【普通攻击键】 消耗2个[应援能量]直接快速发动第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]；在第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]、[连携技]、[终结技]后，若附近的[应援能量]大于等于2个，也可通过在一段时间内点按 【普通攻击键】 消耗2个[应援能量]直接快速发动第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]；
蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，攻击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Aria enters a charging state and can reach three levels of charge. Releasing [Basic Attack] or reaching the maximum charge time causes Aria to unleash a powerful downward attack forward based on the current charge level, dealing massive Ether DMG.
If there is Fandom Power nearby while Aria is charging, she will absorb the Fandom Power, with each absorbed Fandom Power instantly increasing charge level by 1 and granting 1 stack of a buff that increases the next Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch's Ether Anomaly Buildup by 10%. This buff can stack up to 2 times and is removed after the attack ends.
After the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody, Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice, an EX Special Attack, a level three charged Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch, a Quick Assist, a Chain Attack, or an Ultimate, if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 2 Fandom Power and quickly activate a level three charged Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch. After a level three charged Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch, a Chain Attack, or an Ultimate, if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, a level three charged Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch can also be quickly activated by pressing [Basic Attack] within a short window, consuming 2 Fandom Power.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging, and received DMG is reduced by 40%. Character is invulnerable while using this attack.

skills.name: 特殊技：全糖电音
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动踢击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a forward kick, dealing Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：全糖电音·不加冰
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice
skills.description:
在[普通攻击：甜心律动]第四段、[支援突击]、[连携技]和[终结技]后，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动更加迅捷的踢击，造成以太伤害，若攻击命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成1个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody, an Assist Follow-Up, a Chain Attack, or an Ultimate, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a quicker forward kick, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：坠入妄想
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Fall Into Delusion
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力踢击并追加音波攻击，造成以太伤害，若攻击命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成3个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a powerful forward kick followed by a sonic wave attack, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 Fandom Power are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：光速入坑
skills.description:
[强化特殊技：坠入妄想]发动后，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方追加强力下落攻击，造成以太伤害，若攻击命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成3个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After launching EX Special Attack: Fall Into Delusion, and with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a powerful downward attack in front, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 Fandom Power are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：精准卡点
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
若在[普通攻击：甜心律动]中发动，此动作期间不会重置普通攻击段数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
If activated during a Basic Attack: Sweet Melody chain, this action does not reset the Basic Attack count.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：丝滑小连招
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速斩击，造成以太伤害；
若在[普通攻击：甜心律动]中发动，此动作期间不会重置普通攻击段数。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launches a swift slashing attack forward, dealing Ether DMG.
If activated during a Basic Attack: Sweet Melody chain, this action does not reset the Basic Attack count.

skills.name: 闪避反击：滑动变奏
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动强力斩击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击：甜心律动]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash against the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：梦幻联动
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方进行连续攻击，造成大量以太伤害，技能发动时在场上生成4个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG. 4 Fandom Power are generated on the field on skill activation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：元气百分百
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
释放自身全力，进入[妄想时刻]并对目标发动多段强力射击，造成大量以太伤害；
进入[妄想时刻]时爱芮获得3层[全场应援]效果，同时开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]，[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]生效期间，全队角色攻击力额外提升50点，持续30秒，爱芮重复开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]；
爱芮在蓄力时，若自身有[全场应援]效果，则优先消耗[全场应援]进行蓄力，每消耗1层[全场应援]可提升2段蓄力等级；
在进入[妄想时刻]时，若自身已有[全场应援]效果，则会先将剩余层数的[全场应援]转化为[应援能量]生成在场上，每层[全场应援]可转化为2个[应援能量]；
[妄想时刻]最大持续15秒，在[妄想时刻]期间，爱芮的第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]将会提升为强化版；
退出[妄想时刻]时，若自身有[全场应援]效果，也会将剩余层数[全场应援]转化为[应援能量]生成在场上，每层[全场应援]可转化为2个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Releases all her power, entering Moment of Delusion, and fires multiple powerful shots at the target, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, Aria gains 3 stacks of All-Out Cheering and activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will first cancel any existing instance of Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise.
While Aria is charging, if she has All-Out Cheering, stacks of All-Out Cheering are consumed first to charge. Each stack of All-Out Cheering consumed increases the charge level by 2.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, if Aria already has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are first converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power.
Moment of Delusion lasts for up to 15s. During Moment of Delusion, Aria's Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch 3rd attack is upgraded to an enhanced version.
When exiting Moment of Delusion, if Aria has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：破碎幻梦
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对目标发动强力斩击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击：甜心律动]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Delivers a powerful slash to the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：极限救场
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：安可曲目
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动强力连续斩击，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

cinema.name: 元气声浪
cinema.description: 爱芮的[普通攻击]、[特殊技]，[强化特殊技]对敌人造成伤害时，无视目标10%的以太异常积蓄抗性；且自身触发[异放]时有概率触发暴击：基础暴击率为25%，暴击伤害为25%；若初始异常掌控大于100点，每超过1点初始异常掌控会使该效果的暴击率额外提升0.5%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Aria's Basic Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's Ether Anomaly Buildup RES. Additionally, when Aria triggers Abloom, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.
cinema.story:
「你看到了吗？他们都在期待着我们。所以只要灯光亮起，便一定要饱含元气。这便是身为偶像的意义。」
——一些上台前的悄悄话。
cinema.storyEn:
"You see them? Everyone out there is waiting for us. So when the lights come up, we have to be full of energy. That's what it means to be an idol."
—A few whispered words before going on stage.

cinema.name: 梦幻节拍
cinema.description: 爱芮攻击和触发[异放]时无视目标16%防御力；在[妄想时刻]持续时间内，攻击和触发[异放]时额外无视目标8%防御力。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Aria attacks or triggers Abloom, it ignores 16% of the target's DEF. During Moment of Delusion, attacks and Abloom triggers also ignore an additional 8% of the target's DEF.
cinema.story: 「不用唱出来，闭上眼睛，去感受它，去接纳它。之后在舞台上，用我们的表演，让全场听众一起爱上它。」
cinema.storyEn: "We don't have to sing it yet. Just close our eyes, feel it, and accept it. Then, on stage, through our performance, we'll make the whole audience fall in love with it."

cinema.name: 梦想家
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 「梦想也好，妄想也罢，只要奔跑在成为更好自己的路上。每个人都值得被欣赏，每次努力都会有人记在心上。」
cinema.storyEn: "Whether it's a dream or just a delusion, we just need to keep running toward a better version of ourselves. Everyone is worthy of being appreciated, and every effort will be remembered by someone."

cinema.name: 机械天使
cinema.description: 爱芮触发[异放]时，自身获得4点能量和70点喧响值，10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Aria triggers Abloom, she gains 4 Energy and 70 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
cinema.story:
我的羽翼，是精钢锻铸的月光，
在数据中，校准着每一次振响。
齿轮咬合着宿命的节拍，
电流是体内寂静的喧嚷。
cinema.storyEn:
My wings are moonlight forged from tempered steel,
with lines of code, each vibration made real.
Gears bite into the rhythm of destiny,
while silent electricity roars through me.

cinema.name: 雨中之泪
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 我曾看到过，城市被空洞包裹，秩序被以太重塑，美好的一切都被黑暗吞噬，坠入时间的长河…一如泪水消逝在雨中。
cinema.storyEn: I once saw a city swallowed by the Hollows, its order reshaped by Ether. Everything beautiful was consumed by darkness, sinking into the long river of time... like tears fading in the rain.

cinema.name: 构造体之梦
cinema.description: 进入战场时，爱芮立即获得1200点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；且爱芮进入[妄想时刻]后将不会退出，强化版[普通攻击：绝对音准]和[终结技]造成的以太伤害提升40%；当爱芮处于[妄想时刻]时，若场上有敌人进入属性异常状态，爱芮获得1层[全场应援]，该效果6秒内最多触发一次；在获得[全场应援]效果时，若自身已有3层[全场应援]效果，则会将溢出的[全场应援]效果转化为2个[应援能量]生成在场上。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, Aria immediately gains 1,200 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. After Aria enters Moment of Delusion, she will not exit it, and enhanced Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch and her Ultimate deal 40% increased Ether DMG. While in Moment of Delusion, when an enemy on the field enters an Anomaly state, Aria gains 1 stacks of All-Out Cheering. This effect can occur once every 6s. When gaining the All-Out Cheering effect, if already at 3 stacks of All-Out Cheering, any excess All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power and generated on the field.
cinema.story:
你是否还记得，九月的夜晚，爱在那时产生。
你是否还记得，舞台上的欢舞，在坠入妄想的日子。
cinema.storyEn:
Do you still remember that night in September, when love was born?
Do you still remember the dancing on the stage, in those days when we fell into delusions?

1511.name: 南宫羽

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
「天赋」是令南宫游刃有余的光环，也曾是遮蔽她感知真实心意的雾障。她善于为一切事物估值与规划，却唯独无法为「梦想」这个看似虚无的概念标价。

在妄想天使成立之初，面对那个抠门到需要向练习生倒收教学费的事务所，南宫羽第一次感到自己那套「总能抓住商机」的天赋失效了。她可以计算出最优的舞步编排，能预判哪支股票会涨，却无法算出如何让这个承载千夏梦想的脆弱组合活下去。当最后的积蓄见底，而唯一的主唱即将因经济压力退出时，一个危险的「机会」找上了门——利用她们未被登记的以太适性体质，进入空洞，为一笔高额报酬执行一次「物资回收」委托。

那并非舞蹈练习室，而是真正的生死场。手中用于防身的简陋武器，其重量与舞台道具天差地别；而身边千夏因恐惧而急促的呼吸声，比任何观众的欢呼都更揪紧她的神经。那次委托，她们最终侥幸完成了任务，带回了足以维系组合存续的报酬。但当她们跌跌撞撞地回到安全区，看着手中沾满尘垢的酬金时，南宫感到的并非喜悦。

她意识到，自己愿意为之赌上性命、承受恐惧的，早已不再是「帮助朋友实现梦想」这个抽象的责任。而是在那个破旧练习室里，千夏写下的旋律，爱芮唱出的歌声，是尚未到来的、属于她们自己的歌声与舞台。那份渴望本身，已经有了无法用任何投资回报率来衡量的重量。 从那天起，她依然会计算：如何用最小的代价，守护住这个由她亲手拉入局、并已无法割舍的「廉价梦想」。
profile.descriptionEn:
"Talent" is the halo that lets Nangong move through everything with ease, but it once also served as the fog that dulled her sense of her true feelings. She's skilled at evaluating and planning for everything, yet when it comes to the seemingly intangible concept of "dreams," she can't put a price on it.

When the Angels of Delusion formed, Nangong Yu found herself dealing with a stingy agency that even charged its trainees for training. For the first time, she felt that her talent for "always spotting a business opportunity" had failed her. She could calculate the optimal choreography and predict which stocks would rise, yet she couldn't figure out how to keep this fragile group, built around Sunna's dream, alive. When their last savings ran dry and their only lead vocalist was about to quit under financial pressure, a dangerous "opportunity" appeared: use their unregistered Ether aptitude to enter a Hollow and carry out a high-paying "material recovery" job.

It wasn't a dance studio — it was a real fight for survival. The makeshift weapon in her hand felt worlds heavier than any stage prop. And the rapid, frightened breaths Sunna took beside her set her nerves on edge far more than the roar of any crowd. In the end, they were lucky enough to complete the commission and bring back payment that could keep the group afloat. But when they stumbled back into the safe zone and looked at the dust-covered reward in their hands, what Nangong felt wasn't joy.

She realized that what she was willing to risk her life and endure fear for was no longer the abstract duty of "helping a friend achieve her dream." It was the melody Sunna had written in that shabby rehearsal room, and the songs Aria had sung, the voices, and the stage that would one day belong to them. That longing itself had gained a weight no investment return could ever measure. From that day forward, she continued to calculate how to guard this "bargain dream" — one she had pulled into motion with her own hands and could no longer abandon — at the smallest possible cost.

profile.descriptionEn: · The ability to grasp a borrowed dream and never let go is a talent all its own.

1511.description:
南宫羽，偶像团体「妄想天使」的队长与编舞担当，拥有罕见以太适性体质、敏锐商业嗅觉和卓越偶像才能的「天才」。

虽然总以一副慵懒神态示人，调侃队友、玩笑不断，收到的恶评却往往是团队中最少的。虽然总宣称自己的梦想是「借来的」，却为这个小小的舞台倾注了超越常人的心血与感情。

南宫拥有一种举重若轻的天赋——无论是舞蹈、说唱、投资，还是洞察人心。这份天赋曾是支撑她轻松扮演「队长」角色的面具，却也一度让她与内心真实的渴望隔阂相望。

但无论最初是出于对挚友的责任，还是后来对舞台难以割舍的眷恋，她都已在灯光与观众的注视下，将借来的星火淬炼成了属于自己的光芒。
1511.descriptionEn:
Nangong Yu, the captain and choreographer of the idol group the "Angels of Delusion," is a rare prodigy blessed with exceptional Ether aptitude, a sharp business acumen, and outstanding idol talent.

Though she always presents herself with a laid-back air — teasing her teammates and joking around — she consistently receives the fewest negative reviews in the group. Although she often claims that her dream is merely "borrowed," she pours far more effort and emotion into this small stage than anyone would believe.

Nangong possesses a rare gift for making the difficult look effortless — whether it's dancing, rapping, making investments, or reading people. That gift once served as the mask that allowed her to easily play the role of "captain," yet it also kept her isolated from her true desires.

Yet whether it started as responsibility toward a close friend or later turned into an irreplaceable love for the stage, beneath the stage lights and the audience's gaze she has already forged those borrowed sparks into a light of her own.

skills.name: 普通攻击：流星舞步
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成以太属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动蓄力攻击，造成以太属性伤害，在恰当的时机松开按键，可以触发精准蓄力，使得招式造成的失衡值提升20%；
南宫羽至多可以发动三段攻击，第二段和第三段攻击各需要消耗50点[重拍]；
[连携技]、[终结技]和[强化特殊技]发动后，若[重拍]足够，长按 【普通攻击键】 可跳过第一段攻击，直接发动第二段和第三段攻击，且必定触发精准蓄力；
南宫羽为操作中的角色时，[连携技]、[终结技]和[强化特殊技]不会打断[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]的连段计数；
第一段攻击蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低60%；
第二段和第三段攻击蓄力期间拥有无敌效果；
第一段攻击冲刺阶段能够格挡敌人攻击，成功格挡则此次攻击也被视为精准蓄力攻击；
所有攻击发动期间均拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to launch a charged attack, dealing Ether DMG. Release the button at the right moment to trigger precise charging, increasing the Daze dealt by the skill by 20%.
Nangong Yu can perform up to three hits. The second and third hits each must consume 50 Downbeats.
After using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, or EX Special Attack, if enough Downbeats are available, hold [Basic Attack] to skip the first hit and directly perform the second and third hits, which always trigger precise charging.
When Nangong Yu is the active character, Chain Attacks, Ultimates, and EX Special Attacks do not interrupt the combo count of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact.
While charging the first hit, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken decreases by 60%.
While charging the second and third hits, the character is Invulnerable.
During the dash phase of the first hit, enemy attacks can be Blocked. On a successful Block, the attack is treated as a precise charging attack.
Character is invulnerable during all attacks.

skills.name: 特殊技：有点沉重的爱意
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: The Weight of Love
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
挥动锤子发动攻击， 造成以太属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a morning star attack, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
挥动锤子发动攻击，造成以太属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a morning star attack, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：天生舞者
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：回转流星
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行快速攻击，造成以太属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick attack forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：流星华尔兹
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成以太属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on the target, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：慧星引力
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量以太属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：流落星群
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量以太属性伤害；
招式发动时，南宫羽会开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]，[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]生效期间，全队角色攻击力额外提升50点，持续30秒，南宫羽重复开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch multiple attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Nangong Yu activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. If Nangong Yu activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise again, the current Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will first deactivate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：救场技巧
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成以太属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：完美舞步
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：即兴演出
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成大量以太属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：天才偶像
skills.description:
南宫羽的异常精通提升60点；
南宫羽的初始异常掌控大于110点时，每超过1点初始异常掌控会使自身的冲击力提升1点；
敌人处于失衡状态时，任意角色对其造成一次[异放]伤害、[紊乱]伤害、使其进入一次属性异常状态时会为其累计1层[颤音]；
同一敌人最多可被叠加4层[颤音]；
若[颤音]叠加到最大层数且敌人处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态下时或当敌人持有[颤音]并从失衡状态恢复时，所有[颤音]会被清除；
[颤音]被清除时，若敌人处于上述属性异常状态下，南宫羽会对目标造成一次[异放]伤害：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，相对于原属性异常伤害的比例为720%/360%/900%/63%/90%/36%，敌人身上每有1层[颤音]，该次[异放]的伤害比例额外提升25%，同一次失衡期间，若[颤音]已被清除，则敌人无法再被施加[颤音]；
南宫羽的[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]或[强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意]命中敌人时，会使自身的属性异常积蓄效率提升17%，造成的失衡值提升11%，使全队造成的伤害提升13%，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
处于接战状态时，南宫羽每秒回复3.8点[重拍]，队伍中任意角色使敌人进入属性异常状态会额外为南宫羽回复12点[重拍]，该效果每6秒最多触发一次；
南宫羽最多拥有100点[重拍]，进入战场时，初始拥有30点[重拍]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 60.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers Abloom DMG, Disorder DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of Vibrato.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of Vibrato.
If Vibrato reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, or if the enemy has Vibrato and recovers from being Stunned, all Vibrato stacks will be cleared.
When Vibrato is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of Abloom DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 720%/360%/900%/63%/90%/36% of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of Vibrato on the enemy increases this Abloom DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once Vibrato has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain Vibrato again.
When Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact or EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 17%, and her Daze dealt increases by 11%, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by 13% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 Downbeats/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 Downbeats. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 Downbeats, and starts with 30 Downbeats upon entering the battlefield.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

skills.description:
队伍中存在[异常]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
队伍中任意角色攻击命中处于失衡状态的敌人造成的属性异常积蓄值提升30%，[连携技]攻击命中处于失衡状态的敌人造成的属性异常积蓄值额外提升30%；
队伍中任意角色使敌人进入失衡状态时，南宫羽获得2层[舞力全开]效果，最多拥有2层，持续15秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，拥有[舞力全开]时，南宫羽发动[强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意]、[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]或[快速支援：救场技巧]且重击命中同时处于属性异常和失衡状态下的敌人时，会消耗1层[舞力全开]对满足条件的所有敌人触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果25%的伤害，并触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态，若该招式未能触发[极性紊乱]则不会消耗[舞力全开]，当南宫羽拥有[舞力全开]时，下一次换入前场将直接发动[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]第一段蓄力攻击且必定触发精准蓄力；
队伍中任意角色使敌人进入失衡状态后，南宫羽下一次发动[强化特殊技]不会消耗能量，该效果持续15秒，每15秒最多触发一次；
当南宫羽与爱芮共同处于队伍中时，爱芮的[普通攻击：绝对音准]重击命中处于属性异常和失衡状态下的敌人时，若南宫羽完整参与此次攻击，也会消耗1层[舞力全开]对满足条件的所有敌人触发[极性紊乱]；
南宫羽的[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]第三段攻击或[终结技：流落星群]命中敌人时，敌人获得[踉跄]效果，失衡易伤倍率提升30%，该效果下的敌人进入失衡状态后的失衡持续时间提升3秒，从失衡状态恢复前[踉跄]效果对同一目标最多触发一次，失衡持续时间提升效果与同类效果不可叠加，拥有[踉跄]效果的敌人失衡结束时[踉跄]效果结束。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
Any squad member's attack against a Stunned enemy has 30% increased Anomaly Buildup. Chain Attacks against a Stunned enemy have an additional 30% increased Anomaly Buildup.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu gains 2 stacks of Dance Prowess, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration. With Dance Prowess, when a heavy attack from Nangong Yu's EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love, Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, or Quick Assist: Emergency Save hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, 1 stack of Dance Prowess is consumed to trigger the special Disorder effect Polarity Disorder against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's Quick Assist. Polarity Disorder does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly. If the skill fails to trigger Polarity Disorder, Dance Prowess will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has Dance Prowess, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, which will always trigger precise charging.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next EX Special Attack will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.
When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the attack, 1 stack of Dance Prowess will also be consumed to trigger Polarity Disorder on all enemies who meet the conditions.
When the third hit of Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact or Ultimate: Meteor Shower hits an enemy, the enemy suffers Misstep. Under this effect, Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Stun duration increases by 3s. Before recovering from Stun, Misstep can only trigger once on the same target. The increased Stun duration cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Misstep recovers from Stun, the Misstep effect ends.

cinema.name: 慵懒的聚光灯
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意]或[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]命中敌人时，使敌人的全属性伤害抗性降低18%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；进入战场时，南宫羽的[重拍]回复至最大值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's Downbeat is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
cinema.story: 梦想是太麻烦又昂贵的东西，聚光灯打在身上，也只是觉得有点暖和而已。比起这个，看千夏被逗到脸红，看爱芮紧张到宕机，或者发现下一个拓金的际遇，或许才更有趣意。
cinema.storyEn: Dreams are such troublesome and expensive things. When the spotlight shines on her, it just feels a little warm, that's all. Honestly, watching Sunna blush from being teased, seeing Aria short-circuit from nerves, or discovering our next lucky break might be far more entertaining to her.

cinema.name: 无痛的泪水
cinema.description: 每层[颤音]使[核心被动：天才偶像]中[异放]的伤害比例额外提升10%；[额外能力：天使队长]提供的失衡易伤倍率额外提升30%；操作中的角色[连携技]重击命中同时处于属性异常和失衡状态下的敌人时，会对敌人触发[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果25%的伤害，敌人在同一失衡期间仅能触发一次该效果。
cinema.descriptionEn: Each stack of Vibrato's additional Abloom DMG ratio increase from Core Passive: Prodigious Idol increases by an additional 10%. The Stun DMG Multiplier provided by Additional Ability: Angel Captain increases by an additional 30%. When the active character's Chain Attack heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers Polarity Disorder, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once during the same Stun period.
cinema.story: 眼泪是珍贵的演出道具，可惜她的库存天生不足。好在偶像的演技足够精湛，能让它在需要的时候准时落下——为了安慰真正的小哭包，或者骗取一点观众的同情。
cinema.storyEn: Tears are a valuable stage prop, but unfortunately, she's always been short on stock. Luckily, her acting skills as an idol are good enough to make them fall right on cue when needed... whether it's to comfort a real crybaby, or win a little sympathy from the audience.

cinema.name: 天秤上的筹码
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 舞步可以编排，走位可以设计，连人气和未来似乎都可以用钱摆平。数字在账户里跳动，是种令人安心的游戏，直到发现未被明码标价的难题…把玩着这叠最擅用的「筹码」，动摇了「只是生意」的天平。
cinema.storyEn: Choreography can be arranged, stage positions can be planned, and even popularity and the future seem like things money can sort out. Watching the numbers bounce around in the account feels like a reassuring little game... until a problem shows up with no price tag attached. Fiddling with the stack of "chips" she's best at using makes the scale of "it's just business" start to wobble.

cinema.name: 共犯的舞步
cinema.description: 异常精通提升40点；[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]命中敌人造成的属性异常积蓄值提升35%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The Anomaly Buildup of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact when hitting an enemy increases by 35%.
cinema.story: 总习惯为千夏设计最闪耀的站位，为爱芮预留穿透夜空的高音。我的「梦想」是从她们那里借来的，但守护这份借来之物的决心，百分百属于我自己。
cinema.storyEn: I've got a habit of giving Sunna the most dazzling position on stage, and leaving Aria the high note that cuts through the night sky. My "dream" was borrowed from them, but the resolve to protect what I borrowed belongs entirely to me.

cinema.name: 舞台中央
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 启岁的灯火升上天空，舞台的幕布终于拉开。舞台、灯光、她们的侧脸…一切从未如此清晰。原来我早已站在光芒中央，从未袖手旁观。
cinema.storyEn: The Yearlight lanterns drift up into the sky, and the stage curtain finally opens. The stage, the lights, their faces... everything has never been this clear. Turns out I've been standing in the center of the spotlight all along. I was never just watching from the sidelines.

cinema.name: 天使的妄想
cinema.description: 南宫羽攻击造成的失衡值提升50%；敌人不处于失衡状态时，任意角色对其造成一次[异放]伤害或[紊乱]伤害、使其进入一次属性异常状态时会为其累计1层[颤音：改]，被[强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意]或[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]重击命中时会累计1层[颤音：改]，被[终结技：流落星群]重击命中时会累计2层[颤音：改]；[颤音：改]最多累计4层，当敌人进入失衡状态时，[颤音：改]会被全部清除，[颤音：改]被清除时，若敌人处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态下，南宫羽会对目标造成一次[异放]伤害：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，相对于原属性异常伤害的比例为800%/400%/1000%/70%/100%/40%，敌人身上每有1层[颤音：改]，该次[异放]的伤害比例额外提升25%；[颤音：改]与[颤音]无法相互叠加。
cinema.descriptionEn: Nangong Yu's attacks deal 50% more Daze. When the enemy is not Stunned, each time any character triggers Abloom DMG, Disorder DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on them, the enemy gains 1 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. When hit by the heavy attack of EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, they gain 1 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. When hit by the heavy attack of Ultimate: Meteor Shower, they gain 2 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. Vibrato: Modified can stack up to 4 times. When the enemy becomes Stunned, all Vibrato: Modified stacks are cleared. When Vibrato: Modified is cleared, if the enemy is under an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of Abloom DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 800%/400%/1,000%/70%/100%/40% of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of Vibrato: Modified on the enemy increases this Abloom DMG ratio by an additional 25%. Vibrato: Modified cannot stack with Vibrato.
cinema.story: 镜头、欢呼、荧光棒…遥远的暖意化作灼人的焰火。从别人那里借来的梦想——早已与我骨血相融。令人沉醉的「妄想」，现在由南宫队长亲自定义。
cinema.storyEn: Cameras, cheering crowds, glow sticks... that distant warmth turns into blazing fire. The dream I borrowed from others has already fused with my flesh and blood. From here on, this intoxicating "Delusion" will be defined by Captain Nangong.

1521.name: 希希芙

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
「本能」是希希芙赖以生存的基石，却也成了将她拖入更深处漩涡的引力。她过于信赖那些从气味、痕迹与肌肉颤动中读取的信息，却未曾学会辨识纸面契约与权力程序中的陷阱。

在被捕之前，她最后一次「合法」雇佣任务是运送一批保密物资。委托人给出了丰厚报酬和简单的路线——这对熟悉外环每一处暗巷的希希芙来说轻而易举。她像往常一样，凭借动物般的警觉避开了几处微妙的巡逻间隙，却不知自己的每一个规避动作，都被记录为「鬼祟行径」与「反侦察能力」的证据。那场吞噬一切的大爆炸发生时，她恰因察觉到热量异常波动而提前数秒缩进了废弃管道。这救了她一命，也彻底坐实了「唯一幸存且行迹可疑的纵火犯」这个身份。

在治安局的档案中，她的直觉与能力被倒置为精心策划犯罪的证明。审讯并非为了真相，而是一场冰冷的程序：用强光摧毁她对光线的耐受力，用连续的问话剥夺她对时间的概念，最终在她生理与精神濒临断裂时，推来了一份认罪书。

百般的厄运中终于有幸运的眷顾：秩序督察赛维里安发现了希希芙漏洞百出的审讯记录，当她因卓越的天赋与纯良的本质被赛维里安特聘为「案件专员」，颈环与手铐不再是单纯的束缚。它们是她与这个她既不理解也不信任的秩序之间，一道被她利用着的危险界限。
profile.descriptionEn:
"Instinct" is the foundation Cissia relies on to survive, yet it has also become the force pulling her deeper into the vortex. She places too much trust in the signals she reads from scent, tracks, and subtle muscle movements, yet has never learned to spot the pitfalls buried in paperwork and systems of authority.

Before her arrest, the last "legitimate" job Cissia took was transporting a batch of confidential supplies. The client offered generous pay and a simple route — an easy task for someone who knew the Outer Ring's back alleys like the back of her hand. As usual, her animal-like vigilance helped her slip through a few narrow patrol windows. What she didn't realize was that every evasive move was being logged as evidence of "suspicious behavior" and "counter-surveillance ability." When the explosion that swallowed everything erupted, she had already slipped into an abandoned pipe seconds earlier after sensing an unusual surge of heat. It saved her life — and cemented her identity as the "only surviving, highly suspicious arson suspect."

In Public Security's files, her instincts and abilities were twisted into proof of a carefully planned crime. The interrogation wasn't meant to uncover the truth, but to carry out a cold procedure: blinding lights to break her tolerance for brightness, endless questioning to strip away her sense of time, and finally, when her body and mind were on the verge of collapse, a confession was pushed in front of her.

Amid countless misfortunes, fortune finally showed her a trace of favor. Commissioner Severian uncovered the glaring flaws in Cissia's interrogation records. Recognizing her remarkable talent and fundamentally good nature, Severian personally recruited her as a "case specialist." From that moment on, the collar and handcuffs were no longer simple shackles. They marked a dangerous line between her and the system of order she neither understood nor trusted — one she had learned to use to her advantage.

profile.descriptionEn: JAN 10

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 没有什么零食能瞒过希希芙的眼睛和鼻子！她到底是怎么穿过包装袋闻到薯片的味道的？
profile.descriptionEn: There isn't a single snack that can get past Cissia's eyes and nose! How in the world can she smell potato chips through the packaging?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 自从希希芙来了家里之后，有的东西再也没丢过了，比如找不到的老录像带。有些东西再也没见过了，比如冰箱里没吃完的芝士蛋糕…
profile.descriptionEn: Ever since Cissia started coming over on the regular, some things have never gone missing again... like those old videotapes that were always impossible to find. And some things have never been seen again either... like the leftover cheesecake in the fridge.

profile.name: 印象 1

对希希芙的印象：
 · 投蛋报之以膨化食品。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Cissia:

profile.descriptionEn: · She's officially claimed the video store couch as her territory.

1521.description:
希希芙，新艾利都治安局秩序督察麾下的案件专员，正在积极竞选「Random Play」二楼的新室友中。

比起来自行动和任务本身的危险，更害怕的是来自长官的来电。行动中的专业素养比外表和言语表现出来的可靠得多，仅凭五感和直觉便能做出正确的判断。

虽然自称是只遵循本能、自私任性的「坏蛋」，做出的选择却时常闪烁着超越利益的人性微光。虽然对秩序与正义嗤之以鼻，却能成为追猎恶性罪犯最锋利的匕首。

但无论是用于自保的谎言、用以反水的獠牙，还是那套「趋利避害」的野生哲学，希希芙都已将其化为保护仅存之物的盾牌。无论背负着怎样的过往与枷锁，她已决心在此立足。
1521.descriptionEn:
Cissia, a case specialist serving under the New Eridu Public Security Commissioner, is currently campaigning to become the new second-floor roommate at Random Play.

More than the danger of the mission itself, what she fears most is a call from her superior. The professionalism she shows in her actions is far more dependable than how she looks or the way she talks. Relying only on instinct and her senses, she can still make the right call.

She may claim to be a selfish, instinct-driven "bad guy," but the choices she makes often carry a faint glimmer of humanity beyond personal gain. She scoffs at order and justice, yet can become the sharpest blade in the hunt for the worst criminals.

But whether it's the lies she tells to protect herself, the fangs she shows when she bites back, or that wild philosophy of "survive and profit," Cissia has turned them all into a shield to protect the few things she still has. No matter what past or shackles she carries, she has already decided to make her stand here.

skills.name: 普通攻击：吐信
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成电属性伤害；
第四段攻击命中敌人后，获得2点[毒素]，命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，额外获得1点[毒素]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to four attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG.
When the 4th hit lands, gain 2 points of Venom. Hitting a Stunned enemy grants an additional 1 point of Venom.

skills.name: 普通攻击：蛇吻
skills.description:
拥有[蛇影]时可长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
希希芙跳入空中并锁定目标，随后落地对范围内敌人造成电属性伤害；
锁定期间，保持长按 【普通攻击键】 并拖曳摇杆可以延长锁定时间，并自由控制落地位置；
每获得6点[毒素]，自身获得1层[蛇影]效果，至多获得3层；
进入战场时，获得1层[蛇影]效果；
招式发动时消耗1层[蛇影]；
命中敌人后，快速消耗所有[毒素]并触发[蚀骨]；
招式发动时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With Serpentine Shadow, hold [Basic Attack] to launch:
Cissia leaps into the air and locks onto a target, then slams down, dealing Electric DMG to enemies in the area.
While locking on, continue to hold [Basic Attack] and drag the joystick to extend the lock-on duration and freely control the landing position.
For every 6 points of Venom gained, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow, stacking up to 3 times.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow.
Using this skill consumes 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow.
Upon hitting an enemy, all Venom is consumed to trigger Corrode Bone.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 蚀骨
skills.description:
对附近敌人造成电属性伤害；
每次触发，使自身暴击率提升6%，持续15秒，至多叠加3层，重复触发刷新持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn:
Deal Electric DMG to nearby enemies.
Each trigger increases CRIT Rate by 6% for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

skills.name: 特殊技：獠齿
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动远距离蛇咬， 造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a long-range snake bite forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：毒牙
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动多段远距离蛇咬，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复5点能量；
长按发动时，会额外消耗能量，每20点发动一次额外的打击，造成电属性伤害，至多额外消耗60点能量；
招式发动后，自身获得3点[毒素]，长按时每额外消耗20点能量，获得1点[毒素]；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第四段[普通攻击：吐信]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash multiple long-range snake bites forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Grants 5 Energy when the move is used.
When activating by holding, consumes additional Energy. For every 20 additional Energy consumed, unleash 1 extra strike that deals Electric DMG, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy.
After activation, gain 3 Venom. For every additional 20 Energy consumed while holding, gain 1 more Venom.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Tongue Flick.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：蛇行
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：齿痕
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行快速斩击，造成电属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward with a swift slash, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：反咬一口
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方跃起，落地后进行横扫攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leap forward and perform a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：团伙作案
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动后，获得3点[毒素]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch multiple attacks ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, gain 3 Venom.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：爬行恐惧
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方发动落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动后，获得3点[毒素]；
招式发动后，开启[以太帷幕：冷血]，持续30秒，期间全队角色暴击伤害提升5%；
重复开启[以太帷幕：冷血]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕：冷血]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Deliver a thunderbolt attack in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, obtain 3 Venom.
After using this skill, activate Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded, lasting 30s. All squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 5% for the duration.
Re-activating Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded a second time will first deactivate the active Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：报警装置
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方跃起，落地后进行横扫攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间，可以快速衔接[特殊技：獠齿]、[强化特殊技：毒牙]和[普通攻击：蛇吻]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Leaps forward and performs a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing Electric DMG.
During this skill, you can quickly chain into Special Attack: Bared Fangs, EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite, and Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：牢饭加餐
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：共犯情谊
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：致命私酿
skills.description:
进入战场时，获得3点[毒素]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次。
拥有[毒素]时，接战状态下每5秒消耗1点[毒素]，触发一次[蚀骨]，造成电属性伤害；
拥有[毒素]时，使全队角色对敌人造成的电属性伤害无视敌人3%防御力，初始能量自动回复大于1.4时，超过部分每超过0.12，额外无视敌人0.52%防御力，至多无视敌人12.88%防御力，持续至[毒素]耗尽后30秒。
[蚀骨]额外附加自身227%攻击力的电属性伤害；
队伍中有1/2名电属性角色时，[蚀骨]造成的失衡值提升40%/60%；
获得[毒素]时，每溢出1点[毒素]，触发一次[蚀骨]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 3 Venom. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While possessing Venom, consume 1 Venom every 5s while in combat to trigger Corrode Bone, dealing Electric DMG.
With Venom, all squad memebrs' Electric DMG ignores 3% of enemy DEF. If initial Energy Regen is higher than 1.4, for every additional 0.12 above that threshold, an additional 0.52% of the enemy's DEF is ignored, up to a maximum of 12.88% of enemy DEF. This effect lasts until 30s after Venom is depleted.
Corrode Bone deals additional Electric DMG equal to 227% of ATK.

skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun character or shares the same attribute:
While possessing Venom, increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 40%, with Cissia gaining an additional 10%. The effect lasts until 30s after Venom is depleted.

cinema.name: 旅人与猎物
cinema.description: 进入战场时，获得的[毒素]点数提升至6点；[核心被动]中无视敌人防御力效果提升至原本的140%，并使全队角色造成的伤害无视目标5%电属性伤害抗性；[蚀骨]造成的伤害无视目标10%电属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Venom gained upon entering the battlefield increases to 6. The DEF ignore from the Core Passive increases to 140% of its original value, and all squad members ignore 5% of the target's Electric RES. Corrode Bone DMG ignores 10% of the target's Electric RES.
cinema.story: 气味、脚步、闪烁的目光…这些「痕迹」为我区分了猎人与猎物。在成为猎物之前溜走，在成为猎人之前低头——这就是我的生存之道。「家」？那种东西只在童话故事里出现。偌大的荒原，就是我的猎人小屋。
cinema.storyEn:
Scents, footsteps, the way someone's eyes shift... those are the "clues" that let me sort hunters from prey. I vanish before I'm hunted. I lower my head before I hunt. That's how I stay alive.
"Home"? That's just something out of a storybook. The endless wild is my hunting cabin.

cinema.name: 饥肠与箴言
cinema.description: [连携技：团伙作案]或[终结技：爬行恐惧]命中处于失衡状态下的敌人后，额外获得3点[毒素]；[普通攻击：蛇吻]造成的伤害提升35%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After a Chain Attack: Gang Operation or Ultimate: Ophidiophobia hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 Venom. Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss deals 35% increased DMG.
cinema.story: 能吃饱的地方就是好地方，能给我饭吃的就是好人，这是世界上最简单最可靠的道理。另外——蛋包饭是绝世的美味，包括你勺子里的剩饭。
cinema.storyEn: If I can eat my fill there, it's a good place. If someone gives me food, they're a good person. That's the easiest and most dependable rule in the world. And also, omelet with rice is divine. Even that last leftover bit on the spoon.

cinema.name: 锁链与暖巢
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 正义？秩序？那种光明正大的东西让我腿软。我熟悉的是阴影里的规则：背叛、谎言、为了活命可以跪得很漂亮。我不介意被当作工具，只要报酬是一顿饱饭和一个温暖的角落。
cinema.storyEn: Justice? Order? That kind of righteous, aboveboard stuff makes me shaky. What I know are the rules of the shadows — betrayal, lies, bowing low if it keeps me breathing. I don't mind being used as a tool, as long as the pay is a full meal and a warm corner to curl up in.

cinema.name: 坏蛋的觉悟
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]时，获得1层[觉悟]，至多叠加3层；发动[普通攻击：蛇吻]时，消耗全部[觉悟]，每消耗1层额外触发1次不消耗[毒素]的特殊[蚀骨]，该次[蚀骨]无法造成失衡值。
cinema.descriptionEn: When using an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, gain 1 stack of Decidedness, stacking up to 3 times. When using Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss, consume all Decidedness. Each stack consumed triggers 1 special instance of Corrode Bone that does not consume Venom. This Corrode Bone does not cause Daze.
cinema.story: 颈环很冰，手铐很重，提醒着我无法洗刷的罪责。但比起那些看不见的规则和冷眼，这种明码标价的束缚反而让我安心…至少我知道代价是什么。而且，只要回到那个有沙发和零食的小窝，铁疙瘩们也有了温度。
cinema.storyEn: The collar around my neck is cold. The handcuffs are heavy. They remind me of the sins I can't wash away. But compared to those invisible rules and icy stares, this kind of restraint with a clear price tag actually puts me at ease... at least I know what it costs. And once I'm back in that little den with a couch and snacks, even the cold metal seems warm.

cinema.name: 伪证与獠牙
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story: 被强光灼伤的回忆、白纸黑字的罪名…这些「痕迹」构成了曾经的我。但现在不同了，我学会了识字，也学会了分辨谎言的味道。当熟悉的阴谋气味再次飘来，我不会再呆呆地走进笼子。这一次，该由我来留下「痕迹」了——用牙齿，恶狠狠地。
cinema.storyEn: Memories scorched by blinding light, crimes spelled out in black and white... those "marks" were once all that defined me. But things are different now. I've learned to read, and I've learned to recognize the smell of a lie. When that familiar scent of a scheme creeps in again, I won't just walk into the cage like an idiot. This time, I'll be the one leaving "marks" — with my teeth, and I won't hold back.

cinema.name: 家与六分街道
cinema.description: 每次触发[蚀骨]时，获得1层[蚀骨印记]；全队角色除[蚀骨]外的攻击命中敌人时，消耗1层[蚀骨印记]，触发1次特殊的[蚀骨]，该次[蚀骨]无法造成失衡值，3秒内至多消耗1层[蚀骨印记]。
cinema.descriptionEn: Each time Corrode Bone is triggered, gain 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion. When attacks from any squad member, other than Corrode Bone, hit an enemy, consume 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion to trigger 1 special Corrode Bone. This instance of Corrode Bone cannot inflict Daze, and at most 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion can be consumed every 3s.
cinema.story:
一旦有了比「活下去」更想抓住的东西，人就真的会变傻。如果有一天命运一定要我赴死，你那张又大又软的沙发，可不许给别人躺！

「绝 对 不 准 忘 了 我 不 然 就 咬 死 你。」
cinema.storyEn:
Once there's something I want to hold onto more than just "staying alive," I really do turn stupid. If fate ever decides I have to die, that big, soft couch of yours better not have anyone else lying on it.

"Don't you dare forget me... or I'll bite you to death."

1531.name: 星徽·比利

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
和安比相似，比利的个人履历中也存在部分空白区域。
有信息显示，在加入狡兔屋之前比利曾经长期效忠于另一个神秘的组织。
截至目前为止，比利似乎仍然和盘踞于新艾利都外环的某组织老大之间保有密切联系。
profile.descriptionEn:
Similar to Anby, there are gaps in Billy's personal history that remain unfilled. 
The available information indicates that before joining Gentle House, Billy spent an extended period serving with another mysterious gang.
As of now, it appears Billy still maintains a close connection with a certain gang leader from the Outer Ring of New Eridu.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 男
profile.descriptionEn: Male

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: NOV 25

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description:
「星徽骑士」系列的特摄片，哥哥小时候好像也曾经痴迷过？
啊，真怀念呢，哥哥叉着腰大喊「星徽荣耀幻影！」的时候…
profile.descriptionEn:
Weren't you obsessed with the Starlight Knight series as a kid, Wise?
That brings me back. You shouting "Starlight Mirage!" with your arms crossed...

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description:
并没有那种时候。请把这些不存在的记忆从你的大脑里清空。
我已经脱离那个年龄段很久了，毕竟我的名字里可没有「kid」。
profile.descriptionEn:
There was never such a time. Please erase such non-existent memories from your mind.
It's been a long time since I was that age, after all, and my name doesn't have "kid" in it.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对比利的印象：
 · 比利对待武器，就像对自己一样爱护
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Billy:
 · Billy cares for his weapons like he cares for himself.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 他真的很爱星徽骑士，是因为正义还是因为特摄？
profile.descriptionEn: · He sure loves the Starlight Knights, but does he love the sense of justice or just the special effects?

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 比利的过去，也藏着让人难以想象的秘密
profile.descriptionEn: · Billy's past hides unimaginable secrets

1531.description:
比利·奇德，是一台通过了禁果测试的智能构造体。简言之，拥有自我意志的机器人。
人如其名，虽然有着机器人的外表，他的内心却（幼稚的）像个孩子。
钟爱一部名为「星徽骑士」的特摄片。希望自己也能成为剧中主角那样的英雄，于是总是以星徽骑士自居，还会用较为夸张的姿态模仿剧中台词。
但这样的行为似乎只能造成一些（适合用来调节气氛的）喜剧效果。
「不要把我说的好像笨蛋一样啊！我明明是很聪明的！」——by比利
1531.descriptionEn:
Billy Kid, an AI construct that has passed the forbidden fruit test, is essentially a self-aware machine. 
True to his name, despite having the appearance of a robot, he is quite childlike.
He's a big fan of the visual FX show "Starlight Knight" and wishes to be a hero like the main characters of the show. He often refers to himself as a Starlight Knight and imitates the lines in the show.
Such behavior appears to be only for comedic effect, however.
"Don't make me sound like an idiot! I'm obviously very smart!" — Billy.

skills.name: 普通攻击：骑士斗技
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
第四段攻击发动时，点按 【特殊技键】 发动[特殊技：动力压制]消耗生命值减少50%；
招式命中敌人时，少量回复生命值。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG.
During the 4th hit, press [Special Attack] to use Special Attack: Drive Suppression, reducing HP consumption by 50%.
Restores a small amount of HP on hit.

skills.name: 普通攻击：最高马力星光
skills.description:
[决意]足够时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方发动摩托突击，突击结束后打出激光束，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Determination, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Charges forward on the motorcycle, then fires a laser beam, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：动力压制
skills.description:
自身生命值大于25%时，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
消耗等同于自身16%生命值上限的生命值，召出摩托快速撞向敌人，持续造成物理伤害；
招式发动短时间内，若为当前操作中的角色时受到敌人攻击，则会触发格挡，免疫该次攻击，并回复5点[决意]；
触发格挡后，立即衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]；
招式持续攻击一段时间后会自动衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
When HP is above 25%, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Consumes HP equal to 16% of Max HP to summon a motorcycle and swiftly crash into enemies, continuously dealing Physical DMG.
If attacked by an enemy as the active character shortly upon activating this skill, triggers a block, negating the attack and restoring 5 Determination.
After triggering a block, immediately chains into EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie.
After the skill continues for a while, it automatically chains into EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：脱缰
skills.description:
[闪避：银河横行]中断时自动发动：
将摩托车踢向敌人，造成物理伤害；
招式发动后，可以衔接[闪避反击：决斗之王]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Triggers automatically when Dodge: Through the Galaxy is interrupted:
Kicks his motorcycle at enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
After using this skill, it can be chained into Dodge Counter: Duel King.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：孤轮特技
skills.description:
[特殊技：动力压制]达到最大攻击时长或触发格挡时自动发动：
将摩托车抬起攻击敌人，造成物理伤害；
招式命中敌人后，额外回复8点[决意]；
招式发动后，若闪能足够，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以衔接[强化特殊技：摇曳步伐]；
招式动作结束后，自动衔接[特殊技：脱缰]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Triggers automatically when Special Attack: Drive Suppression reaches its maximum duration or a block is triggered:
Lifts the motorcycle to attack enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
On hit, restores an additional 8 Determination.
After using this skill, with enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork.
After the skill animation ends, automatically chains into Special Attack: Run Wild.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：抓地轮毂
skills.description:
闪能足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用摩托下砸，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时，回复自身30%生命值上限的生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Slams down with the motorcycle, dealing Physical DMG.
Restores 30% of Max HP upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：摇曳步伐
skills.description:
发动[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]后，且闪能足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用摩托和手炮进行混合攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时，回复自身15%生命值上限的生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After activating EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie and with enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Uses the motorcycle and hand cannon for a combined attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, restore 15% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：真惊险！
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：银河横行
skills.description:
[特殊技：动力压制]期间拖曳摇杆或长按 【闪避键】 发动：
控制摩托车漂移，短时间内可以触发[极限闪避]；
若成功触发[极限闪避]，则会立即衔接[闪避反击：尾焰全旋]；
招式发动期间，保持拖曳摇杆或长按 【闪避键】 会持续漂移；
招式发动期间，会继续[特殊技：动力压制]的计时，达到最大时长时，自动衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]；
提前中断招式时，自动衔接[特殊技：脱缰]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升且拥有短暂无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
During Special Attack: Drive Suppression, drag the joystick or hold [Dodge] to activate:
Drifts with the motorcycle, enabling Perfect Dodges for a brief duration.
If a Perfect Dodge is successfully triggered, it immediately chains into Dodge Counter: Afterfire Spin.
During this skill, continue dragging the joystick or holding [Dodge] to continue drifting.
During this skill, the duration of Special Attack: Drive Suppression will continue, and upon reaching the maximum duration, it automatically chains into EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie.
If the skill ends early, it automatically chains into Special Attack: Run Wild.
Character is briefly invulnerable and Anti-Interrupt Level increases during this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：星-徽-惩-戒
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行快速斩击，造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Performs a quick forward slash, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：决斗之王
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前使用手炮轰击，造成物理伤害；
若通过[极限闪避]发动该招式，则该招式命中敌人时，回复自身10%生命值上限的生命值，并可以衔接第四段[普通攻击：骑士斗技]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Fires a blast from his arm cannon, dealing Physical DMG.
If this skill is triggered via a Perfect Dodge, hitting an enemy restores 10% of Max HP, and it can be chained into the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Knight's Technique.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避反击：尾焰全旋
skills.description:
[闪避：银河横行]期间触发[极限闪避]时自动发动：
旋转摩托对周围敌人造成物理伤害；
招式发动后，自动衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
During Dodge: Through the Galaxy, trigger a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Spins with the bike to deal Physical DMG to surrounding enemies.
After using this skill, it automatically chains into EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：骑士漫步
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，回复15点[决意]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gains 15 Determination.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：骑士飞踢
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
跃至空中朝目标进行飞踢攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Leaps into the air and delivers a flying kick at the target, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：星徽-羁绊之力
skills.nameEn: Quick Assist: Starlight - Power of Bonds
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前使用手炮轰击，造成物理伤害；
生命值大于25%时，发动该招式改为发动[特殊技：动力压制]，该效果每5秒至多生效1次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Fires a blast from his arm cannon ahead, dealing Physical DMG. When HP is above 25%, this skill is replaced with Special Attack: Drive Suppression. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：英雄登台
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：反派退场
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动踢车攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Kicks the motorcycle at the target, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：骑士决心
skills.description:
星徽·比利会额外根据自身最大生命值提高贯穿力，每1点最大生命值将提高0.1点贯穿力；发动招式造成的物理伤害均为贯穿伤害，无视敌人防御，使用贯穿力作为招式伤害倍率；
星徽·比利进入战场时即可回复60点闪能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次;
生命值大于25%时，可以点按 【特殊技键】 消耗生命值发动[特殊技：动力压制]，且接战状态下，每次发动该招式时，自身暴击伤害提升45%，持续45秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；生命值小于或等于25%时，受到的伤害减少50%；
星徽·比利攻击命中敌人时，会获得[决意]，回复量根据招式变化，[决意]上限为120点，处于接战状态下，会缓慢回复[决意]；[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]命中时、发动[连携技：骑士漫步]时或触发格挡时，额外回复[决意]；任意方式触发[极限闪避]时，回复3点[决意]，此效果0.5秒内最多触发一次；
当[决意]大于等于100点时，长按 【普通攻击键】 会消耗100点[决意]发动[普通攻击：最高马力星光]；
[普通攻击：骑士斗技]命中敌人时，回复少量生命值；通过[极限闪避]发动[闪避反击：决斗之王]命中敌人时，回复生命值；发动[强化特殊技：抓地轮毂]或[强化特殊技：摇曳步伐]时，回复生命值。
skills.descriptionEn:
Starlight - Billy gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1. All Physical DMG Starlight - Billy deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
Starlight - Billy restores 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When his HP is greater than 25%, press [Special Attack] to consume HP and activate Special Attack: Drive Suppression. While in combat, each use of this skill increases his CRIT DMG by 45% for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When HP is at or below 25%, the DMG he takes is reduced by 50%.
Starlight - Billy gains Determination when his attacks hit enemies, with the amount depending on the skill used. Determination regenerates slowly while in combat, and is capped at 120. Hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, activating Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger, or triggering a block restores additional Determination. Triggering a Perfect Dodge by any means restores 3 Determination. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
When Determination is greater than or equal to 100, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 100 Determination and activate Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight.
Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Knight's Technique restores a small amount of HP. Hitting an enemy with Dodge Counter: Duel King activated through a Perfect Dodge restores HP. Using EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels or EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork restores HP.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。

星徽·比利攻击命中敌人时，会获得[决意]，回复量根据招式变化，[决意]上限为120点，处于接战状态下，会缓慢回复[决意]；[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]命中时、发动[连携技：骑士漫步]时或触发格挡时，额外回复[决意]；任意方式触发[极限闪避]时，回复3点[决意]，此效果0.5秒内最多触发一次；
当[决意]大于等于100点时，长按 【普通攻击键】 会消耗100点[决意]发动[普通攻击：最高马力星光]；

skills.description:
队伍中存在[击破]或[防护]或[支援]角色时触发：
[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]、[普通攻击：骑士斗技]第四段、[连携技]、[终结技]命中敌人时获得一层[星辉]，同一招式至多获得一层，持续45秒，至多叠加2层，每层[星辉]会使[连携技]、[终结技]、[强化特殊技]和[普通攻击：最高马力星光]造成的伤害提升20%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun, Defense, or Support character:
Hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Knight's Technique, Chain Attack, or Ultimate grants 1 stack of Starlight for 45s, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, Only one stack can be obtained per use of a skill. Each stack increases the DMG of Chain Attacks, Ultimates, EX Special Attacks, and Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight by 20%.

cinema.name: 英雄登场
cinema.description: [核心被动：骑士决心]进入战场时，额外回复60点闪能；[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，使自身攻击造成的伤害无视目标18%物理伤害抗性，持续45秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: Core Passive: Knight's Resolve restores an additional 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack causes Starlight - Billy's DMG to ignore 18% Physical RES for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
cinema.story:
新艾利都的坏蛋就像特摄片里的一样多，而真正的英雄却没有几个。
「虽然我很会喊英雄的台词，不过我可能还算不上英雄…」
「但我会学着英雄的样子，站在大家的身前！」
cinema.storyEn:
There are just as many bad guys in New Eridu as in a visual FX show, but there aren't many real heroes.
"I might be good at shouting heroic lines, but I can't really call myself a hero yet..."
"But I'll follow their example and stand up front to protect everyone!"

cinema.name: 荒原机兵
cinema.description: [普通攻击：最高马力星光]、[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]和[终结技：骑士飞踢]造成的伤害提升50%；发动[强化特殊技：摇曳步伐]、[强化特殊技：抓地轮毂]时或发动[特殊技：动力压制]命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，获得[涡轮增压]效果：[特殊技：动力压制]会消耗该效果直接衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]，并使该次[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]造成的暴击伤害提升50%，[涡轮增压]效果至多叠加1层。
cinema.descriptionEn: Increases the DMG dealt by Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight, EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, and Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick by 50%. Activating EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork, EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels, or hitting a Stunned enemy with Special Attack: Drive Suppression grants the Turbocharged effect: Special Attack: Drive Suppression consumes this effect to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, and increases that instance's CRIT DMG by 50%. Only 1 stack of Turbocharged can be held.
cinema.story:
外环的神射手数不胜数，但在高速奔驰的机车上还能保持准头，才能成为真正的王牌。
「弹道算法和机械指头？那些当然很有用…」
「但我射术神准的真正原因是…星光选中了我！」
cinema.storyEn:
There's no shortage of sharpshooters in the Outer Ring, but keeping perfect aim on a speeding bike is what defines a real ace.
"Ballistic calculations and mechanical fingers? Of course they help..."
"But the real reason I'm dead-on every time is because... the Starlight chose me!"

cinema.name: 骑士精神
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
星徽骑士的精神到底是什么？永不退缩，锄强扶弱？牺牲、公正、怜悯、荣誉？
「认为正确的事情，就去做…」
「认为是不帅气的事情，就绝不能妥协！」
「这就是我绝不放弃同伴的理由！」
cinema.storyEn:
What does it really mean to be a Starlight Knight? Never backing down and standing up for the weak? Sacrifice, justice, compassion, honor?
"Do what is right..."
"And don't compromise on what's not cool!"
"That's why I'll never abandon my companions!"

cinema.name: 审判底火
cinema.description: 接战状态下，每次发动[特殊技：动力压制]时，自身暴击伤害提升8%，至多叠加2层，持续45秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；若生命值低于35%，且自身非当前操作中的角色时，会持续回复生命值至35%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in combat, each use of Special Attack: Drive Suppression increases Starlight - Billy's CRIT DMG by 8%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If HP is below 35% and Starlight - Billy is not the active character, he continuously recovers HP, up to 35%.
cinema.story:
理想的秩序为维护公义而生，然而理想生来就是为了被背弃。
「你说这些片子是小孩子才看的…？」
「有些最有勇气的梦想，本来只有小孩子才敢做吧？」
「这些被嘲笑的梦想，就由我——星徽·比利来守护！」
cinema.storyEn:
Ideals are born to uphold justice, yet they're destined to be abandoned.
"You're saying those shows are just for kids...?"
"The most courageous dreams are the ones only kids dare to believe in, right?"
"Then I, Starlight - Billy, will protect those ridiculed dreams!"

cinema.name: 辉光武装
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
身披华丽的衣装才能成为威风的英雄…所以说英雄还真是不方便的东西。
「我可不是因为加大口径的武器和加大功率的部件才变强的！」
「我真正的武装，是漫天的星光！」
cinema.storyEn:
You need a dazzling outfit to look like a real hero... it makes the whole thing pretty inconvenient.
"I'm not strong because of larger-caliber weapons or higher-power components!"
"My true weapon... is the endless starlight!"

cinema.name: 星徽骑士

cinema.descriptionEn: Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick and Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight's Sheer DMG increases by 18%. 1541.name: 普罗米娅

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
普罗米娅的手铐是在加入黑枝时被赋予的，这是她提出的，加入黑枝唯一的条件。黑枝并没有收走手铐的钥匙，但在任务以外，普罗米娅几乎不会主动解开手铐。对她而言，这是束缚，亦是审判。

传闻是对的。
对于身为清道夫的普罗米娅而言，曾经的她最主要的工作，便是处理那些遭到不可逆侵蚀症的「以骸」，了结他们的生命与痛苦。她本以为，这是为了某种宏大的使命，是为了脚下的土地。她颤抖着，接受了这样沉重的命运。
直到真相大白。
那个自负的、锋芒毕露的杀手死去了。幸存下来的，不过是一个背负着命运与愧疚的囚徒。
profile.descriptionEn:
Promeia received her handcuffs upon joining Krampus, something she personally insisted on as her only condition. Krampus didn't confiscate the key, but beyond duty to her mission, she almost never chooses to take them off. To her, they represent both restraint and judgment.

The rumors are true.
Back when Promeia was a Sweeper, her primary duty was dealing with so-called "Ethereals" afflicted with irreversible corruption, ending both their lives and their suffering. She once believed it was all for some greater cause, for the land beneath her feet. Trembling, she accepted that heavy fate.
Until the truth came to light.
That arrogant, razor-sharp killer died. What remained was nothing more than a prisoner, burdened by fate and guilt.

1541.description:
普罗米娅，坎卜斯黑枝的裁决官，主要负责「处刑」的工作。

相比于黑枝里其他性格鲜明的裁决官，普罗米娅更像是一座隐藏在水面下的冰山。她沉默寡言，几乎没有出于个人生活爱好的活动。

对于TOPS财联的大部分人而言，他们不希望自己与普罗米娅产生任何交集。倘若不幸东窗事发、被坎卜斯黑枝盯上，那些战战兢兢的违规者们祈祷的第一件事便是负责审查案件的裁决官不是普罗米娅。

公司内部私下流传着一条传闻，但没人敢公开讨论。在进入坎卜斯黑枝以前，普罗米娅出身于恶名昭著的清道夫，一个效力于卡吕冬、负责清扫「不稳定因素」的外环组织。
1541.descriptionEn:
Promeia, a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, is primarily responsible for carrying out "executions."

Unlike the other Judges in Krampus, each with their own strong personalities, Promeia feels more like an iceberg lurking beneath the surface. Quiet and reserved, she seems to have no personal interests or hobbies.

For the majority within the TOPS Alliance, avoiding any involvement with her is a given. If their misdeeds are exposed and they end up under Krampus scrutiny, the first thing those anxious rulebreakers pray for is that Promeia won't be handling their case.

There's a rumor that circulates quietly within the company, but no one dares talk about it openly. Before joining the Krampus Compliance Authority, Promeia came from the infamous Sweepers, an Outer Ring group that served Calydon and specialized in eliminating "unstable elements."

skills.name: 普通攻击：偏锋
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
第五段攻击为下落攻击，落地后保持长按 【特殊技键】 或 【普通攻击键】 ，若[霜刑]足够，可衔接[强化特殊技：处刑式·绝裁]；
第四段攻击将披风扔出后进入[镣锁赦罪]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to five attacks against enemies ahead, dealing Ice DMG.
After landing the fifth hit's downward attack, and with sufficient Trial by Cold, keep holding [Special Attack] or [Basic Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment.
Enters the Bound Absolution state after throwing the cape during the fourth hit.

skills.name: 普通攻击：旋刃
skills.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
普罗米娅向上跃起发动攻击，并将披风扔至敌人身边进入[镣锁赦罪]状态，造成冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，不累积[寒蚀值]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Promeia leaps into the air and attacks, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the Bound Absolution state, dealing Ice DMG.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate Corrosive Chill.

skills.name: 镣锁赦罪
skills.description:
普罗米娅在释放部分招式时会将披风扔出，持续切割敌人，造成冰属性伤害，命中敌人时不累积[寒蚀值]；
扔出披风期间，普罗米娅可缓慢行走；
期间点按 【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 可直接衔接[普通攻击：偏锋]第五段攻击；
期间受到攻击可自动触发[极限闪避]，闪避效果每20秒最多触发一次。
skills.descriptionEn:
When using certain skills, Promeia throws her cape to continuously slice enemies, dealing Ice DMG. Does not accumulate Corrosive Chill upon hit.
While the cape remains out, Promeia can walk slowly.
Press [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] during this period to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
If attacked during this period, Promeia triggers a Perfect Dodge automatically. The dodge can trigger once every 20s.

skills.name: 特殊技：处刑式·寒芒乍现
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
发动飞镖攻击，造成冰属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a flying blade attack, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：处刑式·封喉霜径
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
发动飞镖攻击，并将披风扔至敌人身边进入[镣锁赦罪]状态，造成冰属性伤害；
开始发动招式的短时间内，若受到敌人攻击，则会自动衔接[强化特殊技：处刑式·匿影]；
发动招式时，普罗米娅获得[铁律]效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a flying blade attack, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the Bound Absolution state, dealing Ice DMG.
If attacked by an enemy shortly after using the move, automatically chains into EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow.
Upon use, Promeia gains the Absolute Order effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：处刑式·匿影
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow
skills.description:
发动[强化特殊技：处刑式·封喉霜径]的短时间内受到攻击自动发动：
开启短时间的[极限视域]，并快速绕至敌人身后；
触发[极限闪避]后，若能量足够，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可消耗40点能量触发[强化特殊技：处刑式·匿影]，并获得[铁律]效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Triggers automatically when hit shortly upon activating EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death:
Enters the Vital View state briefly and swiftly circles behind the enemy.
After triggering a Perfect Dodge, and with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to consume 40 Energy and activate EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow, gaining the Absolute Order effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：处刑式·坠霜
skills.description:
拥有[铁律]效果时，在[镣锁赦罪]状态下点按 【普通攻击键】 或点按 【特殊技键】 发动 ：
跃向敌人，收回披风的同时进行下落攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
落地后若拥有[霜刑]，保持长按 【普通攻击键】 、 【特殊技键】 可衔接[强化特殊技：处刑式·绝裁]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While under the Absolute Order effect, press [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] while in the Bound Absolution state to activate:
Leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a descending attack that deals Ice DMG.
After landing, if Promeia possesses Trial by Cold, keep holding [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：处刑式·重霜
skills.description:
触发[强化特殊技：处刑式·匿影]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速发动多段攻击，随后跃向敌人，收回披风的同时进行更强力的下落攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
落地后若拥有[霜刑]，保持长按 【普通攻击键】 、 【特殊技键】 可衔接[强化特殊技：处刑式·绝裁]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After triggering EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow, press [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly launches a flurry of attacks, then leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a more powerful downward attack that deals Ice DMG.
After landing, if Promeia possesses Trial by Cold, keep holding [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：处刑式·绝裁
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment
skills.description:
[霜刑]足够时，发动[普通攻击：偏锋]的最后一段攻击、[特殊技：处刑式·坠霜]、[特殊技：处刑式·重霜]落地后保持长按 【普通攻击键】 、 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速闪身后跳的同时进行更强力的终结一击，造成冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，不累积[寒蚀值]；
招式发动后，可通过长按 【普通攻击键】 、 【特殊技键】 或点按 【普通攻击键】 直接衔接第五段[普通攻击：偏锋]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Trial by Cold and after performing the final hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge, Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost, or Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost, keep holding [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] after landing to activate:
Quickly leaps back while unleashing a more powerful finishing move, dealing Ice DMG.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate Corrosive Chill.
After using this skill, hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack], or press [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：霏步
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：掠命
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行快速攻击，造成冰属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick attack forward, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：蝠跃
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第五段[普通攻击：偏锋]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Ice DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：倒悬清算
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
扔出飞镖，倒吊在敌人上空进行多段攻击，随后进行终结一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
重击命中处于冰属性异常状态、以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的敌人时，触发1次[异放]效果，结算一次100%倍率的对应属性的属性异常伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第五段[普通攻击：偏锋]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws flying blades and hangs upside down above the enemy, unleashing a flurry of attacks and ending with a finishing move, dealing massive Ice DMG.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing 100% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：彻骨磔罚
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
重击命中处于冰属性异常状态、以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的敌人时，触发1次[异放]效果，结算一次250%倍率的对应属性的属性异常伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第五段[普通攻击：偏锋]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launches a series of forward attacks, dealing massive Ice DMG.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing 250% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：折袭
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：禁令
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：截兵
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第五段[普通攻击：偏锋]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Ice DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：盗火
skills.description:
若普罗米娅的初始异常掌控大于150点，每超过1点初始异常掌控会提升自身1.5点异常精通，提升0.35%全队造成的[异放]伤害；
普罗米娅的不同攻击命中敌人时回复一定[寒蚀值]，队伍中角色触发[冻结]效果、[紊乱]效果、敌人被触发[乱流]效果、自身触发[强化特殊技：处刑式·匿影]时，额外回复5/5/5/10点[寒蚀值]，最多积累100点[寒蚀值]；
队友触发[异放]效果命中敌人时，普罗米娅额外回复15点[寒蚀值]；
若[寒蚀值]大于等于50点，则消耗50点[寒蚀值]，转化为1点[霜刑]，最多获得2点[霜刑]；
进入战场时，普罗米娅获得2点[霜刑]；
发动[强化特殊技：处刑式·绝裁]的终结一击命中处于冰属性异常状态、以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的敌人时，触发1次[异放]效果，固定结算330%倍率的对应属性的属性异常伤害，招式发动时消耗1点[霜刑];
普罗米娅触发[异放]效果命中敌人时额外回复100点喧响值，0.5秒内最多触发一次，发动[终结技：彻骨磔罚]时获得[寒誓]效果，拥有[寒誓]效果时，发动[强化特殊技：处刑式·绝裁]、[连携技：倒悬清算]、[终结技：彻骨磔罚]后点按或长按 【特殊技键】 可消耗[寒誓]效果直接衔接[特殊技：处刑式·重霜]，[寒誓]效果最多获得1层。
skills.descriptionEn:
If Promeia's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 150, each additional point increases her Anomaly Proficiency by 1.5 and increases the whole squad's Abloom DMG by 0.35%.
Promeia gains a set amount of Corrosive Chill when her attacks hit enemies.
