普罗米娅的不同攻击命中敌人时回复一定[寒蚀值]，队伍中角色触发[冻结]效果、[紊乱]效果、敌人被触发[乱流]效果、自身触发[强化特殊技：处刑式·匿影]时，额外回复5/5/5/10点[寒蚀值]，最多积累100点[寒蚀值]；
队友触发[异放]效果命中敌人时，普罗米娅额外回复15点[寒蚀值]；
若[寒蚀值]大于等于50点，则消耗50点[寒蚀值]，转化为1点[霜刑]，最多获得2点[霜刑]；
进入战场时，普罗米娅获得2点[霜刑]；
发动[强化特殊技：处刑式·绝裁]的终结一击命中处于冰属性异常状态、以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的敌人时，触发1次[异放]效果，固定结算635%倍率的对应属性的属性异常伤害，招式发动时消耗1点[霜刑];
普罗米娅触发[异放]效果命中敌人时额外回复100点喧响值，0.5秒内最多触发一次，发动[终结技：彻骨磔罚]时获得[寒誓]效果，拥有[寒誓]效果时，发动[强化特殊技：处刑式·绝裁]、[连携技：倒悬清算]、[终结技：彻骨磔罚]后点按或长按 【特殊技键】 可消耗[寒誓]效果直接衔接[特殊技：处刑式·重霜]，[寒誓]效果最多获得1层。
levels.descriptionEn:
If Promeia's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 150, each additional point increases her Anomaly Proficiency by 1.5 and increases the whole squad's Abloom DMG by 0.35%.
Promeia gains a set amount of Corrosive Chill when her attacks hit enemies. When squad members trigger Freeze/Disorder, when the enemy is inflicted with Vortex, or when Promeia triggers EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow, she gains an additional 5/5/5/10 Corrosive Chill, up to a maximum of 100 Corrosive Chill.
When a squad member triggers and hits an enemy with Abloom, Promeia gains an additional 15 Corrosive Chill.
When Corrosive Chill reaches at least 50, 50 Corrosive Chill is consumed and converted into 1 point of Trial by Cold, up to a maximum of 2 points of Trial by Cold.
Upon entering the battlefield, Promeia gains 2 points of Trial by Cold.
When the finishing move of EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment hits an enemy afflicted with Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing 635% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute. The skill consumes 1 Trial by Cold upon activation.
When Promeia triggers and hits an enemy with Abloom, she gains an additional 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. Using Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement grants Frost Oath. With Frost Oath, after using EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment, Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment, or Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement, press or hold [Special Attack] to consume Frost Oath and immediately follow up with Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost. Only 1 stack of Frost Oath can be held.

skills.name: 额外能力：饮冰
skills.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或[支援]角色时触发：
发动[强化特殊技]时，普罗米娅的冰异常积蓄效率提升30%，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[霜寒]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升3秒；
普罗米娅发动[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，敌人获得[有罪推定]状态，全队角色对[有罪推定]状态的敌人造成[异放]效果时无视40%防御力，[有罪推定]状态持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly or Support character:
When using an EX Special Attack, Promeia's Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When any squad member applies the Frostbite effect to an enemy, its duration is increased by 3s.
When Promeia's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, it inflicts Presumption of Guilt. When any squad member triggers Abloom on a target with Presumption of Guilt, it ignores 40% of the target's DEF. Presumption of Guilt lasts 30s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.

cinema.name: 理想稚嫩
cinema.description: 普罗米娅发动[终结技：彻骨磔罚]时额外获得效果：[霜刑]不满时获得1点[霜刑]，该效果在发动[终结技：彻骨磔罚]后可触发一次；全队角色对[有罪推定]状态的敌人造成[异放]效果时额外无视20%防御力。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Promeia uses Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement, she gains an additional effect: if Trial by Cold points are not at maximum, gain 1 point of Trial by Cold. This effect can trigger once after using Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement. When any squad member triggers Abloom on enemies with Presumption of Guilt, it ignores an additional 20% DEF.
cinema.story:
这是一片混乱的无主之地。
轰鸣的引擎与扬起的沙尘，钢筋与血肉的碰撞，纷争与暴力，日日夜夜地上演着。
稚嫩的孩子握紧了同样稚嫩的武器，彷徨地走在同样彷徨的红土地上。
「你愿意，为这儿的和平尽一份力吗？」
cinema.storyEn:
This is a chaotic, lawless land.
Roaring engines and swirling dust, steel clashing with flesh. Conflict and violence play out day and night.
An innocent child grips an equally innocent weapon, wandering the same lost red earth.
"Would you be willing to do your part for the peace here?"

cinema.name: 信念飘摇
cinema.description: 普罗米娅的异常精通提升40点；消耗[霜刑]造成的[异放]效果的倍率提升120%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Promeia's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The multiplier of Abloom triggered by consuming Trial by Cold increases by 120%.
cinema.story:
她成为了出色的清道夫，干净利落，了无声息。目标清晰而众多，是以骸，是感染不可逆侵蚀症的患者，是终将异变的以骸，是溅起的血花与耳边的悲鸣。
可是，这是对的吗？
「这是清道夫的责任！」「就当是…为了这儿的大多数人，明白了吗！」「那些家伙迟早会死的。」…
「这是必要的牺牲。」
cinema.storyEn:
She became an exceptional Sweeper — swift, precise, and silent. Her targets were clear and countless: Ethereals, those infected with irreversible Corruption, those fated to turn into Ethereals... every kill marked by bloodshed and the echoes of their cries.
But... is it right?
"This is a Sweeper's duty!" "Just think of it as... for the greater good, got it?" "Those people were going to die anyway." ...
"It's a necessary sacrifice."

cinema.name: 月光残忍
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
真相往往从一次不起眼的意外中被剖出。
「只是处理那些没用的废物以骸的话，你以为清道夫要怎么捞到现在的油水？！」
「帮派斗争可是门稳赚不赔的生意。你怕脏了自己的手，『黑狼』倒是眼红得紧…」
很快，夜晚来了，比所有人以为的更早。
清道夫，卡吕冬，叫得上名字和叫不上名字的帮派，混乱的时代，似乎都消逝在漫漫无边的黑夜里。
cinema.storyEn:
The truth is often carved out from an unremarkable accident.
"You think the Sweepers could get rich just by dealing with worthless Ethereals?"
"Gang wars are a guaranteed profit. If you're afraid of getting your hands dirty, the 'Black Wolf' is more than eager..."
Night fell soon after, earlier than anyone expected.
The Sweepers, Calydon, the gangs with names and those without... in this chaotic age, all seemed to vanish into the endless dark.

cinema.name: 冷酷罪名
cinema.description: 普罗米娅触发[异放]效果时，回复5点[寒蚀值]，0.5秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Promeia triggers Abloom, she restores 5 Corrosive Chill. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
cinema.story:
一封邀请函寄来了对飞蛾的审判。
选择的权利，光明，正义，以及作为「普罗米娅」的全部。
她戴上手铐，选择了对自我的流放。
「这是我，最后的选择。」
cinema.storyEn:
An invitation arrived, summoning a moth to its judgment.
The right to choose, light, justice, and everything that made her "Promeia."
She put on the handcuffs and chose exile for herself.
"This is my final choice."

cinema.name: 飞蛾将死
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
她将自己淹没在工作之中。
调查，审讯，裁决，几乎无穷无尽。
同伴担忧地望着她。
「你打算这样…到什么时候？」
「直到赎清全部的罪行，或是迎接死亡。」
cinema.storyEn:
She buried herself in her work.
Investigations, interrogations, judgments... an endless list.
Her colleagues watched her with concern.
"How long are you going to keep this up...?"
"Until every last sin is atoned for... or until death takes me."

cinema.name: 故事未完待续
cinema.description: 普罗米娅消耗[霜刑]触发[异放]效果时，额外触发一次特殊的[异放]效果，固定结算200%倍率的对应属性的属性异常伤害，同时回复5点[寒蚀值]、100点喧响值，该效果每15秒最多触发一次；此外，普罗米娅造成的属性异常伤害、[紊乱]伤害无视敌人15%全属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Promeia consumes Trial by Cold to trigger Abloom, it triggers an additional special Abloom effect, dealing Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute at a fixed 200% multiplier. 5 Corrosive Chill and 100 Decibels are also restored. This effect can trigger at most once every 15s. In addition, Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG dealt by Promeia ignore 15% of enemies' All-Attribute RES.
cinema.story:
终点并没有如期到来，夜晚也并没有想象中的那般漆黑。
同僚，旧相识，深夜亮起的灯盏与新的朋友…
「可怜」的飞蛾似乎尚且无法摆脱如此沉甸甸的馈赠，某个期待已久的结局似乎更远了些。
但这样的命运，似乎也不错？
cinema.storyEn:
The end didn't arrive as expected, and the night wasn't as dark as imagined.
Colleagues, old acquaintances, late-night lights, and new friends...
The poor moth still couldn't shake off these heavy gifts, and that long-awaited ending now felt even further away.
But maybe... such a fate isn't so bad.

点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成以太伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to three attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：天光
skills.description:
[日珥]大于等于30点时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成大量以太伤害；
发动第三段攻击时若将其他角色换入前场，佩洛伊斯将在后场自动释放第四段攻击；
每段攻击命中敌人时均会消耗一定[日珥]；
招式第三段和第四段期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
If another character is switched in during the 3rd hit, Pyrois automatically performs the 4th hit off-field.
Each hit consumes a certain amount of Solar Prominence.
Character is invulnerable during the 3rd and 4th hits.

skills.name: 特殊技：残照
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
发动突进攻击，造成以太伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a rush attack, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：日华
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
快速突进并发动连续多段攻击，造成大量以太伤害；
突进期间受到敌人攻击时，可触发完美格挡效果，免疫该次伤害，提高招式的打断等级至与重招架支援一致；
招式发动后，若[日珥]大于等于30点，长按 【普通攻击键】 可直接衔接[普通攻击：天光]的第三段攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly charges forward and performs a series of consecutive attacks, dealing massive Ether DMG.
If hit by an enemy attack during the charge, triggers a Perfect Block effect, nullifying the damage and increasing the move's Interrupt Level to that of a Heavy Defensive Assist.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：重睹天日
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动突刺攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后，若[日珥]大于等于30点，长按 【普通攻击键】 可直接衔接[普通攻击：天光]的第三段攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Performs a forward thrust attack, dealing Ether DMG.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：煊赫车辇
skills.description:
进入战场时，佩洛伊斯获得30点[日珥]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，且不同攻击命中敌人时回复一定[日珥]，处于接战状态下，每秒回复0.5点[日珥]，最多获得60点；
佩洛伊斯发动不同[终结技]时，分别可获得如下效果：
上分支-[终结技：万军诛绝]：获得30点[日珥]，并获得[阳炎]状态，[阳炎]状态下，佩洛伊斯发动[终结技]对处于失衡状态下的敌人造成的暴击伤害提升40%，[日珥]大于等于30点时，[普通攻击：天光]的第四段攻击期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可直接衔接[普通攻击：天光]的第三段攻击，持续21秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
下分支-[终结技：凯旋坦途]：获得[耀斑]状态，[耀斑]状态下，能量获得效率提升15%，造成的伤害提升20%，发动[强化特殊技]触发完美格挡时回复10点[日珥]，持续200秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
左分支-[终结技：无拘剑势]：重击命中[浸染]状态下的敌人时，额外造成等同于450%攻击力的伤害；
右分支-[终结技：永陷幽囚]：重击命中失衡敌人触发[决算]效果，额外造成等同于1125%攻击力的伤害，招式发动时，使所有处于失衡状态的敌人失衡持续时间提升3秒，终结一击命中时敌人失衡结束。
skills.descriptionEn:
Upon entering battle, Pyrois gains 30 Solar Prominence. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. Landing different attacks on enemies grants a certain amount of Solar Prominence, and Pyrois also gains 0.5 Solar Prominence every second while in-combat, up to a max of 60.
When Pyrois uses different Ultimates, they gain the following effects:
Upper Branch - Ultimate: Total Annihilation: Gains 30 Solar Prominence and enters the Mirage state. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals 40% increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies, and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] during the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light. This effect lasts 21s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Lower Branch - Ultimate: Triumphant Return: Enters the Sunflare state. While in the Sunflare state, Energy Generation Rate increases by 15%, DMG dealt increases by 20%, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack grants 10 Solar Prominence. This effect lasts 200s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Left Branch - Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm: When this skill's heavy attack hits an enemy in the Contamination state, it deals 450% of ATK as additional DMG.
Right Branch - Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment: When this skill's heavy attack hits a Stunned enemy, the Totalize effect is triggered, dealing 1,125% of ATK as additional DMG. Upon activating this skill, the Stun duration of all currently Stunned enemies is extended by 3s. After landing the finishing move, the enemy's Stunned state ends.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。

进入战场时，佩洛伊斯获得30点[日珥]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，且不同攻击命中敌人时回复一定[日珥]，处于接战状态下，每秒回复0.5点[日珥]，最多获得60点；
佩洛伊斯发动不同[终结技]时，分别可获得如下效果：
上分支-[终结技：万军诛绝]：获得30点[日珥]，并获得[阳炎]状态，[阳炎]状态下，佩洛伊斯发动[终结技]对处于失衡状态下的敌人造成的暴击伤害提升40%，[日珥]大于等于30点时，[普通攻击：天光]的第四段攻击期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可直接衔接[普通攻击：天光]的第三段攻击，持续21秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
下分支-[终结技：凯旋坦途]：获得[耀斑]状态，[耀斑]状态下，能量获得效率提升15%，造成的伤害提升40%，发动[强化特殊技]触发完美格挡时回复10点[日珥]，持续200秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
左分支-[终结技：无拘剑势]：重击命中[浸染]状态下的敌人时，额外造成等同于900%攻击力的伤害；
右分支-[终结技：永陷幽囚]：重击命中失衡敌人触发[决算]效果，额外造成等同于2250%攻击力的伤害，招式发动时，使所有处于失衡状态的敌人失衡持续时间提升3秒，终结一击命中时敌人失衡结束。
levels.descriptionEn:
Upon entering battle, Pyrois gains 30 Solar Prominence. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. Landing different attacks on enemies grants a certain amount of Solar Prominence, and Pyrois also gains 0.5 Solar Prominence every second while in-combat, up to a max of 60.
When Pyrois uses different Ultimates, they gain the following effects:
Upper Branch - Ultimate: Total Annihilation: Gains 30 Solar Prominence and enters the Mirage state. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals 40% increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies, and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] during the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light. This effect lasts 21s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Lower Branch - Ultimate: Triumphant Return: Enters the Sunflare state. While in the Sunflare state, Energy Generation Rate increases by 15%, DMG dealt increases by 40%, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack grants 10 Solar Prominence. This effect lasts 200s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Left Branch - Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm: When this skill's heavy attack hits an enemy in the Contamination state, it deals 900% of ATK as additional DMG.
Right Branch - Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment: When this skill's heavy attack hits a Stunned enemy, the Totalize effect is triggered, dealing 2,250% of ATK as additional DMG. Upon activating this skill, the Stun duration of all currently Stunned enemies is extended by 3s. After landing the finishing move, the enemy's Stunned state ends.

skills.name: 额外能力：辉煌军势
skills.description:
队伍中存在[击破]或[支援]角色时触发：
佩洛伊斯的暴击伤害提升40%；
发动[连携技]时回复自身300点[喧响值]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Pyrois' CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
Using a Chain Attack grants 300 Decibels.

cinema.name: 黄昏旧章
cinema.description: 进入战场时，佩洛伊斯获得1000点[喧响值]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，暴击率提升8%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, Pyrois gains 1,000 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. CRIT Rate increases by 8%.
cinema.story:
幽夜是黝黯的潮水，沉沦文明的原野，
痴妄的神祇锻造灼亮的金矛，欲刺破深渊的喉管。
cinema.storyEn:
The dark night is a tide of shadow, drowning the fields of a fallen civilization.
Deluded gods forge a blazing golden spear, seeking to pierce the throat of the abyss.

cinema.name: 煜焰铁骑
cinema.description: 发动[终结技：凯旋坦途]时回复1500点[喧响值]，该效果180秒最多触发一次；佩洛伊斯的喧响值上限提升1000点。
cinema.descriptionEn: Using Ultimate: Triumphant Return grants 1,500 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s. Pyrois's Decibel limit increases by 1,000.
cinema.story:
所有被遗忘的故事与呜咽，都沉入一双眼睛的旱海；
等待一驾烈焰灼灼的车辇，碾过无光的渊面。
cinema.storyEn:
All forgotten stories and muffled cries sink into the arid sea behind a pair of eyes,
awaiting a chariot ablaze with searing flames to roll across the lightless surface of the abyss.

cinema.name: 命定枷锁
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
车舆煌煌，焦土茫茫，
天真稚子的躯壳中，却孕育燔荡生灵的暴君。
cinema.storyEn:
The chariot shines in splendor, the scorched earth stretches without end.
Yet within the body of an innocent child grows a tyrant destined to consume all life.

cinema.name: 焚昼孽火
cinema.description: 佩洛伊斯发动[强化特殊技：日华]触发完美格挡时，立刻获得等同于自身8%生命值上限的护盾，持续10秒，重复触发刷新持续时间，持有该护盾时，佩洛伊斯造成的失衡值提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Pyrois triggers a Perfect Block with EX Special Attack: Sun's Halo, immediately gain shield equal to 8% of Max HP, lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Pyrois deals 10% extra Daze while shielded.
cinema.story:
或许启明的灯火总要泅渡午夜，或许英雄的旅途总要踏过荆棘。
于是弃儿漫长地将自己放逐，直到孽火将仅剩的残躯焚尽。
cinema.storyEn:
Perhaps the beacon of first light can only be reached by passing through the darkest night. Perhaps every hero must walk a road of thorns.
So the forsaken child wanders in self-imposed exile, until the cursed fire burns away the final remains of their mortal shell.

cinema.name: 稚子禁卫
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
暴君的冠冕化作缰绳，银白的铁卫与骏马，
拱卫永远燃烧的稚子，跨过数字的牢笼与黑夜的虚言。
cinema.storyEn:
The tyrant's crown is remade as a bridle, with silver-white iron wardens and gallant horses.
They guard the child who burns forever, crossing beyond the digital prison and the deceptions of the night.

cinema.name: 拂晓晨星
cinema.description: 影画效果未揭示
cinema.descriptionEn: Mindscape Effect Hidden
cinema.story:
黄昏猩红若血，黎明温柔如旧。
晨星已从天际升起，抹去童年的泪痕，
它的轻叹如同诗句的尾韵——
长夜无非朝阳的序幕。
cinema.storyEn:
Dusk bleeds crimson, dawn soft as ever.
The morning star has risen above the horizon, wiping away the tears of childhood.
Its soft sigh lingers like the closing rhyme of a poem.
The long night is but a prelude to sunrise.

1561.name: 维琳娜
1561.faction: 罗斯凯利法·外务筹策局

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
作为玛瑟尔集团的管理机构，外策局需要负责处理邦布的退役审批事宜，因此在邦布市民眼中，维琳娜就是传说中的「告死的魔女」，令布遍体生寒的茶会主人。

实际上，维琳娜的真实身份，正是邦布世界中口耳相传的「首席天使」。但她并不介意蒙受恶名，魔女的名号在邦布相关事务中也能提供诸多便利，比起成为邦布们口中的天使，她更习惯作为他们沉默的守护者。

此外，维琳娜似乎在一些生活细节上出人意料的笨拙，尤其不擅长动植物饲养，有着「绿植杀手」的称号。

提议：或许可以作为快速拉近距离的思路之一。
profile.descriptionEn:
As the governing body of the Marcel Group, the External Strategy Department is responsible for handling Bangboo retirement approvals. Because of this, Velina is known among Bangboo citizens as the legendary "Death Witch" — the tea party host whose very presence sends chills through their circuits.

In reality, though, Velina is none other than the "Chief Angel" famed throughout Bangboo society. Yet she has no issue with her infamy. The title of witch makes many Bangboo-related matters easier to handle, and rather than being worshipped as an angel, she is more comfortable acting as their quiet protector.

Velina also seems unexpectedly awkward with certain aspects of daily life, particularly when it comes to raising plants or animals. She's even earned the title of "Serial Plant Killer."

Suggestion: Perhaps this could serve as an effective way to grow closer to her.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: SEP 22

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 维琳娜明明需要和各种人打交道，却喝不惯燃油饮…总感觉非常意外呢！
profile.descriptionEn: Velina deals with all kinds of people every day, yet she still can't get used to Nitro-Fuel... That's really surprising!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 铃…就算知道了她的弱点，你也别再打什么坏主意了…上次半夜把她送回外策局，可是引发了不小的骚动。
profile.descriptionEn: Belle... Even if you've figured out her weakness, don't go getting any ideas... Taking her back to the External Strategy Department that night caused a huge scene.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对维琳娜的印象：
 · 红茶与优雅似乎可以画上等号。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Velina:
 · Black tea and elegance go hand in hand.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 无懈可击的总务官也有不擅长的事。
profile.descriptionEn: · There are still things even the perfect Administrative Director struggles with.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 天使与魔女，两种身份能够同时存在吗？。
profile.descriptionEn: · Can a person be both an angel and a witch?

1561.description:
维琳娜，外务筹策局的总务官，统筹着罗斯凯利法与新艾利都的往来协作事宜。

作为名门艾嘉德家族的后人，维琳娜承袭了一丝不苟的家风，以近乎无懈可击的执行效率与控场能力著称，是诺姆技术官口中能够「应付开会签字和麻烦的大人」的可靠大人。

她行事干练、条理分明，待人接物温和得体，优雅从容的微笑下隐含着不容忽视的威慑性。无论是多么棘手的对外事务、荒唐祸端，她都能游刃有余地摆平，但向她求助的代价，却不一定是求助者能够承受的。

维琳娜对各类红茶情有独钟，也经常在闲暇时邀请朋友、举行茶会。

特别提醒：需要留意她以总务官身份发出的茶会邀请——那往往不止于消遣，更是她用于斡旋局势、悄然推进事态的绝佳场合。
1561.descriptionEn:
Velina, the Administrative Director of the External Strategy Department, oversees cooperation and diplomacy between Roscaelifer and New Eridu.

As a descendant of the prestigious Airgid family, Velina inherited a strict and meticulous upbringing. Renowned for her nearly flawless efficiency and exceptional ability to keep any situation under control, she is the dependable adult whom Chief Technician Norma describes as someone capable of "handling meetings, paperwork, and troublesome people."

She is sharp and efficient in her work, meticulous, and always gentle and composed when dealing with others. Beneath her elegant, effortless smile lies an intensity that is impossible to ignore. No matter how troublesome the diplomatic affair or absurd the disaster may be, Velina can resolve it with ease. However, the price of seeking her help is not always one the requester can afford.

Velina has a particular fondness for all kinds of black tea and often invites friends to tea parties during her spare time.

Please note: Any tea party invitation sent by Velina in her capacity as Administrative Director should never be taken lightly. They are rarely mere leisure. More often, they serve as the perfect setting for her to negotiate situations and quietly steer events toward her desired outcome.

skills.name: 普通攻击：扇舞
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成风属性伤害；
第五段攻击发动期间，维琳娜的抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to five attacks against enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG.
During the 5th attack, Velina's Anti-Interrupt Level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: 特殊技：风切变·激浊
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purging Surge
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前扇出一道风，造成风属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a sweeping gust forward, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：风切变·扬清
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
先向后闪避，随后扇出巨大风弹攻击敌人，造成风属性伤害；
向后闪避期间，具备闪避判定，如果成功闪避敌人攻击，会触发[极限视域]；
发动该招式后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接[普通攻击]第五段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Dodges backward, then unleashes a massive wind blast to attack enemies, dealing Wind DMG.
During the backward dodge, a dodge effect is active. Successfully dodging an enemy attack triggers Vital View.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to chain into the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：风切变·三重绝息
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow
skills.description:
能量足够时，在[强化特殊技：风切变·扬清]后点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
连续挥舞扇子，对敌人造成风属性伤害；
发动该招式后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接[普通攻击]第五段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy and after using EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Continuously swings the fan, dealing Wind DMG.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to chain into the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：风切变·风暴眼
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm
skills.description:
[风华]大于等于90点时，长按 【特殊技键】 或 【普通攻击键】 发动：
维琳娜汇聚旋风，随后召唤出[广域气旋]，持续攻击敌人，并触发上一位角色的[快速支援]；
[广域气旋]持续5秒，每0.5秒对周边敌人造成一次风属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
With 90 or more Windbloom, hold [Special Attack] or [Basic Attack] to activate:
Velina channels a whirlwind and summons a Sweeping Cyclone to continuously attack enemies and triggers the previous character's Quick Assist.
Sweeping Cyclone lasts for 5s and deals Wind DMG to nearby enemies once every 0.5s.

skills.name: 闪避：拂岚
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：踏风
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行快速攻击，造成风属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick attack forward, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：折云
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：旋舞华章
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
化作飓风，对敌人进行多段攻击，随后进行终结一击，造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Transforms into a hurricane to unleash multiple attacks against enemies, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：聆听呼啸
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动后将触发上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes multiple attacks against enemies ahead, dealing massive Wind DMG.
After using this skill, the previous character's Quick Assist is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：紧急预案
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：裁量干预
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：谈判技巧
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a series of attacks, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：风华盈袖
skills.description:
维琳娜初始能量自动回复大于1.2时，超过部分每超过0.01，造成的伤害提升0.21%，最多提升35%，异常掌控提升0.5点，最多提升84点；
维琳娜进入战场时，获得45点[风华]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，维琳娜发动[强化特殊技：风切变·扬清]或[强化特殊技：风切变·三重绝息]都会获得45点[风华]，[风华]上限为135点；
维琳娜触发[乱流]时，会获得1点[风蚀]并召唤[微域气旋]，造成风属性伤害，该效果每3秒最多触发一次，当维琳娜拥有2点[风蚀]时，维琳娜下一次触发[乱流]时，会消耗2点[风蚀]使此时[乱流]的伤害倍率提升90%，并且不再召唤[微域气旋]转而召唤[广域气旋]，此时不会获得[风蚀]；
当维琳娜召唤的[广域气旋]首次命中处于[浸染]状态下的敌人，会触发[赋彩]效果，转化为相应属性的[广域气旋]，并会造成相应属性的伤害，[广域气旋]攻击命中敌人时，会使敌人的风属性异常积蓄抗性降低7%，持续35秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，若[赋彩]后的[广域气旋]攻击命中敌人，则敌人的相应属性异常积蓄抗性也会降低7%，持续35秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；

When Velina triggers Vortex, she gains 1 point of Windbite and summons a Condensed Cyclone, dealing Wind DMG. This effect can trigger once every 3s. When Velina has 2 points of Windbite, the next time she triggers Vortex, 2 points of Windbite are consumed to increase that Vortex's DMG Multiplier by 130%. In addition, a Sweeping Cyclone is summoned instead of a Condensed Cyclone, which does not grant Windbite.
When Velina's summoned Sweeping Cyclone hits an enemy suffering Contamination for the first time, it triggers Chromatic Tint, converting it into a Sweeping Cyclone of the corresponding attribute, dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG. When Sweeping Cyclone hits an enemy, the enemy's Wind Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If a Sweeping Cyclone enhanced by Chromatic Tint hits an enemy, the enemy's corresponding Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES is also reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by Sweeping Cyclone is defeated, the duration of that Sweeping Cyclone is extended by 5s. This effect can only trigger once for the same Sweeping Cyclone, and only one Sweeping Cyclone can exist at a time.
Condensed Cyclone and Sweeping Cyclone trigger an explosion when they dissipate. If this explosion hits an enemy suffering a Wind Anomaly, it triggers one instance of Abloom DMG against the target: resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG, dealing a fixed 125% and 215% multiplier Wind Anomaly DMG respectively.

levels.label: E
levels.description:
维琳娜初始能量自动回复大于1.2时，超过部分每超过0.01，造成的伤害提升0.21%，最多提升35%，异常掌控提升0.5点，最多提升84点；
维琳娜进入战场时，获得45点[风华]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，维琳娜发动[强化特殊技：风切变·扬清]或[强化特殊技：风切变·三重绝息]都会获得45点[风华]，[风华]上限为135点；

当维琳娜召唤的[广域气旋]首次命中处于[浸染]状态下的敌人，会触发[赋彩]效果，转化为相应属性的[广域气旋]，并会造成相应属性的伤害，[广域气旋]攻击命中敌人时，会使敌人的风属性异常积蓄抗性降低7%，持续35秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，若[赋彩]后的[广域气旋]攻击命中敌人，则敌人的相应属性异常积蓄抗性也会降低7%，持续35秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
受到[广域气旋]影响的敌人被击败时，会使该[广域气旋]的持续时间延长5秒，该效果对同一[广域气旋]仅能触发一次，同一时间只能存在一个[广域气旋]；
[微域气旋]和[广域气旋]会在消散时触发一次爆炸，该次爆炸命中处于风属性异常状态下的敌人时，都会对目标造成一次[异放]伤害：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，固定结算135%和235%倍率的风属性异常伤害。

skills.name: 额外能力：茶会礼仪
skills.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身属性相同的角色时触发：
维琳娜造成的[风化]和[乱流]伤害提升10%，[终结技]重击命中处于风属性异常状态下的敌人时，会对目标造成一次[异放]伤害：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，固定结算680%倍率的风属性异常伤害；
[核心被动：风华盈袖]中，[广域气旋]造成的属性异常积蓄抗性降低效果额外提升7%，造成的失衡值提升30%，累积的属性异常积蓄值提升15%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same attribute:
Velina's Windswept and Vortex DMG increases by 10%. When the heavy attack from an Ultimate hits an enemy suffering a Wind Attribute Anomaly, it triggers an instance of Abloom DMG against the target: resolves one additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG, fixed at 680% of Wind Attribute Anomaly DMG.
For Core Passive: Breeze in Bloom, the Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES reduction from Sweeping Cyclone is further increased by 7%, while Daze inflicted increases by 30%, and accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup increases by 15%.

cinema.name: 秩序化优雅
cinema.description: [额外能力：茶会礼仪]中，[广域气旋]造成的失衡值额外提升20%；维琳娜触发[乱流]时无视目标20%全属性伤害抗性；全队造成[风化]伤害时，无视目标20%风属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: Sweeping Cyclone from Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette deals an additional 20% Daze. When Velina triggers Vortex, she ignores 20% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When squad members deal Windswept DMG, 20% of the target's Wind RES is ignored.
cinema.story:
一切言辞与举止，皆被精确安排在应有的位置之上。
对方往往尚未察觉，便欣然接受了她所设定的边界、节奏与结果——
「所谓优雅，不过是秩序运转时最自然的呈现。」
cinema.storyEn:
Every word and gesture is placed precisely where it belongs.
Before the other party even realizes it, they willingly accept the boundaries, rhythm, and outcome she has arranged—
"Elegance is simply the most natural expression of order in motion."

cinema.name: 饱和式计划
cinema.description: 维琳娜触发[风化]时，也可以获取1点[风蚀]，该效果每5秒最多触发一次；[广域气旋]触发[赋彩]效果后，可以积蓄相应属性的异常积蓄值，且该攻击累积的属性异常积蓄值不参与异常伤害结算；[额外能力：茶会礼仪]中，维琳娜造成的[风化]和[乱流]伤害提升效果额外提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Velina triggers Windswept, she can also gain 1 point of Windbite. This effect can trigger once every 5s. After Sweeping Cyclone triggers the Chromatic Tint effect, it can accumulate the corresponding attribute's Anomaly Buildup. The buildup accumulated by this attack is excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations. The DMG increase effects of Velina's Windswept and Vortex from Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette are further increased by 15%.
cinema.story:
预设一切可能，覆盖所有变数，甚至为失控献上余地。
她从不寄望侥幸，每一种结局各得归处。
纵使局势片刻偏离，也不过是被引入另一条早已准备好的路径。
「唉，果然如此吗…所幸我并非全无准备。」
cinema.storyEn:
She anticipates every possibility, accounts for every variable, and makes backup plans for things going wrong.
She never relies on chance. Every ending is calculated.
Even if the situation veers off course for a moment, it only leads onto another path she has already prepared for.
"Sigh, so it's come to this... Good thing I'm not entirely unprepared."

cinema.name: 礼仪性征服
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
无需以力量压制，无需依赖情绪与恫吓。
只需一个得体的回应，一次恰到好处的让步…
局势便已在无形中收束，直至归于既定的征服。
「礼仪是掩盖暴力的手段？」
「抑或，礼仪是更高的暴力？」
cinema.storyEn:
No need to force submission through strength, nor rely on emotion or intimidation.
A graceful response and a carefully measured compromise are enough...
Before anyone realizes it, the situation has already been steered toward destined conquest.
"Is etiquette simply violence in disguise?"
"Or is etiquette the more refined form of violence?"

cinema.name: 茶话即审判
cinema.description: 维琳娜发动[强化特殊技]会使自身攻击力提升15%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Velina uses an EX Special Attack, her ATK increases by 15% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
言笑之间，轻重既分。
红茶未凉，定论已成。
「若某件事让我苦恼，尽快处理妥当就好。若某个人让我苦恼，呵…」
cinema.storyEn:
In the midst of laughter and conversation, the scales have already tipped.
The tea has yet to go cold, yet the verdict is already sold.
"If something's bothering me, I'll simply deal with it and move on. And if someone's bothering me, heh..."

cinema.name: 告死魔女
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
「听见她的脚步，便是听见判决！」
「接过她的请柬，便是步入葬仪！」
银发的魔女端坐于邦布王国的剧场之下，聆听着小小演员对自己深信不疑的诋毁，轻摇华扇，微笑不语。
cinema.storyEn:
"Her footsteps herald judgment!"
"Her invitation is your funeral!"
The silver-haired witch sits calmly beneath the theater of the Bangboo Kingdom, listening to the tiny performers hurl accusations at her with absolute conviction. She gently waves her ornate fan, smiling without a word.

cinema.name: 首席天使
cinema.description: 当维琳娜消耗2点[风蚀]提升[乱流]伤害倍率时，会获得1点[风蚀]，该效果每6秒最多触发一次；维琳娜攻击命中处于风属性异常状态下的敌人时，造成的风属性异常积蓄值提升20%；当维琳娜对处于[风化]状态的敌人再次施加[风化]时，会根据上一次[风化]的剩余持续时间提升此次[风化]的伤害，每1秒剩余持续时间会使伤害提升2.5%，最多提升40%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Velina consumes 2 points of Windbite to increase the DMG Multiplier of Vortex, she gains 1 point of Windbite. This effect can trigger once every 6s. When Velina hits an enemy suffering a Wind Attribute Anomaly, the Wind Attribute Anomaly Buildup she inflicts increases by 20%. When Velina inflicts Windswept on an enemy already affected by Windswept, the new Windswept's DMG increases based on the remaining duration of the previous. Each remaining second increases the DMG by 2.5%, up to a maximum increase of 40%.
cinema.story: 「不必问询天使的名姓。她藏在谣言里，藏在训诫后，藏在你战战兢兢递来的求助信里。」
cinema.storyEn: "There is no need to ask an angel's name. She hides within rumors, behind reprimands, and within the fearful letters requesting aid you deliver with shaking hands."

1571.name: 诺姆
1571.faction: 罗斯凯利法·外务筹策局

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
对于自己的技术有绝对的自信，永远怀揣追逐新鲜事物和探索边界的好奇心，至于满足这份好奇心的手段，站在不同的立场可以分别用「天真」和「可怕」来形容。

具有敏锐的洞察力，能够捕捉事物间常人难以理解的联系，解决问题的方式往往也天马行空。

虽然被邦布们所畏惧，但也总还能骗到成堆的邦布参与自己的实验项目，诀窍在于与任何邦布和学龄前儿童都能打成一片的高超社交手腕（也仅在少经世事的邦布和孩子们面前生效）。

行事手段总令不明所以的人与邦布感到恐慌，但使她对于邦布技术如此热切的缘由除了科学家的好奇心以外，也在于承继挽昼女士的邦布技术责任之重。
profile.descriptionEn:
She has absolute confidence in her own technology and is always driven by a curiosity to pursue new things and push boundaries. As for the methods she uses to satisfy that curiosity, depending on one's perspective, they could be described as either "innocent" or "terrifying."

She possesses sharp insight, capable of noticing connections between things that most people would never understand, and her methods of solving problems are often wildly unconventional.

Although feared by Bangboo, she still somehow manages to rope many of them into participating in her experiments. The key is her surprisingly impressive social skills with Bangboo and preschool-aged children alike, though those skills only seem effective on the innocent and inexperienced.

Her methods often leave both people and Bangboo who do not understand her intentions feeling uneasy, yet her deep dedication to Bangboo technology stems not only from scientific curiosity but also from the burden of carrying on Lady Sunbringer's technological legacy.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JUL 26

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 这下如果家里的邦布出了什么疑难杂症，就不愁没地方给孩子「看病」了~！
profile.descriptionEn: Now if the Bangboo at home ever come down with some strange malfunction, we'll know where to find a "doctor"~!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 那我现在有点理解不愿意去宠物医院的宠物们的心情了。
profile.descriptionEn: I think I finally understand how pets feel when they don't want to go to the vet.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对诺姆的印象：
 · 首席邦布顾问，也是首席麻烦制造专家。
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Norma:
 · Chief Bangboo Tech Consultant, and also the Chief Troublemaker.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 今天惹下的麻烦，就用「嗯呢」来蒙混过关吧。
profile.descriptionEn: · Let's just smooth over today's mess with a few "en-nah"s.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 触摸每一个电流回路，就像触碰每一次心跳。
profile.descriptionEn: · Touching every circuit feels like touching every heartbeat.

1571.description:
诺姆，外务筹策局首席技术官，亦是玛瑟尔集团技术中枢的核心人物。无论头衔如何冗长或复杂，年轻的诺姆小姐毋庸置疑都是当下邦布技术领域的泰斗级人物，就算是挽昼女士本人，也未必比诺姆更加了解邦布机体中的每一个齿轮和芯片。

符合人们对于天才科学家的刻板印象，工程学的精湛技艺与待人接物的水平成反比，认真对待维琳娜制定的《礼仪手册》，也认真地从来不执行。

性能至上主义，由于激进的邦布改造技术和站有些缺乏布文关怀的行事作风，一度遭到邦布们的畏惧，被视为是不择手段的可怕科学家。——抱有相仿观点的或许还有外策局实验室的安全工程师们。

与其说是「首席专家」的头衔为诺姆戴上了邦布技术的皇冠，不如说诺姆本身就是玛瑟尔集团技术高峰的象征。
1571.descriptionEn:
Norma, Chief Technician of the External Strategy Department and a central figure within Marcel Group's technological center. No matter how long or complicated her titles may sound, the young Miss Norma is without question a titan in the field of Bangboo technology. Even Lady Sunbringer herself may not understand every gear and chip inside a Bangboo body better than Norma does.

She fits every stereotype people have about genius scientists: her engineering skills are exceptional, while her people skills are inversely proportional. She takes Velina's "Etiquette Manual" seriously, and is equally serious about never following it.

A firm believer in performance above all, she was once feared by Bangboo due to her radical Bangboo modification techniques and somewhat less-than-Bangboo-centered approach, earning a reputation as a terrifying scientist who would stop at nothing for her research. ...The safety engineers at the External Strategy Department lab may share a similar view.

It's less that the title of "Chief Technician" crowned Norma in the field of Bangboo technology, and more that Norma herself represents the pinnacle of the Marcel Group's technological achievements.

skills.name: 普通攻击：工程保险
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：帽子把戏
skills.description:
诺姆为当前操作角色，且处于接战状态时，每秒获得1.5%[预热膛温]；
头上有[随行礼帽]时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
炮击后扔出[随行礼帽]，令[随行礼帽]发动一轮空中射击，造成火属性伤害，并暂存[预热膛温]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发上一位角色的[快速支援]，5秒内最多触发一次；
[随行礼帽]被扔出后，会代替诺姆以相同的速度累积并暂存[预热膛温]，期间诺姆无需在前场；
诺姆重新拾取[随行礼帽]后，将立即获得暂存的[预热膛温]；
长按 【普通攻击键】 时， [随行礼帽]会加速跑向诺姆；
当诺姆拾取[随行礼帽]后的[预热膛温]能够达到80%时，[随行礼帽]会自动加速跑向诺姆；
当诺姆从前场切换至后场，且处于接战状态时，若[预热膛温]未满，[随行礼帽]会自动跳入战场；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Norma is the active character and is in combat, she gains 1.5% Preheated Chamber per second.
When Top Hat Companion is on her head, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
After firing, Norma throws out Top Hat Companion, ordering it to unleash a round of aerial fire, dealing Fire DMG and storing the current Preheated Chamber.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the previous character's Quick Assist. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Once Top Hat Companion has been thrown out, it will accumulate and retain Preheated Chamber at the same speed on behalf of Norma. Norma does not need to stay on the field during this period.
After Norma retrieves the Top Hat Companion, she immediately gains the stored Preheated Chamber.
When holding [Basic Attack], the Top Hat Companion will accelerate toward Norma.
If retrieving the Top Hat Companion would raise Preheated Chamber to 80% or higher, the Top Hat Companion will automatically accelerate toward Norma.
When Norma switches from on field to off field while in combat, if Preheated Chamber is not full, Top Hat Companion automatically enters the battlefield.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：高温熔断
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
炮击，造成火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Bombards enemies, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：嗯呢弹幕
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
驾驶炮塔连续射击并根据敌人状态发射不同类型的导弹：
主要攻击目标未处于失衡状态时，发射破甲弹头，造成火属性伤害并累积较多失衡值；
主要攻击目标处于失衡状态时，发射高爆弹头，造成更高火属性伤害；
招式发动后，诺姆获得16%[预热膛温]，并进入[嗯呢弹幕]状态，持续32秒，[嗯呢弹幕]状态期间，诺姆会放置两座[嗯呢炮塔]加入战斗；
保持长按可以持续消耗能量并延长最多2秒射击时间，每通过长按消耗1点能量，诺姆额外获得0.4%[预热膛温]，并使本轮[嗯呢弹幕]状态的持续时间额外增加0.8秒，最多增加32秒；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Operates the turret to fire continuously and launch different types of missiles based on the target's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launches an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing Fire DMG and inflicting a large amount of Daze.
When the primary target is Stunned, launches a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater Fire DMG.
After using this skill, Norma gains 16% Preheated Chamber and enters the En-Nah Barrage state for 32s. While En-Nah Barrage is active, Norma deploys two En-Nah Turrets to join the battle.
Continuing to hold extends the firing time by up to 2s, continuously consuming energy. For each 1 point of energy consumed while holding, Norma gains an additional 0.4% Preheated Chamber, and this round of En-Nah Barrage lasts 0.8s longer, up to a maximum additional duration of 32s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：打靶练习
skills.description: 战斗中，[嗯呢炮塔]会自动对敌人发动攻击， 造成火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: During battle, En-Nah Turret automatically attacks enemies, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：火力实验
skills.description:
队伍中任意角色使敌人进入失衡状态时，或是诺姆消耗[预热膛温]触发[连携技]时，[嗯呢炮塔]会展开导弹舱，持续8秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
期间，[嗯呢炮塔]的自动攻击间隔减少，自动攻击时根据敌人状态额外发射不同类型的导弹：
主要攻击目标未处于失衡状态时，发射破甲弹头，造成火属性伤害并累积较多失衡值；
主要攻击目标处于失衡状态时，发射高爆弹头，造成更高火属性伤害；
skills.descriptionEn:
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, or when Norma consumes Preheated Chamber to trigger a Chain Attack, En-Nah Turret deploys its missile bay for 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
During this time, En-Nah Turrets automatically attack more frequently. When performing automatic attacks, they launch different missiles based on the enemy's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launch an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing Fire DMG and inflicting a large amount of Daze.
When the primary target is Stunned, launch a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater Fire DMG.

skills.name: 闪避：开发规范
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：死线冲刺
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
旋转并对周围开火，造成火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Spins while firing at nearby enemies, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：合规测试
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
令隆隆钻头进行持续钻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Commands the Rumble Drill to continuously drill the target, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：冲击钻探
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
命令大量隆隆钻头对敌人进行多段攻击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Commands a swarm of Rumble Drills to deal multiple hits, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：优势火力学说
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
召唤战术火炮轰炸前方敌人，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，立刻获得30%[预热膛温]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Calls in tactical artillery to bombard enemies ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, immediately gains 30% Preheated Chamber.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：隆隆援护
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
令隆隆钻头进行持续钻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Commands the Rumble Drill to continuously attack the target, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：技术壁垒
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：技术压制
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a series of attacks, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：精准制导
skills.description:
初始暴击率超过50%时，每超过1%，暴击伤害提升0.86%，最多额外提升43%；
初始暴击率超过50%时，每超过1%，[强化特殊技]、[特殊技]、[终结技]攻击命中敌人时，造成的失衡值提升0.44%，最多额外提升22%；
诺姆会根据自身贯穿力额外提升攻击力，每1点贯穿力将提升1.25点攻击力，最多提升1200点攻击力；
进入战场时，诺姆立刻获得60%[预热膛温]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
[预热膛温]大于等于80%后，下次发动的[普通攻击：帽子把戏]将无视冷却时间限制触发[快速支援]，并消耗80%[预热膛温]将其替换为[连携技]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases her CRIT DMG by 0.86%, up to a maximum increase of 43%.
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases the Daze dealt by her EX Special Attack, Special Attack, and Ultimate by 0.44% when they hit an enemy, up to a maximum increase of 22%.
Norma gains additional ATK based on her Sheer Force. Every 1 point of Sheer Force increases her ATK by 1.25, up to a maximum increase of 1,200 ATK.
Upon entering the battlefield, Norma immediately gains 60% Preheated Chamber. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Preheated Chamber is at least 80%, the next Basic Attack: Hat Trick can trigger a Quick Assist regardless of cooldown, and consumes 80% Preheated Chamber to replace the Quick Assist with a Chain Attack.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。

When Preheated Chamber is at least 80%, the next Basic Attack: Hat Trick can trigger a Quick Assist regardless of cooldown, and consumes 80% Preheated Chamber to replace the Quick Assist with a Chain Attack.

levels.label: F
levels.description:
初始暴击率超过50%时，每超过1%，暴击伤害提升1.7%，最多额外提升85%；
初始暴击率超过50%时，每超过1%，[强化特殊技]、[特殊技]、[终结技]攻击命中敌人时，造成的失衡值提升0.8%，最多额外提升40%；
诺姆会根据自身贯穿力额外提升攻击力，每1点贯穿力将提升1.25点攻击力，最多提升1200点攻击力；
进入战场时，诺姆立刻获得60%[预热膛温]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
[预热膛温]大于等于80%后，下次发动的[普通攻击：帽子把戏]将无视冷却时间限制触发[快速支援]，并消耗80%[预热膛温]将其替换为[连携技]。
levels.descriptionEn:
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases her CRIT DMG by 1.7%, up to a maximum increase of 85%.
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases the Daze dealt by her EX Special Attack, Special Attack, and Ultimate by 0.8% when they hit an enemy, up to a maximum increase of 40%.
Norma gains additional ATK based on her Sheer Force. Every 1 point of Sheer Force increases her ATK by 1.25, up to a maximum increase of 1,200 ATK.
Upon entering the battlefield, Norma immediately gains 60% Preheated Chamber. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Preheated Chamber is at least 80%, the next Basic Attack: Hat Trick can trigger a Quick Assist regardless of cooldown, and consumes 80% Preheated Chamber to replace the Quick Assist with a Chain Attack.

skills.name: 额外能力：集群优势
skills.description:
队伍中存在[强攻]、[命破]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
诺姆及其造物、战斗邦布攻击命中敌人时，对敌人施加1层[技术鸿沟]，每层[技术鸿沟]能够使目标的失衡易伤倍率提升3%，最多叠加10层，每0.5秒最多叠加1层；
持有任意层数[技术鸿沟]的敌人进入失衡状态后的失衡持续时间提升2秒，失衡持续时间提升效果与同类效果不可叠加，拥有[技术鸿沟]效果的敌人失衡结束时[技术鸿沟]效果结束；
[嗯呢弹幕]期间，诺姆的攻击力提升44点，该效果随角色等级提升，每级增加14点，最多提升870点；
[嗯呢弹幕]期间，全队代理人造成的伤害提升20%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character, or shares the same Faction:
When Norma, her creations, or Combat Bangboo hit an enemy, they apply 1 stack of Tech Divide. Each stack of Tech Divide increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 3%, stacking up to 10 times. This effect can stack once every 0.5s.
Enemies with Tech Divide stacks have their Stun duration increased by 2s upon becoming Stunned. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy affected by Tech Divide recovers from Stun, the Tech Divide effect ends.
While En-Nah Barrage is active, Norma's ATK increases by 44. This effect scales with character level, increasing by 14 per level, up to a maximum increase of 870.
While En-Nah Barrage is active, DMG dealt by all squad members increases by 20%.

cinema.name: 激进远视主义
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：火力实验]中[嗯呢炮塔]展开导弹舱的持续时间增加至12秒；任意招式中的[破甲弹头]或[高爆弹头]命中敌人时，使敌人的全属性伤害抗性降低15%，持续15秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: The duration of the En-Nah Turret's missile bay deployed by EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment increases to 12s. When an Armor-Piercing Warhead or High-Explosive Warhead from any skill hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
前进！不择手段地前进！
末日里追逐我们的东西太多，漆黑的边界，短暂的寿限。
人类的生命与文明，比邦布的逻辑核心还要易碎。
只有不择手段地前进，才能永远比毁灭快上那么一点。
「而且，最先看到的风景永远最美妙，不是吗？」
cinema.storyEn:
Advance! By any means necessary!
Too many things are chasing us in this dying world: the pitch-black frontier, our fleeting lifespan.
Human life and civilization are more fragile than a Bangboo's logic core.
The only way to stay ahead of destruction is to keep moving forward, by any means necessary.
"Besides, the first to witness a new horizon always sees the most beautiful view, don't they?"

cinema.name: 万物统一公理
cinema.description: [额外能力：集群优势]中，每层[技术鸿沟]提供的失衡易伤倍率提升至6%；诺姆处于接战状态下发动[普通攻击：帽子把戏]时，回复25点能量，20秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Stun DMG Multiplier granted by each stack of Tech Divide in Norma's Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers is increased to 6%. When Norma uses Basic Attack: Hat Trick while in combat, she gains 25 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
cinema.story:
物理学家的世界总是被新理论一次次颠覆，普通人的秩序也总是被新的意外和纷争所毁灭。
万事万物的联系总是莫测，极端紧密极端脆弱，如此难以捉摸。
「让邦布和罗斯凯利法更加伟大？你是说『追逐好奇心的副产物』吧？」
cinema.storyEn:
The world of physicists is constantly overturned by new theories. The order ordinary people rely on is just as often shattered by unexpected events and conflict.
The ties that bind all things are always mysterious, both incredibly intimate and incredibly fragile, impossible to fully comprehend.
"Bring Bangboo and Roscaelifer to greater heights? You mean 'the byproduct of chasing curiosity,' right?"

cinema.name: 天生反派佯谬
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
风和日丽的罗斯凯利法又是平静安宁的一天，没有什么反派敢在天空之城兴风作浪。
不过对邦布们来说，或许还是有一位超级大反派——
「儿童动画里最棒的天才总是要跑去当坏蛋…」
「拜托，头发和预算一样紧巴巴的可怜疯狂科学家到底有什么好的？」
cinema.storyEn:
It's another calm, peaceful day in Roscaelifer, with clear skies and a gentle breeze.
But for the Bangboo, there may still be one ultimate supervillain...
"Why is it that the smartest genius in every kids' cartoon always ends up becoming the bad guy...?"
"Seriously, what's so great about those crazy scientists whose budget and hairline are both hanging on by a thread?"

cinema.name: 优势邦布学说
cinema.description: 诺姆消耗[预热膛温]触发[连携技]时：使诺姆和对应代理人回复200点喧响值。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Norma consumes Preheated Chamber to trigger a Chain Attack, both Norma and the corresponding Agent gain 200 Decibels.
cinema.story:
邦布们无疑是百年来人类所能拥有最忠诚的同伴、最高效的工具、甚至是…最强大的武器。
也如所有未经教化的稚童和未得良主的宝剑一样，邦布能为任何人所用，不管是正义的法厄同还是穷凶极恶的反派。
「首先我是个爱好邦布的和平主义者。」
「其次我的日常工作之一，就是让最锋利的剑始终握在我们手中。」
cinema.storyEn:
Without a doubt, Bangboo are the most loyal companions humanity has had in the past century, the most efficient tools, and perhaps even... the most powerful weapons.
Like any child yet to be taught or any blade yet to find a worthy owner, a Bangboo can serve anyone, whether it's the righteous Phaethon or the most ruthless villain.
"First of all, I'm a pacifist who happens to love Bangboo."
"Second, part of my job is making sure the sharpest sword stays in our hands."

cinema.name: 嗯呢大爆炸
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
据有史可稽的外策局卷宗记载，年轻的诺姆研究员所主导的项目迅速提升了量产型邦布的极限性能指标。
而在擢升为外策局首席技术专家前，诺姆最重要的任务是证明自己不会在某天把布亚斯特送出大气层。
「更高，更快，更强！」
「限制想象力的，只有勇气和技术经费！」
cinema.storyEn:
According to archived External Strategy Department records, a project led by the young researcher Norma rapidly pushed the performance limits of mass-produced Bangboo to new heights.
Before being promoted to Chief Technician of the ESD, Norma's most important assignment was proving that she wouldn't one day launch Booastrum into orbit.
"Higher! Faster! Stronger!"
"The only things limiting imagination are courage and the R&D budget!"

cinema.name: 天才第一因
cinema.description: 队伍中任意角色使敌人进入失衡状态后，诺姆将不断召唤导弹轰击场上随机敌人，持续6秒，每发导弹间隔0.75秒，并对范围内敌人造成等同于诺姆200%攻击力的火属性伤害，该伤害会被视为[终结技]伤害，重复触发刷新持续时间，30秒内最多触发一次；诺姆的[破甲弹头]造成的失衡值提升30%，[高爆弹头]造成的伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After any squad member Stuns an enemy, Norma will continuously summon missiles to bombard random enemies on the field for 6s. A missile is launched every 0.75s, dealing Fire DMG equal to 200% of Norma's ATK to enemies within the area. This DMG is considered Ultimate DMG. Repeated triggers reset the duration. This effect can trigger once every 30s. The Daze inflicted by Armor-Piercing Warhead increases by 30%, and the DMG dealt by High-Explosive Warhead increases by 30%.
cinema.story: 任何伟大的创造都源于好奇心加上巧合，或许第一个邦布灵魂的诞生，也不过是由于挽昼女士对于生命迷思的困惑。
cinema.storyEn: Every great creation begins with curiosity and a happy accident. Perhaps the birth of the very first Bangboo soul was nothing more than Lady Sunbringer's fascination with the mysteries of life.

1581.name: 蕾米埃尔

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
「静默之日」行动中，蕾米埃尔与维克上校参与了由亚契和挽昼提出的，名为「逐日计划」的实验。
逐日计划试图将虚狩与虚狩武器中封存的「业核」进行融合，人为创造结使，以消除虚狩武器对持有者施加的代价，让虚狩能以更强大的姿态保卫艾利都。
试验的结果是失败的，两名虚狩全部折损，所幸在塔乌弥尔力量的影响下，蕾米埃尔并未完全转化为结使，而是陷入了百余年的沉睡。
自珀塞纳斯空洞苏醒后，蕾米埃尔所熟知的时代早已落幕，她与达识结社的成员接触，并选择加入结社。
然而，蕾米埃尔的结使化并未终止，不仅如此，过度使用虚狩武器将加剧这一进程。
当侵蚀到达临界点，她的体表将浮现可怖的结使化症状，而她似乎极度抗拒让任何人看到那副模样。
profile.descriptionEn:
During the Day of Silence operation, Remielle and Colonel Vike took part in an experiment proposed by Arche and Sunbringer known as Project Sunseeker.
Project Sunseeker sought to fuse a Void Hunter with the Karma Core sealed within a Void Hunter weapon, artificially creating an Enchainer. Its goal was to eliminate the burden imposed on wielders by Void Hunter weapons, allowing Void Hunters to defend Eridu with even greater power.
The experiment ended in failure, and both Void Hunters were lost. Fortunately, under the influence of Thaumiel's power, Remielle did not fully transform into an Enchainer, instead falling into a slumber that lasted for over a century.
After awakening in the Pursenas Hollow, Remielle found that the era she had known had long since come to an end. She met members of the Covenant of Dayat and chose to join the organization.
However, Remielle's Enchainer transformation did not stop there. Worse still, excessive use of her Void Hunter weapon only accelerates the process.
Once the Corruption reaches its critical threshold, horrifying symptoms of Enchainer transformation begin to appear across her body, and she seems determined to keep anyone from seeing her in such a state.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: MAR 14

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 虽然蕾米埃尔很爱笑，但总感觉她没有看上去那么开心…要怎么做才能帮到她呢？
profile.descriptionEn: Remielle is always smiling, but somehow... it never feels like she's as happy as she looks. What can I do to help her?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 是啊，她远比想象中难以接近…但没关系的，在她需要的时候，「共犯」会陪在她的身边。
profile.descriptionEn: Yeah... She's much harder to get close to than she seems. But that's okay. When she needs someone, her "partner-in-crime" will be right by her side.

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对蕾米埃尔的印象：
 · 她串联起两个时代的记忆
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Remielle:
 · She bridges the memories of two eras.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 共犯嘛…大概算是友谊的升级版本？
profile.descriptionEn: · Partners-in-crime? I'd say it's friendship leveled-up?

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 玩笑包裹着脆弱的谎言与真心
profile.descriptionEn: · Beneath the jokes lie fragile lies and heartfelt truths.

1581.description:
蕾米埃尔·丹，初代虚狩之一，曾经的节杖军中校，秘密组织达识结社的成员。
据记载，蕾米埃尔自幼便展现出极高的天赋，能够迅速掌握大多数领域的知识与技能。
她年纪轻轻就被选拔加入节杖军，破格晋升为中校，继承了虚狩武器「塔乌弥尔」，并在与维克上校、法金汉佣兵团团长的协同作战中斥退黑墙、一战成名，顺利授勋虚狩。
在史称「静默之日」的机要行动中，蕾米埃尔与维克上校因意外双双殉职，但既然她尚存于世，那便说明真相并非如此。
蕾米埃尔来去无踪，却总能在出人意料的关键时刻出现，引导局势。
与人交际时，蕾米埃尔始终带着甜美而游刃有余的微笑，处变不惊、甚至有些自来熟，很难让人起戒心。
她擅长用稍带玩笑意味的言行迅速拉近关系，但又习惯保持一种恰到好处的距离感，令人难以捉摸。
备注：蕾米埃尔喜欢用一些无伤大雅的玩笑捉弄他人，而在这方面，您显然享受着格外的「优待」。
1581.descriptionEn:
Remielle Dan, one of the first-generation Void Hunters, was formerly a Lieutenant Colonel in the Guard of Staves and currently a member of the secret organization known as the Covenant of Dayat.
Records describe her as a prodigy from childhood, capable of rapidly acquiring knowledge and mastering skills in nearly any discipline.
She was selected to join the Guard of Staves at a remarkably young age, was promoted directly to Lieutenant Colonel, and inherited the Void Hunter weapon, "Thaumiel." Fighting alongside Colonel Vike and the leader of the Falkenhayn Mercenary Troupe, she helped drive back the Dark Wall, rose to fame through that decisive battle, and was formally awarded the title of Void Hunter.
During the classified operation later known as the Day of Silence, Remielle and Colonel Vike were both believed to have been killed in action following an unexpected incident. Yet as she's still alive, then the truth must be something else entirely.
Remielle comes and goes without a trace, yet always seems to appear at the most unexpected, pivotal moments, steering events in a new direction.
Around others, Remielle always wears a sweet, effortless smile. Calm under any circumstances and almost disarmingly friendly, she rarely gives people a reason to raise their guard.
She excels at closing the distance with lighthearted banter, yet instinctively maintains just the right amount of distance, making her difficult to read.
Note: Remielle has a habit of playfully teasing those around her. As for you, you seem to receive a particularly generous share of that "special treatment."

skills.description:

若普攻命中目标，招式结束后可为自身回复[浮晖]；
第四段普攻结束后可为命中的敌人施加1个[流明积蓄点]。

Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to four attacks ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
If the Basic Attack hits the target, gains Floating Radiance after the skill ends.
After the 4th hit of the Basic Attack ends, 1 Lumiflux Buildup is applied to enemies hit.

If it hits a target, gains Floating Radiance after the skill ends.

向前方发动大范围强力攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
招式结束后可为自身回复大量[浮晖]；
若命中目标，招式结束后可触发[耀变]效果，倍率为105%；
发动后会清空身上储存的所有[虚曜]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Remielle has stored Voidflare, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Grants a large amount of Floating Radiance when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, triggers the Luminize effect after the skill ends with a 105% multiplier.
Consumes all stored Voidflare upon use.

Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Grants a large amount of Floating Radiance when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, triggers the Luminize effect after the skill ends with a 120% multiplier.
Consumes all stored Voidflare upon use.

skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动远程攻击，造成流明属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a ranged attack ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：曙色颂
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Ode to Dawn
skills.description:
进入战场时，若自身不足60点能量则回复至60点，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动大范围攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
招式结束后为命中的敌人施加2个[流明积蓄点]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, if Remielle has less than 60 Energy, her Energy is recovered to 60. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to all enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：曙色颂·转辉
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
skills.description:
若蕾米埃尔处于接战状态中且[浮晖]达到最大值120点时，在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]后长按 【特殊技键】 可进入[转换姿态]，在[转换姿态]下切换角色时，蕾米埃尔会进入[相变时流]状态：
[相变时流]状态下蕾米埃尔会自主行动，协助作战，其中部分攻击还可为目标施加[流明积蓄点]，期间[浮晖]会随时间消耗，当[浮晖]耗尽或离开接战状态时会退出[相变时流]状态，未退出[相变时流]状态前，蕾米埃尔无法通过[连携技]之外的方式主动换入；
若蕾米埃尔在一次[相变时流]状态下触发3次[异化]反应后，或在[浮晖]耗尽时自身储存的[虚曜]数量大于等于1时，则激活[支援技：花羽轮舞]，解锁普通换入并使蕾米埃尔下次普通换入时自动发动[支援技：花羽轮舞]；
进入[相变时流]状态时，蕾米埃尔会使全队角色造成的伤害提升1.5%，持续60秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
若蕾米埃尔发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]攻击命中处于失衡状态的敌人，且[浮晖]达到最大值120点时，在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]中切换角色也可进入[相变时流]状态；
若进入[转换姿态]后未切换角色，则蕾米埃尔发动下落攻击回到地面。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Remielle is in combat and her Floating Radiance reaches its maximum of 120, hold [Special Attack] after a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to enter Stance Shift. Switching characters while in Stance Shift causes Remielle to enter the Phase Flow state:
While in the Phase Flow state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. In this state, Floating Radiance is consumed over time, and some of her attacks apply Lumiflux Buildup to the target. When Floating Radiance is fully depleted or upon leaving combat, Remielle exits the Phase Flow state. Before exiting the Phase Flow state, Remielle cannot be actively switched in except via a Chain Attack.
If Remielle triggers 3 Refringe reactions in one Phase Flow state, or has at least 1 stored Voidflare when Floating Radiance is fully depleted, Assist: Flower & Feather Dance becomes available, and her normal switch-in is unlocked. Assist: Flower & Feather Dance is automatically used on Remielle's next normal switch-in.
Upon entering the Phase Flow state, Remielle increases all squad members's DMG by 1.5% for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Remielle's Floating Radiance has reached its maximum of 120 and her Special Attack or EX Special Attack hits a Stunned enemy, she can also enter the Phase Flow state by switching characters during the Special Attack or EX Special Attack.
If no character is switched in after entering Stance Shift, Remielle uses a downward attack to return to the ground instead.

levels.description:
若蕾米埃尔处于接战状态中且[浮晖]达到最大值120点时，在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]后长按 【特殊技键】 可进入[转换姿态]，在[转换姿态]下切换角色时，蕾米埃尔会进入[相变时流]状态：
[相变时流]状态下蕾米埃尔会自主行动，协助作战，其中部分攻击还可为目标施加[流明积蓄点]，期间[浮晖]会随时间消耗，当[浮晖]耗尽或离开接战状态时会退出[相变时流]状态，未退出[相变时流]状态前，蕾米埃尔无法通过[连携技]之外的方式主动换入；
若蕾米埃尔在一次[相变时流]状态下触发3次[异化]反应后，或在[浮晖]耗尽时自身储存的[虚曜]数量大于等于1时，则激活[支援技：花羽轮舞]，解锁普通换入并使蕾米埃尔下次普通换入时自动发动[支援技：花羽轮舞]；
进入[相变时流]状态时，蕾米埃尔会使全队角色造成的伤害提升1.5%，持续60秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
若蕾米埃尔发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]攻击命中处于失衡状态的敌人，且[浮晖]达到最大值120点时，在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]中切换角色也可进入[相变时流]状态；
若进入[转换姿态]后未切换角色，则蕾米埃尔发动下落攻击回到地面。
levels.descriptionEn:
When Remielle is in combat and her Floating Radiance reaches its maximum of 120, hold [Special Attack] after a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to enter Stance Shift. Switching characters while in Stance Shift causes Remielle to enter the Phase Flow state:
While in the Phase Flow state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. In this state, Floating Radiance is consumed over time, and some of her attacks apply Lumiflux Buildup to the target. When Floating Radiance is fully depleted or upon leaving combat, Remielle exits the Phase Flow state. Before exiting the Phase Flow state, Remielle cannot be actively switched in except via a Chain Attack.
If Remielle triggers 3 Refringe reactions in one Phase Flow state, or has at least 1 stored Voidflare when Floating Radiance is fully depleted, Assist: Flower & Feather Dance becomes available, and her normal switch-in is unlocked. Assist: Flower & Feather Dance is automatically used on Remielle's next normal switch-in.
Upon entering the Phase Flow state, Remielle increases all squad members's DMG by 1.5% for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Remielle's Floating Radiance has reached its maximum of 120 and her Special Attack or EX Special Attack hits a Stunned enemy, she can also enter the Phase Flow state by switching characters during the Special Attack or EX Special Attack.
If no character is switched in after entering Stance Shift, Remielle uses a downward attack to return to the ground instead.

skills.name: 闪避：敛光
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：锐芒
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速攻击，造成流明属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launches a quick attack ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：对影
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动强力斩击，造成流明属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：交叠舞步
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方发动多段大范围攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
发动时自身进入[映曜]状态，下次发动[普通攻击：垂虹]时会升级为[普通攻击：惊鸿]；
招式结束后为命中的敌人施加2个[流明积蓄点]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple attacks ahead in a large area, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Enters the Luminous Reflection state upon activation. The next Basic Attack: Rainbow's End is upgraded to Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.
After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：缭乱终幕
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行大范围攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
若命中目标，招式结束后可触发[耀变]效果，倍率为220.5%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launches an attack across a large area in front, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
If the skill hits, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of 220.5%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；

Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.

skills.name: 支援突击：眠醒残明

发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续斩击，造成流明属性伤害；

skills.name: 支援技：花羽轮舞
skills.description:
入场并发动大范围攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
发动时消耗40点[浮晖]，若发动时自身剩余[浮晖]小于等于90点，则本次[支援技：花羽轮舞]不再消耗[浮晖]，并且自身进入[映曜]状态，下次发动[普通攻击：垂虹]时会升级为[普通攻击：惊鸿]；
招式命中处于失衡状态的敌人时，敌人的失衡持续时间提升3秒，同一敌人在一次失衡状态下最多受到一次此效果，失衡持续时间提升效果与同类效果不可叠加；
若命中目标，招式结束后可触发[耀变]效果，倍率为210%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Enters the battlefield and unleashes an attack in a large area, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Consumes 40 Floating Radiance upon activation. With 90 or fewer Floating Radiance remaining upon activation, this Assist: Flower & Feather Dance does not consume Floating Radiance. Remielle also enters the Luminous Reflection state, and the next Basic Attack: Rainbow's End is upgraded to Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.
When this skill hits a Stunned enemy, their Stun duration is extended by 3s. Each enemy can be affected by this effect only once per Stun window. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with other effects of the same type.
If this skill lands a hit, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of 210%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：时序=万色滞行
skills.nameEn: Core Passive: Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors
skills.description:
蕾米埃尔的[异化系数]为自身异常精通的0.02%，且当队伍中[异常]角色数量为3时，[异化系数]额外提升10%；
蕾米埃尔通过队友触发[异化]反应时，会根据此次属性异常效果在受到[异化]加强后的[异常效果强度]生成[虚曜]，最多可储存最新生成的3个[虚曜]；
若[支援技：花羽轮舞]/[终结技：缭乱终幕]/[普通攻击：垂虹]/[普通攻击：惊鸿]命中目标，在招式结束后可触发[耀变]效果：
基于已储存的所有[虚曜]中的[异常效果强度]，对敌人造成招式对应倍率的属性异常伤害，并根据自身异常精通的0.1%提升此伤害倍率；
蕾米埃尔在进入[相变时流]状态时或发动[普通攻击：垂虹]或[普通攻击：惊鸿]后，会清空身上储存的所有[虚曜]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Remielle's Refringe Coefficient is equal to 0.02% of her Anomaly Proficiency. If there are 3 Anomaly characters in the squad, her Refringe Coefficient increases by an additional 10%.
When Remielle triggers a Refringe reaction through a teammate, she generates Voidflare based on the enhanced Anomaly Effect Strength of the current Attribute Anomaly after it has been Refringed. Up to the 3 most recently generated Voidflares can be stored.
If Assist: Flower & Feather Dance, Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call, Basic Attack: Rainbow's End, or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace hits a target, Luminize is triggered after the skill ends：
Based on the Anomaly Effect Strength of all stored Voidflares, deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to the enemy using the corresponding skill's DMG multiplier. This multiplier is further increased by 0.1% of Remielle's Anomaly Proficiency.
All stored Voidflares are cleared when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state or after using Basic Attack: Rainbow's End or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.label: 基础
levels.description:
蕾米埃尔的[异化系数]为自身异常精通的0.02%，且当队伍中[异常]角色数量为3时，[异化系数]额外提升10%；
蕾米埃尔通过队友触发[异化]反应时，会根据此次属性异常效果在受到[异化]加强后的[异常效果强度]生成[虚曜]，最多可储存最新生成的3个[虚曜]；
若[支援技：花羽轮舞]/[终结技：缭乱终幕]/[普通攻击：垂虹]/[普通攻击：惊鸿]命中目标，在招式结束后可触发[耀变]效果：
基于已储存的所有[虚曜]中的[异常效果强度]，对敌人造成招式对应倍率的属性异常伤害，并根据自身异常精通的0.1%提升此伤害倍率；
蕾米埃尔在进入[相变时流]状态时或发动[普通攻击：垂虹]或[普通攻击：惊鸿]后，会清空身上储存的所有[虚曜]。
levels.descriptionEn:
Remielle's Refringe Coefficient is equal to 0.02% of her Anomaly Proficiency. If there are 3 Anomaly characters in the squad, her Refringe Coefficient increases by an additional 10%.
When Remielle triggers a Refringe reaction through a teammate, she generates Voidflare based on the enhanced Anomaly Effect Strength of the current Attribute Anomaly after it has been Refringed. Up to the 3 most recently generated Voidflares can be stored.
If Assist: Flower & Feather Dance, Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call, Basic Attack: Rainbow's End, or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace hits a target, Luminize is triggered after the skill ends：
Based on the Anomaly Effect Strength of all stored Voidflares, deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to the enemy using the corresponding skill's DMG multiplier. This multiplier is further increased by 0.1% of Remielle's Anomaly Proficiency.
All stored Voidflares are cleared when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state or after using Basic Attack: Rainbow's End or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.

skills.name: 额外能力：芳菲之邀
skills.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或同阵营角色时触发：
当队伍中[异常]角色数量为1/2/3时，进入战场时为全队角色提升等同于蕾米埃尔初始攻击力6%/12%/40%的攻击力，提升上限不超过1600点，蕾米埃尔在[相变时流]状态下造成的失衡值提升6%/12%/35%；
蕾米埃尔为敌人施加[流明积蓄点]时会同时附加[幻色]效果：全队角色攻击[幻色]效果下的敌人时，异常积蓄效率提升15%，敌人身上无[流明积蓄点]时[幻色]效果消失，[幻色]效果消失后该异常积蓄效率提升效果会额外持续8秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same faction:
When there are 1/2/3 Anomaly characters in the squad, upon entering the battlefield, all squad members gain an ATK increase equal to 6%/12%/40% of Remielle's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of 1,600 ATK. Remielle's Daze dealt while in the Phase Flow state increases by 6%/12%/35%.
When applying Lumiflux Buildup to an enemy, Remielle also applies the Prismatic effect: All squad members' attacks against enemies with the Prismatic effect have 15% increased Anomaly Buildup Rate. Prismatic is removed when the enemy no longer has Lumiflux Buildup. After Prismatic is removed, the Anomaly Buildup Rate increase persists for an additional 8s.

cinema.name: 青涩誓言
cinema.description: 进入战场时，蕾米埃尔获得3个特殊[虚曜]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；蕾米埃尔触发[耀变]效果造成伤害时，无视目标50%的全属性伤害抗性；发动[支援技：花羽轮舞]时，获得200点喧响值，18秒内最多触发1次此效果；蕾米埃尔处于[相变时流]状态下时，队伍中其他角色造成的属性异常伤害提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflares. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Remielle triggers Luminize to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When using Assist: Flower & Feather Dance, she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s. While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%.
cinema.story:
「我们能斩断罪恶，我们能劈开天空。我们能走出迷雾，我们能迈向真理…」
「这是我们的国度，它会永远屹立，它会成就奇迹。」
「…」
粉发少女终于按捺不住，她压低帽檐，向队列最前方的身影悄声抱怨：
「贝莉——这誓词也太长了，以后不会要经常念吧？」
「别急，以后会有更长的。」
那始终笔挺的身影也不禁无奈一笑。
cinema.storyEn:
"We can put an end to evil and split the heavens. We can walk out of the fog and step closer to the truth..."
"This is our nation, forever standing tall, and with the power to accomplish miracles."
"..."
The pink-haired girl finally can't hold it in anymore. Lowering the brim of her hat, she quietly grumbles to the figure at the front of the line:
"Beli... This oath is way too long. We're not going to have to recite it all the time, are we?"
"Just wait. It'll only get longer."
Even the ever-composed figure can't help but smile wryly.

cinema.name: 倾落喧嚣
cinema.description: 蕾米埃尔的[异化系数]提升20%；队伍中[异常]角色对[幻色]效果下的敌人造成属性异常伤害时，无视目标15%的防御力，[幻色]效果消失后该效果会额外持续8秒；蕾米埃尔在[相变时流]状态下自主发动攻击为敌人施加[流明积蓄点]的频率提升。
cinema.descriptionEn: Remielle's Refringe Coefficient increases by 20%. When an Anomaly character in the squad deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by Prismatic, the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after Prismatic ends. While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, the frequency at which she automatically attacks to apply Lumiflux Buildup to enemies increases.
cinema.story:
那是一场盛大的舞会。
城市为之倾倒，满月为之失色。
欢欣的万众汇聚于此，高喊着英雄的名姓，笑着唱着，仿佛此夜永无终结。
功勋卓绝者汇聚于此，注视着喧嚣的人群，一同许下谦卑的宏愿——他们说：奇迹的起点就此开始。
是的，艾利都将要开启它的旅程。
那是一场夺回世界的伟大冒险。
「舞会都快结束了，还没找到舞伴？唉，我就勉为其难陪你跳一曲吧。」
cinema.storyEn:
It was a grand ball.
The city was captivated. Even the full moon paled beside it.
Crowds gathered in celebration, calling out the heroes' names, laughing and singing as though the night would never end.
Those of unparalleled achievement stood together, gazing upon the jubilant crowd as they made a humble vow. "This is where miracles begin."
And so, Eridu's journey was about to begin.
A great adventure to reclaim the world.
"Come on, the ball's almost over, and you still haven't found a partner? Well... I suppose I can spare you a dance."

cinema.name: 时间分岔的花园
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
女孩将名字写进逐日者的行列，因为她怀抱着比骄阳更炽烈的理想。
她相信伤痕将被弥合，相信代价将被终结，于是转身向秘密的花园走去。
她尚不知晓，花园深处，时间永远分岔，通向无数的未来。
有的通向荣光，有的通向希望…
有的通向太阳投下的阴影，通向无人铭记的长夜。
「我知道啦，可有些事总得有人来做，不是么？」
cinema.storyEn:
The girl wrote her name among the Sunseekers, driven by an ideal that burned brighter than the blazing sun.
She believed every wound could be healed. She believed every sacrifice could one day come to an end. And so, she turned and walked into the secret garden.
She did not yet know that, deep within that garden, time forever diverged, leading to countless futures.
Some led to glory. Some led to hope...
Others led to the shadow cast by the sun, to a long night that no one would remember.
"I know, I know. But someone's gotta do it, right?"

cinema.name: 漫长的告别
cinema.description: 蕾米埃尔触发[耀变]效果时，伤害倍率额外提升12%；在蕾米埃尔进入战场获得3个特殊[虚曜]后，若将[虚曜]全部消耗，则可再一次获得最大数量的特殊[虚曜]，可再次获得特殊[虚曜]的效果在生效1次后或蕾米埃尔进入[相变时流]状态时消失。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Remielle triggers Luminize, the DMG multiplier is increased by an additional 12%. After entering the battlefield and gaining 3 special Voidflares, if all Voidflares are consumed, she immediately gains the maximum number of special Voidflares again. This effect to regain special Voidflares is removed after being triggered once or when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state.
cinema.story:
她自苍白荒秽中苏醒。
百年的梦太长。长到迷雾吞噬了旧时代的残骸，长到苍白覆盖了记忆里的余温。
百年的梦太短。短到双眼倒映着离别前的笑靥，短到指尖挽留着虚无里的蹁跹。
她忽然想起某个夏夜，想起并肩仰望的星空，于是她独自迈出舞步，一如既往。
回旋，定步，伸手，再落空。
致旧友，致旧时代，
就以一首挽歌，献上这迟来百年的、漫长的告别。
「嗨，要和我…共舞一曲吗？」
cinema.storyEn:
She awakens to a pale, desolate world
A hundred years is a dream too long. Long enough for the mists to swallow the remnants of a bygone age. Long enough for pale silence to smother the lingering warmth in her memory.
A hundred years is a dream too short. Short enough that the smile before parting still reflects in her eyes. Short enough that her fingertips still reach for a fleeting dance.
Then she remembers a summer night. The star-filled sky they once gazed upon together. So she begins to dance alone, just as she always has.
Turn. Pause. Reach. Fall into empty air.
To an old friend. To a bygone age.
May this lament serve as the farewell that has waited a hundred years to be spoken.
"Hey... Care to share a dance with me?"

cinema.name: 归客痛饮遗忘
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
暮色漫过世界的屋脊，万家灯火次第亮起，每一扇窗都盛着温暖的人间。
单薄的衣衫不足以遮风挡雨，曾被称作英雄的女孩正为凌乱的翅羽犯难。
她饮尽满溢遗忘的杯盏，炽热的记忆灼烧喉管，月光淌过她低垂的眼睑。
「要小心旧时代的幽灵来敲你家的窗户哦？」
cinema.storyEn:
Dusk spills over the rooftops of the world, and lights flicker on one by one. Behind every window glows the warmth of home.
Her thin clothes do little to keep out the wind and rain. The girl once called a hero fusses over her disheveled wings.
She drains a cup brimming with forgetfulness, yet searing memories still burn her throat as moonlight flows across her lowered gaze.
"Be careful... The ghosts of the old world just might come knocking at your window."

cinema.name: 千度振翅的孑羽
cinema.description: 蕾米埃尔发动[普通攻击：垂虹]和[普通攻击：惊鸿]时，会触发2次[耀变]效果；若第四段[普通攻击]命中目标，招式结束后蕾米埃尔可获得3个特殊[虚曜]，通过此种方式获得的特殊[虚曜]可造成的伤害为进入战场时获得的特殊[虚曜]的25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Remielle uses Basic Attack: Rainbow's End or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace, Luminize is triggered 2 times. If the 4th hit of her Basic Attack lands against a target, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflares after the skill ends. Special Voidflares gained this way deal DMG equal to 25% of the special Voidflares gained upon entering the battlefield.
cinema.story:
旅途的终点还是旅途，群星的尽头仍有群星。
所以，再一次——请再一次，振翅高飞吧。
静默的落羽将要再度触碰天空，
飞越漫长的伤痕，飞越破碎的昨日，
飞向那尚未书写的明天。
「我的故事就说到这里，接下来该轮到你了吧，亲爱的共犯？」
cinema.storyEn:
The end of one journey is simply the beginning of another. Beyond every sky of stars lies yet another.
So, once more... just once more, spread your wings and soar.
Silent, fallen feathers will touch the sky again,
crossing scars that have yet to heal, crossing the shattered yesterdays,
toward a tomorrow still waiting to be written.
"My story ends here. I believe it's your turn now, dear partner-in-crime."
