1591.name: 希格莉德
1591.faction: 罗斯凯利法·空域巡戍局

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
「德拉叙尔家族世代追随林德薇恩大人」，希格莉德如是说，就像她的母亲、以及每一位德拉叙尔的继承人一样。

但是林德薇恩不喜欢「追随」这个词，她与希格莉德或是任何一位德拉叙尔的关系都不是亦步亦趋的追随者和领袖的关系，她们更像是并肩作战的战友、亦师亦友的至交，每一位德拉叙尔都把林德薇恩当作师长，也都教会了林德薇恩许多东西。

但不管哪一位德拉叙尔如何努力，都有一样东西永远也追不上林德薇恩——「生命的长度」，林德薇恩用这样一个微妙又曲折的说法来掩饰她的不安。所以德拉叙尔的誓词中从来不出现具体的名字，而只是重复着「世代追随」这样一句庄严的承诺。

不负责任的林德薇恩大人一遍又一遍地渲染着新任空巡局次官的功绩，以致于大家都觉得这位德拉叙尔的出色更胜上一位。德拉叙尔们十分骄傲于这样的传承，但对于林德薇恩来说，每一位德拉叙尔都独一无二。总有一天，拥有过希格莉德的林德薇恩也会再次失去她，这是被德拉叙尔们爱戴着的林德薇恩注定的诅咒。

但希格莉德却能始终拥有着林德薇恩，这是她作为德拉叙尔的幸福。
profile.descriptionEn:
"The de L'Azur family has followed Lindverne for generations," Sigrid says, just as her mother did before her, as has every heir of House de L'Azur.

But Lindverne dislikes the word "follow." Her relationship with Sigrid, or with any member of House de L'Azur, has never been one of leader and follower. They're comrades who fight side by side, as well as trusted friends and mutual mentor and student. Every de L'Azur has regarded Lindverne as a teacher, and each has taught her a great deal in return.

Yet no matter how hard each generation of House de L'Azur strives, there's one thing they'll never surpass Lindverne in: lifespan. That's the subtle, roundabout way Lindverne chooses to conceal her unease. And so the de L'Azur oath never speaks a specific name, repeating instead the solemn vow to "follow for generations."

The ever-irresponsible Lady Lindverne praised the achievements of each new Deputy Director of the Airspace Patrol Department so extravagantly that everyone came to believe every de L'Azur surpassed the last. The de L'Azurs take great pride in that legacy, but to Lindverne, every de L'Azur is one of a kind. One day, just as she once came to have Sigrid by her side, she'll lose her too. That is the inescapable curse of being loved by the House de L'Azur.

But Sigrid will always have Lindverne. That is the blessing of being a de L'Azur.

1591.description:
希格莉德·德拉叙尔，现任空域巡戍局总务次官，林德薇恩·挽昼的亲信副官，罗斯凯利法久负盛名的世家——德拉叙尔家族的家主继承人。

与所有那些传说中的人物一样，希格莉德拥有一个长长的、长长的头衔后缀。但时至今日，即使希格莉德已经接任空巡局次官数年之间，拿到了每一个最佳的年度绩效，她仍然时常心有疑虑，怀疑自己是否匹配得上罗斯凯利法街头巷尾所流传的传闻里，传说中的英雄「希格莉德」的名声。

这倒不能怪希格莉德是个缺乏自信的战士，毕竟面对「轻松比肩虚狩」「单手击碎大楼」「一枪洞穿空洞」这样的传闻，任何正直又不乏理性的战士都会怀疑自己手中的兵器是否真能发挥出如此的伟力。

唯有一则传说，希格莉德始终坚信：「只要她的长枪未曾折断，天空的奇迹就绝不会陷落。」
1591.descriptionEn:
Sigrid de L'Azur, the current Deputy Administrative Director of the Airspace Patrol Department, trusted adjutant to Lindverne Sunbringer, and heir apparent to House de L'Azur, one of Roscaelifer's most prestigious noble families.

Like all those legendary figures, Sigrid has a long, long string of titles attached to her name. Yet even now, after serving for years as the Airspace Patrol Department's Deputy Administrative Director and earning top annual performance honors time and again, she still finds herself wondering whether she's truly worthy of the legendary hero "Sigrid" spoken of throughout the streets of Roscaelifer.

You can't exactly blame Sigrid for lacking confidence. After all, when the stories claim she can "stand shoulder to shoulder with a Void Hunter," "smash a building apart with one hand," or "blast straight through a Hollow with a single stab of her spear," any honest and sensible warrior would question whether they could truly achieve such feats with the weapon in their hand.

There is, however, one legend Sigrid has never doubted: "So long as my spear remains unbroken, the miracle of the skies shall never end."

skills.name: 普通攻击：凛冽枪尖
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动至多四段斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]第四段视为[出枪式]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Ice DMG.
The 4th hit of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.

skills.name: 普通攻击：敛枪式
skills.description:
处于[巡空枪势]状态，并有[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动次数时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
按当前分支段数发动对应[普通攻击：敛枪式]，造成冰属性伤害；
[普通攻击：敛枪式]共有三段，每次释放都可以使段数提升，发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]第三段后重置段数；
[普通攻击：敛枪式]第一、二段蓄力架势期间受到敌方攻击时，希格莉德会用盾牌进行格挡，若格挡成功，抵挡此次攻击伤害，使下一次[普通攻击：敛枪式]造成的失衡值提升100%，刷新[巡空枪势]状态，并获得一次[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动机会；格挡成功后点按 【普通攻击键】 可发动对应段数的[普通攻击：敛枪式]；
衔接在[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]后的[普通攻击：敛枪式]可以保留[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]的段数；
招式发动期间受到的伤害减少60%；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升;
[普通攻击：敛枪式]第三段发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Aerial Patrol Spear state and Basic Attack: Converging Spear can be used, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches the corresponding Basic Attack: Converging Spear based on the current stage, dealing Ice DMG.
Basic Attack: Converging Spear has three stages. Each use advances it to the next stage. After performing the third stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, it resets to the first stage.
If Sigrid is attacked while charging the 1st or 2nd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, she blocks with her shield. On a successful block, the attack's DMG is negated, the next Basic Attack: Converging Spear deals 100% more Daze, the Aerial Patrol Spear state is refreshed, and she gains one use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. Press [Basic Attack] after a successful block to perform the corresponding stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear.
Basic Attack: Converging Spear performed after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear retains the current stage of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear.
DMG taken is reduced by 60% during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable during the third stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear.

skills.name: 特殊技：冰花
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动三段刺击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs three forward thrusts, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：乱琼
skills.description:
能量足够且不处于[巡空枪势]状态时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动强力连续刺击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为[出枪式]；
衔接在[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]后的[强化特殊技：乱琼]可以保留[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]的段数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy and while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a series of powerful stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
When EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade is chained after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear's hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：碎玉
skills.description:
能量足够且处于[巡空枪势]状态时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动强力的连续突进刺击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为[出枪式]；
衔接在[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]后的[强化特殊技：碎玉]可以保留[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]的段数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy and while in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a series of powerful lunging stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
When EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade is chained after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear's hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：蹑云
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：逐风
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行劈斩，造成物理属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Performs a forward cleaving slash, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：回马枪
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
凝聚寒冰在枪头对前方进行强力反击，造成冰属性伤害；
衔接在[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]后的[闪避反击：回马枪]可以保留[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]的段数；
招式视为[出枪式]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Condenses frost around the spearhead before unleashing a powerful counterattack, dealing Ice DMG.
When performed after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Dodge Counter: Counterthrust retains the current stage of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：冰凌卷地
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方敌人发动强力穿刺，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，获得[砥砺]，使后续[普通攻击：敛枪式]造成的伤害提升20%，持续50秒；
当本招式第一次命中处于失衡状态下的精英或首领级敌人时，会记录并重置当前[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数，同时进入[破阵]状态，
[破阵]状态下，[巡空枪势]持续时间不会减少，长按 【普通攻击键】 可连续释放[普通攻击：敛枪式]第一段至第三段；发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]第三段后结束[破阵]状态，并将[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数恢复；
从失衡状态恢复前[破阵]状态对同一目标最多触发一次。
招式视为[出枪式]；
[破阵]状态期间[普通攻击：敛枪式]命中失衡状态下的敌人不会开启连携窗口；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a powerful piercing attack against enemies ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gains the Tempered effect, increasing the DMG dealt by subsequent Basic Attack: Converging Spear attacks by 20% for 50s.
When the current skill hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, the current stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear is recorded and then reset before entering the Formation Breaker state. While in Formation Breaker, Aerial Patrol Spear's duration will not be reduced. Hold [Basic Attack] to continuously activate the 1st through 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. After activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, Formation Breaker ends and Basic Attack: Converging Spear's stage is restored to the recorded stage.
Formation Breaker can trigger at most once against the same target before the target recovers from Stun.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
While in the Formation Breaker state, Basic Attack: Converging Spear does not trigger the Chain Attack window when hitting Stunned enemies.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：霜天
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
凝聚极寒之力对前方发动毁灭性的连续突进，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为[出枪式]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Gathers the power of extreme cold before unleashing a devastating series of lunging attacks, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：巡戍铁卫
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方凝冰突进，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Condenses ice before lunging forward, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：凛然不侵
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：冰饕
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
挥动长枪上挑后重击下砸，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为[出枪式]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Swings the spear upward before following with a powerful downward attack, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：天空骑士
skills.description:
[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]第四段、[强化特殊技：乱琼]、[强化特殊技：碎玉]、[支援突击：冰饕]、[连携技：冰凌卷地]、[终结技：霜天]与[闪避反击：回马枪]视为[出枪式]；
希格莉德的任意[出枪式]命中敌人时，若当前未处于[巡空枪势]状态，则进入[巡空枪势]状态，获得1次[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动机会，最多储存1次；
处于[巡空枪势]状态下，希格莉德发动任意[出枪式]命中敌人时，可刷新[巡空枪势]状态，并获得1次[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动机会，最多储存1次；
触发或刷新[巡空枪势]时，其持续时间随[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数提升而缩短：一/二/三段时，持续时间分别为8/7/6秒；
[巡空枪势]状态结束时，[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数降低一段；
激活或刷新[巡空枪势]状态时，希格莉德的暴击率提升33%，持续8秒；重复触发时持续时间延长8秒，最多不超过40秒；
处于[巡空枪势]状态下，希格莉德攻击命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，对目标造成伤害的失衡易伤倍率提升20%。
skills.descriptionEn:
The 4th hit of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade, EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade, Assist Follow-Up: Devouring Frost, Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice, Ultimate: Frozen Heavens, and Dodge Counter: Counterthrust are considered Unbridled Spear attacks.
Whenever Sigrid hits an enemy with any Unbridled Spear in combat while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, she enters the Aerial Patrol Spear state and gains 1 use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear that cannot be stacked.
While in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, when Sigrid hits an enemy with an Unbridled Spear skill, the Aerial Patrol Spear state is refreshed and she gains 1 use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear that cannot be stacked.

Sigrid's ATK increases by 120. This effect scales with character level, with each level providing an additional increase of 12, up to a maximum increase of 840.

cinema.name: 很久很久以前
cinema.description: 发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]第三段时，获得[巡空枪势]和一次发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]的机会；[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动机会溢出时，下一次[普通攻击：敛枪式]的最后一击额外造成100%攻击力的冰属性伤害；希格莉德自身攻击力提升25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, enters the Aerial Patrol Spear and gains 1 additional activation of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. When activations exceed the stored Basic Attack: Converging Spear's activation limit, the next Basic Attack: Converging Spear's final hit deals an additional 100% of ATK as Ice DMG. Sigrid's ATK increases by 25%.
cinema.story:
很久很久以前，挽昼大人捧起了天空岛的第一抔泥土…
停停停，关于挽昼女士筑成罗斯凯利法第一座岛屿的故事，孩子们都已经听得耳朵起茧了。
今天我们要讲的是关于挽昼女士身旁那位战士的故事，她身着月夜般皎洁的银白铠甲，就像童话故事中远古的骑士一样…
cinema.storyEn:
Long, long ago, Lady Sunbringer lifted the very first handful of soil that would become this sky island...
Alright, alright. The children have already heard the story of Lady Sunbringer creating Roscaelifer's first island a thousand times over.
Today, we're telling the story of the warrior who stood at Lady Sunbringer's side. Clad in moon-bright silver armor, she looked just like an ancient knight from a fairy tale...

cinema.name: 传说的第一幕
cinema.description: [出枪式]和[普通攻击：敛枪式]造成伤害的穿透率提升24%；[巡空枪势]效果的持续时间延长2秒；希格莉德的喧响值获取效率提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: PEN Ratio of Unbridled Spear attacks and Basic Attack: Converging Spear increases by 24%. The duration of Aerial Patrol Spear is extended by 2s. Sigrid's Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%.
cinema.story:
她是罗斯凯利法的第一名士兵、第一柄长枪，她坚守在反击空洞的第一道阵线、第一次冲锋。
她是追随挽昼女士的第一支羽翼，也亲手筑起了罗斯凯利法的第一堵城墙。
她是罗斯凯利法第一柄折断的刀兵，她的姓氏是德拉叙尔。
她的孩子们和她的传说一样，于罗斯凯利法的夜空之中永燃不熄。
cinema.storyEn:
She was Roscaelifer's first soldier, its first spear. She stood on the first front line against the Hollows and led the very first charge.
She was the first wing to follow Lady Sunbringer, and with her own hands, she raised Roscaelifer's very first wall.
She was Roscaelifer's first blade broken. Her family name was de L'Azur.
Like her legend, her descendants burn eternally in the night sky above Roscaelifer.

cinema.name: 奇迹守护者
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
罗斯凯利法是天空的奇迹，而守护奇迹之人的头衔，绝不独属于少数人。
但总要有人成为守护者们的领袖——这本是林德薇恩大人的职责，但生性天真烂漫的她，实在难以成为一名威风的将军。
还好她有一位英姿绝逸的副官，准确地说，是一位又一位。
cinema.storyEn:
Roscaelifer is the miracle of the skies, and the title of those who protect that miracle has never belonged to only a select few.
Yet someone must lead those guardians. That was originally Lady Lindverne's duty, but with her bright and carefree nature, she was hardly suited to be a commanding general.
Fortunately, she had a dashing deputy. More accurately, she had one after another.

cinema.name: 英雄养成中
cinema.description: 每次获得[巡空枪势]时，自身造成的伤害提升18%，持续8秒，重复触发时可使持续时间延长8秒，最多不超过40秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: Each time upon gaining Aerial Patrol Spear, DMG dealt increases by 18% for 8s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by 8s, up to a maximum of 40s.
cinema.story:
士兵和民众们总忍不住将新任的总务次官与上一任暗暗对比——这怪不得他们，毕竟在林德薇恩·挽昼大人的口中，每一位德拉叙尔的家主都是那样传奇的人物。
但也正因如此，大家总期待着年轻的德拉叙尔要更胜于上一位，如此才不负传奇守护者家族的声名。
于是林德薇恩也不断为希格莉德编织着新的、更具颠覆性的传说。
cinema.storyEn:
The soldiers and civilians couldn't help comparing the newly appointed Deputy Administrative Director to her predecessor. Who can blame them? After all, according to Lady Lindverne Sunbringer, every head of House de L'Azur was a legendary figure.
Because of that, everyone expected the young de L'Azur to surpass the last, proving worthy of the legendary guardian family's name.
And so Lindverne continued weaving new, even more groundbreaking legends for Sigrid.

cinema.name: 苍穹誓约
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
如今的挽昼女士仅凭虚狩的名望便能一呼百应，但任何声名卓著的领袖，背后都曾空无一人。
而要追随那位年轻的领袖踏足天空，建成不可能建成的奇迹之城，要么拥有莽汉般的勇气，要么具备痴人般的天真。
而当每一位德拉叙尔再次念诵那份征服天空的誓言，这两种品质都再一次煜煜生辉。
cinema.storyEn:
Today, Lady Sunbringer commands countless followers through her reputation as a Void Hunter alone. But every renowned leader once stood with no one behind them.
To follow that young leader into the skies and build a miracle city that should never have been possible required either a brute's courage or a fool's innocence.
And each time a new de L'Azur recites that oath to conquer the skies, those two qualities shine brilliantly once more.

cinema.name: 天空的骑士
cinema.description: [普通攻击：敛枪式]第一/二/三段的最后一击命中敌人时，额外造成80%/90%/100%攻击力的冰属性伤害；招式[连携技：冰凌卷地]命中失衡状态下的敌人时，自身进入[破阵]状态不再有次数限制；在[破阵]状态下，希格莉德会更快地发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Basic Attack: Converging Spear's 1st/2nd/3rd stage's final hit lands, it deals an additional 80%/90%/100% ATK as Ice DMG. There is no more limit on the number of times Sigrid can enter the Formation Breaker state upon hitting a Stunned enemy with Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice. Formation Breaker state's Basic Attack: Converging Spear will activate faster.
cinema.story:
在亘古的传说中，曾有湖中的骑士留名。
在遥远未来的歌谣中，也必将有凛冽的长枪划破时空的天际。
「直到这柄长枪折断，天空的奇迹也绝不会陷落。」
cinema.storyEn:
Ancient legends tell of a Knight of the Lake.
In the ballads of the distant future, a frostbound spear will also pierce the skies across time and space.
"Until this spear is broken, the miracle of the skies shall never end."

1611.name: 克拉蕾
1611.faction: 罗斯凯利法·弗林特工坊

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
克拉蕾钟爱甜品，并对口味非常挑剔。「天才」和「家主」的身份给少女带来太多烦恼与忧虑，摄入大量甜食是她缓解压力的有效途径。
备注：据其助手观察，若甜品口味不佳，效果往往适得其反。

在专业领域之外，克拉蕾有时略显冒失，并非传闻那般高贵神秘、完美无瑕的领袖，但她会拼尽全力维系人们对她的既有印象，以此维护弗林特家族的形象。

克拉蕾致力于带领家族传承和发展辉金锻造术。长久以来，辉金锻造需要以族人的血液作为催化媒介，克拉蕾试图寻求不依靠血脉铸成辉金的方法，以此将族人从漫长的使命中解脱。
profile.descriptionEn:
Claret has a fondness for desserts and is extremely particular about their flavor. The burdens of being both a "genius" and a "family head" bring the young woman no shortage of worries and stress, and indulging in sweets is one of her most effective ways to unwind.
Note: According to her assistant, if the dessert doesn't taste good, it tends to have the opposite effect.

Outside her area of expertise, Claret can sometimes be a little careless. She's not quite the noble, mysterious, flawless leader the rumors make her out to be, but she does everything she can to preserve that image in people's minds and, in turn, uphold the reputation of the Flint family.

Claret is dedicated to leading her family in preserving and advancing the art of Porcelloy smithing. For generations, forging Porcelloy has required the blood of family members as a catalyst. Claret is searching for a way to forge Porcelloy without relying on their bloodline, hoping to free her family from this long-standing duty.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: JUL 23

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 哥哥，我记得之前佩洛伊斯消耗了不少辉金，具体数目是…
profile.descriptionEn: Wise, I remember Pyrois required quite a bit of Porcelloy, right? The exact amount was...

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 别想了铃，我们还不清的…不出意外的话，克拉蕾也会是我们一辈子的「债主」了…
profile.descriptionEn: Best stop thinking about it, Belle. We're never ever going to be able to pay it all back... Barring any miracles, Claret's gonna be our creditor for life...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对克拉蕾的印象：
 · 没想到价值两亿丁尼的蛋糕是真实存在的…
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Claret:
 · I can't believe a cake worth 200 million Dennies actually exists...

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 谁不想结识一位不急着催债的慷慨债主呢？
profile.descriptionEn: · Who wouldn't want to meet a generous creditor who's in no hurry to collect?

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 天才家主的压力，可以就着甜品一扫而空。
profile.descriptionEn: · Even the pressures of being a genius family head can melt away over dessert.

1611.description:
克拉蕾，弗林特工坊的工坊主与现任家主，传奇辉金锻造师。

极富家族荣誉感与责任心，珍视辉金、家族与世代传承的锻造技艺，正因如此，她厌弃一切浪费辉金、无意义损耗辉金的行为。

罗斯凯利法的日常运转仰赖辉金，弗林特是世间一切辉金的源头，克拉蕾自然就成为了这座天之算枢最大的「债主」。手握足以动摇天空的筹码，却从不借此索求更多的权力与地位，她遵循着这个古老家族最初的誓言。

克拉蕾看似高傲，但并不会端出家主的架子，熟悉她的人往往乐于与其亲近。她不善于坦率表达自己的心意，口是心非，极易心软答应他人的请求，即便那可能将自己陷入窘迫之中。
1611.descriptionEn:
Claret, owner of Flint Workshop, the current head of the Flint family, and a legendary Porcelloy smith.

She has a strong sense of family honor and responsibility, and deeply treasures Porcelloy, her family, and the smithing techniques passed down through generations. For that very reason, she despises any act that wastes Porcelloy or causes it to be needlessly consumed.

Roscaelifer's daily operations rely on Porcelloy, and the Flint family is the source of all Porcelloy in the world. Naturally, this makes Claret the greatest "creditor" of the Celestial Nexus. Though she holds leverage powerful enough to shake the heavens, she never uses it to demand greater power or status, instead abiding by the ancient family's original oath.

Claret may appear aloof, but she doesn't act high and mighty just because she's the family head. People who know her tend to find her easy to get along with. She's bad at being honest about how she really feels, often saying one thing while meaning another, and she's quick to give in to other people's requests, even if it puts her in an awkward position.

skills.name: 普通攻击：血锻四式
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动至多四段锤击，造成电属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to four strikes forward, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.name: 普通攻击：血华誓·锻星
skills.description:
处于[猩红铭刻]下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
使用血斧向前方发动至多三段斩击，造成电属性伤害；
第二段攻击招式发动时，克拉蕾会后跳并扔出血斧，后撤期间可触发极限闪避效果；
第三段攻击招式发动时，克拉蕾会连续斩击后跳起下砸，连续斩击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长连续斩击的持续时间，停止连点或松开 【普通攻击键】 时克拉蕾会立刻跳起下砸，跳起期间可触发极限闪避效果，成功触发极限闪避后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以衔接[普通攻击：血华誓·锻星]第三段；
发动期间不会退出[猩红铭刻]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] while in the Crimson Inscription state to activate:
Performs up to three slashes forward with the Blood Axe, dealing Electric DMG.
When the second attack is launched, Claret leaps backward and throws the Blood Axe. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered during the retreat.
When the third attack is launched, Claret performs a series of slashes before leaping up and performing a downward smash. During the repeated slashes, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. Repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to extend the duration of the repeated slashes. Stop pressing or release [Basic Attack] to make Claret immediately leap up and perform a downward smash. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered while leaping. After successfully triggering a Perfect Dodge, press or hold [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：血华誓·伏钺
skills.nameEn: Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe
skills.description:
处于[猩红铭刻]下，发动[特殊技：血华誓·斩金断铁]或[特殊技：血华誓·葬血强袭]并成功触发[毁伤]后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
使用血斧旋转跳起下砸并斩击目标敌人，造成电属性伤害，跳起期间可触发极限闪避效果；
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以衔接[普通攻击：血华誓·锻星]第三段；
发动期间不会退出[猩红铭刻]状态。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Crimson Inscription state, after launching Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron or Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault to trigger Maim, press or hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Spins and leaps into the air with the Blood Axe, then slams down and slashes the target enemy, dealing Electric DMG. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered while leaping.
After using the skill, press or hold [Basic Attack] to chain into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：初辉启鸣
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动两段锤击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches two bludgeoning attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：血华誓·铸锋秘术
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Secret Forging Techniques
skills.description:
锐能足够且不处于[猩红铭刻]时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将锻造锤变形为血斧并斩击目标敌人，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动后，进入[猩红铭刻]，持续16秒，处于后场时，持续时间不再减少；克拉蕾攻击命中敌人时，若敌人在0.5秒内被击败且自身[猩红铭刻]持续时间不为0，则延长3秒[猩红铭刻]持续时间，3秒内最多触发1次；
招式发动时，保持长按 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以跳过斩击，快速派生[特殊技：血华誓·斩金断铁]和[特殊技：血华誓·葬血强袭]；
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以衔接[普通攻击：血华誓·锻星]第三段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Sharpness, and while Claret is not in the Crimson Inscription state, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Transforms the forging hammer into the Blood Axe to slash the target enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
After using this skill, Claret enters the Crimson Inscription state for 16s. While off-field, its duration no longer decreases. When Claret's attacks hit an enemy, if the enemy is defeated within 0.5s and Crimson Inscription's remaining duration is not 0, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 3s. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
During this skill, keep holding [EX Special Attack] to skip the slash and quickly chain into the alternate Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron and Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault.
After using this skill, press or hold [Basic Attack] to chain into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：血华誓·斩金断铁
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron
skills.description:
处于[猩红铭刻]时，点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力上挑后，横向斩击，造成电属性伤害；
横向斩击命中持有[残痕]的敌人时，对目标触发[毁伤]，额外造成范围电属性伤害；
发动期间不会退出[猩红铭刻]状态；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，成功触发[毁伤]后，招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Crimson Inscription state, press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a powerful upward slash forward, then follows up with a horizontal slash, dealing Electric DMG.
If the horizontal slash hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, triggers Maim on the target, dealing additional AoE Electric DMG.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill. After successfully inflicting Maim, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：血华誓·葬血强袭
skills.nameEn: Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault
skills.description:
处于[猩红铭刻]，在[特殊技：血华誓·斩金断铁]上挑期间，保持长按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动连续3次横向斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
每次横向斩击命中持有[残痕]的敌人时，对目标触发[毁伤]，额外造成范围电属性伤害，招式内最多可以连续触发3次[毁伤]，第3次[毁伤]具有更高打断等级；
发动期间不会退出[猩红铭刻]状态；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，成功触发[毁伤]后，招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
While in the Crimson Inscription state and during the upward slash of Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron, keep holding [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs three consecutive horizontal slashes forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Each horizontal slash that hits an enemy inflicted with Gash triggers Maim on the target, dealing additional AoE Electric DMG. Up to 3 consecutive instances of Maim can be triggered during this skill, with the third having a higher Interrupt Level.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while using this skill. After successfully inflicting Maim, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：夜视
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：淬火
skills.description:
非[猩红铭刻]状态下闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行锤击，造成电属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
While not in the Crimson Inscription state, press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Performs a forward hammer strike, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：回锋
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
使用锤柄对前方进行强力反击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Uses the hammer handle to deliver a powerful forward counterattack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避反击：血华誓·回锋
skills.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Bloodbloom Oath - Returning Edge
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
使用血斧对前方进行强力反击，造成电属性伤害；
发动期间不会退出[猩红铭刻]状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Delivers a powerful forward counterattack with the Blood Axe, dealing Electric DMG.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：血华誓·血契共鸣
skills.nameEn: Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
发动期间，[猩红铭刻]持续时间不再减少，不会退出[猩红铭刻]状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

skills.name: 核心被动：苍白血宴
skills.nameEn: Core Passive: Banquet of Pale Blood
skills.description:
克拉蕾发动招式造成的伤害均为锐化伤害，使用防御力作为招式伤害倍率，部分锐化伤害会积累残痕值，残痕值满时，敌人会进入[残痕]，[残痕]最多叠加3层，发动[特殊技：血华誓·斩金断铁]、[特殊技：血华誓·葬血强袭]命中处于[残痕]状态下的敌人时，会消耗一层[残痕]，触发[毁伤]并造成一次范围伤害；
触发暴击时，锐化伤害不受暴击伤害加成，转而计算锐暴伤害加成；若暴击率超过100%且已经触发暴击，还将基于超过部分的暴击率再进行一次锐暴判定，触发锐暴则额外计算一次锐暴伤害加成；克拉蕾每拥有1%的初始暴击伤害，初始暴击率提升0.35%；
克拉蕾进入战场时即可回复60点锐能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次;
克拉蕾处于[猩红铭刻]期间，抗打断等级提升，克拉蕾发动[连携技]时延长[猩红铭刻]2秒持续时间；
克拉蕾处于[猩红铭刻]，或是在发动[连携技]、[终结技]、[反制支援]、[支援突击]期间，暴击率提升15%，残痕积蓄效率提升20%，在[普通攻击：血华誓·锻星]和[普通攻击：血华誓·伏钺]招式攻击期间触发极限闪避时，使招式剩余时间内造成的伤害提升15%。
skills.descriptionEn:
All DMG dealt by Claret's skills is considered Sharp DMG, and skill DMG Multipliers are based on DEF. Certain Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy is inflicted with Gash, which can stack up to 3 times. When Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron or Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, 1 stack of Gash is consumed to trigger Maim and deal AoE DMG.
When a critical hit is triggered, Sharp DMG doesn't receive the CRIT DMG Bonus and instead uses the Laceration DMG Bonus. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check is performed based on the excess CRIT Rate. If Laceration is triggered, the Laceration DMG Bonus is applied an additional time. For every 1% of Claret's initial CRIT DMG, her initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%.
When Claret enters the battlefield, she gains 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, her Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. When Claret uses a Chain Attack, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s.
While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, CRIT Rate increases by 15% and Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%. Triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging or Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe increases DMG dealt for the remainder of the skill by 15%.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

触发暴击时，锐化伤害不受暴击伤害加成，转而计算锐暴伤害加成；若暴击率超过100%且已经触发暴击，还将基于超过部分的暴击率再进行一次锐暴判定，触发锐暴则额外计算一次锐暴伤害加成；克拉蕾每拥有1%的初始暴击伤害，初始暴击率提升0.35%；
克拉蕾进入战场时即可回复60点锐能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次;
克拉蕾处于[猩红铭刻]期间，抗打断等级提升，克拉蕾发动[连携技]时延长[猩红铭刻]2秒持续时间；
克拉蕾处于[猩红铭刻]，或是在发动[连携技]、[终结技]、[反制支援]、[支援突击]期间，暴击率提升25%，残痕积蓄效率提升40%，在[普通攻击：血华誓·锻星]和[普通攻击：血华誓·伏钺]招式攻击期间触发极限闪避时，使招式剩余时间内造成的伤害提升15%。
levels.descriptionEn:
All DMG dealt by Claret's skills is considered Sharp DMG, and skill DMG Multipliers are based on DEF. Certain Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy is inflicted with Gash, which can stack up to 3 times. When Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron or Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, 1 stack of Gash is consumed to trigger Maim and deal AoE DMG.
When a critical hit is triggered, Sharp DMG doesn't receive the CRIT DMG Bonus and instead uses the Laceration DMG Bonus. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check is performed based on the excess CRIT Rate. If Laceration is triggered, the Laceration DMG Bonus is applied an additional time. For every 1% of Claret's initial CRIT DMG, her initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%.
When Claret enters the battlefield, she gains 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, her Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. When Claret uses a Chain Attack, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s.
While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, CRIT Rate increases by 25% and Gash Buildup Rate increases by 40%. Triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging or Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe increases DMG dealt for the remainder of the skill by 15%.

When another character in your squad is a Stun or Armorer character, or shares the same attribute:
When any Agent in the squad triggers Contamination, Claret gains 300 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
When Claret or another squad member triggers Maim, all Armorer Agents in the squad enter Remnant Edge. While in the Remnant Edge state, Laceration DMG is increased by 25%, lasting 40s. Triggering Remnant Edge again refreshes its duration.

cinema.name: 淋漓古志
cinema.description: 克拉蕾攻击命中敌人并造成锐暴时，残痕积蓄效率提升20%；克拉蕾触发[毁伤]造成的伤害倍率提升至原本的130%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Claret's attacks hit enemies and trigger Laceration, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%. The DMG Multiplier of Maim triggered by Claret increases to 130% of its original value.
cinema.story:
少女翻阅古朴的族志，粗粝的纸张啃噬她的掌心。
一滴血坠入扉页，千万滴血涂满余章。
cinema.storyEn:
The girl turns the pages of the weathered family chronicle, the coarse paper scraping at her palm.
A single drop of blood falls onto the title page; countless more stain every page that follows.

cinema.name: 薪火荣冠
cinema.description: [猩红铭刻]最大持续时间延长2秒；克拉蕾处于[猩红铭刻]，或是在发动[连携技]、[终结技]、[反制支援]、[支援突击]期间，攻击命中时无视目标18%电属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: The maximum duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s. While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, attacks ignore 18% of the target's Electric RES.
cinema.story:
被血脉选中的天才踏入殿堂，流溢的辉光照彻脸庞。
她无言地接过冠冕与权杖，转身奔赴下一个锤锻场。
cinema.storyEn:
The prodigy chosen by her bloodline steps into the great hall, radiant light spilling across her face.
Without a word, she accepts the crown and scepter, then turns and heads for the next forging ground.

cinema.name: 糖霜宣言
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
炉火昼夜不息，家族的重担压于少女肩际。
她向来不知如何排遣心绪，直到某日，天才的助手捧来精巧的甜点，为苦涩的日子添上一缕回甘。
cinema.storyEn:
The forge burns day and night, and the family's heavy burden falls upon the young woman's shoulders.
She has never known how to ease the feelings weighing on her heart, until one day, her brilliant assistant brings her an exquisite dessert, adding a lingering touch of sweetness to her bitter days.

cinema.name: 赤月彷徨
cinema.description: [普通攻击：血华誓·锻星]第三段招式发动期间，连续斩击的可延长时间增加；[普通攻击：血华誓·锻星]第三段、[连携技：血华誓·血契共鸣]、[终结技：血华誓·千锤百炼]造成的伤害提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: During the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging, the time by which the consecutive slashes can be extended is increased. DMG dealt by Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging's 3rd hit, Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact, and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial increases by 20%.
cinema.story:
锤声落尽，长夜唯余赤月高悬。
少女昂起绯色的眼眸，残忍的月光嗤笑着漫过窗棂。
cinema.storyEn:
The hammering falls silent, and only the crimson moon hangs high in the long night.
The young woman raises her scarlet gaze while the merciless moonlight seems to mock her as it creeps across the window frame.

cinema.name: 暮血熔炉
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
历代工匠皆以鲜血滋养熔炉，而她誓要让火焰学会自行燃烧。
锤声再度响彻工坊，炉火依旧长明，却无需再以生命为柴薪。
cinema.storyEn:
Generations of artisans have fed the furnace with their blood, but she swears to teach the flames to burn on their own.
The sound of hammering rings through the workshop once more. The furnace still burns eternal, but no longer needs life itself as fuel.

cinema.name: 热夜之梦
cinema.description: 克拉蕾发动[连携技：血华誓·血契共鸣]、[终结技：血华誓·千锤百炼]重击命中敌人时，不消耗[残痕]直接触发1次单体[毁伤]。
cinema.descriptionEn: When the heavy attacks of Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial hit an enemy, Claret directly triggers 1 instance of single-target Maim without consuming Gash.
cinema.story:
少女终于沉沉睡去。
她梦见一轮满月，一片恒久无垠的大地，
赤红的月光早已消逝，银色的夜空仿若黎明。
cinema.storyEn:
The young woman finally drifts into a deep sleep.
She dreams of a full moon and a vast land stretching on forever.
The crimson moonlight has long since faded, and the silver night sky seems almost like dawn.

1621.name: 洛克茜
1621.fullName: 洛克茜·伊芙莉塔·普莱斯
1621.faction: 罗斯凯利法·弗林特工坊

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
每个脾气怪异、行事乖张的天才身后，都有一个能够一丝不苟地完成疯狂计划、事无巨细地处理好天才惹下的麻烦的天才帮手。

洛克茜就是属于克拉蕾的那位天才帮手。作为弗林特家族的旁系，拉拢未来的家主继承人无疑是最为明智的选择，这也的确是洛克茜的长辈们将年幼的她送往克拉蕾身边的初衷。

但洛克茜从未有一刻选择背离自己选择的家主，她早已不是任何人拉拢克拉蕾的工具——只因克拉蕾是那时唯一没有将她视作「工具」的人。

没有克拉蕾就没有今日弗林特家族的复兴，但如果没有洛克茜，便不会有无畏的克拉蕾。

她是她的胆量与底气，她则是她的心尖血。
profile.descriptionEn:
Behind every eccentric genius with a strange temper and an even stranger way of doing things, there's a brilliant assistant who can carry out those wild plans to the letter and clean up every last mess they leave behind.

Roxy is that brilliant assistant for Claret. As someone from a branch line of the Flint family, winning over the future head of the family was undoubtedly the wisest choice. That was indeed why Roxy's elders sent her to Claret's side when she was still young.

But not once has Roxy chosen to turn her back on the head of the family she chose. Long ago, she stopped being anyone's tool for winning Claret over, because Claret was the only person back then who never saw her as a "tool."

Without Claret, the Flint family would never have seen the revival it enjoys today. But without Roxy, there would never have been the fearless Claret.

Roxy is her courage and the one who always has her back, while Claret is the one Roxy holds dearest to her heart.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 女
profile.descriptionEn: Female

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: DEC 29

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 我也想有一个洛克茜这样可靠又包容的天才助手！！
profile.descriptionEn: I wish I had a genius assistant as reliable and understanding as Roxy too!

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 铃，你这是在暗示哪位首席助手呢？
profile.descriptionEn: Belle, could you perhaps be making a jab at a certain Supreme Assistant?

profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Roxy:
 · A genius assistant who's 100% loyal!

profile.description: · 努力百分百的锻造大师！
profile.descriptionEn: · A master blacksmith who gives 100%!

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 维尔乌姆的失眠奇谭，弗林特的下班神话！
profile.descriptionEn: · Vyrium's sleepless tale, Flint's clocking-out myth!

1621.description:
洛克茜·伊芙莉塔·普莱斯，弗林特工坊的常驻管理人，弗林特家主克拉蕾的挚友、助手、管家以及麻烦处理人。

与克拉蕾或诺姆这样刻板印象的「天才」不同，洛克茜自称只是平凡的努力家，用汗水与时间勉强追上真正天才们的脚步。

撇开她自谦的话语，洛克茜平均每日花在弗林特工坊的汗水与工作时间的确严重超出了健康的标准——这多多少少加重了她因心脏问题呈现的苍白肤色。

洛克茜的情绪通常高度稳定，即使在众多代理人之中，她完成行动的效率和表现的稳定性也名列前茅。据她本人称，这是由于「小姐闹的麻烦够大闯的麻烦够多」，这样特别的工作经历让她在任何危机面前都能保持波澜不惊。
1621.descriptionEn:
Roxy Ifrita Pryce, the resident manager of Flint Workshop, is a close friend, assistant, housekeeper, and problem-solver to Claret, head of the Flint family.

Unlike stereotypical "geniuses" like Claret and Norma, Roxy considers herself merely an ordinary hard worker, barely keeping pace with true geniuses through sheer time and effort.

Setting aside her modesty, the sheer amount of time and effort Roxy puts into Flint Workshop each day is indeed far beyond what could be considered healthy, which has, to some extent, worsened the paleness caused by her heart condition.

Roxy is usually remarkably steady. Even among the many Agents, she ranks near the top in both operational efficiency and consistency. According to Roxy herself, that's because "milady gets into more than enough trouble," and such an unusual work history has taught her to remain unfazed in the face of any crisis.

丢出锤子对场上敌人造成风属性伤害；
被该招式命中的[风眼]会被引爆，至多引爆3个[风眼]，根据引爆数量生成对应数量的微型风旋，造成风属性伤害；
若一次引爆3个[风眼]，则改为生成1阵巨型风旋，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After activating EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace, this attack is automatically activated when the total number of Eyes of the Storm on the field and Roxy's Wind Energy reaches at least 3:
Throws her hammer at enemies on the field, dealing Wind DMG.
Eyes of the Storm hit by this attack are detonated, up to 3 Eyes of the Storm at a time. Based on the number detonated, a corresponding number of Miniature Windstorms are generated, dealing Wind DMG.
If 3 Eyes of the Storm are detonated at once, a Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：小心风寒
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方滑行，造成风属性伤害；
滑行期间若保持长按 【强化特殊技键】 ，洛克茜进入[自旋]状态：
[自旋]状态下洛克茜会化作一阵龙卷风，期间拖曳摇杆可以控制龙卷风的移动方向，期间持续消耗能量并对路径上的敌人造成风属性伤害。能量耗尽或松开 【强化特殊技键】 且不拖曳摇杆时，退出[自旋]状态；
结束滑行或退出[自旋]状态时，自动衔接[强化特殊技：敬请安息]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Slides forward, dealing Wind DMG.
While sliding, press and hold [EX Special Attack] to have Roxy enter the Whirlwind state:
While in the Whirlwind state, Roxy generates a tornado. Drag the joystick to control its direction. During this, Energy is continuously consumed, dealing Wind DMG to enemies along its path. When Energy is depleted, or when [EX Special Attack] is released while the joystick is not being moved, Roxy exits the Whirlwind state.
When the slide ends or when exiting the Whirlwind state, automatically follows up with EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：敬请安息
skills.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace
skills.description:
[强化特殊技：小心风寒]结束自动发动：
消耗全部[风能]向前方发射风炮，造成风属性伤害；
每消耗1点[风能]，在攻击后额外造成一次风属性伤害，并在原地生成1个[风眼]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill ends:
Consumes all Wind Energy to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing Wind DMG.
After the attack, for each point of Wind Energy consumed, deals an additional instance of Wind DMG and generates 1 Eye of the Storm at the current position.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 风眼
skills.description:
[强化特殊技：敬请安息]消耗[风能]后生成，持续30秒后自动引爆；
[风眼]最多同时存在9个，超出上限后最早生成的[风眼]会自动引爆；
被[特殊技：恕不远送]命中时将其引爆，若同时命中数量不足3个，每个[风眼]位置上都会生成1阵微型风旋，追踪敌人并造成风属性伤害，持续1秒；
若同时命中3个，则会生成1阵巨型风旋作为替代，造成风属性伤害，持续1秒。
通过任意方式引爆时，[风眼]会发出爆鸣对周围敌人造成一次风属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Generated after EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace consumes Wind Energy, and automatically detonates after 30s.
Up to 9 Eyes of the Storm can exist at the same time. If this limit is exceeded, the earliest generated Eye of the Storm will automatically detonate.
Detonates when hit by Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off. If fewer than 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Miniature Windstorm is generated at the location of each Eye of the Storm, tracking enemies and dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
If 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
When detonated by any means, an Eye of the Storm releases a blast, dealing 1 instance of Wind DMG to nearby enemies.

skills.name: 闪避：失陪
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
向侧方进行快速闪避。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
Performs a quick dodge to the side.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：失礼
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行打击，造成风属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Strikes forward, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：礼尚往来
skills.description:
极限闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 连携技：葬风巨锤
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方敌人发动强力打击，造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front, dealing massive Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：葬夜安魂曲
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动后，获得1点[风能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Wind DMG.
After the skill ends, gains 1 Wind Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援技：还要加班？
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，再次点按 【切换键】 发动：
洛克茜留在前场，对前方敌人发动打击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动时视为发动[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
After activating a Defensive Assist, press [Switch] again to activate:
Roxy stays on the field and strikes enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG.
This skill is treated as activating a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：听凭差遣
skills.description:
前场角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方进行打击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：为您分忧
skills.nameEn: Defensive Assist: Allow Me to Assist
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：午夜守则
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行打击，造成风属性伤害。
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strikes enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：热夜初拥
skills.description:
每消耗25点能量，获得1点[风能]，[风能]上限为3点；
洛克茜的初始能量自动回复大于1.2时，超过部分每超过0.01，攻击力提升5点，最多提升480点，冲击力提升0.4点，最多提升40点；
[特殊技：恕不远送]命中处于[风化]状态中的敌人后，会触发[净化]，[浸染]状态被还原；
队伍中任意队友触发[浸染]或[净化]效果时，洛克茜将根据[浸染]或[净化]的属性为全队角色提供增益效果：洛克茜每拥有1%暴击率，非[锋御]角色造成对应属性以及风属性伤害时，暴击伤害提升0.4%，最多提升22%；[锋御]角色造成对应属性以及风属性伤害时，锐暴伤害提升0.2%，最多提升10%；每个属性增益效果分别持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
对已经处于[风化]状态下的敌人再次施加[风化]时，根据被覆盖的[风化]状态下的[浸染]属性及风属性，全队角色同样可以获得该增益效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Gain 1 point of Wind Energy for every 25 Energy consumed, up to a maximum of 3 Wind Energy.
When Roxy's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, for every 0.01 above this value, ATK increases by 5, up to a maximum increase of 480, and Impact increases by 0.4, up to a maximum increase of 40.
After Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off hits an enemy affected by Windswept, it triggers Cleanse, reverting Contamination back to its original state.
When any squad member triggers Contamination or Cleanse, Roxy provides all squad members with a buff based on the attribute of the Contamination or Cleanse effect: for every 1% CRIT Rate Roxy has, when non-Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their CRIT DMG increases by 0.4%, up to 22%. When Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their Laceration DMG increases by 0.2%, up to 10%. Each attribute's buff lasts 50s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Windswept is applied again to an enemy already in the Windswept state, all squad members can also gain this buff based on the Contamination attribute of the overwritten Windswept state and Wind attribute.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

When any squad member triggers Contamination or Cleanse, Roxy provides all squad members with a buff based on the attribute of the Contamination or Cleanse effect: for every 1% CRIT Rate Roxy has, when non-Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their CRIT DMG increases by 0.4%, up to 34%. When Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their Laceration DMG increases by 0.2%, up to 16%. Each attribute's buff lasts 50s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Windswept is applied again to an enemy already in the Windswept state, all squad members can also gain this buff based on the Contamination attribute of the overwritten Windswept state and Wind attribute.

洛克茜的初始能量自动回复大于1.2时，超过部分每超过0.01，攻击力提升5点，最多提升880点，冲击力提升0.4点，最多提升70点；
[特殊技：恕不远送]命中处于[风化]状态中的敌人后，会触发[净化]，[浸染]状态被还原；

对已经处于[风化]状态下的敌人再次施加[风化]时，根据被覆盖的[风化]状态下的[浸染]属性及风属性，全队角色同样可以获得该增益效果。

skills.name: 额外能力：辉金心脏
skills.description:
队伍中存在[强攻]角色或[命破]角色或[锋御]角色时触发：
洛克茜造成的伤害提升8%，该效果随角色等级提升，每级增加1.2%，最多提升80%；
队伍中角色攻击命中敌人时，使其失衡易伤倍率提升30%，敌人进入失衡状态时，使其失衡时间延长2秒，失衡持续时间提升效果与同类效果不可叠加，失衡结束时移除该效果；
敌人处于队伍中角色造成的[风化]状态下时，敌人受到的风属性直接攻击伤害和触发[浸染]属性的直接攻击伤害额外提升8%；
进入战场时，自身回复40点能量，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
全队角色施加的[风化]效果延长20秒；
释放[强化特殊技]时，自身异常积蓄效率提升30%，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Rupture, or Armorer character:
Roxy's DMG increases by 8%. This effect increases with character level, increasing by 1.2% per level, up to 80%.
When any squad member's attack hits an enemy, it increases their Stun DMG Multiplier by 30%. When an enemy becomes Stunned, its Stun duration is extended by 2s. This Stun duration increase does not stack with similar effects. The effect is removed once the Stun ends.
While an enemy is in the Windswept state applied by a squad member, the direct Wind DMG they take and the direct DMG they take of the attribute that triggered Contamination are increased by 8%.
Upon entering the battlefield, restores 40 Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Windswept applied by all squad members lasts 20s longer.
When using an EX Special Attack, Roxy's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 30% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

cinema.name: 全能执事
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：敬请安息]命中时，使敌方全属性伤害抗性降低15%，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；自身暴击伤害提升40%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace hits, it reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
cinema.story:
洛克茜总能将一切安排得井井有条，包括任性家主的衣食起居，以及她频繁的心血来潮。
「如果您一定要去的话，请带上这本指南吧。是的，我知道小姐会做出这样的决定。」
「您改主意了？没关系，这是另一份指南，专门用来应对这种情况。」
cinema.storyEn:
Roxy always manages to keep everything perfectly in order, from the head of the household's daily needs to her frequent whims.
"If you insist on going, please take this guide with you. Yes, I knew you would make this decision, milady."
"You've changed your mind? That's fine. Here's another guide, just for this sort of situation."

cinema.name: 下班神话
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：小心风寒]造成的失衡值提升5%；每引爆1个[风眼]，获得一层[流势]效果，至多获得3层；在[强化特殊技：小心风寒]期间进入[自旋]状态下换人时，洛克茜将消耗所有[流势]，每消耗1层可以维持[自旋]状态0.2秒，期间不消耗能量，至多维持0.6秒；[强化特殊技：小心风寒]命中敌人时，使敌人失衡易伤倍率提升30%，持续到目标从失衡状态恢复。
cinema.descriptionEn:
EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill deals 5% more Daze.
For each Eye of the Storm detonated, gain 1 stack of Windflow, up to 3 stacks.
During EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill, if Roxy switches out after entering the Whirlwind state, she consumes all Windflow. Each stack consumed sustains the Whirlwind state for 0.2s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of 0.6s.
When EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% until the target recovers from Stun.
cinema.story:
苍白的肤色和常年的黑眼圈昭示着洛克茜为工坊倾注的心力。
她经常见到凌晨四点的维尔乌姆，尽管她并没有昼伏夜出的习惯。
于她而言，下班如神话般遥远。
「啊…又天亮了…好像永远无法到达下班的真实。」
cinema.storyEn:
Roxy's pale complexion and ever-present dark circles speak to how much effort she pours into the workshop.
She is all too familiar with Vyrium at four in the morning, despite having no nocturnal habits.
To her, clocking out feels as distant as a myth.
"Ah... dawn again... It feels like getting off work will never become a reality."

cinema.name: 失眠奇谭
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
洛克茜习惯做好完备的计划，但牵涉到小姐的计划总是赶不上变化，无数次更改日程、无数次修订方案…
完美的助手也不禁烦躁起来，直到抵达某个临界点——她暴走了。
从此维尔乌姆有了一位深夜游荡的可怖怪人。
「我只是想回家…睡个好觉——！」
cinema.storyEn:
Roxy is used to making thorough plans, but whenever Claret is involved, those plans struggle to keep up with the changes. Countless schedule adjustments, countless revisions...
Even the perfect assistant eventually starts to lose her patience until she reaches a certain breaking point — and snaps.
From then on, Vyrium gains a terrifying figure who roams the streets late at night.
"I just want to go home... and get a good night's sleep—!"

cinema.name: R.I.P.
cinema.description: 发动[招架支援]成功招架敌人攻击时，洛克茜回复1点能量，招式内至多回复1次；[闪避反击：礼尚往来]命中敌人时，回复2点能量，招式内至多回复1次；[终结技：葬夜安魂曲]造成的伤害提升20%，失衡值提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When a Defensive Assist successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains 1 Energy, up to once per skill. When Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy hits an enemy, it grants 2 Energy, up to once per skill. Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial deals 20% more DMG and 10% more Daze.
cinema.story:
每次洛克茜搬出武器，敌人总是感到困惑：怎么会有人把棺椁当作武器？
不过他们的疑惑很快就会消散。
当少女轻描淡写地将它挥舞起来，带动空气撕扯出沉重的呼啸时，他们就会明白：那玩意儿绝不是用来躺着睡觉的。
「虽然还是白天，不过很抱歉——该说晚安了。」
cinema.storyEn:
Whenever Roxy brings out her weapon, her enemies are always left baffled: Who uses a coffin as a weapon?
Their confusion never lasts long, though.
Once they see the girl casually swing it around, tearing through the air with a heavy howl, they quickly understand: that thing definitely wasn't made for sleeping in.
"It's still daytime, but I'm afraid... it's time to say goodnight."

cinema.name: 第二次心跳
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
洛克茜早已记不清儿时的那场冒险，失去心脏的痛楚也早已淡去。
可她不会忘记，被称作天才的少女曾经哭红了骄傲的眼睛，一遍遍地呼唤她的名字，
泪水落在她冰冷的胸膛上，几乎要把她的心烫出一个洞来。
「因为这颗辉金心脏…我偶尔会有点贫血，但有小姐在，那就没必要担心。」
cinema.storyEn:
Roxy can barely remember the adventure she had as a child, and the pain of losing her heart has long since faded.
But she will never forget how the girl known as a genius once cried until her proud eyes were red, calling Roxy's name over and over.
Her tears fell upon Roxy's cold chest, almost hot enough to burn a hole through her heart.
"Because of this Porcelloy Heart... I do get a little anemic sometimes, but with milady around, there's nothing to worry about."

cinema.name: 永远与自动发条人偶
cinema.description: 自身攻击造成的伤害无视目标15%风属性伤害抗性；[特殊技：恕不远送]引爆[风眼]生成巨型风旋时，主目标会被赋予[余响]效果，每间隔3秒在目标位置生成一次巨型风旋，共额外生成2次巨型风旋，重复触发时额外生成次数叠加且刷新[余响]的持续时间；巨型风旋造成的伤害倍率提升至原本的250%，造成的失衡提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: The DMG dealt by attacks ignores 15% of the target's Wind RES. When Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off detonates Eyes of the Storm to generate a Giant Windstorm, the primary target is inflicted with Afterecho. A Giant Windstorm is generated at the target's location every 3s, for a total of 2 additional Giant Windstorms. Repeated triggers stack the number of additional Giant Windstorm instances generated and refresh the duration of Afterecho. The DMG multiplier of the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Daze it inflicts increases by 20%.
cinema.story:
有人认为洛克茜是为了维系辉金心脏才留在那位家主身边：弗林特用血脉俘获了一位得力助手。
洛克茜对此类言论司空见惯，甚至懒得置辩；而另一位当事人却曾为此忐忑不已。
某天忙碌的间隙，她装作若无其事地向助手问起，回答她的只有一声无奈的叹息。
「不，我从不这样想。能活下来就已经很好了，我一直很感谢小姐。」
「况且…恕我直言，被血脉束缚的是小姐才对吧？」
「原来最近令您坐立不安的是这件事…比起无聊的传闻，您不久前向算枢局夸下的海口——那笔超额的辉金订单才更值得烦恼。」
cinema.storyEn:
Some believe Roxy only remains by the head of the household's side to sustain her Porcelloy Heart: Flint Workshop used their bloodline to secure a capable assistant.
Roxy has heard such claims so often that she no longer even bothers refuting them. The other person concerned, however, can't help but worry over it.
One day, during a brief lull in her busy schedule, she casually brought the matter up with her assistant, only to be met with a helpless sigh.
"No, I've never thought of it that way. Just being alive is already more than enough. I've always been grateful to you, milady."
"Besides... if I may be so bold, aren't you the one bound by bloodline here, milady?"
"So this is what's been making you restless lately... Rather than some pointless rumor, I'd say that oversized Porcelloy order you boasted to the CCD about not long ago is far more worth worrying about."

1631.name: 赛维里安

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
与刻板印象中的理性与严苛不同的是，被赛维里安吸纳进治安局的并不只是令行禁止的优等生，相反有许多性格各异，甚至有「背景污点」的人被他收编，例如简或希希芙。因为在他心中，制度规则不等于秩序，有些时候只有打破规则，才能织就那个真正理想的秩序。
                                                                             
此外，如果留心观察赛维里安平时的举止，会发现他或许并不如他的表情那么冷漠。下属虽然常遭冷眼，但认真拜托他的事却大都会实现，偶尔犯下的错误也总在不知不觉中被他弥补。在家庭中他则是一个富有责任感的长子，他会记得自己错过的家庭活动，也会给弟弟寄匿名的生日礼物，在许多容易被忽视的地方偶然流露真心。  
                                                                                                          
只是赛维里安的这些面向鲜少展露于人前，如果有人能够发现的话，那他一定已经在对方面前卸下了许多心防。
profile.descriptionEn:
Contrary to the stereotypical image of someone so rational and strict, the people Severian has brought into Public Security aren't limited to obedient model officers. Quite the opposite, many of his recruits have very different personalities, and some even have "blemishes" in their backgrounds, such as Jane and Cissia. That's because, in Severian's eyes, rules and institutions aren't the same thing as order. Sometimes, only by breaking the rules can the order he truly envisions be created.

If you pay close attention to Severian's everyday behavior, you may find that he isn't quite as cold as his expression makes him seem. His subordinates may often be met with icy looks, but when they sincerely ask something of him, he usually makes it happen. Sometimes, he even ends up quietly cleaning up their mistakes for them. At home, he's a responsible eldest son. He remembers the family events he's missed, sends anonymous birthday presents to his younger brother, and occasionally lets his true feelings show in small ways that are easy to overlook.

These sides of Severian are rarely shown to others. If someone is able to notice them, then he must already have lowered much of his guard around that person.

profile.name: 性别
profile.description: 男
profile.descriptionEn: Male

profile.name: 生日
profile.descriptionEn: DEC 31

profile.name: 铃的评价
profile.description: 每次看到赛维里安都在想，他不那么淡定的时候会是什么样呢…有机会的话真想看看他大笑或者大哭的样子，给他看催泪神片会不会有用？
profile.descriptionEn: Every time I see Severian, I wonder what he'd be like if he weren't so calm... If I ever get the chance, I'd love to see him laugh his head off or burst into tears. Maybe showing him a real tearjerker would do the trick?

profile.name: 哲的评价
profile.description: 以我的了解，铃自己应该会先被感动到哭吧，在这方面我们还是不要以卵击石了…
profile.descriptionEn: Knowing you, you'd probably be the one crying first. Better not pick a fight you can't win...

profile.name: 印象 1
profile.description:
对赛维里安的印象：
 · 绝对不能冒犯的冷酷长官
profile.descriptionEn:
Impressions of Severian:
 · The coldhearted superior you must never offend.

profile.name: 印象 2
profile.description: · 绝对可以合作的可靠大人
profile.descriptionEn: · The reliable superior you can always count on.

profile.name: 印象 3
profile.description: · 绝对值得信赖的理想心灵
profile.descriptionEn: · A kindred spirit you can truly trust.

1631.description:
赛维里安·洛威尔，现任新艾利都治安局高级秩序督察，属于新艾利都市政真正的实权派高层。

在治安局内，他以作风强硬、独断专行著称，不少市政体系内的保守势力将其视为眼中钉，认为他漠视现行制度与规则，他却以无可争议的实绩一步步走到了高级秩序督察的位置。
                                                                              
在下属眼里，他则是一位绝对的铁腕领导者，而这种领袖权威的确立，不是凭借权术或狠勇，而是建立在他的无数次正确决策之上。
                                                                                                                       
一直以来，对赛维里安的批评之声不在少数，但赛维里安向来视之如无物。对他而言，重要的是自己的目的是否达成，其余的一切都不过是手段。
1631.descriptionEn:
Severian Lowell currently serves as a Senior Commissioner with New Eridu Public Security and is one of the true power players at the highest levels of New Eridu's city administration.

Within Public Security, he's known for his hardline approach and tendency to act on his own authority. Many conservative forces within the city administration see him as a thorn in their side, believing he has little regard for the existing system and its rules. Even so, his undeniable results have carried him step by step to the rank of Senior Commissioner.

To his subordinates, he's an uncompromising, iron-fisted leader. But that authority wasn't built through political maneuvering or sheer ruthlessness. It rests on the countless correct decisions he's made over the years.

Severian has never lacked critics, but he has always treated their voices as little more than background noise. To him, what matters is whether his objective is achieved. Everything else is simply a means to that end.

skills.name: 普通攻击：疾锋
skills.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段攻击，造成风属性伤害；
第四段攻击命中敌人后，累积20点[流息]；
第四段攻击发动瞬间具备闪避判定，如果成功闪避敌人攻击，本次普攻的伤害倍率和失衡倍率提升至与[普通攻击：烈旋]一致，并额外累积15点[流息]；
第四段攻击发动期间拥有无敌效果；
赛维里安在[普通攻击]期间发动[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]和[闪避：写意]时，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Wind DMG.
When the 4th attack hits an enemy, it accumulates 20 Flow.
The 4th attack can dodge enemy attacks upon the moment of activation. Upon successfully dodging an enemy attack, this Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to those of Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind, and an additional 15 Flow is accumulated.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
When Severian uses a Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, or Dodge: Spontaneity during a Basic Attack combo, it does not interrupt the Basic Attack combo count.

skills.name: 普通攻击：烈旋
skills.description:
前三段普通攻击发动的瞬间受到敌人攻击或自身存在[烁影]效果且不拥有无敌效果时受到敌人非控制技攻击会自动发动：
向前方进行突进，对前方范围的敌人造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动时累积15点[流息]，命中敌人后额外累积20点[流息]；
招式发动时保持长按 【普通攻击键】，可以快速发动[普通攻击：苍风影猎]且[普通攻击：苍风影猎]的最后一击释放时会累积20点[流息]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Automatically activates when Severian is attacked at the moment he launches the first three attacks of his Basic Attack, or when he has Shadowflash and is hit by a non-Control Skill enemy attack while not invulnerable:
Dashes forward, dealing massive Wind DMG to enemies in an area ahead.
Upon activating this skill, accumulates 15 Flow. Upon hitting an enemy, an additional 20 Flow is accumulated.
Hold [Basic Attack] while activating this skill to quickly launch Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt. When the final hit of Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt is unleashed, it accumulates 20 Flow.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 普通攻击：苍风影猎
skills.description:
[流息]足够时，消耗100点[流息]，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
先向后闪避并蓄势，随后在站场中不断穿梭并不断发动斩击，对前方范围的敌人造成大量风属性伤害；
向后闪避期间，具备闪避判定，如果成功闪避敌人攻击，会触发[极限视域]，并累积15点[流息]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Flow, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 100 Flow and activate:
Dodges backward and charges up, then continuously darts around the field while unleashing slashes, dealing massive Wind DMG to enemies in an area in front.
The backward dodge can dodge enemy attacks. Successfully dodging an enemy attack triggers Vital View and accumulates 15 Flow.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 特殊技：瞬风斩破
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动斩击和刺击，造成风属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes slashes and stabs forward, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：瞬风裂毁
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前发动斩击、爪击和炮击的组合技，对敌人造成大量风属性伤害，并获得一层[烁影]；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以在炮击前持续消耗能量不断发动风刃对敌人造成风属性伤害；
能量消耗达最大时，额外获得一层[烁影];
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a combination of slashes, claw strikes, and cannon fire forward, dealing massive Wind DMG and gaining 1 stack of Shadowflash.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to continuously consume Energy before the cannon attack, and repeatedly launch wind blades that deal Wind DMG to enemies.
When reaching the maximum amount of Energy consumed, gains an additional stack of Shadowflash.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：飘折
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
通过[闪避：飘折]触发[极限闪避]时，累积15点[流息]，此效果0.5秒内最多触发一次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
When Dodge: Windshift triggers a Perfect Dodge, it accumulates 15 Flow. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：凛袭
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行攻击，造成风属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launches an attack forward, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：梢杀
skills.description:
通过[闪避：飘折]触发[极限闪避]时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动快速斩击，造成风属性伤害；
若通过[闪避：飘折]触发[极限闪避]瞬间切入后台，会自动发动本招式；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Dodge: Windshift triggers a Perfect Dodge, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches a quick slash forward, dealing Wind DMG.
If switched off-field immediately after triggering a Perfect Dodge with Dodge: Windshift, this skill is activated automatically.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 闪避：写意
skills.description:
后闪后，持续长按【闪避键】 发动：
向敌人发起挑衅。
skills.descriptionEn:
After dodging backward, hold [Dodge] to activate:
Provokes the enemy.

skills.name: 连携技：冽刃收割
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方发动多段攻击，造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动后，累积35点[流息]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Wind DMG.
After using this skill, accumulates 35 Flow.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 终结技：戮灭的风灾
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
连续发动多次快速斩击，造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动后，累积100点[流息]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes multiple rapid slashes in succession, dealing massive Wind DMG.
After using this skill, accumulates 100 Flow.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 快速支援：火线调令
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
快速突进，对前方敌人发动爪击和斩击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Dashes forward quickly, unleashing claw strikes and slashes at enemies ahead to deal Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 招架支援：寻衅禁止
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：以戈止戈
skills.nameEn: Assist Follow-Up: Fight Force with Force
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
依次对敌人发动斩击，爪击和炮击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes slashes, claw strikes, and cannon fire against enemies in sequence, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 登场技：清场时刻
skills.description:
当赛维里安拥有[凭风]效果且处于接战状态下点按 【切换键】 从后场切换至前场发动：
对前方敌人发动大力斩击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动时视为发动[快速支援]；
招式视为非重击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Severian has Windborne and is in combat, press [Switch] to switch him into battle and activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash against enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG.
Activating this skill is considered activating a Quick Assist.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 核心被动：风回无终
skills.description:
赛维里安的暴击伤害提升30%，造成的伤害提升12.5%，若队伍中存在其他风属性角色则伤害额外提升15%；
赛维里安在即将受到敌人攻击的瞬间发动[普通攻击：疾锋]时，可以闪避本次攻击，若通过前三段普攻闪避了本次攻击则自动发动[普通攻击：烈旋]，若是第四段普攻则提升本次普攻的伤害倍率和失衡倍率至与[普通攻击：烈旋]一致；
赛维里安进入战场时可获得两层[烁影]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
赛维里安拥有[烁影]且不具有无敌效果时，若受到敌人非控制技攻击且未能主动闪避或招架此次攻击，赛维里安会消耗一层[烁影]自动闪避本次攻击并发动[普通攻击：烈旋]；
赛维里安通过发动[普通攻击：疾锋]成功闪避敌人攻击，触发[烁影]自动闪避敌人攻击和直接闪避敌人攻击都视为[极限闪避]；
[烁影]最多获取两层，若满层时再获取[烁影]，将获得一层[凭风]效果且下次的[普通攻击：疾锋]会被提升为[普通攻击：烈旋]；
赛维里安每次极限闪避都能获得一层[凭风]效果，当赛维里安拥有[凭风]效果且处于接战状态下点按 【切换键】 从后场切换至前场发动[登场技]；
赛维里安通过固定招式命中敌人或触发极限闪避时，会获得[流息]，[流息]上限为150点；
当[流息]达到100点时，长按 【普通攻击键】 可以消耗100点[流息]发动[普通攻击：苍风影猎]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Severian's CRIT DMG increases by 30%, and his DMG increases by 12.5%. If there is another Wind character in the squad, his DMG increases by an additional 15%.
When Severian uses Basic Attack: Swift Edge just before being hit by an enemy attack, he can dodge the attack. If he dodges it with any of the first three hits of his Basic Attack, he automatically launches Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind. If he dodges it with the 4th hit, that Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to match Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind.
When Severian enters the battlefield, he gains 2 stacks of Shadowflash. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
When Severian has Shadowflash and is not invulnerable, if he is hit by a non-Control Skill enemy attack that he fails to actively dodge or parry, he consumes 1 stack of Shadowflash to automatically dodge the attack and launch Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind.
Successfully dodging an enemy attack with Basic Attack: Swift Edge, automatically dodging an enemy attack with Shadowflash, or directly dodging an enemy attack all count as a Perfect Dodge.
Shadowflash can stack up to 2 times. If Severian gains Shadowflash while already possessing maximum stacks, he gains 1 stack of Windborne instead, and the next Basic Attack: Swift Edge is enhanced to Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind.
Each time Severian performs a Perfect Dodge, he gains 1 stack of Windborne. While Severian has Windborne and is in combat, press [Switch] to switch him from off-field to on-field and launch an Entry Skill.
Severian gains Flow by hitting enemies with certain skills or triggering a Perfect Dodge. Flow is capped at 150 points.
When Flow reaches 100 points, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 100 Flow and launch Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt.

[烁影]最多获取两层，若满层时再获取[烁影]，将获得一层[凭风]效果且下次的[普通攻击：疾锋]会被提升为[普通攻击：烈旋]；
赛维里安每次极限闪避都能获得一层[凭风]效果，当赛维里安拥有[凭风]效果且处于接战状态下点按 【切换键】 从后场切换至前场发动[登场技]；

levels.descriptionEn:

If he dodges it with any of the first three hits of his Basic Attack, he automatically launches Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind. If he dodges it with the 4th hit, that Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to match Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind.
When Severian enters the battlefield, he gains 2 stacks of Shadowflash. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
When Severian has Shadowflash and is not invulnerable, if he is hit by a non-Control Skill enemy attack that he fails to actively dodge or parry, he consumes 1 stack of Shadowflash to automatically dodge the attack and launch Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind.
Successfully dodging an enemy attack with Basic Attack: Swift Edge, automatically dodging an enemy attack with Shadowflash, or directly dodging an enemy attack all count as a Perfect Dodge.
Shadowflash can stack up to 2 times. If Severian gains Shadowflash while already possessing maximum stacks, he gains 1 stack of Windborne instead, and the next Basic Attack: Swift Edge is enhanced to Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind.
Each time Severian performs a Perfect Dodge, he gains 1 stack of Windborne. While Severian has Windborne and is in combat, press [Switch] to switch him from off-field to on-field and launch an Entry Skill.
Severian gains Flow by hitting enemies with certain skills or triggering a Perfect Dodge. Flow is capped at 150 points.
When Flow reaches 100 points, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 100 Flow and launch Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt.

skills.name: 额外能力：最优编配
skills.description:
队伍中存在[支援]、[击破]或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
赛维里安每拥有1%暴击率，会使自身的攻击力提升8.5点，最多计入100%暴击率。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character, or shares the same faction:
For every 1% CRIT Rate Severian has, his ATK increases by 8.5. This effect is capped at 100% CRIT Rate.

cinema.name: 双份浓缩
cinema.description:
赛维里安释放[连携技]累积的[流息]值提升至50点；
赛维里安通过[登场技：清场时刻]入场时，会将招式替换为[连携技]，该招式入场类型不会被改变，且视为非重击，此效果60秒最多生效一次；
赛维里安每次释放[普通攻击：苍风影猎]会获得1层[凭风]效果；
赛维里安的攻击命中目标时无视目标15%的风属性抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Severian uses a Chain Attack, the accumulated Flow increases to 50.
When Severian switches in through Entry Skill: Clear Out, the skill is replaced with a Chain Attack. The entry type is not changed, and it is treated as a non-heavy attack. This effect can trigger once every 60s.
Each time Severian uses Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt, he gains 1 stack of Windborne.
When Severian's attacks hit a target, they ignore 15% of the target's Wind RES.
cinema.story:
苦涩，大概是时刻保持清醒的必要代价。
从舌根透入心底的苦味，是一种足够刺激性的力量，让人得以直视那些潜藏于阴影中的角落。
不是什么愉快的事，但总有人需要去做。
「看起来很苦？我只是需要它的功效。」
cinema.storyEn:
Bitterness, perhaps, is the necessary cost of always staying alert.
That bitter taste, sinking from the root of the tongue into the heart, provides just enough of a jolt to force you to look straight at what lurks in the shadows.
It isn't enjoyable, but someone has to do it.
"Looks bitter? I need the effect, not the taste."

cinema.name: 理性的缰绳
cinema.description:
赛维里安进入战场时回复150点[流息]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
赛维里安触发[极限闪避]时或释放[普通攻击：苍风影猎]时，使自身穿透率提升20%，持续25秒。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Severian enters the battlefield, he recovers 150 Flow. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Severian triggers a Perfect Dodge or uses Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt, his PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 25s.
cinema.story:
「我已经过了喜欢自我感动的时期，泛滥的情感只会产生妨碍。」
案件、伤亡、奖惩、升降、斗争…尘埃落定后再重复一轮。
每一步都需要严密的计算，有时候或许是算计，但都需要把多余的个人感情拴紧一点。
唯有变成铁石，才能在那堵顽固的高墙上，撞出些微裂缝。
cinema.storyEn:
"I've long since outgrown getting swept up in my own emotions. Excess sentiment only becomes an obstacle."
Cases, casualties, rewards and penalties, promotions and demotions, struggles and battles... Once the dust settles, the cycle begins again.
Every step demands careful consideration. Sometimes that may mean being calculating, but either way, unnecessary personal feelings have to be kept on a tight leash.
Only by becoming unyielding as iron can you force even a hairline crack into that immovable wall.

cinema.name: 最后一盏灯
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
无论多晚离开治安局，总能看到他的办公室仍亮着一盏灯。
当然有不满之声，他灯下的身影本身似乎就是一种压力。
但每当事情走入无计可施的黑暗时，所有人也都知道去哪里找最后一盏明灯。
「别有太多不切实际的猜想，我只是在按我的节奏做事。」
cinema.storyEn:
No matter how late you leave the Public Security precinct, there's always a light still on in his office.
There are, of course, those who resent it. The sight of him working beneath that light seems to be a kind of pressure in itself.
But whenever things descend into a darkness with no clear way forward, everyone knows where to find that last remaining light.
"Don't read too much into it. I'm just working at my own pace."

cinema.name: 光与影的界限
cinema.description:
赛维里安进入战斗或换入前场时使自身攻击力提升10%，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
赛维里安释放[普通攻击：烈旋]或释放[普通攻击：苍风影猎]时，提升自身10%喧响值获取效率，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Severian enters combat or switches on-field, his ATK increases by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Severian uses Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind or Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt, his Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10% for 15s.
cinema.story:
「目空一切，不顾体统。」
「听说只要能捞功绩，没有他干不出来的事，一门心思培植心腹…」
「嘘，他过来了。」
穿过寂静的走廊，窗外的阳光照亮了他一半的面容，银发熠熠生辉。
cinema.storyEn:
"Full of himself. No sense of decorum."
"I heard there's nothing he won't do if it means racking up merits. He's completely focused on building up his own inner circle..."
"Shh. He's coming."
He walks through the silent corridor, sunlight from the window illuminating half his face and setting his silver hair aglow.

cinema.name: 非零度的心
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
要如何表达关心呢？在竞选台上挥舞着讲稿，写一封又一封长信，记住各种不同的纪念日？
或者沉默着挡住风雨，站在身后却随时准备伸出援手…
又或者认真地希望着，让所有人活在一个更美好的世界。
「错过了两个家里的电话，要打回去吗…」
cinema.storyEn:
How do you show that you care? By waving a speech in your hand on the campaign stage, writing letter after letter, remembering every different anniversary and special date?
Or by silently shielding someone from the wind and rain, standing behind them and always being ready to lend a hand...?
Or perhaps, just sincerely wishing for everyone to live in a better world.
"I missed two calls from home... Should I call back?"

cinema.name: 在一颗小星星下
cinema.description:
赛维里安的[流息]上限提升至180，进入战场时回复的流息提升至180点；
[普通攻击：苍风影猎]最后一击额外伤害倍率固定提升350%；
[普通攻击：苍风影猎]最后一击释放时获得[风起]效果：每秒积累5点[流息]，持续5秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn:
Severian's max Flow increases to 180, and the Flow gained when entering the battlefield increases to 180.
The additional DMG Multiplier of the final hit of Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt is increased by a fixed 350%.
Upon using the final hit of Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt, Severian gains Windrise: Accumulates 5 Flow per second for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
cinema.story:
鲜花与胜利是好的，但纪念碑就没那么好。
奖章与希望是好的，但告别式就没那么好。
名利喧嚷的白天没那么好，独处的夜晚则更糟，有些事没那么容易忘掉。
「继续前进吧，前进是唯一的答案。」
cinema.storyEn:
Flowers and victory are good things, but monuments are less so.
Medals and hope are good things, but farewells are less so.
The clamor of fame and fortune by day is bad enough, and the nights spent alone are worse. Some things simply aren't that easy to forget.
"Keep moving forward. It's the only solution."

1641.name: 菲欧妮

profile.name: 补充档案
profile.description:
菲欧妮是TOPS「牲鬼」计划最初的实验品之一，常年的实验给她带来了极为罕见的后遗症——「以太富集综合症」。

她的身体会被动地聚拢周围环境中的以太，这使她长期处于一种有气无力的虚弱状态，只有在濒临死亡的刹那，富集的以太才能如燃料般驱动身体，让她获得超越极限的身体机能，真正化身横扫战场的王牌。

然而力量皆有其代价，在经历「涅槃」般剧烈的转变后，她也会陷入远比平时更加虚弱的状态。
受这奇异的病症影响，菲欧妮成为了一个几乎无法死亡，却又好像永远处于虚弱状态的「病人」。

菲欧妮对生死缺乏必要的感知，于她而言，那些对常人来说过分刺激的玩乐行为似乎有着某种特殊的意义。
profile.descriptionEn:
Phoenix was one of the first test subjects in TOPS's "Sacrifice" Project. Years of experimentation left her with an extremely rare aftereffect known as "Ether Accretion Syndrome."

Her body passively draws in Ether from the surrounding environment, leaving her perpetually frail and lethargic. Only when she's on the brink of death can the accumulated Ether fuel her body, pushing her physical capabilities beyond their limits and allowing her to become the battlefield-dominating ace she truly is.

But such power always comes at a price. After experiencing a dramatic transformation much like a "rebirth," she is left far more debilitated than usual. Afflicted by this strange condition, Phoenix has become a "patient" who is nearly impossible to kill, yet seems destined to remain perpetually frail.

Phoenix has little sense of the boundary between life and death. To her, the kinds of "fun" that would be far too extreme for an ordinary person seem to hold a special significance.
