profile.description: · 对她而言，「玩乐」的意义似乎截然不同…
profile.descriptionEn: · For her, "fun" seems to have a very different meaning...

1641.description:
菲欧妮·蕾法爱菈，黑枝的裁决官与隐藏王牌。

与其他裁决官不同，菲欧妮几乎不受理前序的审查与评估环节，只会偶尔负责处理一些非常难缠的「裁决」。若领头人判断需要派遣菲欧妮，那基本意味着事态相当严峻，裁决对象也将受到最严厉的惩戒——死亡已是黑枝仅存的仁慈。

正因如此，菲欧妮才被称为黑枝最锋利也最隐秘的枝条。那些身处高位的人恐惧她的存在，但往往只有审判降临的那天，他们才能一窥她的真容，并震惊于她外在的虚弱。

与沉重的身份不同，菲欧妮性格跳脱，有些自来熟，好奇心过剩，乐此不疲地尝试着各种刺激而危险的「玩乐」——尽管那会让她不断陷入死亡的威胁。
1641.descriptionEn:
Phoenix Reffaella, Krampus Judge and their secret ace.

Unlike the other Judges, Phoenix is rarely involved in the preliminary review and assessment process. She only steps in from time to time to handle particularly troublesome "judgments." If the leader decides Phoenix needs to be deployed, it generally means the situation is extremely serious, and the target will face the harshest punishment of all. Death is the only mercy Krampus has left to offer.

That's exactly why Phoenix is known as Krampus's sharpest and most secretive branch. Those in positions of power fear her very existence, yet most won't lay eyes on her until the day judgment comes for them, only to be stunned by how frail she appears.

Despite the weight of her role, Phoenix herself is lively and spontaneous, a little overly familiar, and endlessly curious. She never seems to tire of trying all kinds of thrilling and dangerous forms of "fun," even though it constantly puts her life at risk.

When the Finishing Move hits an enemy affected by Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers 1 instance of Abloom, dealing Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute with a 405% multiplier.
When this instance of Abloom triggers a critical hit, its CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 40%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

levels.description:
[燔焰]足够时，消耗90点[燔焰]，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
菲欧妮掷出武器，对前方范围的敌人造成大量火属性伤害；
终结一击命中处于冰属性异常状态、以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的敌人时，触发1次[异放]效果，结算425%倍率的对应属性的属性异常伤害；
该次[异放]效果触发暴击时，其暴击伤害额外提升40%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

skills.name: 普通攻击：熔毁
skills.description:
发动[特殊技：掠火]没有触发完美格挡效果时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前突击，造成火属性伤害；
视为[燃烧攻击]；
招式发动期间，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
If Special Attack: Fire Sweep does not trigger a Perfect Block, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Charges forward, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
During this skill, press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 特殊技：掠火
skills.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
后撤过后，快速向前方发动上挑攻击，造成火属性伤害；
后撤期间，受到的伤害降低40%；
上挑攻击开始瞬间受到攻击以及命中出现红色闪光或黄色闪光的敌人时，可触发完美格挡效果，免疫该次伤害，点按 【普通攻击键】 可直接发动第三段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
After retreating back, quickly launches an upward slash forward, dealing Fire DMG.
During the retreat, DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
If attacked at the instant the upward slash begins, or if the slash hits an enemy flashing red or yellow, a Perfect Block is triggered, negating that instance of DMG. Press [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：燎斩
skills.description:
拥有[升变]效果时，消耗1点[升变]，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
后撤过后，快速向前方进行强力上挑斩击，造成大量火属性伤害；
后撤过程中按住 【特殊技键】 可持续蓄力；
蓄力期间，松开 【特殊技键】 时发动强力上挑斩击，造成大量火属性伤害；
衔接在[燃烧攻击]后可以跳过后撤进入上挑攻击；
后撤以及蓄力期间，受到的伤害降低40%；
上挑斩击开始瞬间受到攻击以及命中出现红色闪光或黄色闪光的敌人时，可触发完美格挡效果；
视为[燃烧攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
While possessing Ascension, press [Special Attack] to consume 1 point of Ascension and activate:
After retreating, quickly performs a powerful upward slash, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] while retreating to continue charging.
While charging, release [Special Attack] to perform a powerful upward slash, dealing massive Fire DMG.
When chained into from a Combustion Attack, skips the retreat and immediately performs the upward slash.
DMG taken while retreating and charging is reduced by 40%.
Receiving an attack just as the upward slash begins or hitting an enemy flashing red or yellow triggers a Perfect Block.
This skill counts as a Combustion Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：眩焰
skills.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
快速转动身体，对敌人造成大量火属性伤害；
转动开始瞬间受到攻击以及命中出现红色闪光或黄色闪光的敌人时，可触发完美格挡效果；
视为[燃烧攻击];
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly spins around, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies.
Receiving an attack at the moment the spin begins or hitting an enemy flashing red or yellow triggers a Perfect Block.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 强化特殊技：坠阳
skills.description:
[强化特殊技：眩焰]发动后，能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
升空后掷出武器，对敌人造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时可获得1点[升变]，最多拥有1点[升变]；
升空开始瞬间受到攻击以及命中出现红色闪光或黄色闪光的敌人时，可触发完美格挡效果；
视为[燃烧攻击];
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
After using EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare, and with enough Energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Rises into the air and throws her weapon, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies.
Gains 1 point of Ascension upon activating this skill. Up to 1 point of Ascension can be held.
Receiving an attack at the moment she starts rising or hitting an enemy flashing red or yellow triggers a Perfect Block.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 闪避：飘摇
skills.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 冲刺攻击：倾身
skills.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突进斩击，造成火属性伤害。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Dashes forward and slashes, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: 闪避反击：业火两渡
skills.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Twin Passage of Karmic Fire
skills.description:
触发[极限闪避]时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方突进并发动快速斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
After triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Dashes forward and unleashes a quick slash, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 连携技：绝处逢生
skills.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方发动多段攻击，造成火属性伤害；
视为[燃烧攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes multiple attacks forward, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 终结技：万死重明
skills.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
飞上高空后俯冲向敌人，消耗自身的所有生命值，引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害，进入[生竭]状态，并触发下一个角色的[快速支援]；
视为[燃烧攻击]；
[生竭]状态下无法主动进攻；
招式发动后一段时间自动释放[烬火追魂]，也可点按 【普通攻击键】 快速发动[烬火追魂]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Flies into the air, then dives at the enemy, consuming all of Phoenix's HP to trigger an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Phoenix then enters the Wither state and triggers the next character's Quick Assist.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
Active attacks cannot be performed while in the Wither state.
After using this skill, Soul-Searching Blaze is automatically activated after a short period. Press [Basic Attack] to quickly activate Soul-Searching Blaze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 烬火追魂
skills.description:
当菲欧妮处于[生竭]状态时，下一次普通换入、快速支援、招架支援换入前场时发动：
周身环绕火焰，对周围敌人造成火属性伤害，视为[终结技]伤害，并退出[生竭]状态，回复[终结技：万死重明]消耗的所有生命值，并额外回复自身10%生命值上限的生命值；
终结一击命中处于冰属性异常状态、以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的敌人时，触发1次[异放]效果，结算300%倍率的对应属性的属性异常伤害；
该次[异放]效果触发暴击时，其暴击伤害额外提升40%；
当处于[生竭]状态的菲欧妮通过[连携技：绝处逢生]、[终结技：万死重明]入场时，也会触发上述生命值回复与[异放]效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Triggered when Phoenix is in the Wither state, the next time she enters the field through a normal switch-in, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist:
Phoenix covers herself in flames, dealing Fire DMG to nearby enemies, and exits the Wither state. This damage is considered Ultimate DMG. She then recovers all HP consumed by Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection, plus an additional 10% of her Max HP.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy affected by Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers 1 instance of Abloom, resolving the corresponding Attribute Anomaly at a 300% multiplier.
When this Abloom effect triggers a critical hit, its CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 40%.
When Phoenix enters the field via Chain Attack: Last-Minute Salvation or Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection while in the Wither state, the HP recovery and Abloom effects described above are also triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
skills.levelNote: 显示基础技能等级 1–12；影画带来的额外等级不计入此选择。
skills.levelNoteEn: Base skill levels 1–12; bonus levels from Mindscapes are excluded.

周身环绕火焰，对周围敌人造成火属性伤害，视为[终结技]伤害，并退出[生竭]状态，回复[终结技：万死重明]消耗的所有生命值，并额外回复自身10%生命值上限的生命值；
终结一击命中处于冰属性异常状态、以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的敌人时，触发1次[异放]效果，结算408%倍率的对应属性的属性异常伤害；
该次[异放]效果触发暴击时，其暴击伤害额外提升40%；
当处于[生竭]状态的菲欧妮通过[连携技：绝处逢生]、[终结技：万死重明]入场时，也会触发上述生命值回复与[异放]效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
levels.descriptionEn:
Triggered when Phoenix is in the Wither state, the next time she enters the field through a normal switch-in, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist:
Phoenix covers herself in flames, dealing Fire DMG to nearby enemies, and exits the Wither state. This damage is considered Ultimate DMG. She then recovers all HP consumed by Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection, plus an additional 10% of her Max HP.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy affected by Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers 1 instance of Abloom, resolving the corresponding Attribute Anomaly at a 408% multiplier.
When this Abloom effect triggers a critical hit, its CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 40%.
When Phoenix enters the field via Chain Attack: Last-Minute Salvation or Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection while in the Wither state, the HP recovery and Abloom effects described above are also triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 快速支援：急救
skills.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方突进并发动快速斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Dashes forward and unleashes a quick slash, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 招架支援：久病成医
skills.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
skills.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: 支援突击：再生疗法
skills.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向敌人掷出武器，随后收回武器发动斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Throws her weapon at the enemy, then recalls it and performs a slash, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: 核心被动：涅槃
skills.description:
菲欧妮的异常精通提升43点；
队伍中任意角色对敌人造成属性异常伤害时，会使其陷入[灼蚀]状态，持续20秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；[灼蚀]状态下的敌人受到属性异常伤害时有概率触发暴击，基础暴击率为30%，暴击伤害为12.5%，若菲欧妮的初始异常掌控大于155点，每点超过的异常掌控会使得该效果的暴击率额外提升0.7%；
当菲欧妮的初始异常掌控达到255点时，[灼蚀]状态下的敌人受到属性异常伤害的暴击率达到最大值；
[灼蚀]状态下的敌人每8秒受到菲欧妮25%攻击力的火属性伤害，该伤害视为[强化特殊技]伤害；
[燃烧攻击]发动期间，抗打断等级提升，造成伤害时，会回复[燔焰]，菲欧妮最多拥有120点[燔焰]；
[燃烧攻击]发动后，点按 【特殊技键】 可跳过[特殊技：掠火]以及[强化特殊技：燎斩]的后撤动作，直接衔接上挑攻击；
菲欧妮受到致命伤害时不会战败退场，可触发[重明]效果，下一次普通换入、快速支援、招架支援换入前场时会回复50%最大生命值，在勘域模式中此效果1200秒内最多触发一次；
菲欧妮触发完美格挡效果时，获得5点[燔焰]，10秒内最多触发一次；
菲欧妮发动[强化特殊技]时，进入[枯荣]状态，持续20秒，[燃烧攻击]命中敌人或重复施加时刷新持续时间；
[枯荣]状态下，发动[强化特殊技：眩焰]后，下次发动[强化特殊技：眩焰]会替换为发动[强化特殊技：坠阳]。
skills.descriptionEn:
Phoenix's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 43.
When any squad member deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy, the enemy enters the Sear state for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When an enemy in the Sear state takes Anomaly DMG, the DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit, with a base CRIT Rate of 30% and CRIT DMG of 12.5%. If Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 155, each point above this threshold increases this effect's CRIT Rate by an additional 0.7%, reaching its maximum value when Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery reaches 255.
Enemies in the Sear state take Fire DMG equal to 25% of Phoenix's ATK every 8s. This DMG is considered EX Special Attack DMG.
During Combustion Attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level increases, and dealing DMG grants Pyre. Phoenix can have up to 120 Pyre.
After Combustion Attacks, press [Special Attack] to skip the backward retreat of Special Attack: Fire Sweep and EX Special Attack: Blazing Slash, and immediately follow up with the rising attack.
When Phoenix takes fatal DMG, she will not be defeated and leave the field. Instead, Rebirth is triggered. The next time Phoenix enters the field through a normal switch-in, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist, she recovers HP equal to 50% of her Max HP. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 1,200s.
When Phoenix triggers a Perfect Block, she gains 5 Pyre. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
When Phoenix uses an EX Special Attack, she enters the Wither and Bloom state for 20s. Hitting an enemy with a Combustion Attack or reapplying this state refreshes its duration.
While in the Wither and Bloom state, after using EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare, the next EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare is replaced with EX Special Attack: Falling Sun.
skills.levelNote: 1 对应基础，2–7 分别对应核心强化 A–F。
skills.levelNoteEn: 1 is Base; 2–7 correspond to Core Enhancements A–F.

levels.description:
菲欧妮的异常精通提升43点；
队伍中任意角色对敌人造成属性异常伤害时，会使其陷入[灼蚀]状态，持续20秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；[灼蚀]状态下的敌人受到属性异常伤害时有概率触发暴击，基础暴击率为30%，暴击伤害为12.5%，若菲欧妮的初始异常掌控大于155点，每点超过的异常掌控会使得该效果的暴击率额外提升0.7%；
当菲欧妮的初始异常掌控达到255点时，[灼蚀]状态下的敌人受到属性异常伤害的暴击率达到最大值；
[灼蚀]状态下的敌人每8秒受到菲欧妮25%攻击力的火属性伤害，该伤害视为[强化特殊技]伤害；
[燃烧攻击]发动期间，抗打断等级提升，造成伤害时，会回复[燔焰]，菲欧妮最多拥有120点[燔焰]；
[燃烧攻击]发动后，点按 【特殊技键】 可跳过[特殊技：掠火]以及[强化特殊技：燎斩]的后撤动作，直接衔接上挑攻击；
菲欧妮受到致命伤害时不会战败退场，可触发[重明]效果，下一次普通换入、快速支援、招架支援换入前场时会回复50%最大生命值，在勘域模式中此效果1200秒内最多触发一次；
菲欧妮触发完美格挡效果时，获得5点[燔焰]，10秒内最多触发一次；
菲欧妮发动[强化特殊技]时，进入[枯荣]状态，持续20秒，[燃烧攻击]命中敌人或重复施加时刷新持续时间；
[枯荣]状态下，发动[强化特殊技：眩焰]后，下次发动[强化特殊技：眩焰]会替换为发动[强化特殊技：坠阳]。
levels.descriptionEn:
Phoenix's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 43.
When any squad member deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy, the enemy enters the Sear state for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When an enemy in the Sear state takes Anomaly DMG, the DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit, with a base CRIT Rate of 30% and CRIT DMG of 12.5%. If Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 155, each point above this threshold increases this effect's CRIT Rate by an additional 0.7%, reaching its maximum value when Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery reaches 255.
Enemies in the Sear state take Fire DMG equal to 25% of Phoenix's ATK every 8s. This DMG is considered EX Special Attack DMG.
During Combustion Attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level increases, and dealing DMG grants Pyre. Phoenix can have up to 120 Pyre.
After Combustion Attacks, press [Special Attack] to skip the backward retreat of Special Attack: Fire Sweep and EX Special Attack: Blazing Slash, and immediately follow up with the rising attack.
When Phoenix takes fatal DMG, she will not be defeated and leave the field. Instead, Rebirth is triggered. The next time Phoenix enters the field through a normal switch-in, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist, she recovers HP equal to 50% of her Max HP. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 1,200s.
When Phoenix triggers a Perfect Block, she gains 5 Pyre. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
When Phoenix uses an EX Special Attack, she enters the Wither and Bloom state for 20s. Hitting an enemy with a Combustion Attack or reapplying this state refreshes its duration.
While in the Wither and Bloom state, after using EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare, the next EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare is replaced with EX Special Attack: Falling Sun.

队伍中任意角色对敌人造成属性异常伤害时，会使其陷入[灼蚀]状态，持续20秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；[灼蚀]状态下的敌人受到属性异常伤害时有概率触发暴击，基础暴击率为30%，暴击伤害为25%，若菲欧妮的初始异常掌控大于155点，每点超过的异常掌控会使得该效果的暴击率额外提升0.7%；
当菲欧妮的初始异常掌控达到255点时，[灼蚀]状态下的敌人受到属性异常伤害的暴击率达到最大值；
[灼蚀]状态下的敌人每8秒受到菲欧妮50%攻击力的火属性伤害，该伤害视为[强化特殊技]伤害；
[燃烧攻击]发动期间，抗打断等级提升，造成伤害时，会回复[燔焰]，菲欧妮最多拥有120点[燔焰]；
[燃烧攻击]发动后，点按 【特殊技键】 可跳过[特殊技：掠火]以及[强化特殊技：燎斩]的后撤动作，直接衔接上挑攻击；
菲欧妮受到致命伤害时不会战败退场，可触发[重明]效果，下一次普通换入、快速支援、招架支援换入前场时会回复50%最大生命值，在勘域模式中此效果1200秒内最多触发一次；
菲欧妮触发完美格挡效果时，获得5点[燔焰]，10秒内最多触发一次；
菲欧妮发动[强化特殊技]时，进入[枯荣]状态，持续20秒，[燃烧攻击]命中敌人或重复施加时刷新持续时间；
[枯荣]状态下，发动[强化特殊技：眩焰]后，下次发动[强化特殊技：眩焰]会替换为发动[强化特殊技：坠阳]。
levels.descriptionEn:
Phoenix's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 85.
When any squad member deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy, the enemy enters the Sear state for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When an enemy in the Sear state takes Anomaly DMG, the DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit, with a base CRIT Rate of 30% and CRIT DMG of 25%. If Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 155, each point above this threshold increases this effect's CRIT Rate by an additional 0.7%, reaching its maximum value when Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery reaches 255.
Enemies in the Sear state take Fire DMG equal to 50% of Phoenix's ATK every 8s. This DMG is considered EX Special Attack DMG.
During Combustion Attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level increases, and dealing DMG grants Pyre. Phoenix can have up to 120 Pyre.
After Combustion Attacks, press [Special Attack] to skip the backward retreat of Special Attack: Fire Sweep and EX Special Attack: Blazing Slash, and immediately follow up with the rising attack.
When Phoenix takes fatal DMG, she will not be defeated and leave the field. Instead, Rebirth is triggered. The next time Phoenix enters the field through a normal switch-in, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist, she recovers HP equal to 50% of her Max HP. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 1,200s.
When Phoenix triggers a Perfect Block, she gains 5 Pyre. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
When Phoenix uses an EX Special Attack, she enters the Wither and Bloom state for 20s. Hitting an enemy with a Combustion Attack or reapplying this state refreshes its duration.
While in the Wither and Bloom state, after using EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare, the next EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare is replaced with EX Special Attack: Falling Sun.

skills.name: 额外能力：黑枝王牌
skills.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或同阵营角色时触发：
[灼蚀]状态下的敌人受到属性异常伤害的暴击伤害提升15%。
skills.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same faction:
Anomaly DMG against enemies in the Sear state gains 15% increased CRIT DMG.

cinema.name: 痛觉残留与刺激游行
cinema.description:
进入战场时，菲欧妮获得1点[升变]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
[灼蚀]状态下的敌人受到属性异常伤害的暴击伤害额外提升25%；
[燃烧攻击]造成伤害时，[燔焰]的获取效率提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, Phoenix gains 1 point of Ascension. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
The CRIT DMG of Anomaly DMG dealt to enemies in the Sear state is increased by an additional 25%.
When a Combustion Attack deals DMG, Pyre generation efficiency increases by 15%.
cinema.story:
求索极限，舔舐痛苦，沿着伤痕留下的足迹蹒跚前行，仿佛那里存在着一瞬鲜活的自己。
疼痛是游行的鼓点，心跳是唯一不会谢幕的掌声。
cinema.storyEn:
Chasing the limits, savoring the pain, stumbling onward along the trail left by old wounds, as if they might lead to a fleeting moment of truly being alive.
Pain beats the drum for the march, while the heart provides the only applause that never ends.

cinema.name: 好奇心害不死猫
cinema.description:
菲欧妮对敌人施加[灼烧]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升2秒；
菲欧妮对[灼蚀]状态下的敌人造成的伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Phoenix applies Burn to an enemy, its duration is increased by 2s.
Phoenix's DMG against enemies in the Sear state increases by 30%.
cinema.story:
他们说，猫有九条命，所以可以肆意攀上最高的屋檐。
她也总爱踮起脚尖，任凭一脚踏空，漫长的坠落不过又一场无趣的冒险。
循着危险散落的蛛丝马迹一路向前，永远不会抵达故事的终点。
cinema.storyEn:
They say cats have nine lives, so they can climb the highest rooftops without a care.
She likes to walk on tiptoe too, and if one step finds nothing beneath it, the long fall is merely another unremarkable adventure.
Following the trail of clues danger leaves behind, she keeps moving forward, with the end of the story forever out of reach.

cinema.name: 稻草人症候群
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
伴随着滴答滴答的心跳，她再次醒来，眼前是熟悉又陌生的天花板。
她侧耳倾听护士讲述那个遥远的童话——在生命的尽头，有一座高墙环绕、与世隔绝的云上小镇，那里没有烦恼也没有恐惧，没有痛苦也没有悲伤。
无忧的稻草人们栖居其中，日复一日，安静而幸福地生活。因为他们没有情感也没有爱，因为他们失去了影子，也失去了心。
她听得很认真，像在辨认一个自己曾反复拒绝的邀请。
cinema.storyEn:
With the steady tick-tock of her heartbeat, she wakes again beneath a ceiling that feels at once familiar and unfamiliar.
She listens as the nurse tells her a distant fairy tale: at the end of life lies a town above the clouds, cut off from the world behind towering walls. There are no worries or fears there, no pain or sorrow.
Carefree scarecrows make their home there, living quietly and happily, day after day. For they have no feelings and no love. They have lost their shadows and their hearts as well.
She listens intently, as though recognizing an invitation she has rejected countless times before.

cinema.name: 生命尽头与冷酷仙境
cinema.nameEn: Life's End and the Heartless Wonderland
cinema.description:
[烬火追魂]以及[普通攻击：焚罪]终结一击命中处于异常状态的敌人时，
额外触发一次[异放]效果，固定结算600%倍率的对应属性的属性异常伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: When the Finishing Move of Soul-Searching Blaze or Basic Attack: Purifying Flame hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers 1 additional instance of Abloom, resolving the corresponding Attribute Anomaly DMG at a fixed 600% multiplier.
cinema.story:
她曾无数次抵达生命的尽头，那里没有云上的小镇，也没有失去心的稻草人。只有一堵高墙耸立，询问她愿不愿意用影子与心换取永久的安宁。
她摸了摸自己的影子，心就在那里，笨拙而顽固地跳动。她还有影子，她想要留下心。
于是她一次次走进深林，一次次从尽头折返。哪怕没有阳光，没有庇护，只有荆棘、伤口和漫无止境的放逐。
没关系，她早已习惯，尽管无法抵达，至少还可以追寻。
cinema.storyEn:
She has reached the end of life countless times. There is no town above the clouds, no scarecrows who have lost their hearts. There is only a towering wall, asking if she would trade her shadow and her heart for eternal peace.
She touches her shadow. Her heart is there, beating awkwardly, stubbornly. She still has a shadow. She wants to hold on to her heart.
So she enters the deep forest again and again, and each time, she turns back at the very end. Even if there is no sunlight, no refuge, only thorns, wounds, and an exile without end.
That's okay. She's used to it by now. Even if she can never arrive, she can at least keep searching.

cinema.name: 狂欢马戏团
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
cinema.story:
世界皆舞台，人们总要出演自己一生的故事，她也不例外。
她是可怜的病患，她是正义的判官；她是喜怒无常的处刑者，她是肆意妄为的冒险家；她是对一切兴致盎然的孩子，她是对伤痛漠不关心的怪人…
她可以是任何人，可这些人中没有一个叫做菲欧妮。
她亲近所有人，却从未亲近自己；她热衷死亡，却不曾真正活过。
但那早已无关紧要，舞台永不落幕，她要做的事唯有一件：选择面具，然后开始扮演自己。
——那就扮演一位马戏团里的小丑吧。永远热热闹闹，永远放声欢笑。
cinema.storyEn:
The world is a stage, and everyone has a part to play in the story of their life. She is no different.
She is the helpless patient and the righteous judge; a capricious executioner, a reckless adventurer; a child fascinated by everything, a strange soul indifferent to pain...
She can be anyone. But none of those people are Phoenix.
She embraces everyone but herself. She delights in death, yet has never truly known what it means to live.
But that stopped mattering long ago. The show must go on, and she has only one thing to do: choose a mask and start playing herself.
So why not play a circus clown? Always making a scene, always laughing out loud.

cinema.name: 禁闭室手记
cinema.description:
菲欧妮无视目标15%全属性伤害抗性；
菲欧妮发动[强化特殊技：眩焰]时，获得1点[升变]；
菲欧妮触发的[异放]效果无视敌人40%防御力。
cinema.descriptionEn:
Phoenix ignores 15% of the targets' All-Attribute RES.
When Phoenix uses EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare, she gains 1 point of Ascension.
Abloom effects triggered by Phoenix ignore 40% of enemy DEF.
cinema.story:
她仍向深夜索要一场盛大的坠落，仍喜欢听见风从耳畔撕裂而过；
她仍旧拥抱荆棘，任世界的锋刃刺入血肉，任鲜血沿着旧日的足迹淌向深渊。
可这一次，荆棘不再落回泥壤。
有人不由分说地闯进她的小小庭院，拾起她遗落的枝桠，缠住门扉，绕上窗棂，筑起一道歪歪扭扭的篱墙，然后挡在她的身前，堵住她荒芜的去路。
她几经犹豫，终于收回了脚步。
cinema.storyEn:
She still asks the dead of night for one grand fall, still loves the sound of the wind tearing past her ears.
She still embraces the thorns, letting the world's sharp edges pierce her flesh, letting her blood follow the tracks of days gone by into the abyss.
But this time, the thorns don't fall back into the soil.
Someone barges into her little garden without so much as asking, picks up the branches she's left behind, winds them around the gate and window frames, and builds a crooked little fence. Then they stand before her, blocking the desolate path ahead.
She hesitates time and again, but finally takes a step back.
